````typescript
import { StateEffect, StateField } from '@codemirror/state';
import { Decoration, type DecorationSet, WidgetType, EditorView } from '@codemirror/view';
import type { Collaborator } from '../types/latex';

export const setPeersEffect = StateEffect.define<Collaborator[]>();

class PeerCursorWidget extends WidgetType {
  name: string;
  color: string;

  constructor(name: string, color: string) {
    super();
    this.name = name;
    this.color = color;
  }

  toDOM(): HTMLElement {
    const span = document.createElement('span');
    span.className = 'cm-peer-cursor';
    span.style.borderLeft = `2px solid ${this.color}`;
    span.style.marginLeft = '-1px';
    span.style.marginRight = '-1px';
    span.style.position = 'relative';
    span.style.display = 'inline-block';
    span.style.height = '1.25em';
    span.style.verticalAlign = 'text-bottom';
    span.style.pointerEvents = 'none';

    const label = document.createElement('span');
    label.className = 'cm-peer-label';
    label.textContent = this.name;
    label.style.position = 'absolute';
    label.style.top = '-1.35em';
    label.style.left = '-1px';
    label.style.backgroundColor = this.color;
    label.style.color = '#ffffff';
    label.style.fontSize = '10px';
    label.style.fontWeight = '600';
    label.style.lineHeight = '1';
    label.style.padding = '2px 5px';
    label.style.borderRadius = '3px';
    label.style.boxShadow = '0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)';
    label.style.whiteSpace = 'nowrap';
    label.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
    label.style.zIndex = '20';

    span.appendChild(label);
    return span;
  }

  eq(other: PeerCursorWidget): boolean {
    return other.name === this.name && other.color === this.color;
  }

  ignoreEvent(): boolean {
    return true;
  }
}

/**
 * StateField that manages real-time peer collaborator cursor flags on the CodeMirror 6 canvas.
 */
export const peerDecorationsField = StateField.define<DecorationSet>({
  create() {
    return Decoration.none;
  },
  update(decorations, tr) {
    for (const effect of tr.effects) {
      if (effect.is(setPeersEffect)) {
        const peers = effect.value;
        const widgets: { from: number; widget: Decoration }[] = [];

        for (const peer of peers) {
          if (peer.isSelf) continue;

          const targetLine = Math.max(1, Math.min(peer.cursorLine || 1, tr.state.doc.lines));
          const lineInfo = tr.state.doc.line(targetLine);
          const targetCol = Math.max(0, Math.min(peer.cursorCol || 0, lineInfo.length));
          const pos = lineInfo.from + targetCol;

          widgets.push({
            from: pos,
            widget: Decoration.widget({
              widget: new PeerCursorWidget(peer.name, peer.color || '#38bdf8'),
              side: 1,
            }),
          });
        }

        // Sort widgets by position to build valid range set
        widgets.sort((a, b) => a.from - b.from);
        return Decoration.set(widgets.map((w) => w.widget.range(w.from)));
      }
    }
    return decorations.map(tr.changes);
  },
  provide: (f) => EditorView.decorations.from(f),
});
````

````typescript
import { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import type { Checkpoint } from '../services/checkpointsService';
import {
  loadProjectCheckpoints,
  createCheckpoint,
  createCommit,
  deleteCheckpoint,
  fetchProjectCheckpointsFromCloud,
  pushCommitsToCloud,
  getWorkingTreeStatus,
  getActiveBranch,
  setActiveBranch,
  getProjectBranches,
  createBranch,
  deleteBranch,
  hydrateCheckpointsFromOffline,
  createAutoSaveCheckpointIfNeeded,
} from '../services/checkpointsService';
import { isSupabaseConnected } from '../services/supabaseClient';
import { projectStore, useProjectStore } from '../stores/projectStore';
import type { UserProfile, ProjectFile } from '../types/latex';

interface UseProjectCheckpointsOptions {
  activeProjectId: string;
  currentUser: UserProfile | null;
  authorName: string;
  onToast?: (message: string) => void;
  setFiles?: (files: ProjectFile[] | ((prev: ProjectFile[]) => ProjectFile[])) => void;
}

export function useProjectCheckpoints({
  activeProjectId,
  currentUser,
  authorName,
  onToast,
  setFiles,
}: UseProjectCheckpointsOptions) {
  // Listen to files only for working tree diff calculation
  const files = useProjectStore(s => s.files);

  // Checkpoints list
  const [checkpoints, setCheckpoints] = useState<Checkpoint[]>(() => {
    return loadProjectCheckpoints(activeProjectId, undefined, currentUser?.fullName || authorName || 'You');
  });

  // Load checkpoints on project switch or user profile change — strictly decoupled from keystroke updates
  useEffect(() => {
    const localCps = loadProjectCheckpoints(activeProjectId, undefined, currentUser?.fullName || authorName || 'You');
    setCheckpoints(localCps);

    hydrateCheckpointsFromOffline(activeProjectId)
      .then(offlineCps => {
        if (offlineCps && offlineCps.length > localCps.length) {
          setCheckpoints(offlineCps);
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {});

    if (isSupabaseConnected()) {
      fetchProjectCheckpointsFromCloud(activeProjectId)
        .then(res => {
          if (res.success && res.checkpoints && res.checkpoints.length > 0) {
            setCheckpoints(res.checkpoints);
          }
        })
        .catch(() => {});
    }
  }, [activeProjectId, currentUser?.fullName, authorName]);

  // Periodic Autosave Checkpoints (every 5 minutes during active session) — reads latest files on-demand
  useEffect(() => {
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      if (!activeProjectId) return;
      const currentFiles = projectStore.getState().files;
      if (!currentFiles || currentFiles.length === 0) return;
      const newCp = createAutoSaveCheckpointIfNeeded(
        activeProjectId,
        currentFiles,
        currentUser?.fullName || authorName || 'You'
      );
      if (newCp) {
        setCheckpoints(prev => [newCp, ...prev.filter(c => c.id !== newCp.id)]);
      }
    }, 5 * 60 * 1000);

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [activeProjectId, currentUser?.fullName, authorName]);

  // Working tree status for git staging/diff
  const workingTreeStatus = useMemo(() => {
    const head = checkpoints[0] || null;
    return getWorkingTreeStatus(files, head);
  }, [files, checkpoints]);

  // Git branches
  const [activeBranch, setActiveBranchState] = useState<string>(() => {
    return getActiveBranch(activeProjectId) || 'main';
  });
  const [projectBranches, setProjectBranches] = useState<string[]>(() => {
    return getProjectBranches(activeProjectId);
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    queueMicrotask(() => {
      setActiveBranchState(getActiveBranch(activeProjectId));
      setProjectBranches(getProjectBranches(activeProjectId));
    });
  }, [activeProjectId]);

  const handleSwitchBranch = useCallback((branchName: string, checkoutHead = false) => {
    setActiveBranch(activeProjectId, branchName);
    setActiveBranchState(branchName);
    if (onToast) onToast(`Switched to branch "${branchName}"`);

    if (checkoutHead && setFiles) {
      const cps = loadProjectCheckpoints(activeProjectId);
      const branchHead = cps.find(c => (c.branch || 'main') === branchName) || cps[0];
      if (branchHead && branchHead.files.length > 0) {
        setFiles(branchHead.files);
        if (onToast) onToast(`Checked out branch "${branchName}" (${branchHead.shortSha})`);
      }
    }
  }, [activeProjectId, onToast, setFiles]);

  const handleCreateBranch = useCallback((branchName: string) => {
    const res = createBranch(activeProjectId, branchName);
    if (res.success) {
      const updated = getProjectBranches(activeProjectId);
      setProjectBranches(updated);
      setActiveBranchState(branchName.trim().replace(/\s+/g, '-').toLowerCase());
      if (onToast) onToast(`Created and switched to branch "${branchName}"`);
    } else {
      if (onToast) onToast(`Failed to create branch: ${res.error || 'Error'}`);
    }
  }, [activeProjectId, onToast]);

  const handleDeleteBranch = useCallback((branchName: string) => {
    const res = deleteBranch(activeProjectId, branchName);
    if (res.success) {
      setProjectBranches(getProjectBranches(activeProjectId));
      if (onToast) onToast(`Deleted branch "${branchName}"`);
    } else {
      if (onToast) onToast(`Failed to delete branch: ${res.error || 'Error'}`);
    }
  }, [activeProjectId, onToast]);

  const handleCreateCommit = useCallback((message: string, description?: string) => {
    const currentBranch = getActiveBranch(activeProjectId) || 'main';
    const currentFiles = projectStore.getState().files;
    const newCommit = createCommit(
      activeProjectId,
      message,
      currentUser?.fullName || authorName || 'You',
      currentFiles,
      description,
      currentBranch,
      currentUser?.email || ''
    );
    setCheckpoints(prev => [newCommit, ...prev.filter(c => c.id !== newCommit.id)]);
    if (onToast) onToast(`Committed: ${message} (${newCommit.shortSha})`);
  }, [activeProjectId, currentUser?.fullName, currentUser?.email, authorName, onToast]);

  const handlePushCommits = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!isSupabaseConnected()) {
      if (onToast) onToast('Supabase Cloud is not connected — commits saved locally');
      return;
    }
    try {
      const res = await pushCommitsToCloud(activeProjectId);
      if (res.success) {
        setCheckpoints(loadProjectCheckpoints(activeProjectId));
        if (onToast) onToast(`Pushed ${res.pushedCount} commit${res.pushedCount === 1 ? '' : 's'} to Cloud`);
      } else {
        if (onToast) onToast(`Push failed: ${res.error || 'Network error'}`);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (onToast) onToast(`Push failed: ${err?.message || 'Error'}`);
    }
  }, [activeProjectId, onToast]);

  const handlePullCommits = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!isSupabaseConnected()) {
      if (onToast) onToast('Supabase Cloud is not connected');
      return;
    }
    try {
      const res = await fetchProjectCheckpointsFromCloud(activeProjectId);
      if (res.success && res.checkpoints) {
        setCheckpoints(res.checkpoints);
        if (onToast) onToast(`Pulled ${res.checkpoints.length} versions from Cloud`);
      } else {
        if (onToast) onToast(`Pull failed: ${res.error || 'Network error'}`);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (onToast) onToast(`Pull failed: ${err?.message || 'Error'}`);
    }
  }, [activeProjectId, onToast]);

  const handleCreateCheckpoint = useCallback((name: string) => {
    const currentFiles = projectStore.getState().files;
    const newCp = createCheckpoint(
      activeProjectId,
      name,
      currentUser?.fullName || authorName || 'You',
      currentFiles,
      false
    );
    setCheckpoints(prev => [newCp, ...prev.filter(c => c.id !== newCp.id)]);
    if (onToast) onToast(`Snapshot "${name}" saved to history`);
  }, [activeProjectId, currentUser?.fullName, authorName, onToast]);

  const handleDeleteCheckpoint = useCallback((cpId: string) => {
    deleteCheckpoint(activeProjectId, cpId)
      .then(updated => {
        setCheckpoints(updated);
        if (onToast) onToast('Checkpoint deleted');
      })
      .catch(() => {});
  }, [activeProjectId, onToast]);

  const handleSyncCheckpointsCloud = useCallback(() => {
    if (!isSupabaseConnected()) {
      if (onToast) onToast('Supabase is not connected');
      return;
    }
    fetchProjectCheckpointsFromCloud(activeProjectId)
      .then(res => {
        if (res.success && res.checkpoints) {
          setCheckpoints(res.checkpoints);
          if (onToast) onToast(`Checkpoints synchronized (${res.checkpoints.length} versions)`);
        } else {
          if (onToast) onToast('Cloud sync completed');
        }
      })
      .catch(err => {
        if (onToast) onToast('Cloud sync error: ' + (err?.message || 'Unknown'));
      });
  }, [activeProjectId, onToast]);

  return {
    checkpoints,
    setCheckpoints,
    activeBranch,
````

````typescript
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';

interface BeforeInstallPromptEvent extends Event {
  readonly platforms: string[];
  readonly userChoice: Promise<{
    outcome: 'accepted' | 'dismissed';
    platform: string;
  }>;
  prompt(): Promise<void>;
}

export function usePwaInstall() {
  const [deferredPrompt, setDeferredPrompt] = useState<BeforeInstallPromptEvent | null>(null);
  const [isInstallable, setIsInstallable] = useState(false);
  const [isInstalled, setIsInstalled] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Check if already running in standalone mode (desktop or mobile PWA)
    const isStandalone =
      window.matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)').matches ||
      (window.navigator as unknown as { standalone?: boolean }).standalone === true;

    if (isStandalone) {
      setIsInstalled(true);
      return;
    }

    const handleBeforeInstallPrompt = (e: Event) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      setDeferredPrompt(e as BeforeInstallPromptEvent);
      setIsInstallable(true);
    };

    const handleAppInstalled = () => {
      setIsInstalled(true);
      setIsInstallable(false);
      setDeferredPrompt(null);
    };

    window.addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', handleBeforeInstallPrompt);
    window.addEventListener('appinstalled', handleAppInstalled);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', handleBeforeInstallPrompt);
      window.removeEventListener('appinstalled', handleAppInstalled);
    };
  }, []);

  const installApp = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!deferredPrompt) return false;

    await deferredPrompt.prompt();
    const { outcome } = await deferredPrompt.userChoice;
    setDeferredPrompt(null);
    setIsInstallable(false);
    return outcome === 'accepted';
  }, [deferredPrompt]);

  return { isInstallable, isInstalled, installApp };
}
````

````typescript
import { useState, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';

export interface UseResizableSplitOptions {
  storageKey?: string;
  defaultPercent?: number;
  minPercent?: number;
  maxPercent?: number;
}

export function useResizableSplit(options: UseResizableSplitOptions = {}) {
  const {
    storageKey = 'teeex_split_percent',
    defaultPercent = 50,
    minPercent = 20,
    maxPercent = 80,
  } = options;

  const [splitPercent, setSplitPercent] = useState<number>(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(storageKey);
      if (saved !== null) {
        const val = parseFloat(saved);
        if (!isNaN(val) && val >= minPercent && val <= maxPercent) {
          return val;
        }
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore storage errors
    }
    return defaultPercent;
  });

  const [isDraggingSplit, setIsDraggingSplit] = useState(false);
  const rafIdRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

  const savePercent = useCallback((percent: number) => {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(storageKey, String(percent));
    } catch {
      // Ignore storage errors
    }
  }, [storageKey]);

  const updateSplit = useCallback((percent: number) => {
    const clamped = Math.min(maxPercent, Math.max(minPercent, percent));
    setSplitPercent(clamped);
    savePercent(clamped);
  }, [maxPercent, minPercent, savePercent]);

  const handlePointerDownSplit = useCallback((e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
    setIsDraggingSplit(true);
    e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
  }, []);

  const handlePointerMoveSplit = useCallback((
    e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
    sidebarWidth: number
  ) => {
    if (!isDraggingSplit) return;
    if (rafIdRef.current !== null) return;

    rafIdRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      rafIdRef.current = null;
      const availableWidth = window.innerWidth - sidebarWidth;
      if (availableWidth <= 0) return;
      const mouseRelativeX = e.clientX - sidebarWidth;
      const newPercent = (mouseRelativeX / availableWidth) * 100;
      updateSplit(newPercent);
    });
  }, [isDraggingSplit, updateSplit]);

  const handlePointerUpSplit = useCallback((e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
    if (isDraggingSplit) {
      setIsDraggingSplit(false);
      try {
        if (e.currentTarget.hasPointerCapture(e.pointerId)) {
          e.currentTarget.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);
        }
      } catch {
        // Ignore pointer capture release error if detached
      }
    }
  }, [isDraggingSplit]);

  const cyclePresetSplit = useCallback(() => {
    setSplitPercent(prev => {
      let next: number;
      if (Math.abs(prev - 50) < 3) next = 70;
      else if (Math.abs(prev - 70) < 3) next = 30;
      else next = 50;
      savePercent(next);
      return next;
    });
  }, [savePercent]);

  const handleKeyDownSplit = useCallback((e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
    const step = e.shiftKey ? 5 : 2;
    let handled = false;

    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      updateSplit(splitPercent - step);
      handled = true;
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      updateSplit(splitPercent + step);
      handled = true;
    } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
      updateSplit(minPercent);
      handled = true;
    } else if (e.key === 'End') {
      updateSplit(maxPercent);
      handled = true;
    } else if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
      cyclePresetSplit();
      handled = true;
    }

    if (handled) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
    }
  }, [cyclePresetSplit, maxPercent, minPercent, splitPercent, updateSplit]);

  return {
    splitPercent,
    setSplitPercent: updateSplit,
    isDraggingSplit,
    handlePointerDownSplit,
    handlePointerMoveSplit,
    handlePointerUpSplit,
    handleKeyDownSplit,
    cyclePresetSplit,
  };
}
````

````typescript
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';

export type Theme = 'dark' | 'light';

export function useTheme() {
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState<Theme>(() => {
    const saved = (localStorage.getItem('teeex_theme') as Theme) || 'dark';
    if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
      document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', saved);
    }
    return saved;
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', theme);
    localStorage.setItem('teeex_theme', theme);
  }, [theme]);

  const toggleTheme = useCallback(() => {
    setTheme(prev => (prev === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark'));
  }, []);

  return { theme, setTheme, toggleTheme };
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Teeex — Unified Diagnostics Hook.
 * Merges high-speed AST parser diagnostics (from Web Worker) with
 * authoritative TeX log compiler diagnostics (from pdfTeX / busytex).
 * Normalizes severities, deduplicates matching issues, and provides
 * a 1-click quick-fix applicator that modifies the target project file.
 */

import { useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import type { Diagnostic as ParserDiagnostic, ProjectFile } from '../types/latex';
import type { CompileDiagnostic, DiagnosticSuggestedFix } from '../services/texLog';

export interface UnifiedDiagnostic {
  id: string;
  source: 'parser' | 'compiler';
  severity: 'error' | 'warning' | 'info';
  code?: string;
  message: string;
  file?: string;
  line?: number;
  endLine?: number;
  column?: number;
  context?: string;
  hint?: string;
  suggestedFix?: DiagnosticSuggestedFix;
}

export interface UseUnifiedDiagnosticsOptions {
  parserDiagnostics?: ParserDiagnostic[];
  compilerDiagnostics?: CompileDiagnostic[];
  activeFileName?: string;
}

export interface UnifiedDiagnosticsResult {
  diagnostics: UnifiedDiagnostic[];
  errorCount: number;
  warningCount: number;
  infoCount: number;
  applyQuickFix: (
    diagnosticId: string,
    files: ProjectFile[],
    updateFileContent: (fileId: string, newContent: string) => void
  ) => boolean;
}

export function useUnifiedDiagnostics({
  parserDiagnostics = [],
  compilerDiagnostics = [],
  activeFileName = 'main.tex',
}: UseUnifiedDiagnosticsOptions): UnifiedDiagnosticsResult {
  const diagnostics = useMemo<UnifiedDiagnostic[]>(() => {
    const list: UnifiedDiagnostic[] = [];
    const seenSignatures = new Set<string>();

    // 1. Authoritative TeX compiler diagnostics
    for (const c of compilerDiagnostics) {
      const sig = `${c.file || activeFileName}:${c.line || 0}:${c.code || c.message}`;
      seenSignatures.add(sig);

      list.push({
        id: c.id,
        source: 'compiler',
        severity: c.severity,
        code: c.code,
        message: c.message,
        file: c.file || activeFileName,
        line: c.line,
        endLine: c.endLine,
        context: c.context,
        hint: c.hint,
        suggestedFix: c.suggestedFix,
      });
    }

    // 2. High-speed AST parser diagnostics (suppress duplicates on same file & line)
    for (const p of parserDiagnostics) {
      const targetFile = activeFileName;
      const sig1 = `${targetFile}:${p.line}:${p.rule}`;
      const sig2 = `${targetFile}:${p.line}:syntax`;
      if (seenSignatures.has(sig1) || seenSignatures.has(sig2)) continue;

      let fix: DiagnosticSuggestedFix | undefined;
      if (p.suggestedFix) {
        fix = {
          title: p.suggestedFix.title,
          description: p.suggestedFix.description || '',
          replacement: p.suggestedFix.replacement,
          startLine: p.suggestedFix.startLine ?? p.line,
          endLine: p.suggestedFix.endLine ?? p.line,
        };
      }

      list.push({
        id: p.id,
        source: 'parser',
        severity: p.severity,
        code: p.rule,
        message: p.message,
        file: targetFile,
        line: p.line,
        column: p.column,
        hint: p.rawLog,
        suggestedFix: fix,
      });
    }

    // Sort by severity (error > warning > info) and then by line number
    const severityWeight = { error: 0, warning: 1, info: 2 };
    return list.sort((a, b) => {
      const sw = severityWeight[a.severity] - severityWeight[b.severity];
      if (sw !== 0) return sw;
      return (a.line || 0) - (b.line || 0);
    });
  }, [parserDiagnostics, compilerDiagnostics, activeFileName]);

  const errorCount = useMemo(() => diagnostics.filter((d) => d.severity === 'error').length, [diagnostics]);
  const warningCount = useMemo(() => diagnostics.filter((d) => d.severity === 'warning').length, [diagnostics]);
  const infoCount = useMemo(() => diagnostics.filter((d) => d.severity === 'info').length, [diagnostics]);

  const applyQuickFix = useCallback(
    (
      diagnosticId: string,
      files: ProjectFile[],
      updateFileContent: (fileId: string, newContent: string) => void
    ): boolean => {
      const diag = diagnostics.find((d) => d.id === diagnosticId);
      if (!diag || !diag.suggestedFix) return false;

      const fix = diag.suggestedFix;
      const targetFileName = diag.file || activeFileName;
      const targetFile =
        files.find((f) => f.name === targetFileName || f.id === targetFileName) ||
        files.find((f) => f.name.endsWith(targetFileName)) ||
        files[0];

      if (!targetFile || typeof targetFile.content !== 'string') return false;

      const lines = targetFile.content.split('\n');
      const startIdx = Math.max(0, fix.startLine - 1);
      const endIdx = Math.min(lines.length - 1, fix.endLine - 1);

      // If replacement starts with a preamble package insert (e.g. \usepackage{...})
      if (fix.startLine === 1 && fix.endLine === 1 && fix.replacement.startsWith('\\usepackage')) {
        // Find documentclass line
        const docClassIdx = lines.findIndex((l) => /\\documentclass/.test(l));
        if (docClassIdx >= 0) {
          lines.splice(docClassIdx + 1, 0, fix.replacement);
        } else {
          lines.unshift(fix.replacement);
        }
      } else {
        // Standard line range replacement
        lines.splice(startIdx, endIdx - startIdx + 1, fix.replacement);
      }

      updateFileContent(targetFile.id, lines.join('\n'));
      return true;
    },
    [diagnostics, activeFileName]
  );

  return {
    diagnostics,
    errorCount,
    warningCount,
    infoCount,
    applyQuickFix,
  };
}
````

## File: src/services/auxiliaryCache.ts
````typescript
/**
 * Teeex — Persistent Auxiliary Artifact Cache.
 *
 * Saves and restores settled `.aux`, `.bbl`, `.toc`, `.out` files in IndexedDB.
 * When opening a project or refreshing the page, pre-mounting these settled files
 * into Emscripten MEMFS allows LaTeX to resolve cross-references and citations on
 * PASS 1, dropping cold-start compile passes from 3-4 down to 1 (7x speedup).
 */

const DB_NAME = 'teeex_artifacts_db';
const DB_VERSION = 1;
const STORE_AUX = 'aux_artifacts';

export interface AuxiliaryFileEntry {
  path: string;
  content: string;
}

export interface StoredAuxRecord {
  projectId: string;
  files: AuxiliaryFileEntry[];
  timestamp: number;
}

let dbPromise: Promise<IDBDatabase | null> | null = null;

function openArtifactsDb(): Promise<IDBDatabase | null> {
  if (typeof indexedDB === 'undefined') return Promise.resolve(null);
  if (dbPromise) return dbPromise;

  dbPromise = new Promise((resolve) => {
    try {
      const req = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, DB_VERSION);
      req.onupgradeneeded = (ev) => {
        const db = (ev.target as IDBOpenDBRequest).result;
        if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains('pdf_snapshots')) {
          db.createObjectStore('pdf_snapshots', { keyPath: 'projectId' });
        }
        if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE_AUX)) {
          db.createObjectStore(STORE_AUX, { keyPath: 'projectId' });
        }
      };
      req.onsuccess = (ev) => resolve((ev.target as IDBOpenDBRequest).result);
      req.onerror = () => resolve(null);
    } catch {
      resolve(null);
    }
  });

  return dbPromise;
}

/**
 * Persists settled auxiliary artifacts (.aux, .bbl, .toc, .out) to IndexedDB.
 */
export async function saveAuxiliaryArtifacts(
  projectId: string,
  files: AuxiliaryFileEntry[],
): Promise<void> {
  if (!projectId || !files || files.length === 0) return;

  const db = await openArtifactsDb();
  if (!db) return;

  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const record: StoredAuxRecord = {
      projectId,
      files,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
    };

    try {
      const tx = (db as any).transaction(
        STORE_AUX,
        'readwrite',
        { durability: 'relaxed' },
      );
      const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_AUX);
      store.put(record);
      tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
      tx.onerror = () => resolve();
    } catch {
      try {
        const tx = db.transaction(STORE_AUX, 'readwrite');
        const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_AUX);
        store.put(record);
        tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
        tx.onerror = () => resolve();
      } catch {
        resolve();
      }
    }
  });
}

/**
 * Loads cached auxiliary files for a project. Returns empty array if none found.
 */
export async function loadAuxiliaryArtifacts(
  projectId: string,
): Promise<AuxiliaryFileEntry[]> {
  if (!projectId) return [];

  const db = await openArtifactsDb();
  if (!db) return [];

  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    try {
      const tx = db.transaction(STORE_AUX, 'readonly');
      const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_AUX);
      const req = store.get(projectId);

      req.onsuccess = () => {
        const res = req.result as StoredAuxRecord | undefined;
        if (res && Array.isArray(res.files)) {
          resolve(res.files);
        } else {
          resolve([]);
        }
      };
      req.onerror = () => resolve([]);
    } catch {
      resolve([]);
    }
  });
}
````

## File: src/services/bracketMatcher.ts

````typescript
/**
 * Teeex Studio — Pure LaTeX Bracket Matching Engine
 * 100% Deterministic, zero-AI pair resolution for (), [], and {}.
 */

export function findMatchingBracket(code: string, cursorOffset: number): [number, number] | null {
  if (!code || cursorOffset < 0 || cursorOffset > code.length) return null;

  // Inspect character under cursor or immediately to the left
  const candidates = [cursorOffset, cursorOffset - 1];
  let targetIndex = -1;
  let targetChar = '';

  for (const idx of candidates) {
    if (idx >= 0 && idx < code.length) {
      const ch = code[idx];
      if ('{}[]()'.includes(ch)) {
        // Ensure bracket is not an escaped literal like \{ or \[
        let backslashes = 0;
        for (let j = idx - 1; j >= 0 && code[j] === '\\'; j--) {
          backslashes++;
        }
        if (backslashes % 2 === 0) {
          targetIndex = idx;
          targetChar = ch;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  if (targetIndex === -1) return null;

  const pairs: Record<string, string> = {
    '{': '}',
    '[': ']',
    '(': ')',
    '}': '{',
    ']': '[',
    ')': '(',
  };

  const partnerChar = pairs[targetChar];
  const isOpening = '{[('.includes(targetChar);

  let depth = 0;

  if (isOpening) {
    for (let i = targetIndex; i < code.length; i++) {
      // Check escaping
      let backslashes = 0;
      for (let j = i - 1; j >= 0 && code[j] === '\\'; j--) {
        backslashes++;
      }
      if (backslashes % 2 === 1) continue;

      if (code[i] === targetChar) {
        depth++;
      } else if (code[i] === partnerChar) {
        depth--;
        if (depth === 0) return [targetIndex, i];
      }
    }
  } else {
    for (let i = targetIndex; i >= 0; i--) {
      // Check escaping
      let backslashes = 0;
      for (let j = i - 1; j >= 0 && code[j] === '\\'; j--) {
        backslashes++;
      }
      if (backslashes % 2 === 1) continue;

      if (code[i] === targetChar) {
        depth++;
      } else if (code[i] === partnerChar) {
        depth--;
        if (depth === 0) return [i, targetIndex];
      }
    }
  }

  return null;
}
````

## File: src/services/codeMirrorCompletion.ts
````typescript
import {
  type CompletionContext,
  type CompletionResult,
  type Completion,
  snippetCompletion,
} from '@codemirror/autocomplete';
import type { BibEntry } from './bibtexParser';
import { LATEX_SNIPPETS } from './latexSnippets';

/**
 * Creates a comprehensive LaTeX autocompletion source for CodeMirror 6.
 * Provides completions for:
 * 1. Citations: \cite{...} -> suggests available BibTeX entries with author/title metadata
 * 2. References: \ref{...}, \eqref{...}, \pageref{...} -> suggests document labels
 * 3. LaTeX Snippets & Environments: \begin{...}, \frac{}{}, figures, tables, etc.
 */
export function createLatexCompletionSource(bibEntries: BibEntry[] = [], labels: string[] = []) {
  return (context: CompletionContext): CompletionResult | null => {
    const word = context.matchBefore(/\\?[a-zA-Z0-9_:*-]*/);
    if (!word || (word.from === word.to && !context.explicit)) return null;

    const lineTextBefore = context.state.doc.sliceString(
      context.state.doc.lineAt(context.pos).from,
      context.pos
    );

    // 1. Check for \cite{ or \citep{ or \citet{ context
    const citeMatch = lineTextBefore.match(/\\cite[a-zA-Z*]*\{([^}]*)$/);
    if (citeMatch) {
      const citePrefix = citeMatch[1];
      const from = context.pos - citePrefix.length;

      const options: Completion[] = bibEntries.map((b) => ({
        label: b.key,
        detail: b.title ? (b.title.length > 40 ? `${b.title.slice(0, 37)}...` : b.title) : b.type,
        info: `${b.author ? `${b.author}\n` : ''}${b.year ? `(${b.year}) ` : ''}${b.title || ''}`,
        type: 'keyword',
        boost: 2,
      }));

      return {
        from,
        options,
        validFor: /^[a-zA-Z0-9_:.-]*$/,
      };
    }

    // 2. Check for \ref{ or \eqref{ or \pageref{ context
    const refMatch = lineTextBefore.match(/\\(?:eq|page)?ref\{([^}]*)$/);
    if (refMatch) {
      const refPrefix = refMatch[1];
      const from = context.pos - refPrefix.length;

      const options: Completion[] = labels.map((lbl) => ({
        label: lbl,
        detail: lbl.startsWith('eq:') ? 'Equation' : lbl.startsWith('fig:') ? 'Figure' : lbl.startsWith('tab:') ? 'Table' : 'Label',
        type: 'variable',
        boost: 2,
      }));

      return {
        from,
        options,
        validFor: /^[a-zA-Z0-9_:.-]*$/,
      };
    }

    // 3. LaTeX Snippets matching current trigger or command
    const options: Completion[] = [];

    for (const snip of LATEX_SNIPPETS) {
      const snippetComp = snippetCompletion(snip.template, {
        label: snip.label,
        detail: snip.description,
        type: snip.category === 'env' ? 'type' : snip.category === 'math' ? 'function' : 'text',
        boost: snip.category === 'env' ? 1.5 : 1,
      });

      options.push(snippetComp);
    }

    return {
      from: word.text.startsWith('\\') ? word.from : word.from,
      options,
      validFor: /^\\?[a-zA-Z0-9_:-]*$/,
    };
  };
}
````

````typescript
      { tag: tags.tagName, color: colors.command },
````

````typescript
/**
 * Teeex Studio — Client-Side End-to-End Encryption Service (AES-256-GCM)
 * Zero-Knowledge cryptographic privacy for proprietary research manuscripts
 */

const SALT_BYTES = 16;
const IV_BYTES = 12;

// OWASP recommendation for PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256: 600,000 iterations
export const CURRENT_ITERATIONS = 600000;
export const LEGACY_ITERATIONS = 100000;
export const CURRENT_VERSION = 1;

// 3-byte magic marker 'TEX' (0x54, 0x45, 0x58)
const MAGIC_BYTES = new Uint8Array([0x54, 0x45, 0x58]);

const BASE64_CHUNK_SIZE = 8192; // 8 KB chunks to prevent call-stack RangeError on large documents

export function bytesToBase64(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
  let binary = '';
  const len = bytes.byteLength;
  for (let i = 0; i < len; i += BASE64_CHUNK_SIZE) {
    const chunk = bytes.subarray(i, Math.min(i + BASE64_CHUNK_SIZE, len));
    binary += String.fromCharCode.apply(null, chunk as unknown as number[]);
  }
  return btoa(binary);
}

export function base64ToBytes(b64: string): Uint8Array {
  const binary = atob(b64);
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) {
    bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
  }
  return bytes;
}

export async function deriveKey(
  passphrase: string,
  salt: Uint8Array,
  iterations: number = CURRENT_ITERATIONS
): Promise<CryptoKey> {
  const enc = new TextEncoder();
  const keyMaterial = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
    'raw',
    enc.encode(passphrase),
    'PBKDF2',
    false,
    ['deriveKey']
  );

  return crypto.subtle.deriveKey(
    {
      name: 'PBKDF2',
      salt: salt as unknown as BufferSource,
      iterations,
      hash: 'SHA-256',
    },
    keyMaterial,
    { name: 'AES-GCM', length: 256 },
    false,
    ['encrypt', 'decrypt']
  );
}

export function generateSalt(): string {
  const salt = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(SALT_BYTES));
  return bytesToBase64(salt);
}

export async function encryptText(
  plainText: string,
  passphrase: string,
  saltB64: string,
  iterations: number = CURRENT_ITERATIONS
): Promise<string> {
  const salt = base64ToBytes(saltB64);
  const key = await deriveKey(passphrase, salt, iterations);
  const iv = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(IV_BYTES));
  const enc = new TextEncoder();

  const cipherBuffer = await crypto.subtle.encrypt(
    { name: 'AES-GCM', iv },
    key,
    enc.encode(plainText)
  );

  const cipherBytes = new Uint8Array(cipherBuffer);

  // Payload format (v1):
  // [0..2]: MAGIC 'TEX' (3 bytes)
  // [3]: Version 1 (1 byte)
  // [4..7]: Iterations (4 bytes, uint32 big-endian)
  // [8..19]: IV (12 bytes)
  // [20..end]: Ciphertext + GCM auth tag
  const headerLen = 3 + 1 + 4 + IV_BYTES; // 20 bytes
  const payload = new Uint8Array(headerLen + cipherBytes.length);

  payload.set(MAGIC_BYTES, 0);
  payload[3] = CURRENT_VERSION;
  new DataView(payload.buffer, payload.byteOffset, payload.byteLength).setUint32(4, iterations, false);
  payload.set(iv, 8);
  payload.set(cipherBytes, headerLen);

  return bytesToBase64(payload);
}

export async function decryptText(
  cipherB64: string,
  passphrase: string,
  saltB64: string
): Promise<string> {
  const salt = base64ToBytes(saltB64);
  const rawPayload = base64ToBytes(cipherB64);

  // Check for Version 1 header: starts with 'TEX' (0x54, 0x45, 0x58) and version byte 1
  const isV1 =
    rawPayload.length >= 20 &&
    rawPayload[0] === 0x54 &&
    rawPayload[1] === 0x45 &&
    rawPayload[2] === 0x58 &&
    rawPayload[3] === 0x01;

  let iterations = LEGACY_ITERATIONS;
  let iv: Uint8Array;
  let cipherBytes: Uint8Array;

  if (isV1) {
    const view = new DataView(rawPayload.buffer, rawPayload.byteOffset, rawPayload.byteLength);
    iterations = view.getUint32(4, false);
    iv = rawPayload.subarray(8, 20);
    cipherBytes = rawPayload.subarray(20);
  } else {
    // Legacy v0 format: 12 bytes IV followed by ciphertext with default 100,000 iterations
    iv = rawPayload.subarray(0, IV_BYTES);
    cipherBytes = rawPayload.subarray(IV_BYTES);
  }

  const key = await deriveKey(passphrase, salt, iterations);
  const decryptedBuffer = await crypto.subtle.decrypt(
    { name: 'AES-GCM', iv: iv as unknown as BufferSource },
    key,
    cipherBytes as unknown as BufferSource
  );

  const dec = new TextDecoder();
  return dec.decode(decryptedBuffer);
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Teeex — Origin Private File System (OPFS) Storage Service.
 *
 * Provides high-throughput, native disk I/O using the browser's sandboxed
 * Origin Private File System (`navigator.storage.getDirectory()`).
 * Bypasses IndexedDB serialization overhead for zero-copy binary and document storage.
 */

export interface OpfsEntry {
  path: string;
  content: string | Uint8Array;
}

let rootDirPromise: Promise<FileSystemDirectoryHandle | null> | null = null;

export function _resetOpfsForTesting(): void {
  rootDirPromise = null;
}

export function isOpfsSupported(): boolean {
  return typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && 'storage' in navigator && typeof navigator.storage.getDirectory === 'function';
}

async function getOpfsRoot(): Promise<FileSystemDirectoryHandle | null> {
  if (!isOpfsSupported()) return null;
  if (rootDirPromise) return rootDirPromise;

  rootDirPromise = (async () => {
    try {
      const root = await navigator.storage.getDirectory();
      // Ensure 'teeex-projects' directory exists
      return await root.getDirectoryHandle('teeex-projects', { create: true });
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('[OPFS] Unable to initialize Origin Private File System root:', err);
      return null;
    }
  })();

  return rootDirPromise;
}

/**
 * Saves a file into the Origin Private File System under a project directory.
 */
export async function writeOpfsFile(
  projectId: string,
  relativePath: string,
  content: string | Uint8Array
): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const root = await getOpfsRoot();
    if (!root) return false;

    // Get or create project folder
    const cleanProjectId = projectId.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_');
    const projectDir = await root.getDirectoryHandle(cleanProjectId, { create: true });

    // Handle nested directories if any
    const segments = relativePath.split('/').filter(Boolean);
    let currentDir = projectDir;
    for (let i = 0; i < segments.length - 1; i++) {
      const seg = segments[i];
      if (seg) {
        currentDir = await currentDir.getDirectoryHandle(seg, { create: true });
      }
    }

    const fileName = segments[segments.length - 1] || 'unnamed.txt';
    const fileHandle = await currentDir.getFileHandle(fileName, { create: true });

    const writable = await fileHandle.createWritable();
    if (typeof content === 'string') {
      await writable.write(content);
    } else {
      // Create a plain ArrayBuffer copy to ensure standard ArrayBuffer compatibility
      const copy = new Uint8Array(content.byteLength);
      copy.set(content);
      await writable.write(copy.buffer);
    }
    await writable.close();
    return true;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[OPFS] Failed to write file to OPFS:', relativePath, err);
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Reads a file from the Origin Private File System.
 */
export async function readOpfsFile(
  projectId: string,
  relativePath: string,
  asBinary = false
): Promise<string | Uint8Array | null> {
  try {
    const root = await getOpfsRoot();
    if (!root) return null;

    const cleanProjectId = projectId.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_');
    const projectDir = await root.getDirectoryHandle(cleanProjectId, { create: false });

    const segments = relativePath.split('/').filter(Boolean);
    let currentDir = projectDir;
    for (let i = 0; i < segments.length - 1; i++) {
      const seg = segments[i];
      if (seg) {
        currentDir = await currentDir.getDirectoryHandle(seg, { create: false });
      }
    }

    const fileName = segments[segments.length - 1] || 'unnamed.txt';
    const fileHandle = await currentDir.getFileHandle(fileName, { create: false });
    const file = await fileHandle.getFile();

    if (asBinary) {
      const buf = await file.arrayBuffer();
      return new Uint8Array(buf);
    }
    return await file.text();
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Lists all file entries stored in a project's OPFS directory.
 */
export async function listOpfsFiles(projectId: string): Promise<string[]> {
  const result: string[] = [];
  try {
    const root = await getOpfsRoot();
    if (!root) return result;

    const cleanProjectId = projectId.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_');
    const projectDir = await root.getDirectoryHandle(cleanProjectId, { create: false });

    async function walk(dir: FileSystemDirectoryHandle, prefix = ''): Promise<void> {
      for await (const [name, handle] of (dir as any).entries()) {
        const fullPath = prefix ? `${prefix}/${name}` : name;
        if (handle.kind === 'file') {
          result.push(fullPath);
        } else if (handle.kind === 'directory') {
          await walk(handle as FileSystemDirectoryHandle, fullPath);
        }
      }
    }

    await walk(projectDir);
  } catch {
    // Non-fatal if project folder doesn't exist yet
  }
  return result;
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Teeex — document class presets.
 *
 * Previously this file described page furniture that was painted into the
 * preview and had no basis in the document: invented IEEE volume numbers, a
 * fabricated arXiv stamp, "Teeex Studio Typeset" footers, and a single set of
 * typography values (12px / 1.5 line-height / 18mm padding) applied to every
 * format regardless of what the source declared. Selecting a format changed
 * the preview's appearance without changing the document, so the preview
 * described a paper that did not exist.
 *
 * Under the current architecture, layout comes from TeX, which takes its
 * instructions from `\documentclass`. A format preset is therefore a *source
 * transformation*: choosing one rewrites the document's class and required
 * packages, and the engine re-typesets accordingly. What you see is what the
 * class actually produces — including its own headers, footers, and page size.
 */

export type PaperFormatId = 'ieee' | 'acm' | 'nature' | 'arxiv' | 'standard';

export interface PaperFormatConfig {
  id: PaperFormatId;
  name: string;
  badge: string;
  description: string;
  /** The `\documentclass` line this preset installs. */
  documentClass: string;
  /** Packages the class needs that are not already conventional. */
  packages: string[];
  /** Informational: what the class itself does by default. */
  defaultColumns: 1 | 2;
  /**
   * How reliably this preset's class actually compiles, verified by the e2e
   * suite — NOT a guess. The format menu uses this to warn honestly instead of
   * presenting every preset as equally ready (see docs/support-matrix.json
   * format.presets).
   *
   *  'bundled'          the class is in the preloaded set; compiles offline.
   *  'remote-verified'  not bundled, but confirmed to resolve and compile.
   *  'remote-heavy'     not bundled; pulls a large dependency tree on first
   *                     compile and is slow or unconfirmed. Choosing it is
   *                     allowed, but the user is told what to expect.
   */
  resolution: 'bundled' | 'remote-verified' | 'remote-heavy';
  /**
   * Approximate styling for the draft outline view only.
   *
   * These are NOT the typesetting parameters. The outline is an HTML skim of
   * the source shown while the engine compiles; it makes no fidelity claim and
   * its values are not derived from the class. Anything that must be accurate
   * is read from the compiled PDF.
   */
  outline: {
    fontFamily: string;
    fontSize: string;
    lineHeight: number;
  };
}

const SERIF_STACK = '"Latin Modern Roman", "Computer Modern", "Newsreader", "Times New Roman", Times, serif';

export const PAPER_FORMATS: Record<PaperFormatId, PaperFormatConfig> = {
  standard: {
    id: 'standard',
    name: 'LaTeX article',
    badge: 'article',
    description: 'The standard class. One column, 10pt, no running head.',
    documentClass: '\\documentclass[10pt,a4paper]{article}',
    packages: ['amsmath', 'amssymb', 'graphicx'],
    defaultColumns: 1,
    resolution: 'bundled',
    outline: { fontFamily: SERIF_STACK, fontSize: '13.3px', lineHeight: 1.2 },
  },
  ieee: {
    id: 'ieee',
    name: 'IEEE Transactions',
    badge: 'IEEEtran',
    description: 'Two-column IEEE journal class. US Letter, 10pt.',
    documentClass: '\\documentclass[journal]{IEEEtran}',
    packages: ['amsmath', 'amssymb', 'graphicx', 'cite'],
    defaultColumns: 2,
    resolution: 'remote-verified',
    outline: { fontFamily: SERIF_STACK, fontSize: '13.3px', lineHeight: 1.2 },
  },
  acm: {
    id: 'acm',
    name: 'ACM Proceedings',
    badge: 'acmart',
    description: 'ACM conference class with its own title block and rights statement.',
    documentClass: '\\documentclass[sigconf]{acmart}',
    packages: ['amsmath', 'graphicx'],
    defaultColumns: 2,
    resolution: 'remote-heavy',
    outline: { fontFamily: SERIF_STACK, fontSize: '12.5px', lineHeight: 1.2 },
  },
  nature: {
    id: 'nature',
    name: 'Springer Nature',
    badge: 'sn-jnl',
    description: 'Springer Nature journal class, single column reference style.',
    documentClass: '\\documentclass[pdflatex,sn-nature]{sn-jnl}',
    packages: ['amsmath', 'graphicx'],
    defaultColumns: 1,
    resolution: 'remote-heavy',
    outline: { fontFamily: SERIF_STACK, fontSize: '13.3px', lineHeight: 1.25 },
  },
  arxiv: {
    id: 'arxiv',
    name: 'arXiv preprint',
    badge: 'preprint',
    description: 'Standard article with wide margins, suitable for preprints.',
    documentClass: '\\documentclass[11pt,a4paper]{article}',
    packages: ['amsmath', 'amssymb', 'graphicx', 'geometry'],
    defaultColumns: 1,
    resolution: 'bundled',
    outline: { fontFamily: SERIF_STACK, fontSize: '14.6px', lineHeight: 1.25 },
  },
};

/**
 * Rewrites a document's `\documentclass` to the chosen preset, adding any
 * packages the class needs that are not already loaded.
 *
 * Returns the source unchanged when it has no `\documentclass`, rather than
 * guessing where a preamble should begin — silently restructuring someone's
 * document is worse than declining to.
 */
export function applyDocumentClass(source: string, format: PaperFormatId): string {
  const preset = PAPER_FORMATS[format];
  const classPattern = /^[ \t]*\\documentclass\s*(?:\[[^\]]*\])?\s*\{[^}]*\}[ \t]*$/m;

  if (!classPattern.test(source)) return source;

  let next = source.replace(classPattern, preset.documentClass);

  const missing = preset.packages.filter(
    (pkg) => !new RegExp(`\\\\usepackage(?:\\s*\\[[^\\]]*\\])?\\s*\\{[^}]*\\b${pkg}\\b[^}]*\\}`).test(next),
  );

  if (missing.length > 0) {
    const insertAfter = next.indexOf(preset.documentClass) + preset.documentClass.length;
    const block = missing.map((pkg) => `\\usepackage{${pkg}}`).join('\n');
    next = `${next.slice(0, insertAfter)}\n${block}${next.slice(insertAfter)}`;
  }

  return next;
}

/** Best-effort read of the class a document already declares. */
export function detectDocumentClass(source: string): PaperFormatId | null {
  const match = source.match(/\\documentclass\s*(?:\[([^\]]*)\])?\s*\{([^}]+)\}/);
  if (!match) return null;

  const [, options = '', className] = match;
  const name = className.trim().toLowerCase();

  if (name === 'ieeetran') return 'ieee';
  if (name === 'acmart') return 'acm';
  if (name.startsWith('sn-')) return 'nature';
  if (name === 'article') {
    return /\b11pt|12pt\b/.test(options) ? 'arxiv' : 'standard';
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * A one-line honest notice for the moment a preset is applied, or null when the
 * preset compiles with no caveat.
 *
 * The format menu offers every preset, but they are not equal: article and
 * arXiv are bundled and compile offline; IEEEtran is confirmed to resolve from
 * the package server; acmart and sn-jnl pull a large dependency tree and, as of
 * the current package wiring, were not seen to finish within a practical time
 * (docs/support-matrix.json format.presets). Rewriting a user's \documentclass
 * to one of those silently would be exactly the misleading support this project
 * is meant to avoid, so the UI says what to expect instead.
 */
export function formatResolutionNotice(format: PaperFormatId): string | null {
  const preset = PAPER_FORMATS[format];
  if (preset.resolution === 'remote-heavy') {
    return (
      `${preset.name} (${preset.badge}) pulls a large set of LaTeX packages on ` +
      `first compile. It needs the package server and may be slow or fail the ` +
      `first time; if nothing appears, check the diagnostics panel.`
    );
  }
  return null;
}

/** Whether the document declares a two-column layout. */
export function isTwoColumnSource(source: string): boolean {
  const match = source.match(/\\documentclass\s*(?:\[([^\]]*)\])?\s*\{[^}]+\}/);
  if (!match) return false;

  const options = match[1] ?? '';
  if (/(?:^|,)\s*twocolumn\s*(?:,|$)/.test(options)) return true;

  // Several journal classes are two-column by default with no explicit option.
  const className = source.match(/\\documentclass[^{]*\{([^}]+)\}/)?.[1]?.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (className === 'ieeetran' && !/(?:^|,)\s*onecolumn\s*(?:,|$)/.test(options)) return true;
  if (className === 'acmart' && /sigconf|sigplan|acmsmall/.test(options)) return true;

  return false;
}

/**
 * Adds or removes the `twocolumn` class option.
 *
 * Column count is a property of the document, not of the viewer: LaTeX decides
 * column widths, gutter, and float placement from it. Toggling a UI flag — as
 * this previously did — restyled an HTML mock and left the compiled document
 * unchanged, so the control did nothing to the actual output.
 *
 * Returns the source unchanged when there is no `\documentclass` to amend.
 */
export function setTwoColumn(source: string, twoColumn: boolean): string {
  const match = source.match(/\\documentclass(\s*\[([^\]]*)\])?\s*\{([^}]+)\}/);
  if (!match) return source;

  const [whole, , rawOptions = '', className] = match;

  const options = rawOptions
    .split(',')
    .map((option) => option.trim())
    .filter((option) => option.length > 0 && option !== 'twocolumn' && option !== 'onecolumn');

  if (twoColumn) {
    options.push('twocolumn');
  } else if (/ieeetran/i.test(className)) {
    // IEEEtran is two-column by default, so a single column needs the opposite
    // option stated explicitly rather than just omitting `twocolumn`.
    options.push('onecolumn');
  }

  const replacement =
    options.length > 0
      ? `\\documentclass[${options.join(',')}]{${className}}`
      : `\\documentclass{${className}}`;

  return source.replace(whole, replacement);
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Minimal valid single-page PDF (PDF-1.4) with byte-exact cross-reference offsets.
 */
export const DUMMY_1X1_PDF = new TextEncoder().encode(
  '%PDF-1.4\n1 0 obj<</Type/Catalog/Pages 2 0 R>>endobj\n2 0 obj<</Type/Pages/Count 1/Kids[3 0 R]>>endobj\n3 0 obj<</Type/Page/MediaBox[0 0 100 100]/Parent 2 0 R/Resources<<>>>>endobj\nxref\n0 4\n0000000000 65535 f \n0000000009 00000 n \n0000000052 00000 n \n0000000101 00000 n \ntrailer<</Size 4/Root 1 0 R>>\nstartxref\n178\n%%EOF\n'
);

export function isGraphicFilename(filename: string): boolean {
  return /\.(?:png|jpe?g|pdf|eps|svg|gif|webp)$/i.test(filename);
}

export function getPlaceholderGraphicBytes(filename: string): Uint8Array {
  const lower = filename.toLowerCase();
  if (lower.endsWith('.png')) return DUMMY_1X1_PNG;
  if (lower.endsWith('.pdf')) return DUMMY_1X1_PDF;
  if (lower.endsWith('.jpg') || lower.endsWith('.jpeg')) return DUMMY_1X1_JPG;
  // Default to standard PNG for unspecified or other formats
  return DUMMY_1X1_PNG;
}

/**
 * Parses all image filenames referenced in TeX code, including \includegraphics and bracketed paths.
 */
export function extractReferencedImages(texContent: string): string[] {
  const images = new Set<string>();
  const includeGraphicsRegex = /\\includegraphics(?:\[[^\]]*\])?\{([^}]+)\}/g;
  for (const match of texContent.matchAll(includeGraphicsRegex)) {
    const raw = match[1]?.trim();
    if (raw) images.add(raw);
  }
  const extRegex = /\{([a-zA-Z0-9_./-]+\.(?:jpe?g|png|gif|svg|eps|pdf|webp))\}/gi;
  for (const match of texContent.matchAll(extRegex)) {
    const raw = match[1]?.trim();
    if (raw) images.add(raw);
  }
  return Array.from(images);
}
````

````typescript
import { createStore, useStore } from './createStore';
import type { EngineStatus } from '../services/latexCompiler';
import type { CompileDiagnostic } from '../services/texLog';

export interface CompilerState {
  status: EngineStatus;
  pdfBytes: Uint8Array | null;
  synctex: Uint8Array | null;
  diagnostics: CompileDiagnostic[];
  log: string;
  isCompiling: boolean;
  durationMs: number;
}

const initialState: CompilerState = {
  status: { phase: 'idle', progress: 0, engine: 'pdflatex' },
  pdfBytes: null,
  synctex: null,
  diagnostics: [],
  log: '',
  isCompiling: false,
  durationMs: 0,
};

export const compilerStore = createStore<CompilerState>(initialState);

export function setCompilerState(partial: Partial<CompilerState>): void {
  compilerStore.setState(partial);
}

export function useCompilerStore<T>(selector: (state: CompilerState) => T): T {
  return useStore(compilerStore, selector);
}
````

## File: src/stores/createStore.ts
````typescript
import { useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';

export interface Store<T> {
  getState: () => T;
  setState: (partial: Partial<T> | ((prev: T) => Partial<T>)) => void;
  subscribe: (listener: () => void) => () => void;
}

export function createStore<T>(initialState: T): Store<T> {
  let state = initialState;
  const listeners = new Set<() => void>();

  return {
    getState: () => state,
    setState: (partial) => {
      const next = typeof partial === 'function' ? (partial as (prev: T) => Partial<T>)(state) : partial;
      state = { ...state, ...next };
      for (const listener of listeners) {
        listener();
      }
    },
    subscribe: (listener) => {
      listeners.add(listener);
      return () => {
        listeners.delete(listener);
      };
    },
  };
}

export function useStore<T, S>(store: Store<T>, selector: (state: T) => S): S {
  return useSyncExternalStore(
    store.subscribe,
    () => selector(store.getState()),
    () => selector(store.getState())
  );
}
````

````typescript
import { createStore, useStore } from './createStore';

export type ViewMode = 'split' | 'editor' | 'preview' | 'outline';
export type EditorTab = 'write' | 'review';

export interface SyncTexPulse {
  page: number;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface EditorSettingsState {
  fontSize: number;
  isWordWrap: boolean;
  isLineNumbers: boolean;
  splitPercentage: number;
  activeViewMode: ViewMode;
  activeTab: EditorTab;
  syncTexPulse: SyncTexPulse | null;
}

const initialState: EditorSettingsState = {
  fontSize: 14,
  isWordWrap: true,
  isLineNumbers: true,
  splitPercentage: 50,
  activeViewMode: 'split',
  activeTab: 'write',
  syncTexPulse: null,
};

export const editorStore = createStore<EditorSettingsState>(initialState);

export function setEditorSettings(partial: Partial<EditorSettingsState>): void {
  editorStore.setState(partial);
}

export function triggerSyncTexPulse(page: number, x: number, y: number): void {
  editorStore.setState({
    syncTexPulse: { page, x, y, timestamp: Date.now() },
  });
}

export function useEditorStore<T>(selector: (state: EditorSettingsState) => T): T {
  return useStore(editorStore, selector);
}
````

## File: src/stores/modalStore.ts
````typescript
import { createStore, useStore } from './createStore';

export type ModalId =
  | 'auth'
  | 'projectsHub'
  | 'share'
  | 'template'
  | 'encryption'
  | 'versionHistory'
  | 'commandPalette'
  | 'wordCount'
  | 'tableBuilder'
  | 'symbolPalette'
  | 'auditLog'
  | 'imageUpload';

export interface ModalState {
  activeModal: ModalId | null;
  props: Record<string, unknown>;
}

const initialState: ModalState = {
  activeModal: null,
  props: {},
};

export const modalStore = createStore<ModalState>(initialState);

export function openModal(id: ModalId, props: Record<string, unknown> = {}): void {
  modalStore.setState({ activeModal: id, props });
}

export function closeModal(): void {
  modalStore.setState({ activeModal: null, props: {} });
}

export function useModalStore<T>(selector: (state: ModalState) => T): T {
  return useStore(modalStore, selector);
}

export function useIsModalOpen(id: ModalId): boolean {
  return useModalStore(state => state.activeModal === id);
}
````

## File: src/workers/latexParser.worker.ts
````typescript
/// <reference lib="webworker" />
import type { Diagnostic, LatexLabel, ParsedDocument, ProjectFile } from '../types/latex';
import {
  diagnoseLatex,
  extractLatexLabels,
  parseLatexDocument,
} from '../services/latexParser';

export interface ParseWorkerRequest {
  id: number;
  type: 'parse';
  content: string;
  files: ProjectFile[];
  activeFileName: string;
}

export interface ParseWorkerResponse {
  id: number;
  type: 'parseResult';
  diagnostics: Diagnostic[];
  parsedDoc: ParsedDocument;
  labels: LatexLabel[];
  durationMs: number;
}

self.onmessage = (event: MessageEvent<ParseWorkerRequest>) => {
  const data = event.data;
  if (!data || data.type !== 'parse') return;

  const { id, content, files, activeFileName } = data;
  const t0 = performance.now();
  const isTex = activeFileName.endsWith('.tex');
  const diagnostics = isTex ? diagnoseLatex(content) : [];
  const parsedDoc = parseLatexDocument(content, files);
  const labels = extractLatexLabels(files);
  const elapsed = performance.now() - t0;

  const response: ParseWorkerResponse = {
    id,
    type: 'parseResult',
    diagnostics,
    parsedDoc,
    labels,
    durationMs: Math.max(0.5, Number(elapsed.toFixed(1))),
  };

  self.postMessage(response);
};
````

## File: supabase/migrations/0002_yjs_collaboration.sql
````sql
-- ==============================================================================
-- Teeex — 0002: Yjs CRDT Collaboration States & Snapshots
-- Idempotent migration extending the hardened RLS schema.
-- ==============================================================================

create table if not exists public.project_crdt_states (
  project_id text primary key references public.projects(id) on delete cascade,
  snapshot text not null, -- Base64-encoded Yjs binary update snapshot
  state_vector text,      -- Base64-encoded state vector for fast delta comparison
  updated_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null,
  updated_by uuid references auth.users(id) on delete set null
);

alter table public.project_crdt_states enable row level security;
alter table public.project_crdt_states force row level security;

-- Drop existing policies if re-running
drop policy if exists "crdt_states_select_via_project" on public.project_crdt_states;
drop policy if exists "crdt_states_insert_via_project" on public.project_crdt_states;
drop policy if exists "crdt_states_update_via_project" on public.project_crdt_states;

-- Select policy: Owners and members can read CRDT snapshots
create policy "crdt_states_select_via_project"
  on public.project_crdt_states for select
  to authenticated
  using (
    exists (
      select 1 from public.projects p
      where p.id = project_crdt_states.project_id
        and (
          p.owner_uid = auth.uid()
          or public.teeex_is_project_member(p.members, auth.jwt() ->> 'email')
        )
    )
  );

-- Insert policy: Owners and editors can insert CRDT snapshots
create policy "crdt_states_insert_via_project"
  on public.project_crdt_states for insert
  to authenticated
  with check (
    exists (
      select 1 from public.projects p
      where p.id = project_crdt_states.project_id
        and (
          p.owner_uid = auth.uid()
          or public.teeex_is_project_writer(p.members, auth.jwt() ->> 'email')
        )
    )
  );

-- Update policy: Owners and editors can update CRDT snapshots
create policy "crdt_states_update_via_project"
  on public.project_crdt_states for update
  to authenticated
  using (
    exists (
      select 1 from public.projects p
      where p.id = project_crdt_states.project_id
        and (
          p.owner_uid = auth.uid()
          or public.teeex_is_project_writer(p.members, auth.jwt() ->> 'email')
        )
    )
  )
  with check (
    exists (
      select 1 from public.projects p
      where p.id = project_crdt_states.project_id
        and (
          p.owner_uid = auth.uid()
          or public.teeex_is_project_writer(p.members, auth.jwt() ->> 'email')
        )
    )
  );
````

## File: supabase/migrations/0003_dashboard_operator_privileges.sql
````sql
-- ==============================================================================
-- Teeex — 0003: Allow Supabase Dashboard Operators & Superusers to Manage Profiles
-- Fixes trigger error when editing is_approved / is_admin in Supabase Table Editor.
-- ==============================================================================

create or replace function public.teeex_is_caller_admin()
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $$
  select (
    current_user in ('postgres', 'supabase_admin', 'service_role')
    or (auth.jwt() ->> 'role') = 'service_role'
    or exists (
      select 1 from public.profiles
      where id = auth.uid() and is_admin = true
    )
  );
$$;

revoke all on function public.teeex_is_caller_admin() from public;
grant execute on function public.teeex_is_caller_admin() to authenticated, service_role;
````

````typescript
import { test, expect, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { openWorkspace, buildSession, type SeededProfile } from './fixtures';

test.describe('Stage 7: Real Yjs CRDT Multi-User Collaboration', () => {
  test.setTimeout(120_000);

  test('synchronizes document edits and cursor presence in real time across browser tabs', async ({ browser }) => {
    const context = await browser.newContext();
    const page1 = await context.newPage();
    const page2 = await context.newPage();

    try {
      const user1: SeededProfile = {
        id: 'user-alice-101',
        email: 'alice@teeex.local',
        fullName: 'Alice Walker',
      };

      const user2: SeededProfile = {
        id: 'user-bob-202',
        email: 'bob@teeex.local',
        fullName: 'Bob Smith',
      };

      const sharedProjectId = 'proj-crdt-quantum-collab';
      const initialContent = '\\documentclass{article}\n\\begin{document}\n\\section{Collaborative Science}\nInitial base manuscript for CRDT tests.\n\\end{document}';

      const sharedProject = {
        id: sharedProjectId,
        title: 'Collaborative Quantum Tomography',
        ownerId: user1.id,
        ownerEmail: user1.email,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        updatedAt: 'Just now',
        files: [
          {
            id: 'main.tex',
            name: 'main.tex',
            content: initialContent,
            type: 'tex',
            isEntry: true,
          },
        ],
        tags: [],
        members: [
          {
            id: user1.id,
            email: user1.email,
            name: user1.fullName,
            avatar: 'AW',
            avatarColor: '#10b981',
            role: 'owner',
            joinedAt: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
          },
          {
            id: user2.id,
            email: user2.email,
            name: user2.fullName,
            avatar: 'BS',
            avatarColor: '#f59e0b',
            role: 'editor',
            joinedAt: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
          },
        ],
        isArchived: false,
      };

      const openSharedWorkspace = async (page: Page, profile: SeededProfile) => {
        const session = buildSession(profile);
        const projectsJson = JSON.stringify([sharedProject]);
        await page.addInitScript(
          ([key, signedOutKey, payload, projJson, activeId]) => {
            localStorage.setItem(key, payload);
            localStorage.removeItem(signedOutKey);
            localStorage.setItem('teeex_saved_projects', projJson);
            localStorage.setItem('teeex_active_project_id', activeId);
          },
          ['teeex_auth_user', 'teeex_signed_out', JSON.stringify(session), projectsJson, sharedProjectId] as const,
        );
        await page.goto('/');
      };

      // 1. Boot Page 1 (Alice) with initial document
      await openSharedWorkspace(page1, user1);
      const editor1 = page1.locator('.cm-content');
      await expect(editor1).toBeVisible({ timeout: 25_000 });

      // 2. Boot Page 2 (Bob) into the same active workspace
      await openSharedWorkspace(page2, user2);
      const editor2 = page2.locator('.cm-content');
      await expect(editor2).toBeVisible({ timeout: 25_000 });

      // 3. Verify presence awareness: Page 2 sees Alice, Page 1 sees Bob
      await page1.waitForTimeout(600);
      await page2.waitForTimeout(600);

      // Check Navbar Share button or Editor presence badge
      const shareBtn1 = page1.getByRole('button', { name: /Share/i });
      await expect(shareBtn1).toBeVisible();

      const shareBtn2 = page2.getByRole('button', { name: /Share/i });
      await expect(shareBtn2).toBeVisible();

      // 4. Alice types collaborative text in Page 1
      await editor1.click();
      await page1.keyboard.press('ControlOrMeta+End');
      await page1.keyboard.type('\n% CRDT Collaboration Test: Hello Bob from Alice!\n');
      await expect(editor1).toContainText('CRDT Collaboration Test: Hello Bob from Alice!', { timeout: 10_000 });

      // 5. Verify Bob in Page 2 receives Alice's edits live via Yjs CRDT
      await expect(editor2).toContainText('CRDT Collaboration Test: Hello Bob from Alice!', { timeout: 15_000 });

      // 6. Bob types a response in Page 2
      await editor2.click();
      await page2.keyboard.press('ControlOrMeta+End');
      await page2.keyboard.type('% Response from Bob: Real-time math received!\n');

      // 7. Verify Alice in Page 1 receives Bob's edits without clobbering
      await expect(editor1).toContainText('Response from Bob: Real-time math received!', { timeout: 15_000 });
      await expect(editor1).toContainText('CRDT Collaboration Test: Hello Bob from Alice!');

      // 8. Both documents are in 100% mathematical convergence
      const doc1 = await page1.evaluate(() => {
        const win = window as unknown as { __teeexEditorView?: { state: { doc: { toString: () => string } } } };
        return win.__teeexEditorView?.state.doc.toString() || '';
      });
      const doc2 = await page2.evaluate(() => {
        const win = window as unknown as { __teeexEditorView?: { state: { doc: { toString: () => string } } } };
        return win.__teeexEditorView?.state.doc.toString() || '';
      });

      expect(doc1.trim()).toBe(doc2.trim());
      expect(doc1).toContain('CRDT Collaboration Test: Hello Bob from Alice!');
      expect(doc1).toContain('Response from Bob: Real-time math received!');

    } finally {
      await page1.close();
      await page2.close();
      await context.close();
    }
  });

  test('displays honest collaborative copy in index.html and document metadata', async ({ page }) => {
    await openWorkspace(page, {
      id: 'copy-verifier',
      email: 'verifier@teeex.local',
      fullName: 'Copy Verifier',
    });

    // Verify index.html title
    await expect(page).toHaveTitle(/Collaborative Browser LaTeX Editor \(CRDT & WebAssembly\)/i);

    // Verify meta description
    const metaDesc = page.locator('meta[name="description"]');
    await expect(metaDesc).toHaveAttribute('content', /Yjs CRDT, Supabase Realtime/i);
  });
});
````

````typescript
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';
import { openWorkspace } from './fixtures';

test.describe('Stage 4: Design System, Command Palette & Splitter Engine', () => {
  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    test.setTimeout(120_000);
    await openWorkspace(page, {
      id: 'e2e-stage4-user',
      email: 'stage4@teeex.local',
      fullName: 'Stage 4 Tester',
    });
  });

  test('Command Palette (Ctrl+K) conforms to WAI-ARIA 1.2+ Combobox pattern', async ({ page }) => {
    // 1. Open via keyboard shortcut (ControlOrMeta+k)
    await page.keyboard.press('ControlOrMeta+k');

    const dialog = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: /Command Palette/i });
    await expect(dialog).toBeVisible();

    const combobox = page.getByRole('combobox', { name: 'Command Palette Search' });
    await expect(combobox).toBeVisible();
    await expect(combobox).toBeFocused();
    await expect(combobox).toHaveAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    await expect(combobox).toHaveAttribute('aria-autocomplete', 'list');

    // 2. Typing into combobox filters listbox options
    await combobox.fill('Format');
    const listbox = page.getByRole('listbox', { name: /Command suggestions/i });
    await expect(listbox).toBeVisible();

    // 3. Continuous typing focus: cursor remains inside combobox input while navigating with arrow keys
    await page.keyboard.press('ArrowDown');
    const activedescendant = await combobox.getAttribute('aria-activedescendant');
    expect(activedescendant).toBeTruthy();

    const activeOption = page.locator(`#${activedescendant}`);
    await expect(activeOption).toHaveAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');

    // 4. Background Isolation: root workspace receives HTML `inert` while dialog is open
    const workspace = page.locator('#root-workspace');
    await expect(workspace).toHaveAttribute('inert', '');

    // 5. Dismiss on Escape: closes dialog and restores root workspace interactivity
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
    await expect(dialog).not.toBeVisible();
    await expect(workspace).not.toHaveAttribute('inert');
  });

  test('APG Window Splitter supports pointer capture, keyboard adjustment, and preset cycling', async ({ page }) => {
    const splitter = page.getByRole('separator', { name: 'Resize Editor and Preview panels' });
    await expect(splitter).toBeVisible();
    await expect(splitter).toHaveAttribute('aria-orientation', 'vertical');

    // Check initial split percent (50%)
    const initialVal = await splitter.getAttribute('aria-valuenow');
    expect(Number(initialVal)).toBe(50);

    // 1. Keyboard resizing: focus splitter and press ArrowLeft
    await splitter.focus();
    await page.keyboard.press('ArrowLeft');

    // Decreased by 2% -> 48
    await expect(splitter).toHaveAttribute('aria-valuenow', '48');

    // Press ArrowRight with Shift -> increased by 5% -> 53
    await page.keyboard.press('Shift+ArrowRight');
    await expect(splitter).toHaveAttribute('aria-valuenow', '53');

    // 2. Home and End keys jump to bounds (min 20, max 80)
    await page.keyboard.press('Home');
    await expect(splitter).toHaveAttribute('aria-valuenow', '20');

    await page.keyboard.press('End');
    await expect(splitter).toHaveAttribute('aria-valuenow', '80');

    // 3. Double click cycles presets: 50 -> 70 -> 30 -> 50
    await splitter.dblclick();
    await expect(splitter).toHaveAttribute('aria-valuenow', '50');

    await splitter.dblclick();
    await expect(splitter).toHaveAttribute('aria-valuenow', '70');

    await splitter.dblclick();
    await expect(splitter).toHaveAttribute('aria-valuenow', '30');

    await splitter.dblclick();
    await expect(splitter).toHaveAttribute('aria-valuenow', '50');
  });

  test('Global shortcuts toggle sidebar (Mod+B) and trigger formatting', async ({ page }) => {
    const editor = page.locator('.cm-content').first();
    await editor.click();

    // 1. Mod+B toggles sidebar
    const sidebar = page.getByRole('complementary', { name: 'Workspace file browser and document outline' });
    await expect(sidebar).toBeVisible();

    await page.keyboard.press('ControlOrMeta+b');
    // Sidebar wrapper should transition width to 0
    const sidebarWrapper = sidebar.locator('..');
    await expect(sidebarWrapper).toHaveCSS('width', '0px');

    // Mod+B again restores sidebar
    await page.keyboard.press('ControlOrMeta+b');
    await expect(sidebarWrapper).toHaveCSS('width', '236px');
  });

  test('Theme switching toggles data-theme between dark obsidian and crisp slate light', async ({ page }) => {
    // Check initial dark theme
    const html = page.locator('html');
    await expect(html).toHaveAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');

    // Toggle theme via Navbar button
    const themeBtn = page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Toggle color theme' });
    await expect(themeBtn).toBeVisible();

    await themeBtn.click();
    await expect(html).toHaveAttribute('data-theme', 'light');

    // Toggle back to dark
    await themeBtn.click();
    await expect(html).toHaveAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');
  });

  test('Prefers-reduced-motion media query disables transitions and animations', async ({ page }) => {
    await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'reduce' });

    const isMatch = await page.evaluate(() => {
      return window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    });
    expect(isMatch).toBe(true);

    const animationDuration = await page.evaluate(() => {
      const el = document.createElement('div');
      el.className = 'spin';
      document.body.appendChild(el);
      const style = window.getComputedStyle(el);
      const dur = parseFloat(style.animationDuration);
      el.remove();
      return dur;
    });

    // Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, animation-duration is 0.01ms (0.00001s), so <= 0.001s
    expect(animationDuration).toBeLessThanOrEqual(0.001);
  });
});
````
