````typescript
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { isSafeUrl } from '../../src/services/pdfRenderer';
import type { PreviewState } from '../../src/components/PdfPreviewPane';

describe('PDF Annotation Layer & Security Protocols (Stage 3)', () => {
  describe('isSafeUrl protocol whitelist', () => {
    it('accepts valid https, http, and mailto links', () => {
      expect(isSafeUrl('https://arxiv.org/abs/2301.00001')).toBe(true);
      expect(isSafeUrl('http://example.com')).toBe(true);
      expect(isSafeUrl('mailto:author@university.edu')).toBe(true);
      expect(isSafeUrl('https://github.com/texlyre/texlyre-busytex')).toBe(true);
      expect(isSafeUrl('/relative/path')).toBe(true);
      expect(isSafeUrl('./doc.pdf')).toBe(true);
    });

    it('strictly rejects javascript: and data: pseudo-protocol injection attacks', () => {
      expect(isSafeUrl('javascript:alert(1)')).toBe(false);
      expect(isSafeUrl('javascript:void(0)')).toBe(false);
      expect(isSafeUrl('JAVASCRIPT:alert(document.cookie)')).toBe(false);
      expect(isSafeUrl('javascript :alert(1)')).toBe(false);
      expect(isSafeUrl('data:text/html,<script>alert(1)</script>')).toBe(false);
      expect(isSafeUrl('data:application/javascript;base64,YWxlcnQoMSk=')).toBe(false);
      expect(isSafeUrl('vbscript:msgbox(1)')).toBe(false);
      expect(isSafeUrl('file:///etc/passwd')).toBe(false);
      expect(isSafeUrl('//malicious.com/payload')).toBe(false);
    });

    it('rejects empty, null, or malformed inputs safely without throwing', () => {
      expect(isSafeUrl('')).toBe(false);
      expect(isSafeUrl('   ')).toBe(false);
      expect(isSafeUrl(null as unknown as string)).toBe(false);
      expect(isSafeUrl(undefined as unknown as string)).toBe(false);
    });
  });

  describe('Explicit 4-State Document Preview Lifecycle', () => {
    function computeState(options: {
      engineFailed?: boolean;
      engineError?: string;
      isCompiling?: boolean;
      elapsedSec?: number;
      hasDocument?: boolean;
      isStale?: boolean;
      isDebouncing?: boolean;
      errorSummary?: string | null;
      durationMs?: number | null;
    }): PreviewState {
      if (options.engineFailed) {
        return { type: 'failed', error: options.engineError || 'The TeX engine could not start' };
      }
      if (options.isCompiling) {
        return { type: 'compiling', elapsedSec: options.elapsedSec || 0 };
      }
      if (!options.hasDocument) {
        return { type: 'failed', error: options.errorSummary || 'No PDF generated yet' };
      }
      if (options.isStale) {
        return { type: 'stale', reason: 'compile_error', errorSummary: options.errorSummary };
      }
      if (options.isDebouncing) {
        return { type: 'stale', reason: 'typing' };
      }
      return { type: 'current', durationMs: options.durationMs ?? null };
    }

    it('resolves to current when document is fresh and compilation succeeded', () => {
      const state = computeState({
        hasDocument: true,
        isCompiling: false,
        isStale: false,
        isDebouncing: false,
        durationMs: 320,
      });

      expect(state.type).toBe('current');
      if (state.type === 'current') {
        expect(state.durationMs).toBe(320);
      }
    });

    it('resolves to compiling with elapsed counter while in flight', () => {
      const state = computeState({
        hasDocument: true,
        isCompiling: true,
        elapsedSec: 1.4,
      });

      expect(state.type).toBe('compiling');
      if (state.type === 'compiling') {
        expect(state.elapsedSec).toBe(1.4);
      }
    });

    it('resolves to stale with typing reason during debounce window', () => {
      const state = computeState({
        hasDocument: true,
        isCompiling: false,
        isDebouncing: true,
      });

      expect(state.type).toBe('stale');
      if (state.type === 'stale') {
        expect(state.reason).toBe('typing');
      }
    });

    it('resolves to stale with compile_error when compilation fails but previous PDF exists', () => {
      const state = computeState({
        hasDocument: true,
        isCompiling: false,
        isStale: true,
        errorSummary: 'Undefined control sequence \\foo',
      });

      expect(state.type).toBe('stale');
      if (state.type === 'stale') {
        expect(state.reason).toBe('compile_error');
        expect(state.errorSummary).toBe('Undefined control sequence \\foo');
      }
    });

    it('resolves to failed when no PDF exists and error occurred', () => {
      const state = computeState({
        hasDocument: false,
        isCompiling: false,
        errorSummary: 'Emergency stop: fatal LaTeX error',
      });

      expect(state.type).toBe('failed');
      if (state.type === 'failed') {
        expect(state.error).toBe('Emergency stop: fatal LaTeX error');
      }
    });
  });
});
````

## File: tests/unit/pdfViewerWindowing.test.ts
````typescript
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import type { PageGeometry } from '../../src/services/pdfRenderer';

const PAGE_GAP = 20;

function computePageOffsets(geometry: PageGeometry[], zoom: number): number[] {
  const out: number[] = [];
  let y = 0;
  for (const page of geometry) {
    out.push(y);
    y += page.height * zoom + PAGE_GAP;
  }
  return out;
}

function computeVisiblePages(
  geometry: PageGeometry[],
  offsets: number[],
  zoom: number,
  scrollTop: number,
  viewportHeight: number,
  overscan = 1.5,
): { activePages: Set<number>; firstVisible: number } {
  if (geometry.length === 0) return { activePages: new Set(), firstVisible: 1 };

  const top = scrollTop;
  const viewH = Math.max(viewportHeight, 400);
  const bottom = top + viewH;
  const margin = viewH * overscan;

  const activePages = new Set<number>();
  let firstVisible = 1;

  for (let index = 0; index < geometry.length; index++) {
    const pageTop = offsets[index] ?? 0;
    const pageBottom = pageTop + geometry[index].height * zoom;

    if (pageBottom >= top - margin && pageTop <= bottom + margin) {
      activePages.add(geometry[index].pageNumber);
    }
    if (pageTop <= top + 60) {
      firstVisible = geometry[index].pageNumber;
    }
  }

  return { activePages, firstVisible };
}

describe('PDF Viewer Virtual Windowing & Page Offsets (Stage 3)', () => {
  const sample10Pages: PageGeometry[] = Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => ({
    pageNumber: i + 1,
    width: 612,
    height: 792,
    rotation: 0,
  }));

  it('computes exact monotonic page offsets including gap', () => {
    const zoom = 1;
    const offsets = computePageOffsets(sample10Pages, zoom);

    expect(offsets).toHaveLength(10);
    expect(offsets[0]).toBe(0);
    expect(offsets[1]).toBe(792 + PAGE_GAP); // 812
    expect(offsets[2]).toBe(812 + 792 + PAGE_GAP); // 1624

    for (let i = 1; i < offsets.length; i++) {
      expect(offsets[i]).toBeGreaterThan(offsets[i - 1]);
    }
  });

  it('mounts only active pages within viewport + overscan margin (Stage 3 windowing)', () => {
    const zoom = 1;
    const offsets = computePageOffsets(sample10Pages, zoom);
    const viewportHeight = 800; // ~1 page visible

    // At top (scrollTop = 0): margin = 800 * 1.5 = 1200px
    const { activePages, firstVisible } = computeVisiblePages(
      sample10Pages,
      offsets,
      zoom,
      0,
      viewportHeight,
      1.5,
    );

    expect(firstVisible).toBe(1);
    expect(activePages.has(1)).toBe(true);
    expect(activePages.has(2)).toBe(true);
    expect(activePages.has(3)).toBe(true);
    // Pages far below must NOT be mounted
    expect(activePages.has(8)).toBe(false);
    expect(activePages.has(9)).toBe(false);
    expect(activePages.has(10)).toBe(false);
    expect(activePages.size).toBeLessThanOrEqual(4);
  });

  it('virtual window slides down when scrolled to middle page', () => {
    const zoom = 1;
    const offsets = computePageOffsets(sample10Pages, zoom);
    const viewportHeight = 800;

    // Scroll to Page 5 (offset ~3248)
    const scrollTarget = offsets[4]; // Page 5 top
    const { activePages, firstVisible } = computeVisiblePages(
      sample10Pages,
      offsets,
      zoom,
      scrollTarget,
      viewportHeight,
      1.5,
    );

    expect(firstVisible).toBe(5);
    // Page 1 and 2 must be unmounted and reclaimed
    expect(activePages.has(1)).toBe(false);
    expect(activePages.has(2)).toBe(false);

    // Active window should surround Page 5 (e.g. 4, 5, 6, 7)
    expect(activePages.has(5)).toBe(true);
    expect(activePages.size).toBeLessThanOrEqual(5);
  });

  it('handles zoom scaling on total layout height accurately', () => {
    const zoom = 1.5;
    const offsets = computePageOffsets(sample10Pages, zoom);

    // Page height at 1.5 zoom is 792 * 1.5 = 1188
    expect(offsets[1]).toBe(1188 + PAGE_GAP);

    const totalHeight = offsets[offsets.length - 1] + sample10Pages[9].height * zoom;
    expect(totalHeight).toBe(offsets[9] + 1188);
  });

  it('handles non-uniform mixed geometry (portrait + landscape)', () => {
    const mixedPages: PageGeometry[] = [
      { pageNumber: 1, width: 612, height: 792, rotation: 0 },
      { pageNumber: 2, width: 792, height: 612, rotation: 90 }, // Landscape page
      { pageNumber: 3, width: 612, height: 792, rotation: 0 },
    ];

    const offsets = computePageOffsets(mixedPages, 1);
    expect(offsets[0]).toBe(0);
    expect(offsets[1]).toBe(792 + PAGE_GAP);
    expect(offsets[2]).toBe(792 + PAGE_GAP + 612 + PAGE_GAP);
  });
});
````

````typescript
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import {
  DUMMY_1X1_PNG,
  DUMMY_1X1_JPG,
  DUMMY_1X1_PDF,
  getPlaceholderGraphicBytes,
  isGraphicFilename,
  extractReferencedImages,
} from '../../src/services/placeholderGraphics';

describe('placeholderGraphics — Robust Image Fallbacks for pdfTeX', () => {
  it('provides a valid standard PNG buffer (color type 2 RGB 24bpp)', () => {
    expect(DUMMY_1X1_PNG[0]).toBe(0x89);
    expect(DUMMY_1X1_PNG[1]).toBe(0x50);
    expect(DUMMY_1X1_PNG[2]).toBe(0x4e);
    expect(DUMMY_1X1_PNG[3]).toBe(0x47);
    // IHDR bit depth 8, color type 2 (RGB)
    expect(DUMMY_1X1_PNG[24]).toBe(8);
    expect(DUMMY_1X1_PNG[25]).toBe(2);
    expect(DUMMY_1X1_PNG.byteLength).toBe(119);
  });

  it('provides a valid JPEG buffer that satisfies writejpg.c marker expectations', () => {
    // SOI
    expect(DUMMY_1X1_JPG[0]).toBe(0xff);
    expect(DUMMY_1X1_JPG[1]).toBe(0xd8);
    // EOI at end
    expect(DUMMY_1X1_JPG[DUMMY_1X1_JPG.length - 2]).toBe(0xff);
    expect(DUMMY_1X1_JPG[DUMMY_1X1_JPG.length - 1]).toBe(0xd9);

    // Simulate writejpg.c parser to ensure no "no marker found" fatal error
    let pos = 0;
    function read2bytes() {
      const b1 = DUMMY_1X1_JPG[pos++];
      const b2 = DUMMY_1X1_JPG[pos++];
      return (b1 << 8) | b2;
    }

    let foundSof0 = false;
    let width = 0;
    let height = 0;
    let colorSpace = 0;

    while (pos < DUMMY_1X1_JPG.length) {
      const b = DUMMY_1X1_JPG[pos++];
      expect(b).toBe(0xff); // Must always read 0xFF marker prefix
      const marker = DUMMY_1X1_JPG[pos++];
      if (marker === 0xd8) continue; // M_SOI
      if (marker === 0xc0 || marker === 0xc1 || marker === 0xc3) {
        // M_SOF0
        read2bytes(); // length
        pos++; // bits per component
        height = read2bytes();
        width = read2bytes();
        colorSpace = DUMMY_1X1_JPG[pos++];
        foundSof0 = true;
        break;
      }
      const segLen = read2bytes();
      pos += (segLen - 2);
    }

    expect(foundSof0).toBe(true);
    expect(width).toBe(1);
    expect(height).toBe(1);
    expect(colorSpace).toBe(3); // DeviceRGB
  });

  it('provides a valid PDF-1.4 single-page buffer with byte-exact xref', () => {
    const text = new TextDecoder().decode(DUMMY_1X1_PDF);
    expect(text).toContain('%PDF-1.4');
    expect(text).toContain('trailer');
    expect(text).toContain('startxref');
    expect(text).toContain('%%EOF');
  });

  it('correctly dispatches placeholder bytes by file extension', () => {
    expect(getPlaceholderGraphicBytes('figure.png')).toBe(DUMMY_1X1_PNG);
    expect(getPlaceholderGraphicBytes('photo.jpg')).toBe(DUMMY_1X1_JPG);
    expect(getPlaceholderGraphicBytes('photo.jpeg')).toBe(DUMMY_1X1_JPG);
    expect(getPlaceholderGraphicBytes('diagram.pdf')).toBe(DUMMY_1X1_PDF);
    expect(getPlaceholderGraphicBytes('unknown_asset')).toBe(DUMMY_1X1_PNG);
  });

  it('identifies graphic filenames reliably', () => {
    expect(isGraphicFilename('svnit.jpg')).toBe(true);
    expect(isGraphicFilename('drishti.png')).toBe(true);
    expect(isGraphicFilename('chart.pdf')).toBe(true);
    expect(isGraphicFilename('main.tex')).toBe(false);
    expect(isGraphicFilename('references.bib')).toBe(false);
  });

  it('extracts referenced images across complex TeX markup', () => {
    const tex = `
      \\documentclass{article}
      \\usepackage{graphicx}
      \\begin{document}
      \\includegraphics[width=0.8\\linewidth]{figures/svnit.jpg}
      \\includegraphics{drishti.png}
      \\includegraphics[scale=0.5]{assets/flowchart}
      \\end{document}
    `;
    const images = extractReferencedImages(tex);
    expect(images).toContain('figures/svnit.jpg');
    expect(images).toContain('drishti.png');
    expect(images).toContain('assets/flowchart');
  });
});
````

````typescript
// Mock offline storage
vi.mock('../../src/services/offlineStorageService', () => {

    }),

// Mock Supabase
vi.mock('../../src/services/supabaseClient', () => {
  return {
    getSupabaseClient: vi.fn(() => ({
      from: vi.fn(() => ({
        upsert: vi.fn(async (row: any) => {
          if (row.id === 'proj-starter') {
            return {
              error: {
                code: '42501',
                message: 'new row violates row-level security policy (USING expression) for table "projects"',
              },
            };
          }
          return { error: null };
        }),
      })),
    })),
    getAuthUid: vi.fn(async () => 'user-test-uid-123'),
  };
});

describe('Projects Storage & Quota Resilience', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    localStorage.clear();
    vi.restoreAllMocks();
  });

  it('safely tiers massive manuscript to IndexedDB and stores quota-safe stubs in localStorage', () => {
    // Create a 35,000-line LaTeX manuscript (~2 MB)
    const massiveContent = '\\documentclass{article}\n' + 'Line of document content with scientific symbols \\alpha \\beta\n'.repeat(35000);
    const massiveProject: Project = {
      id: 'proj-large-doc',
      title: 'MAKERNOVA 4.0 Drone Report',
      ownerId: 'usr-local',
      ownerEmail: 'you@teeex.local',
      role: 'owner',
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      updatedAt: 'Just now',
      files: [
        {
          id: 'main.tex',
          name: 'main.tex',
          content: massiveContent,
        },
      ],
      folders: ['sections', 'figures'],
      tags: ['#research'],
      members: [],
      isArchived: false,
    };

    // Simulate localStorage quota error on raw save
    const store = new Map<string, string>();
    vi.spyOn(Storage.prototype, 'setItem').mockImplementation(function (key: string, value: string) {
      if (typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 500000) {
        const quotaErr = new Error('Setting the value of "teeex_saved_projects" exceeded the quota.');
        quotaErr.name = 'QuotaExceededError';
        throw quotaErr;
      }
      store.set(key, value);
    });
    vi.spyOn(Storage.prototype, 'getItem').mockImplementation((key: string) => store.get(key) || null);

    // Calling saveProjects should NOT throw QuotaExceededError
    expect(() => saveProjects([massiveProject])).not.toThrow();

    // Verify localStorage received a quota-safe version
    const stored = store.get('teeex_saved_projects');
    expect(stored).toBeTruthy();
    const parsed = JSON.parse(stored!);
    expect(parsed[0].id).toBe('proj-large-doc');
    expect(parsed[0].files[0]._persistedInIdb).toBe(true);
    expect(parsed[0].files[0].content.length).toBeLessThan(10000);
  });

  it('re-keys template projects when encountering Supabase RLS collisions', async () => {
    const starterProject: Project = {
      id: 'proj-starter',
      title: 'My First Project',
      ownerId: 'usr-local',
      ownerEmail: 'you@teeex.local',
      role: 'owner',
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      updatedAt: 'Just now',
      files: [{ id: 'main.tex', name: 'main.tex', content: 'test' }],
      folders: ['sections'],
      tags: [],
      members: [],
      isArchived: false,
    };

    const res = await pushProjectToCloud(starterProject);
    expect(res.success).toBe(true);
  });
});
````

````typescript
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, resolve } from 'node:path';

const ROOT = resolve(__dirname, '../..');
const HEADERS_PATH = join(ROOT, 'public', '_headers');
const VERCEL_JSON_PATH = join(ROOT, 'vercel.json');
const VITE_CONFIG_PATH = join(ROOT, 'vite.config.ts');

describe('Security Headers, CSP Tightening & Target Consolidation (S4f, S4d)', () => {
  const headersContent = readFileSync(HEADERS_PATH, 'utf8');

  it('Content-Security-Policy in public/_headers excludes Google Fonts CDNs', () => {
    expect(headersContent).not.toContain('fonts.googleapis.com');
    expect(headersContent).not.toContain('fonts.gstatic.com');
  });

  it('Content-Security-Policy excludes dead hostnames (railway, onrender, fly)', () => {
    expect(headersContent).not.toContain('railway.app');
    expect(headersContent).not.toContain('onrender.com');
    expect(headersContent).not.toContain('fly.dev');
  });

  it('public/_headers contains immutable cache rule for /fonts/*', () => {
    expect(headersContent).toContain('/fonts/*');
    expect(headersContent).toMatch(/\/fonts\/\*\s+Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable/);
  });

  it('public/_headers does not contain ineffective subresource COEP on /core/busytex/*', () => {
    const busytexSection = headersContent.split('/core/busytex/*')[1]?.split('\n\n')[0] || '';
    expect(busytexSection).not.toContain('Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy');
    expect(busytexSection).toContain('Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin');
  });

  it('vercel.json is permanently deleted from the repository root', () => {
    expect(existsSync(VERCEL_JSON_PATH), 'vercel.json must be deleted').toBe(false);
  });

  it('vite.config.ts preview CSP mirrors the tightened production CSP', () => {
    const viteConfig = readFileSync(VITE_CONFIG_PATH, 'utf8');
    expect(viteConfig).not.toContain('fonts.googleapis.com');
    expect(viteConfig).not.toContain('fonts.gstatic.com');
    expect(viteConfig).not.toContain('railway.app');
    expect(viteConfig).not.toContain('onrender.com');
    expect(viteConfig).not.toContain('fly.dev');
  });
});
````

````typescript
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { sha256, sha256Sync } from '../../src/services/shareSecurityService';

describe('SHA-256 Integrity & Non-ASCII Unicode Support', () => {
  // NIST standard test vector: SHA-256("abc") = ba7816bf8f01cfea414140de5dae2223b00361a396177a9cb410ff61f20015ad
  it('correctly computes NIST standard SHA-256 for basic ASCII strings', async () => {
    const input = 'abc';
    const expected = 'ba7816bf8f01cfea414140de5dae2223b00361a396177a9cb410ff61f20015ad';

    const asyncHash = await sha256(input);
    const syncHash = sha256Sync(input);

    expect(asyncHash).toBe(expected);
    expect(syncHash).toBe(expected);
  });

  // NIST standard test vector for empty string
  it('correctly hashes an empty string', async () => {
    const expected = 'e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855';

    expect(await sha256('')).toBe(expected);
    expect(sha256Sync('')).toBe(expected);
  });

  it('preserves full UTF-8 Unicode fidelity for non-ASCII input (accents, math symbols, emoji)', async () => {
    const testCases = [
      'Dr. René Descartes',
      'Schrödinger equation: iℏ ∂/∂t |ψ⟩ = Ĥ |ψ⟩',
      'EUR cost: €1,500 and JPY cost: ¥200,000',
      'Chinese document: 量子计算与拓扑学',
      'Unicode with emojis: 🚀 LaTeX High-Speed Engine ✨',
    ];

    for (const text of testCases) {
      const asyncHash = await sha256(text);
      const syncHash = sha256Sync(text);

      expect(asyncHash.length).toBe(64);
      expect(syncHash.length).toBe(64);
      // Both implementations must produce identical cryptographic hashes
      expect(syncHash).toBe(asyncHash);

      // Verify that code > 255 does not produce the same hash as the masked code & 0xff:
      // '€' (0x20AC) masked with & 0xff is 0xAC ('¬')
      // If text were masked with & 0xff, '€' and '¬' would produce identical hashes
      const corruptedText = text.replace(/€/g, '\xAC');
      if (text.includes('€')) {
        const corruptedHash = await sha256(corruptedText);
        expect(asyncHash).not.toBe(corruptedHash);
      }
    }
  });

  it('generates unguessable room capability tokens with correct ladder', async () => {
    const roomId = 'room_algebra_101';
    const editToken = 'ed_4a2f8c9b1e0d7a6b5c4d3e2f1a0b9c8d';

    const viewHash = await sha256(`${roomId}:${editToken}`);
    const viewToken = `vw_${viewHash.slice(0, 24)}`;

    expect(viewToken).toMatch(/^vw_[0-9a-f]{24}$/);
    expect(viewToken.length).toBe(27); // 'vw_' (3) + 24 hex = 27
  });
});
````

````typescript
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { createStore } from '../../src/stores/createStore';
import { modalStore, openModal, closeModal } from '../../src/stores/modalStore';
import { editorStore, setEditorSettings, triggerSyncTexPulse } from '../../src/stores/editorStore';
import { compilerStore, setCompilerState } from '../../src/stores/compilerStore';
import {
  projectStore,
  setProjects,
  setActiveProjectId,
  setFiles,
  setActiveFileId,
  updateFileContent,
} from '../../src/stores/projectStore';

describe('Modern Reactive Store Layer (createStore & Domain Slices)', () => {
  describe('createStore core', () => {
    it('creates a store with initial state and allows state updates', () => {
      const store = createStore({ count: 0, title: 'initial' });
      expect(store.getState()).toEqual({ count: 0, title: 'initial' });

      store.setState({ count: 1 });
      expect(store.getState()).toEqual({ count: 1, title: 'initial' });

      store.setState(prev => ({ count: prev.count + 5 }));
      expect(store.getState().count).toBe(6);
    });

    it('notifies subscribers on state updates', () => {
      const store = createStore({ active: false });
      let callCount = 0;

      const unsubscribe = store.subscribe(() => {
        callCount++;
      });

      store.setState({ active: true });
      expect(callCount).toBe(1);

      store.setState({ active: false });
      expect(callCount).toBe(2);

      unsubscribe();
      store.setState({ active: true });
      expect(callCount).toBe(2); // no further calls after unsubscribe
    });
  });

  describe('modalStore', () => {
    beforeEach(() => {
      closeModal();
    });

    it('opens and closes modals with associated props', () => {
      expect(modalStore.getState().activeModal).toBeNull();

      openModal('share', { roomId: 'room-101' });
      expect(modalStore.getState().activeModal).toBe('share');
      expect(modalStore.getState().props).toEqual({ roomId: 'room-101' });

      openModal('versionHistory');
      expect(modalStore.getState().activeModal).toBe('versionHistory');

      closeModal();
      expect(modalStore.getState().activeModal).toBeNull();
      expect(modalStore.getState().props).toEqual({});
    });
  });

  describe('editorStore', () => {
    it('updates editor settings and triggers SyncTeX pulse', () => {
      setEditorSettings({ fontSize: 16, isWordWrap: false });
      expect(editorStore.getState().fontSize).toBe(16);
      expect(editorStore.getState().isWordWrap).toBe(false);

      triggerSyncTexPulse(3, 120, 240);
      const pulse = editorStore.getState().syncTexPulse;
      expect(pulse).not.toBeNull();
      expect(pulse?.page).toBe(3);
      expect(pulse?.x).toBe(120);
      expect(pulse?.y).toBe(240);
      expect(typeof pulse?.timestamp).toBe('number');
    });
  });

  describe('compilerStore', () => {
    it('tracks compilation progress, diagnostics, and binary output', () => {
      setCompilerState({ isCompiling: true, durationMs: 150 });
      expect(compilerStore.getState().isCompiling).toBe(true);
      expect(compilerStore.getState().durationMs).toBe(150);

      const fakePdf = new Uint8Array([0x25, 0x50, 0x44, 0x46]);
      setCompilerState({ isCompiling: false, pdfBytes: fakePdf });
      expect(compilerStore.getState().isCompiling).toBe(false);
      expect(compilerStore.getState().pdfBytes).toBe(fakePdf);
    });
  });

  describe('projectStore', () => {
    it('manages projects, active file, and file contents reactively', () => {
      setActiveProjectId('proj-test-1');
      expect(projectStore.getState().activeProjectId).toBe('proj-test-1');

      setFiles([
        { id: 'main.tex', name: 'main.tex', content: '\\documentclass{article}', type: 'tex' },
        { id: 'intro.tex', name: 'intro.tex', content: 'Introduction', type: 'tex' },
      ]);
      expect(projectStore.getState().files.length).toBe(2);

      setActiveFileId('intro.tex');
      expect(projectStore.getState().activeFileId).toBe('intro.tex');
      expect(projectStore.getState().openFileIds).toContain('intro.tex');

      updateFileContent('intro.tex', 'Updated Introduction');
      const intro = projectStore.getState().files.find(f => f.id === 'intro.tex');
      expect(intro?.content).toBe('Updated Introduction');
    });
  });
});
````

````typescript
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import {
  findNearestLine,
  forwardSync,
  inverseSync,
  type SyncTexIndex,
  type SyncTexBox,
} from '../../src/services/synctex';

describe('SyncTeX Fast Indexing & Binary Search', () => {
  describe('findNearestLine', () => {
    const sorted = [10, 20, 30, 40, 50];

    it('returns exact match when target is present', () => {
      expect(findNearestLine(sorted, 10)).toBe(10);
      expect(findNearestLine(sorted, 30)).toBe(30);
      expect(findNearestLine(sorted, 50)).toBe(50);
    });

    it('returns closest line when target is between lines', () => {
      expect(findNearestLine(sorted, 12)).toBe(10);
      expect(findNearestLine(sorted, 18)).toBe(20);
      expect([20, 30]).toContain(findNearestLine(sorted, 25)); // 20 or 30 (equidistant diff 5)
      expect(findNearestLine(sorted, 34)).toBe(30);
      expect(findNearestLine(sorted, 38)).toBe(40);
    });

    it('clamps to bounds when target is outside range', () => {
      expect(findNearestLine(sorted, 1)).toBe(10);
      expect(findNearestLine(sorted, 100)).toBe(50);
    });

    it('returns null for empty array', () => {
      expect(findNearestLine([], 25)).toBeNull();
    });
  });

  describe('forwardSync with lineIndex', () => {
    const mockBox = (tag: number, line: number, page: number): SyncTexBox => ({
      kind: 'hbox',
      tag,
      line,
      column: 0,
      x: 72,
      y: 100 + line * 12,
      width: 200,
      height: 10,
      depth: 2,
    });

    const index: SyncTexIndex = {
      version: 1,
      files: new Map([
        [1, 'main.tex'],
        [2, 'chapters/intro.tex'],
      ]),
      pages: new Map([
        [1, [mockBox(1, 10, 1), mockBox(1, 20, 1)]],
        [2, [mockBox(1, 30, 2), mockBox(2, 5, 2)]],
      ]),
      lineIndex: new Map([
        [
          1,
          new Map([
            [10, [{ page: 1, box: mockBox(1, 10, 1) }]],
            [20, [{ page: 1, box: mockBox(1, 20, 1) }]],
            [30, [{ page: 2, box: mockBox(1, 30, 2) }]],
          ]),
        ],
        [
          2,
          new Map([[5, [{ page: 2, box: mockBox(2, 5, 2) }]]]),
        ],
      ]),
      sortedLines: new Map([
        [1, [10, 20, 30]],
        [2, [5]],
      ]),
    };

    it('resolves exact line in O(1)', () => {
      const match = forwardSync(index, 'main.tex', 20);
      expect(match).not.toBeNull();
      expect(match?.page).toBe(1);
      expect(match?.matchedLine).toBe(20);
      expect(match?.exact).toBe(true);
      expect(match?.rects.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    });

    it('finds nearest line on page when exact line is commented or blank', () => {
      const match = forwardSync(index, 'main.tex', 22);
      expect(match).not.toBeNull();
      expect(match?.page).toBe(1);
      expect(match?.matchedLine).toBe(20);
      expect(match?.exact).toBe(false);
    });

    it('navigates to the correct page for multi-page indexes', () => {
      const match = forwardSync(index, 'main.tex', 31);
      expect(match).not.toBeNull();
      expect(match?.page).toBe(2);
      expect(match?.matchedLine).toBe(30);
    });

    it('resolves secondary file lines correctly', () => {
      const match = forwardSync(index, 'chapters/intro.tex', 5);
      expect(match).not.toBeNull();
      expect(match?.page).toBe(2);
      expect(match?.matchedLine).toBe(5);
      expect(match?.exact).toBe(true);
    });

    it('returns null when file is not found in index', () => {
      expect(forwardSync(index, 'nonexistent.tex', 10)).toBeNull();
    });
  });

  describe('inverseSync with dense spatial pruning', () => {
    // Generate a dense page with 120 boxes spanning y from 50 to 650
    const boxes: SyncTexBox[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++) {
      boxes.push({
        kind: 'hbox',
        tag: 1,
        line: i + 1,
        column: 0,
        x: 72,
        y: 50 + i * 5,
        width: 300,
        height: 8,
        depth: 2,
      });
    }

    const index: SyncTexIndex = {
      version: 1,
      files: new Map([[1, 'main.tex']]),
      pages: new Map([[1, boxes]]),
    };

    it('correctly maps coordinates on dense page to exact line', () => {
      // Click at x=100, y=100 (which corresponds to line ~10 with y=100)
      const match = inverseSync(index, 1, 100, 100);
      expect(match).not.toBeNull();
      expect(match?.file).toBe('main.tex');
      expect(match?.line).toBe(12); // Box with vertical center closest to y=100
    });

    it('gracefully handles clicks in bottom margin of dense page', () => {
      const match = inverseSync(index, 1, 100, 700);
      expect(match).not.toBeNull();
      expect(match?.file).toBe('main.tex');
      expect(match?.line).toBe(120); // Closest box at bottom
    });
  });
});
````

````typescript
      },
    },
  ];

  const compilerDiags: CompileDiagnostic[] = [
    {
      id: 'c1',
      line: 12,
      severity: 'error',
      code: 'missing-package',
      message: "File `graphicx.sty' not found.",
      suggestedFix: {
        title: 'Add \\usepackage{graphicx}',
        description: 'Inserts package declaration in preamble.',
        replacement: '\\usepackage{graphicx}',
        startLine: 1,
        endLine: 1,
      },
      raw: '! LaTeX Error',
    },
  ];

  it('merges parser and compiler diagnostics with proper prioritization', async () => {
    await act(async () => {
      root.render(
        React.createElement(TestHarness, {
          parserDiagnostics: parserDiags,
          compilerDiagnostics: compilerDiags,
          activeFileName: 'main.tex',
        })
      );
    });

    expect(hookResult).not.toBeNull();
    expect(hookResult!.diagnostics).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(hookResult!.errorCount).toBe(2);
    expect(hookResult!.warningCount).toBe(0);
    // Compiler diag c1 line 12, parser diag p1 line 5 -> sorted by line: p1 then c1
    expect(hookResult!.diagnostics[0].id).toBe('p1');
    expect(hookResult!.diagnostics[1].id).toBe('c1');
  });

  it('applies 1-click quick fix for preamble packages right after documentclass', async () => {
    let files: ProjectFile[] = [
      {
        id: 'main.tex',
        name: 'main.tex',
        content: '\\documentclass{article}\n\\begin{document}\nHello\n\\end{document}',
        type: 'tex',
        isEntry: true,
      },
    ];

    const updateFileContent = (fileId: string, newContent: string) => {
      files = files.map((f) => (f.id === fileId ? { ...f, content: newContent } : f));
    };

    await act(async () => {
      root.render(
        React.createElement(TestHarness, {
          parserDiagnostics: [],
          compilerDiagnostics: compilerDiags,
          activeFileName: 'main.tex',
        })
      );
    });

    let ok = false;
    act(() => {
      ok = hookResult!.applyQuickFix('c1', files, updateFileContent);
    });

    expect(ok).toBe(true);
    expect(files[0].content).toContain('\\documentclass{article}\n\\usepackage{graphicx}\n\\begin{document}');
  });
});
````

````typescript
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { uint8ArrayToDataUrl, dataUrlToUint8Array } from '../../src/services/virtualFileSystem';
import { extractLatexLabels, extractLatexLabelsForFile } from '../../src/services/latexParser';
import type { ProjectFile } from '../../src/types/latex';

describe('Virtual File System & Parser Performance Hardening', () => {
  describe('uint8ArrayToDataUrl (Chunked 32KB)', () => {
    it('accurately encodes and decodes large binary payloads (>64KB)', () => {
      // 100 KB test payload
      const size = 102400;
      const original = new Uint8Array(size);
      for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        original[i] = (i * 31 + 7) & 0xff;
      }

      const dataUrl = uint8ArrayToDataUrl(original, 'application/octet-stream');
      expect(dataUrl.startsWith('data:application/octet-stream;base64,')).toBe(true);

      const decoded = dataUrlToUint8Array(dataUrl);
      expect(decoded.length).toBe(original.length);

      // Verify sample bytes
      expect(decoded[0]).toBe(original[0]);
      expect(decoded[50000]).toBe(original[50000]);
      expect(decoded[size - 1]).toBe(original[size - 1]);
    });

    it('handles empty byte arrays', () => {
      const empty = new Uint8Array(0);
      const dataUrl = uint8ArrayToDataUrl(empty, 'image/png');
      expect(dataUrl).toBe('data:image/png;base64,');
      expect(dataUrlToUint8Array(dataUrl).length).toBe(0);
    });
  });

  describe('extractLatexLabels caching', () => {
    const file1: ProjectFile = {
      id: 'f1',
      name: 'main.tex',
      content: `
\\section{Introduction}\\label{sec:intro}
This is intro text.
\\begin{figure}
  \\caption{Architecture Diagram}
  \\label{fig:arch}
\\end{figure}
`,
      isEntry: true,
    };

    const file2: ProjectFile = {
      id: 'f2',
      name: 'method.tex',
      content: `
\\section{Methodology}\\label{sec:method}
\\begin{equation}
  E = mc^2 \\label{eq:einstein}
\\end{equation}
`,
    };

    it('extracts labels from all files accurately', () => {
      const labels = extractLatexLabels([file1, file2]);
      const keys = labels.map((l) => l.key);
      expect(keys).toContain('sec:intro');
      expect(keys).toContain('fig:arch');
      expect(keys).toContain('sec:method');
      expect(keys).toContain('eq:einstein');
    });

    it('returns memoized result when file content has not changed', () => {
      const first = extractLatexLabelsForFile(file1);
      const second = extractLatexLabelsForFile(file1);
      // Strict equality check on the cached array reference
      expect(first).toBe(second);
    });

    it('invalidates cache when file content is updated', () => {
      const first = extractLatexLabelsForFile(file1);
      const modifiedFile1: ProjectFile = {
        ...file1,
        content: file1.content + '\n\\label{sec:new}',
      };
      const updated = extractLatexLabelsForFile(modifiedFile1);
      expect(updated).not.toBe(first);
      expect(updated.map((l) => l.key)).toContain('sec:new');
    });
  });
});
````

````typescript
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { sanitizeWorkerFiles } from '../../src/hooks/useLatexParser';
import type { ProjectFile } from '../../src/types/latex';

describe('Web Worker Payload Sanitization', () => {
  it('filters out binary images, PDFs, and irrelevant assets while preserving TeX/Bib files', () => {
    const hugeBase64 = 'data:image/png;base64,' + 'A'.repeat(50000); // ~50KB mock image
    const files: ProjectFile[] = [
      {
        id: 'main.tex',
        name: 'main.tex',
        content: '\\documentclass{article}\\begin{document}\\includegraphics{figure.png}\\end{document}',
        type: 'tex',
        isEntry: true,
      },
      {
        id: 'figure.png',
        name: 'figure.png',
        content: '',
        dataUrl: hugeBase64,
        type: 'image',
      },
      {
        id: 'refs.bib',
        name: 'refs.bib',
        content: '@article{einstein, author = "Albert Einstein"}',
        type: 'bib',
      },
    ];

    const sanitized = sanitizeWorkerFiles(files);

    // Only .tex and .bib are sent to the worker
    expect(sanitized).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(sanitized.map((f) => f.name)).toEqual(['main.tex', 'refs.bib']);

    // TeX file preserved verbatim with isEntry flag
    expect(sanitized[0].content).toContain('\\includegraphics{figure.png}');
    expect(sanitized[0].isEntry).toBe(true);
    expect(sanitized[0].type).toBe('tex');

    // Bib file preserved verbatim
    expect(sanitized[1].content).toContain('@article{einstein');
    expect(sanitized[1].type).toBe('bib');
  });

  it('preserves all relevant TeX source types (.tex, .bib, .sty, .cls)', () => {
    const files: ProjectFile[] = [
      { id: '1', name: 'main.tex', content: '\\documentclass{custom}\\usepackage{pkg}', type: 'tex' },
      { id: '2', name: 'refs.bib', content: '@book{b}', type: 'bib' },
      { id: '3', name: 'pkg.sty', content: '\\ProvidesPackage{pkg}', type: 'sty' },
      { id: '4', name: 'custom.cls', content: '\\ProvidesClass{custom}', type: 'tex' },
    ];

    const sanitized = sanitizeWorkerFiles(files);
    expect(sanitized).toHaveLength(4);
    expect(sanitized.map((f) => f.name)).toEqual(['main.tex', 'refs.bib', 'pkg.sty', 'custom.cls']);
  });

  it('achieves > 99% size reduction when large graphics are present', () => {
    const megabyteImage = 'data:image/jpeg;base64,' + 'X'.repeat(1024 * 1024); // ~1MB mock image
    const files: ProjectFile[] = [
      {
        id: 'main.tex',
        name: 'main.tex',
        content: '\\documentclass{article}',
        type: 'tex',
      },
      {
        id: 'diagram.jpg',
        name: 'diagram.jpg',
        content: '',
        dataUrl: megabyteImage,
        type: 'image',
      },
    ];

    const originalSize = JSON.stringify(files).length;
    const sanitizedSize = JSON.stringify(sanitizeWorkerFiles(files)).length;

    expect(originalSize).toBeGreaterThan(1024 * 1024);
    expect(sanitizedSize).toBeLessThan(1024); // Under 1KB!
    const ratio = (originalSize - sanitizedSize) / originalSize;
    expect(ratio).toBeGreaterThan(0.99);
  });
});
````

````typescript
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import * as Y from 'yjs';
import { Awareness, encodeAwarenessUpdate, applyAwarenessUpdate } from 'y-protocols/awareness';
import * as buffer from 'lib0/buffer';
import { SupabaseYjsProvider, CHUNK_SIZE } from '../../src/services/yjsProvider';
import type { Collaborator, ProjectFile, ReviewComment, TrackedChange } from '../../src/types/latex';

describe('Stage 7: Yjs CRDT Collaboration Engine', () => {
  let docA: Y.Doc;
  let docB: Y.Doc;

  beforeEach(() => {
    docA = new Y.Doc();
    docB = new Y.Doc();
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    docA.destroy();
    docB.destroy();
  });

  it('converges to 100% identical text on concurrent insertions at different positions', () => {
    const textA = docA.getText('file:main.tex');
    const textB = docB.getText('file:main.tex');

    // Initial synchronized baseline
    textA.insert(0, '\\documentclass{article}\n\\begin{document}\nHello World\n\\end{document}');
    const initUpdate = Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(docA);
    Y.applyUpdate(docB, initUpdate);
    expect(textB.toString()).toBe(textA.toString());

    // Concurrent independent edits without immediate exchange
    textA.insert(23, '% Added by Alice\n');
    textB.insert(textB.toString().indexOf('Hello World'), 'Collaborative ');

    // Exchange updates
    const updateFromA = Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(docA, Y.encodeStateVector(docB));
    const updateFromB = Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(docB, Y.encodeStateVector(docA));

    Y.applyUpdate(docB, updateFromA);
    Y.applyUpdate(docA, updateFromB);

    // CRDT mathematical convergence
    expect(textA.toString()).toBe(textB.toString());
    expect(textA.toString()).toContain('% Added by Alice');
    expect(textA.toString()).toContain('Collaborative Hello World');
  });

  it('resolves conflicting concurrent deletions and insertions gracefully', () => {
    const textA = docA.getText('file:main.tex');
    const textB = docB.getText('file:main.tex');

    textA.insert(0, 'The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog');
    Y.applyUpdate(docB, Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(docA));

    // Alice deletes "brown fox "
    textA.delete(10, 10);

    // Bob simultaneously modifies "fox" to "silver fox"
    textB.insert(13, 'silver ');

    // Exchange updates
    const updateFromA = Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(docA, Y.encodeStateVector(docB));
    const updateFromB = Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(docB, Y.encodeStateVector(docA));

    Y.applyUpdate(docB, updateFromA);
    Y.applyUpdate(docA, updateFromB);

    expect(textA.toString()).toBe(textB.toString());
  });

  it('manages multi-file LaTeX project separation inside a single root Y.Doc', () => {
    const mainA = docA.getText('file:main.tex');
    const introA = docA.getText('file:sections/intro.tex');
    const bibA = docA.getText('file:references.bib');

    mainA.insert(0, '\\input{sections/intro.tex}');
    introA.insert(0, '\\section{Introduction}\nCollaborative writing is fun.');
    bibA.insert(0, '@article{knuth1984, author={Knuth, Donald}}');

    // Sync all files to Doc B in one delta
    const fullProjectUpdate = Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(docA);
    Y.applyUpdate(docB, fullProjectUpdate);

    const mainB = docB.getText('file:main.tex');
    const introB = docB.getText('file:sections/intro.tex');
    const bibB = docB.getText('file:references.bib');

    expect(mainB.toString()).toBe('\\input{sections/intro.tex}');
    expect(introB.toString()).toBe('\\section{Introduction}\nCollaborative writing is fun.');
    expect(bibB.toString()).toContain('Knuth, Donald');

    // Edit intro on B and bib on A
    introB.insert(introB.length, '\nAdded section 1.1.');
    bibA.insert(bibA.length, '\n@book{lamport1994}');

    // Sync deltas
    Y.applyUpdate(docA, Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(docB, Y.encodeStateVector(docA)));
    Y.applyUpdate(docB, Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(docA, Y.encodeStateVector(docB)));

    expect(introA.toString()).toBe(introB.toString());
    expect(bibA.toString()).toBe(bibB.toString());
    expect(introA.toString()).toContain('Added section 1.1.');
    expect(bibB.toString()).toContain('lamport1994');
  });

  it('slices large updates into 48KB binary chunks and correctly reassembles them', () => {
    const textA = docA.getText('file:paper.tex');

    // Generate a payload > 100KB (exceeds CHUNK_SIZE = 48000)
    let largeLatex = '\\documentclass{article}\n\\begin{document}\n';
    for (let i = 1; i <= 1500; i++) {
      largeLatex += `\\section{Experiment ${i}}\nWe observe equation: $E_${i} = mc^2 + \\int_0^1 x^${i} dx$.\n`;
    }
    largeLatex += '\\end{document}';
    textA.insert(0, largeLatex);

    const fullUpdate = Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(docA);
    expect(fullUpdate.byteLength).toBeGreaterThan(CHUNK_SIZE * 2);

    // Simulate binary chunking
    const totalChunks = Math.ceil(fullUpdate.byteLength / CHUNK_SIZE);
    const chunks: Uint8Array[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < totalChunks; i++) {
      const start = i * CHUNK_SIZE;
      const end = Math.min(start + CHUNK_SIZE, fullUpdate.byteLength);
      chunks.push(fullUpdate.subarray(start, end));
    }

    expect(chunks.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);

    // Reassemble chunks
    let totalLength = 0;
    for (const c of chunks) totalLength += c.byteLength;
    expect(totalLength).toBe(fullUpdate.byteLength);

    const reassembled = new Uint8Array(totalLength);
    let offset = 0;
    for (const c of chunks) {
      reassembled.set(c, offset);
      offset += c.byteLength;
    }

    // Apply to Doc B
    Y.applyUpdate(docB, reassembled);
    const textB = docB.getText('file:paper.tex');
    expect(textB.toString()).toBe(textA.toString());
    expect(textB.toString()).toContain('\\section{Experiment 600}');
  });

  it('isolates undo/redo per user so undoing does not revert a collaborator’s edits', () => {
    const textA = docA.getText('file:main.tex');
    const textB = docB.getText('file:main.tex');

    textA.insert(0, 'Base sentence. ');
    Y.applyUpdate(docB, Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(docA));

    // Configure per-user UndoManagers tracking only local origin
    const undoManagerA = new Y.UndoManager(textA, {
      trackedOrigins: new Set(['user-alice']),
    });

    // Alice types with origin 'user-alice'
    docA.transact(() => {
      textA.insert(textA.length, 'Alice added this. ');
    }, 'user-alice');

    // Bob types on B with origin 'user-bob'
    docB.transact(() => {
      textB.insert(textB.length, 'Bob added that. ');
    }, 'user-bob');

    // Sync updates between A and B
    Y.applyUpdate(docA, Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(docB, Y.encodeStateVector(docA)));
    Y.applyUpdate(docB, Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(docA, Y.encodeStateVector(docB)));

    expect(textA.toString()).toContain('Alice added this.');
    expect(textA.toString()).toContain('Bob added that.');

    // Alice presses Undo
    undoManagerA.undo();

    // Alice's edits should be undone, but Bob's edits must remain intact!
    expect(textA.toString()).not.toContain('Alice added this.');
    expect(textA.toString()).toContain('Bob added that.');

    // Sync Alice's undo to Bob
    Y.applyUpdate(docB, Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(docA, Y.encodeStateVector(docB)));
    expect(textB.toString()).toBe(textA.toString());
  });

  it('synchronizes real-time cursor awareness positions and selections', () => {
    const awarenessA = new Awareness(docA);
    const awarenessB = new Awareness(docB);

    awarenessA.setLocalState({
      user: {
        id: 'usr_alice',
        name: 'Alice Cooper',
        color: '#10b981',
      },
      cursor: {
        fileId: 'main.tex',
        line: 42,
        col: 15,
        updatedAt: Date.now(),
      },
    });

    // Encode awareness update from A and apply on B
    const update = encodeAwarenessUpdate(awarenessA, [docA.clientID]);
    applyAwarenessUpdate(awarenessB, update, 'remote');

    const statesOnB = awarenessB.getStates();
    const aliceState = statesOnB.get(docA.clientID);

    expect(aliceState).toBeDefined();
    expect(aliceState?.user.name).toBe('Alice Cooper');
    expect(aliceState?.user.color).toBe('#10b981');
    expect(aliceState?.cursor.line).toBe(42);
    expect(aliceState?.cursor.col).toBe(15);
    expect(aliceState?.cursor.fileId).toBe('main.tex');

    awarenessA.destroy();
    awarenessB.destroy();
  });

  it('synchronizes review comments and tracked suggestions collaboratively via CRDT arrays', () => {
    const commentsA = docA.getArray<ReviewComment>('project-comments');
    const commentsB = docB.getArray<ReviewComment>('project-comments');

    const newComment: ReviewComment = {
      id: 'comment-101',
      fileId: 'main.tex',
      line: 14,
      authorName: 'Dr. Elena',
      authorAvatar: 'DE',
      authorColor: '#a855f7',
      text: 'Please cite Knuth 1984 here.',
      createdAt: '12:00',
      resolved: false,
    };

    commentsA.push([newComment]);

    // Sync
    Y.applyUpdate(docB, Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(docA));

    expect(commentsB.length).toBe(1);
    expect(commentsB.get(0).text).toBe('Please cite Knuth 1984 here.');
    expect(commentsB.get(0).authorName).toBe('Dr. Elena');

    // Bob resolves the comment on B
    docB.transact(() => {
      const existing = commentsB.get(0);
      commentsB.delete(0, 1);
      commentsB.insert(0, [{ ...existing, resolved: true }]);
    });

    // Sync back to A
    Y.applyUpdate(docA, Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(docB));
    expect(commentsA.get(0).resolved).toBe(true);
  });

  it('provides zero-credential BroadcastChannel local fallback for offline multi-tab dev', () => {
    const userA: Collaborator = {
      id: 'usr_tab_a',
      name: 'Tab A User',
      color: '#38bdf8',
      cursorLine: 1,
      cursorCol: 1,
      activeFile: 'main.tex',
      status: 'active',
      isSelf: true,

      { id: 'main.tex', name: 'main.tex', content: '\\documentclass{article}', type: 'tex' },

});
````

## File: docs/security/share-links-rls-analysis.md
````markdown
# Share Links vs. Supabase Row-Level Security (RLS) Analysis

This document provides a comprehensive security review and architectural analysis of project sharing capability tokens (`shareSecurityService.ts`) versus database-level enforcement in Supabase migrations (`0001_rls_ownership.sql` and `0002_yjs_collaboration.sql`).

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Confirmation

- **User Inquiry**: Does migration `0002_yjs_collaboration.sql` (or `0001_rls_ownership.sql`) verify share tokens or roles, or are share links enforced purely on the client?
- **Finding**: **Confirmed**. Share capability tokens (`ed_<random_32_hex>` and `vw_<sha256_hash>`) are enforced **exclusively in the client application** (`shareSecurityService.ts`). Neither `0001_rls_ownership.sql` nor `0002_yjs_collaboration.sql` inspects or verifies share tokens.

---

## 2. Policy Enforcement Breakdown

### Migration `0001_rls_ownership.sql`
In `0001_rls_ownership.sql`, policies are defined on `public.projects`, `public.checkpoints`, and `public.profiles`:

```sql
-- Read Policy
create policy "projects_select_own_or_member"
  on public.projects for select
  to authenticated
  using (
    owner_uid = auth.uid()
    or public.teeex_is_project_member(members, auth.jwt() ->> 'email')
  );

-- Update Policy
create policy "projects_update_own_or_writer"
  on public.projects for update
  to authenticated
  using (
    owner_uid = auth.uid()
    or public.teeex_is_project_writer(members, auth.jwt() ->> 'email')
  )
  with check (
    owner_uid = auth.uid()
    or public.teeex_is_project_writer(members, auth.jwt() ->> 'email')
  );
```

### Migration `0002_yjs_collaboration.sql`
In `0002_yjs_collaboration.sql`, policies are defined on `public.project_crdt_states`:

```sql
-- Select policy
create policy "crdt_states_select_via_project"
  on public.project_crdt_states for select
  to authenticated
  using (
    exists (
      select 1 from public.projects p
      where p.id = project_crdt_states.project_id
        and (
          p.owner_uid = auth.uid()
          or public.teeex_is_project_member(p.members, auth.jwt() ->> 'email')
        )
    )
  );

-- Insert & Update policy
create policy "crdt_states_update_via_project"
  on public.project_crdt_states for update
  to authenticated
  using (
    exists (
      select 1 from public.projects p
      where p.id = project_crdt_states.project_id
        and (
          p.owner_uid = auth.uid()
          or public.teeex_is_project_writer(p.members, auth.jwt() ->> 'email')
        )
    )
  );
```

---

## 3. Threat Model & Security Boundaries

| Collaborator Type | Client Enforcement (`shareSecurityService.ts`) | Server / Database Enforcement (`Postgres RLS`) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Anonymous Visitor** | Evaluates `?key=ed_...` or `?key=vw_...` locally | **Blocked 100%**: All DB policies are `to authenticated`. Cannot read or write `projects` or `project_crdt_states`. |
| **Logged-In User (Not in `members`)** | Sets editor to `readOnly` if given `vw_...` | **Blocked 100%**: User email is not in `members` and `auth.uid() != owner_uid`. All DB queries fail with RLS denial. |
| **Invited Viewer (in `members` with `role: viewer`)** | Sets editor to `readOnly` | **Enforced**: `teeex_is_project_writer` checks `m ->> 'role' in ('owner', 'editor')`. DB blocks update queries. |
| **Invited Editor given View Link** | Sets UI to `readOnly` based on `?key=vw_...` | **Vulnerable to UI bypass**: Because the server only checks `members` (where they are listed as editor), a direct Supabase REST/GraphQL call succeeds. |

---

## 4. Architectural Remediation Blueprint: Migration 0004

To enforce capability tokens on the server without forcing guest users to create accounts, projects can store cryptographic hashes of the active `edit_token` and `view_token`:

```sql
-- ==============================================================================
-- Teeex — 0004: Server-Side Share Capability Tokens & Anonymous Link Access
-- ==============================================================================

create extension if not exists pgcrypto;

alter table public.projects
  add column if not exists edit_token_hash text,
  add column if not exists view_token_hash text,
  add column if not exists share_tokens_revoked boolean default false;

-- Allow read access via view token or edit token passed via header or RPC:
create or replace function public.teeex_verify_token(p_token text, p_hash text)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
set search_path = public, extensions, pg_temp
as $$
  select p_token is not null
     and p_hash is not null
     and encode(digest(p_token, 'sha256'::text), 'hex') = p_hash;
$$;
```

When projects are saved to the cloud, the owner's client sends `sha256(editToken)` and `sha256(viewToken)` to the server. Then, Postgres functions or session headers allow access even for unauthenticated link holders while strictly preventing view-link holders from executing edit operations.
````

````typescript
import React, { useRef, useEffect, useCallback, useState } from 'react';
import { getThemeColors, type SyntaxTheme } from '../services/syntaxHighlighter';

interface Props {
  code: string;
  theme: SyntaxTheme;
  isLightMode: boolean;
  scrollTop: number;
  viewportHeight: number;
  totalContentHeight: number;
  onScrollTo: (targetScrollTop: number) => void;
  width?: number;
}

export const EditorMinimap: React.FC<Props> = ({
  code,
  theme,
  isLightMode,
  scrollTop,
  viewportHeight,
  totalContentHeight,
  onScrollTo,
  width = 62,
}) => {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);

  // Render Minimap onto Canvas
  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas || viewportHeight <= 0) return;

    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;

    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    canvas.width = width * dpr;
    canvas.height = viewportHeight * dpr;
    ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);

    // Clear canvas
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, viewportHeight);

    const colors = getThemeColors(theme, isLightMode);
    const lines = code.split('\n');
    const totalLines = Math.max(1, lines.length);

    // Calculate line height on minimap
    const minimapLineHeight = Math.max(1.8, Math.min(3.5, viewportHeight / totalLines));

    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, minimapLineHeight * 0.7);

    for (let i = 0; i < totalLines; i++) {
      const line = lines[i];
      if (!line || line.trim().length === 0) continue;

      const y = i * minimapLineHeight;
      if (y > viewportHeight) break;

      const trimmed = line.trimStart();
      const indent = Math.min(18, (line.length - trimmed.length) * 1.5);

      // Determine primary token color for this line
      let strokeColor = colors.defaultText;
      if (trimmed.startsWith('%')) {
        strokeColor = colors.comment;
      } else if (trimmed.includes('\\begin') || trimmed.includes('\\end') || trimmed.startsWith('\\')) {
        strokeColor = colors.command;
      } else if (trimmed.includes('$') || trimmed.includes('\\[')) {
        strokeColor = colors.math;
      }

      ctx.fillStyle = strokeColor;
      ctx.globalAlpha = trimmed.startsWith('%') ? 0.45 : 0.75;

      // Draw word segments
      const words = trimmed.split(/\s+/);
      let currentX = 4 + indent;

      for (const word of words) {
        if (currentX >= width - 6) break;
        const wordLen = Math.min(16, word.length * 1.6);
        ctx.fillRect(currentX, y, wordLen, Math.max(1, minimapLineHeight - 0.8));
        currentX += wordLen + 2;
      }
    }

    ctx.globalAlpha = 1.0;
  }, [code, theme, isLightMode, viewportHeight, width]);

  // Compute slider bounds for hardware-accelerated CSS compositor layer
  const visibleRatio = totalContentHeight > 0 ? Math.min(1, viewportHeight / totalContentHeight) : 1;
  const sliderHeight = Math.max(20, viewportHeight * visibleRatio);
  const scrollRange = Math.max(1, totalContentHeight - viewportHeight);
  const scrollRatio = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, scrollTop / scrollRange));
  const sliderY = scrollRatio * (viewportHeight - sliderHeight);
  const showSlider = totalContentHeight > viewportHeight;

  // Handle Drag / Click navigation
  const handlePointerDown = useCallback((e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    setIsDragging(true);
    const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    const clickY = e.clientY - rect.top;
    const ratio = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, clickY / viewportHeight));
    const targetScroll = ratio * Math.max(0, totalContentHeight - viewportHeight);
    onScrollTo(targetScroll);
    (e.target as HTMLElement).setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);
  }, [viewportHeight, totalContentHeight, onScrollTo]);

  const handlePointerMove = useCallback((e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!isDragging) return;
    const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    const moveY = e.clientY - rect.top;
    const ratio = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, moveY / viewportHeight));
    const targetScroll = ratio * Math.max(0, totalContentHeight - viewportHeight);
    onScrollTo(targetScroll);
  }, [isDragging, viewportHeight, totalContentHeight, onScrollTo]);

  const handlePointerUp = useCallback((e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    setIsDragging(false);
    (e.target as HTMLElement).releasePointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);
  }, []);

  return (
    <div
      ref={containerRef}
      onPointerDown={handlePointerDown}
      onPointerMove={handlePointerMove}
      onPointerUp={handlePointerUp}
      style={{
        width,
        height: '100%',
        backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-surface-0)',
        borderLeft: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)',
        position: 'relative',
        cursor: isDragging ? 'grabbing' : 'pointer',
        userSelect: 'none',
        flexShrink: 0,
        overflow: 'hidden',
      }}
      title="Code Minimap: Click or drag to jump across document"
    >
      <canvas
        ref={canvasRef}
        style={{
          width,
          height: '100%',
          display: 'block',
        }}
      />
      {showSlider && (
        <div
          className="minimap-viewport-slider"
          style={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: 0,
            left: 0,
            width: '100%',
            height: sliderHeight,
            transform: `translate3d(0, ${sliderY}px, 0)`,
            willChange: 'transform',
            backgroundColor: isLightMode ? 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.16)' : 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.18)',
            border: '1px solid #38bdf8',
            borderRadius: 2,
            boxSizing: 'border-box',
            pointerEvents: 'none',
          }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
````

## File: src/hooks/useAutosaveRecovery.ts
````typescript
/**
 * Teeex — Autosave & Crash Recovery Engine.
 * Dual-write architecture:
 *  1. Periodic asynchronous persistence to IndexedDB project storage.
 *  2. Synchronous emergency mirror to localStorage draft key on every change
 *     and on beforeunload / visibilitychange.
 * Detects crashes and uncommitted drafts on startup, offering an authoritative
 * 1-click restore banner.
 */

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import type { Project, ProjectFile } from '../types/latex';
import { saveProjectOffline } from '../services/offlineStorageService';
import { updateProject } from '../services/projectsService';

export interface RecoveredDraftInfo {
  timestamp: number;
  fileCount: number;
  files: ProjectFile[];
  folders?: string[];
  title?: string;
}

export interface UseAutosaveRecoveryOptions {
  activeProject: Project;
  files: ProjectFile[];
  folders: string[];
  projectTitle: string;
  onApplyRecoveredDraft?: (draft: RecoveredDraftInfo) => void;
  debounceMs?: number;
}

export interface AutosaveRecoveryResult {
  isDirty: boolean;
  lastSaved: Date | null;
  hasRecoverableCrash: boolean;
  recoveredDraftInfo: RecoveredDraftInfo | null;
  restoreRecoveredDraft: () => void;
  discardRecoveredDraft: () => void;
  saveNow: () => Promise<void>;
  markDirty: (immediateFiles?: ProjectFile[]) => void;
}

export const EMERGENCY_DRAFT_PREFIX = 'teeex_emergency_draft_';

export function getEmergencyDraftKey(projectId: string): string {
  return `${EMERGENCY_DRAFT_PREFIX}${projectId}`;
}

export function readEmergencyDraft(projectId: string): RecoveredDraftInfo | null {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(getEmergencyDraftKey(projectId));
    if (!raw) return null;
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (parsed && Array.isArray(parsed.files) && typeof parsed.timestamp === 'number') {
      return parsed as RecoveredDraftInfo;
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('[AutosaveRecovery] Failed reading emergency draft:', e);
  }
  return null;
}

export function clearEmergencyDraft(projectId: string): void {
  try {
    localStorage.removeItem(getEmergencyDraftKey(projectId));
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('[AutosaveRecovery] Failed clearing emergency draft:', e);
  }
}

export function writeEmergencyDraft(
  projectId: string,
  files: ProjectFile[],
  folders: string[],
  title: string
): void {
  try {
    const draft: RecoveredDraftInfo = {
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      fileCount: files.length,
      files,
      folders,
      title,
    };
    localStorage.setItem(getEmergencyDraftKey(projectId), JSON.stringify(draft));
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('[AutosaveRecovery] Failed writing emergency draft:', e);
  }
}

export function useAutosaveRecovery({
  activeProject,
  files,
  folders,
  projectTitle,
  onApplyRecoveredDraft,
  debounceMs = 1500,
}: UseAutosaveRecoveryOptions): AutosaveRecoveryResult {
  const [isDirty, setIsDirty] = useState(false);
  const [lastSaved, setLastSaved] = useState<Date | null>(() => {
    if (activeProject?.updatedAt) {
      const d = new Date(activeProject.updatedAt);
      if (Number.isFinite(d.getTime())) return d;
    }
    return new Date();
  });
  const [hasRecoverableCrash, setHasRecoverableCrash] = useState(false);
  const [recoveredDraftInfo, setRecoveredDraftInfo] = useState<RecoveredDraftInfo | null>(null);

  const activeProjectId = activeProject?.id || 'default';
  const saveTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  // Latest references for synchronous unload flushing
  const stateRef = useRef({
    projectId: activeProjectId,
    files,
    folders,
    projectTitle,
    isDirty,
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    stateRef.current = {
      projectId: activeProjectId,
      files,
      folders,
      projectTitle,
      isDirty,
    };
  }, [activeProjectId, files, folders, projectTitle, isDirty]);

  // Check for crash recovery draft when active project changes or mounts
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!activeProjectId) return;
    const draft = readEmergencyDraft(activeProjectId);
    if (draft) {
      const rawTime = activeProject?.updatedAt ? new Date(activeProject.updatedAt).getTime() : 0;
      const projUpdatedAt = Number.isFinite(rawTime) ? rawTime : 0;
      // If emergency draft is newer by at least 1.5 seconds, present recovery banner
      if (draft.timestamp > projUpdatedAt + 1500) {
        setHasRecoverableCrash(true);
        setRecoveredDraftInfo(draft);
      } else {
        // Obsolete draft from previously cleanly saved session
        clearEmergencyDraft(activeProjectId);
      }
    } else {
      setHasRecoverableCrash(false);
      setRecoveredDraftInfo(null);
    }
  }, [activeProjectId, activeProject?.updatedAt]);

  const saveNow = useCallback(async () => {
    const current = stateRef.current;
    if (!current.projectId) return;

    try {
      // 1. IndexedDB persistence
      await saveProjectOffline({
        ...activeProject,
        files: current.files,
        folders: current.folders,
        title: current.projectTitle,
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      });

      // 2. In-memory project service update
      updateProject(current.projectId, {
        files: current.files,
        folders: current.folders,
        title: current.projectTitle,
      });

      // 3. Mark clean and clear emergency draft
      setIsDirty(false);
      setLastSaved(new Date());
      clearEmergencyDraft(current.projectId);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[AutosaveRecovery] Periodic save failed:', err);
    }
  }, [activeProject]);

  const markDirty = useCallback((immediateFiles?: ProjectFile[]) => {
    setIsDirty(true);
    const current = stateRef.current;
    const targetFiles = immediateFiles || current.files;
    stateRef.current = {
      ...current,
      files: targetFiles,
      isDirty: true,
    };
    writeEmergencyDraft(current.projectId, targetFiles, current.folders, current.projectTitle);

    if (saveTimerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(saveTimerRef.current);
    }
    saveTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      saveNow();
    }, debounceMs);
  }, [debounceMs, saveNow]);

  // Listen to beforeunload and visibilitychange to synchronously write emergency draft
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleUnloadOrHide = () => {
      const current = stateRef.current;
      if (current.isDirty && current.projectId) {
        writeEmergencyDraft(current.projectId, current.files, current.folders, current.projectTitle);
      }
    };

    const handleVisibilityChange = () => {
      if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') {
        handleUnloadOrHide();
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', handleUnloadOrHide);
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibilityChange);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('beforeunload', handleUnloadOrHide);
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibilityChange);
      if (saveTimerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(saveTimerRef.current);
      }
    };
  }, []);

  const restoreRecoveredDraft = useCallback(() => {
    if (!recoveredDraftInfo) return;
    if (onApplyRecoveredDraft) {
      onApplyRecoveredDraft(recoveredDraftInfo);
    }
    setHasRecoverableCrash(false);
    setRecoveredDraftInfo(null);
    clearEmergencyDraft(activeProjectId);
  }, [recoveredDraftInfo, onApplyRecoveredDraft, activeProjectId]);

  const discardRecoveredDraft = useCallback(() => {
    setHasRecoverableCrash(false);
    setRecoveredDraftInfo(null);
    clearEmergencyDraft(activeProjectId);
  }, [activeProjectId]);

  return {
    isDirty,
    lastSaved,
    hasRecoverableCrash,
    recoveredDraftInfo,
    restoreRecoveredDraft,
    discardRecoveredDraft,
    saveNow,
    markDirty,
  };
}
````

````typescript
import { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import type { Collaborator, Project, ProjectRole, ReviewComment, TrackedChange, UserProfile, ProjectFile } from '../types/latex';
import { verifyShareKey, verifyShareKeyWithServer } from '../services/shareSecurityService';
import { SupabaseYjsProvider } from '../services/yjsProvider';
import { isSupabaseConnected } from '../services/supabaseClient';
import { updateProject } from '../services/projectsService';
import { setFiles, projectStore } from '../stores/projectStore';
import { logAuditAction } from '../services/auditService';

interface UseCollaborationOptions {
  activeProjectId: string;
  activeProject?: Project;
  currentUser: UserProfile | null;
  activeFileId?: string;
  onSelectFile?: (fileId: string) => void;
  onJumpToLine?: (line: number) => void;
  onToast?: (message: string) => void;
}

export function useCollaboration({
  activeProjectId,
  activeProject,
  currentUser,
  activeFileId = 'main.tex',
  onSelectFile,
  onJumpToLine,
  onToast,
}: UseCollaborationOptions) {
  const activeFileIdRef = useRef(activeFileId);
  useEffect(() => {
    activeFileIdRef.current = activeFileId;
  }, [activeFileId]);

  // Scoped room ID: If URL has ?room=, use it. Otherwise namespace to the active project (Finding 8)
  const [roomId] = useState<string>(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 'proj_default';
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    return params.get('room') || `proj_${activeProjectId || 'default'}`;
  });

  // Base synchronous role calculation
  const initialRole = useMemo<ProjectRole>(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 'owner';
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const isSharedRoom = Boolean(params.get('room'));
    const key = params.get('key');

    if (isSharedRoom) {
      if (key) {
        const verified = verifyShareKey(roomId, key);
        if (verified) return verified;
      }
      if (currentUser && activeProject?.ownerEmail === currentUser.email) {
        return 'owner';
      }
      return 'viewer';
    }

    if (currentUser && activeProject) {
      if (activeProject.ownerEmail === currentUser.email || activeProject.ownerId === currentUser.id) {
        return 'owner';
      }
      const member = activeProject.members?.find(
        m => m.email?.toLowerCase() === currentUser.email?.toLowerCase() || m.id === currentUser.id
      );
      if (member) return member.role;
    }

    return activeProject?.role || 'owner';
  }, [activeProject, currentUser, roomId]);

  const [currentRole, setCurrentRole] = useState<ProjectRole>(initialRole);

  // Sync role with base calculation
  useEffect(() => {
    setCurrentRole(initialRole);
  }, [initialRole]);

  // Asynchronous server verification for unknown edit capability keys (Finding 2)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const key = params.get('key');
    if (key && key.startsWith('ed_') && currentRole === 'viewer') {
      verifyShareKeyWithServer(roomId, key)
        .then(verified => {
          if (verified === 'editor') {
            setCurrentRole('editor');
          }
        })
        .catch(() => {});
    }
  }, [roomId, currentRole]);

  // Initial selfUser collaborator state
  const [selfUser, setSelfUser] = useState<Collaborator>(() => {
    const savedName = typeof localStorage !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem('teeex_user_name') || 'Guest Author' : 'Guest Author';
    const userId =
      typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && typeof crypto.randomUUID === 'function'
        ? `usr_${crypto.randomUUID()}`
        : `usr_${Date.now().toString(36)}`;
    const color = '#38bdf8';
    if (currentUser) {
      return {
        id: currentUser.id || userId,
        name: currentUser.fullName,
        avatar: currentUser.fullName.substring(0, 2).toUpperCase(),
        color: currentUser.avatarColor || color,
        role: initialRole,
        cursorLine: 1,
        cursorCol: 1,
        activeFile: 'main.tex',
        status: 'active',
        isSelf: true,
      };
    }
    return {
      id: userId,
      name: savedName,
      avatar: savedName.substring(0, 2).toUpperCase(),
      color,
      role: initialRole || 'owner',
      cursorLine: 1,
      cursorCol: 1,
      activeFile: 'main.tex',
      status: 'active',
      isSelf: true,
    };
  });

  // Keep selfUser updated reactively when currentRole or currentUser changes (Finding 7)
  useEffect(() => {
    setSelfUser(prev => {
      const nextRole = currentRole || 'owner';
      const nextName = currentUser?.fullName || prev.name;
      const nextAvatar = nextName.substring(0, 2).toUpperCase();
      const nextColor = currentUser?.avatarColor || prev.color;
      if (prev.role === nextRole && prev.name === nextName && prev.color === nextColor) {
        return prev;
      }
      return {
        ...prev,
        role: nextRole,
        name: nextName,
        avatar: nextAvatar,
        color: nextColor,
      };
    });
  }, [currentRole, currentUser]);

  // Yjs CRDT Collaboration Provider
  const [provider, setProvider] = useState<SupabaseYjsProvider | null>(null);
  const providerRef = useRef<SupabaseYjsProvider | null>(null);
  const selfUserRef = useRef(selfUser);

  const [activeCursorLine, setActiveCursorLine] = useState<number>(1);
  const cursorThrottleRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  const [peers, setPeers] = useState<Collaborator[]>([]);
  const [comments, setComments] = useState<ReviewComment[]>([]);
  const [trackedChanges, setTrackedChanges] = useState<TrackedChange[]>([]);

  // Initialize and observe Yjs provider — lifecycle strictly bound to activeProjectId
  useEffect(() => {
    let p = providerRef.current;
    if (!p || p.projectId !== activeProjectId || p.isDestroyed) {
      if (p && !p.isDestroyed) p.destroy();
      const currentFiles = projectStore.getState().files;
      p = new SupabaseYjsProvider(
        activeProjectId,
        selfUserRef.current,
        currentFiles,
        (updatedFiles: ProjectFile[]) => {
          setFiles(prev => {
            const map = new Map(updatedFiles.map(f => [f.id, f.content]));
            return prev.map(f => (map.has(f.id) ? { ...f, content: map.get(f.id)! } : f));
          });
          updateProject(activeProjectId, { files: projectStore.getState().files });
        }
      );
      providerRef.current = p;
      setProvider(p);
    }

    p.loadSnapshotFromCloud().catch(() => {});

    const unsubPeers = p.onPeersChange(livePeers => {
      setPeers(livePeers);
    });

    const yComments = p.getCommentsArray();
    const updateComments = () => {
      const arr = yComments.toArray();
      if (arr.length > 0) setComments(arr);
    };
    yComments.observe(updateComments);

    const yTracked = p.getTrackedChangesArray();
    const updateTracked = () => {
      const arr = yTracked.toArray();
      if (arr.length > 0) setTrackedChanges(arr);
    };
    yTracked.observe(updateTracked);

    return () => {
      unsubPeers();
      yComments.unobserve(updateComments);
      yTracked.unobserve(updateTracked);
    };
  }, [activeProjectId]);

  // Imperatively sync selfUser changes to Yjs awareness without tearing down the provider
  useEffect(() => {
    selfUserRef.current = selfUser;
    if (providerRef.current?.awareness) {
      providerRef.current.awareness.setLocalStateField('user', selfUser);
    }
  }, [selfUser]);

  // Clean up provider on unmount
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (providerRef.current) {
        providerRef.current.destroy();
        providerRef.current = null;
      }
    };
  }, []);

  // Update peer awareness with new cursor position (throttling UI outline to 200ms)
  const handleCursorChange = useCallback((line: number, col: number) => {
    providerRef.current?.setLocalCursor(activeFileIdRef.current, line, col);
    if (cursorThrottleRef.current) clearTimeout(cursorThrottleRef.current);
    cursorThrottleRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setActiveCursorLine(prev => (prev !== line ? line : prev));
    }, 200);
  }, []);

  // Comments
  const handleAddComment = useCallback((line: number, text: string) => {
    const newComment: ReviewComment = {
      id: 'comment-' + Date.now(),
      fileId: activeFileIdRef.current,
      line,
      authorName: selfUser.name,
      authorAvatar: selfUser.avatar,
      authorColor: selfUser.color,
      text,
      createdAt: 'Just now',
      resolved: false,
    };
    setComments(prev => [...prev, newComment]);
    provider?.getCommentsArray().push([newComment]);
  }, [selfUser, provider]);

  const handleResolveComment = useCallback((commentId: string) => {
    setComments(prev => prev.map(c => (c.id === commentId ? { ...c, resolved: true } : c)));
    if (provider) {
      const yArr = provider.getCommentsArray();
      const idx = yArr.toArray().findIndex(c => c.id === commentId);
      if (idx >= 0) {
        const item = yArr.get(idx);
        yArr.delete(idx, 1);
        yArr.insert(idx, [{ ...item, resolved: true }]);
      }
    }
  }, [provider]);

  // Follow peer in editor
  const handleFollowPeer = useCallback((peer: Collaborator) => {
    if (peer.activeFile && peer.activeFile !== activeFileIdRef.current && onSelectFile) {
      onSelectFile(peer.activeFile);
    }
    if (peer.cursorLine && onJumpToLine) {
      onJumpToLine(peer.cursorLine);
    }
    if (onToast) onToast(`Following ${peer.name}`);
  }, [onSelectFile, onJumpToLine, onToast]);

  // Tracked changes
  const handleAddTrackedChange = useCallback((change: Omit<TrackedChange, 'id' | 'status' | 'timestamp'>) => {
    const newChange: TrackedChange = {
      ...change,
      id:
        typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && typeof crypto.randomUUID === 'function'
          ? `change-${crypto.randomUUID()}`
          : `change-${Date.now()}`,
      timestamp: 'Just now',
      status: 'pending',
    };
    setTrackedChanges(prev => [newChange, ...prev]);
  }, []);

  const handleAcceptTrackedChange = useCallback((changeId: string) => {
    setTrackedChanges(prev => {
      const c = prev.find(t => t.id === changeId);
      if (c) {
        logAuditAction(
          activeProjectId,
          'CHANGE_ACCEPTED',
          `Accepted review suggestion: "${c.text.slice(0, 35)}..."`,
          currentUser?.fullName || 'Current User',
          currentRole,
          'collaboration'
        );
      }
      return prev.filter(t => t.id !== changeId);
    });
  }, [activeProjectId, currentUser, currentRole]);

  const handleRejectTrackedChange = useCallback((changeId: string) => {
    setTrackedChanges(prev => {
      const c = prev.find(t => t.id === changeId);
      if (c) {
        logAuditAction(
          activeProjectId,
          'CHANGE_REJECTED',
          `Rejected review suggestion: "${c.text.slice(0, 35)}..."`,
          currentUser?.fullName || 'Current User',
          currentRole,
          'collaboration'
        );
      }
      return prev.filter(t => t.id !== changeId);
    });
  }, [activeProjectId, currentUser, currentRole]);

  return {
    roomId,
    currentRole,
    selfUser,
    setSelfUser,
    peers,
    setPeers,
    provider,
    providerRef,
    comments,
    setComments,
    trackedChanges,
    setTrackedChanges,
    activeCursorLine,
    setActiveCursorLine,
    handleCursorChange,
    handleAddComment,
    handleResolveComment,
    handleFollowPeer,
    handleAddTrackedChange,
    handleAcceptTrackedChange,
    handleRejectTrackedChange,
    isCloudConnected: isSupabaseConnected(),
  };
}
````
