````typescript
import { useEffect, useMemo, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import type { UserProfile, Template, ProjectRole, ProjectMember } from '../types/latex';
import {
  projectStore,
  useProjectStore,
  setProjectState,
  setProjects,
  setFiles,
  setFolders,
  setProjectTitle,
} from '../stores/projectStore';
import {
  loadProjects,
  getActiveProjectId,
  createProject,
  duplicateProject,
  toggleArchiveProject,
  deleteProject,
  updateProject,
  syncProjectsWithCloudBiDirectional,
  hydrateProjectFromOffline,
} from '../services/projectsService';
import { saveProjectOffline } from '../services/offlineStorageService';
import { STARTER_TEMPLATES } from '../services/templates';
import { useAutosaveRecovery } from './useAutosaveRecovery';

interface UseProjectLifecycleOptions {
  currentUser: UserProfile | null;
  onToast: (message: string) => void;
  triggerCompile: () => void;
  providerRef?: React.MutableRefObject<any>;
}

export function useProjectLifecycle({
  currentUser,
  onToast,
  triggerCompile,
  providerRef,
}: UseProjectLifecycleOptions) {
  const projects = useProjectStore(s => s.projects);
  const activeProjectId = useProjectStore(s => s.activeProjectId);
  const files = useProjectStore(s => s.files);
  const folders = useProjectStore(s => s.folders);
  const projectTitle = useProjectStore(s => s.projectTitle);

  // Initialize projects and active project on initial load
  const isInitializedRef = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isInitializedRef.current) return;
    isInitializedRef.current = true;

    const initialProjects = loadProjects(currentUser?.email, currentUser?.fullName);
    const initialActiveId = getActiveProjectId(initialProjects);
    const active = initialProjects.find(p => p.id === initialActiveId) || initialProjects[0];

    const initialFiles = active?.files || STARTER_TEMPLATES[0].files;
    const initialFolders = active?.folders || ['sections', 'figures'];
    const firstFileId = initialFiles[0]?.id || 'main.tex';

    setProjectState({
      projects: initialProjects,
      activeProjectId: initialActiveId,
      files: initialFiles,
      folders: initialFolders,
      activeFileId: firstFileId,
      openFileIds: [firstFileId],
      projectTitle: active?.title || 'Untitled Project',
    });

    if (active?.files.some(f => (f as any)._persistedInIdb)) {
      hydrateProjectFromOffline(initialActiveId).then(offlineProj => {
        if (offlineProj && Array.isArray(offlineProj.files) && offlineProj.files.length > 0) {
          setProjectState({
            files: offlineProj.files,
            folders: offlineProj.folders || ['sections', 'figures'],
          });
        }
      }).catch(() => {});
    }
  }, [currentUser]);

  const activeProject = useMemo(() => {
    return projects.find(p => p.id === activeProjectId) || projects[0];
  }, [projects, activeProjectId]);

  // Synchronous flush of current project state
  const flushCurrentProjectSave = useCallback(() => {
    const s = projectStore.getState();
    const pid = s.activeProjectId;
    if (!pid) return;

    const updatedProjects = updateProject(pid, {
      files: s.files,
      folders: s.folders,
      title: s.projectTitle,
    });
    setProjects(updatedProjects);

    const currProj = s.projects.find(p => p.id === pid) || updatedProjects.find(p => p.id === pid);
    if (currProj) {
      saveProjectOffline({
        ...currProj,
        files: s.files,
        folders: s.folders,
        title: s.projectTitle,
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      }).catch(() => {});
    }
  }, []);

  // Flush on beforeunload and visibility change
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleBeforeUnload = () => flushCurrentProjectSave();
    const handleVisibilityChange = () => {
      if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') flushCurrentProjectSave();
    };

    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', handleBeforeUnload);
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibilityChange);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('beforeunload', handleBeforeUnload);
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibilityChange);
    };
  }, [flushCurrentProjectSave]);

  // Debounced auto-save during typing
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      flushCurrentProjectSave();
    }, 800);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [files, folders, projectTitle, activeProjectId, flushCurrentProjectSave]);

  // Autosave crash recovery
  const {
    hasRecoverableCrash,
    recoveredDraftInfo,
    restoreRecoveredDraft,
    discardRecoveredDraft,
    markDirty,
  } = useAutosaveRecovery({
    activeProject,
    files,
    folders,
    projectTitle,
    onApplyRecoveredDraft: (draft) => {
      if (draft.files) setFiles(draft.files);
      if (draft.folders) setFolders(draft.folders);
      if (draft.title) setProjectTitle(draft.title);
      if (providerRef?.current && draft.files) {
        draft.files.forEach(f => {
          const yText = providerRef.current.getText(f.id);
          if (yText.toString() !== f.content) {
            providerRef.current.getDoc().transact(() => {
              yText.delete(0, yText.length);
              yText.insert(0, f.content);
            }, 'local-editor');
          }
        });
      }
      onToast('Restored uncommitted session from crash recovery.');
    },
  });

  // Bi-directional cloud sync on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;
    if (currentUser?.email) {
      syncProjectsWithCloudBiDirectional(currentUser.email, currentUser.fullName)
        .then(res => {
          if (!isMounted) return;
          if (res.success && res.projects && res.projects.length > 0) {
            setProjects(res.projects);
          }
        })
        .catch(() => {});
    }
    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, [currentUser]);

  // Project switching & CRUD
  const handleSelectProject = useCallback((projId: string) => {
    if (projId === projectStore.getState().activeProjectId) return;
    flushCurrentProjectSave();

    const currProjects = projectStore.getState().projects;
    const proj = currProjects.find(p => p.id === projId) || loadProjects().find(p => p.id === projId);
    if (!proj) return;

    const firstId = proj.files[0]?.id || 'main.tex';
    setProjectState({
      activeProjectId: projId,
      files: proj.files,
      folders: proj.folders || ['sections', 'figures'],
      activeFileId: firstId,
      openFileIds: [firstId],
      projectTitle: proj.title,
    });

    if (proj.files.some(f => (f as any)._persistedInIdb)) {
      hydrateProjectFromOffline(projId).then(offlineProj => {
        if (offlineProj && Array.isArray(offlineProj.files) && offlineProj.files.length > 0) {
          setProjectState({
            files: offlineProj.files,
            folders: offlineProj.folders || ['sections', 'figures'],
          });
          setTimeout(() => triggerCompile(), 60);
        }
      }).catch(() => {});
    } else {
      setTimeout(() => triggerCompile(), 60);
    }
  }, [flushCurrentProjectSave, triggerCompile]);

  const handleCreateProject = useCallback((title: string, templateId?: string) => {
    flushCurrentProjectSave();

    const newProj = createProject(
      title,
      currentUser?.email || 'you@teeex.local',
      currentUser?.fullName || 'You',
      templateId
    );
    const updated = loadProjects(currentUser?.email, currentUser?.fullName);
    setProjects(updated);
    const proj = updated.find(p => p.id === newProj.id);
    if (proj) {
      const firstId = proj.files[0]?.id || 'main.tex';
      setProjectState({
        activeProjectId: proj.id,
        files: proj.files,
        folders: proj.folders || ['sections', 'figures'],
        activeFileId: firstId,
        openFileIds: [firstId],
        projectTitle: proj.title,
      });
      setTimeout(() => triggerCompile(), 60);
      onToast(`Created and opened project "${title}"`);
    }
  }, [currentUser, flushCurrentProjectSave, triggerCompile, onToast]);

  const handleDuplicateProject = useCallback((projId: string) => {
    flushCurrentProjectSave();

    const cloned = duplicateProject(projId);
    if (cloned) {
      const updated = loadProjects(currentUser?.email, currentUser?.fullName);
      setProjects(updated);
      const firstId = cloned.files[0]?.id || 'main.tex';
      setProjectState({
        activeProjectId: cloned.id,
        files: cloned.files,
        folders: cloned.folders || ['sections', 'figures'],
        activeFileId: firstId,
        openFileIds: [firstId],
        projectTitle: cloned.title,
      });
      setTimeout(() => triggerCompile(), 60);
      onToast(`Duplicated project "${cloned.title}"`);
    }
  }, [currentUser, flushCurrentProjectSave, triggerCompile, onToast]);

  const handleToggleArchiveProject = useCallback((projId: string) => {
    const updated = toggleArchiveProject(projId);
    setProjects(updated);
  }, []);

  const handleDeleteProject = useCallback((projId: string) => {
    const s = projectStore.getState();
    const updated = deleteProject(projId);
    setProjects(updated);
    if (s.activeProjectId === projId && updated.length > 0) {
      const next = updated[0];
      const firstId = next.files[0]?.id || 'main.tex';
      setProjectState({
        activeProjectId: next.id,
        files: next.files,
        folders: next.folders || ['sections', 'figures'],
        activeFileId: firstId,
        openFileIds: [firstId],
        projectTitle: next.title,
      });
      setTimeout(() => triggerCompile(), 60);
    }
    onToast('Project deleted.');
  }, [triggerCompile, onToast]);

  const handleSelectTemplate = useCallback((template: Template) => {
    const firstId = template.files[0]?.id || 'main.tex';
    setProjectState({
      files: template.files,
      activeFileId: firstId,
      openFileIds: [firstId],
      projectTitle: template.name,
    });
    setTimeout(() => triggerCompile(), 50);
  }, [triggerCompile]);

  // Project members
  const handleInviteMember = useCallback((email: string, role: ProjectRole) => {
    const s = projectStore.getState();
    const currProj = s.projects.find(p => p.id === s.activeProjectId);
    const newMember: ProjectMember = {
      id: `usr-${Date.now().toString(36)}`,
      email,
      name: email.split('@')[0].replace(/[._]/g, ' '),
      avatar: email.substring(0, 2).toUpperCase(),
      avatarColor: role === 'owner' ? '#38bdf8' : role === 'editor' ? '#10b981' : '#f59e0b',
      role,
      joinedAt: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
    };
    const members = [...(currProj?.members || []), newMember];
    const updated = updateProject(s.activeProjectId, { members });
    setProjects(updated);
  }, []);

  const handleUpdateMemberRole = useCallback((memberId: string, newRole: ProjectRole) => {
    const s = projectStore.getState();
    const currProj = s.projects.find(p => p.id === s.activeProjectId);
    const members = (currProj?.members || []).map(m =>
      m.id === memberId ? { ...m, role: newRole } : m
    );
    const updated = updateProject(s.activeProjectId, { members });
    setProjects(updated);
  }, []);

  const handleRemoveMember = useCallback((memberId: string) => {
    const s = projectStore.getState();
    const currProj = s.projects.find(p => p.id === s.activeProjectId);
    const members = (currProj?.members || []).filter(m => m.id !== memberId);
    const updated = updateProject(s.activeProjectId, { members });
    setProjects(updated);
  }, []);

  return {
    projects,
````

````typescript
import type { UserProfile } from '../types/latex';
import { useProjectLifecycle } from './useProjectLifecycle';
import { useFileOperations } from './useFileOperations';

interface UseProjectManagerOptions {
  currentUser: UserProfile | null;
  onToast: (message: string) => void;
  triggerCompile: () => void;
  providerRef?: React.MutableRefObject<any>;
}

export function useProjectManager({
  currentUser,
  onToast,
  triggerCompile,
  providerRef,
}: UseProjectManagerOptions) {
  const lifecycle = useProjectLifecycle({
    currentUser,
    onToast,
    triggerCompile,
    providerRef,
  });

  const fileOps = useFileOperations({
    currentUser,
    activeProject: lifecycle.activeProject,
    onToast,
    triggerCompile,
    markDirty: lifecycle.markDirty,
    providerRef,
  });

  return {
    ...lifecycle,
    ...fileOps,
  };
}
````

## File: src/services/collaboration.ts
````typescript
import type { Collaborator } from '../types/latex';

/**
 * Presence and document sync across tabs of the same browser.
 *
 * This is a `BroadcastChannel`, which is same-origin and same-browser: it does
 * NOT reach another person's machine. Nothing here is cross-user collaboration,
 * and the UI must not describe it as such. Real multi-user editing needs a CRDT
 * and a network transport, which is separate work.
 */

export interface RoomSyncMessage {
  type: 'FILE_UPDATE' | 'CURSOR_MOVE' | 'PEER_JOIN' | 'PEER_LEAVE';
  roomId: string;
  senderId: string;
  senderName: string;
  senderColor: string;
  fileId?: string;
  content?: string;
  cursorLine?: number;
  cursorCol?: number;
}

const PEER_COLORS = [
  '#38BDF8', // Sky Cyan
  '#10B981', // Emerald
  '#F59E0B', // Amber
  '#EC4899', // Pink
  '#8B5CF6', // Purple
  '#14B8A6', // Teal
];

export class CollaborationHub {
  private channel: BroadcastChannel | null = null;
  private roomId: string;
  public selfUser: Collaborator;
  private listeners: Array<(msg: RoomSyncMessage) => void> = [];

  constructor(roomId: string, initialUserName?: string) {
    this.roomId = roomId;
    const randomColor = PEER_COLORS[Math.floor(Math.random() * PEER_COLORS.length)];
    const savedName = localStorage.getItem('teeex_user_name') || initialUserName || 'Guest Author';
    const userId =
      typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && typeof crypto.randomUUID === 'function'
        ? `user_${crypto.randomUUID()}`
        : `user_${Date.now().toString(36)}`;

    this.selfUser = {
      id: userId,
      name: savedName,
      color: randomColor,
      avatar: savedName.substring(0, 2).toUpperCase(),
      cursorLine: 1,
      cursorCol: 1,
      activeFile: 'main.tex',
      status: 'active',
      isSelf: true,
    };

    if (typeof BroadcastChannel !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        this.channel = new BroadcastChannel(`teeex_room_${roomId}`);
        this.channel.onmessage = (event) => {
          const msg = event.data as RoomSyncMessage;
          if (msg.senderId !== this.selfUser.id) {
            this.notifyListeners(msg);
          }
        };
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('BroadcastChannel not supported or restricted', e);
      }
    }
  }

  public onMessage(callback: (msg: RoomSyncMessage) => void): () => void {
    this.listeners.push(callback);
    return () => {
      this.listeners = this.listeners.filter(l => l !== callback);
    };
  }

  private notifyListeners(msg: RoomSyncMessage) {
    for (const listener of this.listeners) {
      listener(msg);
    }
  }

  public broadcastFileUpdate(fileId: string, content: string) {
    const msg: RoomSyncMessage = {
      type: 'FILE_UPDATE',
      roomId: this.roomId,
      senderId: this.selfUser.id,
      senderName: this.selfUser.name,
      senderColor: this.selfUser.color,
      fileId,
      content,
    };
    this.channel?.postMessage(msg);
  }

  public broadcastCursor(fileId: string, line: number, col: number) {
    this.selfUser.cursorLine = line;
    this.selfUser.cursorCol = col;
    this.selfUser.activeFile = fileId;

    const msg: RoomSyncMessage = {
      type: 'CURSOR_MOVE',
      roomId: this.roomId,
      senderId: this.selfUser.id,
      senderName: this.selfUser.name,
      senderColor: this.selfUser.color,
      fileId,
      cursorLine: line,
      cursorCol: col,
    };
    this.channel?.postMessage(msg);
  }

  public destroy() {
    this.channel?.close();
    this.listeners = [];
  }
}
````

````typescript
import type { Project } from '../types/latex';
import type { Checkpoint } from './checkpointsService';

const DB_NAME = 'teeex_offline_db';
const DB_VERSION = 2;
const STORE_NAME = 'projects_cache';
const CHECKPOINTS_STORE = 'checkpoints_cache';

function openDatabase(): Promise<IDBDatabase> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (typeof indexedDB === 'undefined') {
      return reject(new Error('IndexedDB not supported in this environment'));
    }

    const request = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, DB_VERSION);

    request.onupgradeneeded = (e) => {
      const db = (e.target as IDBOpenDBRequest).result;
      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE_NAME)) {
        db.createObjectStore(STORE_NAME, { keyPath: 'id' });
      }
      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(CHECKPOINTS_STORE)) {
        db.createObjectStore(CHECKPOINTS_STORE, { keyPath: 'projectId' });
      }
    };

    request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
    request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
  });
}

export async function saveProjectOffline(project: Project): Promise<void> {
  if (typeof indexedDB === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    const db = await openDatabase();
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readwrite');
      const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
      const req = store.put({ ...project, _offlineSavedAt: Date.now() });

      req.onsuccess = () => resolve();
      req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Offline project storage failed:', err);
  }
}

export async function loadProjectOffline(projectId: string): Promise<Project | null> {
  try {
    const db = await openDatabase();
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readonly');
      const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
      const req = store.get(projectId);

      req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result || null);
      req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
    });
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export async function saveCheckpointsOffline(projectId: string, checkpoints: Checkpoint[]): Promise<void> {
  if (!projectId) return;
  try {
    const db = await openDatabase();
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const tx = db.transaction(CHECKPOINTS_STORE, 'readwrite');
      const store = tx.objectStore(CHECKPOINTS_STORE);
      const req = store.put({
        projectId,
        checkpoints,
        savedAt: Date.now(),
      });

      req.onsuccess = () => resolve();
      req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Offline checkpoints storage failed:', err);
  }
}

export async function loadCheckpointsOffline(projectId: string): Promise<Checkpoint[] | null> {
  if (!projectId) return null;
  try {
    const db = await openDatabase();
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const tx = db.transaction(CHECKPOINTS_STORE, 'readonly');
      const store = tx.objectStore(CHECKPOINTS_STORE);
      const req = store.get(projectId);

      req.onsuccess = () => {
        const result = req.result;
        if (result && Array.isArray(result.checkpoints)) {
          resolve(result.checkpoints);
        } else {
          resolve(null);
        }
      };
      req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
    });
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Requests durable (persistent) storage so the browser will not evict
 * offline projects, compiled PDFs, and checkpoints under disk pressure.
 */
export async function requestDurableStorage(): Promise<boolean> {
  if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.storage && navigator.storage.persist) {
    try {
      return await navigator.storage.persist();
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

/**
 * Proactively checks local storage quota health.
 */
export async function getStorageEstimate(): Promise<{ usageMB: number; quotaMB: number; percentUsed: number }> {
  if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.storage && navigator.storage.estimate) {
    try {
      const estimate = await navigator.storage.estimate();
      const usage = estimate.usage || 0;
      const quota = estimate.quota || 1;
      const usageMB = Math.round((usage / (1024 * 1024)) * 100) / 100;
      const quotaMB = Math.round((quota / (1024 * 1024)) * 100) / 100;
      const percentUsed = Math.min(100, Math.round((usage / quota) * 10000) / 100);
      return { usageMB, quotaMB, percentUsed };
    } catch {
      return { usageMB: 0, quotaMB: 0, percentUsed: 0 };
    }
  }
  return { usageMB: 0, quotaMB: 0, percentUsed: 0 };
}
````

## File: src/services/pdfSnapshotCache.ts
````typescript
/**
 * Teeex — Persistent PDF Snapshot Cache.
 *
 * Stores the most recently compiled PDF in IndexedDB per project.
 * When a user opens Teeex or refreshes the page, the cached PDF is restored in
 * < 50ms, eliminating the 20-second blank screen while the TeX engine warms up.
 */

const DB_NAME = 'teeex_artifacts_db';
const DB_VERSION = 1;
const STORE_PDF = 'pdf_snapshots';

export interface StoredPdfSnapshot {
  projectId: string;
  pdf: Uint8Array;
  synctex?: Uint8Array | null;
  timestamp: number;
}

let dbPromise: Promise<IDBDatabase | null> | null = null;

function openArtifactsDb(): Promise<IDBDatabase | null> {
  if (typeof indexedDB === 'undefined') return Promise.resolve(null);
  if (dbPromise) return dbPromise;

  dbPromise = new Promise((resolve) => {
    try {
      const req = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, DB_VERSION);
      req.onupgradeneeded = (ev) => {
        const db = (ev.target as IDBOpenDBRequest).result;
        if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE_PDF)) {
          db.createObjectStore(STORE_PDF, { keyPath: 'projectId' });
        }
        if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains('aux_artifacts')) {
          db.createObjectStore('aux_artifacts', { keyPath: 'projectId' });
        }
      };
      req.onsuccess = (ev) => resolve((ev.target as IDBOpenDBRequest).result);
      req.onerror = () => resolve(null);
    } catch {
      resolve(null);
    }
  });

  return dbPromise;
}

/**
 * Persists the compiled PDF and optional SyncTeX bytes to IndexedDB under the project ID.
 * Uses relaxed durability for non-blocking asynchronous disk writes.
 */
export async function saveCompiledPdfSnapshot(
  projectId: string,
  pdfBytes: Uint8Array,
  synctexBytes?: Uint8Array | null,
): Promise<void> {
  if (!projectId || !pdfBytes || pdfBytes.byteLength === 0) return;

  const db = await openArtifactsDb();
  if (!db) return;

  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const record: StoredPdfSnapshot = {
      projectId,
      pdf: pdfBytes,
      synctex: synctexBytes && synctexBytes.byteLength > 0 ? synctexBytes : null,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
    };

    try {
      const tx = (db as any).transaction(
        STORE_PDF,
        'readwrite',
        { durability: 'relaxed' },
      );
      const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_PDF);
      store.put(record);
      tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
      tx.onerror = () => resolve();
    } catch {
      try {
        const tx = db.transaction(STORE_PDF, 'readwrite');
        const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_PDF);
        store.put(record);
        tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
        tx.onerror = () => resolve();
      } catch {
        resolve();
      }
    }
  });
}

/**
 * Loads the latest compiled PDF bytes from IndexedDB.
 * Returns null if no snapshot exists or if storage is unavailable.
 */
export async function loadCompiledPdfSnapshot(
  projectId: string,
): Promise<Uint8Array | null> {
  const snapshot = await loadCompiledSnapshot(projectId);
  return snapshot ? snapshot.pdf : null;
}

/**
 * Loads the complete compiled snapshot (PDF and SyncTeX bytes) from IndexedDB.
 * Returns null if no snapshot exists or if storage is unavailable.
 */
export async function loadCompiledSnapshot(
  projectId: string,
): Promise<{ pdf: Uint8Array; synctex: Uint8Array | null } | null> {
  if (!projectId) return null;

  const db = await openArtifactsDb();
  if (!db) return null;

  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    try {
      const tx = db.transaction(STORE_PDF, 'readonly');
      const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_PDF);
      const req = store.get(projectId);

      req.onsuccess = () => {
        const res = req.result as StoredPdfSnapshot | undefined;
        if (res && res.pdf && res.pdf.byteLength > 0) {
          const pdf = res.pdf instanceof Uint8Array ? res.pdf : new Uint8Array(res.pdf);
          const synctex =
            res.synctex && res.synctex.byteLength > 0
              ? res.synctex instanceof Uint8Array
                ? res.synctex
                : new Uint8Array(res.synctex)
              : null;
          resolve({ pdf, synctex });
        } else {
          resolve(null);
        }
      };
      req.onerror = () => resolve(null);
    } catch {
      resolve(null);
    }
  });
}
````

````typescript
 * Provides customizable IDE color themes: Antigravity Neon, VS Code Dark+/Light, Monokai Pro, Dracula, and Normal

      comment: 'var(--text-muted)',
      number: 'inherit',

    },
  },
};

/**
 * Resolves theme colors with high-contrast adaptation for Light and Dark modes
 */
export function getThemeColors(theme: SyntaxTheme = 'vscode', isLight: boolean = false): ThemeColors {
  if (isLight) {
    switch (theme) {
      case 'vscode':
        return {
          command: '#0000ff',
          math: '#098658',
          brace: '#811f3f',
          bracket: '#0451a5',
          comment: '#008000',
          number: '#098658',
          defaultText: 'var(--text-primary)',
        };
      case 'monokai':
        return {
          command: '#d30e52',
          math: '#0284c7',
          brace: '#4d7c0f',
          bracket: '#c2410c',
          comment: '#78716c',
          number: '#7c3aed',
          defaultText: 'var(--text-primary)',
        };
      case 'dracula':
        return {
          command: '#c026d3',
          math: '#059669',
          brace: '#7c3aed',
          bracket: '#0284c7',
          comment: '#64748b',
          number: '#d97706',
          defaultText: 'var(--text-primary)',
        };
      case 'normal':
        return {
          command: 'inherit',
          math: 'inherit',
          brace: 'inherit',
          bracket: 'inherit',
          comment: 'var(--text-muted)',
          number: 'inherit',
          defaultText: 'var(--text-primary)',
        };
      case 'antigravity':
      default:
        return {
          command: '#0284c7',
          math: '#059669',
          brace: '#7c3aed',
          bracket: '#db2777',
          comment: '#64748b',
          number: '#d97706',
          defaultText: 'var(--text-primary)',
        };
    }
  }

  return SYNTAX_THEMES[theme]?.colors || SYNTAX_THEMES.vscode.colors;
}

function escapeHtml(str: string): string {
  return str
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
}

/**
 * Tokenize raw LaTeX code into syntax-highlighted HTML spans for the editor backdrop
 */
export function highlightLatexCode(
  code: string,
  theme: SyntaxTheme = 'vscode',
  isLight: boolean = false,
  matchingPair?: [number, number] | null
): string {
  if (theme === 'normal') {
    return escapeHtml(code);
  }

  const colors = getThemeColors(theme, isLight);

  // Regex tokenizer matching comments, math blocks, commands, delimiters, numbers, and symbols
  const tokenRegex = /(%[^\n]*)|(\$\$[\s\S]*?\$\$|\\\[[\s\S]*?\\\]|\$[^$\n]+\$|\\\(.*?\\\))|(\\[a-zA-Z@]+)|([{}])|([\[\]\(\)])|(\b\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?:pt|mm|cm|in|em|ex|%|s|ms|k|M|G)?\b)|(&|\\\\)/g;

  let lastIndex = 0;
  let html = '';
  let match: RegExpExecArray | null;

  while ((match = tokenRegex.exec(code)) !== null) {
    // Append plain text before match
    if (match.index > lastIndex) {
      html += escapeHtml(code.slice(lastIndex, match.index));
    }

    const [, comment, math, command, brace, bracket, number, symbol] = match;

    if (comment) {
      html += `<span style="color: ${colors.comment};">${escapeHtml(comment)}</span>`;
    } else if (math) {
      html += `<span style="color: ${colors.math};">${escapeHtml(math)}</span>`;
    } else if (command) {
      html += `<span style="color: ${colors.command};">${escapeHtml(command)}</span>`;
    } else if (brace) {
      const isMatched = matchingPair && (match.index === matchingPair[0] || match.index === matchingPair[1]);
      if (isMatched) {
        html += `<span class="latex-matching-bracket" style="border-bottom: 2px solid #f59e0b; background-color: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.28); border-radius: 2px; color: #f59e0b; font-weight: 700;">${escapeHtml(brace)}</span>`;
      } else {
        html += `<span style="color: ${colors.brace};">${escapeHtml(brace)}</span>`;
      }
    } else if (bracket) {
      const isMatched = matchingPair && (match.index === matchingPair[0] || match.index === matchingPair[1]);
      if (isMatched) {
        html += `<span class="latex-matching-bracket" style="border-bottom: 2px solid #f59e0b; background-color: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.28); border-radius: 2px; color: #f59e0b; font-weight: 700;">${escapeHtml(bracket)}</span>`;
      } else {
        html += `<span style="color: ${colors.bracket};">${escapeHtml(bracket)}</span>`;
      }
    } else if (number) {
      html += `<span style="color: ${colors.number};">${escapeHtml(number)}</span>`;
    } else if (symbol) {
      html += `<span style="color: ${colors.command};">${escapeHtml(symbol)}</span>`;
    }

    lastIndex = tokenRegex.lastIndex;
  }

  // Append remaining text
  if (lastIndex < code.length) {
    html += escapeHtml(code.slice(lastIndex));
  }

  return html;
}
````

## File: src/services/zipExporter.ts
````typescript
import type { ProjectFile } from '../types/latex';
import { dataUrlToUint8Array } from './virtualFileSystem';

/**
 * Packages all LaTeX files, bibliographies, and uploaded images into a clean .zip bundle
 * Ready for submission to arXiv, IEEE, ACM, or Overleaf.
 */
export async function exportProjectAsZip(projectTitle: string, files: ProjectFile[]): Promise<void> {
  const { default: JSZip } = await import('jszip');
  const zip = new JSZip();

  for (const file of files) {
    if (file.type === 'image' && file.dataUrl) {
      const buffer = dataUrlToUint8Array(file.dataUrl);
      zip.file(file.name, buffer, { binary: true });
    } else {
      zip.file(file.name, file.content);
    }
  }

  // Generate README inside zip
  zip.file('README_TEEEX.txt', `Project: ${projectTitle}\nExported from Teeex Studio (Collaborative LaTeX Platform)\nReady for compiling with pdflatex or tectonic.\nDate: ${new Date().toISOString()}\n`);

  const blob = await zip.generateAsync({ type: 'blob' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  const safeName = projectTitle.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_').toLowerCase();
  a.href = url;
  a.download = `${safeName}_latex_bundle.zip`;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}
````

````typescript
import { createStore, useStore } from './createStore';
import type { Project, ProjectFile } from '../types/latex';
import type { PaperFormatId } from '../services/paperFormats';

export interface ProjectState {
  projects: Project[];
  activeProjectId: string;
  files: ProjectFile[];
  folders: string[];
  activeFileId: string;
  openFileIds: string[];
  projectTitle: string;
  paperFormat: PaperFormatId;
  isTwoColumn: boolean;
}

const initialPaperFormat = (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined'
  ? (localStorage.getItem('teeex_paper_format') as PaperFormatId) || 'ieee'
  : 'ieee') as PaperFormatId;

const initialTwoColumn = typeof localStorage !== 'undefined'
  ? localStorage.getItem('teeex_column_mode') !== '1'
  : true;

const initialState: ProjectState = {
  projects: [],
  activeProjectId: '',
  files: [],
  folders: ['sections', 'figures'],
  activeFileId: '',
  openFileIds: [],
  projectTitle: 'Untitled Project',
  paperFormat: initialPaperFormat,
  isTwoColumn: initialTwoColumn,
};

export const projectStore = createStore<ProjectState>(initialState);

export function setProjectState(partial: Partial<ProjectState> | ((prev: ProjectState) => Partial<ProjectState>)): void {
  projectStore.setState(partial);
}

export function setProjects(projects: Project[]): void {
  projectStore.setState({ projects });
}

export function setActiveProjectId(activeProjectId: string): void {
  projectStore.setState({ activeProjectId });
}

export function setFiles(files: ProjectFile[] | ((prev: ProjectFile[]) => ProjectFile[])): void {
  if (typeof files === 'function') {
    projectStore.setState(prev => ({ files: files(prev.files) }));
  } else {
    projectStore.setState({ files });
  }
}

export function setFolders(folders: string[] | ((prev: string[]) => string[])): void {
  if (typeof folders === 'function') {
    projectStore.setState(prev => ({ folders: folders(prev.folders) }));
  } else {
    projectStore.setState({ folders });
  }
}

export function setActiveFileId(activeFileId: string): void {
  projectStore.setState(prev => ({
    activeFileId,
    openFileIds: prev.openFileIds.includes(activeFileId)
      ? prev.openFileIds
      : [...prev.openFileIds, activeFileId],
  }));
}

export function setOpenFileIds(openFileIds: string[] | ((prev: string[]) => string[])): void {
  if (typeof openFileIds === 'function') {
    projectStore.setState(prev => ({ openFileIds: openFileIds(prev.openFileIds) }));
  } else {
    projectStore.setState({ openFileIds });
  }
}

export function setProjectTitle(projectTitle: string): void {
  projectStore.setState({ projectTitle });
}

export function setPaperFormat(paperFormat: PaperFormatId): void {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem('teeex_paper_format', paperFormat);
  } catch {}
  projectStore.setState({ paperFormat });
}

export function setIsTwoColumn(isTwoColumn: boolean): void {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem('teeex_column_mode', isTwoColumn ? '2' : '1');
  } catch {}
  projectStore.setState({ isTwoColumn });
}

export function updateFileContent(fileId: string, content: string): void {
  projectStore.setState(prev => ({
    files: prev.files.map(f => (f.id === fileId ? { ...f, content } : f)),
  }));
}

export function useProjectStore<T>(selector: (state: ProjectState) => T): T {
  return useStore(projectStore, selector);
}
````

````sql
-- ==============================================================================
-- Teeex — 0004: Server-Side Share Capability Tokens & Anonymous Link Access
-- Cryptographically binds edit (ed_...) and view (vw_...) tokens to Postgres RLS.
-- ==============================================================================

begin;

-- 0. Ensure pgcrypto extension is available for cryptographic token digests (SHA-256)
create extension if not exists pgcrypto;

-- 1. Add capability hash storage columns to projects table
alter table public.projects
  add column if not exists edit_token_hash text,
  add column if not exists view_token_hash text,
  add column if not exists share_tokens_revoked boolean default false,
  add column if not exists share_tokens_expires_at timestamp with time zone;

create index if not exists idx_projects_view_token_hash on public.projects (view_token_hash);
create index if not exists idx_projects_edit_token_hash on public.projects (edit_token_hash);

-- 2. Capability verification helper
create or replace function public.teeex_verify_capability(
  p_token text,
  p_hash text
)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
set search_path = public, extensions, pg_temp
as $$
  select p_token is not null
     and p_hash is not null
     and encode(digest(p_token, 'sha256'::text), 'hex') = p_hash;
$$;

-- 3. Capability token extraction from HTTP headers (x-share-token)
create or replace function public.teeex_request_share_token()
returns text
language sql
stable
set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $$
  select coalesce(
    nullif(current_setting('request.headers', true)::json ->> 'x-share-token', ''),
    nullif(current_setting('request.headers', true)::json ->> 'x-teeex-token', '')
  );
$$;

-- 4a. Enable read access for token holders (viewers & editors)
drop policy if exists "projects_select_via_capability" on public.projects;
create policy "projects_select_via_capability"
  on public.projects for select
  to public
  using (
    share_tokens_revoked is distinct from true
    and (share_tokens_expires_at is null or share_tokens_expires_at > now())
    and (
      public.teeex_verify_capability(public.teeex_request_share_token(), view_token_hash)
      or public.teeex_verify_capability(public.teeex_request_share_token(), edit_token_hash)
    )
  );

-- 4b. Enable project updates strictly for edit capability holders (NOT viewers)
drop policy if exists "projects_update_via_capability" on public.projects;
create policy "projects_update_via_capability"
  on public.projects for update
  to public
  using (
    share_tokens_revoked is distinct from true
    and (share_tokens_expires_at is null or share_tokens_expires_at > now())
    and public.teeex_verify_capability(public.teeex_request_share_token(), edit_token_hash)
  )
  with check (
    share_tokens_revoked is distinct from true
    and (share_tokens_expires_at is null or share_tokens_expires_at > now())
    and public.teeex_verify_capability(public.teeex_request_share_token(), edit_token_hash)
  );

-- 5. Enable CRDT snapshot read access for capability token holders
drop policy if exists "crdt_states_select_via_capability" on public.project_crdt_states;
create policy "crdt_states_select_via_capability"
  on public.project_crdt_states for select
  to public
  using (
    exists (
      select 1 from public.projects p
      where p.id = project_crdt_states.project_id
        and p.share_tokens_revoked is distinct from true
        and (p.share_tokens_expires_at is null or p.share_tokens_expires_at > now())
        and (
          public.teeex_verify_capability(public.teeex_request_share_token(), p.view_token_hash)
          or public.teeex_verify_capability(public.teeex_request_share_token(), p.edit_token_hash)
        )
    )
  );

-- 6. Enable CRDT snapshot insert & update strictly for edit capability holders (NOT viewers)
drop policy if exists "crdt_states_insert_via_capability" on public.project_crdt_states;
create policy "crdt_states_insert_via_capability"
  on public.project_crdt_states for insert
  to public
  with check (
    exists (
      select 1 from public.projects p
      where p.id = project_crdt_states.project_id
        and p.share_tokens_revoked is distinct from true
        and (p.share_tokens_expires_at is null or p.share_tokens_expires_at > now())
        and public.teeex_verify_capability(public.teeex_request_share_token(), p.edit_token_hash)
    )
  );

drop policy if exists "crdt_states_update_via_capability" on public.project_crdt_states;
create policy "crdt_states_update_via_capability"
  on public.project_crdt_states for update
  to public
  using (
    exists (
      select 1 from public.projects p
      where p.id = project_crdt_states.project_id
        and p.share_tokens_revoked is distinct from true
        and (p.share_tokens_expires_at is null or p.share_tokens_expires_at > now())
        and public.teeex_verify_capability(public.teeex_request_share_token(), p.edit_token_hash)
    )
  )
  with check (
    exists (
      select 1 from public.projects p
      where p.id = project_crdt_states.project_id
        and p.share_tokens_revoked is distinct from true
        and (p.share_tokens_expires_at is null or p.share_tokens_expires_at > now())
        and public.teeex_verify_capability(public.teeex_request_share_token(), p.edit_token_hash)
    )
  );

-- 7. Enable Checkpoint read access for capability token holders
drop policy if exists "checkpoints_select_via_capability" on public.checkpoints;
create policy "checkpoints_select_via_capability"
  on public.checkpoints for select
  to public
  using (
    exists (
      select 1 from public.projects p
      where p.id = checkpoints.project_id
        and p.share_tokens_revoked is distinct from true
        and (p.share_tokens_expires_at is null or p.share_tokens_expires_at > now())
        and (
          public.teeex_verify_capability(public.teeex_request_share_token(), p.view_token_hash)
          or public.teeex_verify_capability(public.teeex_request_share_token(), p.edit_token_hash)
        )
    )
  );

-- 8. Enable Checkpoint creation strictly for edit capability holders (NOT viewers)
drop policy if exists "checkpoints_insert_via_capability" on public.checkpoints;
create policy "checkpoints_insert_via_capability"
  on public.checkpoints for insert
  to public
  with check (
    exists (
      select 1 from public.projects p
      where p.id = checkpoints.project_id
        and p.share_tokens_revoked is distinct from true
        and (p.share_tokens_expires_at is null or p.share_tokens_expires_at > now())
        and public.teeex_verify_capability(public.teeex_request_share_token(), p.edit_token_hash)
    )
  );

-- 9. Secure project owner pinning trigger to prevent capability token holders or non-owners from hijacking metadata
create or replace function public.teeex_pin_project_owner()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $$
begin
  new.owner_uid := old.owner_uid;

  -- If the caller is not the owner (either non-owner authenticated user OR anonymous capability token holder):
  -- they cannot alter owner fields, members, or share token hashes
  if auth.uid() is null or old.owner_uid is distinct from auth.uid() then
    new.members                  := old.members;
    new.owner_email              := old.owner_email;
    new.owner_id                 := old.owner_id;
    new.edit_token_hash          := old.edit_token_hash;
    new.view_token_hash          := old.view_token_hash;
    new.share_tokens_revoked     := old.share_tokens_revoked;
    new.share_tokens_expires_at  := old.share_tokens_expires_at;
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$$;
````

````typescript
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';
import { openWorkspace, setEditorContent } from './fixtures';

const OFFLINE_TEST_DOC = String.raw`\documentclass[10pt]{article}
\usepackage{amsmath,lipsum}
\begin{document}
\section{Offline Typesetting Test}
This document tests that Teeex compiles 100% locally in the browser with zero network access.
\lipsum[1-2]
\end{document}`;

test.describe('Delivery, Typography & Offline Compilation (Stage 2)', () => {
  test('zero external font requests and zero CSP violations on clean load', async ({ page }) => {
    test.setTimeout(180_000);
    const leakedUrls: string[] = [];
    const cspViolations: string[] = [];

    page.on('request', (req) => {
      const url = req.url();
      if (url.includes('fonts.googleapis.com') || url.includes('fonts.gstatic.com')) {
        leakedUrls.push(url);
      }
    });

    page.on('console', (msg) => {
      const text = msg.text();
      if (text.includes('Content-Security-Policy') || text.includes('violates the following Content Security Policy')) {
        cspViolations.push(text);
      }
    });

    await openWorkspace(page, {
      id: 'e2e-delivery-test',
      email: 'delivery@teeex.local',
      fullName: 'Delivery Test',
    });

    const preview = page.getByRole('document', { name: 'Compiled document preview' });
    const canvas = preview.locator('canvas').first();
    await expect(canvas).toBeVisible({ timeout: 120_000 });

    // Assert strictly zero third-party font leaks
    expect(leakedUrls, 'Must not leak any requests to Google Fonts CDNs').toEqual([]);
    // Assert strictly zero CSP violations
    expect(cspViolations, 'Must have zero Content-Security-Policy violations').toEqual([]);
  });

  test('compiles and updates PDF preview with network completely disabled (setOffline)', async ({ page, context }) => {
    test.setTimeout(240_000);

    // 1. Initial load online to establish worker and initial compile
    await openWorkspace(page, {
      id: 'e2e-offline-compile',
      email: 'offline@teeex.local',
      fullName: 'Offline Tester',
    });
    await setEditorContent(page, OFFLINE_TEST_DOC);

    const preview = page.getByRole('document', { name: 'Compiled document preview' });
    const canvas = preview.locator('canvas').first();
    await expect(canvas).toBeVisible({ timeout: 120_000 });

    // 2. Cut off network completely
    await context.setOffline(true);

    // 3. Make an edit while completely offline
    const offlineToken = `OFFLINE_TOKEN_${Date.now()}`;
    const editedDoc = OFFLINE_TEST_DOC.replace(
      'This document tests',
      `[${offlineToken}] This document tests`
    );
    await setEditorContent(page, editedDoc);

    // 4. Trigger compilation while offline
    const busy = page.locator('.pdf-status-busy');
    await page.keyboard.press('ControlOrMeta+Enter');
    await expect(busy).toBeVisible({ timeout: 30_000 });
    await expect(busy).toBeHidden({ timeout: 120_000 });

    // 5. Assert compiled canvas is still visible and rendered
    await expect(canvas).toBeVisible();

    // 6. Restore online state for cleanup
    await context.setOffline(false);
  });
});
````

````typescript
import { expect, type Locator, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { sha256Sync } from '../../src/services/shareSecurityService';

/**
 * Shared end-to-end helpers.
 *
 * WHY THIS FILE EXISTS
 *
 * Every spec used to seed its own session and drive the editor with its own
 * copy of the same code. When the stored-session format was hardened — the blob
 * is now `{ user, issuedAt, sum }` rather than a bare profile, so that a
 * tampered record cannot carry privileges — all four copies broke at once, in
 * four different files, and every spec failed on the sign-in screen. One copy
 * means one place to change.
 *
 * The session format here must match `saveSession()` in
 * src/services/authService.ts. If you change the checksum input there, change
 * `sessionChecksum` here; a mismatch shows up immediately as specs stuck on the
 * sign-in screen.
 */

/** Matches SESSION_CHECKSUM_KEY in src/services/authService.ts. */
const SESSION_CHECKSUM_KEY = 'teeex-session-v4';
const AUTH_STORAGE_KEY = 'teeex_auth_user';
const SIGNED_OUT_KEY = 'teeex_signed_out';

export interface SeededProfile {
  id: string;
  email: string;
  fullName?: string;
  /**
   * 'local' is the default because it is the only mode that needs no server:
   * `getStoredSession()` treats a local profile as approved, and
   * `verifyActiveSupabaseSession()` returns it untouched. A 'supabase' profile
   * is re-checked against the server on startup and would be signed out here,
   * since tests configure no Supabase credentials.
   */
  authProvider?: 'local' | 'supabase';
}

function sessionChecksum(
  identity: { id: string; email: string; authProvider: string },
  issuedAt: number,
): string {
  return sha256Sync(
    `${SESSION_CHECKSUM_KEY}:${identity.id}:${identity.email}:${identity.authProvider}:${issuedAt}`,
  );
}

interface SeededSession {
  user: { id: string; email: string; fullName: string; authProvider: string };
  issuedAt: number;
  sum: string;
}

/** Builds the exact wrapper `saveSession()` writes. */
export function buildSession(profile: SeededProfile): SeededSession {
  const identity = {
    id: profile.id,
    email: profile.email,
    fullName: profile.fullName ?? 'Playwright',
    avatarColor: '#38bdf8',
    avatarUrl: '',
    authProvider: profile.authProvider ?? 'local',
  };
  const issuedAt = Date.now();
  return { user: identity, issuedAt, sum: sessionChecksum(identity, issuedAt) };
}

export function buildInitialProject(profile: SeededProfile, source: string) {
  return [
    {
      id: `proj-${profile.id}`,
      title: 'E2E Test Document',
      ownerId: profile.id,
      ownerEmail: profile.email,
      role: 'owner',
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      updatedAt: 'Just now',
      files: [
        {
          id: 'main.tex',
          name: 'main.tex',
          content: source,
          type: 'tex',
          isEntry: true,
        },
      ],
      tags: [],
      members: [
        {
          id: profile.id,
          email: profile.email,
          name: profile.fullName ?? 'Playwright',
          avatar: 'PW',
          avatarColor: '#38bdf8',
          role: 'owner',
          joinedAt: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
        },
      ],
      isArchived: false,
    },
  ];
}

/**
 * Seeds a signed-in session before the app boots.
 *
 * `addInitScript` runs in the page before any app code, so the first render
 * already sees the session and never flashes the sign-in screen.
 */
export async function seedSession(
  page: Page,
  profile: SeededProfile,
  initialSource?: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const session = buildSession(profile);
  const projectsJson = initialSource ? JSON.stringify(buildInitialProject(profile, initialSource)) : null;
  const activeProjectId = initialSource ? `proj-${profile.id}` : null;
  await page.addInitScript(
    ([key, signedOutKey, payload, projJson, activeId]) => {
      localStorage.setItem(key, payload);
      localStorage.removeItem(signedOutKey);
      if (projJson && activeId) {
        localStorage.setItem('teeex_saved_projects', projJson);
        localStorage.setItem('teeex_active_project_id', activeId);
      }
    },
    [AUTH_STORAGE_KEY, SIGNED_OUT_KEY, JSON.stringify(session), projectsJson, activeProjectId] as const,
  );
}

/** Seeds a session and loads the app, leaving the editor mounted. */
export async function openWorkspace(
  page: Page,
  profile: SeededProfile,
  initialSource?: string,
): Promise<void> {
  await seedSession(page, profile, initialSource);
  await page.goto('/');
  await expect(page.locator('.cm-content').first()).toBeVisible({ timeout: 30_000 });
}

/**
 * Replaces the whole document in the CodeMirror editor.
 *
 * `fill()` does not work on CodeMirror — it is a contenteditable, not an input.
 * This dispatches directly to the mounted CodeMirror EditorView.
 */
export async function setEditorContent(page: Page, source: string): Promise<void> {
  const editor = page.locator('.cm-content').first();
  await expect(editor).toBeVisible({ timeout: 30_000 });
  await editor.click();

  await page.evaluate((text) => {
    const view = (window as unknown as { __teeexEditorView?: { state: { doc: { length: number } }; dispatch: (tr: unknown) => void } }).__teeexEditorView;
    if (view) {
      view.dispatch({
        changes: { from: 0, to: view.state.doc.length, insert: text },
        userEvent: 'input.paste',
      });
      return;
    }

    const dt = new DataTransfer();
    dt.setData('text/plain', text);
    const pasteEvent = new ClipboardEvent('paste', {
      bubbles: true,
      cancelable: true,
      clipboardData: dt,
    });
    const contentEl = document.querySelector('.cm-content');
    contentEl?.dispatchEvent(pasteEvent);
  }, source);
}

/** The compiled-document pane, as exposed by its ARIA role. */
export function previewPane(page: Page): Locator {
  return page.getByRole('document', { name: 'Compiled document preview' });
}

/** The first page canvas inside the preview pane. */
export function firstPreviewCanvas(page: Page): Locator {
  return previewPane(page).locator('canvas').first();
}

/** The "typesetting in progress" status pill. */
export function compilingStatus(page: Page): Locator {
  return page.locator('.pdf-status-busy');
}

/**
 * Sets the document and waits until a rendered page appears.
 *
 * The generous timeout is deliberate: the first compile in a fresh browser has
 * to fetch and instantiate the TeX engine, which is tens of megabytes. Later
 * compiles reuse the warm engine and are far quicker.
 */
export async function compileAndWaitForPreview(
  page: Page,
  source?: string,
  timeoutMs = 240_000,
): Promise<Locator> {
  if (source !== undefined) {
    const currentDoc = await page.evaluate(
      () =>
        (
          window as unknown as {
            __teeexEditorView?: { state: { doc: { toString: () => string } } };
          }
        ).__teeexEditorView?.state?.doc?.toString() ?? '',
    );

    if (currentDoc !== source) {
      const busy = compilingStatus(page);
      if (await busy.isVisible()) {
        await busy.waitFor({ state: 'hidden', timeout: 30_000 }).catch(() => {});
      }

      const countBefore = await page.evaluate(
        () =>
          (window as unknown as { __teeexCompileCount?: number }).__teeexCompileCount ?? 0,
      );

      await setEditorContent(page, source);
      await page.keyboard.press('ControlOrMeta+Enter');

      await page.waitForFunction(
        (prev) =>
          ((window as unknown as { __teeexCompileCount?: number }).__teeexCompileCount ?? 0) >
          prev,
        countBefore,
        { timeout: timeoutMs },
      );
    } else {
      await page.waitForFunction(
        () =>
          ((window as unknown as { __teeexCompileCount?: number }).__teeexCompileCount ?? 0) >= 1,
        null,
        { timeout: timeoutMs },
      );
    }
  } else {
    await page.waitForFunction(
      () =>
        ((window as unknown as { __teeexCompileCount?: number }).__teeexCompileCount ?? 0) >= 1,
      null,
      { timeout: timeoutMs },
    );
  }

  const canvas = firstPreviewCanvas(page);
  await expect(canvas).toBeVisible({ timeout: timeoutMs });
  return canvas;
}

/** Reads the bytes of the PDF produced by the Download button. */
export async function downloadedPdfBytes(page: Page): Promise<Uint8Array> {
  const button = page.locator('button[title="Download the compiled PDF"]');
  await expect(button).toBeEnabled({ timeout: 30_000 });

  const download = await Promise.all([
    page.waitForEvent('download', { timeout: 30_000 }),
    button.click(),
  ]).then(([d]) => d);

  const path = await download.path();
  expect(path, 'Playwright should provide a downloaded file path').toBeTruthy();

  const fs = await import('node:fs/promises');
  return new Uint8Array(await fs.readFile(path!));
}

/**
 * Opens the compiled PDF with pdf.js and extracts its per-page text.
 *
 * Text extraction is the check that matters: it proves the artifact contains
 * selectable, positioned text from real typesetting rather than a raster image
 * or a placeholder.
 */
export async function extractPdfText(bytes: Uint8Array): Promise<{
  numPages: number;
  perPage: string[];
  all: string;
}> {
  const pdfjs = await import('pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.mjs');
  const pdf = await pdfjs.getDocument({ data: new Uint8Array(bytes), useSystemFonts: true }).promise;

  const perPage: string[] = [];
  for (let pageNumber = 1; pageNumber <= pdf.numPages; pageNumber++) {
    const pdfPage = await pdf.getPage(pageNumber);
    const content = await pdfPage.getTextContent();
    perPage.push(
      content.items
        .filter((item) => 'str' in item)
        .map((item) => (item as { str: string }).str)
        .join(''),
    );
  }

  return { numPages: pdf.numPages, perPage, all: perPage.join('\n') };
}
````

````typescript
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';

function loadCompleteCss(filePath: string): string {
  const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8');
  return content.replace(/@import\s+['"](\.\/[^'"]+)['"];/g, (_, rel) => {
    const resolved = path.resolve(path.dirname(filePath), rel);
    return fs.existsSync(resolved) ? loadCompleteCss(resolved) : '';
  });
}

describe('Design System W3C DTCG Tokens & A11y (src/index.css)', () => {
  const cssPath = path.resolve(__dirname, '../../src/index.css');
  const cssContent = loadCompleteCss(cssPath);

  it('defines 3-Tier Global Spacing scale (--space-*) conforming to 4px baseline', () => {
    const requiredSpacing = [
      '--space-0: 0px;',
      '--space-1: 4px;',
      '--space-2: 8px;',
      '--space-3: 12px;',
      '--space-4: 16px;',
      '--space-6: 24px;',
      '--space-8: 32px;',
      '--space-12: 48px;',
      '--space-16: 64px;',
    ];

    for (const token of requiredSpacing) {
      expect(cssContent).toContain(token);
    }
  });

  it('defines Typography scale (--font-size-*, --line-height-*)', () => {
    const requiredTypography = [
      '--font-size-2xs:',
      '--font-size-xs:',
      '--font-size-sm:',
      '--font-size-base:',
      '--font-size-lg:',
      '--font-size-xl:',
      '--font-size-2xl:',
      '--line-height-none: 1;',
      '--line-height-tight: 1.25;',
      '--line-height-normal: 1.5;',
      '--line-height-relaxed: 1.65;',
    ];

    for (const token of requiredTypography) {
      expect(cssContent).toContain(token);
    }
  });

  it('defines Authoritative Z-Index scale (--z-*)', () => {
    const requiredZ = [
      '--z-base: 1;',
      '--z-split-handle: 35;',
      '--z-dropdown: 50;',
      '--z-dock: 100;',
      '--z-toast: 500;',
      '--z-modal-backdrop: 1000;',
      '--z-modal: 1010;',
      '--z-command-palette: 2000;',
    ];
````

````typescript
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { existsSync, readFileSync, statSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, resolve } from 'node:path';

const ROOT = resolve(__dirname, '../..');
const FONTS_DIR = join(ROOT, 'public', 'fonts');

const EXPECTED_FONTS = [
  'PlusJakartaSans-Variable.woff2',
  'JetBrainsMono-Variable.woff2',
  'JetBrainsMono-Italic-Variable.woff2',
  'Newsreader-Variable.woff2',
  'Newsreader-Italic-Variable.woff2',
];

function loadCompleteCss(filePath: string): string {
  const content = readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8');
  return content.replace(/@import\s+['"](\.\/[^'"]+)['"];/g, (_, rel) => {
    const resolved = resolve(join(ROOT, 'src'), rel);
    return existsSync(resolved) ? loadCompleteCss(resolved) : '';
  });
}

describe('Self-Hosted Typography & Zero-Leak Delivery (S4g)', () => {
  it('all 5 WOFF2 variable font files exist in public/fonts/', () => {
    for (const font of EXPECTED_FONTS) {
      const p = join(FONTS_DIR, font);
      expect(existsSync(p), `Font ${font} must exist on disk`).toBe(true);
    }
  });

  it('all font files contain valid WOFF2 binary magic header (0x77 0x4F 0x46 0x32)', () => {
    for (const font of EXPECTED_FONTS) {
      const p = join(FONTS_DIR, font);
      const buf = readFileSync(p);
      expect(buf.length).toBeGreaterThan(15_000);

      // WOFF2 magic number is ASCII 'wOF2'
      expect(buf[0], `${font} byte 0`).toBe(0x77); // 'w'
      expect(buf[1], `${font} byte 1`).toBe(0x4f); // 'O'
      expect(buf[2], `${font} byte 2`).toBe(0x46); // 'F'
      expect(buf[3], `${font} byte 3`).toBe(0x32); // '2'
    }
  });

  it('total typography footprint is under 250 KB', () => {
    let totalBytes = 0;
    for (const font of EXPECTED_FONTS) {
      totalBytes += statSync(join(FONTS_DIR, font)).size;
    }
    const totalKb = totalBytes / 1024;
    expect(totalKb).toBeGreaterThan(170);
    expect(totalKb).toBeLessThan(250);
  });

  it('src/index.css defines local @font-face rules with font-display: swap', () => {
    const css = loadCompleteCss(join(ROOT, 'src', 'index.css'));

    expect(css).toContain("font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans'");
    expect(css).toContain("url('/fonts/PlusJakartaSans-Variable.woff2')");

    expect(css).toContain("font-family: 'JetBrains Mono'");
    expect(css).toContain("url('/fonts/JetBrainsMono-Variable.woff2')");
    expect(css).toContain("url('/fonts/JetBrainsMono-Italic-Variable.woff2')");

    expect(css).toContain("font-family: 'Newsreader'");
    expect(css).toContain("url('/fonts/Newsreader-Variable.woff2')");
    expect(css).toContain("url('/fonts/Newsreader-Italic-Variable.woff2')");

    expect(css).toContain('font-display: swap');
  });

  it('index.html contains strictly 0 external Google Fonts links or preconnects', () => {
    const html = readFileSync(join(ROOT, 'index.html'), 'utf8');
    expect(html).not.toContain('fonts.googleapis.com');
    expect(html).not.toContain('fonts.gstatic.com');
  });
});
````

````typescript
import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { existsSync, statSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, resolve } from 'node:path';
import {
  BUNDLED_PACKAGES,
  isHtmlResponse,
  readResponseLimited,
  preloadDocumentPackages,
  MAX_PRELOADED_FILES,
  _resetPackageCachesForTesting,
} from '../../src/services/bundledPackages';

const ROOT = resolve(__dirname, '../..');
const PACKAGES_DIR = join(ROOT, 'public', 'packages');

describe('Stage 3: Package Poison Guard & In-Flight Coalescing', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.restoreAllMocks();
    _resetPackageCachesForTesting();
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
    _resetPackageCachesForTesting();
  });

  describe('isHtmlResponse Detection', () => {
    it('isHtmlResponse detects text/html content-type header', () => {
      const dummyBuf = new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3]);
      expect(isHtmlResponse(dummyBuf, 'text/html')).toBe(true);
      expect(isHtmlResponse(dummyBuf, 'text/html; charset=utf-8')).toBe(true);
      expect(isHtmlResponse(dummyBuf, 'TEXT/HTML')).toBe(true);
      expect(isHtmlResponse(dummyBuf, 'application/octet-stream')).toBe(false);
      expect(isHtmlResponse(dummyBuf, 'text/plain')).toBe(false);
      expect(isHtmlResponse(dummyBuf, null)).toBe(false);
    });

    it('isHtmlResponse sniffs HTML markup even if content-type header is missing or octet-stream', () => {
      const htmlDoctype = new TextEncoder().encode('<!DOCTYPE html><html><body>Error</body></html>');
      const htmlFragment = new TextEncoder().encode('<html><head><title>404</title></head></html>');
      const validTex = new TextEncoder().encode('\\ProvidesPackage{mypkg}[2026/01/01]');
      const binaryTfm = new Uint8Array([0x00, 0x11, 0x00, 0x02, 0x5a, 0x6b]);

      expect(isHtmlResponse(htmlDoctype, 'application/octet-stream')).toBe(true);
      expect(isHtmlResponse(htmlFragment, undefined)).toBe(true);
      expect(isHtmlResponse(validTex, 'application/octet-stream')).toBe(false);
      expect(isHtmlResponse(binaryTfm, 'application/octet-stream')).toBe(false);
    });
  });

  describe('Streaming Remote Package Limits (readResponseLimited)', () => {
    it('rejects an oversized Content-Length immediately', async () => {
      const headers = new Headers({ 'content-length': (8 * 1024 * 1024 + 500).toString() });
      const mockRes = new Response(new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3]), { headers });

      await expect(readResponseLimited(mockRes, 8 * 1024 * 1024)).rejects.toThrow(
        /Content-Length.*exceeds limit/i
      );
    });

    it('rejects a streamed body that exceeds the 8 MiB cap', async () => {
      let chunkCount = 0;
      const stream = new ReadableStream({
        pull(controller) {
          if (chunkCount++ < 3) {
            controller.enqueue(new Uint8Array(3 * 1024 * 1024)); // 3 x 3 MiB = 9 MiB
          } else {
            controller.close();
          }
        },
      });

      const mockRes = new Response(stream);
      await expect(readResponseLimited(mockRes, 8 * 1024 * 1024)).rejects.toThrow(
        /exceeded limit.*while streaming/i
      );
    });
  });

  describe('In-Flight Request Deduplication', () => {
    it('makes only one network request for concurrent requests to the same package', async () => {
      let fetchCallCount = 0;
      const validPackageContent = new TextEncoder().encode('\\ProvidesPackage{concurrentpkg}\n');

      global.fetch = vi.fn().mockImplementation(async (url: string) => {
        fetchCallCount++;
        // Simulate a slight network delay
        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 30));
        return new Response(validPackageContent, {
          status: 200,
          headers: { 'content-type': 'text/plain' },
        });
      });

      // Call preloadDocumentPackages twice simultaneously for the same remote package
      const doc = '\\usepackage{concurrentpkg}';
      const [res1, res2] = await Promise.all([
        preloadDocumentPackages(doc, 'https://mock.texlive.org'),
        preloadDocumentPackages(doc, 'https://mock.texlive.org'),
      ]);

      expect(fetchCallCount).toBe(1);
      expect(res1.length).toBe(1);
      expect(res2.length).toBe(1);
      expect(res1[0]?.name).toBe('concurrentpkg.sty');
      expect(res2[0]?.name).toBe('concurrentpkg.sty');
    });
  });

  describe('160-File Cap Budget Enforcement', () => {
    it('limits a document with 200 distinct imports to at most 160 prefetched files', async () => {
      // Generate document with 200 distinct packages
      const packages = Array.from({ length: 200 }, (_, i) => `pkg${i}`);
      const doc = `\\usepackage{${packages.join(',')}}`;

      global.fetch = vi.fn().mockImplementation(async (url: string) => {
        return new Response(new TextEncoder().encode('\\ProvidesPackage{stub}\n'), {
          status: 200,
          headers: { 'content-type': 'text/plain' },
        });
      });

      const results = await preloadDocumentPackages(doc, 'https://mock.texlive.org');
      expect(results.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(MAX_PRELOADED_FILES);
      expect(results.length).toBe(160);
    });
  });

  describe('Transient Network Failures Remain Retryable', () => {
    it('does not permanently blacklist packages on 500 server error, allowing subsequent retries', async () => {
      let attempt = 0;
      const validContent = new TextEncoder().encode('\\ProvidesPackage{retrypkg}\n');

      global.fetch = vi.fn().mockImplementation(async () => {
        attempt++;
        if (attempt === 1) {
          // First attempt: Server returns 500 Internal Server Error
          return new Response('Internal Server Error', { status: 500 });
        }
        // Second attempt: Server recovers
        return new Response(validContent, {
          status: 200,
          headers: { 'content-type': 'text/plain' },
        });
      });

      const doc = '\\usepackage{retrypkg}';

      // First run: fails to resolve package due to 500 error
      const firstRun = await preloadDocumentPackages(doc, 'https://mock.texlive.org');
      expect(firstRun.length).toBe(0);

      // Second run: succeeds and fetches the package because 500 was NOT permanently cached
      const secondRun = await preloadDocumentPackages(doc, 'https://mock.texlive.org');
      expect(secondRun.length).toBe(1);
      expect(secondRun[0]?.name).toBe('retrypkg.sty');
    });
  });

  describe('Essential Packages Registration in BUNDLED_PACKAGES', () => {
    it('lipsum.sty and lipsum.ltd are registered in BUNDLED_PACKAGES', () => {
      const lipsumSty = BUNDLED_PACKAGES.find((p) => p.name === 'lipsum.sty');
      const lipsumLtd = BUNDLED_PACKAGES.find((p) => p.name === 'lipsum.ltd');

      expect(lipsumSty, 'lipsum.sty must be registered').toBeDefined();
      expect(lipsumSty?.format).toBe(26);

      expect(lipsumLtd, 'lipsum.ltd must be registered').toBeDefined();
      expect(lipsumLtd?.format).toBe(26);
    });

    it('lipsum files are provisioned into public/packages/ with valid size', () => {
      const styPath = join(PACKAGES_DIR, 'lipsum.sty');
      const ltdPath = join(PACKAGES_DIR, 'lipsum.ltd');

      expect(existsSync(styPath), 'lipsum.sty must exist in public/packages/').toBe(true);
      expect(existsSync(ltdPath), 'lipsum.ltd must exist in public/packages/').toBe(true);

      expect(statSync(styPath).size).toBeGreaterThan(10_000);
      expect(statSync(ltdPath).size).toBeGreaterThan(50_000);
    });
  });
});
````

````typescript
import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest';
import {
  validatePackagePayload,
  validatePackageAgainstManifest,
  readResponseLimited,
  provisionPackages,
  computeSha256,
  MAX_PACKAGE_SIZE,
  MIN_PACKAGE_SIZE,
} from '../../scripts/download-essential-packages.mjs';

function createMockResponse({
  headers = {},
  chunks = [],
}: {
  headers?: Record<string, string>;
  chunks?: Uint8Array[];
}) {
  let chunkIndex = 0;
  const headerMap = new Map(Object.entries(headers).map(([k, v]) => [k.toLowerCase(), v]));

  const stream = new ReadableStream({
    pull(controller) {
      if (chunkIndex < chunks.length) {
        controller.enqueue(chunks[chunkIndex++]);
      } else {
        controller.close();
      }
    },
  });

  return {
    headers: {
      get: (k: string) => headerMap.get(k.toLowerCase()) ?? null,
    },
    body: stream,
  } as unknown as Response;
}

describe('Stage 2: Package Provisioning & Cryptographic Integrity', () => {
  describe('readResponseLimited (Streaming Bounds)', () => {
    it('rejects responses whose advertised Content-Length exceeds 8 MiB before reading body', async () => {
      const oversizedLen = (8 * 1024 * 1024 + 1).toString();
      const mockRes = createMockResponse({
        headers: { 'Content-Length': oversizedLen },
        chunks: [new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3])],
      });

      await expect(
        readResponseLimited(mockRes, 8 * 1024 * 1024)
      ).rejects.toThrow(/Content-Length.*exceeds limit/i);
    });

    it('cancels reading immediately when accumulated body exceeds 8 MiB during streaming', async () => {
      const chunk1 = new Uint8Array(4 * 1024 * 1024); // 4 MiB
      const chunk2 = new Uint8Array(5 * 1024 * 1024); // 5 MiB -> 9 MiB total
      const mockRes = createMockResponse({
        chunks: [chunk1, chunk2],
      });

      await expect(
        readResponseLimited(mockRes, 8 * 1024 * 1024)
      ).rejects.toThrow(/exceeded limit.*while streaming/i);
    });

    it('returns complete bytes after body has finished within limit', async () => {
      const chunk1 = new TextEncoder().encode('\\ProvidesPackage{test}');
      const chunk2 = new TextEncoder().encode('[2026/01/01]');
      const mockRes = createMockResponse({
        chunks: [chunk1, chunk2],
      });

      const result = await readResponseLimited(mockRes, 8 * 1024 * 1024);
      expect(result.toString('utf8')).toBe('\\ProvidesPackage{test}[2026/01/01]');
    });
  });

  describe('Manifest Integrity Verification (validatePackageAgainstManifest)', () => {
    const validSample = Buffer.from('\\ProvidesPackage{sample}[2026/01/01 Sample]\n');
    const mockManifest = {
      'sample.sty': {
        bytes: validSample.length,
        sha256: computeSha256(validSample),
      },
    };

    it('accepts package whose byte count and SHA-256 match manifest', () => {
      const res = validatePackageAgainstManifest('sample.sty', validSample, mockManifest);
      expect(res.valid).toBe(true);
    });

    it('rejects package when byte count does not match manifest', () => {
      const tamperedBuf = Buffer.from('\\ProvidesPackage{sample}[2026/01/01 Sample]\nEXTRA');
      const res = validatePackageAgainstManifest('sample.sty', tamperedBuf, mockManifest);
      expect(res.valid).toBe(false);
      expect(res.reason).toContain('Byte count mismatch');
    });

    it('rejects package when SHA-256 digest does not match manifest (hash mismatch)', () => {
      // Same byte length but altered content
      const alteredBuf = Buffer.from('\\ProvidesPackage{sample}[2026/01/01 Xample]\n');
      expect(alteredBuf.length).toBe(validSample.length);

      const res = validatePackageAgainstManifest('sample.sty', alteredBuf, mockManifest);
      expect(res.valid).toBe(false);
      expect(res.reason).toContain('SHA-256 digest mismatch');
    });

    it('rejects packages not registered in the manifest', () => {
      const unlistedBuf = Buffer.from('\\ProvidesPackage{unlisted}[2026/01/01 Unlisted]\n');
      const res = validatePackageAgainstManifest('unlisted.sty', unlistedBuf, mockManifest);
      expect(res.valid).toBe(false);
      expect(res.reason).toContain('not registered in integrity manifest');
    });
  });

  describe('Concurrency Configuration Validation', () => {
    it('rejects invalid concurrency values (< 1, > 16, non-integer)', async () => {
      await expect(provisionPackages({ concurrency: 0 })).rejects.toThrow(/Invalid concurrency "0"/);
      await expect(provisionPackages({ concurrency: -5 })).rejects.toThrow(/Invalid concurrency "-5"/);
      await expect(provisionPackages({ concurrency: 20 })).rejects.toThrow(/Invalid concurrency "20"/);
      await expect(provisionPackages({ concurrency: 2.5 as any })).rejects.toThrow(/Invalid concurrency/);
      await expect(provisionPackages({ concurrency: NaN as any })).rejects.toThrow(/Invalid concurrency/);
    });
  });

  describe('HTML and Upstream Error Rejection', () => {
    it('rejects HTML error content served with misleading binary payload', () => {
      const htmlPayload = Buffer.from(
        '<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><title>404 Not Found</title></head><body><h1>404 Not Found</h1></body></html>'
      );
      const result = validatePackagePayload('booktabs.sty', htmlPayload);

      expect(result.valid).toBe(false);
      expect(result.reason).toContain('HTML error response detected');
    });

    it('rejects explicit upstream server error text', () => {
      const errorText = Buffer.from('Cannot GET /26/titlesec.sty\nUpstream 404 Not Found\n');
      const result = validatePackagePayload('titlesec.sty', errorText);

      expect(result.valid).toBe(false);
      expect(result.reason).toContain('Explicit upstream error text detected');
    });

    it('rejects AWS/Cloudflare XML/text NoSuchKey or Access Denied errors', () => {
      const accessDenied = Buffer.from('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><Error><Code>Access Denied</Code></Error>');
      const result = validatePackagePayload('environ.sty', accessDenied);

      expect(result.valid).toBe(false);
      expect(result.reason).toContain('Explicit upstream error text detected');
    });
  });

  describe('Size Boundaries', () => {
    it('rejects empty or null payload', () => {
      const result = validatePackagePayload('test.sty', Buffer.from(''));
      expect(result.valid).toBe(false);
      expect(result.reason).toContain('Undersized');
    });

    it(`rejects payloads smaller than MIN_PACKAGE_SIZE (${MIN_PACKAGE_SIZE} bytes)`, () => {
      const tiny = Buffer.from('\\def\\a{1}'); // 9 bytes
      const result = validatePackagePayload('tiny.sty', tiny);

      expect(result.valid).toBe(false);
      expect(result.reason).toContain(`Undersized payload (${tiny.length} bytes < ${MIN_PACKAGE_SIZE} bytes)`);
    });

    it('rejects payloads exceeding the 8 MiB size limit', () => {
      const oversized = {
        length: MAX_PACKAGE_SIZE + 1,
        toString: () => '\\ProvidesPackage{large}',
      };

      const result = validatePackagePayload('huge.sty', oversized as any);
      expect(result.valid).toBe(false);
      expect(result.reason).toContain('Oversized payload');
    });
  });

  describe('Embedded NUL Byte Guard', () => {
    it('rejects text packages containing embedded NUL bytes', () => {
      const corrupted = Buffer.from('\\ProvidesPackage{test}[2026/01/01]\x00\\def\\corrupted{true}');
      const result = validatePackagePayload('corrupt.sty', corrupted);

      expect(result.valid).toBe(false);
      expect(result.reason).toContain('Embedded NUL byte detected');
    });
  });

  describe('TeX Style and Class Source Markers', () => {
    it('accepts modern style files with \\ProvidesPackage and \\NeedsTeXFormat', () => {
      const modernStyle = Buffer.from(
        '% Modern LaTeX package\n\\NeedsTeXFormat{LaTeX2e}\n\\ProvidesPackage{booktabs}[2020/05/08 v1.00 Academic publication tables]\n\\RequirePackage{array}\n'
      );
      const result = validatePackagePayload('booktabs.sty', modernStyle);

      expect(result.valid).toBe(true);
      expect(result.reason).toBe('Valid TeX style/class');
    });

    it('accepts legacy style files with direct macro definitions (\\def, \\catcode, \\makeatletter)', () => {
      const legacyStyle = Buffer.from(
        '% Legacy style definitions\n\\catcode`\\@=11\n\\def\\legacytable#1{\\begingroup#1\\endgroup}\n\\let\\oldlegacy=\\legacytable\n\\catcode`\\@=12\n'
      );
      const result = validatePackagePayload('legacy.sty', legacyStyle);

      expect(result.valid).toBe(true);
      expect(result.reason).toBe('Valid TeX style/class');
    });

    it('accepts document classes (.cls) with \\ProvidesClass', () => {
      const clsPayload = Buffer.from(
        '\\NeedsTeXFormat{LaTeX2e}\n\\ProvidesClass{sn-jnl}[2023/05/01 Springer Nature Journal]\n\\DeclareOption*{\\PassOptionsToClass{\\CurrentOption}{article}}\n\\ProcessOptions\\relax\n'
      );
      const result = validatePackagePayload('sn-jnl.cls', clsPayload);

      expect(result.valid).toBe(true);
      expect(result.reason).toBe('Valid TeX style/class');
    });

    it('rejects style files missing all expected TeX markers', () => {
      const invalidStyle = Buffer.from(
        'Plain english text without any latex macro backslashes or percent comments whatsoever in this file.'
      );
      const result = validatePackagePayload('invalid.sty', invalidStyle);

      expect(result.valid).toBe(false);
      expect(result.reason).toContain('Missing expected TeX source markers');
    });
  });

  describe('BibTeX Style (.bst) Markers', () => {
    it('accepts valid BibTeX styles containing ENTRY and FUNCTION blocks', () => {
      const bstPayload = Buffer.from(
        '% BibTeX standard bibliography style\nENTRY\n  { address\n    author\n    title\n  }\n  {}\n  { label }\nFUNCTION {output.bibitem}\n{\n  newline$\n}\nREAD\n'
      );
      const result = validatePackagePayload('ACM-Reference-Format.bst', bstPayload);

      expect(result.valid).toBe(true);
      expect(result.reason).toBe('Valid BibTeX style');
    });

    it('rejects .bst files lacking required BibTeX markers', () => {
      const invalidBst = Buffer.from(
        'This is not a valid BibTeX style file and has no entry functions or grammar definitions.'
      );
      const result = validatePackagePayload('invalid.bst', invalidBst);

      expect(result.valid).toBe(false);
      expect(result.reason).toContain('Missing expected BibTeX style markers');
    });
  });
});
````
