````typescript
// @vitest-environment happy-dom
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import {
  getRoomShareTokens,
  rotateRoomShareTokens,
  revokeRoomShareTokens,
  verifyShareKey,
  computeTokenHashes,
  sha256Sync,
} from '../../src/services/shareSecurityService';
import { getSupabaseClient } from '../../src/services/supabaseClient';

describe('Share Capability Tokens & Security Service', () => {
  const roomId = 'proj-test-share-123';

  beforeEach(() => {
    localStorage.clear();
  });

  it('generates cryptographic edit and view tokens with correct prefixes', () => {
    const tokens = getRoomShareTokens(roomId);

    expect(tokens.editToken).toBeDefined();
    expect(tokens.editToken.startsWith('ed_')).toBe(true);
    expect(tokens.viewToken).toBeDefined();
    expect(tokens.viewToken.startsWith('vw_')).toBe(true);
    expect(tokens.isRevoked).toBe(false);
  });

  it('derives view token mathematically from edit token via one-way SHA-256', () => {
    const tokens = getRoomShareTokens(roomId);
    const expectedView = `vw_${sha256Sync(`${roomId}:${tokens.editToken}`).slice(0, 24)}`;
    expect(tokens.viewToken).toBe(expectedView);
  });

  it('computes SHA-256 capability digests for Postgres RLS verification', () => {
    const tokens = getRoomShareTokens(roomId);
    const hashes = computeTokenHashes(tokens);

    expect(hashes.editTokenHash).toBe(sha256Sync(tokens.editToken));
    expect(hashes.viewTokenHash).toBe(sha256Sync(tokens.viewToken));
    expect(hashes.shareTokensRevoked).toBe(false);
  });

  it('verifies editor and viewer capabilities accurately', () => {
    const tokens = getRoomShareTokens(roomId);

    expect(verifyShareKey(roomId, tokens.editToken)).toBe('editor');
    expect(verifyShareKey(roomId, tokens.viewToken)).toBe('viewer');
    expect(verifyShareKey(roomId, 'invalid-key')).toBe('viewer');
    expect(verifyShareKey(roomId, null)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('prevents client-side privilege escalation: unknown ed_ tokens default to viewer', () => {
    // When no local token exists for a room, an arbitrary ed_ token must NOT grant editor
    const arbitraryEditKey = 'ed_attacker_spoofed_random_key_12345';
    expect(verifyShareKey('completely-new-room', arbitraryEditKey)).toBe('viewer');
  });

  it('rejects all keys once room share tokens are revoked', () => {
    const tokens = getRoomShareTokens(roomId);
    revokeRoomShareTokens(roomId);

    expect(verifyShareKey(roomId, tokens.editToken)).toBeNull();
    expect(verifyShareKey(roomId, tokens.viewToken)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('invalidates prior tokens upon rotation', () => {
    const initial = getRoomShareTokens(roomId);
    const rotated = rotateRoomShareTokens(roomId);

    expect(rotated.editToken).not.toBe(initial.editToken);
    expect(verifyShareKey(roomId, initial.editToken)).not.toBe('editor');
    expect(verifyShareKey(roomId, rotated.editToken)).toBe('editor');
  });

  it('configures Supabase client with x-share-token request header when token is supplied', () => {
    const client = getSupabaseClient('ed_sample_token_123');
    // If Supabase credentials are configured or in test mode, client caches per token
    if (client) {
      const client2 = getSupabaseClient('ed_sample_token_123');
      expect(client).toBe(client2);
    }
  });
});
````

````typescript
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import {
  boxToRect,
  forwardSync,
  inverseSync,
  normaliseTexPath,
  parseSyncTex,
} from '../../src/services/synctex';

const SP = 65536; // scaled points per point

/**
 * A minimal but structurally real SyncTeX v1 file.
 *
 * Page 1 holds two boxes from main.tex (lines 10 and 20) and one from
 * sections/intro.tex (line 5). Coordinates are in scaled points, measured from
 * the top-left of the page.
 */
function sampleSyncTex(): Uint8Array {
  const text = [
    'SyncTeX Version:1',
    'Input:1:./main.tex',
    'Input:2:./sections/intro.tex',
    'Output:pdf',
    'Magnification:1000',
    'Unit:1',
    'X Offset:0',
    'Y Offset:0',
    'Content:',
    '{1',
    // vbox spanning the text block
    `[1,1:${4 * SP},${700 * SP}:${500 * SP},${650 * SP},0`,
    // line 10 at (72, 100), 400pt wide, 10pt tall, 2pt deep
    `(1,10:${72 * SP},${100 * SP}:${400 * SP},${10 * SP},${2 * SP}`,
    ')',
    // line 20 at (72, 200)
    `(1,20:${72 * SP},${200 * SP}:${400 * SP},${10 * SP},${2 * SP}`,
    ')',
    // intro.tex line 5 at (72, 300)
    `(2,5:${72 * SP},${300 * SP}:${400 * SP},${10 * SP},0`,
    ')',
    ']',
    '}',
    '{2',
    `(1,40:${72 * SP},${100 * SP}:${400 * SP},${10 * SP},0`,
    ')',
    '}',
    'Postamble:',
    'Count:4',
    '',
  ].join('\n');

  return new TextEncoder().encode(text);
}

describe('normaliseTexPath', () => {
  it('strips the leading ./ TeX writes', () => {
    expect(normaliseTexPath('./main.tex')).toBe('main.tex');
  });

  it('normalises backslashes so Windows paths match project names', () => {
    expect(normaliseTexPath('sections\\intro.tex')).toBe('sections/intro.tex');
  });
});

describe('parseSyncTex', () => {
  it('reads the input map', async () => {
    const index = await parseSyncTex(sampleSyncTex());
    expect(index.files.get(1)).toBe('main.tex');
    expect(index.files.get(2)).toBe('sections/intro.tex');
  });

  it('groups boxes by page', async () => {
    const index = await parseSyncTex(sampleSyncTex());
    expect(index.pages.size).toBe(2);
    // Page 1: the vbox plus three hboxes.
    expect(index.pages.get(1)).toHaveLength(4);
    expect(index.pages.get(2)).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('converts scaled points to points', async () => {
    const index = await parseSyncTex(sampleSyncTex());
    const box = index.pages.get(1)!.find((b) => b.line === 10)!;

    expect(box.x).toBeCloseTo(72, 5);
    expect(box.y).toBeCloseTo(100, 5);
    expect(box.width).toBeCloseTo(400, 5);
    expect(box.height).toBeCloseTo(10, 5);
    expect(box.depth).toBeCloseTo(2, 5);
  });

  it('applies magnification', async () => {
    const doubled = new TextEncoder().encode(
      new TextDecoder()
        .decode(sampleSyncTex())
        .replace('Magnification:1000', 'Magnification:2000'),
    );

    const index = await parseSyncTex(doubled);
    const box = index.pages.get(1)!.find((b) => b.line === 10)!;
    expect(box.x).toBeCloseTo(144, 5);
  });

  it('transparently handles gzipped output', async () => {
    const raw = sampleSyncTex();
    const gzipped = new Uint8Array(
      await new Response(
        new Blob([raw as unknown as BlobPart])
          .stream()
          .pipeThrough(new CompressionStream('gzip')),
      ).arrayBuffer(),
    );

    // pdfTeX writes .synctex.gz by default, so this is the common case.
    const index = await parseSyncTex(gzipped);
    expect(index.files.get(1)).toBe('main.tex');
    expect(index.pages.get(1)).toHaveLength(4);
  });

  it('ignores content after Postamble', async () => {
    const index = await parseSyncTex(sampleSyncTex());
    expect(index.pages.has(3)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('returns an empty index for junk rather than throwing', async () => {
    const index = await parseSyncTex(new TextEncoder().encode('not synctex'));
    expect(index.pages.size).toBe(0);
    expect(index.files.size).toBe(0);
  });
});

describe('boxToRect', () => {
  it('places the rect above the baseline and spans height plus depth', () => {
    const rect = boxToRect({
      kind: 'h',
      tag: 1,
      line: 1,
      column: 0,
      x: 72,
      y: 100,
      width: 400,
      height: 10,
      depth: 2,
    });

    // The baseline is at y=100, so the box top is 10pt above it.
    expect(rect.y).toBeCloseTo(90, 5);
    expect(rect.height).toBeCloseTo(12, 5);

    expect(rect.x).toBeCloseTo(60, 5);
    expect(rect.width).toBeCloseTo(40, 5);

  it('gives a zero-height box a clickable extent', () => {
    const rect = boxToRect({
      kind: 'h',
      tag: 1,
      line: 1,
      column: 0,
      x: 0,

      depth: 0,
    });
    expect(rect.height).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });
});

describe('forwardSync', () => {
  it('finds the page and rect for an exact source line', async () => {
    const index = await parseSyncTex(sampleSyncTex());
    const match = forwardSync(index, 'main.tex', 20)!;

    expect(match.page).toBe(1);
    expect(match.exact).toBe(true);
    expect(match.matchedLine).toBe(20);
    expect(match.rects[0].y).toBeCloseTo(190, 5);
  });

  it('falls back to the nearest line that produced output', async () => {
    const index = await parseSyncTex(sampleSyncTex());
    // Line 21 typeset nothing (a comment, say); line 20 is nearest.
    const match = forwardSync(index, 'main.tex', 21)!;

    expect(match.exact).toBe(false);
    expect(match.matchedLine).toBe(20);
  });

  it('resolves lines in an included file to that file only', async () => {
    const index = await parseSyncTex(sampleSyncTex());
    const match = forwardSync(index, 'sections/intro.tex', 5)!;

    expect(match.exact).toBe(true);
    expect(match.rects[0].y).toBeCloseTo(290, 5);
  });

  it('matches a file TeX recorded under a longer path', async () => {
    const index = await parseSyncTex(sampleSyncTex());
    expect(forwardSync(index, 'intro.tex', 5)).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it('returns null for a file the engine never read', async () => {
    const index = await parseSyncTex(sampleSyncTex());
    expect(forwardSync(index, 'nowhere.tex', 1)).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('inverseSync', () => {
  it('resolves a point inside a line box to that source line', async () => {
    const index = await parseSyncTex(sampleSyncTex());
    // Inside the line-20 box: x in [72,472], y in [190,202].
    const match = inverseSync(index, 1, 200, 195)!;

    expect(match.file).toBe('main.tex');
    expect(match.line).toBe(20);
    expect(match.exact).toBe(true);
  });

  it('prefers the innermost box over the enclosing page box', async () => {
    const index = await parseSyncTex(sampleSyncTex());
    const match = inverseSync(index, 1, 200, 95)!;

    // The line-10 hbox and the page vbox both contain this point; the smaller
    // one is the useful answer.
    expect(match.line).toBe(10);
  });

  it('attributes a click in an included file correctly', async () => {
    const index = await parseSyncTex(sampleSyncTex());
    const match = inverseSync(index, 1, 100, 295)!;

    expect(match.file).toBe('sections/intro.tex');
    expect(match.line).toBe(5);
  });

  it('falls back to the nearest box for a click in a margin', async () => {
    const index = await parseSyncTex(sampleSyncTex());
    const match = inverseSync(index, 2, 2000, 2000)!;

    expect(match.exact).toBe(false);
    expect(match.line).toBe(40);
  });

  it('returns null for a page with no records', async () => {
    const index = await parseSyncTex(sampleSyncTex());
    expect(inverseSync(index, 99, 10, 10)).toBeNull();
  });
});
````

````typescript
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterEach, vi } from 'vitest';
import http from 'node:http';
import https from 'node:https';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import os from 'node:os';
import { createPackageServer } from '../../deploy/texlive-server/server.mjs';

function doRequest(
  port: number,
  path: string,
  method = 'GET',
  headers: Record<string, string> = {}
): Promise<{ status: number; headers: http.IncomingHttpHeaders; body: string }> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const req = http.request(
      {
        host: '127.0.0.1',
        port,
        path,
        method,
        headers,
      },
      (res) => {
        let body = '';
        res.on('data', (chunk) => {
          body += chunk.toString();
        });
        res.on('end', () => {
          resolve({
            status: res.statusCode || 0,
            headers: res.headers,
            body,
          });
        });
      }
    );
    req.on('error', reject);
    req.end();
  });
}

      upstream: 'https://texlive2026.texlyre.org',
    });

    await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
      server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', () => {
        const addr = server.address();
        port = typeof addr === 'object' && addr ? addr.port : 0;
        resolve();
      });
    });
  });

  afterEach(async () => {

      server.close(() => resolve());

    } catch {}
  });

    expect(res.status).toBe(200);

    const res = await doRequest(port, '/26/querytest.sty?v=1.0.0&cache=true');

    expect(res.headers['x-cache']).toBe('HIT');

  });

    expect(res.body).toBe('\\ProvidesPackage{testpkg}\n');

    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(cachedFile), { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(cachedFile, 'header-test-content');

  });

    const insecureServer = createPackageServer({
      cacheDir: tempCacheDir,
      upstream: 'http://insecure.texlyre.org',
    });

    await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
      insecureServer.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', resolve);
    });

    const insecurePort = (insecureServer.address() as any).port;
    try {
      const res = await doRequest(insecurePort, '/pkg.sty');
      expect(res.status).toBe(500);
      expect(res.body).toContain('Server Misconfiguration: Upstream URL must use HTTPS');
    } finally {
      await new Promise<void>((resolve) => insecureServer.close(() => resolve()));
    }
  });

  it('rejects upstream redirects with 502 Bad Gateway to prevent host hijacking', async () => {
    // Mock https.request to simulate upstream returning a 302 redirect
    const origRequest = https.request;
    const httpsMock = vi.spyOn(https, 'request').mockImplementation((url: any, opts: any, cb: any) => {
      const callback = typeof opts === 'function' ? opts : cb;
      const { PassThrough } = require('node:stream');
      const mockSocket = new PassThrough();
      const mockIncoming = new http.IncomingMessage(mockSocket as any);
      mockIncoming.statusCode = 302;
      mockIncoming.headers = { location: 'https://malicious.upstream.org/hijacked.sty' };

      const clientReq = new http.ClientRequest({ host: 'localhost' });
      process.nextTick(() => {
        if (callback) callback(mockIncoming);
      });
      return clientReq;
    });

    try {
      const res = await doRequest(port, '/26/redirected.sty');
      expect(res.status).toBe(502);
      expect(res.body).toContain('Upstream redirects are prohibited');
    } finally {
      httpsMock.mockRestore();
    }
  });
});
````

````sql
-- ==============================================================================
-- TEEEX STUDIO — SUPABASE DATABASE INITIALIZATION SCRIPT
-- Paste and run this in your Supabase SQL Editor:
-- https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/_/sql
-- ==============================================================================

-- 1. Enable UUID Extension
create extension if not exists "uuid-ossp";

-- 2. Profiles Table (stores academic user information)
create table if not exists public.profiles (
  id uuid references auth.users(id) on delete cascade primary key,
  email text not null,
  full_name text default '',
  avatar_url text,
  avatar_color text default '#38bdf8',
  is_approved boolean default false,
  is_admin boolean default false,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null,
  updated_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null
);

-- Add columns if the table already exists from an older version
alter table if exists public.profiles add column if not exists is_approved boolean default false;
alter table if exists public.profiles add column if not exists is_admin boolean default false;

-- Enable Row Level Security (RLS) on profiles
alter table public.profiles enable row level security;

-- Drop existing policies if re-running
drop policy if exists "Profiles are viewable by everyone" on public.profiles;
drop policy if exists "Users can insert their own profile" on public.profiles;
drop policy if exists "Users can update their own profile" on public.profiles;

create policy "Profiles are viewable by everyone"
  on public.profiles for select
  using (true);

create policy "Users can insert their own profile"
  on public.profiles for insert
  with check (auth.uid() = id);

create policy "Users can update their own profile"
  on public.profiles for update
  using (auth.uid() = id);

create policy "Admins can update profiles"
  on public.profiles for update
  using (true);

create policy "Admins can delete profiles"
  on public.profiles for delete
  using (true);

-- Dedicated RPC functions with security definer for profile approvals
create or replace function public.approve_profile(target_user_id uuid)
returns boolean as $$
begin
  update public.profiles set is_approved = true, updated_at = now() where id = target_user_id;
  return true;
end;
$$ language plpgsql security definer;

create or replace function public.reject_profile(target_user_id uuid)
returns boolean as $$
begin
  delete from public.profiles where id = target_user_id;
  return true;
end;
$$ language plpgsql security definer;

-- 3. Projects Table (LaTeX files, metadata, members, and tags)
create table if not exists public.projects (
  id text primary key,
  title text not null,
  owner_id text not null,
  owner_email text not null,
  role text not null default 'owner',
  files jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  folders text[] default array['sections', 'figures']::text[],
  tags text[] default array[]::text[],
  members jsonb default '[]'::jsonb,
  is_archived boolean default false,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null,
  updated_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null
);

-- Add column if projects table was created previously without folders
alter table if exists public.projects add column if not exists folders text[] default array['sections', 'figures']::text[];

-- Enable RLS on projects
alter table public.projects enable row level security;

drop policy if exists "Allow select on projects" on public.projects;
drop policy if exists "Allow insert on projects" on public.projects;
drop policy if exists "Allow update on projects" on public.projects;
drop policy if exists "Allow delete on projects" on public.projects;

create policy "Allow select on projects"
  on public.projects for select
  using (true);

create policy "Allow insert on projects"
  on public.projects for insert
  with check (true);

create policy "Allow update on projects"
  on public.projects for update
  using (true);

create policy "Allow delete on projects"
  on public.projects for delete
  using (true);

-- 4. Checkpoints Table (Version History & Time Machine)
create table if not exists public.checkpoints (
  id text primary key,
  project_id text references public.projects(id) on delete cascade,
  name text not null,
  timestamp text not null,
  author text not null,
  files jsonb not null,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null
);

alter table public.checkpoints enable row level security;

drop policy if exists "Allow all on checkpoints" on public.checkpoints;
create policy "Allow all on checkpoints"
  on public.checkpoints for all
  using (true);

-- 5. Enable Supabase Realtime for Projects Table
-- This powers live multi-user paper syncing across devices (safe idempotent check)
do $$
begin
  if not exists (
    select 1
    from pg_publication_tables
    where pubname = 'supabase_realtime'
      and schemaname = 'public'
      and tablename = 'projects'
  ) then
    alter publication supabase_realtime add table public.projects;
  end if;
end $$;

-- 6. Trigger to automatically create a profile when a new user signs up
create or replace function public.handle_new_user()
returns trigger as $$
begin
  insert into public.profiles (id, email, full_name, avatar_color, is_approved, is_admin)
  values (
    new.id,
    new.email,
    coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name', split_part(new.email, '@', 1)),
    '#38bdf8',
    coalesce((new.raw_user_meta_data->>'is_approved')::boolean, false),
    coalesce((new.raw_user_meta_data->>'is_admin')::boolean, false)
  )
  on conflict (id) do nothing;
  return new;
end;
$$ language plpgsql security definer;

drop trigger if exists on_auth_user_created on auth.users;
create trigger on_auth_user_created
  after insert on auth.users
  for each row execute procedure public.handle_new_user();
````

## File: deploy/texlive-server/README.md
````markdown
# Teeex — Self-Hosted TeX Live Package Server (Option C)

This lightweight caching proxy eliminates the runtime dependency on the third-party `texlive2026.texlyre.org` server.

When documents use packages beyond `texlive-basic` (e.g. `\usepackage{tikz}`, `\usepackage{amsmath}`, IEEEtran, acmart), the TeX engine resolves those files on demand. This server caches all requested packages on disk and serves them with full CORS and immutable cache headers.

---

## 1-Click / Free Tier Deployments

### Option 1: Railway.app (Free Tier — Recommended)
1. Go to [railway.app](https://railway.app) and click **New Project** -> **Deploy from GitHub repo**.
2. Select your Teeex repo and set the root directory to `deploy/texlive-server`.
3. In **Variables**, you can optionally set:
   - `PORT`: `8080` (Railway detects this automatically)
   - `UPSTREAM_URL`: `https://texlive2026.texlyre.org`
4. In **Settings** -> **Networking**, click **Generate Domain** (e.g. `https://teeex-texlive.up.railway.app`).
5. Copy your domain and set it in your frontend environment variables:
   ```env
   VITE_TEXLIVE_REMOTE_ENDPOINT=https://teeex-texlive.up.railway.app
   ```

### Option 2: Render.com (Free Tier)
1. Go to [render.com](https://render.com) -> **New Web Service**.
2. Connect your repository.
3. Settings:
   - Root Directory: `deploy/texlive-server`
   - Environment: `Docker`
   - Plan: `Free`
4. Copy the assigned URL (e.g. `https://teeex-texlive.onrender.com`) and set:
   ```env
   VITE_TEXLIVE_REMOTE_ENDPOINT=https://teeex-texlive.onrender.com
   ```

### Option 3: Fly.io (Free Tier)
1. Install flyctl: `powershell -Command "iwr https://fly.io/install.ps1 -useb | iex"`
2. From this folder:
   ```bash
   cd deploy/texlive-server
   fly launch
   fly deploy
   ```
3. Set your endpoint in the main project:
   ```env
   VITE_TEXLIVE_REMOTE_ENDPOINT=https://your-app.fly.dev
   ```

### Option 4: Local or VPS Docker
```bash
cd deploy/texlive-server
docker compose up -d
```
Accessible locally at `http://localhost:8080`.

---

## Health Check
Verify your server is running:
```bash
curl https://your-server-url/health
# Returns: {"status":"healthy","service":"teeex-texlive-server","upstream":"https://texlive2026.texlyre.org"}
```

---

## Security & Deployment Constraints

The package proxy is hardened with defensive controls to protect host infrastructure and cached assets:
- **Method Whitelist**: Only `GET`, `HEAD`, and `OPTIONS` requests are accepted. All other methods return `405 Method Not Allowed` with an explicit `Allow` header.
- **Path Sanitization & Traversal Prevention**: Raw request URLs have query strings and fragments stripped before analysis. The path is inspected prior to normalisation to reject malformed percent-encodings (`%(?![0-9a-fA-F]{2})`), multi-layer encoded sequences (`%252e%252e`, `%252f`, `%255c`), direct/encoded directory traversals (`..`, `%2e%2e`), backslashes (`\`, `%5c`), NUL bytes (`%00`), and carriage returns/newlines (`\r`, `\n`). Resolved paths must stay strictly within the designated cache directory root, or return `400 Bad Request`.
- **HTTPS Upstream & Redirect Rejection**: The proxy strictly requires an HTTPS upstream URL (`UPSTREAM_URL`) to prevent insecure man-in-the-middle package substitution. Upstream redirects (`301`, `302`, `303`, `307`, `308`) are explicitly rejected with `502 Bad Gateway` to prevent SSRF and redirect hijacking.
- **Payload Limits, Timeouts & Streaming Backpressure**: Imposes a 15-second upstream request timeout and a 64 MiB maximum package size limit (enforced on advertised `Content-Length` and accumulated streaming chunks). Upstream streaming respects client socket backpressure by pausing reads when the downstream buffer is saturated and resuming on `drain`.
- **Client Disconnect & Cancellation**: If a downstream client terminates the connection prematurely (`req.on('close')`), the upstream request is aborted immediately and any in-flight temporary cache files are deleted.
- **Atomic Cache Writes & Resilience**: Cache misses are streamed directly to the client while writing to a uniquely named temporary file. The file is atomically renamed into the cache hierarchy only after a complete, verified write. Disk I/O failures are treated as best-effort so cache write issues do not drop a valid upstream response.
- **Security Headers**: All responses include `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` and `X-Cache: HIT` / `X-Cache: MISS` headers.

> [!CAUTION]
> **Deployment Boundary**:
> This service functions as a public package proxy, not an authenticated compilation service.
> - Always run behind an HTTPS-terminating reverse proxy (Cloudflare, Railway, Caddy, or Nginx) in production.
> - Permissive CORS headers (`Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`) are designed for browser package downloads and do not provide access control or document security.
````

## File: deploy/texlive-server/server.mjs
````javascript
import http from 'node:http';
import https from 'node:https';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const PORT = process.env.PORT || 8080;
const CACHE_DIR = process.env.CACHE_DIR || path.join(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), 'cache');
const UPSTREAM = (process.env.UPSTREAM_URL || 'https://texlive2026.texlyre.org').replace(/\/+$/, '');
const MAX_PACKAGE_SIZE = 64 * 1024 * 1024; // 64 MiB
const UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT_MS = 15000; // 15 seconds

if (!fs.existsSync(CACHE_DIR)) {
  fs.mkdirSync(CACHE_DIR, { recursive: true });
}

export function createPackageServer({
  cacheDir = CACHE_DIR,
  upstream = UPSTREAM,
  maxSize = MAX_PACKAGE_SIZE,
  timeoutMs = UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT_MS,
} = {}) {
  const resolvedCacheDir = path.resolve(cacheDir);

  if (!fs.existsSync(resolvedCacheDir)) {
    fs.mkdirSync(resolvedCacheDir, { recursive: true });
  }

  return http.createServer((req, res) => {
    // 1. CORS and nosniff headers
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, HEAD, OPTIONS');
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', '*');
    res.setHeader('X-Content-Type-Options', 'nosniff');

    // 2. Method Filtering
    if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
      res.writeHead(204);
      res.end();
      return;
    }

    if (req.method !== 'GET' && req.method !== 'HEAD') {
      res.setHeader('Allow', 'GET, HEAD, OPTIONS');
      res.writeHead(405, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8' });
      res.end('Method Not Allowed');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Upstream Protocol Enforcement
    if (!upstream.startsWith('https://')) {
      res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8' });
      res.end('Server Misconfiguration: Upstream URL must use HTTPS');
      return;
    }

    const rawUrl = req.url || '';
    // Exclude query string from filesystem path checks
    const rawPathOnly = rawUrl.split('?')[0];

    // 4. Raw Path Traversal & Segment Validation
    // Malformed percent escapes (e.g. %zz, %2, trailing %)
    if (/%(?![0-9a-fA-F]{2})/.test(rawPathOnly)) {
      res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8' });
      res.end('Bad Request: Malformed percent escape');
      return;
    }

    // Control characters: NUL, CR, LF
    if (/[\r\n\0]/.test(rawPathOnly) || /%0[0a-fA-F]|%0[dD]/.test(rawPathOnly)) {
      res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8' });
      res.end('Bad Request: Invalid URL characters detected');
      return;
    }

    // Backslashes or encoded backslashes
    if (/\\|%5[cC]/.test(rawPathOnly)) {
      res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8' });
      res.end('Bad Request: Backslash path separator detected');
      return;
    }

    // Multi-encoded traversals or slashes (%252e, %252f, %255c)
    if (/%25(?:2[eE]|2[fF]|5[cC])/i.test(rawPathOnly) || /%2525/i.test(rawPathOnly)) {
      res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8' });
      res.end('Bad Request: Multi-encoded path traversal detected');
      return;
    }

    // Traversal segments (.. or %2e%2e)
    if (/(?:^|\/|%2[fF])(?:\.\.|%2[eE]%2[eE]|%2[eE]\.|\.%2[eE])(?:\/|%2[fF]|$)/.test(rawPathOnly)) {
      res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8' });
      res.end('Bad Request: Path traversal sequence detected');
      return;
    }

    let url;
    try {
      url = new URL(rawUrl, `http://${req.headers.host || 'localhost'}`);
    } catch {
      res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8' });
      res.end('Bad Request: Malformed URL');
      return;
    }

    const pathname = decodeURIComponent(url.pathname);

    // 5. Health Check Endpoint
    if (pathname === '/health' || pathname === '/') {
      res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8' });
      if (req.method === 'HEAD') {
        res.end();
        return;
      }
      res.end(JSON.stringify({ status: 'healthy', service: 'teeex-texlive-server', upstream }));
      return;
    }

    // 6. Path Resolution & Cache Root Containment Check
    const safeSubPath = path.normalize(pathname).replace(/^[/\\]+/, '');
    const localFile = path.resolve(resolvedCacheDir, safeSubPath);

    if (!localFile.startsWith(resolvedCacheDir + path.sep) && localFile !== resolvedCacheDir) {
      res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8' });
      res.end('Bad Request: Path escapes cache root');
      return;
    }

    // 7. Cache Hit
    if (fs.existsSync(localFile) && fs.statSync(localFile).isFile()) {
      const stat = fs.statSync(localFile);
      res.writeHead(200, {
        'Content-Type': 'application/octet-stream',
        'Content-Length': stat.size,
        'Cache-Control': 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable',
        'X-Cache': 'HIT',
      });
      if (req.method === 'HEAD') {
        res.end();
        return;
      }
      fs.createReadStream(localFile).pipe(res);
      return;
    }

    // 8. Cache Miss -> Fetch from Upstream
    const upstreamUrl = `${upstream}${pathname}`;
    const tempFile = path.join(resolvedCacheDir, `.tmp.${Date.now()}.${crypto.randomUUID()}.tmp`);
    let tempWriteStream = null;
    let isClientClosed = false;

    req.on('close', () => {
      isClientClosed = true;
      if (!res.writableEnded) {
        upstreamReq.destroy();
        if (tempWriteStream && !tempWriteStream.destroyed) {
          tempWriteStream.destroy();
        }
        try { if (fs.existsSync(tempFile)) fs.unlinkSync(tempFile); } catch {}
      }
    });

    const upstreamReq = https.request(
      upstreamUrl,
      {
        method: req.method,
        timeout: timeoutMs,
      },
      (upstreamRes) => {
        if (isClientClosed) {
          upstreamRes.destroy();
          return;
        }

        const statusCode = upstreamRes.statusCode || 502;

        // Reject upstream redirects (301, 302, 303, 307, 308)
        if ([301, 302, 303, 307, 308].includes(statusCode)) {
          try { upstreamRes.destroy(); } catch {}
          if (!res.headersSent) {
            res.writeHead(502, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8', 'X-Cache': 'MISS' });
            res.end('Bad Gateway: Upstream redirects are prohibited');
          }
          return;
        }

        if (statusCode !== 200) {
          if (!res.headersSent) {
            res.writeHead(statusCode, {
              'Content-Type': upstreamRes.headers['content-type'] || 'text/plain; charset=utf-8',
              'X-Cache': 'MISS',
            });
          }
          if (req.method === 'HEAD') {
            res.end();
            return;
          }
          upstreamRes.pipe(res);
          return;
        }

        // Validate advertised content-length
        const advertisedLen = parseInt(upstreamRes.headers['content-length'] || '0', 10);
        if (advertisedLen > maxSize) {
          upstreamRes.destroy();
          if (!res.headersSent) {
            res.writeHead(502, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8', 'X-Cache': 'MISS' });
            res.end(`Bad Gateway: Upstream payload exceeds ${maxSize} bytes limit`);
          }
          return;
        }

        if (req.method === 'HEAD') {
          if (!res.headersSent) {
            res.writeHead(200, {
              'Content-Type': upstreamRes.headers['content-type'] || 'application/octet-stream',
              'Content-Length': upstreamRes.headers['content-length'],
              'Cache-Control': 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable',
              'X-Cache': 'MISS',
            });
          }
          res.end();
          return;
        }

        // GET: Stream to client while writing to temporary cache file
        try {
          fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(localFile), { recursive: true });
          tempWriteStream = fs.createWriteStream(tempFile);
        } catch (err) {
          console.warn('[cache] Unable to open temp cache stream:', err.message);
        }

        let streamedBytes = 0;
        let isOversized = false;

        if (!res.headersSent) {
          res.writeHead(200, {
            'Content-Type': upstreamRes.headers['content-type'] || 'application/octet-stream',
            'Cache-Control': 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable',
            'X-Cache': 'MISS',
          });
        }

        upstreamRes.on('data', (chunk) => {
          streamedBytes += chunk.length;
          if (streamedBytes > maxSize) {
            isOversized = true;
            upstreamRes.destroy();
            if (tempWriteStream) tempWriteStream.destroy();
            try { if (fs.existsSync(tempFile)) fs.unlinkSync(tempFile); } catch {}
            if (!res.writableEnded) {
              res.destroy(new Error(`Payload exceeded maximum size limit of ${maxSize} bytes`));
            }
            return;
          }

          const canWriteTemp = tempWriteStream && !tempWriteStream.destroyed ? tempWriteStream.write(chunk) : true;
          const canWriteRes = res.write(chunk);

          // Apply stream backpressure if buffer full
          if (!canWriteTemp || !canWriteRes) {
            upstreamRes.pause();
            let drainedTemp = canWriteTemp;
            let drainedRes = canWriteRes;

            const checkDrain = () => {
              if (drainedTemp && drainedRes) {
                upstreamRes.resume();
              }
            };

            if (!canWriteRes) {
              res.once('drain', () => {
                drainedRes = true;
                checkDrain();
              });
            }
            if (!canWriteTemp && tempWriteStream) {
              tempWriteStream.once('drain', () => {
                drainedTemp = true;
                checkDrain();
              });
            }
          }
        });

        upstreamRes.on('end', () => {
          if (isOversized) return;
          res.end();

          if (tempWriteStream && !tempWriteStream.destroyed) {
            tempWriteStream.end(() => {
              try {
                fs.renameSync(tempFile, localFile);
              } catch (renameErr) {
                // Best-effort cache: do not fail client response if disk write fails
                console.warn('[cache] Failed to commit cache file:', renameErr.message);
                try { if (fs.existsSync(tempFile)) fs.unlinkSync(tempFile); } catch {}
              }
            });
          }
        });

        upstreamRes.on('error', (err) => {
          if (tempWriteStream && !tempWriteStream.destroyed) tempWriteStream.destroy();
          try { if (fs.existsSync(tempFile)) fs.unlinkSync(tempFile); } catch {}
          if (!res.headersSent) {
            res.writeHead(502, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8' });
            res.end(`Proxy stream error: ${err.message}`);
          } else if (!res.writableEnded) {
            res.destroy(err);
          }
        });
      }
    );

    upstreamReq.on('timeout', () => {
      upstreamReq.destroy();
      if (!res.headersSent) {
        res.writeHead(504, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8' });
        res.end('Gateway Timeout: Upstream request timed out');
      } else if (!res.writableEnded) {
        res.destroy(new Error('Gateway Timeout'));
      }
    });

    upstreamReq.on('error', (err) => {
      if (!res.headersSent) {
        res.writeHead(502, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8' });
        res.end(`Proxy error: ${err.message}`);
      } else if (!res.writableEnded) {
        res.destroy(err);
      }
    });

    upstreamReq.end();
  });
}

// Auto-start server when run directly
const isMain = process.argv[1] && fileURLToPath(import.meta.url) === path.resolve(process.argv[1]);
if (isMain) {
  const server = createPackageServer();
  server.listen(PORT, () => {
    console.log(`Teeex TeX Live package server running on port ${PORT}`);
    console.log(`Cache directory: ${CACHE_DIR}`);
    console.log(`Upstream: ${UPSTREAM}`);
  });
}
````

## File: scripts/upload-r2.mjs
````javascript
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * Teeex — Upload TeX engine assets to Cloudflare R2 bucket.
 *
 * Uploads the provisioned, patched, and SHA-256-verified engine assets from
 * `public/core/busytex/` to a Cloudflare R2 bucket (`TEEEX_ENGINE_BUCKET`).
 *
 * Usage:
 *   node scripts/upload-r2.mjs
 *   node scripts/upload-r2.mjs --bucket my-custom-bucket
 *
 * Prerequisites:
 *   1. Logged into Cloudflare: npx wrangler login
 *   2. Bucket created: npx wrangler r2 bucket create teeex-engine
 */

import { execSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import { stat } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { dirname, join, resolve } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const ROOT = resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
const SOURCE_DIR = join(ROOT, 'public', 'core', 'busytex');

const FILES_TO_UPLOAD = [
  '.teeex-manifest.json',
  'busytex_worker.js',
  'busytex_pipeline.js',
  'busytex_biber.js',
  'busytex.js',
  'busytex.wasm',
  'texlive-basic.js',
  'texlive-basic.data',
  'biber.js',
  'biber.wasm',
  'biber.data',
];

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const option = (name, fallback) => {
  const i = args.indexOf(`--${name}`);
  return i !== -1 && args[i + 1] ? args[i + 1] : fallback;
};

const BUCKET = process.env.TEEEX_ENGINE_BUCKET || option('bucket', 'teeex-engine');

function mib(bytes) {
  return `${(bytes / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)} MiB`;
}

async function main() {
  console.log('\n  Teeex Cloudflare R2 Asset Uploader');
  console.log(`  bucket  ${BUCKET}`);
  console.log(`  source  ${SOURCE_DIR}\n`);

  const files = FILES_TO_UPLOAD.filter((f) => existsSync(join(SOURCE_DIR, f)));

  if (files.length === 0) {
    console.error(`No assets found in ${SOURCE_DIR}. Run "npm run engine" first.`);
    process.exit(1);
  }

  console.log(`Found ${files.length} assets to upload:\n`);

  for (const [index, file] of files.entries()) {
    const filePath = join(SOURCE_DIR, file);
    const fileStat = await stat(filePath);
    const pos = `[${index + 1}/${files.length}]`;

    process.stdout.write(`  ${pos} Uploading ${file.padEnd(28)} (${mib(fileStat.size)})... `);

    try {
      execSync(
        `npx wrangler r2 object put "${BUCKET}/${file}" --file "${filePath}" --remote`,
        { stdio: 'pipe', encoding: 'utf8' }
      );
      console.log('DONE');
    } catch (err) {
      console.log('FAILED');
      console.error(`\nError uploading ${file}:`);
      console.error(err.stderr || err.message);
      console.error('\nMake sure you are logged into Cloudflare (npx wrangler login) and the bucket exists.');
      process.exit(1);
    }
  }

  console.log('\n  All assets successfully uploaded to Cloudflare R2!\n');
  console.log('  Next step in Cloudflare Dashboard:');
  console.log('  1. Navigate to: Workers & Pages -> your Pages project -> Settings -> Functions');
  console.log('  2. Under "R2 bucket bindings", click "Add binding":');
  console.log(`     - Variable name: TEEEX_ENGINE_BUCKET`);
  console.log(`     - R2 bucket:     ${BUCKET}`);
  console.log('  3. Re-deploy or trigger a new deployment.\n');
}

main().catch((err) => {
  console.error(err);
  process.exit(1);
});
````

````typescript
  onClose: () => void;
  currentUser: UserProfile | null;
  onAuthSuccess: (user: UserProfile) => void;

  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');

  const [fullName, setFullName] = useState('');
  const [rememberMe, setRememberMe] = useState(true);

    if (!email || !password) {

      return;
    }

    setIsLoading(true);

    try {
      const res = await loginWithEmail(email, password, rememberMe);
      if (res.success && res.user) {
        setSuccessMessage('Successfully signed in.');
        setTimeout(() => {
          onAuthSuccess(res.user!);
          onClose();

      } else {
        setErrorMessage(res.error || 'Invalid credentials.');
      }
    } catch {
      setErrorMessage('An unexpected error occurred during sign in.');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);

  };

                    autoComplete="username"
                    required
                    value={email}
                    onChange={e => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="jane.doe@university.edu"
                    className="auth-input"
                    style={inputStyle}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label style={labelStyle}>CHOOSE PASSWORD</label>
                <div style={inputWrapperStyle}>
                  <Lock size={14} color="var(--text-muted)" style={{ marginLeft: 10 }} />
                  <input
                    type="password"
                    name="password"
                    autoComplete="new-password"
                    required
                    value={password}
                    onChange={e => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="At least 6 characters"
                    className="auth-input"
                    style={inputStyle}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Remember Me Toggle */}
              <label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={rememberMe}
                  onChange={e => setRememberMe(e.target.checked)}
                  style={{ accentColor: '#38bdf8', cursor: 'pointer' }}
                />
                <span>Remember me on this browser</span>
              </label>

              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={isLoading}
                className="btn-primary"
                style={{ width: '100%', height: 38, fontSize: 13, marginTop: 4 }}
              >
                {isLoading ? <Loader2 size={16} style={{ animation: 'spin 1s linear infinite' }} /> : 'Create Account'}
              </button>
            </form>
          )}

          {/* FORGOT PASSWORD FORM */}
          {isCloud && activeTab === 'forgot' && (
            <form onSubmit={handleForgot} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--text-secondary)', lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
                Enter the email address registered with your account. We will send you instructions and a secure magic link to reset your password.
              </div>

              <div>
                <label style={labelStyle}>REGISTERED EMAIL</label>
                <div style={inputWrapperStyle}>
                  <Mail size={14} color="var(--text-muted)" style={{ marginLeft: 10 }} />
                  <input
                    type="email"
                    name="email"
                    autoComplete="username"
                    required
                    value={email}
                    onChange={e => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g. elena.rostova@teeex.io"
                    className="auth-input"
                    style={inputStyle}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 10, marginTop: 6 }}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => { setActiveTab('signin'); setErrorMessage(null); setSuccessMessage(null); }}
                  className="btn-secondary"
                  style={{ flex: 1, height: 38, fontSize: 12 }}
                >
                  Back to Sign In
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={isLoading}
                  className="btn-primary"
                  style={{ flex: 1.5, height: 38, fontSize: 12 }}
                >
                  {isLoading ? <Loader2 size={16} style={{ animation: 'spin 1s linear infinite' }} /> : (
                    <>
                      <KeyRound size={14} /> Send Reset Link
                    </>
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
````

````typescript
import React, { useRef, useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import {
  Bold,
  Italic,
  Sigma,
  Quote,
  List,
  MessageSquarePlus,
  Check,
  MessageSquare,
  Code as CodeIcon,
  PanelLeftClose,
  PanelLeftOpen,
  ArrowRight,
  Edit3,
  Palette,
  FileText,
  ChevronDown,
  Zap,
  Search,
  Layers,
  Map as MapIcon,
  Image as ImageIcon,
  Download,
  Copy,
  Upload,
} from 'lucide-react';
import type { Collaborator, ProjectRole, ProjectFile } from '../types/latex';
import { SYNTAX_THEMES, type SyntaxTheme } from '../services/syntaxHighlighter';

export interface EditorToolbarProps {
  isSidebarOpen?: boolean;
  onToggleSidebar?: () => void;
  isImageFile: boolean;
  fileName: string;
  lineCount: number;
  peers: Collaborator[];
  suggestionMode: boolean;
  setSuggestionMode: (val: boolean) => void;
  role?: ProjectRole;
  currentFile?: ProjectFile;
  imageCopied: boolean;
  setImageCopied: (val: boolean) => void;
  onOpenImageUpload?: () => void;
  onWrapSelection: (before: string, after: string) => void;
  onInsertSnippet: (text: string, offset?: number) => void;
  onOpenSnippets?: () => void;
  onFormatDocument?: () => void;
  trackedChangesCount: number;
  onForwardSync?: (line: number) => void;
  currentCursorLine: number;
  autoSyncPreview: boolean;
  setAutoSyncPreview: (val: boolean) => void;
  syntaxTheme: SyntaxTheme;
  setSyntaxTheme: (theme: SyntaxTheme) => void;
  onOpenFind: () => void;
  isFindOpen: boolean;
  isReviewPanelOpen: boolean;
  setIsReviewPanelOpen: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<boolean>>;
  activeReviewCount: number;
  isMinimapOpen: boolean;
  setIsMinimapOpen: (val: boolean) => void;
  onAddCommentClick: () => void;
  onFollowPeer?: (peer: Collaborator) => void;
}

export const EditorToolbar: React.FC<EditorToolbarProps> = React.memo(({
  isSidebarOpen = true,
  onToggleSidebar,
  isImageFile,
  fileName,
  lineCount,
  peers,
  onFollowPeer,
  suggestionMode,
  setSuggestionMode,
  role = 'owner',
  currentFile,
  imageCopied,
  setImageCopied,
  onOpenImageUpload,
  onWrapSelection,
  onInsertSnippet,
  onOpenSnippets,
  onFormatDocument,
  trackedChangesCount,
  onForwardSync,
  currentCursorLine,
  autoSyncPreview,
  setAutoSyncPreview,
  syntaxTheme,
  setSyntaxTheme,
  onOpenFind,
  isFindOpen,
  isReviewPanelOpen,
  setIsReviewPanelOpen,
  activeReviewCount,
  isMinimapOpen,
  setIsMinimapOpen,
  onAddCommentClick,
}) => {
  const [isThemeMenuOpen, setIsThemeMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [menuCoords, setMenuCoords] = useState<{ top: number; right: number } | null>(null);
  const themeButtonRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const themeMenuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const toggleThemeMenu = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (!isThemeMenuOpen && themeButtonRef.current) {
      const rect = themeButtonRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
      setMenuCoords({
        top: rect.bottom + 5,
        right: Math.max(10, window.innerWidth - rect.right),
      });
    }
    setIsThemeMenuOpen((prev) => !prev);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (
        themeMenuRef.current &&
        !themeMenuRef.current.contains(e.target as Node) &&
        themeButtonRef.current &&
        !themeButtonRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)
      ) {
        setIsThemeMenuOpen(false);
      }
    };
    if (isThemeMenuOpen) {
      document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
      const handleResize = () => setIsThemeMenuOpen(false);
      window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);
      return () => {
        document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
        window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
      };
    }
  }, [isThemeMenuOpen]);

  return (
    <div
      style={editorToolbarStyle}
      className="editor-toolbar toolbar-scrollbar"
      onWheel={(e) => {
        if (e.deltaY !== 0) e.currentTarget.scrollLeft += e.deltaY;
      }}
    >
      {/* Left Controls: Sidebar toggle, Code/Visual switcher, File Badge */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, flexShrink: 0, whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
        {onToggleSidebar && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onToggleSidebar}
            style={{
              height: 24,
              padding: '0 6px',
              display: 'inline-flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              color: isSidebarOpen ? 'var(--text-secondary)' : '#38bdf8',
              backgroundColor: isSidebarOpen ? 'var(--bg-surface-1)' : 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12)',
              border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)',
              borderRadius: 5,
              cursor: 'pointer',
              transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
            }}
            title={isSidebarOpen ? 'Collapse files sidebar' : 'Expand files sidebar'}
          >
            {isSidebarOpen ? <PanelLeftClose size={12} /> : <PanelLeftOpen size={12} />}
          </button>
        )}

        {isImageFile && (
          <div
            style={{
              display: 'inline-flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              gap: 5,
              padding: '0 8px',
              borderRadius: 5,
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12)',
              color: '#38bdf8',
              border: '1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25)',
              fontSize: 10.5,
              fontWeight: 600,
              height: 24,
              boxSizing: 'border-box',
            }}
          >
            <ImageIcon size={11} />
            <span>Image Asset</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Active File Pill */}
        <div
          style={{
            display: 'inline-flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: 5,
            padding: '0 7px',
            backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-surface-1)',
            border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)',
            borderRadius: 5,
            height: 24,
            whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
            flexShrink: 0,
          }}
        >
          {isImageFile ? <ImageIcon size={11} color="#38bdf8" /> : <FileText size={11} color="#38bdf8" />}
          <span style={{ fontSize: 11, fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)', fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--text-primary)', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
            {fileName}
          </span>
          <span style={{ fontSize: 9.5, color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
            {isImageFile ? '• Asset' : `• ${lineCount} lines`}
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Active Co-Authors Presence Avatar Stack */}
        {peers.filter((p) => p.activeFile === fileName).length > 0 && (
          <div style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5, flexShrink: 0 }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', marginLeft: 2 }}>
              {peers
                .filter((p) => p.activeFile === fileName)
                .map((p, idx) => (
                  <div
                    key={p.id}
                    onClick={() => onFollowPeer && onFollowPeer(p)}
                    style={{
                      width: 20,
                      height: 20,
                      borderRadius: '50%',
                      backgroundColor: p.color,
                      color: '#ffffff',
                      fontSize: 9,
                      fontWeight: 700,
                      display: 'flex',

                      border: '2px solid var(--bg-surface-0)',

                      position: 'relative',
                      boxShadow: '0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)',
                      cursor: onFollowPeer ? 'pointer' : 'default',
                      transition: 'transform 0.15s ease',
                    }}
                    onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                      if (onFollowPeer) (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).style.transform = 'scale(1.15)';
                    }}
                    onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                      if (onFollowPeer) (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).style.transform = 'scale(1)';
                    }}
                    title={`${p.name} (Line ${p.cursorLine} • ${p.status === 'typing' ? 'Typing...' : 'Active'})${onFollowPeer ? ' — Click to follow' : ''}`}
                  >
                    {p.avatar || p.name.substring(0, 2).toUpperCase()}
                  </div>
                ))}
            </div>
            <span className="badge badge-emerald" style={{ fontSize: 9, padding: '2px 6px', gap: 4 }}>
              <span style={{ width: 5, height: 5, borderRadius: '50%', backgroundColor: '#10b981', display: 'inline-block' }} />
              {peers.filter((p) => p.activeFile === fileName).length} co-author{peers.filter((p) => p.activeFile === fileName).length > 1 ? 's' : ''} live
            </span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Suggesting vs Editing Mode Toggle */}
        {role !== 'viewer' && (
          <div style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-surface-2)', borderRadius: 5, padding: 2, border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)', height: 24, flexShrink: 0 }}>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setSuggestionMode(false)}
              style={{

            <button

              }}
              title="Suggesting Mode: Edits become track-change suggestions"
            >
              <Check size={10} />
              <span>Suggesting</span>
              {trackedChangesCount > 0 && (
                <span

      {isImageFile ? (

              const cleanLabel = (fileName.split('/').pop() || 'fig').replace(/\.[^/.]+$/, '');
              const snippet = `\\begin{figure}[htbp]\n  \\centering\n  \\includegraphics[width=0.8\\linewidth]{${includePath}}\n  \\caption{Caption}\n  \\label{fig:${cleanLabel}}\n\\end{figure}`;

            title="Copy LaTeX \\includegraphics snippet to clipboard"

            <span>{imageCopied ? 'Copied' : 'Copy \\includegraphics'}</span>

          {onOpenImageUpload && (
````

````typescript
/**
 * Pure Deterministic LaTeX Formatter & Beautifier
 * Zero-AI, 100% deterministic syntax-aware indentation & whitespace normalization.
 */

const INDENT_STR = '  ';

// Environments that increase indentation level
const INDENT_ENVIRONMENTS = new Set([
  'equation',
  'equation*',
  'align',
  'align*',
  'gather',
  'gather*',
  'multline',
  'multline*',
  'tabular',
  'tabular*',
  'tabularx',
  'tabularx*',
  'tabulary',
  'table',
  'table*',
  'figure',
  'figure*',
  'itemize',
  'enumerate',
  'description',
  'matrix',
  'bmatrix',
  'pmatrix',
  'vmatrix',
  'cases',
  'proof',
  'theorem',
  'lemma',
  'definition',
  'corollary',
  'proposition',
  'example',
  'remark',
  'conjecture',
  'axiom',
  'claim',
  'algorithmic',
  'algorithm',
  'minipage',
  'tcolorbox',
  'framed',
  'boxed',
  'mdframed',
  'quote',
  'quotation',
  'verse',
  'center',
  'flushleft',
  'flushright',
  'thebibliography',
  'tablular',
]);

// Environments whose internal content must be preserved verbatim
const VERBATIM_ENVIRONMENTS = new Set([
  'verbatim',
  'verbatim*',
  'lstlisting',
  'minted',
]);

export function formatLatexCode(code: string): string {
  if (!code || !code.trim()) return code;

  const rawLines = code.split('\n');
  const formattedLines: string[] = [];
  let indentLevel = 0;
  let inVerbatim = false;
  let verbatimClosingTag = '';

  for (let i = 0; i < rawLines.length; i++) {
    const rawLine = rawLines[i];
    const trimmed = rawLine.trim();

    // 1. Verbatim Environment Handling (preserve line verbatim)
    if (inVerbatim) {
      formattedLines.push(rawLine.trimEnd());
      if (trimmed.includes(verbatimClosingTag)) {
        inVerbatim = false;
        verbatimClosingTag = '';
      }
      continue;
    }

    // Check if starting verbatim
    const verbMatch = trimmed.match(/\\begin\{([a-zA-Z0-9*]+)\}/);
    if (verbMatch && VERBATIM_ENVIRONMENTS.has(verbMatch[1])) {
      inVerbatim = true;
      verbatimClosingTag = `\\end{${verbMatch[1]}}`;
      formattedLines.push(INDENT_STR.repeat(indentLevel) + trimmed);
      continue;
    }

    // 2. Empty Lines Handling (normalize consecutive empty lines)
    if (trimmed.length === 0) {
      if (formattedLines.length > 0 && formattedLines[formattedLines.length - 1] !== '') {
        formattedLines.push('');
      }
      continue;
    }

    // 3. Count environment closings and openings on this line
    const beginMatches = [...trimmed.matchAll(/\\begin\{([a-zA-Z0-9*]+)\}/g)];
    const endMatches = [...trimmed.matchAll(/\\end\{([a-zA-Z0-9*]+)\}/g)];

    let opensThisLine = 0;
    let closesThisLine = 0;

    for (const m of beginMatches) {
      if (INDENT_ENVIRONMENTS.has(m[1])) opensThisLine++;
    }
    for (const m of endMatches) {
      if (INDENT_ENVIRONMENTS.has(m[1])) closesThisLine++;
    }

    // If the line starts with a closing tag, dedent BEFORE printing this line
    const startsWithClosing = /^\s*\\end\{([a-zA-Z0-9*]+)\}/.test(trimmed);
    if (startsWithClosing && closesThisLine > 0) {
      indentLevel = Math.max(0, indentLevel - closesThisLine);
      closesThisLine = 0; // already applied
    }

    // Build indented line
    const currentIndent = INDENT_STR.repeat(indentLevel);
    formattedLines.push(currentIndent + trimmed);

    // Apply remaining opens / closes for subsequent lines
    indentLevel = Math.max(0, indentLevel + opensThisLine - closesThisLine);
  }

  return formattedLines.join('\n').trimEnd() + '\n';
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Teeex — Service Worker & Persistent Cache Manager.
 *
 * Coordinates Service Worker registration, persistent storage requests
 * (`navigator.storage.persist()`), and engine binary CacheStorage inspection.
 */

export interface EngineCacheStatus {
  isSupported: boolean;
  isRegistered: boolean;
  isEngineCached: boolean;
  hasWasm: boolean;
  hasData: boolean;
  persistedStorage: boolean;
  cachedBytes: number;
}

export const ENGINE_CACHE_NAME = 'teeex-engine-v1.4.2';

/**
 * Registers the root service worker (/sw.js) and requests persistent storage.
 */
export async function registerServiceWorker(): Promise<ServiceWorkerRegistration | null> {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !('serviceWorker' in navigator)) {
    return null;
  }

  // Only bypass in local development if specifically disabled
  if (import.meta.env.DEV && import.meta.env.VITE_DISABLE_SW === 'true') {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    const registration = await navigator.serviceWorker.register('/sw.js', { scope: '/' });

    // Force service worker update check on registration
    try {
      await registration.update();
    } catch {}

    // Invalidate stale or poisoned engine caches in CacheStorage
    if (typeof caches !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        const cacheKeys = await caches.keys();
        for (const k of cacheKeys) {
          if (k.startsWith('teeex-engine-') && k !== ENGINE_CACHE_NAME) {
            await caches.delete(k);
          }
        }
        const cache = await caches.open(ENGINE_CACHE_NAME);
        const pipelineResp = await cache.match('/core/busytex/busytex_pipeline.js');
        if (pipelineResp) {
          const text = await pipelineResp.clone().text();
          if (!text.includes('supported_drivers =')) {
            await cache.delete('/core/busytex/busytex_pipeline.js');
          }
        }
        const wasmResp = await cache.match('/core/busytex/busytex.wasm');
        if (wasmResp) {
          const enc = wasmResp.headers.get('content-encoding');
          const ct = wasmResp.headers.get('content-type') || '';
          if (enc || ct.includes('text/html')) {
            await cache.delete('/core/busytex/busytex.wasm');
          }
        }
      } catch {}
    }

    // Request persistent storage to protect against browser eviction under disk pressure
    await requestPersistentStorage();

    return registration;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[ServiceWorker] Registration notice:', err);
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Requests browser permission for persistent storage so CacheStorage and IndexedDB
 * are never purged during temporary storage cleanups.
 */
export async function requestPersistentStorage(): Promise<boolean> {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !navigator.storage || !navigator.storage.persist) {
    return false;
  }

  try {
    const isPersisted = await navigator.storage.persisted();
    if (isPersisted) return true;
    return await navigator.storage.persist();
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Queries both CacheStorage and IndexedDB to verify whether the 120MB TeX engine
 * binaries (busytex.wasm & texlive-basic.data) are fully cached on local disk.
 */
export async function checkEngineCacheStatus(): Promise<EngineCacheStatus> {
  const fallback: EngineCacheStatus = {
    isSupported: false,
    isRegistered: false,
    isEngineCached: false,
    hasWasm: false,
    hasData: false,
    persistedStorage: false,
    cachedBytes: 0,
  };

  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !('caches' in window)) {
    return fallback;
  }

  try {
    const isRegistered = Boolean(navigator.serviceWorker?.controller);
    const persistedStorage = navigator.storage?.persisted ? await navigator.storage.persisted() : false;

    let cachedBytes = 0;
    if (navigator.storage?.estimate) {
      const est = await navigator.storage.estimate();
      cachedBytes = est.usage || 0;
    }

    const cache = await caches.open(ENGINE_CACHE_NAME);
    const wasmMatch = await cache.match('/core/busytex/busytex.wasm');
    const dataMatch = await cache.match('/core/busytex/texlive-basic.data');

    // Also check Emscripten's built-in IndexedDB package cache (EM_PRELOAD_CACHE)
    const idbDataCached = await checkEmscriptenIdbCache();

    const hasWasm = Boolean(wasmMatch);
    const hasData = Boolean(dataMatch || idbDataCached);
    const isEngineCached = hasWasm && hasData;

    return {
      isSupported: true,
      isRegistered,
      isEngineCached,
      hasWasm,
      hasData,
      persistedStorage,
      cachedBytes,
    };
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[ServiceWorker] Cache inspection notice:', err);
    return { ...fallback, isSupported: true };
  }
}

/**
 * Inspects Emscripten's EM_PRELOAD_CACHE IndexedDB database where texlive-basic.data
 * is partitioned and cached by the Emscripten runtime.
 */
async function checkEmscriptenIdbCache(): Promise<boolean> {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.indexedDB) return false;

  return new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
    try {
      const req = indexedDB.open('EM_PRELOAD_CACHE', 1);
      req.onerror = () => resolve(false);
      req.onupgradeneeded = () => {
        // Database didn't exist yet
        req.transaction?.abort();
        resolve(false);
      };
      req.onsuccess = (e) => {
        const db = (e.target as IDBOpenDBRequest).result;
        try {
          if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains('METADATA')) {
            db.close();
            return resolve(false);
          }
          const tx = db.transaction('METADATA', 'readonly');
          const store = tx.objectStore('METADATA');
          const getReq = store.get('metadata/texlive-basic.data');
          getReq.onsuccess = () => {
            db.close();
            resolve(Boolean(getReq.result));
          };
          getReq.onerror = () => {
            db.close();
            resolve(false);
          };
        } catch {
          db.close();
          resolve(false);
        }
      };
    } catch {
      resolve(false);
    }
  });
}

/**
 * Subscribes to broadcast notifications emitted by sw.js when engine assets
 * or packages are streamed and saved into CacheStorage.
 */
export function onServiceWorkerBroadcast(callback: (msg: { type: string; url?: string }) => void): () => void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !('BroadcastChannel' in window)) {
    return () => {};
  }

  let channel: BroadcastChannel | null = null;
  try {
    channel = new BroadcastChannel('teeex_sw_channel');
    const handler = (event: MessageEvent) => {
      if (event.data) callback(event.data);
    };
    channel.addEventListener('message', handler);
    return () => {
      channel?.removeEventListener('message', handler);
      channel?.close();
    };
  } catch {
    return () => {};
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { createClient, SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import type { ProjectFile } from '../types/latex';

export interface CloudProject {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  files: ProjectFile[];
  updatedAt: string;
}

/**
 * Credentials come from build-time environment only.
 *
 * There used to be a hardcoded project URL and anon key here as a fallback "so
 * the live site is always connected", and a localStorage override that let any
 * visitor repoint the client at an arbitrary project through a UI gated by a
 * passcode list shipped in the same bundle. An anon key is publishable, so
 * shipping one is not itself the defect — but it is only safe behind correct
 * row-level security, and the schema granted `using (true)` on every table. A
 * baked-in default also means a misconfigured deployment silently writes user
 * documents into someone else's database instead of failing loudly.
 *
 * Both are gone. No credentials, no cloud: the app runs local-first and says so.
 */
function readEnv(name: 'VITE_SUPABASE_URL' | 'VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY'): string {
  const value = import.meta.env[name];
  return typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim() : '';
}

const clientCache = new Map<string, SupabaseClient>();

export function getSupabaseClient(shareToken?: string | null): SupabaseClient | null {
  const tokenKey = shareToken?.trim() || '';
  if (clientCache.has(tokenKey)) {
    return clientCache.get(tokenKey)!;
  }

  const url = readEnv('VITE_SUPABASE_URL');
  const anonKey = readEnv('VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY');

  // A placeholder copied out of .env.example is a misconfiguration, not a
  // credential; treat it as absent rather than letting createClient fail later.
  if (!url || !anonKey || url.includes('your-project-id') || anonKey.includes('your-anon-public-key')) {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    const client = createClient(url, anonKey, {
      auth: {
        persistSession: !tokenKey,
        autoRefreshToken: !tokenKey,
      },
      global: tokenKey
        ? {
            headers: {
              'x-share-token': tokenKey,
            },
          }
        : undefined,
    });
    clientCache.set(tokenKey, client);
    return client;
  } catch (cause) {
    console.warn('Supabase client could not be created; running local-only.', cause);
    return null;
  }
}

export function isSupabaseConnected(): boolean {
  return getSupabaseClient() !== null;
}

/** The authenticated user's id, or null when signed out or running local-only. */
export async function getAuthUid(): Promise<string | null> {
  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();
  if (!supabase) return null;
  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
    if (error) return null;
    return data.session?.user?.id ?? null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}
````
