    onDocSave?: (files: ProjectFile[]) => void,
    shareToken?: string | null
  ) {
    this.projectId = projectId;
    this.selfUser = selfUser;
    this.onDocSaveCallback = onDocSave;
    this.shareToken = shareToken;

    // 1. Initialize root Y.Doc and Awareness
    this.ydoc = new Y.Doc({ gc: true });
    this.awareness = new Awareness(this.ydoc);

    // Seed initial files into Y.Text instances if provided
    if (initialFiles && initialFiles.length > 0) {
      this.initFiles(initialFiles);
    }

    // Configure local awareness state with current user profile
    this.awareness.setLocalStateField('user', {
      id: selfUser.id,
      name: selfUser.name,
      color: selfUser.color,
      colorLight: selfUser.color + '33',
      avatar: selfUser.avatar || selfUser.name.substring(0, 2).toUpperCase(),
    });
    this.awareness.setLocalStateField('clientCursor', {
      fileId: 'main.tex',
      line: 1,
      col: 1,
      updatedAt: Date.now(),
    });

    // 2. Set up Yjs local update listener
    this.ydoc.on('update', (update: Uint8Array, origin: unknown) => {
      // Do not re-broadcast updates that originated from our own remote provider
      if (origin === this) return;

      this.broadcastUpdate(update);
      this.scheduleDocSave();
    });

    // 3. Set up Awareness local change listener
    this.awareness.on('change', ({ added, updated, removed }: { added: number[]; updated: number[]; removed: number[] }) => {
      // Emit to subscribers
      this.notifyPeerListeners();

      // Broadcast local awareness changes to peers (throttled at 60ms)
      const localClientId = this.ydoc.clientID;
      if (added.includes(localClientId) || updated.includes(localClientId) || removed.includes(localClientId)) {
        this.throttleBroadcastAwareness();
      }
    });

    // 4. Initialize Local BroadcastChannel transport (same-browser / multi-tab / offline fallback)
    if (typeof BroadcastChannel !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        this.localBroadcast = new BroadcastChannel(`teeex_yjs_${projectId}`);
        this.localBroadcast.onmessage = (event) => {
          this.handleWireMessage(event.data as YjsWireMessage);
        };
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('[SupabaseYjsProvider] BroadcastChannel fallback unavailable:', err);
      }
    }

    // 5. Initialize Supabase Realtime transport (cross-machine / cloud)
    this.initSupabaseRealtime();

    // 6. Broadcast initial sync step 1
    this.sendSyncStep1();
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // File & CRDT Text Management
  // ============================================================================

  public getText(fileId: string): Y.Text {
    return this.ydoc.getText(`file:${fileId}`);
  }

  public initFiles(files: ProjectFile[]) {
    let hasContent = false;
    for (const key of this.ydoc.share.keys()) {
      if (key.startsWith('file:') && this.ydoc.getText(key).length > 0) {
        hasContent = true;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (hasContent) return;

    // Owners seed immediately. Collaborators wait 300ms for peer/cloud sync; if still empty, seed fallback.
    if (this.selfUser.role === 'owner' || !this.selfUser.role) {
      this.doSeedFiles(files);
    } else {
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (!this.isDestroyed) {
          let populated = false;
          for (const key of this.ydoc.share.keys()) {
            if (key.startsWith('file:') && this.ydoc.getText(key).length > 0) {
              populated = true;
              break;
            }
          }
          if (!populated) {
            this.doSeedFiles(files);
          }
        }
      }, 300);
    }
  }

  private doSeedFiles(files: ProjectFile[]) {
    this.ydoc.transact(() => {
      for (const file of files) {
        const ytext = this.getText(file.id);
        if (ytext.length === 0 && file.content) {
          ytext.insert(0, file.content);
        }
      }
    }, this);
  }

  public getDoc(): Y.Doc {
    return this.ydoc;
  }

  public getUndoManager(fileId: string): Y.UndoManager {
    let um = this.undoManagers.get(fileId);
    if (!um) {
      um = new Y.UndoManager(this.getText(fileId), {
        trackedOrigins: new Set([null, undefined, 'local-editor']), // track local keystrokes and local-editor transactions
      });
      this.undoManagers.set(fileId, um);
    }
    return um;
  }

  public getCommentsArray(): Y.Array<ReviewComment> {
    return this.ydoc.getArray<ReviewComment>('project-comments');
  }

  public getTrackedChangesArray(): Y.Array<TrackedChange> {
    return this.ydoc.getArray<TrackedChange>('project-tracked-changes');
  }

  public getMetadataMap(): Y.Map<unknown> {
    return this.ydoc.getMap<unknown>('project-metadata');
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // Transport Initialization
  // ============================================================================

  private initSupabaseRealtime() {
    const supabase = getSupabaseClient(this.shareToken);
    if (!supabase) return;

    try {
      const channelName = `teeex:collab:${this.projectId}`;
      this.supabaseChannel = supabase.channel(channelName, {
        config: {
          broadcast: { self: false },
          presence: { key: this.selfUser.id },
        },
      });

      // Handle incoming broadcast messages
      this.supabaseChannel
        .on('broadcast', { event: 'yjs-wire' }, ({ payload }) => {
          this.handleWireMessage(payload as YjsWireMessage);
        })
        .on('presence', { event: 'sync' }, () => {
          this.syncPeersFromSupabasePresence();
        })
        .subscribe((status) => {
          if (status === 'SUBSCRIBED') {
            this.isChannelSubscribed = true;

            // Track presence on the channel
            this.supabaseChannel?.track({
              user: this.selfUser,
              clientCursor: { line: 1, col: 1, fileId: 'main.tex' },
              onlineAt: Date.now(),
            });

            // Flush buffered messages queued before WebSocket channel completed subscription
            if (this.pendingWireMessages.length > 0) {
              const pending = [...this.pendingWireMessages];
              this.pendingWireMessages = [];
              for (const msg of pending) {
                try {
                  this.supabaseChannel?.send({
                    type: 'broadcast',
                    event: 'yjs-wire',
                    payload: msg,
                  });
                } catch { }
              }
            }

            // Handshake: Send sync-step-1 to discover peer states
            this.sendSyncStep1();
          } else if (status === 'CLOSED' || status === 'CHANNEL_ERROR') {
            this.isChannelSubscribed = false;
          }
        });
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('[SupabaseYjsProvider] Failed to initialize Supabase Realtime channel:', err);
    }
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // Message Handling & Binary Chunking
  // ============================================================================

  private sendWireMessage(msg: YjsWireMessage) {
    if (this.isDestroyed) return;

    // 1. Post to local BroadcastChannel (for other tabs)
    try {
      this.localBroadcast?.postMessage(msg);
    } catch { }

    // 2. Post to Supabase Realtime Broadcast (for remote peers)
    if (this.supabaseChannel) {
      if (this.isChannelSubscribed) {
        try {
          this.supabaseChannel.send({
            type: 'broadcast',
            event: 'yjs-wire',
            payload: msg,
          });
        } catch { }
      } else {
        // Buffer until WebSocket handshake finishes to avoid REST fallback warning
        this.pendingWireMessages.push(msg);
        if (this.pendingWireMessages.length > 50) {
          this.pendingWireMessages.shift();
        }
      }
    }
  }

  private broadcastUpdate(update: Uint8Array) {
    if (update.byteLength <= CHUNK_SIZE) {
      this.sendWireMessage({
        type: 'update',
        senderId: this.selfUser.id,
        data: buffer.toBase64(update),
      });
    } else {
      // Chunk large update into slices
      const transferId =
        typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && typeof crypto.randomUUID === 'function'
          ? `xfer_${crypto.randomUUID()}`
          : `xfer_${Date.now().toString(36)}`;
      const totalChunks = Math.ceil(update.byteLength / CHUNK_SIZE);

      for (let i = 0; i < totalChunks; i++) {
        const start = i * CHUNK_SIZE;
        const end = Math.min(start + CHUNK_SIZE, update.byteLength);
        const slice = update.subarray(start, end);

        this.sendWireMessage({
          type: 'chunk',
          senderId: this.selfUser.id,
          transferId,
          chunkIndex: i,
          totalChunks,
          data: buffer.toBase64(slice),
        });
      }
    }
  }

  private sendSyncStep1() {
    const stateVector = Y.encodeStateVector(this.ydoc);
    this.sendWireMessage({
      type: 'sync-step-1',
      senderId: this.selfUser.id,
      data: buffer.toBase64(stateVector),
    });
  }

  private handleWireMessage(msg: YjsWireMessage) {
    if (!msg || msg.senderId === this.selfUser.id || this.isDestroyed) return;

    switch (msg.type) {
      case 'sync-step-1': {
        if (!msg.data) return;
        try {
          const peerVector = buffer.fromBase64(msg.data);
          const diffUpdate = Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(this.ydoc, peerVector);
          // Send back sync-step-2 with the missing updates
          if (diffUpdate.byteLength <= CHUNK_SIZE) {
            this.sendWireMessage({
              type: 'sync-step-2',
              senderId: this.selfUser.id,
              data: buffer.toBase64(diffUpdate),
            });
          } else {
            this.broadcastUpdate(diffUpdate);
          }
        } catch (err) {
          console.warn('[SupabaseYjsProvider] Error handling sync-step-1:', err);
        }
        break;
      }

      case 'sync-step-2':
      case 'update': {
        if (!msg.data) return;
        try {
          const update = buffer.fromBase64(msg.data);
          Y.applyUpdate(this.ydoc, update, this);
        } catch (err) {
          console.warn(`[SupabaseYjsProvider] Error applying ${msg.type}:`, err);
        }
        break;
      }

      case 'chunk': {
        if (!msg.transferId || msg.chunkIndex === undefined || !msg.totalChunks || !msg.data) return;
        let transfer = this.pendingChunkTransfers.get(msg.transferId);
        if (!transfer) {
          transfer = { total: msg.totalChunks, chunks: new Map() };
          this.pendingChunkTransfers.set(msg.transferId, transfer);
        }

        transfer.chunks.set(msg.chunkIndex, buffer.fromBase64(msg.data));

        if (transfer.chunks.size === transfer.total) {
          // Reassemble all slices
          let totalLength = 0;
          for (let i = 0; i < transfer.total; i++) {
            totalLength += transfer.chunks.get(i)?.byteLength || 0;
          }

          const completeUpdate = new Uint8Array(totalLength);
          let offset = 0;
          for (let i = 0; i < transfer.total; i++) {
            const chunk = transfer.chunks.get(i);
            if (chunk) {
              completeUpdate.set(chunk, offset);
              offset += chunk.byteLength;
            }
          }

          this.pendingChunkTransfers.delete(msg.transferId);
          try {
            Y.applyUpdate(this.ydoc, completeUpdate, this);
          } catch (err) {
            console.warn('[SupabaseYjsProvider] Error applying reassembled chunk update:', err);
          }
        }
        break;
      }

      case 'awareness': {
        if (!msg.data) return;
        try {
          const awarenessUpdate = buffer.fromBase64(msg.data);
          applyAwarenessUpdate(this.awareness, awarenessUpdate, this);
        } catch (err) {
          console.warn('[SupabaseYjsProvider] Error applying awareness update:', err);
        }
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // Awareness & Cursor Throttling
  // ============================================================================

  public setLocalCursor(fileId: string, line: number, col: number, anchor?: number, head?: number) {
    if (this.isDestroyed) return;

    this.awareness.setLocalStateField('clientCursor', {
      fileId,
      line,
      col,
      anchor,
      head,
      updatedAt: Date.now(),
    });
  }

  private throttleBroadcastAwareness() {
    const now = Date.now();
    const elapsed = now - this.lastAwarenessBroadcastTime;

    if (elapsed >= 60) {
      this.lastAwarenessBroadcastTime = now;
      this.doBroadcastAwareness();
    } else if (!this.pendingAwarenessTimer) {
      this.pendingAwarenessTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        this.pendingAwarenessTimer = null;
        this.lastAwarenessBroadcastTime = Date.now();
        this.doBroadcastAwareness();
      }, 60 - elapsed);
    }
  }

  private doBroadcastAwareness() {
    if (this.isDestroyed) return;
    try {
      const awarenessUpdate = encodeAwarenessUpdate(this.awareness, [this.ydoc.clientID]);
      this.sendWireMessage({
        type: 'awareness',
        senderId: this.selfUser.id,
        data: buffer.toBase64(awarenessUpdate),
      });
    } catch { }
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // Peer State & Presence Extraction
  // ============================================================================

  public onPeersChange(callback: (peers: Collaborator[]) => void): () => void {
    this.peerListeners.add(callback);
    callback(this.getConnectedPeers());
    return () => this.peerListeners.delete(callback);
  }

  private notifyPeerListeners() {
    const peers = this.getConnectedPeers();
    for (const listener of this.peerListeners) {
      listener(peers);
    }
  }

  public getConnectedPeers(): Collaborator[] {
    const states = this.awareness.getStates();
    const peers: Collaborator[] = [];
    const localId = this.ydoc.clientID;

    for (const [clientId, state] of states.entries()) {
      if (clientId === localId) continue;

      const user = state.user as { id?: string; name?: string; color?: string; avatar?: string } | undefined;
      const clientCursor = (state.clientCursor || (state.cursor && typeof state.cursor.line === 'number' ? state.cursor : undefined)) as PeerCursorInfo | undefined;

      if (user && user.name) {
        peers.push({
          id: user.id || `client_${clientId}`,
          name: user.name,
          color: user.color || '#38bdf8',
          avatar: user.avatar || user.name.substring(0, 2).toUpperCase(),
          cursorLine: (clientCursor && typeof clientCursor.line === 'number') ? clientCursor.line : 1,
          cursorCol: (clientCursor && typeof clientCursor.col === 'number') ? clientCursor.col : 1,
          activeFile: (clientCursor && typeof clientCursor.fileId === 'string') ? clientCursor.fileId : 'main.tex',
          status: 'active',
          isSelf: false,
        });
      }
    }

    return peers;
  }

  private syncPeersFromSupabasePresence() {
    if (!this.supabaseChannel) return;
    try {
      void this.supabaseChannel.presenceState();
      // Combine with local awareness states
      this.notifyPeerListeners();
    } catch { }
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // Debounced Persistence
  // ============================================================================

  private scheduleDocSave() {
    if (this.pendingDocSaveTimer) clearTimeout(this.pendingDocSaveTimer);
    this.pendingDocSaveTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      this.pendingDocSaveTimer = null;
      this.persistActiveFiles();
    }, 2000);
  }

  public persistActiveFiles() {
    if (this.isDestroyed || !this.onDocSaveCallback) return;

    // Build updated ProjectFile array from Y.Text contents
    const fileKeys = Array.from(this.ydoc.share.keys()).filter((k) => k.startsWith('file:'));
    const files: ProjectFile[] = [];

    for (const key of fileKeys) {
      const fileId = key.replace('file:', '');
      const ytext = this.ydoc.getText(key);
      const isBib = fileId.endsWith('.bib');
      files.push({
        id: fileId,
        name: fileId,
        content: ytext.toString(),
        type: isBib ? 'bib' : 'tex',
      });
    }

    if (files.length > 0) {
      this.onDocSaveCallback(files);
      this.saveSnapshotToCloud().catch(() => { });
    }
  }

  public async saveSnapshotToCloud() {
    const supabase = getSupabaseClient(this.shareToken);
    if (!supabase) return;

    const uid = await getAuthUid();
    // Allow saving if authenticated OR if holding an edit capability token
    if (!uid && (!this.shareToken || !this.shareToken.startsWith('ed_'))) return;

    try {
      const snapshot = buffer.toBase64(Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(this.ydoc));
      const stateVector = buffer.toBase64(Y.encodeStateVector(this.ydoc));

      await supabase.from('project_crdt_states').upsert(
        {
          project_id: this.projectId,
          snapshot,
          state_vector: stateVector,
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
          updated_by: uid ?? null,
        },
        { onConflict: 'project_id' }
      );
    } catch (err) {
      // Quiet fail if table doesn't exist yet in remote Supabase
      console.warn('[SupabaseYjsProvider] Cloud snapshot save notice:', err);
    }
  }

  public async loadSnapshotFromCloud(): Promise<boolean> {
    const supabase = getSupabaseClient(this.shareToken);
    if (!supabase) return false;

    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('project_crdt_states')
        .select('snapshot')
        .eq('project_id', this.projectId)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (!error && data && data.snapshot) {
        const update = buffer.fromBase64(data.snapshot);
        Y.applyUpdate(this.ydoc, update, this);
        return true;
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('[SupabaseYjsProvider] Cloud snapshot load notice:', err);
    }
    return false;
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // Teardown & Lifecycle
  // ============================================================================

  public destroy() {
    this.isDestroyed = true;
    this.isChannelSubscribed = false;
    this.pendingWireMessages = [];

    if (this.pendingAwarenessTimer) {
      clearTimeout(this.pendingAwarenessTimer);
      this.pendingAwarenessTimer = null;
    }
    if (this.pendingDocSaveTimer) {
      clearTimeout(this.pendingDocSaveTimer);
      this.pendingDocSaveTimer = null;
    }

    try {
      this.awareness.destroy();
    } catch { }

    try {
      this.localBroadcast?.close();
    } catch { }

    try {
      if (this.supabaseChannel) {
        this.supabaseChannel.unsubscribe();
      }
    } catch { }

    this.peerListeners.clear();
    this.undoManagers.clear();
    this.pendingChunkTransfers.clear();
    this.ydoc.destroy();
  }
}

````typescript
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';
import {
  compileAndWaitForPreview,
  downloadedPdfBytes,
  extractPdfText,
  openWorkspace,
} from './fixtures';

/**
 * PDF fidelity.
 *
 * These tests assert on the artifact itself — page geometry, positioned text,
 * operator stream, and the rendered canvas — rather than on the app's own
 * claims about it. A preview that merely looks like a document passes a
 * screenshot test; it does not pass these.
 */

const SOURCE = String.raw`\documentclass[10pt]{article}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\title{Teeex Fidelity Check}
\author{Playwright}
\begin{document}
\maketitle
\section{Geometry}
This document exists to be measured, not read.
\[
\sum_{k=1}^{n} k = \frac{n(n+1)}{2}
\]
\end{document}`;

const PROFILE = { id: 'e2e-fidelity', email: 'fidelity@teeex.local', fullName: 'Playwright' };

/** Opens the app, types the document, and waits for a page to render. */
async function openAndCompile(
  page: Parameters<typeof openWorkspace>[0],
  source = SOURCE,
  profileId = 'e2e-fidelity',
) {
  await openWorkspace(
    page,
    {
      id: profileId,
      email: `${profileId}@teeex.local`,
      fullName: 'Playwright',
    },
    source,
  );
  await compileAndWaitForPreview(page, source);
}

test('the shipped PDF has real page geometry, usable fonts and positioned text', async ({
  page,
}) => {
  test.setTimeout(240_000);

  const browserErrors: string[] = [];
  page.on('pageerror', (error) => browserErrors.push(error.message));

  await openAndCompile(page, SOURCE, 'e2e-fidelity-geom');
  const bytes = await downloadedPdfBytes(page);

  expect(String.fromCharCode(...bytes.subarray(0, 5))).toBe('%PDF-');

  const { numPages, perPage } = await extractPdfText(bytes);
  expect(numPages).toBeGreaterThan(0);

  // A real TeX page is letter or A4 sized. A placeholder or an empty page would
  // not be.
  const pdfjs = await import('pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.mjs');
  const pdf = await pdfjs.getDocument({ data: bytes, useSystemFonts: true }).promise;
  const viewport = (await pdf.getPage(1)).getViewport({ scale: 1 });
  expect(viewport.width).toBeGreaterThan(400);
  expect(viewport.height).toBeGreaterThan(600);

  // Positioned text, not a raster: glyph positions come from the typesetter.
  const firstPage = await pdf.getPage(1);
  const operatorList = await firstPage.getOperatorList();
  expect(operatorList.fnArray.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);

  const textContent = await firstPage.getTextContent();
  for (const item of textContent.items) {
    if ('transform' in item) {
      for (const value of (item as { transform: number[] }).transform) {
        expect(Number.isFinite(value)).toBe(true);
      }
    }
  }

  const joined = perPage.join(' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
  expect(joined).toContain('Teeex Fidelity Check');
  expect(joined).toContain('Geometry');

  expect(browserErrors, browserErrors.join('\n')).toEqual([]);
});

test('the preview renders the shipped artifact, not a placeholder', async ({ page }) => {
  test.setTimeout(240_000);

  await openAndCompile(page, SOURCE, 'e2e-fidelity-raster');

  const canvas = page.getByRole('document', { name: 'Compiled document preview' })
    .locator('canvas')
    .first();

  // A placeholder or a blank pane is a flat field. Real typeset text produces
  // many distinct luminance buckets once PDF.js finishes rasterizing.
  await expect.poll(async () => {
    return canvas.evaluate((el: HTMLCanvasElement) => {
      const ctx = el.getContext('2d');
      if (!ctx || el.width === 0 || el.height === 0) {
        return 0;
      }
      const { data } = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, el.width, el.height);
      const seen = new Set<number>();
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i += 4 * 97) {
        const luma = (data[i] * 299 + data[i + 1] * 587 + data[i + 2] * 114) / 1000;
        seen.add(luma >> 3);
        if (seen.size > 8) break;
      }
      return seen.size;
    });
  }, { timeout: 15_000 }).toBeGreaterThan(2);

  const stats = await canvas.evaluate((el: HTMLCanvasElement) => ({
    width: el.width,
    height: el.height,
  }));
  expect(stats.width).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  expect(stats.height).toBeGreaterThan(0);

  // Backing store must be at least CSS-sized, or text is upscaled and blurry.
  const cssWidth = await canvas.evaluate((el) => el.getBoundingClientRect().width);
  expect(stats.width).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(Math.floor(cssWidth));
});

test('the preview page count equals the shipped PDF page count', async ({ page }) => {
  test.setTimeout(240_000);

  const threePages = String.raw`\documentclass[10pt]{article}
\usepackage{lipsum}
\begin{document}
\section{One}\lipsum[1-15]
\newpage
\section{Two}\lipsum[1-15]
\newpage
\section{Three}\lipsum[1-10]
\end{document}`;

  await openAndCompile(page, threePages, 'e2e-fidelity-pages');

  const { numPages } = await extractPdfText(await downloadedPdfBytes(page));
  expect(numPages).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(3);

  const indicator = await page.locator('.pdf-page-indicator').first().textContent();
  const total = Number.parseInt((indicator ?? '').split('/')[1]?.trim() ?? '', 10);

  // The viewer's "1 / N" must agree with the artifact, or the preview is
  // showing a different document from the one that was downloaded.
  expect(total, `preview reported "${indicator}"`).toBe(numPages);
});

test('microtype survives into the compiled PDF without silent preamble stripping', async ({
  page,
}) => {
  test.setTimeout(240_000);

  // \textls is defined by microtype. If \usepackage{microtype} were being
  // stripped from the preamble before compilation — which is exactly what
  // optimizeTexForFastWasm() used to do — this document would fail with
  // "Undefined control sequence" and no PDF would be produced at all.
  const microtypeDoc = String.raw`\documentclass[10pt]{article}
\usepackage{microtype}
\begin{document}
\noindent\parbox{135pt}{%
  Microtype character protrusion and font expansion verification paragraph with
  narrow measure so line breaking and horizontal glyph positions reflect microtype.
}

\noindent\textls[200]{MICROTYPEACTIVE}
\end{document}`;

  await openAndCompile(page, microtypeDoc, 'e2e-fidelity-microtype');

  const { numPages, all } = await extractPdfText(await downloadedPdfBytes(page));
  expect(numPages).toBe(1);
  expect(all.replace(/\s+/g, '')).toContain('MICROTYPEACTIVE');
});

test('scrolling a 100-page document does not grow the heap without bound', async ({ page }) => {
  test.setTimeout(360_000);

  const hundredPages = String.raw`\documentclass[10pt]{article}
\begin{document}
${Array.from({ length: 100 }, (_, i) => `Page ${i + 1} content block.\\newpage`).join('\n')}
\end{document}`;

  await openAndCompile(page, hundredPages, 'e2e-fidelity-heap');

  const preview = page.getByRole('document', { name: 'Compiled document preview' });

  const readHeap = () =>
    page.evaluate(() => {
      const mem = (performance as unknown as { memory?: { usedJSHeapSize: number } }).memory;
      return mem ? mem.usedJSHeapSize : 0;
    });

  const heapBefore = await readHeap();

  await preview.evaluate(async (container) => {
    const scrollTarget =
      container.querySelector('.pdf-pages-scroll, .pdf-scroll-container') ?? container;
    const maxScroll = scrollTarget.scrollHeight - scrollTarget.clientHeight;
    const steps = 20;
    for (let s = 1; s <= steps; s++) {
      scrollTarget.scrollTop = Math.floor((maxScroll * s) / steps);
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 60));
    }
  });

  const heapAfter = await readHeap();
  // performance.memory is coarse and GC-dependent, so this is a leak *signal*,
  // not proof. Skipped entirely when the reading is unavailable.
  if (heapBefore > 0 && heapAfter > 0) {
    expect((heapAfter - heapBefore) / 1e6).toBeLessThan(250);
  }
});
````

    expect(cps[0].name).toBe('Snapshot 1');
    expect(cps[0].isAutoSave).toBe(false);

    expect(updated[0].name).toBe('Snapshot 2');

    const loaded = loadProjectCheckpoints('test-proj');
    expect(loaded[0].isAutoSave).toBe(true);
  });

  it('deletes checkpoints properly', async () => {
    const cp = createCheckpoint('test-proj', 'To Delete', 'Author', dummyFiles, false);
    const remaining = await deleteCheckpoint('test-proj', cp.id);
    expect(remaining.some(c => c.id === cp.id)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('detects file modifications for autosave trigger', () => {

      { id: '1', name: 'main.tex', content: 'abc', type: 'tex' },
    ];
    const filesB: ProjectFile[] = [
      { id: '1', name: 'main.tex', content: 'abc', type: 'tex' },
    ];
    const filesC: ProjectFile[] = [
      { id: '1', name: 'main.tex', content: 'abcdef', type: 'tex' },
    ];

    expect(haveFilesChanged(filesA, filesB)).toBe(false);
    expect(haveFilesChanged(filesA, filesC)).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe('Session persistence', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    localStorage.clear();
    sessionStorage.clear();
  });

  it('persists session in localStorage when rememberMe is true', () => {
    const user: UserProfile = {
      id: 'local-abc',
      email: 'local-abc@local.invalid',
      fullName: 'Local Author',
      authProvider: 'local',
    };

    saveSession(user, true);

    const stored = getStoredSession();
    expect(stored.user).not.toBeNull();
    expect(stored.user?.email).toBe('local-abc@local.invalid');
    expect(stored.rememberMe).toBe(true);
    expect(localStorage.getItem('teeex_remember_me')).toBe('true');
  });

  /**
   * The stored session used to carry isAdmin/isApproved behind a checksum whose
   * salt ships in the same bundle, so anyone could mint an admin session from
   * devtools. Privileges are now resolved from the server per session and are
   * never persisted — so even a perfectly-signed record cannot grant them.
   */
  it('never restores privileges from storage, even when asked to', () => {
    const user: UserProfile = {
      id: '1788ae39-7e82-41c3-aaa5-af6d9b5a6184',
      email: 'someone@example.com',
      fullName: 'Someone',
      isAdmin: true,
      isApproved: true,
      authProvider: 'supabase',
    };

    saveSession(user, true);

    const raw = localStorage.getItem('teeex_auth_user') ?? '';
    expect(raw).not.toContain('isAdmin');
    expect(raw).not.toContain('isApproved');

    const stored = getStoredSession();
    expect(stored.user?.email).toBe('someone@example.com');
    expect(stored.user?.isAdmin).toBe(false);
    // A cloud identity is unapproved until the server says otherwise.
    expect(stored.user?.isApproved).toBe(false);
  });

  it('rejects a session record whose contents were edited', () => {
    saveSession(
      {
        id: 'local-xyz',
        email: 'local-xyz@local.invalid',
        fullName: 'Local Author',
        authProvider: 'local',
      },
      true,
    );

    const wrapper = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('teeex_auth_user')!);
    wrapper.user.id = 'someone-elses-id';
    localStorage.setItem('teeex_auth_user', JSON.stringify(wrapper));

    expect(getStoredSession().user).toBeNull();
  });

  it('persists session in sessionStorage when rememberMe is false', () => {
    const user: UserProfile = {
      id: 'local-guest',
      email: 'local-guest@local.invalid',
      fullName: 'Temp User',
      authProvider: 'local',
    };

    saveSession(user, false);

    const stored = getStoredSession();
    expect(stored.user).not.toBeNull();
    expect(stored.rememberMe).toBe(false);
    expect(localStorage.getItem('teeex_auth_user')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('clears session properly upon sign out', () => {
    startLocalWorkspace('Local Author', true);
    expect(getStoredSession().user).not.toBeNull();

    clearSession();
    expect(getStoredSession().user).toBeNull();
    expect(localStorage.getItem('teeex_signed_out')).toBe('true');
  });

  it('creates a local workspace with no privileges and a stable id', () => {
    const first = startLocalWorkspace('Local Author');
    expect(first.user.authProvider).toBe('local');
    expect(first.user.isAdmin).toBe(false);
    expect(isLocalProfile(first.user)).toBe(true);

    // The id is per-browser, so reopening the workspace keeps project ownership.
    const second = startLocalWorkspace('Renamed Author');
    expect(second.user.id).toBe(first.user.id);
    expect(second.user.fullName).toBe('Renamed Author');
  });

  it('treats a cloud identity as not local', () => {
    const supabaseUser: UserProfile = {
      id: '99999999-1111-2222-3333-444444444444',
      email: 'cloud@user.com',
      fullName: 'Cloud User',
      authProvider: 'supabase',
    };
    expect(isLocalProfile(supabaseUser)).toBe(false);
  });
});

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { parseTexLog, unwrapLogLines } from '../../src/services/texLog';

/**
 * Log excerpts here are shaped like real pdfTeX output, including its
 * 79-column wrapping and unbalanced parentheses, because those are precisely
 * the properties that break naive parsers.
 */

describe('unwrapLogLines', () => {
  it('rejoins a message TeX wrapped at the print width', () => {
    const wrapped = `${'a'.repeat(79)}tail`;
    expect(unwrapLogLines(wrapped.replace('tail', '\ntail'))).toEqual([
      `${'a'.repeat(79)}tail`,
    ]);
  });

  it('does not join when the next line starts a new record', () => {
    const log = `${'a'.repeat(79)}\n! Undefined control sequence.`;
    expect(unwrapLogLines(log)).toEqual([
      'a'.repeat(79),
      '! Undefined control sequence.',
    ]);
  });

  it('leaves short lines alone', () => {
    expect(unwrapLogLines('one\ntwo\nthree')).toEqual(['one', 'two', 'three']);
  });

  it('normalises CRLF', () => {
    expect(unwrapLogLines('one\r\ntwo')).toEqual(['one', 'two']);
  });
});

describe('parseTexLog — errors', () => {
  it('extracts message, line and source context', () => {
    const log = [
      'This is pdfTeX, Version 3.141592653',
      '(./main.tex',
      'LaTeX2e <2026-06-01>',
      '! Undefined control sequence.',
      'l.42 \\includegrafics',
      '                    {figure.png}',
      '?',
    ].join('\n');

    const { diagnostics } = parseTexLog(log, { root: 'main.tex' });
    const error = diagnostics.find((d) => d.severity === 'error');

    expect(error).toBeDefined();
    expect(error!.message).toBe('Undefined control sequence.');
    expect(error!.line).toBe(42);
    expect(error!.code).toBe('undefined-control-sequence');
    // The hint must name the actual offending macro, read off the context.
    expect(error!.hint).toContain('\\includegrafics');
  });

  it('classifies a missing .sty as a resolvable package', () => {
    const log = [
      '(./main.tex',
      "! LaTeX Error: File `IEEEtran.cls' not found.",
      'l.1 \\documentclass{IEEEtran}',
    ].join('\n');

    const { diagnostics, missingPackages, missingFiles } = parseTexLog(log);

    // A .cls is not a .sty, so it is reported as a missing file, not a package.
    expect(missingPackages).toEqual([]);
    expect(missingFiles).toContain('IEEEtran.cls');
    expect(diagnostics[0].code).toBe('missing-file');
  });

  it('names the package for a missing .sty', () => {
    const log = "! LaTeX Error: File `xcolor.sty' not found.";
    const { missingPackages, diagnostics } = parseTexLog(log);

    expect(missingPackages).toEqual(['xcolor']);
    expect(diagnostics[0].code).toBe('missing-package');
    expect(diagnostics[0].hint).toContain('xcolor');
  });

  it('distinguishes a missing graphic from a missing package', () => {
    const log = "! LaTeX Error: File `figures/plot.pdf' not found.";
    const { diagnostics, missingFiles } = parseTexLog(log);

    expect(diagnostics[0].code).toBe('missing-graphic');
    expect(diagnostics[0].hint).toContain('includegraphics');
    expect(missingFiles).toEqual(['figures/plot.pdf']);
  });

  it('marks an emergency stop as fatal', () => {
    const log = ['! Emergency stop.', 'l.9 \\end{documnet}'].join('\n');
    const { diagnostics, fatal } = parseTexLog(log);

    expect(fatal).toBe(true);
    expect(diagnostics[0].code).toBe('fatal');
  });

  it('flags a no-output run as fatal even without a bang line', () => {
    const log = '!  ==> Fatal error occurred, no output PDF file produced!';
    expect(parseTexLog(log).fatal).toBe(true);
  });

  it('classifies brace and math delimiter mistakes as syntax', () => {
    for (const message of [
      '! Missing $ inserted.',
      '! Extra }, or forgotten $.',
      '! Missing } inserted.',
      '! Paragraph ended before \\textbf was complete.',
    ]) {
      const { diagnostics } = parseTexLog(message);
      expect(diagnostics[0].code, message).toBe('syntax');
    }
  });
});

describe('parseTexLog — file attribution', () => {

      '(./sections/intro.tex',

    ].join('\n');

    const { diagnostics } = parseTexLog(log, { root: 'main.tex' });

  'tfrupee.tfm',
  'titlesec.sty',
  'wrapfig.sty',
  'xcolor.sty',
]);

export const onRequest: PagesFunction = async (context) => {
  const url = new URL(context.request.url);
  const subpath = url.pathname.replace(/^\/api\/texlive\//, '');

  if (!subpath) {
    return new Response('Not Found', { status: 404 });
  }

  if (context.request.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new Response(null, {
      status: 204,
      headers: {
        'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
        'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'GET, HEAD, OPTIONS',
        'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': '*',
        'Access-Control-Max-Age': '86400',
      },
    });
  }

  // 1. Only serve from local /packages/ if the file is genuinely in BUNDLED_STATIC_FILES
  const filename = decodeURIComponent(subpath.slice(subpath.lastIndexOf('/') + 1));
  if (filename && BUNDLED_STATIC_FILES.has(filename)) {
    try {
      const packageUrl = new URL(`/packages/${encodeURIComponent(filename)}`, url.origin);
      const localRes = await fetch(packageUrl.toString());
      const contentType = localRes.headers.get('content-type') || '';
      if (localRes.ok && localRes.body && !contentType.includes('text/html')) {
        const headers = new Headers(localRes.headers);
        headers.set('Cache-Control', 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable');
        headers.set('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
        headers.set('Access-Control-Expose-Headers', 'fileid, Content-Length');
        headers.set('Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy', 'cross-origin');
        if (
          filename.endsWith('.cls') ||
          filename.endsWith('.sty') ||
          filename.endsWith('.tex') ||
          filename.endsWith('.def') ||
          filename.endsWith('.fd')
        ) {
          headers.set('Content-Type', 'text/plain; charset=utf-8');
        } else if (filename.endsWith('.tfm')) {
          headers.set('Content-Type', 'application/x-tex-tfm');
        }
        return new Response(localRes.body, { headers });
      }
    } catch {
      // Fall through to upstream
    }
  }

  // 2. Fetch from upstream TeX Live server with Cloudflare Edge Cache
  const upstreamBase =
    ((context.env as Record<string, unknown>)?.VITE_TEXLIVE_REMOTE_ENDPOINT as string) ||
    ((context.env as Record<string, unknown>)?.TEXLIVE_REMOTE_ENDPOINT as string) ||
    UPSTREAM_TEXLIVE_BASE;
  const upstreamUrl = `${upstreamBase.replace(/\/+$/, '')}/${subpath}`;

  try {
    const upstreamRes = await fetch(upstreamUrl, {
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8000),
      headers: {
        'User-Agent': 'Teeex-Edge-Proxy/2.0',
        'Accept': '*/*',
      },
      cf: {
        cacheTtl: 31536000,
        cacheEverything: true,
      },
    });

    if (upstreamRes.ok && upstreamRes.body) {
      const headers = new Headers(upstreamRes.headers);
      headers.set('Cache-Control', 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable');
      headers.set('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
      headers.set('Access-Control-Expose-Headers', 'fileid, Content-Length');
      headers.set('Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy', 'cross-origin');

      if (
        subpath.endsWith('.cls') ||
        subpath.endsWith('.sty') ||
        subpath.endsWith('.tex') ||
        subpath.endsWith('.def') ||
        subpath.endsWith('.fd')
      ) {
        headers.set('Content-Type', 'text/plain; charset=utf-8');
      } else if (
        subpath.endsWith('.tfm') ||
        subpath.endsWith('.vf') ||
        subpath.endsWith('.pfb') ||
        subpath.endsWith('.otf') ||
        subpath.endsWith('.ttf')
      ) {
        headers.set('Content-Type', 'application/octet-stream');
      }

      return new Response(upstreamRes.body, {
        status: upstreamRes.status,
        headers,
      });
    }

    if (upstreamRes.status === 404) {
      return new Response('Not Found', {
        status: 404,
        headers: {
          'Cache-Control': 'public, max-age=86400',
          'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
        },
      });
    }

    return new Response(`Upstream error: ${upstreamRes.statusText}`, {
      status: upstreamRes.status,
      headers: {
        'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
      },
    });
  } catch (err) {
    return new Response(`Proxy error: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)}`, {
      status: 502,
      headers: {
        'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
      },
    });
  }
};

self.onerror = function (message, source, lineno, colno, error) {
    try {
        self.postMessage({
            exception: `Worker Error: ${message} (${source || 'busytex_worker.js'}:${lineno || 0}:${colno || 0})` +
                (error?.stack ? `\nStack:\n${error.stack}` : '')
        });
    } catch (_) {}
    return true;
};

self.onunhandledrejection = function (event) {
    try {
        const reason = event.reason;
        const msg = reason instanceof Error ? (reason.stack || reason.message) : String(reason);
        self.postMessage({ exception: `Worker Unhandled Rejection: ${msg}` });
    } catch (_) {}
};

importScripts('busytex_biber.js');
importScripts('busytex_pipeline.js');

self._newlyFetchedRemoteFiles = [];
self._newlyFetchedRemoteMisses = [];

(function installFastXhrInterceptor() {
    if (typeof XMLHttpRequest === 'undefined') return;

    const xhrMemoryCache = new Map();
    const IMAGE_OR_AUX_EXT = /\.(?:jpe?g|png|gif|webp|svg|eps|bmp|aux|toc|lof|lot|bbl|out|log)$/i;

    const origOpen = XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open;
    const origSend = XMLHttpRequest.prototype.send;
    const origGetResponseHeader = XMLHttpRequest.prototype.getResponseHeader;

    XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open = function (method, url, async, user, password) {
        this._teeexUrl = typeof url === 'string' ? url : String(url);
        this._teeexMethod = method;
        this._teeexShortCircuit = null;

        if (this._teeexUrl.includes('/api/texlive/') || this._teeexUrl.includes('texlive2026.texlyre.org')) {
            if (IMAGE_OR_AUX_EXT.test(this._teeexUrl)) {
                this._teeexShortCircuit = { status: 404, buffer: new ArrayBuffer(0), text: '', headers: {} };
                return;
            }
            const cached = xhrMemoryCache.get(this._teeexUrl);
            if (cached) {
                this._teeexShortCircuit = cached;
                return;
            }
        }

        return origOpen.call(this, method, url, async !== false, user, password);
    };

    XMLHttpRequest.prototype.getResponseHeader = function (name) {
        if (this._teeexShortCircuit) {
            return this._teeexShortCircuit.headers[name.toLowerCase()] || null;
        }
        return origGetResponseHeader.call(this, name);
    };

    XMLHttpRequest.prototype.send = function (body) {
        if (this._teeexShortCircuit) {
            const hit = this._teeexShortCircuit;
            Object.defineProperty(this, 'status', { value: hit.status, configurable: true });
            Object.defineProperty(this, 'readyState', { value: 4, configurable: true });
            Object.defineProperty(this, 'response', { value: this.responseType === 'arraybuffer' ? hit.buffer : hit.text, configurable: true });
            Object.defineProperty(this, 'responseText', { value: hit.text, configurable: true });
            if (typeof this.onload === 'function') this.onload();
            if (typeof this.onreadystatechange === 'function') this.onreadystatechange();
            return;
        }

        if (this._teeexUrl && (this._teeexUrl.includes('/api/texlive/') || this._teeexUrl.includes('texlive2026.texlyre.org'))) {
            origOpen.call(this, this._teeexMethod || 'GET', this._teeexUrl, false);
        }

        origSend.call(this, body);

        if (this._teeexUrl && (this._teeexUrl.includes('/api/texlive/') || this._teeexUrl.includes('texlive2026.texlyre.org'))) {
            if (this.status === 200 || this.status === 404) {
                let buf = new ArrayBuffer(0);
                let txt = '';
                try {
                    if (this.response instanceof ArrayBuffer) {
                        buf = this.response.slice(0);
                    } else if (typeof this.responseText === 'string') {
                        txt = this.responseText;
                        buf = new TextEncoder().encode(txt).buffer;
                    }
                } catch { }
                xhrMemoryCache.set(this._teeexUrl, {
                    status: this.status,
                    buffer: buf,
                    text: txt,
                    headers: {
                        'fileid': origGetResponseHeader.call(this, 'fileid') || '',
                        'content-type': origGetResponseHeader.call(this, 'content-type') || 'application/octet-stream',
                    },
                });

                // Extract format & filename so BusytexPipeline bakes it into C++ kpathsea RAM
                const m = this._teeexUrl.match(/\/(\d+)\/([^/?#]+)$/);
                if (m) {
                    const fmt = Number(m[1]);
                    const fname = decodeURIComponent(m[2]);
                    if (this.status === 200 && buf.byteLength > 0) {
                        self._newlyFetchedRemoteFiles.push({
                            name: fname,
                            format: fmt,
                            bytes: new Uint8Array(buf),
                        });
                    } else if (this.status === 404) {
                        self._newlyFetchedRemoteMisses.push(`${fmt}/${fname}`);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    };
})();

self.pipeline = null;

onmessage = async ({ data: { files, main_tex_path, bibtex, biber, makeindex, rerun, busytex_wasm, busytex_js, biber_js, biber_wasm, biber_data, preload_data_packages_js, data_packages_js, texmf_local, preload, verbose, driver, remote_endpoint, shell_escape, clean, load_shell_handler_script, read_project_files, write_texlive_remote_files, write_texlive_remote_misses } }) => {
    if (busytex_wasm && busytex_js && preload_data_packages_js) {
        try {
            self.pipeline = new BusytexPipeline(
                busytex_js,
                busytex_wasm,
                data_packages_js,
                preload_data_packages_js,
                texmf_local,
                msg => postMessage({ print: msg }),
                applet_versions => postMessage({ initialized: applet_versions }),
                preload,
                BusytexPipeline.ScriptLoaderWorker,
                biber_js,
                biber_wasm,
                biber_data
            );
        } catch (err) {
            postMessage({ exception: 'Exception during initialization: ' + err.toString() + '\nStack:\n' + err.stack });
        }
    } else if (load_shell_handler_script) {
        try {
            importScripts(load_shell_handler_script);
            if (self.handler_ready) await self.handler_ready;
            postMessage({ shell_handler_script_loaded: load_shell_handler_script });
        } catch (err) {
            postMessage({ exception: 'Exception loading shell handler script: ' + err.toString() + '\nStack:\n' + err.stack });
        }
    } else if (read_project_files && self.pipeline) {
        try {
            postMessage({ project_files: await self.pipeline.read_project_files(read_project_files.dir || null) });
        } catch (err) {
            postMessage({ exception: 'Exception reading project files: ' + err.toString() + '\nStack:\n' + err.stack });
        }
    } else if (write_texlive_remote_files && self.pipeline) {
        try {
            await self.pipeline.write_texlive_remote_files(write_texlive_remote_files);
            postMessage({ texlive_remote_written: true });
        } catch (err) {
            postMessage({ exception: 'Exception writing remote files: ' + err.toString() + '\nStack:\n' + err.stack });
        }
    } else if (write_texlive_remote_misses && self.pipeline) {
        try {
            await self.pipeline.write_texlive_remote_misses(write_texlive_remote_misses);
            postMessage({ texlive_remote_misses_written: true });
        } catch (err) {
            postMessage({ exception: 'Exception writing remote misses: ' + err.toString() + '\nStack:\n' + err.stack });
        }
    } else if (files && self.pipeline) {
        try {
            const result = await self.pipeline.compile(
                files,
                main_tex_path,
                bibtex,
                biber,
                makeindex,
                rerun,
                verbose,
                driver,
                data_packages_js,
                remote_endpoint,
                shell_escape === true,
                clean === true
            );

            const transferables = [];
            if (result.pdf && result.pdf.buffer && result.pdf.byteLength > 0) {
                transferables.push(result.pdf.buffer);
            }
            if (result.synctex && result.synctex.buffer && result.synctex.byteLength > 0) {
                transferables.push(result.synctex.buffer);
            }

            postMessage(result, transferables);
        } catch (err) {
            postMessage({ exception: 'Exception during compilation: ' + err.toString() + '\nStack:\n' + err.stack });
        }
    }
};

    onForwardSync,
    isTwoColumn,
    onToggleTwoColumn,
    theme,
    onToggleTheme,
    onExportPdf,
    onExportZip,
    onOpenWordCount,
    onOpenHistory,
    onOpenTableBuilder,
    onOpenSymbols,
    onOpenProjectsHub,
    projects,
    activeProjectId,
    onSelectProject,
    activeFormat,
    onSelectFormat,
    files,
    onSelectFile,
    sections,
    onJumpToLine,
    onClose,
  ]);

  // Filter commands by search query and prefix modes
  const filteredCommands = useMemo(() => {
    const raw = query.trim();
    if (!raw) return allCommands;

    let targetCategory: string | null = null;
    let searchTerm = raw.toLowerCase();

    if (raw.startsWith('@')) {
      targetCategory = 'Sections';
      searchTerm = raw.slice(1).trim().toLowerCase();
    } else if (raw.startsWith('#')) {
      targetCategory = 'Academic Formats';
      searchTerm = raw.slice(1).trim().toLowerCase();
    } else if (raw.startsWith('>')) {
      targetCategory = 'Commands';
      searchTerm = raw.slice(1).trim().toLowerCase();
    } else if (raw.toLowerCase().startsWith('p:')) {
      targetCategory = 'Projects';
      searchTerm = raw.slice(2).trim().toLowerCase();
    } else if (raw.toLowerCase().startsWith('f:')) {
      targetCategory = 'Files';
      searchTerm = raw.slice(2).trim().toLowerCase();
    }

    return allCommands.filter(c => {
      if (targetCategory && c.category !== targetCategory) {
        return false;
      }
      if (!searchTerm) return true;
      return (
        c.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm) ||
        (c.subtitle && c.subtitle.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm)) ||
        c.category.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm)
      );
    });
  }, [allCommands, query]);

  // Reset selectedIndex when filter changes
  useEffect(() => {
    setSelectedIndex(0);
  }, [filteredCommands.length, query]);

  // Auto-scroll the active option into view when selectedIndex changes
  useEffect(() => {
    const current = filteredCommands[selectedIndex];
    if (current) {
      const el = document.getElementById(`cmd-opt-${current.id}`);
      if (el) {
        el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
      }
    }
  }, [selectedIndex, filteredCommands]);

  // Keyboard navigation inside Combobox
  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setSelectedIndex(prev => (prev + 1) % Math.max(1, filteredCommands.length));
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setSelectedIndex(prev => (prev - 1 + filteredCommands.length) % Math.max(1, filteredCommands.length));
    } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      const current = filteredCommands[selectedIndex];
      if (current) current.onExecute();
    } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      e.preventDefault();
      onClose();
    }
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const activeOptionId = filteredCommands[selectedIndex]
    ? `cmd-opt-${filteredCommands[selectedIndex].id}`
    : undefined;

  return (
    <div
      onClick={onClose}
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-label="Universal Command Palette"
      style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        inset: 0,
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(10px)',
        zIndex: 2000,
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'flex-start',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        paddingTop: '12vh',
      }}
    >
      <div
        onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}
        style={{
          width: 580,
          maxHeight: 460,
          backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-surface-0)',
          border: '1px solid var(--border-medium)',
          borderRadius: 'var(--radius-md)',
          boxShadow: '0 24px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65)',
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          overflow: 'hidden',
          animation: 'modalSlideUp 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)',
        }}
      >
        {/* Search Input Bar (Combobox Pattern) */}
        <div style={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          gap: 10,
          padding: '12px 14px',
          borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)',
          backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-surface-1)',
        }}>
          <Search size={15} color="#38bdf8" aria-hidden="true" />
          <input
            ref={inputRef}
            autoFocus
            type="text"
            role="combobox"
            aria-label="Command Palette Search"
            aria-expanded={isOpen}
            aria-haspopup="listbox"
            aria-autocomplete="list"
            aria-controls="command-palette-listbox"
            aria-activedescendant={activeOptionId}
            value={query}
            onChange={e => setQuery(e.target.value)}
            onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
            placeholder="Type a command, or prefix with @ (sections), # (formats), > (commands), p: (files)..."
            style={{
              flex: 1,
              border: 'none',
              outline: 'none',
              backgroundColor: 'transparent',
              color: 'var(--text-primary)',
              fontSize: 13,
              fontWeight: 500,
            }}
          />
          <kbd style={{
            fontSize: 9.5,
            fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)',
            padding: '2px 5px',
            borderRadius: 4,
            backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-surface-0)',
            border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)',
            color: 'var(--text-muted)',
          }}>
            ESC
          </kbd>
        </div>

        {/* Live Status Announcer for Screen Readers */}
        <div
          aria-live="polite"
          aria-atomic="true"
          style={{
            position: 'absolute',
            width: 1,
            height: 1,
            padding: 0,
            margin: -1,
            overflow: 'hidden',
            clip: 'rect(0, 0, 0, 0)',
            whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
            border: 0,
          }}
        >
          {filteredCommands.length} commands available
        </div>

        {/* Results Listbox */}
        <div
          id="command-palette-listbox"
          ref={listRef}
          role="listbox"
          aria-label="Command suggestions"
          style={{
            flex: 1,
            overflowY: 'auto',
            padding: '6px 6px',
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column',
            gap: 2,
          }}
        >
          {filteredCommands.length === 0 ? (
            <div style={{ padding: '32px 16px', textAlign: 'center', color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontSize: 12 }}>
              No commands or files matching &ldquo;{query}&rdquo;
            </div>
          ) : (
            filteredCommands.map((item, idx) => {
              const isSelected = idx === selectedIndex;
              return (
                <div
                  key={item.id}
                  id={`cmd-opt-${item.id}`}
                  role="option"
                  aria-selected={isSelected}
                  onClick={item.onExecute}
                  onMouseEnter={() => setSelectedIndex(idx)}
                  style={{
                    padding: '8px 10px',
                    borderRadius: 5,
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'space-between',
                    backgroundColor: isSelected ? 'var(--bg-active)' : 'transparent',
                    borderLeft: isSelected ? '2px solid #38bdf8' : '2px solid transparent',
                    transition: 'background 0.08s ease',
                  }}
                >
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
                    <div style={{
                      width: 24,
                      height: 24,
                      borderRadius: 4,
                      backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-surface-1)',
                      display: 'flex',
                      alignItems: 'center',
                      justifyContent: 'center',
                      flexShrink: 0,
                    }}>
                      {item.icon}
                    </div>

                    <div style={{ overflow: 'hidden' }}>
                      <div style={{
                        fontSize: 12,
                        fontWeight: isSelected ? 600 : 500,
                        color: isSelected ? '#38bdf8' : 'var(--text-primary)',
                        overflow: 'hidden',
                        textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                        whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                      }}>
                        {item.title}
                      </div>
                      {item.subtitle && (
                        <div style={{
                          fontSize: 10,
                          color: 'var(--text-muted)',
                          overflow: 'hidden',
                          textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                          whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                        }}>
                          {item.subtitle}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {item.shortcut ? (
                    <kbd style={{
                      fontSize: 9.5,
                      fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)',
                      padding: '2px 5px',
                      borderRadius: 4,
                      backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-surface-1)',
                      border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)',
                      color: 'var(--text-muted)',
                      flexShrink: 0,
                    }}>
                      {item.shortcut}
                    </kbd>
                  ) : (
                    <span style={{
                      fontSize: 9,
                      color: 'var(--text-muted)',
                      letterSpacing: '0.04em',
                      textTransform: 'uppercase',
                      padding: '1px 5px',
                      borderRadius: 3,
                      backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-surface-1)',
                      flexShrink: 0,
                    }}>
                      {item.category}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Footer Navigation Hints */}
        <div style={{
          padding: '6px 12px',
          borderTop: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)',
          backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-surface-1)',
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          fontSize: 10,
          color: 'var(--text-muted)',
        }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
            <span><kbd>↑</kbd> <kbd>↓</kbd> Navigate</span>
            <span><kbd>↵</kbd> Select</span>
            <span><kbd>ESC</kbd> Close</span>
            <span style={{ opacity: 0.4 }}>|</span>
            <span><kbd>p:</kbd> Projects</span>
            <span><kbd>f:</kbd> Files</span>
            <span><kbd>&gt;</kbd> Commands</span>
            <span><kbd>@</kbd> Headings</span>
          </div>
          <span>{filteredCommands.length} actions</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default CommandPaletteModal;
