## File: src/components/modals/ShareModal.tsx
````typescript
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import {
  Users,
  Copy,
  Check,
  X,
  Mail,
  UserPlus,
  Shield,
  Edit3,
  Eye,
  Trash2,
  Lock,
  Key,
  RefreshCw,
  ShieldOff,
  Clock
} from 'lucide-react';
import type { Collaborator, ProjectMember, ProjectRole, UserProfile } from '../../types/latex';
import {
  getRoomShareTokens,
  rotateRoomShareTokens,
  revokeRoomShareTokens,
  syncRoomShareTokensToCloud,
  type RoomShareTokens,
} from '../../services/shareSecurityService';

interface Props {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  roomId: string;
  peers: Collaborator[];
  selfUser: Collaborator;
  currentUser?: UserProfile | null;
  projectMembers?: ProjectMember[];
  onInviteMember?: (email: string, role: ProjectRole) => void;
  onUpdateMemberRole?: (memberId: string, newRole: ProjectRole) => void;
  onRemoveMember?: (memberId: string) => void;
  currentRole?: ProjectRole;
}

export const ShareModal: React.FC<Props> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  roomId,
  peers,
  selfUser,
  currentUser,
  projectMembers = [],
  onInviteMember,
  onUpdateMemberRole,
  onRemoveMember,
  currentRole = 'owner',
}) => {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const [linkRole, setLinkRole] = useState<'editor' | 'viewer'>('editor');
  const [inviteEmail, setInviteEmail] = useState('');
  const [inviteRole, setInviteRole] = useState<ProjectRole>('editor');
  const [inviteFeedback, setInviteFeedback] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [tokensState, setTokensState] = useState<RoomShareTokens>(() => getRoomShareTokens(roomId));
  const [expiresInDays, setExpiresInDays] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [actionFeedback, setActionFeedback] = useState<{ message: string; type: 'success' | 'warn' } | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen && currentRole === 'owner') {
      syncRoomShareTokensToCloud(roomId, tokensState).catch(() => {});
    }
  }, [isOpen, roomId, currentRole, tokensState]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const activeKey = linkRole === 'editor' ? tokensState.editToken : tokensState.viewToken;
  const currentUrl = tokensState.isRevoked
    ? 'Access Revoked (Generate new keys below to re-enable sharing)'
    : `${window.location.origin}${window.location.pathname}?room=${encodeURIComponent(roomId)}&key=${activeKey}`;

  const handleCopy = () => {
    if (tokensState.isRevoked) return;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(currentUrl);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  const handleRotateKeys = () => {
    const rotated = rotateRoomShareTokens(roomId, expiresInDays);
    setTokensState(rotated);
    syncRoomShareTokensToCloud(roomId, rotated).catch(() => {});
    setActionFeedback({
      message: 'Fresh secret keys generated! All previously shared links have been invalidated.',
      type: 'success',
    });
    setTimeout(() => setActionFeedback(null), 4000);
  };

  const handleRevokeKeys = () => {
    revokeRoomShareTokens(roomId);
    const updated = { ...tokensState, isRevoked: true };
    setTokensState(updated);
    syncRoomShareTokensToCloud(roomId, updated).catch(() => {});
    setActionFeedback({
      message: 'All links revoked. Room is now strictly private.',
      type: 'warn',
    });
    setTimeout(() => setActionFeedback(null), 4000);
  };

  const handleSendInvite = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!inviteEmail.trim()) return;

    if (onInviteMember) {
      onInviteMember(inviteEmail.trim(), inviteRole);
    }
    setInviteFeedback(`Invited ${inviteEmail.trim()} as ${inviteRole}.`);
    setInviteEmail('');
    setTimeout(() => setInviteFeedback(null), 3000);
  };

  const getRoleIcon = (role: ProjectRole) => {
    switch (role) {
      case 'owner': return <Shield size={11} color="#38bdf8" />;
      case 'editor': return <Edit3 size={11} color="#10b981" />;
      case 'viewer': return <Eye size={11} color="#f59e0b" />;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div style={backdropStyle} onClick={onClose}>
      <div style={modalStyle} onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
        {/* Header */}
        <div style={headerStyle}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
            <Users size={18} color="#38bdf8" />
            <h2 style={{ fontSize: 16, fontWeight: 700, margin: 0 }}>Collaboration &amp; Permissions</h2>
          </div>
          <button onClick={onClose} style={closeBtnStyle}>
            <X size={18} />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Content */}
        <div style={{ padding: 20, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 16, maxHeight: '78vh', overflowY: 'auto' }}>
          {/* Share Link Box with Role Picker */}
          <div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 6 }}>
              <label style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
                SHAREABLE ROOM LINK
              </label>

              {/* Permission Toggle */}
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-surface-0)', padding: '2px 4px', borderRadius: 'var(--radius-xs)', border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)' }}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setLinkRole('editor')}
                  style={{
                    ...roleToggleBtnStyle,
                    backgroundColor: linkRole === 'editor' ? 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15)' : 'transparent',
                    color: linkRole === 'editor' ? '#38bdf8' : 'var(--text-muted)',
                  }}
                >
                  <Edit3 size={11} /> Can Edit
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setLinkRole('viewer')}
                  style={{
                    ...roleToggleBtnStyle,
                    backgroundColor: linkRole === 'viewer' ? 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15)' : 'transparent',
                    color: linkRole === 'viewer' ? '#f59e0b' : 'var(--text-muted)',
                  }}
                >
                  <Eye size={11} /> View Only
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
              <input
                type="text"
                readOnly
                value={currentUrl}
                style={{
                  flex: 1,
                  padding: '8px 12px',
                  fontSize: 12,
                  fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)',
                  color: linkRole === 'viewer' ? '#f59e0b' : '#38bdf8',
                  backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-surface-0)',
                }}
              />
              <button
                onClick={handleCopy}
                className="btn-primary"
                style={{ minWidth: 100, fontSize: 12 }}
              >
                {copied ? <><Check size={14} /> Copied!</> : <><Copy size={14} /> Copy</>}
              </button>
            </div>
            <div style={{
              fontSize: 11,
              marginTop: 6,
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              gap: 6,
              color: linkRole === 'viewer' ? '#f59e0b' : '#38bdf8',
              backgroundColor: linkRole === 'viewer' ? 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.08)' : 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.08)',
              padding: '6px 10px',
              borderRadius: 'var(--radius-xs)',
              border: `1px solid ${linkRole === 'viewer' ? 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.2)' : 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.2)'}`,
            }}>
              {linkRole === 'viewer' ? <Lock size={12} /> : <Key size={12} />}
              <span>
                {tokensState.isRevoked
                  ? 'All capability keys revoked. Collaborators cannot access this room until keys are regenerated.'
                  : linkRole === 'viewer'
                  ? 'Cryptographically sealed view link (vw_...). Viewers cannot elevate to edit access by altering query parameters.'
                  : 'Authoritative edit capability key (ed_...). Anyone with this link has real-time co-authoring & editing privileges.'}
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Key Rotation & Expiration Controls Strip */}
            <div style={{
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'space-between',
              marginTop: 10,
              paddingTop: 8,
              borderTop: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)',
              fontSize: 11,
            }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
                <Clock size={12} />
                <span>Link Expiration:</span>
                <select
                  value={expiresInDays === null ? 'never' : expiresInDays}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    const val = e.target.value;
                    const days = val === 'never' ? null : parseInt(val, 10);
                    setExpiresInDays(days);
                    const rotated = rotateRoomShareTokens(roomId, days);
                    setTokensState(rotated);
                    setActionFeedback({
                      message: days ? `Expiration set to ${days} days.` : 'Expiration set to Never (permanent).',
                      type: 'success',
                    });
                    setTimeout(() => setActionFeedback(null), 3000);
                  }}
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-surface-0)',
                    border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)',
                    borderRadius: 'var(--radius-xs)',
                    color: 'var(--text-primary)',
                    fontSize: 11,
                    padding: '2px 6px',
                    outline: 'none',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                  }}
                >
                  <option value="never">Never (Permanent)</option>
                  <option value="7">7 Days</option>
                  <option value="30">30 Days</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleRotateKeys}
                  className="btn-ghost"
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 11,
                    padding: '3px 8px',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    gap: 4,
                    color: '#38bdf8',
                  }}
                  title="Generate new capability keys and invalidate previously shared links"
                >
                  <RefreshCw size={11} /> Rotate Keys
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleRevokeKeys}
                  className="btn-ghost"
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 11,
                    padding: '3px 8px',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    gap: 4,
                    color: '#f43f5e',
                  }}
                  title="Revoke all active links immediately"
                >
                  <ShieldOff size={11} /> Revoke Links
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {actionFeedback && (
              <div style={{
                marginTop: 6,
                fontSize: 11,
                padding: '4px 8px',
                borderRadius: 'var(--radius-xs)',
                backgroundColor: actionFeedback.type === 'success' ? 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12)' : 'rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.12)',
                color: actionFeedback.type === 'success' ? '#10b981' : '#f43f5e',
                border: `1px solid ${actionFeedback.type === 'success' ? 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.25)' : 'rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.25)'}`,
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 5,
              }}>
                <Check size={12} />
                <span>{actionFeedback.message}</span>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Email Invite Box (For Owners & Editors) */}
          {currentRole !== 'viewer' && (
            <form onSubmit={handleSendInvite} style={inviteBoxStyle}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, marginBottom: 8 }}>
                <UserPlus size={14} color="#38bdf8" />
                <span style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                  Invite Collaborator by Email
                </span>
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
                <div style={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-surface-1)', border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)', borderRadius: 'var(--radius-sm)' }}>
                  <Mail size={13} color="var(--text-muted)" style={{ marginLeft: 8 }} />
                  <input
                    type="email"
                    required
                    placeholder="colleague@institution.edu"
                    value={inviteEmail}
                    onChange={e => setInviteEmail(e.target.value)}
                    style={{ flex: 1, padding: '7px 10px', fontSize: 12, background: 'transparent', border: 'none', color: 'var(--text-primary)', outline: 'none' }}
                  />
                </div>

                <select
                  value={inviteRole}
                  onChange={e => setInviteRole(e.target.value as ProjectRole)}
                  style={roleSelectStyle}
                >
                  <option value="editor">Editor (Can edit)</option>
                  <option value="viewer">Viewer (Read-only)</option>
                </select>

                <button type="submit" className="btn-primary" style={{ fontSize: 12, padding: '6px 12px' }}>
                  Invite
                </button>
              </div>

              {inviteFeedback && (
                <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#10b981', marginTop: 6, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
                  <Check size={12} /> {inviteFeedback}
                </div>
              )}
            </form>
          )}

          {/* Project Members & Roles List */}
          <div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 8 }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
                PROJECT MEMBERS &amp; ROLES ({projectMembers.length > 0 ? projectMembers.length : peers.length + 1})
              </span>
              <span className="badge badge-emerald">
                <span style={{ width: 6, height: 6, borderRadius: '50%', backgroundColor: '#10b981', display: 'inline-block' }} />
                Live Sync
              </span>
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6 }}>
              {projectMembers.length > 0 ? (
                projectMembers.map(m => {
                  const isCurrentSelf = Boolean(
                    (currentUser?.email && m.email?.toLowerCase() === currentUser.email.toLowerCase()) ||
                    (selfUser?.name && m.email?.toLowerCase() === selfUser.name.toLowerCase()) ||
                    (selfUser?.id && m.id === selfUser.id)
                  );
                  const displayName = (isCurrentSelf && currentUser?.fullName)
                    ? currentUser.fullName
                    : m.name;
                  const displayAvatar = (isCurrentSelf && currentUser?.fullName)
                    ? currentUser.fullName.substring(0, 2).toUpperCase()
                    : (m.avatar || displayName.substring(0, 2).toUpperCase());
                  const avatarColor = (isCurrentSelf && currentUser?.avatarColor)
                    ? currentUser.avatarColor
                    : m.avatarColor;

                  return (
                    <div key={m.id} style={peerItemStyle}>
                      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
                        <div style={{ ...avatarStyle, backgroundColor: avatarColor }}>
                          {displayAvatar}
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <div style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                            {displayName} {isCurrentSelf && <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontWeight: 400 }}>(You)</span>}
                          </div>
                          <div style={{ fontSize: 10.5, color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>{m.email}</div>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                      {currentRole === 'owner' && m.role !== 'owner' && onUpdateMemberRole ? (
                        <select
                          value={m.role}
                          onChange={e => onUpdateMemberRole(m.id, e.target.value as ProjectRole)}
                          style={{ ...roleSelectStyle, padding: '3px 6px', fontSize: 11 }}
                        >
                          <option value="editor">Editor</option>
                          <option value="viewer">Viewer</option>
                        </select>
                      ) : (
                        <span className={`badge ${m.role === 'owner' ? 'badge-cyan' : m.role === 'editor' ? 'badge-emerald' : ''}`} style={{ fontSize: 10.5, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
                          {getRoleIcon(m.role)}
                          {m.role === 'owner' ? 'Host' : m.role}
                        </span>
                      )}

                      {currentRole === 'owner' && m.role !== 'owner' && onRemoveMember && (
                        <button
                          onClick={() => onRemoveMember(m.id)}
                          className="btn-ghost"
                          style={{ padding: 4, color: '#f43f5e' }}
                          title="Remove collaborator"
                        >
                          <Trash2 size={12} />
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })
            ) : (
                /* Fallback to peer list */
                <>
                  <div style={peerItemStyle}>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
                      <div style={{ ...avatarStyle, backgroundColor: selfUser.color }}>
                        {selfUser.avatar}
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                          {selfUser.name} <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontWeight: 400 }}>(You)</span>
                        </div>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>Editing {selfUser.activeFile}</div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <span className="badge badge-cyan">Host</span>
                  </div>

                  {peers.map(p => (
                    <div key={p.id} style={peerItemStyle}>
                      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
                        <div style={{ ...avatarStyle, backgroundColor: p.color }}>
                          {p.avatar}
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <div style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>{p.name}</div>
                          <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
                            Line {p.cursorLine} &bull; {p.status === 'typing' ? 'Typing...' : 'Viewing'}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <span className="badge badge-emerald">Editor</span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div style={{ padding: '12px 20px', borderTop: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)', display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-surface-0)' }}>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="btn-secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
            Done
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

const backdropStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
````

````typescript
import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  X,
  GitCommit,
  GitBranch,
  Check,
  Columns,
  AlignLeft,
  Trash2,
  RefreshCw,
  UploadCloud,
  DownloadCloud,
  Clock,
  ShieldAlert,
  ArrowRight,
  Download,
  Search,
  Undo2,
  Copy,
  FileText,
  ChevronDown,
  Plus,
} from 'lucide-react';
import type { ProjectFile } from '../../types/latex';
import {
  computeLineDiff,
  computeProjectFileDiffs,
  type DiffResult,
  type FileDiffSummary,
} from '../../services/diffService';
import {
  getProjectBranches,
  getActiveBranch,
  setActiveBranch,
  createBranch,
  type Checkpoint,
  type WorkingTreeStatus,
} from '../../services/checkpointsService';
import { readEmergencyDraft, type RecoveredDraftInfo } from '../../hooks/useAutosaveRecovery';

export type { Checkpoint };

interface Props {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  checkpoints: Checkpoint[];
  currentFiles: ProjectFile[];
  workingTreeStatus?: WorkingTreeStatus;
  activeBranch?: string;
  branches?: string[];
  onSwitchBranch?: (branchName: string, checkoutHead?: boolean) => void;
  onCreateBranch?: (branchName: string) => void;
  onDeleteBranch?: (branchName: string) => void;
  onCreateCommit?: (message: string, description?: string) => void;
  onCreateCheckpoint: (name: string) => void;
  onRestoreCheckpoint: (checkpoint: Checkpoint) => void;
  onRestoreSingleFile?: (file: ProjectFile) => void;
  onDeleteCheckpoint?: (checkpointId: string) => void;
  onPushCommits?: () => Promise<void>;
  onPullCommits?: () => Promise<void>;
  onSyncCloud?: () => void;
  isCloudConnected?: boolean;
  activeProjectId?: string;
}

const ROW_HEIGHT = 22;
const OVERSCAN = 15;

export const VersionHistoryModal: React.FC<Props> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  checkpoints = [],
  currentFiles = [],
  workingTreeStatus,
  activeBranch,
  branches,
  onSwitchBranch,
  onCreateBranch,
  onDeleteBranch,
  onCreateCommit,
  onCreateCheckpoint,
  onRestoreCheckpoint,
  onRestoreSingleFile,
  onDeleteCheckpoint,
  onPushCommits,
  onPullCommits,
  onSyncCloud,
  isCloudConnected = false,
  activeProjectId = '',
}) => {
  const safeCheckpoints = useMemo(() => checkpoints || [], [checkpoints]);
  const safeCurrentFiles = useMemo(() => currentFiles || [], [currentFiles]);
  const headCommit = safeCheckpoints[0] || null;

  // Branch management
  const effectiveActiveBranch = activeBranch || getActiveBranch(activeProjectId) || 'main';
  const safeBranches = branches || getProjectBranches(activeProjectId) || ['main'];
  const [isBranchPopoverOpen, setIsBranchPopoverOpen] = useState(false);
  const [branchSearchQuery, setBranchSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [branchFilter, setBranchFilter] = useState<'all' | 'current'>('all');

  // Derive working tree if not passed
  const isWorkingClean = workingTreeStatus
    ? workingTreeStatus.isClean
    : safeCheckpoints.length > 0 &&
      safeCheckpoints[0].files.length === safeCurrentFiles.length &&
      safeCurrentFiles.every(f => {
        const matched = safeCheckpoints[0].files.find(cf => cf.name === f.name);
        return matched && matched.content === f.content;
      });

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'changes' | 'commits' | 'drafts'>(() => {
    return !isWorkingClean ? 'changes' : 'commits';
  });

  const [inspectingWorkingTree, setInspectingWorkingTree] = useState<boolean>(!isWorkingClean);
  const [selectedCheckpointId, setSelectedCheckpointId] = useState<string>(
    safeCheckpoints.length > 0 ? safeCheckpoints[0].id : ''
  );

  // View mode: 'diff' (what changed) vs 'snapshot' (full older version file reader)
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState<'diff' | 'snapshot'>('diff');
  // Diff sub-mode: 'unified' vs 'split'
  const [diffMode, setDiffMode] = useState<'split' | 'unified'>('unified');
  // Comparison target: 'parent' (compare commit to parent) vs 'current' (compare commit to current working tree)
  const [comparisonTarget, setComparisonTarget] = useState<'parent' | 'current'>('parent');

  const [selectedFileName, setSelectedFileName] = useState<string>(() => {
    return safeCurrentFiles.find(f => f.name.endsWith('.tex'))?.name || safeCurrentFiles[0]?.name || 'main.tex';
  });

  // Commit form
  const [commitMessage, setCommitMessage] = useState('');
  const [commitDescription, setCommitDescription] = useState('');
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [isSyncing, setIsSyncing] = useState(false);
  const [restoredToast, setRestoredToast] = useState<'commit' | 'file' | 'draft' | null>(null);
  const [copiedSha, setCopiedSha] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [copiedCode, setCopiedCode] = useState(false);

  // Virtualization Scroll & Viewport Measurement
  const virtualViewportRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [scrollTop, setScrollTop] = useState(0);
  const [viewportHeight, setViewportHeight] = useState(600);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = virtualViewportRef.current;
    if (!el) return;

    const onScroll = () => {
      setScrollTop(el.scrollTop);
    };
    const onResize = () => {
      setViewportHeight(el.clientHeight);
    };

    onResize();
    el.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('resize', onResize);

    return () => {
      el.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);
      window.removeEventListener('resize', onResize);
    };
  }, [viewMode, diffMode, selectedFileName]);

  // Emergency crash draft
  const [emergencyDraft, setEmergencyDraft] = useState<RecoveredDraftInfo | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen && activeProjectId) {
      setEmergencyDraft(readEmergencyDraft(activeProjectId));
    }
  }, [isOpen, activeProjectId]);

  // Selected commit resolution
  const selectedCheckpoint = safeCheckpoints.find(c => c.id === selectedCheckpointId) || safeCheckpoints[0] || null;

  // Determine comparison snapshots
  const comparison = useMemo(() => {
    if (inspectingWorkingTree) {
      const oldFiles = headCommit ? headCommit.files : [];
      const newFiles = safeCurrentFiles;
      return {
        oldFiles,
        newFiles,
        labelOld: headCommit ? `HEAD (${headCommit.shortSha || 'head'})` : 'Initial',
        labelNew: 'Working Tree (Uncommitted)',
        isRootBaseline: false,
      };
    }

    if (!selectedCheckpoint) {
      return {
        oldFiles: [],
        newFiles: safeCurrentFiles,
        labelOld: 'Base',
        labelNew: 'Current',
        isRootBaseline: false,
      };
    }

    if (comparisonTarget === 'current') {
      return {
        oldFiles: selectedCheckpoint.files,
        newFiles: safeCurrentFiles,
        labelOld: `${selectedCheckpoint.name} (${selectedCheckpoint.shortSha || selectedCheckpoint.id.slice(0, 7)})`,
        labelNew: 'Current Working Tree',
        isRootBaseline: false,
      };
    }

    // Default 'parent' comparison
    const parent = selectedCheckpoint.parentId ? safeCheckpoints.find(c => c.id === selectedCheckpoint.parentId) : null;
    const isRoot = !parent;
    const oldFiles = parent ? parent.files : [];
    const newFiles = selectedCheckpoint.files;

    return {
      oldFiles,
      newFiles,
      labelOld: parent ? `${parent.name} (${parent.shortSha})` : 'Root / Init (Baseline)',
      labelNew: `${selectedCheckpoint.name} (${selectedCheckpoint.shortSha || selectedCheckpoint.id.slice(0, 7)})`,
      isRootBaseline: isRoot,
    };
  }, [inspectingWorkingTree, headCommit, safeCurrentFiles, selectedCheckpoint, safeCheckpoints, comparisonTarget]);

  // Compute multi-file diff summary
  const projectDiffSummaries: FileDiffSummary[] = useMemo(() => {
    return computeProjectFileDiffs(comparison.oldFiles, comparison.newFiles);
  }, [comparison]);

  // Active file diff resolution
  const activeFileDiff = useMemo(() => {
    const matched = projectDiffSummaries.find(d => d.fileName === selectedFileName);
    if (matched) return matched;
    return projectDiffSummaries[0] || null;
  }, [projectDiffSummaries, selectedFileName]);

  const activeDiffResult: DiffResult = useMemo(() => {
    if (activeFileDiff) return activeFileDiff.diff;
    return computeLineDiff('', '');
  }, [activeFileDiff]);

  // Full file snapshot content for "View Older Version"
  const snapshotContent = useMemo(() => {
    if (inspectingWorkingTree) {
      return safeCurrentFiles.find(f => f.name === selectedFileName)?.content || '';
    }
    return selectedCheckpoint?.files.find(f => f.name === selectedFileName)?.content || '';
  }, [inspectingWorkingTree, safeCurrentFiles, selectedCheckpoint, selectedFileName]);

  const snapshotLines = useMemo(() => {
    if (!snapshotContent) return [];
    return snapshotContent.split('\n');
  }, [snapshotContent]);

  // Virtualization window calculations
  const virtualUnifiedWindow = useMemo(() => {
    const totalCount = activeDiffResult.lines.length;
    const startIndex = Math.max(0, Math.floor(scrollTop / ROW_HEIGHT) - OVERSCAN);
    const endIndex = Math.min(totalCount, Math.ceil((scrollTop + viewportHeight) / ROW_HEIGHT) + OVERSCAN);
    return {
      totalCount,
      startIndex,
      endIndex,
      topPadding: startIndex * ROW_HEIGHT,
      bottomPadding: Math.max(0, (totalCount - endIndex) * ROW_HEIGHT),
      visibleItems: activeDiffResult.lines.slice(startIndex, endIndex),
    };
  }, [activeDiffResult.lines, scrollTop, viewportHeight]);

  const virtualSplitWindow = useMemo(() => {
    const totalCount = activeDiffResult.splitRows.length;
    const startIndex = Math.max(0, Math.floor(scrollTop / ROW_HEIGHT) - OVERSCAN);
    const endIndex = Math.min(totalCount, Math.ceil((scrollTop + viewportHeight) / ROW_HEIGHT) + OVERSCAN);
    return {
      totalCount,
      startIndex,
      endIndex,
      topPadding: startIndex * ROW_HEIGHT,
      bottomPadding: Math.max(0, (totalCount - endIndex) * ROW_HEIGHT),
      visibleItems: activeDiffResult.splitRows.slice(startIndex, endIndex),
    };
  }, [activeDiffResult.splitRows, scrollTop, viewportHeight]);

  const virtualSnapshotWindow = useMemo(() => {
    const totalCount = snapshotLines.length;
    const startIndex = Math.max(0, Math.floor(scrollTop / ROW_HEIGHT) - OVERSCAN);
    const endIndex = Math.min(totalCount, Math.ceil((scrollTop + viewportHeight) / ROW_HEIGHT) + OVERSCAN);
    return {
      totalCount,
      startIndex,
      endIndex,
      topPadding: startIndex * ROW_HEIGHT,
      bottomPadding: Math.max(0, (totalCount - endIndex) * ROW_HEIGHT),
      visibleItems: snapshotLines.slice(startIndex, endIndex),
    };
  }, [snapshotLines, scrollTop, viewportHeight]);

  // Calculate sync status (ahead commits)
  const aheadCount = useMemo(() => {
    return safeCheckpoints.filter(c => !c.isSyncedToCloud && !c.isAutoSave).length;
  }, [safeCheckpoints]);

  // Filtered branches for switcher
  const filteredBranches = useMemo(() => {
    if (!branchSearchQuery.trim()) return safeBranches;
    const q = branchSearchQuery.toLowerCase();
    return safeBranches.filter(b => b.toLowerCase().includes(q));
  }, [safeBranches, branchSearchQuery]);

  const handleSwitchToBranch = (b: string) => {
    if (onSwitchBranch) {
      onSwitchBranch(b, true);
    } else {
      setActiveBranch(activeProjectId, b);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateNewBranch = (name: string) => {
    if (onCreateBranch) {
      onCreateBranch(name);
    } else {
      createBranch(activeProjectId, name);
    }
    setBranchSearchQuery('');
    setIsBranchPopoverOpen(false);
  };

  // Commit submission
  const handleCommitSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!commitMessage.trim()) return;

    if (onCreateCommit) {
      onCreateCommit(commitMessage.trim(), commitDescription.trim());
    } else {
      onCreateCheckpoint(commitMessage.trim());
    }

    setCommitMessage('');
    setCommitDescription('');
    setInspectingWorkingTree(false);
    setActiveTab('commits');
  };

  const handlePush = async () => {
    if (!onPushCommits) return;
    setIsSyncing(true);
    try {
      await onPushCommits();
    } finally {
      setIsSyncing(false);
    }
  };

  const handlePull = async () => {
    if (!onPullCommits) return;
    setIsSyncing(true);
    try {
      await onPullCommits();
    } finally {
      setIsSyncing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSync = async () => {
    setIsSyncing(true);
    try {
      if (onPullCommits) await onPullCommits();
      if (onPushCommits) await onPushCommits();
      if (onSyncCloud) onSyncCloud();
    } finally {
      setIsSyncing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRestoreCommit = () => {
    if (!selectedCheckpoint) return;
    onRestoreCheckpoint(selectedCheckpoint);
    setRestoredToast('commit');
    setTimeout(() => {
      setRestoredToast(null);
    }, 1200);
  };

  const handleRestoreFile = () => {
    if (!activeFileDiff || !onRestoreSingleFile) return;
    const fileToRestore: ProjectFile = {
      id: activeFileDiff.fileId,
      name: activeFileDiff.fileName,
      content: activeFileDiff.oldContent,
      type: activeFileDiff.fileName.endsWith('.bib') ? 'bib' : activeFileDiff.fileName.endsWith('.sty') ? 'sty' : 'tex',
    };
    onRestoreSingleFile(fileToRestore);
    setRestoredToast('file');
    setTimeout(() => {
      setRestoredToast(null);
    }, 1400);
  };

  const handleRestoreEmergencyDraft = () => {
    if (!emergencyDraft) return;
    const draftCp: Checkpoint = {
      id: `emergency-draft-${emergencyDraft.timestamp}`,
      shortSha: 'draft',
      projectId: activeProjectId,
      name: `Recovered Emergency Draft (${new Date(emergencyDraft.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString()})`,
      message: `Recovered Emergency Draft (${new Date(emergencyDraft.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString()})`,
      timestamp: new Date(emergencyDraft.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),
      author: 'Crash Recovery',
      files: emergencyDraft.files,
      isAutoSave: true,
      createdAt: new Date(emergencyDraft.timestamp).toISOString(),
    };
    onRestoreCheckpoint(draftCp);
    setRestoredToast('draft');
    setTimeout(() => {
      setRestoredToast(null);
    }, 1200);
  };

  const handleCopySha = (sha: string) => {
    if (!navigator.clipboard) return;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(sha);
    setCopiedSha(sha);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedSha(null), 1500);
  };

  const handleDownloadZip = () => {
    if (!selectedCheckpoint) return;
    import('jszip').then(({ default: JSZip }) => {
      const zip = new JSZip();
      for (const f of selectedCheckpoint.files) {
        zip.file(f.name, f.content);
      }
      zip.generateAsync({ type: 'blob' }).then(blob => {
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        const a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = url;
        a.download = `teeex-commit-${selectedCheckpoint.shortSha || 'snapshot'}.zip`;
        a.click();
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      });
    });
  };

  // Keyboard shortcut Ctrl+Enter to commit
  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === 'Enter') {
      if (activeTab === 'changes' && commitMessage.trim()) {
        e.preventDefault();
        handleCommitSubmit(e as unknown as React.FormEvent);
      }
    }
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div style={backdropStyle} onClick={onClose}>
      <div style={modalStyle} onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()} onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}>
        {/* Header Bar */}
        <div style={headerStyle}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12 }}>
            <div style={{ width: 34, height: 34, borderRadius: 8, backgroundColor: 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.14)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
              <GitBranch size={18} color="#38bdf8" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                <h2 style={{ fontSize: 16, fontWeight: 700, margin: 0, color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                  Source Control &amp; Git Version History
                </h2>

                {/* Interactive Branch Switcher Popover Trigger */}
                <div style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
                  <button
                    type="button"

                    className="btn-ghost"

                      padding: '2px 8px',
                      borderRadius: 4,

                      color: isCloudConnected ? '#10b981' : '#38bdf8',

                    title="Switch or create Git branches"
                  >
````
