````typescript
import React, { useState, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  FileText,
  FileCode,
  Plus,
  Trash2,
  ListTree,
  FileSpreadsheet,
  BarChart2,
  History,
  Folder,
  FolderOpen,
  FolderPlus,
  FilePlus,
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronRight,
  Image as ImageIcon,
  PanelLeftClose,
  Search,
  X,
  Upload,
  UploadCloud,
  ImagePlus
} from 'lucide-react';
import type { ProjectFile, ParsedDocument, ProjectRole, Collaborator } from '../types/latex';
import { extractLatexLabels } from '../services/latexParser';

interface Props {
  files: ProjectFile[];
  folders?: string[];
  activeFileId: string;
  onSelectFile: (fileId: string) => void;
  onCreateFile: (name: string, type: 'tex' | 'bib', targetFolder?: string) => void;
  onDeleteFile: (fileId: string) => void;
  onCreateFolder?: (folderName: string) => void;
  onDeleteFolder?: (folderName: string) => void;
  documentOutline: ParsedDocument['sections'];
  onJumpToLine: (line: number) => void;
  wordCount: number;
  equationCount: number;
  onOpenWordCount?: () => void;
  onOpenHistory?: () => void;
  role?: ProjectRole;
  onCollapse?: () => void;
  activeCursorLine?: number;
  parsedDoc?: ParsedDocument;
  onImportFiles?: (files: FileList | File[], targetFolder?: string) => void;
  onOpenImageUpload?: () => void;
  peers?: Collaborator[];
}

export const Sidebar: React.FC<Props> = ({
  files,
  folders = ['sections', 'figures'],
  activeFileId,
  onSelectFile,
  onCreateFile,
  onDeleteFile,
  onCreateFolder,
  onDeleteFolder,
  documentOutline,
  onJumpToLine,
  wordCount,
  equationCount,
  onOpenWordCount,
  onOpenHistory,
  role = 'owner',
  onCollapse,
  activeCursorLine,
  parsedDoc,
  onImportFiles,
  onOpenImageUpload,
  peers = [],
}) => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'files' | 'outline'>('files');

  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const imageInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [dragOverFolder, setDragOverFolder] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Document Outline Filter & Search State
  const [outlineFilter, setOutlineFilter] = useState<'all' | 'sections' | 'figures' | 'tables' | 'math'>('all');
  const [outlineSearch, setOutlineSearch] = useState('');

  // Creation Modes: null | 'root-file' | 'root-folder' | `folder:${folderName}`
  const [creationMode, setCreationMode] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [newItemName, setNewItemName] = useState('');

  // Open Folders Set
  const [openFolders, setOpenFolders] = useState<Set<string>>(() => new Set(folders));

  const toggleFolder = (fName: string) => {
    setOpenFolders(prev => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(fName)) next.delete(fName);
      else next.add(fName);
      return next;
    });
  };

  // Helper: Extract folder of a file
  const getFileFolder = (f: ProjectFile): string | null => {
    if (f.folder) return f.folder;
    if (f.name.includes('/')) {
      return f.name.split('/')[0];
    }
    return null;
  };

  // Helper: Display name without folder prefix
  const getFileDisplayName = (f: ProjectFile): string => {
    if (f.name.includes('/')) {
      const parts = f.name.split('/');
      return parts[parts.length - 1];
    }
    return f.name;
  };

  // Aggregate all unique folders
  const allFolders = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set<string>(folders);
    files.forEach(f => {
      const fFolder = getFileFolder(f);
      if (fFolder) set.add(fFolder);
    });
    return Array.from(set).sort();
  }, [folders, files]);

  // Group files by folder
  const filesByFolder = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, ProjectFile[]>();
    allFolders.forEach(f => map.set(f, []));
    files.forEach(f => {
      const folderName = getFileFolder(f);
      if (folderName) {
        if (!map.has(folderName)) map.set(folderName, []);
        map.get(folderName)!.push(f);
      }
    });
    return map;
  }, [allFolders, files]);

  // Files at root
  const rootFiles = useMemo(() => {
    return files.filter(f => getFileFolder(f) === null);
  }, [files]);

  // Outline Nodes computation for Document Outline Tree
  interface OutlineNode {
    id: string;
    type: 'section' | 'subsection' | 'subsubsection' | 'figure' | 'table' | 'equation';
    title: string;
    caption?: string;
    line: number;
    level: number;
  }

  const allOutlineNodes = useMemo<OutlineNode[]>(() => {
    const nodes: OutlineNode[] = [];

    // 1. Sections from documentOutline
    (documentOutline || []).forEach((sec, idx) => {
      nodes.push({
        id: `sec-${idx}-${sec.line}`,
        type: sec.level === 1 ? 'section' : sec.level === 2 ? 'subsection' : 'subsubsection',
        title: sec.title,
        line: sec.line,
        level: sec.level,
      });
    });

    // 2. Labels for Figures, Tables, Equations
    const labels = extractLatexLabels(files);
    labels.forEach(l => {
      if (l.type === 'figure') {
        nodes.push({
          id: `fig-${l.key}-${l.line}`,
          type: 'figure',
          title: l.caption || `Figure: ${l.key}`,
          caption: l.key,
          line: l.line,
          level: 2,
        });
      } else if (l.type === 'table') {
        nodes.push({
          id: `tab-${l.key}-${l.line}`,
          type: 'table',
          title: l.caption || `Table: ${l.key}`,
          caption: l.key,
          line: l.line,
          level: 2,
        });
      } else if (l.type === 'equation') {
        nodes.push({
          id: `eq-${l.key}-${l.line}`,
          type: 'equation',
          title: `Eq: ${l.key}`,
          caption: l.caption,
          line: l.line,
          level: 2,
        });
      }
    });

    // 3. Parsed math blocks without labels
    if (parsedDoc?.mathBlocks) {
      parsedDoc.mathBlocks.forEach((mb, idx) => {
        if (!nodes.some(n => n.type === 'equation' && Math.abs(n.line - mb.line) <= 1)) {
          const preview = mb.latex.replace(/\\label\{[^}]+\}/g, '').trim().slice(0, 32);
          nodes.push({
            id: `mathblock-${idx}-${mb.line}`,
            type: 'equation',
            title: `$$ ${preview}${mb.latex.length > 32 ? '...' : ''} $$`,
            line: mb.line,
            level: 2,
          });
        }
      });
    }

    return nodes.sort((a, b) => a.line - b.line);
  }, [documentOutline, files, parsedDoc]);

  const filteredOutlineNodes = useMemo(() => {
    return allOutlineNodes.filter(node => {
      if (outlineFilter === 'sections' && !['section', 'subsection', 'subsubsection'].includes(node.type)) return false;
      if (outlineFilter === 'figures' && node.type !== 'figure') return false;
      if (outlineFilter === 'tables' && node.type !== 'table') return false;
      if (outlineFilter === 'math' && node.type !== 'equation') return false;

      if (outlineSearch.trim()) {
        const q = outlineSearch.toLowerCase();
        return node.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) || (node.caption && node.caption.toLowerCase().includes(q));
      }
      return true;
    });
  }, [allOutlineNodes, outlineFilter, outlineSearch]);

  // Handle Form Submission
  const handleCreateSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const clean = newItemName.trim();
    if (!clean) {
      setCreationMode(null);
      return;
    }

    if (creationMode === 'root-folder') {
      if (onCreateFolder) {
        onCreateFolder(clean);
      }
      setOpenFolders(prev => new Set(prev).add(clean));
    } else if (creationMode === 'root-file') {
      const isBib = clean.endsWith('.bib');
      if (clean.includes('/')) {
        const parts = clean.split('/');
        const folderPart = parts.slice(0, -1).join('/');
        if (onCreateFolder) onCreateFolder(folderPart);
        onCreateFile(clean, isBib ? 'bib' : 'tex', folderPart);
      } else {
        onCreateFile(clean, isBib ? 'bib' : 'tex');
      }
    } else if (creationMode?.startsWith('folder:')) {
      const targetFolder = creationMode.replace('folder:', '');
      const isBib = clean.endsWith('.bib');
      onCreateFile(clean, isBib ? 'bib' : 'tex', targetFolder);
      setOpenFolders(prev => new Set(prev).add(targetFolder));
    }

    setNewItemName('');
    setCreationMode(null);
  };

  const getFileIcon = (f: ProjectFile, isActive: boolean) => {
    if (f.type === 'image' || f.name.match(/\.(png|jpe?g|svg|pdf)$/i)) {
      return <ImageIcon size={13} color="#10b981" />;
    }
    if (f.name.endsWith('.bib') || f.type === 'bib') {
      return <FileSpreadsheet size={13} color="#f59e0b" />;
    }
    if (f.name.endsWith('.tex') || f.type === 'tex') {
      return <FileCode size={13} color={isActive ? '#38bdf8' : 'var(--text-muted)'} />;
    }
    return <FileText size={13} color="var(--text-muted)" />;
  };

  return (
    <aside aria-label="Workspace file browser and document outline" style={sidebarStyle}>
      {/* Sleek Segmented Tab Switcher */}
      <div style={tabBarStyle}>
        <div style={{
          display: 'flex',
          backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-surface-1)',
          borderRadius: 6,
          padding: 2,
          flex: 1,
          gap: 2,
          border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)',
        }}>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('files')}
            style={{
              flex: 1,
              padding: '4px 6px',
              fontSize: 11,
              fontWeight: activeTab === 'files' ? 600 : 500,
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              gap: 5,
              borderRadius: 4,
              border: 'none',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
              backgroundColor: activeTab === 'files' ? 'var(--bg-surface-elevated)' : 'transparent',
              color: activeTab === 'files' ? '#38bdf8' : 'var(--text-muted)',
              boxShadow: activeTab === 'files' ? '0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)' : 'none',
            }}
          >
            <FileText size={12} />
            <span>Files</span>
            <span style={{
              fontSize: 9.5,
              fontWeight: 700,
              padding: '0 5px',
              borderRadius: 10,
              backgroundColor: activeTab === 'files' ? 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15)' : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06)',
              color: activeTab === 'files' ? '#38bdf8' : 'var(--text-muted)',
              lineHeight: '14px',
            }}>
              {files.length}
            </span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('outline')}
            style={{
              flex: 1,
              padding: '4px 6px',
              fontSize: 11,
              fontWeight: activeTab === 'outline' ? 600 : 500,
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              gap: 5,
              borderRadius: 4,
              border: 'none',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
              backgroundColor: activeTab === 'outline' ? 'var(--bg-surface-elevated)' : 'transparent',
              color: activeTab === 'outline' ? '#38bdf8' : 'var(--text-muted)',
              boxShadow: activeTab === 'outline' ? '0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)' : 'none',
            }}
          >
            <ListTree size={12} />
            <span>Outline</span>
            <span style={{
              fontSize: 9.5,
              fontWeight: 700,
              padding: '0 5px',
              borderRadius: 10,
              backgroundColor: activeTab === 'outline' ? 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15)' : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06)',
              color: activeTab === 'outline' ? '#38bdf8' : 'var(--text-muted)',
              lineHeight: '14px',
            }}>
              {documentOutline.length}
            </span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {onCollapse && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onCollapse}
            className="sidebar-icon-btn"
            style={{
              width: 24,
              height: 24,
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              borderRadius: 4,
              color: 'var(--text-muted)',
              border: 'none',
              background: 'transparent',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              flexShrink: 0,
            }}
            title="Collapse Sidebar"
          >
            <PanelLeftClose size={13} />
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Files List View */}
      {activeTab === 'files' && (
        <div
          onDragOver={e => {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'copy';
          }}
          onDrop={e => {
            e.preventDefault();
            if (e.dataTransfer.files && onImportFiles) {
              onImportFiles(e.dataTransfer.files);
            }
          }}
          style={{ flex: 1, overflowY: 'auto', padding: '6px 8px' }}
        >
          {/* Hidden file input for general upload */}
          <input
            ref={fileInputRef}
            type="file"
            multiple
            accept=".tex,.bib,.sty,.cls,.png,.jpg,.jpeg,.svg,.webp,.pdf,.txt"
            style={{ display: 'none' }}
            onChange={e => {
              if (e.target.files && onImportFiles) {
                onImportFiles(e.target.files);
              }
              e.target.value = '';
            }}
          />

          {/* Hidden image input for direct figure import */}
          <input
            ref={imageInputRef}
            type="file"
            multiple
            accept=".png,.jpg,.jpeg,.svg,.webp,.pdf"
            style={{ display: 'none' }}
            onChange={e => {
              if (e.target.files && onImportFiles) {
                onImportFiles(e.target.files, 'figures');
              }
              e.target.value = '';
            }}
          />

          {/* Header & New File / New Folder / Upload Micro-actions */}
          <div style={{
            display: 'flex',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            alignItems: 'center',
            padding: '6px 4px 6px 6px',
            borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)',
            marginBottom: 6,
          }}>
            <span style={{
              fontSize: 10,
              fontWeight: 700,
              letterSpacing: '0.07em',
              textTransform: 'uppercase',
              color: 'var(--text-muted)',
            }}>
              Workspace Files
            </span>

            {role !== 'viewer' && (
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 3 }}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setCreationMode('root-file');
                    setNewItemName('');
                  }}
                  className="sidebar-icon-btn"
                  style={sidebarIconBtnStyle}
                  title="New File (.tex, .bib)"
                >
                  <FilePlus size={13} color="#38bdf8" />
                </button>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setCreationMode('root-folder');
                    setNewItemName('');
                  }}
                  className="sidebar-icon-btn"
                  style={sidebarIconBtnStyle}
                  title="New Folder Directory"
                >
                  <FolderPlus size={13} color="#f59e0b" />
                </button>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
                  className="sidebar-icon-btn"
                  style={sidebarIconBtnStyle}
                  title="Upload / Import LaTeX files or figures from your computer"
                >
                  <Upload size={13} color="#10b981" />
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Inline creation input for root file */}
          {creationMode === 'root-file' && role !== 'viewer' && (
            <form onSubmit={handleCreateSubmit} style={{ padding: '2px 0 6px 0' }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5, backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-surface-1)', borderRadius: 5, padding: '3px 6px', border: '1px solid #38bdf8' }}>
                <FileCode size={13} color="#38bdf8" />
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={newItemName}
                  onChange={e => setNewItemName(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="filename.tex or .bib"
                  style={{ width: '100%', border: 'none', background: 'transparent', fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--text-primary)', outline: 'none', fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)' }}
                  autoFocus
                  onBlur={() => !newItemName && setCreationMode(null)}
                  onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Escape' && setCreationMode(null)}
                />
              </div>
            </form>
          )}

          {/* Inline creation input for root folder */}
          {creationMode === 'root-folder' && role !== 'viewer' && (
            <form onSubmit={handleCreateSubmit} style={{ padding: '2px 0 6px 0' }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5, backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-surface-1)', borderRadius: 5, padding: '3px 6px', border: '1px solid #f59e0b' }}>
                <FolderPlus size={13} color="#f59e0b" />
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={newItemName}
                  onChange={e => setNewItemName(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="folder name (e.g. sections)"
                  style={{ width: '100%', border: 'none', background: 'transparent', fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--text-primary)', outline: 'none' }}
                  autoFocus
                  onBlur={() => !newItemName && setCreationMode(null)}
                  onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Escape' && setCreationMode(null)}
                />
              </div>
            </form>
          )}

          {/* Folders & Nested Files */}
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2 }}>
            {allFolders.map(folderName => {
              const folderFiles = filesByFolder.get(folderName) || [];
              const isOpen = openFolders.has(folderName);
              const isCreatingInThisFolder = creationMode === `folder:${folderName}`;
              const isOverThis = dragOverFolder === folderName;

              return (
                <div key={folderName} style={{ marginBottom: 2 }}>
                  {/* Folder Row */}
                  <div
                    onClick={() => toggleFolder(folderName)}
                    className="sidebar-folder-row"
                    onDragOver={e => {
                      e.preventDefault();
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'copy';
                      if (dragOverFolder !== folderName) setDragOverFolder(folderName);
                    }}
                    onDragLeave={e => {
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      if (dragOverFolder === folderName) setDragOverFolder(null);
                    }}
                    onDrop={e => {
                      e.preventDefault();
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      setDragOverFolder(null);
                      if (e.dataTransfer.files && onImportFiles) {
                        onImportFiles(e.dataTransfer.files, folderName);
                      }
                    }}
                    style={{
                      ...folderRowStyle,
                      backgroundColor: isOverThis ? 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12)' : 'transparent',
                      border: isOverThis ? '1px dashed #38bdf8' : '1px solid transparent',
                    }}
                  >
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, minWidth: 0, flex: 1 }}>
                      <span style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
                        {isOpen ? <ChevronDown size={12} /> : <ChevronRight size={12} />}
                      </span>
                      <span style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', color: '#f59e0b' }}>
                        {isOpen ? <FolderOpen size={13} /> : <Folder size={13} />}
                      </span>
                      <span style={{
                        fontSize: 11.5,
                        fontWeight: 600,
                        color: 'var(--text-primary)',
                        overflow: 'hidden',
                        textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                        whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                      }}>
                        {folderName}
                      </span>
                      <span style={{
                        fontSize: 9,
                        fontWeight: 600,
                        color: 'var(--text-muted)',
                        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)',
                        padding: '1px 5px',
                        borderRadius: 8,
                        marginLeft: 2,
                      }}>
                        {folderFiles.length}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    {role !== 'viewer' && (
                      <div className="folder-hover-actions" style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                        {folderName === 'figures' && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={e => {
                              e.stopPropagation();
                              imageInputRef.current?.click();
                            }}
                            className="sidebar-row-action-btn"
                            style={{ padding: 3, borderRadius: 3, border: 'none', background: 'transparent', cursor: 'pointer', color: '#10b981' }}
                            title="Upload image into figures/"
                          >
                            <ImagePlus size={11.5} />
                          </button>
                        )}
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={e => {
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            setCreationMode(`folder:${folderName}`);
                            setOpenFolders(prev => new Set(prev).add(folderName));
                            setNewItemName('');
                          }}
                          className="sidebar-row-action-btn"
                          style={{ padding: 3, borderRadius: 3, border: 'none', background: 'transparent', cursor: 'pointer', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}
                          title={`New file in ${folderName}/`}
                        >
                          <Plus size={11.5} />
                        </button>
                        {onDeleteFolder && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={e => {
                              e.stopPropagation();
                              if (window.confirm(`Delete folder '${folderName}' and all its contents?`)) {
                                onDeleteFolder(folderName);
                              }
                            }}
                            className="sidebar-row-action-btn"
                            style={{ padding: 3, borderRadius: 3, border: 'none', background: 'transparent', cursor: 'pointer', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}
                            title="Delete folder"
                          >
                            <Trash2 size={11} />
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {/* Folder Children */}
                  {isOpen && (
                    <div style={{
                      paddingLeft: 8,
                      borderLeft: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07)',
                      marginLeft: 11,
                      marginTop: 2,
                      marginBottom: 4,
                      display: 'flex',
                      flexDirection: 'column',
                      gap: 1
                    }}>
                      {/* Sub-file Creation Input inside folder */}
                      {isCreatingInThisFolder && role !== 'viewer' && (
                        <form onSubmit={handleCreateSubmit} style={{ padding: '2px 0 4px 0' }}>
                          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-surface-1)', borderRadius: 4, padding: '2px 6px', border: '1px solid #38bdf8' }}>
                            <FileCode size={12} color="#38bdf8" />
                            <input
                              type="text"
                              value={newItemName}
                              onChange={e => setNewItemName(e.target.value)}
                              placeholder="filename.tex"
                              style={{ width: '100%', border: 'none', background: 'transparent', fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--text-primary)', outline: 'none', fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)' }}
                              autoFocus
                              onBlur={() => !newItemName && setCreationMode(null)}
                              onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Escape' && setCreationMode(null)}
                            />
                          </div>
                        </form>
                      )}

                      {folderFiles.length === 0 && !isCreatingInThisFolder ? (
                        <div
                          style={{
                            margin: '3px 4px 4px 4px',
                            padding: '6px 8px',
                            borderRadius: 5,
                            border: '1px dashed rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)',
                            backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02)',
                            display: 'flex',
                            alignItems: 'center',
                            justifyContent: 'space-between',
                            gap: 4,
                          }}
                        >
                          <span style={{ fontSize: 9.5, color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
                            Empty folder
                          </span>
                          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => {
                                setCreationMode(`folder:${folderName}`);
                                setNewItemName('');
                              }}
                              style={{
                                fontSize: 9.5,
                                fontWeight: 600,
                                color: '#38bdf8',
                                background: 'transparent',
                                border: 'none',
                                cursor: 'pointer',
                                display: 'inline-flex',
                                alignItems: 'center',
                                gap: 2,
                                padding: '1px 3px',
                              }}
                            >
                              <Plus size={10} /> File
                            </button>
                            {(folderName.toLowerCase().includes('figure') || folderName.toLowerCase().includes('image')) && (
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={(e) => {
                                  e.stopPropagation();
                                  onOpenImageUpload ? onOpenImageUpload() : imageInputRef.current?.click();
                                }}
                                style={{
                                  fontSize: 9.5,
                                  fontWeight: 600,
                                  color: '#10b981',
                                  background: 'transparent',
                                  border: 'none',
                                  cursor: 'pointer',
                                  display: 'inline-flex',
                                  alignItems: 'center',
                                  gap: 2,
                                  padding: '1px 3px',
                                }}
                              >
                                <UploadCloud size={10} /> Image
                              </button>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        folderFiles.map(f => {
                          const isActive = f.id === activeFileId;
                          return (
                            <div
                              key={f.id}
                              onClick={() => onSelectFile(f.id)}
                              className="sidebar-file-item"
                              style={{
                                ...fileItemStyle,
                                backgroundColor: isActive ? 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.09)' : 'transparent',
                                borderLeft: isActive ? '2px solid #38bdf8' : '2px solid transparent',
                                color: isActive ? 'var(--text-primary)' : 'var(--text-secondary)',
                                fontWeight: isActive ? 600 : 400,
                                paddingLeft: 6,
                              }}
                            >
                              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, overflow: 'hidden', minWidth: 0, flex: 1 }}>
                                {getFileIcon(f, isActive)}
                                <span style={{
                                  fontSize: 11.5,
                                  fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)',
                                  overflow: 'hidden',
                                  textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                                  whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                                }}>
                                  {getFileDisplayName(f)}
                                </span>
                                {peers.filter(p => p.activeFile === f.name || p.activeFile === f.id).map(p => (
                                  <span
                                    key={p.id}
                                    className="sidebar-peer-dot"
                                    style={{
                                      width: 6,
                                      height: 6,
                                      borderRadius: '50%',
                                      backgroundColor: p.color,
                                      flexShrink: 0,
                                      boxShadow: `0 0 5px ${p.color}`,
                                      display: 'inline-block',
                                    }}
                                    title={`${p.name} is active in this file`}
                                  />
                                ))}
                              </div>

                              {files.length > 1 && !f.isEntry && role !== 'viewer' && (
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  onClick={e => {
                                    e.stopPropagation();
                                    onDeleteFile(f.id);
                                  }}
                                  className="file-delete-btn"
                                  style={{
                                    border: 'none',
                                    background: 'transparent',
                                    color: 'var(--text-muted)',
                                    padding: 2,
                                    borderRadius: 3,
                                    cursor: 'pointer',
                                    display: 'flex',
                                    alignItems: 'center',
                                  }}
                                  title="Delete file"
                                >
                                  <Trash2 size={11} />
                                </button>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          );
                        })
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })}

            {/* Root Files Header & Items */}
            {rootFiles.length > 0 && (
              <div style={{ marginTop: 6, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 1 }}>
                <div style={{
                  fontSize: 9,
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  letterSpacing: '0.07em',
                  textTransform: 'uppercase',
                  color: 'var(--text-muted)',
                  padding: '4px 6px 2px 6px',
                  opacity: 0.75,
                }}>
                  Root Files
                </div>
                {rootFiles.map(f => {
                  const isActive = f.id === activeFileId;
                  const isMain = f.isEntry || f.name === 'main.tex';

                  return (
                    <div
                      key={f.id}
                      onClick={() => onSelectFile(f.id)}
                      className="sidebar-file-item"
                      style={{
                        ...fileItemStyle,
                        backgroundColor: isActive ? 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.09)' : 'transparent',
                        borderLeft: isActive ? '2px solid #38bdf8' : '2px solid transparent',
                        color: isActive ? 'var(--text-primary)' : 'var(--text-secondary)',
                        fontWeight: isActive ? 600 : 400,
                        paddingLeft: 6,
                      }}
                    >
                      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, overflow: 'hidden', minWidth: 0, flex: 1 }}>
                        {getFileIcon(f, isActive)}
                        <span style={{
                          fontSize: 11.5,
                          fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)',
                          overflow: 'hidden',
                          textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                          whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                        }}>
                          {f.name}
                        </span>
                        {isMain && (
                          <span style={{
                            fontSize: 8,
                            fontWeight: 700,
                            padding: '1px 4px',
                            borderRadius: 3,
                            backgroundColor: 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12)',
                            color: '#38bdf8',
                            letterSpacing: '0.04em',
                            border: '1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25)',
                          }}>
                            ROOT
                          </span>
                        )}
                        {peers.filter(p => p.activeFile === f.name || p.activeFile === f.id).map(p => (
                          <span
                            key={p.id}
                            className="sidebar-peer-dot"
                            style={{
                              width: 6,
                              height: 6,
                              borderRadius: '50%',
                              backgroundColor: p.color,
                              flexShrink: 0,
                              boxShadow: `0 0 5px ${p.color}`,
                              display: 'inline-block',
                            }}
                            title={`${p.name} is active in this file`}
                          />
                        ))}
                      </div>

                      {files.length > 1 && !f.isEntry && f.name !== 'main.tex' && role !== 'viewer' && (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={e => {
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            onDeleteFile(f.id);
                          }}
                          className="file-delete-btn"
                          style={{
                            border: 'none',
                            background: 'transparent',
                            color: 'var(--text-muted)',
                            padding: 2,
                            borderRadius: 3,
                            cursor: 'pointer',
                            display: 'flex',
                            alignItems: 'center',
                          }}
                          title="Delete file"
                        >
                          <Trash2 size={11} />
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Document Outline View */}
      {activeTab === 'outline' && (
        <div style={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
          {/* Outline Search & Filters Header */}
          <div style={{ padding: '8px 8px 6px 8px', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6 }}>
            {/* Search Input */}
            <div style={{
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-surface-1)',
              border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)',
              borderRadius: 'var(--radius-sm)',
              padding: '2px 6px',
              gap: 5,
            }}>
              <Search size={11} color="var(--text-muted)" />
              <input
                type="text"
                value={outlineSearch}
                onChange={e => setOutlineSearch(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Filter outline..."
                style={{
                  border: 'none',
                  outline: 'none',
                  background: 'transparent',
                  color: 'var(--text-primary)',
                  fontSize: 10.5,
                  width: '100%',
                }}
              />
              {outlineSearch && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setOutlineSearch('')}
                  style={{ background: 'transparent', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', padding: 0, color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}
                >
                  <X size={10} />
                </button>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Category Filter Pills */}
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 3, overflowX: 'auto' }} className="toolbar-scrollbar">
````

````typescript
import { test, expect, type Page } from '@playwright/test';

const DOCS = {
  small: String.raw`\documentclass[10pt]{article}
\begin{document}
\section{Small}
A single short paragraph of text.
\end{document}`,

  medium: String.raw`\documentclass[10pt]{article}
\usepackage{amsmath,lipsum}
\begin{document}
\section{Medium}
\lipsum[1-12]
\[ \int_0^1 x^2\,dx = \frac{1}{3} \qquad E = mc^2 \]
\lipsum[13-18]
\end{document}`,

  large: String.raw`\documentclass[10pt]{article}
\usepackage{amsmath,lipsum}
\begin{document}
${Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, i) => `\\section{Section ${i + 1}}\n\\lipsum[1-10]`).join('\n\\newpage\n')}
\end{document}`,
};

function quantile(sorted: number[], q: number): number {
  if (sorted.length === 0) return 0;
  const pos = (sorted.length - 1) * q;
  const base = Math.floor(pos);
  const rest = pos - base;
  return sorted[base + 1] !== undefined
    ? sorted[base] + rest * (sorted[base + 1] - sorted[base])
    : sorted[base];
}

function summarise(samples: number[]) {
  const sorted = [...samples].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  return {
    samples: samples.length,
    median: Math.round(quantile(sorted, 0.5)),
    p95: Math.round(quantile(sorted, 0.95)),
    min: Math.round(sorted[0]),
    max: Math.round(sorted[sorted.length - 1]),
  };
}

import { openWorkspace, setEditorContent } from './fixtures';

test('measure compile latency, first-paint, structure outline latency and heap stability', async ({
  page,
}) => {
  test.setTimeout(600_000);

  const REPS = process.env.BENCHMARK_REPS ? parseInt(process.env.BENCHMARK_REPS, 10) : 4;
  const isConfiguredOrCi = Boolean(process.env.BENCHMARK_REPS || process.env.CI);

  const results: Record<string, unknown> = {
    machine: isConfiguredOrCi ? 'automated CI / baseline tracking' : 'local dev (see host); single Chromium worker',
    note: REPS >= 10
      ? `Statistically robust benchmark baseline (${REPS} repetitions/size).`
      : 'Small-sample baseline. p95 over few samples is indicative only.',
    capturedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  };

  // --- cold start: page load through first painted page -----------------
  const preview = page.getByRole('document', { name: 'Compiled document preview' });
  const canvas = preview.locator('canvas').first();

  const t0 = Date.now();
  await openWorkspace(page, {
    id: 'e2e-bench',
    email: 'bench@teeex.local',
    fullName: 'Playwright',
  });
  await setEditorContent(page, DOCS.small);
  await expect(canvas).toBeVisible({ timeout: 180_000 });
  results.coldStartToFirstPaintMs = Date.now() - t0;

  // --- compile latency by size (warm engine) ---------------------------
  const latency: Record<string, ReturnType<typeof summarise>> = {};

  const measureCompile = async (source: string, rep: number): Promise<number> => {
    const marked = source.replace('\\begin{document}', `\\begin{document}\n% rep ${rep}`);
    const countBefore = await page.evaluate(
      () => (window as unknown as { __teeexCompileCount?: number }).__teeexCompileCount ?? 0,
    );
    const start = Date.now();
    await setEditorContent(page, marked);
    await page.keyboard.press('ControlOrMeta+Enter');
    await page.waitForFunction(
      (prev) =>
        ((window as unknown as { __teeexCompileCount?: number }).__teeexCompileCount ?? 0) > prev,
      countBefore,
      { timeout: 180_000 },
    );
    return Date.now() - start;
  };

  for (const [size, source] of Object.entries(DOCS)) {
    const samples: number[] = [];
    for (let rep = 0; rep < REPS; rep++) {
      samples.push(await measureCompile(source, rep));
    }
    latency[size] = summarise(samples);
  }
  results.compileLatencyMs = latency;

  // --- structure outline latency: edit -> React StructurePanel update ---
  const structureTab = page.getByRole('tab', { name: /Structure|Outline/i });
  if (await structureTab.count()) {
    await structureTab.click();
    const outlineSamples: number[] = [];
    for (let rep = 0; rep < 5; rep++) {
      const token = `MARKER_${rep}_${Date.now()}`;
      const start = Date.now();
      await setEditorContent(page, DOCS.small.replace('\\section{Small}', `\\section{${token}}`));
      await expect(page.locator('.structure-panel')).toContainText(token, { timeout: 30_000 });
      outlineSamples.push(Date.now() - start);
    }
    results.outlineLatencyMs = summarise(outlineSamples);
    await page.getByRole('tab', { name: 'PDF' }).click();
  }

  // --- heap stability across repeated compiles -------------------------
  const heapReading = () =>
    page.evaluate(() => {
      const mem = (performance as unknown as { memory?: { usedJSHeapSize: number } }).memory;
      return mem ? mem.usedJSHeapSize : 0;
    });

  await setEditorContent(page, DOCS.medium);
  await page.keyboard.press('ControlOrMeta+Enter');
  await expect(canvas).toBeVisible({ timeout: 180_000 });
  await page.waitForTimeout(500);
  const heapBefore = await heapReading();

  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    const countBefore = await page.evaluate(
      () => (window as unknown as { __teeexCompileCount?: number }).__teeexCompileCount ?? 0,
    );
    await setEditorContent(page, DOCS.medium.replace('\\begin{document}', `\\begin{document}\n% churn ${i}`));
    await page.keyboard.press('ControlOrMeta+Enter');
    await page.waitForFunction(
      (prev) =>
        ((window as unknown as { __teeexCompileCount?: number }).__teeexCompileCount ?? 0) > prev,
      countBefore,
      { timeout: 180_000 },
    );
  }
  await page.waitForTimeout(500);
  const heapAfter = await heapReading();

  results.heap = {
    available: heapBefore > 0,
    beforeMB: Math.round(heapBefore / 1e6),
    afterMB: Math.round(heapAfter / 1e6),
    deltaMB: Math.round((heapAfter - heapBefore) / 1e6),
    compiles: 6,
    note: 'performance.memory is coarse and GC-dependent; a large positive delta is a leak signal, not proof.',
  };

  const fs = await import('node:fs/promises');
  await fs.writeFile('docs/benchmarks.json', `${JSON.stringify(results, null, 2)}\n`);

  expect(results.coldStartToFirstPaintMs as number).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  expect(latency.small.median).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  if (results.heap && (results.heap as { available: boolean }).available) {
    const heap = results.heap as { beforeMB: number; deltaMB: number };
    expect(heap.deltaMB).toBeLessThan(Math.max(50, heap.beforeMB));
  }
});
````

````typescript
import { test, expect, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { compileAndWaitForPreview, openWorkspace, setEditorContent } from './fixtures';

const IEEE_SOURCE = String.raw`\documentclass[conference]{IEEEtran}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\usepackage{lipsum}
\begin{document}
\title{Two Column Resolution Test}
\author{\IEEEauthorblockN{Playwright}}
\maketitle
\begin{abstract}
This document uses the IEEEtran class, which is not part of the bundled
texlive-basic set and must be fetched on demand.
\end{abstract}
\section{Body}
\lipsum[1-4]
\section{More}
\lipsum[5-8]
\end{document}`;

test.describe('@remote on-demand package resolution', () => {
  test.skip(
    Boolean(process.env.TEEEX_SKIP_REMOTE),
    'Remote TeX Live endpoint disabled for this run.',
  );

  test('an IEEEtran document resolves its class and typesets two columns', async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    test.setTimeout(360_000);

    const failedRequests: string[] = [];
    page.on('requestfailed', (request) => {
      const url = request.url();
      if (/busytex|texlive|\.sty|\.cls/.test(url)) {
        failedRequests.push(`${url}: ${request.failure()?.errorText}`);
      }
    });

    await openWorkspace(page, { id: 'e2e-remote', email: 'e2e-remote@teeex.local', fullName: 'Playwright' }, IEEE_SOURCE);
    await compileAndWaitForPreview(page, IEEE_SOURCE, 300_000);

    const { numPages, twoColumnShare } = await inspectDownloadedPdf(page);
    expect(numPages).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(
      twoColumnShare,
      `Expected two populated columns; share=${twoColumnShare}`,
    ).toBeGreaterThan(0.2);

    expect(failedRequests, `Package fetch failures:\n${failedRequests.join('\n')}`).toEqual([]);
  });

  test(
    'an acmart (sigconf) document resolves and typesets two columns',
    async ({ page }) => {
      test.setTimeout(360_000);

      await openWorkspace(page, { id: 'e2e-acmart', email: 'e2e-acmart@teeex.local', fullName: 'Playwright' });

      await setEditorContent(
        page,
        String.raw`\documentclass[sigconf,nonacm]{acmart}
\usepackage{lipsum}
\begin{document}
\title{ACM Resolution Test}
\author{Playwright}
\affiliation{\institution{Teeex}}
\maketitle
\section{Body}
\lipsum[1-6]
\section{More}
\lipsum[7-12]
\end{document}`,
      );

      const preview = page.getByRole('document', { name: 'Compiled document preview' });
      await expect(preview).toBeVisible({ timeout: 30_000 });
      await expect(preview.locator('canvas').first()).toBeVisible({ timeout: 300_000 });

      const { numPages, twoColumnShare } = await inspectDownloadedPdf(page);
      expect(numPages).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(
        twoColumnShare,
        `acmart sigconf should be two-column; share=${twoColumnShare}`,
      ).toBeGreaterThan(0.2);
    },
  );

  test('an sn-jnl document resolves and typesets', async ({ page }) => {
    test.setTimeout(360_000);

    await openWorkspace(page, { id: 'e2e-snjnl', email: 'e2e-snjnl@teeex.local', fullName: 'Playwright' });

    await setEditorContent(
      page,
      String.raw`\documentclass[pdflatex,sn-basic]{sn-jnl}
\usepackage{lipsum}
\begin{document}
\title{Springer Nature Resolution Test}
\author[1]{Playwright}
\affil[1]{Teeex}
\maketitle
\section{Body}
\lipsum[1-6]
\end{document}`,
    );

    const preview = page.getByRole('document', { name: 'Compiled document preview' });
    await expect(preview).toBeVisible({ timeout: 30_000 });
    await expect(preview.locator('canvas').first()).toBeVisible({ timeout: 300_000 });

    const { numPages } = await inspectDownloadedPdf(page);
    expect(numPages).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });
});

async function inspectDownloadedPdf(page: Page) {
  const download = await Promise.all([
    page.waitForEvent('download', { timeout: 30_000 }),
    page.locator('button[title="Download the compiled PDF"]').click(),
  ]).then(([d]) => d);

  const fs = await import('node:fs/promises');
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(await fs.readFile((await download.path())!));
  expect(String.fromCharCode(...bytes.subarray(0, 5))).toBe('%PDF-');

  const pdfjs = await import('pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.mjs');
  const pdf = await pdfjs.getDocument({ data: bytes, useSystemFonts: true }).promise;

  const firstPage = await pdf.getPage(1);
  const viewport = firstPage.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
  const content = await firstPage.getTextContent();
  const xs = content.items
    .filter((item) => 'transform' in item && 'str' in item && (item as { str: string }).str.trim())
    .map((item) => (item as { transform: number[] }).transform[4]);

  const midpoint = viewport.width / 2;
  const left = xs.filter((x) => x < midpoint).length;
  const right = xs.filter((x) => x >= midpoint).length;
  const twoColumnShare = xs.length > 0 ? Math.min(left, right) / xs.length : 0;

  return { numPages: pdf.numPages, twoColumnShare };
}
````

## File: functions/core/busytex/[[path]].ts
````typescript
// Cloudflare Pages Function: /core/busytex/*
// Dual-Mode delivery pipeline:
// 1. If TEEEX_ENGINE_BUCKET is bound (R2 mode), serves directly from private R2 bucket.
// 2. Otherwise serves static assets <= 25MB from the deployment bundle.
// 3. For large engine assets (>25MB) in Zero-Credit-Card mode (no R2 bound),
//    streams from the configured upstream engine source and caches indefinitely at Cloudflare edge.

interface Env {
  TEEEX_ENGINE_BUCKET?: R2Bucket;
  TEEEX_ENGINE_BASE_URL?: string;
}

const DEFAULT_UPSTREAM_BASE = 'https://texlyre.github.io/texlyre-busytex/core/busytex';

function getContentType(key: string): string {
  if (key.endsWith('.wasm')) return 'application/wasm';
  if (key.endsWith('.data')) return 'application/octet-stream';
  if (key.endsWith('.js')) return 'application/javascript';
  if (key.endsWith('.json')) return 'application/json';
  return 'application/octet-stream';
}

export const onRequest: PagesFunction<Env> = async (context) => {
  const url = new URL(context.request.url);
  const key = url.pathname.replace(/^\/core\/busytex\//, '');

  if (!key) {
    return new Response('Not Found', { status: 404 });
  }

  // 1. Priority 1: Try R2 bucket first if bound
  if (context.env?.TEEEX_ENGINE_BUCKET) {
    try {
      const object = await context.env.TEEEX_ENGINE_BUCKET.get(key);
      if (object) {
        const headers = new Headers();
        object.writeHttpMetadata(headers);
        headers.set('etag', object.httpEtag);
        headers.set('Cache-Control', 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable');
        headers.set('Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy', 'same-origin');
        headers.set('Content-Type', getContentType(key));

        const clientEtag = context.request.headers.get('if-none-match');
        if (clientEtag && clientEtag === object.httpEtag) {
          return new Response(null, { status: 304, headers });
        }

        return new Response(object.body, { headers });
      }
    } catch (_err) {
      // Fall through to next handler on R2 error
    }
  }

  // 2. Priority 2: Static files <= 25MB in deployment bundle
  const isHeavyFile = key === 'texlive-basic.data' || key === 'busytex.wasm';
  if (!isHeavyFile) {
    const staticResponse = await context.next();
    const contentType = staticResponse.headers.get('content-type') || '';
    if (staticResponse.status === 200 && !contentType.includes('text/html')) {
      const headers = new Headers(staticResponse.headers);
      headers.set('Cache-Control', 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable');
      headers.set('Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy', 'same-origin');
      headers.set('Content-Type', getContentType(key));
      return new Response(staticResponse.body, {
        status: 200,
        headers,
      });
    }
  }

  // 3. Priority 3: Zero-Credit-Card Mode (stream large files and cache at Cloudflare edge)
  try {
    const upstreamBase = (context.env?.TEEEX_ENGINE_BASE_URL || DEFAULT_UPSTREAM_BASE).replace(/\/+$/, '');
    const upstreamUrl = `${upstreamBase}/${key}`;
    const upstreamRes = await fetch(upstreamUrl, {
      headers: {
        'Accept-Encoding': 'identity',
      },
      cf: {
        cacheTtl: 31536000,
        cacheEverything: true,
      },
    });

    if (upstreamRes.ok && upstreamRes.body) {
      const headers = new Headers();
      headers.set('Cache-Control', 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable');
      headers.set('Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy', 'same-origin');
      headers.set('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
      headers.set('Content-Type', getContentType(key));
      // Explicit 'Accept-Encoding: identity' forces upstream to serve exact uncompressed bytes.
      // Forward the exact raw byte length so WebAssembly streaming and browsers know total size.
      const rawLen = upstreamRes.headers.get('content-length');
      if (rawLen) headers.set('Content-Length', rawLen);

      return new Response(upstreamRes.body, {
        status: upstreamRes.status,
        headers,
      });
    }
  } catch (_err) {
    // Return honest 404 below
  }

  return new Response(`Asset not found: ${key}`, { status: 404 });
};
````

````javascript
};

export const MAX_PACKAGE_SIZE = 8 * 1024 * 1024; // 8 MiB
export const MIN_PACKAGE_SIZE = 30; // 30 bytes

const TEX_STYLE_MARKERS = [
  '\\ProvidesPackage',
  '\\ProvidesClass',
  '\\ProvidesFile',
  '\\NeedsTeXFormat',
  '\\def',
  '\\let',
  '\\newcommand',
  '\\DeclareOption',
  '\\catcode',
  '\\makeatletter',
  '\\RequirePackage',
  '\\newcount',
  '\\newdimen',
  '\\newskip',
  '\\newbox',
  '\\newif',
  '\\ProcessOptions',
  '\\AtBeginDocument',
  '\\begingroup',
  '\\endgroup',
  '%',
];

const BST_MARKERS = [
  'ENTRY',
  'FUNCTION',
  'READ',
  'EXECUTE',
  'ITERATE',
  'SORT',
  'STRINGS',
  'INTEGERS',
  'MACRO',
];

/**
 * Reads a Fetch Response with strict streaming limits.
 * Avoids response.arrayBuffer() on untrusted bodies by:
 * 1. Rejecting advertised Content-Length > maxBytes immediately.
 * 2. Streaming chunks via reader and cancelling immediately if accumulated bytes > maxBytes.
 */
export async function readResponseLimited(response, maxBytes = MAX_PACKAGE_SIZE) {
  const advertised = response.headers?.get?.('content-length');
  if (advertised !== null && advertised !== undefined) {
    const len = parseInt(advertised, 10);
    if (!Number.isNaN(len) && len > maxBytes) {
      throw new Error(`Response Content-Length ${len} exceeds limit of ${maxBytes} bytes`);
    }
  }

  if (!response.body || typeof response.body.getReader !== 'function') {
    if (typeof response.arrayBuffer === 'function') {
      const buf = await response.arrayBuffer();
      if (buf.byteLength > maxBytes) {
        throw new Error(`Response body exceeded limit of ${maxBytes} bytes`);
      }
      return Buffer.from(buf);
    }
    throw new Error('Response body is null');
  }

  const reader = response.body.getReader();
  const chunks = [];
  let totalBytes = 0;

  try {
    while (true) {
      const { done, value } = await reader.read();
      if (done) break;
      if (value) {
        totalBytes += value.byteLength;
        if (totalBytes > maxBytes) {
          await reader.cancel();
          throw new Error(`Response body exceeded limit of ${maxBytes} bytes while streaming`);
        }
        chunks.push(Buffer.from(value.buffer, value.byteOffset, value.byteLength));
      }
    }
  } finally {
    reader.releaseLock?.();
  }

  return Buffer.concat(chunks);
}

/**
 * Validates package payload against size bounds, HTML/error strings, NUL bytes,
 * and structural TeX/BibTeX markers.
 */
export function validatePackagePayload(name, buffer) {
  if (!buffer || buffer.length < MIN_PACKAGE_SIZE) {
    return {
      valid: false,
      reason: `Undersized payload (${buffer ? buffer.length : 0} bytes < ${MIN_PACKAGE_SIZE} bytes)`,
    };
  }

  if (buffer.length > MAX_PACKAGE_SIZE) {
    return {
      valid: false,
      reason: `Oversized payload (${buffer.length} bytes > ${MAX_PACKAGE_SIZE} bytes limit)`,
    };
  }

  // Reject embedded NUL bytes in text packages
  for (let i = 0; i < buffer.length; i++) {
    if (buffer[i] === 0) {
      return {
        valid: false,
        reason: 'Embedded NUL byte detected in text package',
      };
    }
  }

  const text = buffer.toString('utf8');
  const leadingSnippet = text.slice(0, 2048);

  // Check for HTML error response (even if served as binary/octet-stream)
  if (/<!doctype\s+html|<html[\s>]|<head[\s>]|<body[\s>]|<title[\s>]/i.test(leadingSnippet)) {
    return {
      valid: false,
      reason: 'HTML error response detected',
    };
  }

  // Check for explicit upstream error responses
  if (/Cannot GET|404 Not Found|502 Bad Gateway|Internal Server Error|Access Denied|NoSuchKey/i.test(leadingSnippet)) {
    return {
      valid: false,
      reason: 'Explicit upstream error text detected',
    };
  }

  const lowerName = name.toLowerCase();

  // Validate BibTeX styles (.bst)
  if (lowerName.endsWith('.bst')) {
    const hasBstMarker = BST_MARKERS.some(marker => text.includes(marker));
    if (!hasBstMarker) {
      return {
        valid: false,
        reason: 'Missing expected BibTeX style markers (ENTRY, FUNCTION, READ, etc.)',
      };
    }
    return { valid: true, reason: 'Valid BibTeX style' };
  }

  // Validate TeX styles/classes (.sty, .cls, .def)
  if (lowerName.endsWith('.sty') || lowerName.endsWith('.cls') || lowerName.endsWith('.def')) {
    const hasTexMarker = TEX_STYLE_MARKERS.some(marker => text.includes(marker));
    if (!hasTexMarker) {
      return {
        valid: false,
        reason: 'Missing expected TeX source markers (\\ProvidesPackage, \\def, %, etc.)',
      };
    }
    return { valid: true, reason: 'Valid TeX style/class' };
  }

  // LaTeX data / auxiliary (.ltd)
  if (lowerName.endsWith('.ltd')) {
    if (!text.includes('%') && !text.includes('\\')) {
      return {
        valid: false,
        reason: 'Missing expected LaTeX data markers (% or \\)',
      };
    }
    return { valid: true, reason: 'Valid LaTeX data file' };
  }

  return { valid: true, reason: 'OK' };
}

export function computeSha256(buffer) {
  return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(buffer).digest('hex');
}

/**
 * Validates structural package markers and compares byte count and SHA-256 digest
 * against the cryptographic integrity manifest.
 */
export function validatePackageAgainstManifest(name, buffer, manifest = PACKAGE_HASHES) {
  const structural = validatePackagePayload(name, buffer);
  if (!structural.valid) return structural;

  const expected = manifest[name];
  if (!expected) {
    return {
      valid: false,
      reason: `Package "${name}" is not registered in integrity manifest`,
    };
  }

  if (buffer.length !== expected.bytes) {
    return {
      valid: false,
      reason: `Byte count mismatch for "${name}": expected ${expected.bytes}, got ${buffer.length}`,
    };
  }

  const digest = computeSha256(buffer);
  if (digest !== expected.sha256) {
    return {
      valid: false,
      reason: `SHA-256 digest mismatch for "${name}": expected ${expected.sha256}, got ${digest}`,
    };
  }

  return { valid: true, reason: 'Passed structural and integrity manifest verification' };
}

async function fetchWithRetry(name, url, maxRetries = 2, timeoutMs = 15000, manifest = PACKAGE_HASHES) {
  let lastError = null;

  for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= maxRetries; attempt++) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(url, {
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(timeoutMs),
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status} ${res.statusText}`);
      }

      // Read through chunk-limited streaming reader (enforcing 8 MiB bounds)
      const buf = await readResponseLimited(res, MAX_PACKAGE_SIZE);

      const validation = validatePackageAgainstManifest(name, buf, manifest);
      if (!validation.valid) {
        throw new Error(`Validation failed: ${validation.reason}`);
      }

      return buf;
    } catch (err) {
      lastError = err;
      if (attempt < maxRetries) {
        const backoffMs = (attempt + 1) * 300;
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, backoffMs));
      }
    }
  }

  throw lastError || new Error('Fetch failed');
}

export async function provisionPackages({
  packagesDir = PACKAGES_DIR,
  concurrency = 4,
  allowIncomplete = process.env.TEEEX_ALLOW_INCOMPLETE_PACKAGES === '1',
  manifest = PACKAGE_HASHES,
} = {}) {
  // Validate concurrency configuration (must be integer between 1 and 16)
  if (
    typeof concurrency !== 'number' ||
    !Number.isInteger(concurrency) ||
    concurrency < 1 ||
    concurrency > 16
  ) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid concurrency "${concurrency}". Must be an integer between 1 and 16.`);
  }

  if (!fs.existsSync(packagesDir)) {
    fs.mkdirSync(packagesDir, { recursive: true });
  }

  const allTargets = [
    ...ESSENTIAL_PACKAGES.map((pkg) => ({ name: pkg, url: `${UPSTREAM_BASE}/${pkg}` })),
    ...Object.entries(SPECIAL_SOURCES).map(([pkg, url]) => ({ name: pkg, url })),
  ];

  console.log(`Provisioning ${allTargets.length} essential LaTeX packages (concurrency: ${concurrency})...`);

  const failedPackages = [];
  let completedCount = 0;
  let index = 0;

  async function worker() {
    while (index < allTargets.length) {
      const target = allTargets[index++];
      if (!target) break;

      const { name: pkg, url } = target;
      const dest = path.join(packagesDir, pkg);

      // 1. Check existing cached package against manifest
      if (fs.existsSync(dest)) {
        try {
          const existingBuf = fs.readFileSync(dest);
          const validation = validatePackageAgainstManifest(pkg, existingBuf, manifest);
          if (validation.valid) {
            const hash = computeSha256(existingBuf);
            console.log(`[skip] ${pkg} already exists and matches integrity pin (${existingBuf.length} bytes, sha256: ${hash.slice(0, 16)}...)`);
            completedCount++;
            continue;
          } else {
            console.warn(`[invalid] Existing ${pkg} failed integrity verification (${validation.reason}), re-fetching...`);
          }
        } catch (err) {
          console.warn(`[warn] Failed reading existing ${pkg}:`, err.message);
        }
      }

      // 2. Fetch with bounded retries, streaming limits & atomic rename
      const tempPath = path.join(packagesDir, `.${pkg}.tmp.${Date.now()}.${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`);
      try {
        const buf = await fetchWithRetry(pkg, url, 2, 15000, manifest);
        fs.writeFileSync(tempPath, buf);
        fs.renameSync(tempPath, dest);

        const hash = computeSha256(buf);
        console.log(`[ok] ${pkg} verified and saved (${buf.length} bytes, sha256: ${hash})`);
        completedCount++;
      } catch (err) {
        if (fs.existsSync(tempPath)) {
          try { fs.unlinkSync(tempPath); } catch {}
        }
        console.error(`[fail] ${pkg} failed:`, err.message);
        failedPackages.push({ name: pkg, error: err.message });
      }
    }
  }

  const workers = Array.from({ length: concurrency }, () => worker());
  await Promise.all(workers);

  if (failedPackages.length > 0) {
    if (allowIncomplete) {
      console.warn(`\n[warn] Incomplete package provisioning allowed by TEEEX_ALLOW_INCOMPLETE_PACKAGES=1.`);
      console.warn(`Failed packages (${failedPackages.length}/${allTargets.length}): ${failedPackages.map(f => f.name).join(', ')}\n`);
      return { success: true, incomplete: true, failedPackages };
    } else {
      console.error(`\n[error] Failed to provision ${failedPackages.length}/${allTargets.length} required packages:`);
      for (const f of failedPackages) {
        console.error(`  - ${f.name}: ${f.error}`);
      }
      console.error(`Set TEEEX_ALLOW_INCOMPLETE_PACKAGES=1 to allow local/offline dev with missing packages.\n`);
      throw new Error(`Essential package provisioning failed for ${failedPackages.length} packages`);
    }
  }

  console.log(`Essential packages sync completed successfully (${completedCount}/${allTargets.length} packages ready)!`);
  return { success: true, count: completedCount };
}

// Auto-run when executed directly via CLI
const isMain = process.argv[1] && fileURLToPath(import.meta.url) === path.resolve(process.argv[1]);
if (isMain) {
  provisionPackages().catch((err) => {
    console.error('[fatal] Provisioning aborted:', err.message);
    process.exit(1);
  });
}
````

````typescript
import { useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { StateEffect, StateField, EditorState, Compartment, type Extension } from '@codemirror/state';
import { EditorView, ViewUpdate, Decoration, type DecorationSet } from '@codemirror/view';
import { setDiagnostics, type Diagnostic as CMDiagnostic } from '@codemirror/lint';
import type * as Y from 'yjs';
import type { Awareness } from 'y-protocols/awareness';
import { yCollab } from 'y-codemirror.next';

import type { Collaborator, Diagnostic } from '../types/latex';
import type { SyntaxTheme } from '../services/syntaxHighlighter';
import { createEditorTheme } from '../services/codeMirrorThemes';
import { themeCompartment, readOnlyCompartment, completionCompartment } from './useLatexExtensions';
import { autocompletion } from '@codemirror/autocomplete';
import { createLatexCompletionSource } from '../services/codeMirrorCompletion';
import type { BibEntry } from '../services/bibtexParser';
import { setPeersEffect } from './usePeerDecorations';

export const flashLineEffect = StateEffect.define<number>();
export const clearFlashEffect = StateEffect.define<void>();
export const collabCompartment = new Compartment();

const flashLineDecoration = Decoration.line({
  attributes: { class: 'cm-line-flash' },
});

export const flashLineField = StateField.define<DecorationSet>({
  create() {
    return Decoration.none;
  },
  update(decorations, tr) {
    decorations = decorations.map(tr.changes);
    for (const effect of tr.effects) {
      if (effect.is(flashLineEffect)) {
        const lineNum = Math.max(1, Math.min(effect.value, tr.state.doc.lines));
        const line = tr.state.doc.line(lineNum);
        decorations = Decoration.set([flashLineDecoration.range(line.from)]);
      } else if (effect.is(clearFlashEffect)) {
        decorations = Decoration.none;
      }
    }
    return decorations;
  },
  provide: (f) => EditorView.decorations.from(f),
});

export interface UseCodeMirrorProps {
  code: string;
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
  onCursorChange?: (line: number, col: number) => void;
  extensions: Extension[];
  theme: SyntaxTheme;
  isLight: boolean;
  readOnly?: boolean;
  bibEntries?: BibEntry[];
  labels?: string[];
  peers?: Collaborator[];
  diagnostics?: Diagnostic[];
  targetLine?: number | null;
  onClearTargetLine?: () => void;
  // Stage 7 Yjs collaboration integration
  ytext?: Y.Text | null;
  awareness?: Awareness | null;
  undoManager?: Y.UndoManager | null;
}

export function useCodeMirror({
  code,
  onChange,
  onCursorChange,
  extensions,
  theme,
  isLight,
  readOnly = false,
  bibEntries = [],
  labels = [],
  peers = [],
  diagnostics = [],
  targetLine,
  onClearTargetLine,
  ytext,
  awareness,
  undoManager,
}: UseCodeMirrorProps) {
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const viewRef = useRef<EditorView | null>(null);
  const lastEmittedDocRef = useRef<string>(code);

  const onChangeRef = useRef(onChange);
  onChangeRef.current = onChange;

  const onCursorChangeRef = useRef(onCursorChange);
  onCursorChangeRef.current = onCursorChange;

  // Initialize CodeMirror instance
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!containerRef.current) return;

    const updateListener = EditorView.updateListener.of((update: ViewUpdate) => {
      if (update.docChanged) {
        const nextDoc = update.state.doc.toString();
        lastEmittedDocRef.current = nextDoc;
        onChangeRef.current(nextDoc);
      }

      if (update.selectionSet || update.docChanged) {
        if (onCursorChangeRef.current) {
          const pos = update.state.selection.main.head;
          const lineInfo = update.state.doc.lineAt(pos);
          const col = pos - lineInfo.from + 1;
          onCursorChangeRef.current(lineInfo.number, col);
        }
      }
    });

    const collabExtension =
      ytext && awareness
        ? yCollab(ytext, awareness, { undoManager: undoManager || false })
        : [];

    const state = EditorState.create({
      doc: ytext ? ytext.toString() : code,
      extensions: [
        ...extensions,
        collabCompartment.of(collabExtension),
        flashLineField,
        updateListener,
      ],
    });

    const view = new EditorView({
      state,
      parent: containerRef.current,
    });

    viewRef.current = view;
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      (window as unknown as { __teeexEditorView?: EditorView }).__teeexEditorView = view;
    }
    lastEmittedDocRef.current = ytext ? ytext.toString() : code;

    return () => {
      view.destroy();
      viewRef.current = null;
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        const win = window as unknown as { __teeexEditorView?: EditorView };
        if (win.__teeexEditorView === view) {
          delete win.__teeexEditorView;
        }
      }
    };

  // Reconfigure Yjs collaboration extension when active ytext or awareness changes (e.g. file tab switch)
  useEffect(() => {
    const view = viewRef.current;
    if (!view) return;

    const collabExtension =
      ytext && awareness

        : [];

    view.dispatch({
      effects: collabCompartment.reconfigure(collabExtension),

  }, [ytext, awareness, undoManager]);

  // Sync external code changes (tab switch, formatting, quick-fix) with minimal diff
  useEffect(() => {
    const view = viewRef.current;
    if (!view) return;

    // If Yjs CRDT is active on this document, yCollab manages all document operations
    if (ytext) return;

    // Fast path: if `code` matches what CodeMirror itself just emitted, do nothing!
    if (code === lastEmittedDocRef.current) return;

    const currentDoc = view.state.doc.toString();
    if (code === currentDoc) {
      lastEmittedDocRef.current = code;
      return;
    }

    // Compute minimal prefix/suffix diff so cursor and undo history survive
    let start = 0;
    const minLen = Math.min(currentDoc.length, code.length);
    while (start < minLen && currentDoc.charCodeAt(start) === code.charCodeAt(start)) {
      start++;
    }

    let endCurrent = currentDoc.length;
    let endNext = code.length;
    while (
      endCurrent > start &&
      endNext > start &&
      currentDoc.charCodeAt(endCurrent - 1) === code.charCodeAt(endNext - 1)
    ) {
      endCurrent--;
      endNext--;
    }

    lastEmittedDocRef.current = code;
    view.dispatch({
      changes: {
        from: start,
        to: endCurrent,
        insert: code.slice(start, endNext),
      },
    });
  }, [code]);

  // Update theme when theme or isLight changes
  useEffect(() => {
    const view = viewRef.current;
    if (!view) return;

    view.dispatch({
      effects: themeCompartment.reconfigure(createEditorTheme(theme, isLight)),
    });
  }, [theme, isLight]);

  // Update read-only state
  useEffect(() => {
    const view = viewRef.current;
    if (!view) return;

    view.dispatch({
      effects: readOnlyCompartment.reconfigure(EditorView.editable.of(!readOnly)),
    });
  }, [readOnly]);

  // Update autocomplete dictionary dynamically when bibEntries or labels change
  useEffect(() => {
    const view = viewRef.current;
    if (!view) return;

    view.dispatch({
      effects: completionCompartment.reconfigure(
        autocompletion({
          override: [createLatexCompletionSource(bibEntries, labels)],
          defaultKeymap: true,
        })
      ),
    });
  }, [bibEntries, labels]);

  // Update peer collaborator cursors
  useEffect(() => {
    const view = viewRef.current;
    if (!view) return;

    view.dispatch({
      effects: setPeersEffect.of(peers),
    });
  }, [peers]);

  // Update compiler diagnostics
  useEffect(() => {
    const view = viewRef.current;
    if (!view) return;

    const docLines = view.state.doc.lines;
    const cmDiagnostics: CMDiagnostic[] = diagnostics.map((d) => {
      const lineNum = Math.max(1, Math.min(d.line, docLines));
      const lineInfo = view.state.doc.line(lineNum);
      const col = Math.max(0, Math.min((d.column || 1) - 1, lineInfo.length));
      const from = lineInfo.from + col;
      const to = Math.min(from + 1, lineInfo.to);

      return {
        from,
        to: to > from ? to : lineInfo.to,
        severity: d.severity === 'error' ? 'error' : d.severity === 'warning' ? 'warning' : 'info',
        message: d.message,
        source: d.rule || 'LaTeX',
      };
    });

    view.dispatch(setDiagnostics(view.state, cmDiagnostics));
  }, [diagnostics]);

  // Jump to targetLine when requested
  useEffect(() => {
    const view = viewRef.current;
    if (!view || targetLine === null || targetLine === undefined) return;

    const docLines = view.state.doc.lines;
    const lineNum = Math.max(1, Math.min(targetLine, docLines));
    const lineInfo = view.state.doc.line(lineNum);

    view.dispatch({
      selection: { anchor: lineInfo.from, head: lineInfo.from },
      effects: [flashLineEffect.of(lineNum)],
      scrollIntoView: true,
    });

    view.focus();

    setTimeout(() => {
      if (viewRef.current) {
        viewRef.current.dispatch({ effects: [clearFlashEffect.of()] });
      }
    }, 1200);

    if (onClearTargetLine) {
      onClearTargetLine();
    }
  }, [targetLine, onClearTargetLine]);

  const insertText = useCallback((text: string, cursorOffset?: number) => {
    const view = viewRef.current;
    if (!view) return;

    const selection = view.state.selection.main;
    const insertPos = selection.from;

    view.dispatch({
      changes: {
        from: selection.from,
        to: selection.to,

    });

  }, []);

  const wrapSelection = useCallback((before: string, after: string) => {
    const view = viewRef.current;

    const selection = view.state.selection.main;

      if (viewRef.current) {
        viewRef.current.dispatch({ effects: [clearFlashEffect.of()] });
````
