````typescript
  highlightActiveLine,
  keymap,
  EditorView,
} from '@codemirror/view';
import { foldGutter, foldService, bracketMatching, indentOnInput } from '@codemirror/language';
import { defaultKeymap, history, historyKeymap, indentWithTab } from '@codemirror/commands';
import { searchKeymap, highlightSelectionMatches } from '@codemirror/search';
import { lintGutter } from '@codemirror/lint';
import { autocompletion, completionKeymap, closeBrackets, closeBracketsKeymap } from '@codemirror/autocomplete';
import { latex } from 'codemirror-lang-latex';

import type { SyntaxTheme } from '../services/syntaxHighlighter';
import type { BibEntry } from '../services/bibtexParser';
import { createEditorTheme } from '../services/codeMirrorThemes';
import { createLatexCompletionSource } from '../services/codeMirrorCompletion';
import { peerDecorationsField } from './usePeerDecorations';

export const latexFoldService = foldService.of((state, lineStart) => {
  const line = state.doc.lineAt(lineStart);
  const text = line.text;
  const beginMatch = text.match(/\\begin\{([^}]+)\}/);
  if (beginMatch) {
    const env = beginMatch[1];
    const endTag = `\\end{${env}}`;
    let depth = 1;
    for (let i = line.number + 1; i <= state.doc.lines; i++) {
      const nextLine = state.doc.line(i);
      if (nextLine.text.includes(`\\begin{${env}}`)) depth++;
      if (nextLine.text.includes(endTag)) {
        depth--;
        if (depth === 0) {
          const from = line.from + text.indexOf(beginMatch[0]) + beginMatch[0].length;
          const to = nextLine.from + nextLine.text.indexOf(endTag);
          if (to > from) {
            return { from, to };
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return null;
});

export interface UseLatexExtensionsOptions {
  theme: SyntaxTheme;
  isLight: boolean;
  bibEntries?: BibEntry[];
  labels?: string[];
  readOnly?: boolean;
  onCompileShortcut?: () => void;
  onForwardSync?: (line: number) => void;
  onOpenCommandPalette?: () => void;
  onSaveShortcut?: () => void;
}

export const themeCompartment = new Compartment();
export const readOnlyCompartment = new Compartment();
export const completionCompartment = new Compartment();


/**
 * Hook to assemble all core CodeMirror 6 extensions.
 */
export function useLatexExtensions({
  theme,
  isLight,
  bibEntries = [],
  labels = [],
  readOnly = false,
  onCompileShortcut,
  onForwardSync,
  onOpenCommandPalette,
  onSaveShortcut,
}: UseLatexExtensionsOptions): Extension[] {
  return useMemo(() => {
    const compileKeymap = onCompileShortcut
      ? keymap.of([
          {
            key: 'Mod-Enter',
            run: () => {
              onCompileShortcut();
              return true;
            },
          },
        ])
      : [];

    const commandKeymap = onOpenCommandPalette
      ? keymap.of([
          {
            key: 'Mod-k',
            run: () => {
              onOpenCommandPalette();
              return true;
            },
          },
        ])
      : [];

    const saveKeymap = onSaveShortcut
      ? keymap.of([
          {
            key: 'Mod-s',
            run: () => {
              onSaveShortcut();
              return true;
            },
          },
        ])
      : [];

    const forwardSyncKeymap = onForwardSync
      ? keymap.of([
          {
            key: 'Ctrl-Alt-j',
            run: (view) => {
              const line = view.state.doc.lineAt(view.state.selection.main.head).number;
              onForwardSync(line);
              return true;
            },
          },
        ])
      : [];

    const forwardSyncClickExtension = onForwardSync
      ? EditorView.domEventHandlers({
          click(event, view) {
            const pos = view.posAtCoords({ x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY });
            if (pos !== null) {
              const line = view.state.doc.lineAt(pos).number;
              onForwardSync(line);
            }
          },
        })
      : [];

    const extensions: Extension[] = [
      lineNumbers(),
      highlightActiveLineGutter(),
      highlightSpecialChars(),
      history(),
      foldGutter(),
      latexFoldService,
      drawSelection(),
      dropCursor(),
      rectangularSelection(),
      crosshairCursor(),
      highlightActiveLine(),
      highlightSelectionMatches(),
      closeBrackets(),
      bracketMatching(),
      indentOnInput(),
      lintGutter(),
      peerDecorationsField,
      forwardSyncClickExtension,

      // LaTeX language support with Lezer parser (disabled conflicting internal autocompletion)
      latex({
        enableAutocomplete: false,
        enableLinting: false,
        autoCloseBrackets: false,
      }),

      // Autocomplete configured with BibTeX, labels, and LaTeX environments
      completionCompartment.of(
        autocompletion({
          override: [createLatexCompletionSource(bibEntries, labels)],
          defaultKeymap: true,
        })
      ),

      // Theme & Syntax Highlighting compartment
      themeCompartment.of(createEditorTheme(theme, isLight)),

      // Read-only configuration compartment
      readOnlyCompartment.of(EditorView.editable.of(!readOnly)),

      // Keymaps
      Prec.highest(commandKeymap),
      Prec.highest(saveKeymap),
      Prec.high(compileKeymap),
      Prec.high(forwardSyncKeymap),
      keymap.of([
        ...closeBracketsKeymap,
        ...defaultKeymap,
        ...searchKeymap,
        ...historyKeymap,
        ...completionKeymap,
        indentWithTab,
      ]),
    ];

    return extensions;
  }, [
    theme,
    isLight,
    readOnly,
    onCompileShortcut,
    onForwardSync,
    onOpenCommandPalette,
    onSaveShortcut,
    bibEntries,
    labels,
  ]);
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Teeex — React hook for structural LaTeX parsing and linting.
 * Offloads heavy AST extraction, transclusion expansion, and diagnostic linting
 * to a dedicated Web Worker (src/workers/latexParser.worker.ts).
 * Falls back gracefully to synchronous parsing if Web Workers are unavailable
 * (e.g., inside happy-dom / node test runners).
 */

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import type { Diagnostic, LatexLabel, ParsedDocument, ProjectFile } from '../types/latex';
import {
  diagnoseLatex,
  extractLatexLabels,
  parseLatexDocument,
} from '../services/latexParser';
import type { ParseWorkerRequest, ParseWorkerResponse } from '../workers/latexParser.worker';

export interface UseLatexParserOptions {
  content: string;
  files: ProjectFile[];
  activeFileName?: string;
  /** Quiet period after last keystroke before parsing. Default: 180ms */
  debounceMs?: number;
}

export interface LatexParserResult {
  diagnostics: Diagnostic[];
  parsedDoc: ParsedDocument;
  labels: LatexLabel[];
  durationMs: number;
  isParsing: boolean;
}

const EMPTY_PARSED_DOC: ParsedDocument = {
  title: '',
  authors: [],
  date: '',
  abstract: '',
  sections: [],
  mathBlocks: [],
  citations: [],
  isTwoColumn: false,
  documentClass: 'article',
};

function runSynchronousFallback(content: string, files: ProjectFile[], isTex: boolean): LatexParserResult {
  const t0 = performance.now();
  const diagnostics = isTex ? diagnoseLatex(content) : [];
  const parsedDoc = parseLatexDocument(content, files);
  const labels = extractLatexLabels(files);
  const elapsed = performance.now() - t0;
  const durationMs = elapsed < 10 ? Number(elapsed.toFixed(1)) : Math.round(elapsed);

  return {
    diagnostics,
    parsedDoc,
    labels,
    durationMs: Math.max(0.5, durationMs),
    isParsing: false,
  };
}

export function sanitizeWorkerFiles(files: ProjectFile[]): ProjectFile[] {
  return files
    .filter(
      (f) =>
        f.type !== 'image' &&
        (f.name.endsWith('.tex') ||
          f.name.endsWith('.bib') ||
          f.name.endsWith('.sty') ||
          f.name.endsWith('.cls')),
    )
    .map((f) => ({
      id: f.id,
      name: f.name,
      content: f.content,
      type: f.type,
      isEntry: f.isEntry,
    }));
}

export function useLatexParser({
  content,
  files,
  activeFileName = 'main.tex',
  debounceMs = 180,
}: UseLatexParserOptions): LatexParserResult {
  const isTex = activeFileName.endsWith('.tex');

  const [result, setResult] = useState<LatexParserResult>({
    diagnostics: [],
    parsedDoc: EMPTY_PARSED_DOC,
    labels: [],
    durationMs: 1,
    isParsing: true,
  });

  const workerRef = useRef<Worker | null>(null);
  const timerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const nextRequestIdRef = useRef<number>(1);
  const activeRequestIdRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const lastFileNameRef = useRef<string>(activeFileName);
  const isFirstRunRef = useRef<boolean>(true);

  // Initialize Web Worker with Vite ES module syntax if supported
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof Worker === 'undefined') return;

    try {
      const worker = new Worker(
        new URL('../workers/latexParser.worker.ts', import.meta.url),
        { type: 'module' }
      );

      worker.onmessage = (event: MessageEvent<ParseWorkerResponse>) => {
        const data = event.data;
        if (!data || data.type !== 'parseResult') return;
        if (data.id !== activeRequestIdRef.current) return; // Discard stale/cancelled requests

        setResult({
          diagnostics: data.diagnostics,
          parsedDoc: data.parsedDoc,
          labels: data.labels,
          durationMs: data.durationMs,
          isParsing: false,
        });
      };

      worker.onerror = (err) => {
        console.warn('[useLatexParser] Worker execution failed, falling back to sync:', err);
      };

      workerRef.current = worker;
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('[useLatexParser] Could not instantiate parser worker:', err);
      workerRef.current = null;
    }

    return () => {
      if (workerRef.current) {
        workerRef.current.terminate();
        workerRef.current = null;
      }
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (timerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
      timerRef.current = null;
    }

    const fileChanged = activeFileName !== lastFileNameRef.current;
    lastFileNameRef.current = activeFileName;

    const delay = isFirstRunRef.current || fileChanged ? 0 : debounceMs;
    isFirstRunRef.current = false;

    timerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      const worker = workerRef.current;
      if (worker) {
        const reqId = ++nextRequestIdRef.current;
        activeRequestIdRef.current = reqId;
        const msg: ParseWorkerRequest = {
          id: reqId,
          type: 'parse',
          content,
          files: sanitizeWorkerFiles(files),
          activeFileName,
        };
        worker.postMessage(msg);
      } else {
        // Synchronous fallback (happy-dom or unsupported worker)
        setResult(runSynchronousFallback(content, files, isTex));
      }
    }, delay);

    return () => {
      if (timerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
        timerRef.current = null;
      }
    };
  }, [content, files, activeFileName, isTex, debounceMs]);

  return result;
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Teeex Studio — Cryptographically Secure Share Links & Capability Tokens
 * 
 * Protects projects against privilege escalation attacks where viewers alter query params
 * (e.g. changing role=viewer to role=editor) to gain unauthorized edit/owner privileges.
 * 
 * Uses a one-way SHA-256 capability hash ladder:
 * - Edit Token: ed_<random_32_hex>
 * - View Token: vw_<sha256(roomId + ':' + editToken).substring(0, 24)>
 * 
 * Given a View Token (vw_...), it is mathematically impossible to compute
 * the Edit Token (ed_...) due to SHA-256 one-way pre-image resistance.
 */

import { getSupabaseClient } from './supabaseClient';

export interface RoomShareTokens {
  editToken: string;
  viewToken: string;
  createdAt: number;
  expiresAt: number | null; // Milliseconds timestamp, null = Never
  isRevoked?: boolean;
}

export interface TokenCapabilityHashes {
  editTokenHash: string;
  viewTokenHash: string;
  shareTokensRevoked: boolean;
  shareTokensExpiresAt: string | null;
}

/**
 * Asynchronous cryptographic SHA-256 via Web Crypto API (SubtleCrypto).
 * Non-blocking, standards-compliant, and fully preserves UTF-8 non-ASCII characters.
 */
export async function sha256(str: string): Promise<string> {
  if (typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && crypto.subtle) {
    const enc = new TextEncoder();
    const data = enc.encode(str);
    const hashBuffer = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', data);
    return Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer))
      .map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
      .join('');
  }
  return sha256Sync(str);
}

// Synchronous SHA-256 with full UTF-8 encoding support (no silent & 0xff non-ASCII truncation)
export function sha256Sync(str: string): string {
  function rightRotate(value: number, amount: number) {
    return (value >>> amount) | (value << (32 - amount));
  }

  const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(str);
  const words: number[] = [];
  const bitLength = bytes.length * 8;

  let h0 = 0x6a09e667;
  let h1 = 0xbb67ae85;
  let h2 = 0x3c6ef372;
  let h3 = 0xa54ff53a;
  let h4 = 0x510e527f;
  let h5 = 0x9b05688c;
  let h6 = 0x1f83d9ab;
  let h7 = 0x5be0cd19;

  const k = [
    0x428a2f98, 0x71374491, 0xb5c0fbcf, 0xe9b5dba5, 0x3956c25b, 0x59f111f1, 0x923f82a4, 0xab1c5ed5,
    0xd807aa98, 0x12835b01, 0x243185be, 0x550c7dc3, 0x72be5d74, 0x80deb1fe, 0x9bdc06a7, 0xc19bf174,
    0xe49b69c1, 0xefbe4786, 0x0fc19dc6, 0x240ca1cc, 0x2de92c6f, 0x4a7484aa, 0x5cb0a9dc, 0x76f988da,
    0x983e5152, 0xa831c66d, 0xb00327c8, 0xbf597fc7, 0xc6e00bf3, 0xd5a79147, 0x06ca6351, 0x14292967,
    0x27b70a85, 0x2e1b2138, 0x4d2c6dfc, 0x53380d13, 0x650a7354, 0x766a0abb, 0x81c2c92e, 0x92722c85,
    0xa2bfe8a1, 0xa81a664b, 0xc24b8b70, 0xc76c51a3, 0xd192e819, 0xd6990624, 0xf40e3585, 0x106aa070,
    0x19a4c116, 0x1e376c08, 0x2748774c, 0x34b0bcb5, 0x391c0cb3, 0x4ed8aa4a, 0x5b9cca4f, 0x682e6ff3,
    0x748f82ee, 0x78a5636f, 0x84c87814, 0x8cc70208, 0x90befffa, 0xa4506ceb, 0xbef9a3f7, 0xc67178f2,
  ];

  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) {
    words[i >> 2] |= bytes[i] << (24 - (i % 4) * 8);
  }
  words[bytes.length >> 2] |= 0x80 << (24 - (bytes.length % 4) * 8);

  const totalBlocks = ((bytes.length + 8) >> 6) + 1;
  words[(totalBlocks << 4) - 1] = bitLength;

  for (let i = 0; i < words.length; i += 16) {
    const w: number[] = [];
    for (let j = 0; j < 16; j++) w[j] = words[i + j] || 0;
    for (let j = 16; j < 64; j++) {
      const s0 = rightRotate(w[j - 15], 7) ^ rightRotate(w[j - 15], 18) ^ (w[j - 15] >>> 3);
      const s1 = rightRotate(w[j - 2], 17) ^ rightRotate(w[j - 2], 19) ^ (w[j - 2] >>> 10);
      w[j] = (w[j - 16] + s0 + w[j - 7] + s1) | 0;
    }

    let a = h0, b = h1, c = h2, d = h3, e = h4, f = h5, g = h6, h = h7;

    for (let j = 0; j < 64; j++) {
      const s1 = rightRotate(e, 6) ^ rightRotate(e, 11) ^ rightRotate(e, 25);
      const ch = (e & f) ^ (~e & g);
      const temp1 = (h + s1 + ch + k[j] + w[j]) | 0;
      const s0 = rightRotate(a, 2) ^ rightRotate(a, 13) ^ rightRotate(a, 22);
      const maj = (a & b) ^ (a & c) ^ (b & c);
      const temp2 = (s0 + maj) | 0;

      h = g;
      g = f;
      f = e;
      e = (d + temp1) | 0;
      d = c;
      c = b;
      b = a;
      a = (temp1 + temp2) | 0;
    }

    h0 = (h0 + a) | 0;
    h1 = (h1 + b) | 0;
    h2 = (h2 + c) | 0;
    h3 = (h3 + d) | 0;
    h4 = (h4 + e) | 0;
    h5 = (h5 + f) | 0;
    h6 = (h6 + g) | 0;
    h7 = (h7 + h) | 0;
  }

  const hexParts = [h0, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, h7].map(num => {
    const hex = (num >>> 0).toString(16);
    return hex.padStart(8, '0');
  });

  return hexParts.join('');
}

function generateCryptographicKey(): string {
  const randomBytes = new Uint8Array(16);
  if (typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && crypto.getRandomValues) {
    crypto.getRandomValues(randomBytes);
  } else if (typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && typeof crypto.randomUUID === 'function') {
    return crypto.randomUUID().replace(/-/g, '').slice(0, 32);
  }
  return Array.from(randomBytes).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
}

/**
 * Retrieves or generates unguessable cryptographic tokens for a room
 */
export function getRoomShareTokens(roomId: string): RoomShareTokens {
  const storageKey = `teeex_room_tokens_${roomId}`;
  const saved = localStorage.getItem(storageKey);
  if (saved) {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(saved) as RoomShareTokens;
      if (parsed.editToken?.startsWith('ed_') && parsed.viewToken?.startsWith('vw_')) {
        return parsed;
      }
    } catch {
      // Re-generate below
    }
  }

  const rawHex = generateCryptographicKey();
  const editToken = `ed_${rawHex}`;
  const viewToken = `vw_${sha256Sync(`${roomId}:${editToken}`).slice(0, 24)}`;

  const tokens: RoomShareTokens = {
    editToken,
    viewToken,
    createdAt: Date.now(),
    expiresAt: null,
    isRevoked: false,
  };

  try {
    localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(tokens));
  } catch {
    // Ignore localStorage quota errors
  }
  return tokens;
}

/**
 * Rotates / regenerates cryptographic capability keys for a room.
 * Invalidates all previously shared links immediately.
 */
export function rotateRoomShareTokens(roomId: string, expiresInDays?: number | null): RoomShareTokens {
  const storageKey = `teeex_room_tokens_${roomId}`;
  const rawHex = generateCryptographicKey();
  const editToken = `ed_${rawHex}`;
  const viewToken = `vw_${sha256Sync(`${roomId}:${editToken}`).slice(0, 24)}`;

  const expiresAt = expiresInDays && expiresInDays > 0
    ? Date.now() + expiresInDays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000
    : null;

  const tokens: RoomShareTokens = {
    editToken,
    viewToken,
    createdAt: Date.now(),
    expiresAt,
    isRevoked: false,
  };

  try {
    localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(tokens));
  } catch {}

  return tokens;
}

/**
 * Revokes all active share links for a room, reverting it to private access.
 */
export function revokeRoomShareTokens(roomId: string): void {
  const storageKey = `teeex_room_tokens_${roomId}`;
  try {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem(storageKey);
    if (saved) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(saved) as RoomShareTokens;
      parsed.isRevoked = true;
      localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(parsed));
    }
  } catch {}
}

/**
 * Validates a share key against room security.
 * Prevents tampering: viewers cannot forge or guess the ed_ token from vw_.
 */
export function verifyShareKey(roomId: string, key: string | null): 'editor' | 'viewer' | null {
  if (!key) return null;

  const storageKey = `teeex_room_tokens_${roomId}`;
  let savedTokens: RoomShareTokens | null = null;
  try {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem(storageKey);
    if (saved) {
      savedTokens = JSON.parse(saved) as RoomShareTokens;
    }
  } catch {
    // Ignore storage parse errors
  }

  // If room tokens have been revoked, reject all external keys
  if (savedTokens?.isRevoked) {
    return null;
  }

  // If token has an active expiration date and has passed it, reject
  if (savedTokens?.expiresAt && Date.now() > savedTokens.expiresAt) {
    return null;
  }

  // 1. Editor capability key provided (ed_...)
  if (key.startsWith('ed_')) {
    // Direct match with active stored token
    if (savedTokens?.editToken && key === savedTokens.editToken) {
      return 'editor';
    }

    // If device already knows the room's viewToken, verify that this edit token hashes to it
    if (savedTokens?.viewToken) {
      const derived = `vw_${sha256Sync(`${roomId}:${key}`).slice(0, 24)}`;
      if (derived === savedTokens.viewToken) {
        try {
          localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify({ ...savedTokens, editToken: key, viewToken: derived }));
        } catch {}
        return 'editor';
      }
      // Forgery detected! Key does not hash to the known room view token. Lock to viewer.
      return 'viewer';
    }

    // Unknown edit token on this device — do NOT grant editor client-side.
    // Default to 'viewer' pending asynchronous server RLS verification.
    return 'viewer';
  }

  // 2. View-only capability key provided (vw_...)
  if (key.startsWith('vw_')) {
    if (!savedTokens || !savedTokens.viewToken) {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify({
          editToken: '',
          viewToken: key,
          createdAt: Date.now(),
          expiresAt: null,
          isRevoked: false,
        }));
      } catch {}
    }
    return 'viewer';
  }

  return 'viewer';
}

/**
 * Asynchronously verifies an external edit or view token with Supabase Postgres RLS.
 * Guarantees that untrusted client-provided ed_ keys cannot escalate privilege without
 * server-side confirmation against edit_token_hash.
 */
export async function verifyShareKeyWithServer(
  roomId: string,
  key: string | null
): Promise<'editor' | 'viewer' | null> {
  if (!key) return null;

  // First do synchronous check
  const localCheck = verifyShareKey(roomId, key);
  if (localCheck === 'editor') {
    return 'editor';
  }
  if (localCheck === null) {
    return null;
  }

  // If local check returned 'viewer' but the key claims to be an edit token ('ed_...'):
  if (key.startsWith('ed_')) {
    const supabase = getSupabaseClient(key);
    if (!supabase) {
      // Offline or unconfigured Supabase — default safely to viewer
      return 'viewer';
    }

    try {
      const editHash = sha256Sync(key);
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('projects')
        .select('id, edit_token_hash, share_tokens_revoked, share_tokens_expires_at')
        .eq('id', roomId)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (error || !data) {
        return 'viewer';
      }

      if (data.share_tokens_revoked) {
        return null;
      }

      if (data.share_tokens_expires_at && new Date(data.share_tokens_expires_at).getTime() < Date.now()) {
        return null;
      }

      if (data.edit_token_hash === editHash) {
        // Cryptographically verified by server RLS and matching hash!
        const storageKey = `teeex_share_tokens_${roomId}`;
        const derived = `vw_${sha256Sync(`${roomId}:${key}`).slice(0, 24)}`;
        try {
          localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify({
            editToken: key,
            viewToken: derived,
            createdAt: Date.now(),
            expiresAt: data.share_tokens_expires_at ? new Date(data.share_tokens_expires_at).getTime() : null,
            isRevoked: false,
          }));
        } catch {}
        return 'editor';
      }
    } catch {
      return 'viewer';
    }
  }

  return 'viewer';
}

/**
  * Computes cryptographic digests (SHA-256) of active share tokens
  * for storage in Postgres projects table.
  */
export function computeTokenHashes(tokens: RoomShareTokens): TokenCapabilityHashes {
  return {
    editTokenHash: tokens.editToken ? sha256Sync(tokens.editToken) : '',
    viewTokenHash: tokens.viewToken ? sha256Sync(tokens.viewToken) : '',
    shareTokensRevoked: Boolean(tokens.isRevoked),
    shareTokensExpiresAt: tokens.expiresAt ? new Date(tokens.expiresAt).toISOString() : null,
  };
}

/**
  * Synchronizes cryptographic capability hashes to Supabase Postgres.
  * Allows anonymous visitors with share tokens to pass RLS verification.
  */
export async function syncRoomShareTokensToCloud(roomId: string, tokens: RoomShareTokens): Promise<boolean> {
  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();
  if (!supabase) return false;

  const hashes = computeTokenHashes(tokens);
  try {
    const { error } = await supabase
      .from('projects')
      .update({
        edit_token_hash: hashes.editTokenHash,
        view_token_hash: hashes.viewTokenHash,
        share_tokens_revoked: hashes.shareTokensRevoked,
        share_tokens_expires_at: hashes.shareTokensExpiresAt,
      })
      .eq('id', roomId);

    if (error) {
      console.warn('Could not sync share capability hashes to cloud:', error.message);
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Network error syncing share tokens to cloud:', err);
    return false;
  }
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Teeex — SyncTeX parser and accurate bidirectional source ↔ page mapping.
 */

const SP_PER_PT = 65536;

export type SyncTexNodeKind = 'hbox' | 'vbox' | 'point';

export interface SyncTexBox {
  kind: SyncTexNodeKind;
  tag: number;
  line: number;
  column: number;
  /** Points from the page's left edge. */
  x: number;
  /** Points from the page's top edge, at the box baseline. */
  y: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  depth: number;
}

export interface Rect {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
}

export interface SyncTexIndex {
  version: number;
  files: Map<number, string>;
  pages: Map<number, SyncTexBox[]>;
  /** Fast O(1) lookup by tag and source line */
  lineIndex?: Map<number, Map<number, Array<{ page: number; box: SyncTexBox }>>>;
  /** Sorted unique line numbers per tag for fast binary search */
  sortedLines?: Map<number, number[]>;
}

export interface ForwardMatch {
  page: number;
  rects: Rect[];
  matchedLine: number;
  exact: boolean;
  nonce?: number;
}

export interface InverseMatch {
  file: string;
  line: number;
  column: number;
  exact: boolean;
}

function isGzip(bytes: Uint8Array): boolean {
  return bytes.length > 2 && bytes[0] === 0x1f && bytes[1] === 0x8b;
}

async function gunzip(bytes: Uint8Array): Promise<Uint8Array> {
  if (typeof DecompressionStream === 'undefined') {
    throw new Error('This browser cannot decompress SyncTeX output (DecompressionStream unavailable).');
  }
  const stream = new Blob([bytes as unknown as BlobPart])
    .stream()
    .pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream('gzip'));
  return new Uint8Array(await new Response(stream).arrayBuffer());
}

export function normaliseTexPath(path: string): string {
  return path
    .trim()
    .replace(/\\/g, '/')
    .replace(/^\.\//, '')
    .replace(/^\/+/, '');
}

interface Scale {
  unit: number;
  magnification: number;
  xOffset: number;
  yOffset: number;
}

function toPoints(value: number, scale: Scale, offset: number): number {
  return ((value * scale.unit + offset) / SP_PER_PT) * scale.magnification;
}

function parseRecord(
  kind: SyncTexNodeKind,
  body: string,
  scale: Scale,
): SyncTexBox | null {
  const match = body.match(
    /^(\d+),(\d+)(?:,(\d+))?(?::(-?\d+),(-?\d+)(?::(-?\d+),(-?\d+),(-?\d+))?)?/,
  );
  if (!match) return null;

  const [, tag, line, column, x, y, width, height, depth] = match;
  if (x === undefined || y === undefined) return null;

  const parsedLine = Number(line);
  if (!parsedLine || parsedLine <= 0) return null;

  const rawWidth = width === undefined ? 0 : Number(width);
  const rawHeight = height === undefined ? 0 : Number(height);
  const rawDepth = depth === undefined ? 0 : Number(depth);

  return {
    kind,
    tag: Number(tag),
    line: parsedLine,
    column: column === undefined ? 0 : Number(column),
    x: toPoints(Number(x), scale, scale.xOffset),
    y: toPoints(Number(y), scale, scale.yOffset),
    width: toPoints(rawWidth, scale, 0),
    height: toPoints(rawHeight, scale, 0),
    depth: toPoints(rawDepth, scale, 0),
  };
}

export function boxToRect(box: SyncTexBox): Rect {
  const x = box.width < 0 ? box.x + box.width : box.x;
  const width = Math.abs(box.width);
  // Point records (g, k, x, $) don't carry height; give them a standard 10pt line height above baseline
  const effectiveHeight = box.kind === 'point' && box.height === 0 ? 10 : Math.max(0, box.height);
  const effectiveDepth = box.kind === 'point' && box.depth === 0 ? 3 : Math.max(0, box.depth);
  const top = box.y - effectiveHeight;
  const height = effectiveHeight + effectiveDepth;

  return {
    x,
    y: top,
    width: width > 0 ? width : 8,
    height: height > 0 ? height : 12,
  };
}

export async function parseSyncTex(input: Uint8Array): Promise<SyncTexIndex> {
  const bytes = isGzip(input) ? await gunzip(input) : input;
  const text = new TextDecoder('utf-8', { fatal: false }).decode(bytes);

  const files = new Map<number, string>();
  const pages = new Map<number, SyncTexBox[]>();
  const scale: Scale = { unit: 1, magnification: 1, xOffset: 0, yOffset: 0 };

  let version = 1;
  let inContent = false;
  let currentPage: number | null = null;
  let boxes: SyncTexBox[] = [];

  for (const rawLine of text.split('\n')) {
    const line = rawLine.endsWith('\r') ? rawLine.slice(0, -1) : rawLine;
    if (line.length === 0) continue;

    if (!inContent) {
      if (line.startsWith('SyncTeX Version:')) {
        version = Number.parseInt(line.slice(16), 10) || 1;
        continue;
      }
      if (line.startsWith('Input:')) {
        const separator = line.indexOf(':', 6);
        if (separator !== -1) {
          const tag = Number.parseInt(line.slice(6, separator), 10);
          if (Number.isFinite(tag)) {
            files.set(tag, normaliseTexPath(line.slice(separator + 1)));
          }
        }
        continue;
      }
      if (line.startsWith('Magnification:')) {
        const value = Number.parseFloat(line.slice(14));
        if (Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0) scale.magnification = value / 1000;
        continue;
      }
      if (line.startsWith('Unit:')) {
        const value = Number.parseFloat(line.slice(5));
        if (Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0) scale.unit = value;
        continue;
      }
      if (line.startsWith('X Offset:')) {
        const value = Number.parseFloat(line.slice(9));
        if (Number.isFinite(value)) scale.xOffset = value;
        continue;
      }
      if (line.startsWith('Y Offset:')) {
        const value = Number.parseFloat(line.slice(9));
        if (Number.isFinite(value)) scale.yOffset = value;
        continue;
      }
      if (line === 'Content:') {
        inContent = true;
      }
      continue;
    }

    if (line.startsWith('Postamble:')) break;

    const marker = line[0];

    if (marker === '{') {
      const page = Number.parseInt(line.slice(1), 10);
      currentPage = Number.isFinite(page) ? page : null;
      boxes = [];
      continue;
    }

    if (marker === '}') {
      if (currentPage !== null && boxes.length > 0) {
        const existing = pages.get(currentPage);
        pages.set(currentPage, existing ? existing.concat(boxes) : boxes);
      }
      currentPage = null;
      boxes = [];
      continue;
    }

    if (currentPage === null) continue;
    if (marker === ']' || marker === ')' || marker === 'r') continue;

    if (marker === '(' || marker === 'h') {
      const box = parseRecord('hbox', line.slice(1), scale);
      if (box) boxes.push(box);
    } else if (marker === 'x' || marker === '$' || marker === 'g' || marker === 'k') {
      const box = parseRecord('point', line.slice(1), scale);
      if (box) boxes.push(box);
    } else if (marker === '[' || marker === 'v') {
      const box = parseRecord('vbox', line.slice(1), scale);
      if (box) boxes.push(box);
    }
  }

  // Build fast O(1) lineIndex and sorted line numbers for sub-millisecond forward lookup
  const lineIndex = new Map<number, Map<number, Array<{ page: number; box: SyncTexBox }>>>();

  for (const [page, pBoxes] of pages) {
    for (const box of pBoxes) {
      if (box.kind === 'vbox') continue;
      let fileMap = lineIndex.get(box.tag);
      if (!fileMap) {
        fileMap = new Map();
        lineIndex.set(box.tag, fileMap);
      }
      let lineList = fileMap.get(box.line);
      if (!lineList) {
        lineList = [];
        fileMap.set(box.line, lineList);
      }
      lineList.push({ page, box });
    }
  }

  const sortedLines = new Map<number, number[]>();
  for (const [tag, fileMap] of lineIndex) {
    const sorted = Array.from(fileMap.keys()).sort((a, b) => a - b);
    sortedLines.set(tag, sorted);
  }

  return { version, files, pages, lineIndex, sortedLines };
}

export function tagFor(index: SyncTexIndex, file: string): number | null {
  const wanted = normaliseTexPath(file);
  const wantedLower = wanted.toLowerCase();
  const wantedBase = wantedLower.split('/').pop() || wantedLower;

  // 1. Exact normalized path match
  for (const [tag, path] of index.files) {
    if (path === wanted || path.toLowerCase() === wantedLower) return tag;
  }

  // 2. Suffix / Subpath match (e.g. ./sections/intro.tex matching sections/intro.tex)
  for (const [tag, path] of index.files) {
    const pathLower = path.toLowerCase();
    if (
      pathLower.endsWith(`/${wantedLower}`) ||
      wantedLower.endsWith(`/${pathLower}`) ||
      pathLower.endsWith(wantedLower) ||
      wantedLower.endsWith(pathLower)
    ) {
      return tag;
    }
  }

  // 3. Basename match (e.g. main.tex matching /home/web_user/project_dir/main.tex)
  for (const [tag, path] of index.files) {
    const pathBase = path.toLowerCase().split('/').pop();
    if (pathBase && pathBase === wantedBase) {
      return tag;
    }
  }

  // 4. Fallback if index has only 1 file or main document
  if (index.files.size === 1) {
    const firstTag = index.files.keys().next().value;
    if (typeof firstTag === 'number') return firstTag;

  return null;
}

export function findNearestLine(sorted: number[], target: number): number | null {
  if (sorted.length === 0) return null;
  let low = 0;
  let high = sorted.length - 1;

  while (low <= high) {
    const mid = (low + high) >> 1;
    const val = sorted[mid];
    if (val === target) return val;
    if (val < target) low = mid + 1;
    else high = mid - 1;
  }

  if (low >= sorted.length) return sorted[high];
  if (high < 0) return sorted[low];

  const diffLow = Math.abs(sorted[low] - target);
  const diffHigh = Math.abs(sorted[high] - target);
  return diffLow < diffHigh ? sorted[low] : sorted[high];
}

export function forwardSync(
  index: SyncTexIndex,
  file: string,
  line: number,
  nonce?: number,
): ForwardMatch | null {
  const tag = tagFor(index, file);
  if (tag === null) return null;

  // 1. Fast O(1) / O(log N) lookup if lineIndex is available
  if (index.lineIndex && index.sortedLines) {
    const fileMap = index.lineIndex.get(tag);
    const sorted = index.sortedLines.get(tag);

    if (fileMap && sorted && sorted.length > 0) {
      let targetLine = line;
      let exact = fileMap.has(line);

      if (!exact) {
        const nearest = findNearestLine(sorted, line);
        if (nearest !== null) {
          targetLine = nearest;
        }
      }

      const entries = fileMap.get(targetLine);
      if (entries && entries.length > 0) {
        const page = entries[0].page;
        const pageEntries = entries.filter((e) => e.page === page);
        const hboxes = pageEntries.filter((e) => e.box.kind === 'hbox').map((e) => e.box);
        const rectBoxes = hboxes.length > 0 ? hboxes : pageEntries.map((e) => e.box);

        return {
          page,
          rects: rectBoxes.slice(0, 6).map(boxToRect),
          matchedLine: targetLine,
          exact,
          nonce,
        };
      }
    }
  }

  // 2. Fallback path for manually constructed mock indexes without lineIndex
  let best: { page: number; boxes: SyncTexBox[]; line: number } | null = null;
  let bestDistance = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;

  for (const [page, boxes] of index.pages) {
    for (const box of boxes) {
      if (box.tag !== tag || box.kind === 'vbox') continue;

      const distance = Math.abs(box.line - line);
      if (distance > bestDistance) continue;

      if (distance < bestDistance) {
        bestDistance = distance;
        best = { page, boxes: [box], line: box.line };
      } else if (best && best.page === page && box.line === best.line && box.kind === 'hbox') {
        best.boxes.push(box);
      }
    }
  }

  if (!best) return null;

  return {
    page: best.page,
    rects: best.boxes.slice(0, 6).map(boxToRect),
    matchedLine: best.line,
    exact: bestDistance === 0,
    nonce,
  };
}

function isAuxiliaryMacroFile(filePath: string): boolean {
  const lower = filePath.toLowerCase();
  return (
    lower.endsWith('.cls') ||
    lower.endsWith('.sty') ||
    lower.endsWith('.clo') ||
    lower.endsWith('.aux') ||
    lower.endsWith('.toc') ||
    lower.endsWith('.bbl') ||
    lower.endsWith('.blg') ||
    lower.endsWith('.out') ||
    lower.endsWith('.def') ||
    lower.endsWith('.ldf') ||
    lower.endsWith('.fd') ||
    lower.endsWith('.log')

/**
 * Preview → source (`inverseSync`).
 * Matches horizontal text boxes (`hbox`) and inline nodes (`point`) on the clicked line,
 * heavily weighting vertical proximity (`dy`) so clicking a line of text always
 * resolves to that exact horizontal line rather than an enclosing vertical box.
 */
export function inverseSync(
  index: SyncTexIndex,
  page: number,
  x: number,
  y: number,
): InverseMatch | null {
  const boxes = index.pages.get(page);
  if (!boxes || boxes.length === 0) return null;

  // 1. Filter out internal class/package boxes BEFORE spatial pruning
  // so external .cls/.sty definitions do not crowd out user document text
  const validBoxes = boxes.filter((b) => {
    const file = index.files.get(b.tag);
    return file && !isAuxiliaryMacroFile(file);
  });

  // Prefer hbox and point records over vbox containers
  const pool = validBoxes.length > 0 ? validBoxes : boxes;
  const primaryBoxes = pool.filter((b) => b.kind !== 'vbox');
  const candidates = primaryBoxes.length > 0 ? primaryBoxes : pool;

  // Spatial candidate pruning on dense pages: only test boxes within vertical reach (80pt)
  let candidateList = candidates;
  if (candidates.length > 80) {
    const nearby = candidates.filter((b) => Math.abs(b.y - y) <= 80);
    if (nearby.length > 0) {
      candidateList = nearby;
    }
  }

  let bestContainingHbox: { box: SyncTexBox; score: number } | null = null;
  let bestNearest: { box: SyncTexBox; score: number } | null = null;

  for (const box of candidateList) {
    const file = index.files.get(box.tag);
    if (!file || isAuxiliaryMacroFile(file)) continue;

    const rect = boxToRect(box);

    // Expand hit box slightly for comfortable clicking on text lines and equations
    const insideX = x >= rect.x - 6 && x <= rect.x + rect.width + 6;
    const insideY = y >= rect.y - 3 && y <= rect.y + rect.height + 3;

    if (insideX && insideY && box.kind === 'hbox' && rect.width > 4 && rect.height < 80) {
      // Score by vertical distance to box vertical center + small area tie-breaker
      const centerY = rect.y + rect.height / 2;
      const score = Math.abs(y - centerY) * 10 + rect.height;
      if (!bestContainingHbox || score < bestContainingHbox.score) {
        bestContainingHbox = { box, score };
      }
    }

    const dx = Math.max(rect.x - x, 0, x - (rect.x + rect.width));
    const dy = Math.max(rect.y - y, 0, y - (rect.y + rect.height));
    // Weight vertical distance 6x higher than horizontal distance so clicking in the
    // margin or between words on a line still picks that exact line of text!
    const kindPenalty = box.kind === 'hbox' ? 0 : box.kind === 'point' ? 4 : 30;
    const distScore = dy * 6 + dx + kindPenalty;

    if (!bestNearest || distScore < bestNearest.score) {
      bestNearest = { box, score: distScore };
    }
  }

  const chosen = bestContainingHbox?.box ?? bestNearest?.box;
  if (!chosen) return null;

  const file = index.files.get(chosen.tag);
  if (!file) return null;

  return {
    file,
    line: chosen.line,
    column: chosen.column,
    exact: Boolean(bestContainingHbox),
  };
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Teeex — project to TeX engine mapping.
 *
 * Decides *what* gets compiled and *which* auxiliary passes are needed. Kept
 * separate from the engine service so it can be tested without loading the
 * WASM runtime.
 */

import type { ProjectFile } from '../types/latex';
import { mountVirtualTeXFileSystem } from './virtualFileSystem';
import { BUNDLED_PACKAGES, getCachedPackageContent } from './bundledPackages';

/** A file as the engine's virtual filesystem expects it. */
export interface EngineFile {
  path: string;
  content: string | Uint8Array;
  hash?: string;
}

export function computeCitationSignature(files: ProjectFile[], citations?: string[]): string {
  const bibFiles = files.filter((f) => f.name.endsWith('.bib'));
  let bibHash = 0x811c9dc5;
  for (const bf of bibFiles) {
    for (let i = 0; i < bf.content.length; i++) {
      bibHash = Math.imul(bibHash ^ bf.content.charCodeAt(i), 0x01000193);
    }
  }
  const citKey = (citations || []).slice().sort().join(';');
  return `${(bibHash >>> 0).toString(36)}:${citKey}`;
}

/**
 * Picks the file to compile.
 *
 * Compiling whichever file is open in the editor is wrong: an `\input`-ed
 * section has no preamble and cannot compile standalone, so editing
 * `sections/intro.tex` would always fail. The entry file is the only valid
 * root.
 *
 * Detection falls back through explicit marking, then convention, then the
 * strongest available signal — a `\documentclass`, which only a root document
 * has.
 */
export function resolveEntryFile(files: ProjectFile[]): ProjectFile | null {
  const texFiles = files.filter((file) => file.name.endsWith('.tex'));
  if (texFiles.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    texFiles.find((file) => file.isEntry) ??
    texFiles.find((file) => file.name === 'main.tex') ??
    texFiles.find((file) =>
      /\\documentclass\s*(?:\[[^\]]*\])?\s*\{/.test(file.content),
    ) ??
    texFiles[0]
  );
}

/**
 * Project files as engine filesystem entries, excluding the entry file (which
 * is passed separately as the compile input).
 *
 * Binary assets must stay binary. Image files carry their bytes in `dataUrl`,
 * not `content`; handing TeX the empty `content` string — as this previously
 * did — means `\includegraphics` can never resolve a figure.
 * `mountVirtualTeXFileSystem` already decodes data URLs to `Uint8Array`, and
 * aliases each file under the several paths LaTeX might reference it by.
 */
export function toEngineFiles(
  files: ProjectFile[],
  entryPath: string,
): EngineFile[] {
  const mounted = mountVirtualTeXFileSystem(files);
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const out: EngineFile[] = [];

  for (const [alias, entry] of mounted) {
    if (alias === entryPath) continue;
    // The mount aliases one payload under several keys; send each file once,
    // under the alias LaTeX is most likely to use.
    if (seen.has(alias)) continue;
    seen.add(alias);

    const c = entry.content;
    let hash = '';
    if (typeof c === 'string') {
      let h = 0x811c9dc5;
      const cLen = c.length;
      for (let i = 0; i < cLen; i++) {
        h = Math.imul(h ^ c.charCodeAt(i), 0x01000193);
      }
      hash = `${cLen}:${(h >>> 0).toString(36)}`;
    } else {
      const bLen = c.byteLength;
      let bHash = 0x811c9dc5;
      const sampleLimit = Math.min(bLen, 65536);
      for (let i = 0; i < sampleLimit; i++) {
        bHash = Math.imul(bHash ^ c[i], 0x01000193);
      }
      hash = `${bLen}:${(bHash >>> 0).toString(36)}`;
    }

    out.push({ path: alias, content: entry.content, hash });
  }

  // Pre-seed academic classes, styles, and companion assets directly into working directory if referenced
  const entryFile = files.find((file) => file.name === entryPath);
  const entryContent = entryFile?.content || '';

  const requestedClasses = new Set<string>();
  for (const match of entryContent.matchAll(/\\documentclass\s*(?:\[[^\]]*\])?\s*\{([^}]+)\}/gi)) {
    for (const name of match[1].split(',')) {
      const trimmed = name.trim();
      if (trimmed) requestedClasses.add(trimmed.toLowerCase());
    }
  }

  const requestedPackages = new Set<string>();
  for (const match of entryContent.matchAll(/\\(?:usepackage|RequirePackage)\s*(?:\[[^\]]*\])?\s*\{([^}]+)\}/gi)) {
    for (const name of match[1].split(',')) {
      const trimmed = name.trim();
      if (trimmed) requestedPackages.add(trimmed.toLowerCase());
    }
  }

  for (const pkg of BUNDLED_PACKAGES) {
    if (seen.has(pkg.name)) continue;

    let shouldMount = false;
    const lowerName = pkg.name.toLowerCase();

    if (lowerName.endsWith('.cls')) {
      const base = lowerName.slice(0, -4);
      if (requestedClasses.has(base)) shouldMount = true;
    } else if (lowerName.endsWith('.sty')) {
      const base = lowerName.slice(0, -4);
      if (requestedPackages.has(base)) {
        shouldMount = true;
      } else if (base === 'caption3' && (requestedPackages.has('caption') || requestedPackages.has('subcaption'))) {
        shouldMount = true;
      } else if (base === 'everysel' && requestedPackages.has('ragged2e')) {
        shouldMount = true;
      } else if ((base === 'totpages' || base === 'environ') && requestedClasses.has('acmart')) {
        shouldMount = true;
      } else if (base === 'program' && requestedClasses.has('sn-jnl')) {
        shouldMount = true;
      }
    } else if (lowerName === 'microtype-pdftex.def' && requestedPackages.has('microtype')) {
      shouldMount = true;
    } else if (lowerName === 'lipsum.ltd' && requestedPackages.has('lipsum')) {
      shouldMount = true;
    } else if (lowerName === 'tfrupee.tfm' && requestedPackages.has('tfrupee')) {
      shouldMount = true;
    } else if (
      (lowerName.endsWith('.tfm') || lowerName.endsWith('.fd')) &&
      (requestedClasses.has('ieeetran') || requestedClasses.has('acmart') || requestedClasses.has('sn-jnl'))
    ) {
      shouldMount = true;
    } else if (
      lowerName === 'acm-reference-format.bst' &&
      (requestedClasses.has('acmart') || entryContent.includes('ACM-Reference-Format'))
    ) {
      shouldMount = true;
    } else if (
      lowerName === 'sn-basic.bst' &&
      (requestedClasses.has('sn-jnl') || entryContent.includes('sn-basic'))
    ) {
      shouldMount = true;
    }

    if (shouldMount) {
      const cached = getCachedPackageContent(pkg.name);
      if (cached) {
        seen.add(pkg.name);
        out.push({ path: pkg.name, content: cached });
      }
    }
  }

  return out;
}

export interface BibliographyConfig {
  needed: boolean;
  engine: 'bibtex' | 'biblatex-biber' | 'none';
  hasBibFile: boolean;
  usesBiblatex: boolean;
  warning?: string;
}

/**
 * Inspects document bibliography directives to determine if BibTeX is needed
 * and detect incompatible Biber-only configurations in the browser environment.
 */
export function detectBibliographyConfig(files: ProjectFile[], source: string): BibliographyConfig {
  const hasBibFile = files.some((file) => file.name.endsWith('.bib'));
  const usesBiblatex = /\\usepackage(?:\s*\[[^\]]*\])?\s*\{\s*biblatex\s*\}/.test(source);
  const usesBibtexBackend = /\\usepackage\s*\[[^\]]*backend\s*=\s*bibtex[^\]]*\]\s*\{\s*biblatex\s*\}/.test(source);
  const usesNatbibOrStandard = /\\(?:bibliography|bibliographystyle)\b/.test(source);
  const usesAddBibResource = /\\addbibresource\b/.test(source);

  if (!hasBibFile && !usesAddBibResource) {
    return { needed: false, engine: 'none', hasBibFile: false, usesBiblatex: false };
  }

  if (usesBiblatex) {
    if (usesBibtexBackend) {
      return {
        needed: hasBibFile,
        engine: 'bibtex',
        hasBibFile,
        usesBiblatex: true,
      };
    }
    return {
      needed: false,
      engine: 'biblatex-biber',
      hasBibFile,
      usesBiblatex: true,
      warning:
        'biblatex defaults to Biber backend. In browser TeX, use \\usepackage[backend=bibtex]{biblatex} to compile with the bundled BibTeX engine.',
    };
  }

  if (usesNatbibOrStandard || usesAddBibResource) {
    return {
      needed: hasBibFile,
      engine: 'bibtex',
      hasBibFile,
      usesBiblatex: false,
    };
  }

  return { needed: false, engine: 'none', hasBibFile, usesBiblatex: false };
}

/**
 * Whether a BibTeX pass is needed.
 *
 * Running BibTeX unconditionally costs a pass on every compile and emits
 * spurious "I found no \citation commands" errors into the log, which then
 * surface as diagnostics on a document that is actually fine.
 */
export function needsBibtex(files: ProjectFile[], source: string): boolean {
  return detectBibliographyConfig(files, source).needed;
}

export function needsMakeindex(source: string): boolean {
  return /\\(?:makeindex|printindex)\b/.test(source);
}
````

````css
/* ==========================================================================
   Transient notice

   For actions that cannot be completed, where the reason belongs to the user's
   intent rather than to the document — asking to export before a successful
   build exists, for instance. Document problems belong in the diagnostics
   dock, not here.
   ========================================================================== */

.app-toast {
  position: fixed;
  left: 50%;
  bottom: 28px;
  z-index: 9000;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  max-width: min(560px, calc(100vw - 32px));
  padding: 10px 12px 10px 16px;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  background: var(--bg-surface-elevated);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-medium);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 32px -8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
  animation: toastIn 0.26s var(--ease-spring);
}

.app-toast button {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  background: none;
  border: none;
  border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.app-toast button:hover {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  background: var(--bg-hover);
}

@keyframes toastIn {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translate(-50%, 8px);
  }

  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translate(-50%, 0);
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .app-toast {
    animation: none;
  }
}

/* ==========================================================================
   Preview shell: surface switch
   ========================================================================== */

.preview-shell {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 0;
  background: var(--bg-app);
  border-left: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.preview-surface-switch {
  display: flex;
  align-items: stretch;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  height: 30px;
  padding: 0 8px;
  gap: 2px;
  background: var(--bg-surface-0);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
}

.preview-surface-tab {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  padding: 0 11px;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  background: none;
  border: none;
  /* The active marker is a bottom rule, so the row keeps a single baseline and
     nothing shifts when selection changes. */
  border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: color var(--transition-fast), border-color var(--transition-fast);
}

.preview-surface-tab:hover {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.preview-surface-tab.is-active {

  border-bottom-color: var(--accent-cyan);
}

.preview-surface-tab:focus-visible {

  outline-offset: -2px;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   Outline surface

   A draft skim of the source. One continuous column — it does not paginate,

   ========================================================================== */

.outline-pane {

  flex-direction: column;
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
}

.outline-notice {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 7px 14px;
  font-size: 11px;

  background: var(--bg-surface-1);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
}

}

.outline-scroll {

.outline-sheet {

/* The draft markup carries `.latex-*` classes styled in index.css for the old

.outline-body.latex-paper-sheet {

/* Columns are a layout decision belonging to the document class, not to a

.outline-body .paper-body {

/* ==========================================================================
   Compiled PDF viewer

   The viewer paints the artifact the TeX engine produced, so its styling must
   never influence geometry: page boxes are sized from PDF page geometry in JS,
   and nothing here adds padding, borders, or transforms inside a page.

   Built on the token system in index.css so both themes are covered; the
   previous viewer hardcoded hex literals and stayed dark-on-light in light
   mode.
   ========================================================================== */

.pdf-pane {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 0;
  background: var(--bg-app);
}

/* --- Toolbar ------------------------------------------------------------ */

.pdf-toolbar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  height: 38px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  padding: 0 10px;
  background: var(--bg-surface-0);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
}

.pdf-toolbar-group {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.pdf-toolbar-divider {
  width: 1px;
  height: 16px;
  margin: 0 6px;
  background: var(--border-subtle);
}

.pdf-toolbar-status {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  min-width: 0;
  /* The status region yields space before the controls do. */
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  justify-content: center;
}

.pdf-page-indicator,
.pdf-zoom-readout {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  min-width: 52px;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 3px 6px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
}

.pdf-zoom-readout {
  background: none;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background var(--transition-fast), border-color var(--transition-fast);
}

.pdf-zoom-readout:hover {
  background: var(--bg-hover);
  border-color: var(--border-subtle);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.pdf-status {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  padding: 3px 9px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.pdf-status-busy,
.pdf-status-compiling {
  color: var(--accent-cyan);
  background: var(--accent-cyan-glow);
}

.pdf-status-current {
  color: #10b981;
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.14);
  border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.28);
}

.pdf-status-warn,
.pdf-status-stale {
  color: var(--accent-amber);
  background: var(--accent-amber-glow);
  border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.25);
}

.pdf-status-failed {
  color: #f43f5e;
  background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.14);
  border: 1px solid rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.3);
}

/* --- Scroll surface ----------------------------------------------------- */

.pdf-scroll {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: auto;
  /* Keeps wheel momentum inside the viewer instead of chaining to the page. */
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
  padding: 24px;
  background:
    radial-gradient(120% 100% at 50% 0%,
      color-mix(in oklab, var(--bg-surface-0) 55%, transparent),
      transparent 70%),
    var(--bg-app);
}

.pdf-scroll:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--border-focus);
  outline-offset: -2px;
}

.pdf-pages-container,
.pdf-pages {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  /* Narrow viewports: keep the page reachable rather than clipping its left
     edge, which centering alone would do once a page is wider than the pane. */
  min-width: fit-content;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.pdf-page-wrapper {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
}

/* --- Page --------------------------------------------------------------- */

.pdf-page {
  position: relative;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  background: #ffffff;
  /* A page is a physical object; the shadow is the only decoration, and it sits
     outside the page box so it cannot affect geometry. */
  box-shadow:
    0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28),
    0 10px 28px -6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42);
}

.pdf-page-canvas {
  display: block;
  /* Guards against a stale bitmap being stretched for one frame after a zoom
     change, before the re-raster lands. */
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}

.pdf-page-placeholder {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #cbd5e1;
  background: #ffffff;
}

/* --- Text layer ---------------------------------------------------------

   Geometry here comes from pdf.js, which positions each run using
   --scale-factor. The text is transparent and sits exactly over the painted
   glyphs, so selection and search work against the real document.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

.pdf-text-layer {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  line-height: 1;
  text-align: initial;
  text-size-adjust: none;
  forced-color-adjust: none;
  transform-origin: 0 0;
  z-index: 2;
  /* Caret colour would otherwise be inherited from the dark app shell. */
  caret-color: #000000;
}

.pdf-text-layer span,
.pdf-text-layer br {
  position: absolute;
  white-space: pre;
  cursor: text;
  color: transparent;
  transform-origin: 0 0;
}

.pdf-text-layer span[role='img'] {

}

.pdf-text-layer ::selection {

}

/* pdf.js emits this marker element; it must not be selectable or visible. */
.pdf-text-layer .endOfContent {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 100% 0 0;
  display: block;
  z-index: 0;
  cursor: default;
  user-select: none;
}

/* --- Annotation & Link layer -------------------------------------------- */

.pdf-annotation-layer {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 4;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.pdf-link-annotation {
  position: absolute;
  pointer-events: auto;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: transparent;
  transition: background 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
  outline: none;
}

.pdf-link-annotation:hover,
.pdf-link-annotation:focus-visible {

  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent-cyan) 45%, transparent);
}

.pdf-link-annotation.is-unsafe {

  pointer-events: none;

}

/* --- SyncTeX highlight --------------------------------------------------- */

.pdf-highlight-layer {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 3;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.pdf-highlight {
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent-cyan) 26%, transparent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent-cyan) 55%, transparent);
  animation: pdfHighlightIn 1.6s var(--ease-spring) forwards;
}

@keyframes pdfHighlightIn {
  0% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(1.08);
  }

  18% {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: scale(1);
  }

  70% {

  }

  }
}

/* --- Inverse SyncTeX click ripple -------------------------------------- */

.pdf-sync-ripple {
  position: absolute;
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  margin-left: -11px;
  margin-top: -11px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent-cyan) 45%, transparent);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--accent-cyan);
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent-cyan) 70%, transparent);
  pointer-events: none;

}

@keyframes pdfRipple {

  100% {

}

/* --- Empty, loading and error states ------------------------------------ */

.pdf-empty {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  max-width: 420px;
  margin: 15vh auto 0;
  padding: 0 16px;

}

.pdf-empty-icon {

}

.pdf-empty-error .pdf-empty-icon {

}

.pdf-empty-title {

}

.pdf-empty-detail {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.55;

  /* Engine errors can be long and contain paths; keep them readable. */
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

/* --- Shared bits -------------------------------------------------------- */

.btn-icon {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 26px;
  height: 24px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
  background: none;

}

.btn-icon:hover:not(:disabled) {

}

.btn-icon:disabled {

}

.btn-primary-sm {

  background: var(--accent-cyan-glow);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent-cyan) 32%, transparent);

    background var(--transition-fast),

.btn-primary-sm:hover:not(:disabled) {

}

.btn-primary-sm:disabled {
  opacity: 0.4;
  cursor: default;
}

.spin {
  animation: spin 0.9s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes spin {

/* A spinner is the one animation that must keep running to remain truthful —

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {

}

/* ==========================================================================
   Compile Progress Bar & Status Badges
   ========================================================================== */

.pdf-compile-progress-bar {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: 2.5px;
  background: var(--bg-surface-1);
  overflow: hidden;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  z-index: 20;
}

.pdf-compile-progress-bar::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  width: 45%;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #38bdf8, #818cf8, #38bdf8);
  border-radius: 999px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.7);
  animation: compileProgressIndeterminate 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite;
}

@keyframes compileProgressIndeterminate {
  0% {
    left: -45%;
  }

  50% {
    left: 40%;
    width: 60%;
  }

  100% {
    left: 105%;
  }
}

.pdf-status-duration {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  padding: 2px 7px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
  background: var(--bg-surface-1);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

.pdf-status-queued {
  color: #38bdf8;
  background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.1);
  border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 3px 9px;
  border-radius: 999px;
}

.pulse-dot {
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #38bdf8;
  box-shadow: 0 0 6px #38bdf8;
  display: inline-block;
  animation: pulseDot 1s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}

@keyframes pulseDot {

    transform: scale(0.8);
    opacity: 0.5;

/* Smooth Page Entrance & Shimmer Skeleton */
.pdf-page {

  opacity: 0;

}

  opacity: 1;
}

  }

    background-position: 200% 0;
  }

  background: linear-gradient(90deg,
      rgba(241, 245, 249, 0.95) 25%,
      rgba(226, 232, 240, 0.98) 50%,

  animation: pdfShimmer 1.6s infinite linear;

@keyframes synctexLaserPulse {

    background-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.48);

    background-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.28);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25);

    background-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.14);
    box-shadow: none;
    transform: scaleY(1);
  }
}

.pdf-highlight {
  border-radius: 3px;

}

.pdf-status-duration {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.1);
  border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.22);
  color: #38bdf8;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 11px;
}

/* In-document Find Bar */
.pdf-find-bar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 6px 12px;
  background: var(--bg-surface, #18181b);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  font-size: 12px;
}

.pdf-find-input-wrap {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  background: var(--bg-base, #09090b);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 4px);
  padding: 2px 8px;
  flex: 1;
  max-width: 320px;
}

.pdf-find-input-wrap:focus-within {
  border-color: var(--accent-cyan);
}

.pdf-find-input {
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: 12px;
  width: 100%;
  outline: none;
}

.pdf-find-count {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--text-tertiary);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.pdf-find-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
}

/* Page Jump Input */
.pdf-page-jumper {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 3px;
}

.pdf-page-input {
  width: 34px;
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: var(--radius-xs, 3px);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  text-align: right;
  padding: 1px 4px;
  outline: none;
  -moz-appearance: textfield;
}

.pdf-page-input::-webkit-outer-spin-button,
.pdf-page-input::-webkit-inner-spin-button {
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  margin: 0;
}

.pdf-page-input:hover,
.pdf-page-input:focus {
  background: var(--bg-hover);
  border-color: var(--border-subtle);
}

.pdf-page-total {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
````
