## File: scripts/fetch-engine.mjs
````javascript
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * Teeex — TeX engine asset provisioning.
 *
 * The authoritative layout engine is pdfLaTeX compiled to WebAssembly
 * (texlyre-busytex / TeX Live 2026). Its assets are NOT on npm: the complete
 * release archive is ~522 MB, which is infeasible to commit or to pull through
 * a build step.
 *
 * This script fetches only the subset the configured engine profile actually
 * loads (~159.5 MB for pdftex), straight into `public/core/busytex/`, so the
 * worker is served same-origin and version-pinned rather than proxied from a
 * third party at runtime.
 *
 * Cryptographic SHA-256 hashes are calculated on fetch/copy, validated against
 * the pinned upstream golden digests, and stored in `.teeex-manifest.json`.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   node scripts/fetch-engine.mjs                  # pdftex profile (default)
 *   node scripts/fetch-engine.mjs --profile pages  # assets <= 25MB for static Pages
 *   node scripts/fetch-engine.mjs --force          # re-download, ignore manifest
 *   node scripts/fetch-engine.mjs --verify         # check sizes & sha256 digests
 *
 * Env:
 *   TEEEX_ENGINE_BASE_URL   override the asset source origin
 */

import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { createReadStream, createWriteStream, existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import { mkdir, readFile, rename, rm, stat, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { dirname, join, resolve } from 'node:path';
import { Readable } from 'node:stream';
import { pipeline } from 'node:stream/promises';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const ROOT = resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
const DEST = join(ROOT, 'public', 'core', 'busytex');
const MANIFEST = join(DEST, '.teeex-manifest.json');
const PATCHES_DIR = join(ROOT, 'scripts', 'engine-patches');

/**
 * Pinned to the texlyre-busytex version in package.json.
 */
const ENGINE_VERSION = '1.4.0';
const DEFAULT_BASE_URL = 'https://texlyre.github.io/texlyre-busytex/core/busytex';

/**
 * Golden SHA-256 digests for official upstream texlyre-busytex@1.4.0 release files.
 */
const GOLDEN_UPSTREAM_DIGESTS = {
  'biber.data': ['9ea1357e6180477479b5edfe17538ba655ebebc03142a195d85fb1d47899df21'],
  'biber.js': [
    'f08b8db474874ea8213ee6146847c778d5cf4e00f7856237ad7c428484948868', // remote texlyre.github.io
    'f097b241ec1dfaff8c43b7c3e242a85c535d4a24b6252288da869d1a8b465c08', // local release
  ],
  'biber.wasm': ['6c2ddccf3b95e06b419d4aee5f88ef10ddec658ce760fabb34d7145371ff18c5'],
  'busytex_biber.js': [
    '1dfc8f07df938fde690303f67b108d8b9efc8039e60b56bac0f6586835fc7147', // remote texlyre.github.io
    'e1a3ff55a120e392d3a7ef27f1bff1978c7a9d5978999296e39e1cfeac01d923', // local release
  ],
  'busytex.wasm': ['8d1988fc58cd1611c3cbd6bd986c3e607e5ff44f1d94252207ff7aae4cee72e0'],
  'texlive-basic.data': ['ccb35d98d77cbaf988e1481f8538709f72166196785cf6b8785eabe6c8fb2993'],
  'texlive-basic.js': [
    '3f4f6006df549f8f36fe7262911b4b1c1943c24b9d45c9ac4521d0f09fd66fc3', // remote texlyre.github.io
    'd4abc2e93a1ae33099107c6ad8a61813978cd44036a95697db2f2365a393c283', // local release
  ],
  'busytex.js': [
    '752060769b85f104ecb314f50a77786f0f4c098e2fe539e892416b13295cb95d', // remote texlyre.github.io
    'c505d883028d95bcffa692f994aa9e2c97b89022c63d8519a43c58bd715a7470', // local release
  ],
  'busytex_pipeline.js': [
    '2625186ee7b454049b5479a7b50476369e3d9c30bc6eb9435d85067cca5cd0d2', // remote texlyre.github.io
    '509475fdf6996e45bea5deaa2f5ca9dd1ce25d44b2208ab03b95a63123b2c6f6', // local release
  ],
  'busytex_worker.js': [
    'a38e756734f99d37bbdcaf7f315e332150f9f0a45ccb2adb551e54478ba664d1', // remote texlyre.github.io
    '04c77465d87885628663420838b288a6f870915995988ec7c4c320014e41b74d', // local release
  ],
};

/**
 * Derived from BusyTexRunner.initializeWorker() / getEngineAssetNames() /
 * getBiberAssetPaths() in texlyre-busytex.
 */
const PROFILES = {
  pdftex: [
    'busytex_worker.js',
    'busytex_pipeline.js',
    'busytex_biber.js',
    'busytex.js',
    'busytex.wasm',
    'texlive-basic.js',
    'texlive-basic.data',
    'biber.js',
    'biber.wasm',
    'biber.data',
  ],
  full: [
    'busytex_worker.js',
    'busytex_pipeline.js',
    'busytex_biber.js',
    'busytex.js',
    'busytex.wasm',
    'texlive-basic.js',
    'texlive-basic.data',
    'biber.js',
    'biber.wasm',
    'biber.data',
  ],
  pages: [
    'busytex_worker.js',
    'busytex_pipeline.js',
    'busytex_biber.js',
    'busytex.js',
    'texlive-basic.js',
    'biber.js',
    'biber.wasm',
  ],
};

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const flag = (name) => args.includes(`--${name}`);
const option = (name, fallback) => {
  const i = args.indexOf(`--${name}`);
  return i !== -1 && args[i + 1] ? args[i + 1] : fallback;
};

const isCloudflare = Boolean(
  process.env.CF_PAGES === '1' ||
  process.env.CF_PAGES ||
  process.env.CF_PAGES_COMMIT_SHA ||
  process.env.CF_PAGES_BRANCH ||
  process.env.CLOUDFLARE_PAGES
);
const defaultProfile = isCloudflare ? 'pages' : 'pdftex';
const profileName = option('profile', defaultProfile);
const configuredBaseUrl = process.env.TEEEX_ENGINE_BASE_URL || DEFAULT_BASE_URL;
const LOCAL_RELEASE = join(ROOT, 'tmp-busytex-assets', 'busytex');
const force = flag('force');
const verifyOnly = flag('verify');

const files = PROFILES[profileName];
if (!files) {
  fail(
    `Unknown profile "${profileName}". Available: ${Object.keys(PROFILES).join(', ')}.`,
  );
}

function fail(message) {
  console.error(`\n  ERROR  ${message}\n`);
  process.exit(1);
}

function mib(bytes) {
  return `${(bytes / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)} MiB`;
}

async function computeSha256(filePath) {
  const hash = createHash('sha256');
  const stream = createReadStream(filePath);
  for await (const chunk of stream) {
    hash.update(chunk);
  }
  return hash.digest('hex');
}

async function readManifest() {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(await readFile(MANIFEST, 'utf8'));
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

const CONCURRENCY = 4;

class Semaphore {
  #queue = [];
  #running = 0;
  #concurrency;

  constructor(concurrency) {
    this.#concurrency = concurrency;
  }

  run(fn) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      this.#queue.push({ fn, resolve, reject });
      this.#drain();
    });
  }

  #drain() {
    while (this.#running < this.#concurrency && this.#queue.length > 0) {
      const { fn, resolve, reject } = this.#queue.shift();
      this.#running++;
      fn()
        .then(resolve, reject)
        .finally(() => {
          this.#running--;
          this.#drain();
        });
    }
  }
}

const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

async function getLocalFileInfo(filePath) {
  try {
    const s = await stat(filePath);
    return s.isFile() && s.size > 0 ? s : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/** True when every file in the profile matches both byte size and sha256. */
async function isProvisioned(manifest) {
  if (!manifest) return false;
  if (manifest.engineVersion !== ENGINE_VERSION) return false;

  for (const name of files) {
    const recorded = manifest.files?.[name];
    if (!recorded || !recorded.sha256) return false;
    try {
      const filePath = join(DEST, name);
      const stats = await stat(filePath);
      if (stats.size !== recorded.bytes) return false;
      const actualDigest = await computeSha256(filePath);
      if (actualDigest !== recorded.sha256) return false;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }
  return true;
}

/**
 * Downloads or copies an asset to disk via a temp file so an interrupted run never leaves
 * a truncated .wasm or .data behind. Validates against golden upstream digests.
 */
async function download(name, localInfo) {
  const localSource = join(LOCAL_RELEASE, name);
  const target = join(DEST, name);
  const temp = `${target}.partial`;

  try {
    if (localInfo) {
      await pipeline(
        createReadStream(localSource),
        createWriteStream(temp)
      );

      const copied = await stat(temp);
      if (copied.size !== localInfo.size) {
        await rm(temp, { force: true });
        throw new Error(
          `Size mismatch copying ${name}: source=${localInfo.size}, copied=${copied.size}`
        );
      }

      const digest = await computeSha256(temp);
      const expected = GOLDEN_UPSTREAM_DIGESTS[name];
      const allowedDigests = Array.isArray(expected) ? expected : (expected ? [expected] : []);
      if (allowedDigests.length > 0 && !allowedDigests.includes(digest)) {
        await rm(temp, { force: true });
        throw new Error(
          `Checksum mismatch copying ${name}: expected ${allowedDigests.join(' or ')}, actual=${digest}`
        );
      }

      await rename(temp, target);
      return { bytes: copied.size, sha256: digest, source: 'local' };
    }

    // Remote download fallback with retry
    const url = `${configuredBaseUrl.replace(/\/+$/, '')}/${name}`;
    let res;
    let lastError;
    const maxRetries = 3;

    for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= maxRetries; attempt++) {
      try {
        res = await fetch(url);
        if (res.ok && res.body) break;
        lastError = new Error(`HTTP ${res.status} ${res.statusText} fetching ${url}`);
      } catch (err) {
        lastError = err;
      }
      if (attempt < maxRetries) {
        await sleep(300 * attempt);
      }
    }

    if (!res || !res.ok || !res.body) {
      throw lastError || new Error(`Failed to fetch ${url}`);
    }

    const contentEncoding = res.headers.get('content-encoding');
    const rawContentLength = res.headers.get('content-length');
    const expectedLength = !contentEncoding && rawContentLength
      ? parseInt(rawContentLength, 10)
      : null;

    await pipeline(
      Readable.fromWeb(res.body),
      createWriteStream(temp)
    );

    const downloaded = await stat(temp);
    if (expectedLength && downloaded.size !== expectedLength) {
      await rm(temp, { force: true });
      throw new Error(
        `Size mismatch downloading ${name}: expected=${expectedLength}, downloaded=${downloaded.size}`
      );
    }
    if (downloaded.size === 0) {
      await rm(temp, { force: true });
      throw new Error(`Downloaded zero-byte asset: ${name}`);
    }

    const digest = await computeSha256(temp);
    const expected = GOLDEN_UPSTREAM_DIGESTS[name];
    const allowedDigests = Array.isArray(expected) ? expected : (expected ? [expected] : []);
    if (allowedDigests.length > 0 && !allowedDigests.includes(digest)) {
      await rm(temp, { force: true });
      throw new Error(
        `Checksum mismatch downloading ${name}: expected ${allowedDigests.join(' or ')}, actual=${digest}`
      );
    }

    await rename(temp, target);
    return { bytes: downloaded.size, sha256: digest, source: 'remote' };
  } catch (error) {
    await rm(temp, { force: true }).catch(() => {});
    throw error;
  }
}

async function applyEnginePatches() {
  const patchFiles = ['busytex_pipeline.js', 'busytex_worker.js', 'busytex.js'];
  const applied = {};
  for (const patchName of patchFiles) {
    const patchPath = join(PATCHES_DIR, patchName);
    const patchStat = await getLocalFileInfo(patchPath);
    if (patchStat) {
      const destPath = join(DEST, patchName);
      await pipeline(
        createReadStream(patchPath),
        createWriteStream(destPath)
      );
      const digest = await computeSha256(destPath);
      applied[patchName] = { size: patchStat.size, sha256: digest };
    }
  }
  return applied;
}

async function main() {
  const hasLocalRelease = (await getLocalFileInfo(join(LOCAL_RELEASE, 'busytex_worker.js'))) !== null;
  const baseUrl = hasLocalRelease ? 'local-release:texlyre-busytex@1.4.0' : configuredBaseUrl;

  console.log('\n  Teeex TeX engine assets');
  console.log(`  profile  ${profileName} (${files.length} files)`);
  console.log(`  source   ${hasLocalRelease ? 'local official release assets' : configuredBaseUrl}`);
  console.log('  dest     public/core/busytex\n');

  if (verifyOnly) {
    const existing = await readManifest();

    if (!existing || !(await isProvisioned(existing))) {
      fail(
        'The asset manifest is missing, corrupt, or stale.\n' +
        '         Run: node scripts/fetch-engine.mjs'
      );
    }

    console.log(`  Verified ${files.length} local assets with SHA-256 integrity.\n`);
    return;
  }

  await mkdir(DEST, { recursive: true });

  // Clean up any unreferenced 205MB assets that may be lingering on disk
  const bloatFiles = ['texlive-recommended.data', 'texlive-recommended.js', 'busytex.js.pre-diagnostic-restore'];
  for (const b of bloatFiles) {
    await rm(join(DEST, b), { force: true }).catch(() => {});
  }

  // When building with the 'pages' profile, clean up files >25MB
  if (profileName === 'pages') {
    const heavyFiles = [
      'busytex.wasm',
      'texlive-basic.data',
      'biber.data',
    ];
    for (const heavy of heavyFiles) {
      await rm(join(DEST, heavy), { force: true }).catch(() => {});
    }
  }

  const sem = new Semaphore(CONCURRENCY);
  const results = new Array(files.length);

  await Promise.all(
    files.map((name, index) =>
      sem.run(async () => {
        const localSourceInfo = await getLocalFileInfo(join(LOCAL_RELEASE, name));

        let info;
        try {
          info = await stat(join(DEST, name));
        } catch (error) {
          if (error?.code !== 'ENOENT') throw error;
        }

        const needsFetch =
          force ||
          !info ||
          !info.isFile() ||
          info.size === 0 ||
          (localSourceInfo && info.size !== localSourceInfo.size);

        let sha256Digest = null;
        if (needsFetch) {
          const downloadResult = await download(name, localSourceInfo);
          info = { isFile: () => true, size: downloadResult.bytes };
          sha256Digest = downloadResult.sha256;
        } else {
          sha256Digest = await computeSha256(join(DEST, name));
        }

        if (!info || !info.isFile() || info.size === 0) {
          fail(`Missing or empty engine asset: ${name}`);
        }

        results[index] = { name, size: info.size, sha256: sha256Digest };
      })
    )
  );

  const patched = await applyEnginePatches();
  for (const [name, patchInfo] of Object.entries(patched)) {
    const resIdx = results.findIndex((r) => r && r.name === name);
    if (resIdx !== -1) {
      results[resIdx].size = patchInfo.size;
      results[resIdx].sha256 = patchInfo.sha256;
    }
  }

  const record = {};
  let totalBytes = 0;

  for (const [index, { name, size, sha256 }] of results.entries()) {
    const position = `${String(index + 1).padStart(2)}/${files.length}`;
    record[name] = {
      bytes: size,
      sha256,
    };
    totalBytes += size;
    console.log(
      `  ${position}  ${name.padEnd(24)} ${mib(size).padStart(9)}   sha256:${sha256.slice(0, 8)}...`
    );
  }

  const manifest = {
    engineVersion: ENGINE_VERSION,
    profile: profileName,
    baseUrl,
    provisionedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    totalBytes,
    files: record,
  };

  await writeFile(
    MANIFEST,
    `${JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2)}\n`,
  );

  console.log(
    `\n  Validated ${files.length} engine assets, ${mib(totalBytes)} total with SHA-256 integrity.`
  );
}

main().catch((error) => {
  console.error('\n  FATAL: Engine provisioning failed.');
  console.error(error?.stack || error);
  process.exitCode = 1;
});
````

          triggerAnnoyanceReaction('disturbed_sleep');
        } else if (playSpecificAnimation) {
          playSpecificAnimation('drama-flop', 3200);
        } else {
          wakeUp?.();
        }
      } else {
        wakeUp?.();
      }
    } else {
      triggerPet?.();
      setShowHearts(true);
      setTimeout(() => setShowHearts(false), 1400);
    }
  };

  const handleDoubleClick = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    triggerYarnChase?.();
  };

  // Click-to-copy & insert mathematical dream formula (Surprise Easter Egg)
  const handleCopyFormula = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    try {
      if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.clipboard) {
        void navigator.clipboard.writeText(currentDreamFormula);
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore
    }
    if (onInsertFormula && currentDreamFormula) {
      onInsertFormula(currentDreamFormula);
    }
    setHasCopiedFormula(true);
    setTimeout(() => setHasCopiedFormula(false), 1600);
  };

  // Keyboard accessibility handler
  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    const key = e.key.toLowerCase();
    if (key === ' ' || key === 'enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      handleClick(e as unknown as React.MouseEvent);
    } else if (key === 'y') {
      e.preventDefault();
      triggerYarnChase?.();
    } else if (key === 'p') {
      e.preventDefault();
      triggerPeekABoo?.();
    } else if (key === 'l') {
      e.preventDefault();
      triggerLaser?.();
    } else if (key === 'b') {
      e.preventDefault();
      triggerBox?.();
    } else if (key === 'f') {
      e.preventDefault();
      triggerFish?.();
    } else if (key === 'k') {
      e.preventDefault();
      triggerKnuthCelebration?.();
    } else if (key === 'r') {
      e.preventDefault();
      toggleRoamMode?.();
    } else if (key === 'w') {
      e.preventDefault();
      triggerRoam?.();
    } else if (key === 's') {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (toggleSleep) {
        toggleSleep();
      } else {
        wakeUp?.();
      }
    } else if (key === 'c') {
      e.preventDefault();
      cycleSkin?.();
    } else if (key === 'a') {
      e.preventDefault();
      cycleAccessory?.();
    } else if (key === 'm') {
      e.preventDefault();
      toggleSound?.();
    } else if (key === 'u') {
      e.preventDefault();
      triggerKnockMug?.();
    } else if (key === 't') {
      e.preventDefault();
      triggerSwatCursor?.();
    } else if (key === 'g') {
      e.preventDefault();
      triggerBellyFlop?.();
    } else if (key === 'e') {
      e.preventDefault();
      triggerEarScratch?.();
    } else if (key === 'z') {
      e.preventDefault();
      triggerNapYawn?.();
    } else if (key === 'o') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setShowToolbar(prev => !prev);
    } else if (key === 'escape') {
      setShowToolbar(false);
    }
  };

  // KaTeX Mathematical Dream Formula Rendering
  const renderedDreamHtml = useMemo(() => {
    try {
      return katex.renderToString(currentDreamFormula, { displayMode: false, throwOnError: false });
    } catch {
      return currentDreamFormula;
    }
  }, [currentDreamFormula]);

  // If disabled and not mid-exit animation, render zero DOM elements
  if (!isEnabled && !isExiting) {
    return null;
  }

  return (

                      {skin === s && <Check size={11} color={s === 'calico' || s === 'siamese' ? '#0f172a' : '#ffffff'} />}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>

                <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: 'var(--text-muted)', margin: '6px 0 4px', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.04em' }}>
                  Academic Attire ({accessory})
                </div>
                <div className="outfit-chips-grid">
                  {(['none', 'mortarboard', 'scarf', 'detective', 'bowtie'] as DeskPetAccessory[]).map((acc) => (
                    <button
                      key={acc}
                      type="button"
                      className={`outfit-chip ${accessory === acc ? 'is-active' : ''}`}
                      onClick={(e) => {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        setAccessory?.(acc);
                      }}
                    >
                      {acc === 'none' ? 'No Outfit' : acc}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Tab 3: Perch & Settings */}
            {companionTab === 'settings' && (
              <div className="companion-settings-group">
                {/* Roam Mode Toggle */}
                <div className="companion-settings-row">
                  <span>Navigation:</span>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="btn-ghost"
                    style={{ padding: '2px 8px', fontSize: 11, display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}
                    onClick={(e) => {
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      toggleRoamMode?.();
                    }}
                  >
                    <Compass size={11} color={roamMode === 'free' ? '#38bdf8' : '#94a3b8'} />
                    <span>{roamMode === 'dock' ? 'Dock Patrol' : 'Safe Perches'}</span>
                  </button>
                </div>

                {/* Return to Ledge Button */}
                <div className="companion-settings-row">
                  <span>Dock Ledge:</span>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="btn-ghost"
                    style={{ padding: '2px 8px', fontSize: 11, display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, color: '#38bdf8' }}
                    onClick={(e) => {
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      resetPositionToDock?.();
                    }}
                    title="Return position to bottom status dock ledge"
                  >
                    <Pin size={11} color="#38bdf8" />
                    <span>Return to Ledge</span>
                  </button>
                </div>

                {/* Sound & Volume */}
                <div className="companion-settings-row">
                  <span>Sound ({Math.round((volume || 0.6) * 100)}%):</span>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="btn-ghost"
                      style={{ padding: '2px 4px' }}
                      onClick={(e) => {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        toggleSound?.();
                      }}
                      title="Toggle sound"
                    >
                      {isSoundEnabled ? <Volume2 size={12} color="#10b981" /> : <VolumeX size={12} color="var(--text-muted)" />}
                    </button>
                    <input
                      type="range"
                      min="0"
                      max="1"
                      step="0.05"
                      value={volume ?? 0.6}
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        setVolume?.(parseFloat(e.target.value));
                      }}
                      style={{ width: 60, height: 4, cursor: 'pointer' }}
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Sleep / Wake */}
                <div className="companion-settings-row">
                  <span>Power State:</span>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="btn-ghost"
                    style={{ padding: '2px 8px', fontSize: 11, display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}
                    onClick={(e) => {
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      if (toggleSleep) {
                        toggleSleep();
                      } else {
                        wakeUp?.();
                      }
                    }}
                  >
                    <Moon size={11} color="#a855f7" />
                    <span>{state === 'sleep' ? 'Wake Up (S)' : 'Sleep (S)'}</span>
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div style={{ width: '100%', height: 1, backgroundColor: 'var(--border-subtle, rgba(255,255,255,0.08))', margin: '2px 0' }} />

                {/* Disable Companion */}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="btn-ghost"
                  style={{ width: '100%', padding: '3px 0', fontSize: 10.5, color: '#f87171', justifyContent: 'center', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}
                  onClick={(e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    onToggleEnabled?.();
                  }}
                >
                  <X size={11} />
                  <span>Turn Off Companion</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Main Mascot Wrapper with 2D Drag & Fling Physics - Guaranteed full opacity (ghost-hover completely removed) */}
        <div
          ref={mascotRef}
          className="desk-pet-mascot-wrapper"
          style={{
            pointerEvents: 'auto',
            position: 'relative',
            cursor: isDragging ? 'grabbing' : 'grab',
            touchAction: 'none',
            transform: isReducedMotion
              ? 'none'
              : isDragging
              ? `rotate(${dragTilt}deg) scale(0.92, 1.12)`
              : state === 'fling-air'
              ? 'rotate(25deg) scale(0.95)'
              : `translate3d(-${pacingOffset}px, 0, 0)`,
            transition: isReducedMotion || isDragging ? 'none' : 'transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1)',
          }}
          onClick={handleClick}
          onDoubleClick={handleDoubleClick}
          onPointerDown={startDrag}
          role="img"
          tabIndex={0}
          aria-label={`TeXCat Desk Companion: ${stateLabel}. Coat: ${skin}. Outfit: ${accessory}. Pet count: ${petCount}. (Triple-click for menu, drag anywhere in 2D, double-click for yarn)`}
          onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
        >
          {/* Floating Heart Particles */}
          {showHearts && (
            <div className="pet-heart-particles" aria-hidden="true">
              <span className="floating-heart heart-1">♥</span>
              <span className="floating-heart heart-2">♥</span>
              <span className="floating-heart heart-3">♥</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Floating Zzz Particles during Sleep */}
          {state === 'sleep' && (
            <div className="pet-sleep-particles" aria-hidden="true">
              <span className="floating-z z-1">z</span>
              <span className="floating-z z-2">z</span>
              <span className="floating-z z-3">Z</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* High-DPI KaTeX Mathematical Dream Thought Bubble during Sleep (Surprise Click-to-Insert) */}
          {state === 'sleep' && (
            <div
              className="pet-dream-bubble"
              role="button"
              tabIndex={0}
              onClick={handleCopyFormula}
              onKeyDown={(e) => {
                if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  handleCopyFormula(e as unknown as React.MouseEvent);
                }
              }}
              style={{ cursor: 'pointer', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}
              title="✨ TeXCat's mathematical dream — click to insert into editor"
            >
              <span className="dream-formula" dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: renderedDreamHtml }} />
              {hasCopiedFormula && (
                <span className="dream-bubble-inserted-badge">
                  <Sparkles size={9} /> Inserted!
                </span>
              )}
              <div className="dream-dots">
                <span className="dot dot-1" />
                <span className="dot dot-2" />
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Floating Sparkles on Compile Success / Knuth Celebration */}
          {(state === 'compile-success' || state === 'knuth-texbook' || state === 'knuth-check' || state === 'qed-celebration') && (
            <div className="pet-sparkle-particles" aria-hidden="true">
              <span className="floating-sparkle sparkle-1">✦</span>
              <span className="floating-sparkle sparkle-2">✧</span>
              <span className="floating-sparkle sparkle-3">⋆</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Interactive Bouncy Yarn Ball with Physics Bounce Arc */}
          {state === 'yarn-chase' && (
            <div className="pet-yarn-ball pet-bouncy-ball" aria-hidden="true">
              <svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none">
                <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" fill="#0284c7" stroke="#38bdf8" strokeWidth="2" />
                <path d="M6 12C9 8 15 8 18 12" stroke="#bae6fd" strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round" />
                <path d="M12 6C8 9 8 15 12 18" stroke="#bae6fd" strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round" />
                <path d="M18 15C19.5 17 21 19 23 18" stroke="#38bdf8" strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round" />
              </svg>
              <div className="ball-bounce-trail" />
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Pixel Butterfly for Idle Butterfly Batting */}
          {state === 'butterfly-bat' && (
            <div className="pet-pixel-butterfly" aria-hidden="true">
              <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none">
                <path d="M4 4 Q 1 1 2 7 Q 5 6 6 8 Q 7 6 10 7 Q 11 1 8 4 Z" fill="#38bdf8" opacity="0.9" />
                <circle cx="8" cy="8" r="1.5" fill="#f8fafc" />
              </svg>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Status Speech Bubbles (Classics + Stage 19 Behaviors & Annoyances) */}
          {state === 'compile-fail' && (
            <div className="pet-reaction-bubble reaction-fail" aria-hidden="true">
              <span>❓ Log alert</span>
              <div className="bubble-arrow" />
            </div>
          )}
          {state === 'compile-warning' && (
            <div className="pet-reaction-bubble reaction-warning" aria-hidden="true">
              <span>📏 Margins ok</span>
              <div className="bubble-arrow" />
            </div>
          )}
          {state === 'compile-success' && (
            <div className="pet-reaction-bubble reaction-success" aria-hidden="true">
              <span>✨ Q.E.D.</span>
              <div className="bubble-arrow" />
            </div>
          )}
          {state === 'knuth-texbook' && (
            <div className="pet-reaction-bubble reaction-knuth" aria-hidden="true">
              <span>📖 The TeXbook</span>
              <div className="bubble-arrow" />
            </div>
          )}
          {state === 'knuth-check' && (
            <div className="pet-reaction-bubble reaction-knuth" aria-hidden="true">
              <span>🏆 $2.56 Bug Reward</span>
              <div className="bubble-arrow" />
            </div>
          )}
          {state === 'knock-mug' && (
            <div className="pet-reaction-bubble reaction-warning" aria-hidden="true">
              <span>☕ Oops! (mug tap)</span>
              <div className="bubble-arrow" />
            </div>
          )}
          {state === 'swat-cursor' && (
            <div className="pet-reaction-bubble reaction-success" aria-hidden="true">
              <span>🐾 Swat!</span>
              <div className="bubble-arrow" />
            </div>
          )}
          {state === 'peek-a-boo' && (
            <div className="pet-reaction-bubble reaction-success" aria-hidden="true">
              <span>👀 Peek-a-boo!</span>
              <div className="bubble-arrow" />
            </div>
          )}
          {state === 'airplane-ears' && (
            <div className="pet-reaction-bubble reaction-warning" aria-hidden="true">
              <span>✈️ Unimpressed</span>
              <div className="bubble-arrow" />
            </div>
          )}
          {state === 'annoyed-hiss' && (
            <div className="pet-reaction-bubble reaction-fail" aria-hidden="true">
              <span>😾 *Hisss!*</span>
              <div className="bubble-arrow" />
            </div>
          )}
          {state === 'swat-aggressive' && (
            <div className="pet-reaction-bubble reaction-fail" aria-hidden="true">
              <span>💥 *WHAP!*</span>
              <div className="bubble-arrow" />
            </div>
          )}
          {state === 'tail-thump' && (
            <div className="pet-reaction-bubble reaction-warning" aria-hidden="true">
              <span>🥁 *Thump...*</span>
              <div className="bubble-arrow" />
            </div>
          )}
          {state === 'cold-shoulder' && (
            <div className="pet-reaction-bubble reaction-warning" aria-hidden="true">
              <span>❄️ Hmph.</span>
              <div className="bubble-arrow" />
            </div>
          )}
          {state === 'facepalm-paw' && (
            <div className="pet-reaction-bubble reaction-fail" aria-hidden="true">
              <span>🤦 *Sigh* (LaTeX syntax)</span>
              <div className="bubble-arrow" />
            </div>
          )}
          {state === 'paper-shred' && (
            <div className="pet-reaction-bubble reaction-warning" aria-hidden="true">
              <span>📄 Shredding bad math</span>
              <div className="bubble-arrow" />
            </div>
          )}
          {state === 'glare-judge' && (
            <div className="pet-reaction-bubble reaction-warning" aria-hidden="true">
              <span>👁️ Judging your code</span>
              <div className="bubble-arrow" />
            </div>
          )}
          {state === 'dizzy-wobble' && (
            <div className="pet-reaction-bubble reaction-warning" aria-hidden="true">
              <span>💫 Woah dizzy!</span>
              <div className="bubble-arrow" />
            </div>
          )}
          {state === 'keyboard-sprawl' && (
            <div className="pet-reaction-bubble reaction-warning" aria-hidden="true">
              <span>⌨️ Pet me now!</span>
              <div className="bubble-arrow" />
            </div>
          )}
          {state === 'hairball-cough' && (
            <div className="pet-reaction-bubble reaction-warning" aria-hidden="true">
              <span>📦 *Agh!* (unclosed brace)</span>
              <div className="bubble-arrow" />
            </div>
          )}
          {state === 'drama-flop' && (
            <div className="pet-reaction-bubble reaction-success" aria-hidden="true">
              <span>🎭 The melodrama!</span>
              <div className="bubble-arrow" />
            </div>
          )}
          {state === 'pounce-prep' && (
            <div className="pet-reaction-bubble reaction-success" aria-hidden="true">
              <span>🎯 Butt wiggle locked on</span>
              <div className="bubble-arrow" />
            </div>
          )}
          {state === 'laser-pounce' && (
            <div className="pet-reaction-bubble reaction-success" aria-hidden="true">
              <span>⚡ Pounce!</span>
              <div className="bubble-arrow" />
            </div>
          )}
          {state === 'knead-dough' && (
            <div className="pet-reaction-bubble reaction-success" aria-hidden="true">
              <span>🥐 Making biscuits</span>
              <div className="bubble-arrow" />
            </div>
          )}
          {state === 'midnight-zoomies' && (
            <div className="pet-reaction-bubble reaction-success" aria-hidden="true">
              <span>🚀 3 AM Zoomies!</span>
              <div className="bubble-arrow" />
            </div>
          )}
          {state === 'slow-blink' && (
            <div className="pet-reaction-bubble reaction-success" aria-hidden="true">
              <span>💖 Cat love & trust</span>
              <div className="bubble-arrow" />
            </div>
          )}
          {state === 'cheek-bunt' && (
            <div className="pet-reaction-bubble reaction-success" aria-hidden="true">
              <span>🥰 Scent marked</span>
              <div className="bubble-arrow" />
            </div>
          )}
          {state === 'cello-leg' && (
            <div className="pet-reaction-bubble reaction-success" aria-hidden="true">
              <span>🎻 Cello groom pose</span>
              <div className="bubble-arrow" />
            </div>
          )}
          {state === 'blep' && (
            <div className="pet-reaction-bubble reaction-success" aria-hidden="true">
              <span>👅 *Blep*</span>
              <div className="bubble-arrow" />
            </div>
          )}
          {state === 'math-zoomies' && (
            <div className="pet-reaction-bubble reaction-success" aria-hidden="true">
              <span>📐 \int Zoomies!</span>
              <div className="bubble-arrow" />
            </div>
          )}
          {state === 'focus-scholar' && (
            <div className="pet-reaction-bubble reaction-success" aria-hidden="true">
              <span>🧘 LaTeX Zen Focus</span>
              <div className="bubble-arrow" />
            </div>
          )}
          {state === 'qed-celebration' && (
            <div className="pet-reaction-bubble reaction-success" aria-hidden="true">
              <span>🏆 Q.E.D. Complete!</span>
              <div className="bubble-arrow" />
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Procedural High-DPI Vector Mascot Rig */}
          <div
            className={`texcat-rig state-${state} ${state === 'walk' && direction === 'left' ? 'facing-left' : ''}`}
            style={{
              width: 52,
              height: 52,
              position: 'relative',
              transformOrigin: 'bottom center',
            }}
          >
            <svg
              viewBox="0 0 64 64"
              width="52"
              height="52"
              fill="none"
              xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
              style={{ overflow: 'visible' }}
            >
              <defs>
                <filter id="texcat-shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
                  <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="2" floodColor="#000" floodOpacity="0.35" />
                </filter>
              </defs>

              {/* Base platform shadow */}
              <ellipse
                cx="32"
                cy="56"
                rx={state === 'lifted-scruff' ? 12 : state === 'loaf' ? 24 : 20}
                ry={state === 'lifted-scruff' ? 2 : 4}
                fill="rgba(0,0,0,0.25)"
                opacity={state === 'lifted-scruff' ? 0.35 : 0.8}
              />

              {/* Tail Layer with Sway Animation */}
              <g className={`texcat-tail ${state === 'loaf' ? 'tail-tucked' : ''}`} style={{ transformOrigin: '48px 50px' }}>
                <path
                  d={state === 'loaf' ? 'M42 48 C 48 52, 36 56, 26 55' : 'M44 48 C 54 44, 58 36, 56 30 C 54 26, 50 28, 51 32 C 52 38, 48 42, 42 46'}
                  stroke={activePalette.furStroke}
                  strokeWidth="4"
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  fill="none"
                />
              </g>

              {/* Cat Body */}
              <g className={`texcat-body ${state === 'loaf' ? 'body-loaf' : ''}`} filter="url(#texcat-shadow)">
                <ellipse
                  cx="32"
                  cy={state === 'loaf' ? 46 : 44}
                  rx={state === 'loaf' ? 18 : 15}
                  ry={state === 'loaf' ? 11 : 13}
                  fill={activePalette.furFill}
                  stroke={activePalette.furStroke}
                  strokeWidth="2"
                />

                {/* Tiger Stripes for Ginger or Calico */}
                {activePalette.stripeColor && (
                  <g className="texcat-stripes" opacity="0.45">
                    <path d="M22 41 L 28 43" stroke={activePalette.stripeColor} strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round" />
                    <path d="M42 41 L 36 43" stroke={activePalette.stripeColor} strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round" />
                    <path d="M20 46 L 26 47" stroke={activePalette.stripeColor} strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round" />
                    <path d="M44 46 L 38 47" stroke={activePalette.stripeColor} strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round" />
                  </g>
                )}

                {/* Chest Marking */}
                <ellipse cx="32" cy={state === 'loaf' ? 47 : 45} rx={state === 'loaf' ? 10 : 8} ry={state === 'loaf' ? 7 : 9} fill={activePalette.chestFill} opacity="0.8" />
              </g>

              {/* Academic Accessory: Professor Bowtie */}
              {accessory === 'bowtie' && (
                <g className="texcat-accessory-bowtie" aria-hidden="true">
                  <polygon points="26,38 32,41 26,44" fill="#dc2626" />
                  <polygon points="38,38 32,41 38,44" fill="#dc2626" />
                  <circle cx="32" cy="41" r="2.2" fill="#b91c1c" />
                </g>
              )}

              {/* Academic Accessory: Knitted Scholar Scarf */}
              {accessory === 'scarf' && (
                <g className="texcat-accessory-scarf" aria-hidden="true">
                  <ellipse cx="32" cy="38" rx="14" ry="4.5" fill="#b91c1c" stroke="#7f1d1d" strokeWidth="1" />
                  <line x1="22" y1="38" x2="42" y2="38" stroke="#fbbf24" strokeWidth="1.5" strokeDasharray="3 2" />
                  {/* Flowing scarf tail with tassel fringe */}
                  <path d="M38 40 Q 42 48 40 54" stroke="#b91c1c" strokeWidth="4.5" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none" className="scarf-flutter" />
                  <line x1="38" y1="54" x2="42" y2="54" stroke="#fbbf24" strokeWidth="1.5" />
                </g>
              )}

              {/* Cat Head Layer */}
              <g className="texcat-head" style={{ transformOrigin: '32px 30px' }}>
                {/* Left Ear */}
                <g
                  className="texcat-ear-left-group"
                  style={{
                    transformOrigin: '23px 18px',
                    transform: state === 'airplane-ears' ? 'rotate(-35deg)' : undefined,
                    transition: 'transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)',
                  }}
                >
                  <path
                    d="M19 22 L 23 10 L 31 18 Z"
                    fill={activePalette.furFill}
                    stroke={activePalette.furStroke}
                    strokeWidth="2"
                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                    className="texcat-ear-left"
                  />
                  <path d="M22 19 L 24 13 L 29 18 Z" fill={activePalette.earPink} opacity="0.8" />
                </g>

                {/* Right Ear */}
                <g
                  className="texcat-ear-right-group"
                  style={{
                    transformOrigin: '41px 18px',
                    transform: state === 'airplane-ears' ? 'rotate(35deg)' : undefined,
                    transition: 'transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)',
                  }}
                >
                  <path
                    d="M45 22 L 41 10 L 33 18 Z"
                    fill={activePalette.furFill}
                    stroke={activePalette.furStroke}
                    strokeWidth="2"
                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                    className="texcat-ear-right"
                  />
                  <path d="M42 19 L 40 13 L 35 18 Z" fill={activePalette.earPink} opacity="0.8" />
                </g>

                {/* Head Circle */}
                <ellipse
                  cx="32"
                  cy="28"
                  rx="17"
                  ry="14"
                  fill={activePalette.furFill}
                  stroke={activePalette.furStroke}
                  strokeWidth="2"
                />

                {/* Cheeks / Whiskers */}
                <path d="M12 28 L 22 29 M 11 32 L 21 31" stroke="var(--text-muted, #94a3b8)" strokeWidth="1.2" strokeLinecap="round" />
                <path d="M52 28 L 42 29 M 53 32 L 43 31" stroke="var(--text-muted, #94a3b8)" strokeWidth="1.2" strokeLinecap="round" />

                {/* Nose */}
                <polygon points="30,31 34,31 32,33" fill={activePalette.earPink} />

                {/* Mouth & Sleepy Nap Yawn / Hiss / Blep / Flehmen */}
                {state === 'nap-yawn' ? (
                  <g className="texcat-mouth-yawn">
                    <ellipse cx="32" cy="35" rx="4.5" ry="5" fill="#f43f5e" />
                    <polygon points="29.5,32 31.5,32 30.5,34" fill="#ffffff" />
                    <polygon points="32.5,32 34.5,32 33.5,34" fill="#ffffff" />
                  </g>
                ) : state === 'annoyed-hiss' ? (
                  <g className="texcat-mouth-hiss">
                    <ellipse cx="32" cy="35" rx="4.5" ry="3.5" fill="#991b1b" />
                    <polygon points="29.5,33.5 31.5,33.5 30.5,36" fill="#ffffff" />
                    <polygon points="32.5,33.5 34.5,33.5 33.5,36" fill="#ffffff" />
                  </g>
                ) : state === 'blep' ? (
                  <g className="texcat-mouth-blep">
                    <path d="M30 34 Q 32 35 34 34" stroke="var(--text-muted, #94a3b8)" strokeWidth="1.5" fill="none" />
                    <ellipse cx="32" cy="36.5" rx="2" ry="2.5" fill="#f43f5e" />
                    <line x1="32" y1="35" x2="32" y2="38" stroke="#be123c" strokeWidth="0.8" />
                  </g>
                ) : state === 'flehmen-sniff' ? (

  '\\TeX \\; \\text{v}\\pi',
];

export function getScholarLevel(xp: number): { level: number; title: string; nextXp: number; progress: number } {
  if (xp < 100) return { level: 1, title: 'Novice Kitten', nextXp: 100, progress: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, xp / 100)) };
  if (xp < 300) return { level: 2, title: 'Math Apprentice', nextXp: 300, progress: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (xp - 100) / 200)) };
  if (xp < 600) return { level: 3, title: 'TeX Journeyman', nextXp: 600, progress: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (xp - 300) / 300)) };
  if (xp < 1000) return { level: 4, title: 'Macro Wizard', nextXp: 1000, progress: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (xp - 600) / 400)) };
  return { level: 5, title: 'Knuth Grandmaster', nextXp: 2000, progress: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (xp - 1000) / 1000)) };
}

export interface UseDeskPetOptions {
  compileStatus?: 'idle' | 'compiling' | 'success' | 'error';
  lastCompiledAt?: number | null;
  errorCount?: number;
  warningCount?: number;
  isTypingActive?: boolean;
  inactivitySleepMs?: number; // default: 45,000ms
}

export interface UseDeskPetReturn {
  isEnabled: boolean;
  isExiting: boolean;
  entryVariant: DeskPetEntryVariant;
  exitVariant: DeskPetExitVariant;
  setIsEnabled: (enabled: boolean) => void;
  toggleEnabled: () => void;
  state: DeskPetActionState;
  direction: 'left' | 'right';
  pacingOffset: number;
  isSleeping: boolean;
  isReducedMotion: boolean;
  isPaused: boolean;
  petCount: number;
  skin: DeskPetSkin;
  setSkin: (skin: DeskPetSkin) => void;
  cycleSkin: () => void;
  accessory: DeskPetAccessory;
  setAccessory: (acc: DeskPetAccessory) => void;
  cycleAccessory: () => void;
  isSoundEnabled: boolean;
  toggleSound: () => void;
  volume: number;
  setVolume: (vol: number) => void;
  perchX: number;
  perchY: number;
  isSnappedToDock: boolean;
  resetPositionToDock: () => void;
  dragTilt: number;
  isDragging: boolean;
  startDrag: (e: React.PointerEvent) => void;
  currentDreamFormula: string;
  triggerYarnChase: () => void;
  triggerPet: () => void;
  wakeUp: () => void;
  toggleSleep: () => void;
  // Stage 15 additions:
  roamMode: DeskPetRoamMode;
  setRoamMode: (mode: DeskPetRoamMode) => void;
  toggleRoamMode: () => void;
  isTransitioning: boolean;
  isLaserActive: boolean;
  laserCoords: { x: number; y: number };
  triggerLaser: () => void;
  triggerBox: () => void;
  triggerFish: () => void;
  triggerKnuthCelebration: () => void;
  triggerPeekABoo: () => void;
  triggerSwatCursor: () => void;
  triggerKnockMug: () => void;
  triggerBellyFlop: () => void;
  triggerEarScratch: () => void;
  triggerNapYawn: () => void;
  triggerRoam: () => void;
  // Stage 19 additions:
  annoyanceLevel: number;
  annoyanceReason: string | null;
  scholarXp: number;
  scholarLevel: number;
  scholarTitle: string;
  scholarProgress: number;
  addScholarXp: (amount: number) => void;
  playSpecificAnimation: (anim: DeskPetActionState, durationMs?: number) => void;
  triggerAnnoyanceReaction: (reason?: string) => void;
  triggerPouncePrep: () => void;
  triggerKneadDough: () => void;
  triggerMidnightZoomies: () => void;
  triggerSlowBlink: () => void;
  triggerCheekBunt: () => void;
  triggerCelloLeg: () => void;
  triggerBlep: () => void;
  triggerFlehmenSniff: () => void;
  triggerMathZoomies: () => void;
  triggerLoafWiggle: () => void;
  triggerFocusScholar: () => void;
  triggerQedCelebration: () => void;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'teeex_desk_pet_enabled';
const SKIN_STORAGE_KEY = 'teeex_desk_pet_skin';
const SOUND_STORAGE_KEY = 'teeex_desk_pet_sound';
const VOLUME_STORAGE_KEY = 'teeex_desk_pet_volume';
const ACCESSORY_STORAGE_KEY = 'teeex_desk_pet_accessory';
const PERCH_X_STORAGE_KEY = 'teeex_desk_pet_perch_x';
const PERCH_Y_STORAGE_KEY = 'teeex_desk_pet_perch_y';
const SNAPPED_STORAGE_KEY = 'teeex_desk_pet_is_snapped';
const ROAM_MODE_STORAGE_KEY = 'teeex_desk_pet_roam_mode';
const SCHOLAR_XP_STORAGE_KEY = 'teeex_desk_pet_scholar_xp';

export function useDeskPet({
  compileStatus = 'idle',
  lastCompiledAt,
  errorCount: _errorCount = 0,
  warningCount = 0,
  isTypingActive = false,
  inactivitySleepMs = 45000,
}: UseDeskPetOptions = {}): UseDeskPetReturn {
  // 1. Off-by-default initialization: defaults strictly to false
  const [isEnabled, setIsEnabledState] = useState<boolean>(() => {
    try {
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
        return window.localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) === 'true';
      }
    } catch {
      // LocalStorage access restricted / SSR fallback
    }
    return false;
  });

  const [isExiting, setIsExiting] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [entryVariant, setEntryVariant] = useState<DeskPetEntryVariant>('box');
  const [exitVariant, setExitVariant] = useState<DeskPetExitVariant>('smoke');

  // 2. Coat Skin customization (default: 'tuxedo')
  const [skin, setSkinState] = useState<DeskPetSkin>(() => {
    try {
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
        const saved = window.localStorage.getItem(SKIN_STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved && DESK_PET_SKINS.includes(saved as DeskPetSkin)) {
          return saved as DeskPetSkin;
        }
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore
    }
    return 'tuxedo';
  });

  const setSkin = useCallback((newSkin: DeskPetSkin) => {
    setSkinState(newSkin);
    try {
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
        window.localStorage.setItem(SKIN_STORAGE_KEY, newSkin);
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore
    }
  }, []);

  const cycleSkin = useCallback(() => {
    setSkinState(prev => {
      const idx = DESK_PET_SKINS.indexOf(prev);
      const next = DESK_PET_SKINS[(idx + 1) % DESK_PET_SKINS.length];
      try {
        if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
          window.localStorage.setItem(SKIN_STORAGE_KEY, next);
        }
      } catch {
        // Ignore
      }
      return next;
    });
  }, []);

  // 3. Academic Accessory Outfits
  const [accessory, setAccessoryState] = useState<DeskPetAccessory>(() => {
    try {
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
        const saved = window.localStorage.getItem(ACCESSORY_STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved && DESK_PET_ACCESSORIES.includes(saved as DeskPetAccessory)) {
          return saved as DeskPetAccessory;
        }
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore
    }
    return 'none';
  });

  const setAccessory = useCallback((acc: DeskPetAccessory) => {
    setAccessoryState(acc);
    try {
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
        window.localStorage.setItem(ACCESSORY_STORAGE_KEY, acc);
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore
    }
  }, []);

  const cycleAccessory = useCallback(() => {
    setAccessoryState(prev => {
      const idx = DESK_PET_ACCESSORIES.indexOf(prev);
      const next = DESK_PET_ACCESSORIES[(idx + 1) % DESK_PET_ACCESSORIES.length];
      try {
        if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
          window.localStorage.setItem(ACCESSORY_STORAGE_KEY, next);
        }
      } catch {
        // Ignore
      }
      return next;
    });
  }, []);

  // 4. Procedural Audio Engine (Muted by default)
  const [isSoundEnabled, setIsSoundEnabled] = useState<boolean>(() => {
    try {
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
        return window.localStorage.getItem(SOUND_STORAGE_KEY) === 'true';
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore
    }
    return false;
  });

  const [volume, setVolumeState] = useState<number>(() => {
    try {
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
        const saved = window.localStorage.getItem(VOLUME_STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved) return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, parseFloat(saved)));
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore
    }
    return 0.6;
  });

  const setVolume = useCallback((vol: number) => {
    const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, vol));
    setVolumeState(clamped);
    audioEngineRef.current?.setVolume(clamped);
    try {
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
        window.localStorage.setItem(VOLUME_STORAGE_KEY, clamped.toString());
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore
    }
  }, []);

  const audioEngineRef = useRef<DeskPetAudioEngine | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    audioEngineRef.current = new DeskPetAudioEngine(!isSoundEnabled, volume);
  }, []); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  const toggleSound = useCallback(() => {
    setIsSoundEnabled(prev => {
      const next = !prev;
      audioEngineRef.current?.setMuted(!next);
      try {
        if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
          window.localStorage.setItem(SOUND_STORAGE_KEY, next ? 'true' : 'false');
        }
      } catch {
        // Ignore
      }
      return next;
    });
  }, []);

  // 5. 2D Coordinates & Ledge Snapping
  const [perchX, setPerchX] = useState<number>(() => {
    try {
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
        const saved = window.localStorage.getItem(PERCH_X_STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved) {
          const val = parseInt(saved, 10);
          if (!isNaN(val) && val > 0) return val;
        }
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore
    }
    return 28;
  });

  const [perchY, setPerchY] = useState<number>(() => {
    try {
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
        const saved = window.localStorage.getItem(PERCH_Y_STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved) {
          const val = parseInt(saved, 10);
          if (!isNaN(val) && val >= 0) return val;
        }
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore
    }
    return 36;
  });

  const [isSnappedToDock, setIsSnappedToDock] = useState<boolean>(() => {
    try {
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
        const saved = window.localStorage.getItem(SNAPPED_STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved !== null) return saved === 'true';
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore
    }
    return true;
  });

  const resetPositionToDock = useCallback(() => {
    setPerchX(28);
    setPerchY(36);
    setPacingOffset(0);
    setIsSnappedToDock(true);
    try {
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
        window.localStorage.setItem(PERCH_X_STORAGE_KEY, '28');
        window.localStorage.setItem(PERCH_Y_STORAGE_KEY, '36');
        window.localStorage.setItem(SNAPPED_STORAGE_KEY, 'true');
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore
    }
  }, []);

  // 6. Action state, physics & transitions
  const [state, setState] = useState<DeskPetActionState>('idle');
  const [direction, setDirection] = useState<'left' | 'right'>('right');
  const [pacingOffset, setPacingOffset] = useState<number>(0);
  const [petCount, setPetCount] = useState<number>(0);
  const [isReducedMotion, setIsReducedMotion] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isPaused, setIsPaused] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [dragTilt, setDragTilt] = useState<number>(0);
  const [isTransitioning, setIsTransitioning] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [currentDreamFormula, setCurrentDreamFormula] = useState<string>(MATH_DREAM_FORMULAS[0]);

  // Stage 15: Roam Mode ('dock' | 'free')
  const [roamMode, setRoamModeState] = useState<DeskPetRoamMode>(() => {
    try {
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
        const saved = window.localStorage.getItem(ROAM_MODE_STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved === 'free' || saved === 'dock') return saved as DeskPetRoamMode;
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore
    }
    return 'dock';
  });

  const setRoamMode = useCallback((mode: DeskPetRoamMode) => {
    setRoamModeState(mode);
    try {
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
        window.localStorage.setItem(ROAM_MODE_STORAGE_KEY, mode);
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore
    }
  }, []);

  const toggleRoamMode = useCallback(() => {
    setRoamModeState(prev => {
      const next = prev === 'dock' ? 'free' : 'dock';
      try {
        if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
          window.localStorage.setItem(ROAM_MODE_STORAGE_KEY, next);
        }
      } catch {
        // Ignore
      }
      return next;
    });
  }, []);

  // Stage 15: Red Laser Pointer Tracking Mode
  const [isLaserActive, setIsLaserActive] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [laserCoords, setLaserCoords] = useState<{ x: number; y: number }>({ x: 0, y: 0 });

  // Stage 19: Feline Annoyance Engine
  const [annoyanceLevel, setAnnoyanceLevel] = useState<number>(0);
  const [annoyanceReason, setAnnoyanceReason] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Stage 19: LaTeX Scholar Progression XP
  const [scholarXp, setScholarXp] = useState<number>(() => {
    try {
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
        const saved = window.localStorage.getItem(SCHOLAR_XP_STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved) {
          const val = parseInt(saved, 10);
          if (!isNaN(val) && val >= 0) return val;
        }
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore
    }
    return 0;
  });

  const addScholarXp = useCallback((amount: number) => {
    setScholarXp(prev => {
      const next = prev + amount;
      try {
        if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
          window.localStorage.setItem(SCHOLAR_XP_STORAGE_KEY, next.toString());
        }
      } catch {
        // Ignore
      }
      return next;
    });
  }, []);

  const scholarInfo = useMemo(() => getScholarLevel(scholarXp), [scholarXp]);

  const dragStartRef = useRef<{
    clientX: number;
    clientY: number;
    initialPerchX: number;
    initialPerchY: number;
    lastX: number;
    lastY: number;
    lastTime: number;
    vx: number;
    vy: number;
  } | null>(null);
  const dragStartTimeRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

  // References for active timers
  const stateTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const transitionTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const inactivityTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const loafTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const organicScheduleTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const walkStepTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const typingSettleTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const dreamIntervalRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);
  const prevCompileStatusRef = useRef<string>(compileStatus);
  const prevLastCompiledAtRef = useRef<number | null | undefined>(lastCompiledAt);
  const isTypingRef = useRef<boolean>(false);
  const stateRef = useRef<DeskPetActionState>(state);
  const petTimestampsRef = useRef<number[]>([]);
  const consecutiveErrorsRef = useRef<number>(0);

  // Synchronize stateRef with current state
  useEffect(() => {
    stateRef.current = state;
  }, [state]);

  // Annoyance passive decay: cool down by 10 every 2.5s if left alone
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isEnabled || isPaused || annoyanceLevel <= 0) return;
    const decayTimer = setInterval(() => {
      setAnnoyanceLevel(prev => Math.max(0, prev - 10));
    }, 2500);
    return () => clearInterval(decayTimer);
  }, [isEnabled, isPaused, annoyanceLevel]);

  // Clear helper
  const clearStateTimer = useCallback(() => {
    if (stateTimerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(stateTimerRef.current);
      stateTimerRef.current = null;
    }
    if (transitionTimerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(transitionTimerRef.current);
      transitionTimerRef.current = null;
    }
  }, []);

  // Smooth State Transition Helper (triggers 180ms ease blending)
  const transitionTo = useCallback((nextState: DeskPetActionState, durationMs?: number, nextCallback?: () => void) => {
    clearStateTimer();

    setIsTransitioning(true);
    transitionTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setIsTransitioning(false);
    }, 180);

    setState(nextState);

    if (durationMs) {
      stateTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        if (nextCallback) {
          nextCallback();
        } else {
          setState('idle');
        }
      }, durationMs);
    }
  }, [clearStateTimer]);

  const setIsEnabled = useCallback((enabled: boolean) => {
    if (enabled) {
      // Pick random entry variant
      const entries: DeskPetEntryVariant[] = ['box', 'portal', 'jump'];
      setEntryVariant(entries[Math.floor(Math.random() * entries.length)]);
      setIsExiting(false);
      setIsEnabledState(true);
      try {
        if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
          window.localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, 'true');
        }
      } catch {
        // Ignore
      }
    } else {
      // Pick random exit variant and animate before unmounting
      const exits: DeskPetExitVariant[] = ['box', 'portal', 'smoke'];
      setExitVariant(exits[Math.floor(Math.random() * exits.length)]);
      setIsExiting(true);
      setIsEnabledState(false);
      try {
        if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
          window.localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, 'false');
        }
      } catch {
        // Ignore
      }
      setTimeout(() => {
        setIsExiting(false);
      }, 550);
    }
  }, []);

  const toggleEnabled = useCallback(() => {
    setIsEnabled(!isEnabled);
  }, [isEnabled, setIsEnabled]);

  // Reduced motion media query listener
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.matchMedia) return;
    const media = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
    setIsReducedMotion(media.matches);

    const handler = (e: MediaQueryListEvent) => {
      setIsReducedMotion(e.matches);
      if (e.matches) {
        setPacingOffset(0);
        setDragTilt(0);
      }
    };
    media.addEventListener?.('change', handler);
    return () => {
      media.removeEventListener?.('change', handler);
    };
  }, []);

  // Inactivity & Loaf Progression: idle -> loaf (18s) -> sleep (45s)
  const resetInactivityTimer = useCallback(() => {
    if (!isEnabled || isPaused) return;

    if (inactivityTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(inactivityTimerRef.current);
    if (loafTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(loafTimerRef.current);

    // 18s idle loaf trigger
    loafTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      clearStateTimer();
      if (organicScheduleTimerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(organicScheduleTimerRef.current);
        organicScheduleTimerRef.current = null;
      }
      setState(current => {
        const nonInterruptible: DeskPetActionState[] = [
          'compiling-scholar',
          'compile-success',
          'compile-fail',
          'typing-paws',
          'yarn-chase',
          'laser-chase',
          'fish-feast',
          'knuth-check',
          'lifted-scruff',
          'sleep',
        ];
        if (!nonInterruptible.includes(current)) {
          return 'loaf';
        }
        return current;
      });
    }, 18000);

    // 45s sleep trigger
    inactivityTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      clearStateTimer();
      if (organicScheduleTimerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(organicScheduleTimerRef.current);
        organicScheduleTimerRef.current = null;
      }
      setState(current => {
        const nonInterruptible: DeskPetActionState[] = [
          'compiling-scholar',
          'compile-success',
          'compile-fail',
          'typing-paws',
          'yarn-chase',
          'laser-chase',
          'lifted-scruff',
        ];
        if (!nonInterruptible.includes(current)) {
          return 'sleep';
        }
        return current;
      });
    }, inactivitySleepMs);
  }, [isEnabled, isPaused, inactivitySleepMs, clearStateTimer]);

  // Tab visibility listener (zero CPU/timer consumption when hidden)
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleVisibilityChange = () => {
      const hidden = document.hidden;
      if (hidden) {
        setIsPaused(true);
        clearStateTimer();
        if (inactivityTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(inactivityTimerRef.current);
        if (loafTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(loafTimerRef.current);
        if (organicScheduleTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(organicScheduleTimerRef.current);
        if (walkStepTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(walkStepTimerRef.current);
        if (dreamIntervalRef.current) clearInterval(dreamIntervalRef.current);
      } else {
        setIsPaused(false);
        resetInactivityTimer();
      }
      if (audioEngineRef.current) {
        audioEngineRef.current.handleVisibilityChange(hidden);
      }
    };

    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibilityChange);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibilityChange);
    };
  }, [clearStateTimer, resetInactivityTimer]);

  const wakeUp = useCallback(() => {
    resetInactivityTimer();
    setState(current => {
      if (current === 'sleep' || current === 'loaf') {
        clearStateTimer();
        stateTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
          setState('idle');
        }, 1200);
        return 'waking-stretch';
      }
      return current;
    });
  }, [resetInactivityTimer, clearStateTimer]);

  const toggleSleep = useCallback(() => {
    if (!isEnabled || isPaused) return;
    clearStateTimer();
    setState(current => {
      if (current === 'sleep') {
        stateTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
          setState('idle');
        }, 1200);
        return 'waking-stretch';
      } else {
        if (inactivityTimerRef.current) {
          clearTimeout(inactivityTimerRef.current);
          inactivityTimerRef.current = null;
        }
        if (loafTimerRef.current) {
          clearTimeout(loafTimerRef.current);
          loafTimerRef.current = null;
        }
        return 'sleep';
      }
    });
  }, [isEnabled, isPaused, clearStateTimer]);

  // Dream formula cycling during sleep
  useEffect(() => {
    if (state === 'sleep' && !isPaused && isEnabled) {
      dreamIntervalRef.current = setInterval(() => {
        setCurrentDreamFormula(prev => {
          const idx = MATH_DREAM_FORMULAS.indexOf(prev);
          return MATH_DREAM_FORMULAS[(idx + 1) % MATH_DREAM_FORMULAS.length];
        });
      }, 5500);
    } else {
      if (dreamIntervalRef.current) {
        clearInterval(dreamIntervalRef.current);
        dreamIntervalRef.current = null;
      }
    }
    return () => {
      if (dreamIntervalRef.current) clearInterval(dreamIntervalRef.current);
    };
  }, [state, isPaused, isEnabled]);

  // Anonymous Keystroke activity listener (strictly timestamp pulse, zero inspection)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isEnabled || isPaused) return;

    const handleAnonymousActivity = (e: Event) => {
      // If the event originated inside the desk pet container, ignore it so pet interaction doesn't count as editor typing
      if (e.target && (e.target as HTMLElement).closest?.('.desk-pet-container')) {
        return;
      }
      if (state === 'sleep' || state === 'loaf') {
        wakeUp();
      } else {
        resetInactivityTimer();
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleAnonymousActivity, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('pointerdown', handleAnonymousActivity, { passive: true });

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleAnonymousActivity);
      window.removeEventListener('pointerdown', handleAnonymousActivity);
    };
  }, [isEnabled, isPaused, state, wakeUp, resetInactivityTimer]);

  // External isTypingActive pulse synchronization (Bongo Cat Mode)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isEnabled || isPaused) return;

    if (isTypingActive) {
      isTypingRef.current = true;
      clearStateTimer();
      audioEngineRef.current?.playKeyClick();
      setState(cur => {
        if (cur === 'sleep' || cur === 'loaf') {
          return 'waking-stretch';
        }
        if (cur === 'idle' || cur === 'walk' || cur === 'yoga-stretch' || cur === 'face-wash' || cur === 'tail-flick') {
          return 'typing-paws';
        }
        return cur;
      });

      if (typingSettleTimerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(typingSettleTimerRef.current);
      }
      typingSettleTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        isTypingRef.current = false;
        setState(cur => (cur === 'typing-paws' ? 'idle' : cur));
      }, 450);
    }
  }, [isTypingActive, isEnabled, isPaused, clearStateTimer]);

  // Compiler Lifecycle State Transitions with Diagnostic Empathy
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isEnabled || isPaused) return;

    const prevStatus = prevCompileStatusRef.current;
    const prevTimestamp = prevLastCompiledAtRef.current;
    prevCompileStatusRef.current = compileStatus;
    prevLastCompiledAtRef.current = lastCompiledAt;

    // A. Compiling active -> scholar reading manuscript mode
    if (compileStatus === 'compiling') {
      clearStateTimer();
      setState('compiling-scholar');
      resetInactivityTimer();
      return;
    }

    // B. Compilation resolved to Success
    if (compileStatus === 'success' && (prevStatus === 'compiling' || (lastCompiledAt && lastCompiledAt !== prevTimestamp))) {
      clearStateTimer();
      resetInactivityTimer();
      consecutiveErrorsRef.current = 0;

      if (warningCount > 0) {
        // Warning build: typesetter tape measure inspection
        setState('compile-warning');
        audioEngineRef.current?.playWarningChime();
        addScholarXp(10);
        stateTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
          setState('idle');
        }, 3200);
      } else {
        // Clean zero-warning compilation: Q.E.D. celebration
        setState('compile-success');
        audioEngineRef.current?.playSuccessChime();
        addScholarXp(25);
        stateTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
          setState('idle');
        }, 3500);
      }
      return;
    }

    // C. Compilation resolved to Error
    if (compileStatus === 'error' && (prevStatus === 'compiling' || (lastCompiledAt && lastCompiledAt !== prevTimestamp))) {
      clearStateTimer();
      resetInactivityTimer();
      consecutiveErrorsRef.current = (consecutiveErrorsRef.current || 0) + 1;

      if (consecutiveErrorsRef.current >= 2) {
        // Feline frustration at consecutive LaTeX errors
        setAnnoyanceReason('compile_frustration');
        setAnnoyanceLevel(prev => Math.min(100, prev + 35));
        setState('facepalm-paw');
        audioEngineRef.current?.playAlertBoop();
        stateTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
          setState('idle');
        }, 3200);
      } else {
        setState('compile-fail');
        audioEngineRef.current?.playAlertBoop();
        stateTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
          setState('idle');
        }, 4500);
      }
      return;
    }
  }, [compileStatus, lastCompiledAt, warningCount, isEnabled, isPaused, clearStateTimer, resetInactivityTimer, addScholarXp]);

  // Autonomous Waypoint Navigation Stroll
  const triggerRoam = useCallback(() => {
    if (!isEnabled || isPaused || isReducedMotion || isTypingRef.current || isDragging) return;

    if (roamMode === 'dock') {
      // Dock Patrol Mode: Choose dynamic offset along status ledge, safely clamped away from sidebar & diagnostics
      const maxLedgeOffset = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? Math.min(window.innerWidth - 220, 360) : 300;
      const targetOffset = Math.round(Math.random() * maxLedgeOffset);
      const isMovingLeft = targetOffset > pacingOffset;
      setDirection(isMovingLeft ? 'left' : 'right');

      const distance = Math.abs(targetOffset - pacingOffset);
      const duration = Math.max(1200, Math.min(3000, distance * 10));

      transitionTo('walk', duration, () => {
        transitionTo('landing', 300, () => {
          setState('idle');
        });
      });
      setPacingOffset(targetOffset);
    } else {
      // Safe Perch Roam Mode: Choose among structural architectural perches
      // STRICTLY AVOIDS the central Monaco code editor lines and central PDF text!
      const maxW = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.innerWidth : 1200;
      const maxH = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.innerHeight : 800;

      // 4 Designated Safe Perches:
      // Perch 1: Bottom Status Dock Ledge (safe right margin)
      // Perch 2: Top Navbar Margin Ledge (safe top margin)
      // Perch 3: Vertical Split Pane Divider Line (between editor and PDF)
      // Perch 4: PDF Top-Right Whitespace Margin
      const perchOptions = [
        { x: Math.round(Math.random() * 240 + 28), y: 36, snapped: true }, // Dock Right
        { x: Math.round(maxW * 0.35), y: 36, snapped: true }, // Dock Center-Left
        { x: Math.round(Math.random() * 200 + 40), y: Math.max(36, maxH - 80), snapped: false }, // Navbar Right
        { x: Math.round(maxW * 0.45), y: Math.max(36, maxH - 80), snapped: false }, // Navbar Center
        { x: Math.round(maxW * 0.5), y: Math.round(maxH * 0.7), snapped: false }, // Split-Pane Top
        { x: Math.round(maxW * 0.5), y: Math.round(maxH * 0.25), snapped: false }, // Split-Pane Bottom
      ];

      const chosen = perchOptions[Math.floor(Math.random() * perchOptions.length)];
      const targetX = chosen.x;
      const targetY = chosen.y;

      setDirection(targetX > perchX ? 'left' : 'right');
      const dx = targetX - perchX;
      const dy = targetY - perchY;
      const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
      const duration = Math.max(1400, Math.min(3600, dist * 8));

      transitionTo('walk', duration, () => {
        transitionTo('landing', 300, () => {
          setState('idle');
        });
      });

      setPerchX(targetX);
      setPerchY(targetY);
      setIsSnappedToDock(chosen.snapped);
    }
  }, [isEnabled, isPaused, isReducedMotion, isDragging, roamMode, pacingOffset, perchX, perchY, transitionTo]);

  // Stage 19: Dynamic Organic Behavior Scheduler (Every 2.0s–4.2s when idle)
  // Decoupled from `state` dependencies so state transitions never abort or starve the scheduler!
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isEnabled || isPaused || isReducedMotion) {
