      return;
    }

    const scheduleNextBehavior = () => {
      const delay = 2000 + Math.random() * 2200; // 2000ms - 4200ms
      organicScheduleTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        if (stateRef.current === 'idle' && !isTypingRef.current && !isDragging && !isLaserActive) {
          const roll = Math.random();

          if (roll < 0.05) {
            audioEngineRef.current?.playYawnSigh();
            transitionTo('nap-yawn', 2400);
          } else if (roll < 0.10) {
            audioEngineRef.current?.playPurr(1200);
            transitionTo('belly-flop', 2600);
          } else if (roll < 0.15) {
            transitionTo('ear-scratch', 2200);
          } else if (roll < 0.20) {
            audioEngineRef.current?.playPurr(1400);
            transitionTo('knead-dough', 2800);
          } else if (roll < 0.25) {
            transitionTo('pounce-prep', 2000);
          } else if (roll < 0.30) {
            audioEngineRef.current?.playPurr(1600);
            transitionTo('slow-blink', 2800);
          } else if (roll < 0.35) {
            audioEngineRef.current?.playPurr(1400);
            transitionTo('cheek-bunt', 2200);
          } else if (roll < 0.40) {
            audioEngineRef.current?.playSlurp();
            transitionTo('blep', 2600);
          } else if (roll < 0.45) {
            audioEngineRef.current?.playSlurp();
            transitionTo('cello-leg', 2800);
          } else if (roll < 0.50) {
            transitionTo('flehmen-sniff', 2400);
          } else if (roll < 0.55) {
            audioEngineRef.current?.playMugClink();
            transitionTo('knock-mug', 2400);
          } else if (roll < 0.60) {
            transitionTo('yoga-stretch', 2200);
          } else if (roll < 0.65) {
            transitionTo('face-wash', 2200);
          } else if (roll < 0.70) {
            transitionTo('butterfly-bat', 2400);
          } else if (roll < 0.75) {
            transitionTo('tail-chase', 2000);
          } else if (roll < 0.80) {
            audioEngineRef.current?.playSuccessChime();
            transitionTo('knuth-texbook', 3000);
          } else if (roll < 0.85) {
            transitionTo('loaf', 3600);
          } else if (roll < 0.90) {
            audioEngineRef.current?.playBoxThud();
            transitionTo('box-sit', 3000);
          } else if (roll < 0.94) {
            audioEngineRef.current?.playZoomieWhoosh();
            transitionTo('midnight-zoomies', 2400);
          } else {
            // Autonomous Waypoint Stroll
            triggerRoam();
          }
        }
        scheduleNextBehavior();
      }, delay);
    };

    scheduleNextBehavior();

    return () => {
      if (organicScheduleTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(organicScheduleTimerRef.current);
    };
  }, [isEnabled, isPaused, isReducedMotion, isDragging, isLaserActive, transitionTo, triggerRoam]);

  // Stage 19: Feline Annoyance Engine Reaction Trigger
  const triggerAnnoyanceReaction = useCallback((reason?: string) => {
    if (!isEnabled || isPaused) return;
    resetInactivityTimer();
    const currentReason = reason || 'general';
    setAnnoyanceReason(currentReason);
    setAnnoyanceLevel(prev => Math.min(100, prev + 35));

    const annoyedStates: { state: DeskPetActionState; duration: number; sound?: () => void }[] = [
      { state: 'airplane-ears', duration: 2200, sound: () => audioEngineRef.current?.playAlertBoop() },
      { state: 'annoyed-hiss', duration: 1800, sound: () => audioEngineRef.current?.playHiss() },
      { state: 'swat-aggressive', duration: 1400, sound: () => audioEngineRef.current?.playAlertBoop() },
      { state: 'tail-thump', duration: 2400, sound: () => audioEngineRef.current?.playTailThump() },
      { state: 'cold-shoulder', duration: 3200 },
      { state: 'facepalm-paw', duration: 2600, sound: () => audioEngineRef.current?.playAlertBoop() },
      { state: 'paper-shred', duration: 2000, sound: () => audioEngineRef.current?.playTreatCrunch() },
      { state: 'glare-judge', duration: 3000 },
      { state: 'dizzy-wobble', duration: 2600 },
      { state: 'keyboard-sprawl', duration: 3500 },
      { state: 'hairball-cough', duration: 2400, sound: () => audioEngineRef.current?.playAlertBoop() },
      { state: 'drama-flop', duration: 2800, sound: () => audioEngineRef.current?.playPurr(800) },
    ];

    const pick = annoyedStates[Math.floor(Math.random() * annoyedStates.length)];
    pick.sound?.();
    transitionTo(pick.state, pick.duration);
  }, [isEnabled, isPaused, resetInactivityTimer, transitionTo]);

  // Stage 19: Authentic Behaviors & Quick Action Triggers

  const playSpecificAnimation = useCallback((anim: DeskPetActionState, durationMs = 2800) => {

    else if (anim === 'tail-thump') audioEngineRef.current?.playTailThump();
    else if (anim === 'midnight-zoomies' || anim === 'math-zoomies') audioEngineRef.current?.playZoomieWhoosh();
    else if (anim === 'laser-pounce') audioEngineRef.current?.playPounceLeap();
    else if (anim === 'blep' || anim === 'cello-leg') audioEngineRef.current?.playSlurp();
    else if (anim === 'focus-scholar') audioEngineRef.current?.playSingingBowl();
    else if (anim === 'knead-dough' || anim === 'slow-blink' || anim === 'cheek-bunt' || anim === 'loaf-wiggle') audioEngineRef.current?.playPurr(1500);
    else if (anim === 'knuth-texbook' || anim === 'knuth-check' || anim === 'compile-success' || anim === 'qed-celebration') audioEngineRef.current?.playSuccessChime();
    else if (anim === 'knock-mug') audioEngineRef.current?.playMugClink();
    else if (anim === 'box-sit') audioEngineRef.current?.playBoxThud();
    else if (anim === 'fish-feast') audioEngineRef.current?.playTreatCrunch();
    else if (anim === 'yarn-chase') audioEngineRef.current?.playYarnChirp();
    else if (anim === 'laser-chase') audioEngineRef.current?.playLaserChirp();

  }, [isEnabled, isPaused, resetInactivityTimer, transitionTo]);

  }, [isEnabled, isPaused, resetInactivityTimer, transitionTo]);

  const triggerLaser = useCallback(() => {
    if (!isEnabled || isPaused) return;

    transitionTo('belly-flop', 2600);
  }, [isEnabled, isPaused, resetInactivityTimer, transitionTo]);

  const triggerEarScratch = useCallback(() => {
    if (!isEnabled || isPaused) return;
    resetInactivityTimer();
    transitionTo('ear-scratch', 2200);
  }, [isEnabled, isPaused, resetInactivityTimer, transitionTo]);

  const triggerNapYawn = useCallback(() => {
    if (!isEnabled || isPaused) return;
    resetInactivityTimer();
    audioEngineRef.current?.playYawnSigh();
    transitionTo('nap-yawn', 2400);
  }, [isEnabled, isPaused, resetInactivityTimer, transitionTo]);

  const triggerPet = useCallback(() => {
    if (!isEnabled || isPaused) return;
    resetInactivityTimer();

    const now = Date.now();
    petTimestampsRef.current = petTimestampsRef.current.filter(t => now - t < 5000);
    petTimestampsRef.current.push(now);

    if (petTimestampsRef.current.length >= 8) {
      // Feline overstimulation / petting aggression
      petTimestampsRef.current = [];
      triggerAnnoyanceReaction('over_petting');
      return;
    }

    setPetCount(prev => prev + 1);
    audioEngineRef.current?.playPurr();
    if (state === 'sleep' || state === 'loaf') {
      wakeUp();
    }
  }, [isEnabled, isPaused, state, wakeUp, resetInactivityTimer, triggerAnnoyanceReaction]);

  // Stage 19: Real-Time Active Laser Chasing Kinematics Loop
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isLaserActive || !isEnabled || isPaused) return;

    const handlePointerMove = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      setLaserCoords({ x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY });
    };

    window.addEventListener('pointermove', handlePointerMove, { passive: true });

    const chaseInterval = setInterval(() => {
      if (!isLaserActive || isDragging) return;

      const targetX = typeof window !== 'undefined'
        ? Math.max(20, Math.min(window.innerWidth - 60, window.innerWidth - laserCoords.x - 30))
        : 100;
      const targetY = typeof window !== 'undefined'
        ? Math.max(20, Math.min(window.innerHeight - 60, window.innerHeight - laserCoords.y - 20))
        : 40;

      const dx = targetX - perchX;
      const dy = targetY - perchY;
      const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);

      if (dx > 10) setDirection('left');
      else if (dx < -10) setDirection('right');

      if (dist > 80) {
        // Active sprint towards moving red dot
        const speed = Math.min(dist, 55);
        const nextX = perchX + (dx / dist) * speed;
        const nextY = perchY + (dy / dist) * speed;
        setPerchX(Math.round(nextX));
        setPerchY(Math.round(nextY));
        setIsSnappedToDock(false);

        setState(cur => (cur === 'laser-pounce' || cur === 'pounce-prep' ? cur : 'laser-chase'));
      } else if (dist <= 80 && dist > 15) {
        // Pre-pounce butt wiggle
        setState('pounce-prep');
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (!isLaserActive) return;
          // Pounce leap slam directly onto the dot
          setPerchX(targetX);
          setPerchY(targetY);
          setState('laser-pounce');
          audioEngineRef.current?.playPounceLeap();
        }, 450);
      }
    }, 110);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('pointermove', handlePointerMove);
      clearInterval(chaseInterval);
    };
  }, [isLaserActive, isEnabled, isPaused, laserCoords, perchX, perchY, isDragging]);

  // 2D Pointer Drag, Ledge Snap & Shimeji-Style Fling Physics
  const startDrag = useCallback((e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    if (isReducedMotion) return;
    if ((e.target as HTMLElement).closest('button')) return;

    try {
      (e.target as HTMLElement).setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    } catch {
      // Ignore
    }

    clearStateTimer();
    setIsDragging(true);
    setState('lifted-scruff');
    dragStartTimeRef.current = Date.now();

    dragStartRef.current = {
      clientX: e.clientX,
      clientY: e.clientY,
      initialPerchX: perchX,
      initialPerchY: isSnappedToDock ? 36 : perchY,
      lastX: e.clientX,
      lastY: e.clientY,
      lastTime: Date.now(),
      vx: 0,
      vy: 0,
    };

    const handlePointerMove = (moveEv: PointerEvent) => {
      if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
      const dx = moveEv.clientX - dragStartRef.current.clientX;
      const dy = moveEv.clientY - dragStartRef.current.clientY;

      // Invert dx because perchX is measured from right edge; subtract dy because bottom position increases as cursor moves up (dy < 0)
      const newPerchX = Math.max(16, Math.min(window.innerWidth - 80, dragStartRef.current.initialPerchX - dx));
      const newPerchY = Math.max(16, Math.min(window.innerHeight - 80, dragStartRef.current.initialPerchY - dy));

      setPerchX(newPerchX);
      setPerchY(newPerchY);

      const now = Date.now();
      const dt = Math.max(1, now - dragStartRef.current.lastTime);
      const vx = (moveEv.clientX - dragStartRef.current.lastX) / dt;
      const vy = (moveEv.clientY - dragStartRef.current.lastY) / dt;

      dragStartRef.current.vx = vx;
      dragStartRef.current.vy = vy;
      dragStartRef.current.lastX = moveEv.clientX;
      dragStartRef.current.lastY = moveEv.clientY;
      dragStartRef.current.lastTime = now;

      const tilt = Math.max(-24, Math.min(24, vx * 12));
      setDragTilt(tilt);
    };

    const handlePointerUp = (upEv: PointerEvent) => {
      try {
        (upEv.target as HTMLElement).releasePointerCapture(upEv.pointerId);
      } catch {
        // Ignore
      }

      window.removeEventListener('pointermove', handlePointerMove);
      window.removeEventListener('pointerup', handlePointerUp);
      window.removeEventListener('pointercancel', handlePointerUp);

      setIsDragging(false);
      setDragTilt(0);

      if (dragStartTimeRef.current && Date.now() - dragStartTimeRef.current > 2500) {
        // Drag abuse: held by scruff for too long triggers dizzy/annoyance
        triggerAnnoyanceReaction('drag_abuse');
      }
      dragStartTimeRef.current = null;

      const dragInfo = dragStartRef.current;
      dragStartRef.current = null;

      // 1. Shimeji Fling Detection: If released with high velocity, animate fling inertia
      const speed = dragInfo ? Math.sqrt(dragInfo.vx * dragInfo.vx + dragInfo.vy * dragInfo.vy) : 0;
      if (speed > 0.45) {
        setState('fling-air');
        setTimeout(() => {
          setState('landing');
          setTimeout(() => setState('idle'), 350);
        }, 400);
      } else {
        setState('landing');
        stateTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
          setState('idle');
        }, 350);
      }

      // 2. Dock Ledge Magnetic Snap: If within 64px of bottom dock ledge line, snap to dock
      setPerchY(curY => {
        const isNearLedge = curY <= 68;
        setIsSnappedToDock(isNearLedge);
        try {
          localStorage.setItem(SNAPPED_STORAGE_KEY, isNearLedge ? 'true' : 'false');
          localStorage.setItem(PERCH_Y_STORAGE_KEY, isNearLedge ? '36' : curY.toString());
        } catch {
          // Ignore
        }
        return isNearLedge ? 36 : curY;
      });

      setPerchX(curX => {
        try {
          localStorage.setItem(PERCH_X_STORAGE_KEY, curX.toString());
        } catch {
          // Ignore
        }
        return curX;
      });
    };

    window.addEventListener('pointermove', handlePointerMove);
    window.addEventListener('pointerup', handlePointerUp);
    window.addEventListener('pointercancel', handlePointerUp);
  }, [isReducedMotion, perchX, perchY, clearStateTimer, triggerAnnoyanceReaction]);

  // Cleanup on unmount or when disabled
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isEnabled) {
      clearStateTimer();
      if (inactivityTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(inactivityTimerRef.current);
      if (loafTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(loafTimerRef.current);
      if (organicScheduleTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(organicScheduleTimerRef.current);
      if (walkStepTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(walkStepTimerRef.current);
      if (typingSettleTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(typingSettleTimerRef.current);
      if (dreamIntervalRef.current) clearInterval(dreamIntervalRef.current);
      setState('idle');
      setPacingOffset(0);
      setIsDragging(false);
      setDragTilt(0);
      setIsLaserActive(false);
    } else {
      resetInactivityTimer();
    }
    return () => {
      clearStateTimer();
      if (inactivityTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(inactivityTimerRef.current);
      if (loafTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(loafTimerRef.current);
      if (organicScheduleTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(organicScheduleTimerRef.current);
      if (walkStepTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(walkStepTimerRef.current);
      if (typingSettleTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(typingSettleTimerRef.current);
      if (dreamIntervalRef.current) clearInterval(dreamIntervalRef.current);
    };
  }, [isEnabled, clearStateTimer, resetInactivityTimer]);

  return {
    isEnabled,
    isExiting,
    entryVariant,
    exitVariant,
    setIsEnabled,
    toggleEnabled,
    state,
    direction,
    pacingOffset: isReducedMotion ? 0 : pacingOffset,
    isSleeping: state === 'sleep',
    isReducedMotion,
    isPaused,
    petCount,
    skin,
    setSkin,
    cycleSkin,
    accessory,
    setAccessory,
    cycleAccessory,
    isSoundEnabled,
    toggleSound,
    volume,
    setVolume,
    perchX,
    perchY,
    isSnappedToDock,
    resetPositionToDock,
    dragTilt: isReducedMotion ? 0 : dragTilt,
    isDragging,
    startDrag,
    currentDreamFormula,
    triggerYarnChase,
    triggerPet,
    wakeUp,
    toggleSleep,
    // Stage 15 additions:
    roamMode,
    setRoamMode,
    toggleRoamMode,
    isTransitioning,
    isLaserActive,
    laserCoords,
    triggerLaser,
    triggerBox,
    triggerFish,
    triggerKnuthCelebration,
    triggerPeekABoo,
    triggerSwatCursor,
    triggerKnockMug,
    triggerBellyFlop,
    triggerEarScratch,
    triggerNapYawn,
    triggerRoam,
    // Stage 19 additions:
    annoyanceLevel,
    annoyanceReason,
    scholarXp,
    scholarLevel: scholarInfo.level,
    scholarTitle: scholarInfo.title,

/**
 * Teeex — authentication and local profiles.
 *
 * WHAT CHANGED AND WHY
 *
 * This module previously granted privileges from values the user controls:
 *
 *  - Approval checks read a `teeex_approved_emails_cache` list out of
 *    localStorage and were OR-ed into the server's approval check, so writing one
 *    key in devtools satisfied the approval gate.
 *  - `DEMO_ACCOUNTS` shipped `admin@teeex.io` with the password `admin` and
 *    `isAdmin: true`, plus three accounts with no password at all, surfaced as
 *    one-click "Quick demo login" buttons.
 *  - The stored session carried `isAdmin`/`isApproved` and was "protected" by a
 *    SHA-256 signature whose salt sits in the same bundle, so it was forgeable —
 *    while the code logged "Tampered auth session signature detected" as though
 *    it were a control.
 *
 * Now: privileges are server facts or they do not exist. The stored session
 * holds identity only — never `isAdmin` or `isApproved` — so a tampered blob
 * cannot escalate anything; the worst it can do is change a display name.
 * `is_admin` is resolved from `profiles` per session and kept in memory.
 *
 * There are two modes, and the UI says which one is active:
 *
 *  - **cloud** — Supabase is configured. Real authentication, approval from
 *    `profiles.is_approved`, admin from `profiles.is_admin`. Approval is granted
 *    by an operator in the Supabase dashboard or through the `approve_profile`
 *    RPC, which checks the caller is an admin.
 *  - **local** — no Supabase credentials. There is nothing to authenticate
 *    against, so the app does not pretend: the user names a local workspace and
 *    documents stay in this browser. No password, no approval, no admin.
 */

import type { UserProfile } from '../types/latex';
import { getSupabaseClient, isSupabaseConnected } from './supabaseClient';
import { sha256Sync } from './shareSecurityService';

const AUTH_STORAGE_KEY = 'teeex_auth_user';
const REMEMBER_ME_KEY = 'teeex_remember_me';
const SIGNED_OUT_KEY = 'teeex_signed_out';

/**
 * Integrity checksum, not a security control: it catches a half-written or
 * stale record from an older schema so the app starts clean instead of
 * crashing on a malformed profile. Any value a client can recompute cannot
 * authenticate anything, which is why nothing security-relevant is stored
 * here in the first place.
 */
const SESSION_CHECKSUM_KEY = 'teeex-session-v4';

export type AuthMode = 'cloud' | 'local';

export function getAuthMode(): AuthMode {
  return isSupabaseConnected() ? 'cloud' : 'local';
}

/** Fields that are safe to persist: identity and presentation only. */
interface StoredIdentity {
  id: string;
  email: string;
  fullName: string;
  avatarColor?: string;
  avatarUrl?: string;
  authProvider: 'supabase' | 'local';
}

interface StoredSessionWrapper {
  user: StoredIdentity;
  issuedAt: number;
  sum: string;
}

function checksum(identity: StoredIdentity, issuedAt: number): string {
  return sha256Sync(
    `${SESSION_CHECKSUM_KEY}:${identity.id}:${identity.email}:${identity.authProvider}:${issuedAt}`,
  );
}

function toStoredIdentity(user: UserProfile): StoredIdentity {
  return {
    id: user.id,
    email: user.email,
    fullName: user.fullName,
    avatarColor: user.avatarColor,
    avatarUrl: user.avatarUrl,
    authProvider: user.authProvider === 'supabase' ? 'supabase' : 'local',
  };
}

/**
 * Admin status for the current session, held in memory only. Resolved from
 * `profiles.is_admin` on sign-in and on session verification; never read from
 * or written to storage.
 */
let sessionIsAdmin = false;

export function isSessionAdmin(): boolean {
  return sessionIsAdmin;
}

function toUserProfile(identity: StoredIdentity): UserProfile {
  return {
    id: identity.id,
    email: identity.email,
    fullName: identity.fullName,
    avatarColor: identity.avatarColor,
    avatarUrl: identity.avatarUrl,
    isAnonymous: false,
    // Local workspaces have no privilege model at all; cloud sessions get their
    // real value from verifyActiveSupabaseSession().
    isAdmin: false,
    isApproved: identity.authProvider === 'local' ? true : false,
    authProvider: identity.authProvider,
  };
}

export function isLocalProfile(user: UserProfile | null): boolean {
  return Boolean(user) && user!.authProvider !== 'supabase';
}

export function getStoredSession(): { user: UserProfile | null; rememberMe: boolean } {
  if (localStorage.getItem(SIGNED_OUT_KEY) === 'true') {
    return { user: null, rememberMe: false };
  }

  const read = (raw: string | null): UserProfile | null => {
    if (!raw) return null;
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as StoredSessionWrapper;
      if (
        !parsed?.user?.id ||
        typeof parsed.issuedAt !== 'number' ||
        typeof parsed.sum !== 'string'
      ) {
        return null;
      }
      if (parsed.sum !== checksum(parsed.user, parsed.issuedAt)) return null;
      return toUserProfile(parsed.user);
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  };

  const remembered = read(localStorage.getItem(AUTH_STORAGE_KEY));
  if (remembered) return { user: remembered, rememberMe: true };
  if (localStorage.getItem(AUTH_STORAGE_KEY)) localStorage.removeItem(AUTH_STORAGE_KEY);

  const perSession = read(sessionStorage.getItem(AUTH_STORAGE_KEY));
  if (perSession) return { user: perSession, rememberMe: false };
  if (sessionStorage.getItem(AUTH_STORAGE_KEY)) sessionStorage.removeItem(AUTH_STORAGE_KEY);

  return { user: null, rememberMe: false };
}

export function saveSession(user: UserProfile, rememberMe: boolean): void {
  localStorage.removeItem(SIGNED_OUT_KEY);

  const identity = toStoredIdentity(user);
  const issuedAt = Date.now();
  const json = JSON.stringify({
    user: identity,
    issuedAt,
    sum: checksum(identity, issuedAt),
  } satisfies StoredSessionWrapper);

  localStorage.setItem(REMEMBER_ME_KEY, rememberMe ? 'true' : 'false');
  if (rememberMe) {
    localStorage.setItem(AUTH_STORAGE_KEY, json);
    sessionStorage.removeItem(AUTH_STORAGE_KEY);
  } else {
    sessionStorage.setItem(AUTH_STORAGE_KEY, json);
    localStorage.removeItem(AUTH_STORAGE_KEY);
  }
}

export function clearSession(): void {
  sessionIsAdmin = false;
  localStorage.removeItem(AUTH_STORAGE_KEY);
  sessionStorage.removeItem(AUTH_STORAGE_KEY);
  localStorage.setItem(SIGNED_OUT_KEY, 'true');
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- local mode --

const LOCAL_PROFILE_KEY = 'teeex_local_profile';

/**
 * Creates or reuses this browser's local workspace profile. Deliberately not
 * authentication: there is no server, so there is nothing to prove. The id is
 * random and stable per browser so project ownership strings stay consistent.
 */
export function startLocalWorkspace(
  displayName: string,
  rememberMe = true,
): { success: true; user: UserProfile } {
  let id: string;
  try {
    id = localStorage.getItem(LOCAL_PROFILE_KEY) || '';
    if (!id) {
      id =
        typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && typeof crypto.randomUUID === 'function'
          ? `local-${crypto.randomUUID()}`
          : `local-${Array.from(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16))).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('')}`;
      localStorage.setItem(LOCAL_PROFILE_KEY, id);
    }
  } catch {
    id = typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && typeof crypto.randomUUID === 'function'
      ? `local-${crypto.randomUUID()}`
      : `local-${Date.now().toString(36)}`;
  }

  const name = displayName.trim() || 'Local workspace';
  const user: UserProfile = {
    id,
    // Not an address anyone can reach; it exists because Project rows key the
    // owner and member list on an email-shaped string.
    email: `${id}@local.invalid`,
    fullName: name,
    avatarColor: '#38bdf8',
    isAnonymous: false,
    isAdmin: false,
    isApproved: true,
    authProvider: 'local',
  };

  sessionIsAdmin = false;
  saveSession(user, rememberMe);
  return { success: true, user };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- cloud mode --

async function resolveCloudProfile(
  userId: string,
  email: string,
  metadataName: string | undefined,
): Promise<{ user: UserProfile; isApproved: boolean; isAdmin: boolean } | null> {
  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();
  if (!supabase) return null;

  const { data: profile } = await supabase
    .from('profiles')
    .select('is_approved, is_admin, full_name, avatar_color')
    .eq('id', userId)
    .maybeSingle();

  // Approval and admin come from the server row and nowhere else. A missing row
  // means not approved — fail closed.
  const isApproved = profile?.is_approved === true;
  const isAdmin = profile?.is_admin === true;

  return {
    user: {
      id: userId,
      email,
      fullName: profile?.full_name || metadataName || email.split('@')[0],
      avatarColor: profile?.avatar_color || '#38bdf8',
      isAnonymous: false,
      isAdmin,
      isApproved,
      authProvider: 'supabase',
    },
    isApproved,
    isAdmin,
  };
}

export async function loginWithEmail(
  email: string,
  pass: string,
  rememberMe: boolean,
): Promise<{ success: boolean; user?: UserProfile; error?: string }> {
  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();
  if (!supabase) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error:
        'This deployment has no cloud account service configured. Use the local workspace instead — documents stay in this browser.',
    };
  }

  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password: pass });
    if (error) return { success: false, error: error.message };
    if (!data.user) return { success: false, error: 'Sign-in failed.' };

    const resolved = await resolveCloudProfile(
      data.user.id,
      data.user.email || email,
      data.user.user_metadata?.full_name,
    );

    // An admin still has to be approved; there is no longer a path where
    // is_admin alone opens the door.
    if (!resolved || !resolved.isApproved) {
      await supabase.auth.signOut();
      return { success: false, error: 'Your account is pending administrator approval.' };
    }

    sessionIsAdmin = resolved.isAdmin;
    saveSession(resolved.user, rememberMe);
    return { success: true, user: resolved.user };
  } catch (cause) {
    // Never fall back to a local privilege grant on a cloud error: a network
    // blip must not become an authentication bypass.
    return {
      success: false,
      error: cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : 'Could not reach the account service.',
    };
  }
}

export async function signUpWithEmail(
  email: string,
  pass: string,
  fullName: string,
  _rememberMe: boolean,
): Promise<{ success: boolean; user?: UserProfile; error?: string }> {
  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();
  if (!supabase) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error:
        'This deployment has no cloud account service configured. Use the local workspace instead — documents stay in this browser.',
    };
  }

  try {
    // Only full_name is sent. is_approved/is_admin used to be passed here and
    // read by the handle_new_user trigger, which meant a direct call to the auth
    // endpoint could request an approved administrator account at signup. The
    // trigger now hardcodes both to false and ignores client metadata.
    const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signUp({
      email,
      password: pass,
      options: { data: { full_name: fullName } },
    });

    if (error) return { success: false, error: error.message };

    if (data.user) await supabase.auth.signOut();
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'Your account has been created and is pending administrator approval.',
    };
  } catch (cause) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : 'Could not reach the account service.',
    };
  }
}

export async function requestPasswordReset(
  email: string,
): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; error?: string }> {
  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();
  if (!supabase) {
    return {
      success: false,
      message: '',
      error: 'This deployment has no cloud account service configured.',
    };
  }

  try {
    const { error } = await supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email, {
      redirectTo: window.location.origin,
    });
    if (error) return { success: false, message: '', error: error.message };
    return {
      success: true,
      // Deliberately does not confirm whether the address is registered.
      message: `If an account exists for ${email}, reset instructions are on their way.`,
    };
  } catch (cause) {
    return {
      success: false,
      message: '',
      error: cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : 'Could not reach the account service.',
    };
  }
}

export async function signOutUser(): Promise<void> {
  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();
  if (supabase) {
    try {
      await supabase.auth.signOut();
    } catch (cause) {
      console.warn('Supabase sign-out failed; clearing the local session anyway.', cause);
    }
  }
  clearSession();
}

/**
 * Re-resolves the signed-in user against the server on startup.
 *
 * A local workspace profile is returned as-is — there is no server to check it
 * against. A cloud session is re-read from `profiles` every time, so revoking
 * approval or admin takes effect on the user's next load rather than whenever
 * their cached blob happens to expire.
 */
export async function verifyActiveSupabaseSession(): Promise<UserProfile | null> {
  const stored = getStoredSession();

  if (stored.user && isLocalProfile(stored.user)) {
    sessionIsAdmin = false;
    return stored.user;
  }

  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();
  if (!supabase) return stored.user;

  try {
    const {
      data: { session },
      error,
    } = await supabase.auth.getSession();

    if (error || !session?.user) {
      if (stored.user?.authProvider === 'supabase') {
        clearSession();
        return null;
      }
      return stored.user;
    }

    const resolved = await resolveCloudProfile(
      session.user.id,
      session.user.email || '',
      session.user.user_metadata?.full_name,
    );

    if (!resolved || !resolved.isApproved) {
      await supabase.auth.signOut();
      clearSession();
      return null;
    }

    sessionIsAdmin = resolved.isAdmin;
    saveSession(resolved.user, localStorage.getItem(REMEMBER_ME_KEY) !== 'false');
    return resolved.user;
  } catch (cause) {
    // Offline: keep the stored identity so the editor stays usable, but do not
    // grant admin on an unverified session.
    console.warn('Could not verify the cloud session; continuing with stored identity.', cause);
    sessionIsAdmin = false;
    return stored.user;
  }
}

import { StrictMode } from 'react'
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client'
import './index.css'
import './styles/pdf-viewer.css'
import App from './App.tsx'
import { ErrorBoundary } from './components/ErrorBoundary'
import { registerServiceWorker } from './services/serviceWorker'
import { texEngine } from './services/latexCompiler'

// Kick off Service Worker immediately
registerServiceWorker().catch(() => {});

// Pre-warm WASM engine and PDF.js immediately in background worker so initial frame renders in <200ms
if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
  texEngine.prewarm('pdflatex');
  void import('./services/pdfRenderer').then((m) => m.prewarmPdfRenderer()).catch(() => {});
}

createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(
  <StrictMode>
    <ErrorBoundary>
      <App />
    </ErrorBoundary>
  </StrictMode>,
)

    });

  describe('Tab Inactivity & Visibility Pause (document.hidden)', () => {
    beforeEach(() => {
      localStorage.setItem('teeex_desk_pet_enabled', 'true');
    });

    it('pauses state and clears timers when document.hidden is true', async () => {
      await mountHook();
      expect(currentHook.isPaused).toBe(false);

      // Simulate tab backgrounding
      Object.defineProperty(document, 'hidden', { value: true, configurable: true });
      await act(async () => {
        document.dispatchEvent(new Event('visibilitychange'));
      });
      expect(currentHook.isPaused).toBe(true);

      // Advance timers while hidden: should NOT transition to sleep because timer is canceled
      await act(async () => {
        vi.advanceTimersByTime(50000);
      });
      expect(currentHook.state).toBe('idle');

      // Simulate tab return
      Object.defineProperty(document, 'hidden', { value: false, configurable: true });
      await act(async () => {
        document.dispatchEvent(new Event('visibilitychange'));
      });
      expect(currentHook.isPaused).toBe(false);
    });
  });

    it('corrects vertical drag physics to move UP when pointer moves up', async () => {
      localStorage.setItem('teeex_desk_pet_enabled', 'true');
      await mountHook();

      expect(currentHook.perchY).toBe(36);

      // Simulate pointer down to begin drag
      const mockElement = document.createElement('div');
      await act(async () => {
        currentHook.startDrag({
          clientX: 500,
          clientY: 400,
          pointerId: 1,
          target: mockElement,
        } as unknown as React.PointerEvent);
      });

      expect(currentHook.isDragging).toBe(true);

      // Simulate pointer moving UP (clientY moves from 400 down to 300, dy = -100)
      await act(async () => {
        window.dispatchEvent(
          new PointerEvent('pointermove', {
            clientX: 500,
            clientY: 300,
          })
        );
      });

      // Upwards pointer motion (dy < 0) MUST increase perchY (moving UP away from bottom)
      expect(currentHook.perchY).toBe(136); // 36 - (-100) = 136

      // Release drag
      await act(async () => {
        window.dispatchEvent(
          new PointerEvent('pointerup', {
            clientX: 500,
            clientY: 300,
          })
        );
      });
      expect(currentHook.isDragging).toBe(false);
    });
  });

  describe('Stage 19: Pet Scholar Progression, Authentic Behaviors & Feline Annoyance Engine', () => {
    beforeEach(() => {
      localStorage.setItem('teeex_desk_pet_enabled', 'true');
    });

    it('verifies mascot opacity is full and never fades on hover (no ghost-hover class)', async () => {
      await act(async () => {
        root.render(
          React.createElement(DeskPet, {
            isEnabled: true,

          })

      const mascotWrapper = container.querySelector('.desk-pet-mascot-wrapper');
      expect(mascotWrapper).not.toBeNull();
      expect(mascotWrapper?.classList.contains('ghost-hover')).toBe(false);
    });

    it('renders clean dream thought bubble without explicit button and surprises user by inserting formula on bubble click', async () => {
      const mockInsert = vi.fn();
      await act(async () => {
        root.render(
          React.createElement(DeskPet, {
            isEnabled: true,
            state: 'sleep',
            direction: 'right',
            pacingOffset: 0,
            isSleeping: true,
            isReducedMotion: false,
            isPaused: false,
            petCount: 0,
            currentDreamFormula: 'e^{i\\pi} + 1 = 0',
            onInsertFormula: mockInsert,
          })
        );
      });

      const dreamBubble = container.querySelector('.pet-dream-bubble');
      expect(dreamBubble).not.toBeNull();
      // Ensure no explicit "Insert" button is rendered
      const insertBtn = Array.from(dreamBubble?.querySelectorAll('button') || []).find(b => b.textContent?.includes('Insert'));
      expect(insertBtn).toBeUndefined();

      // Clicking the dream bubble directly triggers onInsertFormula as a surprise
      await act(async () => {
        dreamBubble?.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true }));
      });
      expect(mockInsert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('e^{i\\pi} + 1 = 0');

      // Feedback badge appears

## File: README.md
````markdown
# Teeex

A modern, browser-native LaTeX editor (React 19 + Vite 8 + CodeMirror 6). Documents are typeset
by **real pdfLaTeX** (TeX Live 2026, compiled to WebAssembly via
`texlyre-busytex` 1.4.0) running locally in the browser and rendered with PDF.js
6.4 — not by an HTML approximation of LaTeX.

## Architecture

```
Project files (entry resolved from \documentclass / isEntry)
│
▼
pdfLaTeX — WebAssembly, Web Worker        ← the only layout engine
│
├── PDF bytes ──┬──► pdf.js ──► preview
│               └──► download          ← the same bytes, not a re-render
├── SyncTeX     ────► source ↔ page mapping
└── log         ────► diagnostics & 1-click quick-fixes
```

The preview and the exported file are **the same authoritative artifact**. The preview does not
compute its own layout, and export does not re-render the document, so the two
cannot disagree about line breaking, hyphenation, pagination, page size, or typography. Also,
the source handed to pdfLaTeX is never rewritten or stripped before compilation.

Alongside the PDF viewer, an **Outline & Structure** panel lists the document's sections,
labels, figures, tables, and citations as navigation elements so you can
jump to source lines while a compile runs.

---

## Features

- **Authoritative Typesetting**: Real pdfLaTeX WebAssembly engine executing in a background Web Worker. What you see in the viewer is byte-for-byte identical to the exported PDF.
- **Bi-directional SyncTeX**: Precise source-to-PDF forward jump and double-click inverse navigation with vertical centering and laser-pulse highlights.
- **In-Document PDF Search & Navigation**:
  - Full-text search across all PDF pages via `findText` (`Ctrl+F` / `Cmd+F`).
  - Next/previous match cycling (`Enter` / `Shift+Enter`) with live counter (`[ 2 of 5 ]`) and auto-scroll to match coordinates.
  - Interactive page jump input (`Page [ 3 ] / 12`).
  - Native hyperref link annotations with strict URL protocol sanitization.
- **CodeMirror 6 LaTeX Authoring**:
  - Code folding for balanced `\begin{...} ... \end{...}` environments (equations, figures, tables, proofs).
  - Multi-file BibTeX aggregation across all project `.bib` files with deduplicated citation autocomplete.
  - Preamble package autocompletion and macro snippets.
- **Academic Template Presets**:
  - Built-in support for standard articles, **IEEEtran**, ACM (**`acmart`**), and Springer Nature (**`sn-jnl`**).
  - Automatic virtual filesystem mounting of companion packages, styles, font metrics (`.tfm`, `.fd`), and bibliography styles (`ACM-Reference-Format.bst`, `sn-basic.bst`).
  - Smart bibliography detection distinguishing standard BibTeX from `biblatex` (warning if `backend=bibtex` is required).
- **Capability-Based Cloud Sharing & Collaboration**:
  - Cryptographically secure share links with dedicated view tokens (`vw_...`) and edit tokens (`ed_...`).
  - Row Level Security (RLS) enforcement in Supabase with server-side SHA-256 capability token hashing and owner-pinning triggers.
  - Real-time CRDT synchronization via Yjs with capability header injection for anonymous collaborators.
  - Local cross-tab sync via `BroadcastChannel` with offline-first persistence (OPFS + IndexedDB fallback).

---

## Getting started

```bash
npm install
```

The TeX engine's WASM and TeX Live data are not on npm — the full upstream
archive is ~498 MiB. A version-pinned subset (pdfTeX engine + texlive-basic) is
fetched into `public/core/busytex/` by a prebuild step, along with PDF.js CMaps
and standard fonts. `npm run dev` and `npm run build` run it automatically; to do
it explicitly:

```bash
npm run engine
```

Then start the development server:

```bash
npm run dev
```

The first compile downloads the engine once (~128 MB across `busytex.wasm` and
`texlive-basic.data`) and caches it in browser storage. Compiles take seconds, not milliseconds —
that is the cost of real TeX, and the same cost Overleaf pays server-side.

---

## Packages

`texlive-basic` and a curated set of common academic `.sty`/`.cls`/`.bst` files in `public/packages/` ship locally (35 standard academic packages plus Springer Nature `sn-jnl.cls` and `sn-basic.bst`, totaling 37 files).

Before the WASM engine runs, `preloadDocumentPackages()` resolves the transitive dependency closure of packages and classes declared in the preamble (`\usepackage`, `\RequirePackage`, `\LoadClass`, `\input`) and mounts them into MEMFS.
- **In-Flight Request Deduplication**: Simultaneous requests for the same package file share a single in-flight promise to eliminate redundant roundtrips.
- **Bounded Fetch Concurrency**: Remote fetches are constrained to at most 8 parallel HTTP requests.
- **Payload Streaming Guard**: Responses are streamed with an 8 MiB upper limit; oversized responses or bodies advertising `Content-Length > 8 MiB` are immediately aborted.
- **160-File Cap**: Live resolution limits total preloaded files to 160 to prevent memory exhaustion from cyclic or unbounded package dependency trees.
- **Strict 404 Caching**: Only permanent HTTP 404 responses are cached as negative misses; transient 5xx errors or network drops remain retryable on subsequent compiles.

### Essential Package Provisioning

Local packages are provisioned by `scripts/download-essential-packages.mjs` during `npm run predev` and `npm run prebuild`:
- **Cryptographic Integrity Manifest**: Package sizes and SHA-256 digests are pinned in `scripts/essential-package-hashes.json`. Both newly downloaded files and existing cached assets are verified against this manifest.
- **Streaming Response Limits**: Upstream responses are inspected for `Content-Length` headers (> 8 MiB rejected immediately) and read in streamed chunks with hard cancellation if accumulated bytes exceed 8 MiB, preventing unbounded memory consumption.
- **Bounded Concurrency & Retries**: Downloads execute across configurable worker pools (default 4, bounded 1–16) with 15-second timeouts and up to two retries per package.
- **Payload & Marker Validation**: In addition to cryptographic hash validation, packages are checked for:
  - Prevention of HTML error payloads and server error messages (`Cannot GET`, `404 Not Found`).
  - Size boundaries (minimum 30 bytes, maximum 8 MiB).
  - Absence of embedded NUL bytes in plain text packages.
  - Expected TeX/BibTeX format markers (`\ProvidesPackage`, `\ProvidesClass`, `\def`, BibTeX entries).
- **Atomic Writes & Verification**: Downloads are staged in temporary files (`.tmp-*`) and atomically renamed into `public/packages/` only after full validation.
- **Strict Failure Policy**: Any download failure, size discrepancy, or hash mismatch triggers an immediate exit (code 1) to halt builds with corrupt assets.

> [!TIP]
> **Offline / Incomplete Package Override**:
> For offline development or environments with restricted external network access, set:
> ```bash
> TEEEX_ALLOW_INCOMPLETE_PACKAGES=1 npm run dev
> ```
> This issues a warning for missing packages while allowing compilation with whatever assets are already cached.

> [!NOTE]
> **Integrity Scope**:
> Manifest hashes in `scripts/essential-package-hashes.json` are repository-managed integrity pins rather than third-party signed cryptographic attestations from upstream CTAN/TeX Live mirrors. Source-marker heuristics provide defense-in-depth against upstream server error pages.

The default remote endpoint is proxied via `/api/texlive` (falling back to `https://texlive2026.texlyre.org`). To point at your own server (see `deploy/texlive-server`):

```bash
VITE_TEXLIVE_REMOTE_ENDPOINT=https://your-texlive-host
```

Set it to `off` to disable remote package resolution entirely; compilation is then limited to the locally provisioned package set.

---

## Scripts

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `npm run dev` | Dev server (runs `predev` provisioning step first) |
| `npm run build` | Typecheck (`tsc`) and Vite production bundle |
| `npm run build:pages` | Typecheck, build, and prune assets exceeding Cloudflare Pages 25MB file limit (`scripts/prune-pages-dist.mjs`) |
| `npm run preview` | Run Vite local preview server on production build |
| `npm run fonts` | Download modern variable fonts into `public/fonts/` (`scripts/download-fonts.mjs`) |
| `npm run engine` | Provision the pdfTeX engine subset into `public/core/busytex/` (`scripts/fetch-engine.mjs`) |
| `npm run engine:full` | Also provision XeTeX and LuaHBTeX engine profiles (`scripts/fetch-engine.mjs --profile full`) |
| `npm run engine:verify` | Verify engine asset cryptographic digests against golden manifest (`scripts/fetch-engine.mjs --verify`) |
| `npm run engine:r2-upload` | Synchronize version-pinned engine assets to Cloudflare R2 bucket mirror (`scripts/upload-r2.mjs`) |
| `node scripts/download-essential-packages.mjs` | Prefetch essential companion `.sty`/`.cls` packages for offline use into `public/packages/` |
| `npm test` | Run Vitest unit & fuzz test matrix (506 tests across 56 files) |
| `npm run test:e2e` | Run Playwright browser verification suite |
| `npx playwright test tests/e2e/benchmark.spec.ts` | Capture cold-start, warm compile, and heap baselines to `docs/benchmarks.json` |
| `npm run lint` | Oxlint fast static analysis |

---

## Status

[`docs/project-state.json`](docs/project-state.json) records confirmed facts, architectural decisions and
their rationale, rejected hypotheses, open questions, and what has and has not
been verified. [`docs/support-matrix.json`](docs/support-matrix.json) records per-capability status across
invocation, artifact, preview, export, and edge cases.

Both files distinguish implemented from verified. Nothing is described as
working on the strength of having been written.

### Known limitations

- **Cold Engine Download**: The first compile requires downloading ~128 MB of WASM and TeX data; compiles take seconds, not milliseconds. Surfaced via real-time progress indicators in the UI.
- **Offline Package Scope**: Offline compilation is limited to `texlive-basic`, `public/packages/`, and packages previously cached in browser IndexedDB/OPFS.
- **XeLaTeX / LuaLaTeX Support**: Selectable from the Navbar engine dropdown. Full multi-engine compilation requires provisioning assets via `npm run engine:full`.
- **Biber Backend**: Browser WASM includes `bibtex8`. For `biblatex` users, `\usepackage[backend=bibtex]{biblatex}` is required as the standalone Perl Biber executable cannot run in browser WebAssembly.

---

## Licensing

The TeX engine is `texlyre-busytex`, licensed under **AGPL-3.0-or-later**.
- The engine executes entirely client-side within browser WebAssembly without proprietary server-side alterations.
- Links to upstream source repositories, licenses, and attributions are maintained in project documentation and the application interface.
- If you deploy Teeex Studio as a public network-accessible service, review AGPL-3.0 Section 13 regarding source code disclosure obligations.
````

## File: public/sw.js
````javascript
/**
 * Teeex — 3-Tier Partitioned Service Worker Cache with LRU Eviction & Navigation Freshness.
 *
 * Cache Partitioning:
 * - CACHE_STATIC: Build-stamped application shell, JS/CSS bundles, fonts, and icons.
 *   Purged automatically on worker activation when new deploys are detected.
 * - CACHE_ENGINE: Version-pinned TeX engine assets (/core/busytex/*).
 *   Preserved across application releases to avoid re-downloading ~152 MB.
 * - CACHE_PACKAGES: Dynamic on-demand TeX Live packages (/packages/*, /api/texlive/*).
 *   Guarded against HTML response poisoning; capped at 300 entries with LRU eviction.
 */

const CACHE_STATIC = 'teeex-static-v7-20261028';
const CACHE_ENGINE = 'teeex-engine-v1.4.2';
const CACHE_PACKAGES = 'teeex-packages-v1';
const MAX_PACKAGE_ENTRIES = 300;

const PRECACHE_STATIC_URLS = [
  '/',
  '/index.html',
  '/favicon.svg',
  '/packages/IEEEtran.cls',
  '/packages/booktabs.sty',
  '/packages/microtype.sty',
  '/packages/cite.sty',
];

let swChannel = null;
try {
  swChannel = new BroadcastChannel('teeex_sw_channel');
} catch {}

self.addEventListener('install', (event) => {
  self.skipWaiting();
  event.waitUntil(
    caches.open(CACHE_STATIC).then((cache) => cache.addAll(PRECACHE_STATIC_URLS).catch(() => {}))
  );
});

self.addEventListener('activate', (event) => {
  event.waitUntil(
    (async () => {
      const keys = await caches.keys();
      await Promise.all(
        keys
          .filter((k) => k !== CACHE_STATIC && k !== CACHE_ENGINE && k !== CACHE_PACKAGES)
          .map((k) => caches.delete(k))
      );
      // Evict stale pipeline JS script from CACHE_ENGINE so fresh patched file is used
      try {
        const engineCache = await caches.open(CACHE_ENGINE);
        await engineCache.delete('/core/busytex/busytex_pipeline.js');
      } catch {}
      await self.clients.claim();
    })()
  );
});

self.addEventListener('message', async (event) => {
  if (event.data?.type === 'GET_ENGINE_STATUS') {
    try {
      const cache = await caches.open(CACHE_ENGINE);
      const wasm = await cache.match('/core/busytex/busytex.wasm');
      const data = await cache.match('/core/busytex/texlive-basic.data');
      event.ports?.[0]?.postMessage({
        isCached: Boolean(wasm && data),
        hasWasm: Boolean(wasm),
        hasData: Boolean(data),
      });
    } catch {
      event.ports?.[0]?.postMessage({ isCached: false });
    }
  } else if (event.data?.type === 'SKIP_WAITING') {
    self.skipWaiting();
  }
});


async function trimCache(cache, maxItems) {
  try {
    const keys = await cache.keys();
    if (keys.length > maxItems) {
      const purgeCount = Math.ceil(maxItems * 0.2); // Purge oldest 20%
      for (let i = 0; i < purgeCount; i++) {
        await cache.delete(keys[i]);
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // Non-fatal
  }
}

self.addEventListener('fetch', (event) => {
  const { request } = event;
  if (request.method !== 'GET') return;

  const url = new URL(request.url);

  // 1. Navigation requests: Network-First with 2.5s timeout, falling back to cached index.html
  // Fixes Defect S3a (the stale-deploy trap) where users were stuck on old builds indefinitely.
  if (
    request.mode === 'navigate' ||
    (url.origin === self.location.origin && (url.pathname === '/' || url.pathname === '/index.html'))
  ) {
    event.respondWith(
      (async () => {
        try {
          const controller = new AbortController();
          const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 2500);
          const networkRes = await fetch(request, { signal: controller.signal });
          clearTimeout(timeoutId);
          if (networkRes && networkRes.ok) {
            const cache = await caches.open(CACHE_STATIC);
            cache.put(request, networkRes.clone()).catch(() => {});
            return networkRes;
          }
        } catch (_err) {
          // Offline or network timeout — fall back to cache below
        }

        const cached = await caches.match(request);
        if (cached) return cached;
        const indexFallback = await caches.match('/index.html');
        if (indexFallback) return indexFallback;

        return new Response('Offline: Teeex is unavailable without network.', {
          status: 503,
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8' },
        });
      })()
    );
    return;
  }

  // 2. TeX Engine Assets (/core/busytex/*): Network-First for JS scripts, Cache-First for WASM binaries
  if (url.origin === self.location.origin && url.pathname.startsWith('/core/busytex/')) {
    event.respondWith(
      (async () => {
        const cache = await caches.open(CACHE_ENGINE);
        const isScript = url.pathname.endsWith('.js');
        const isDataPkg = url.pathname.endsWith('.data');

        // Fast-path 1: Network-First for lightweight JS scripts so patches take effect immediately
        if (isScript) {
          try {
            const res = await fetch(request);
            const ct = res.headers.get('content-type') || '';
            if (res.ok && !ct.includes('text/html')) {
              cache.put(request, res.clone()).catch(() => {});
            }
            return res;
          } catch {
            const cached = await cache.match(request);
            if (cached) return cached;
            return new Response('Offline: Engine script unavailable', { status: 503 });
          }
        }

        // Fast-path 2: Do NOT cache .data packages in CacheStorage.
        // Emscripten's texlive-basic.js manages chunked persistence directly into IndexedDB ('EM_PRELOAD_CACHE').
        // Duplicating it into CacheStorage wastes ~180MB of device storage and risks stream lock / clone exhaustion.
        if (isDataPkg) {
          try {
            return await fetch(request);
          } catch (_err) {
            return new Response('Offline: Engine package unavailable', { status: 503 });
          }
        }

        // Fast-path 3: Cache-First for heavy WASM binary (busytex.wasm, biber.wasm)
        const cached = await cache.match(request);
        if (cached) {
          const enc = cached.headers.get('content-encoding');
          const ct = cached.headers.get('content-type') || '';
          // Ensure cached WASM is not a poisoned HTML fallback or compressed stream
          if (!enc && !ct.includes('text/html')) {
            return cached;
          }
          await cache.delete(request);
        }

        try {
          const res = await fetch(request);
          const ct = res.headers.get('content-type') || '';
          const enc = res.headers.get('content-encoding');
          // Guard: Only cache valid uncompressed WASM binaries, never HTML fallbacks or gzipped responses
          if (res.ok && !ct.includes('text/html') && !enc) {
            cache.put(request, res.clone()).catch(() => {});
            try {
              swChannel?.postMessage({ type: 'ENGINE_ASSET_CACHED', url: url.pathname });
            } catch {}
          }
          return res;
        } catch (_err) {
          return new Response('Offline: Engine asset unavailable', { status: 503 });
        }
      })()
    );
    return;
  }

  // 3. Dynamic TeX Live Packages (/packages/*, /api/texlive/*): Cache-First with LRU & HTML Poison Guard
  if (
    url.origin === self.location.origin &&
    (url.pathname.startsWith('/packages/') || url.pathname.startsWith('/api/texlive/'))
  ) {
    event.respondWith(
      (async () => {
        const cache = await caches.open(CACHE_PACKAGES);
        const cached = await cache.match(request);
        if (cached) return cached;

        try {
          const res = await fetch(request);
          const ct = res.headers.get('content-type') || '';
          // Guard: Never cache 404 HTML fallback responses into TeX package cache
          if (res.ok && !ct.includes('text/html')) {
            cache.put(request, res.clone()).then(() => trimCache(cache, MAX_PACKAGE_ENTRIES)).catch(() => {});
          }
          return res;
        } catch (_err) {
          return new Response('Offline: Package unavailable', { status: 503 });
        }
      })()
    );
    return;
  }

  // 4. Content-Hashed Assets, Fonts, & PDF.js (/assets/*, /fonts/*, /pdfjs/*): Cache-First
  if (
    url.origin === self.location.origin &&
    (url.pathname.startsWith('/assets/') ||
      url.pathname.startsWith('/fonts/') ||
      url.pathname.startsWith('/pdfjs/'))
  ) {
    event.respondWith(
      (async () => {
        const cache = await caches.open(CACHE_STATIC);
        const cached = await cache.match(request);
        if (cached) return cached;

        try {
          const res = await fetch(request);
          if (res.ok) {
            cache.put(request, res.clone()).catch(() => {});
          }
          return res;
        } catch (_err) {
          return new Response('Offline asset unavailable', { status: 503 });
        }
      })()
    );
    return;
  }

  // 5. General same-origin assets: Stale-While-Revalidate
  if (url.origin === self.location.origin) {
    event.respondWith(
      (async () => {
        const cache = await caches.open(CACHE_STATIC);
        const cached = await cache.match(request);
        const netFetch = fetch(request)
          .then((res) => {
            if (res.ok) cache.put(request, res.clone()).catch(() => {});
            return res;
          })
          .catch(() => cached);
        return cached || netFetch;
      })()
    );
  }
});
````

  ProjectRole,
  UserProfile,
  ParsedDocument,
} from '../../types/latex';
import type { PaperFormatId } from '../../services/paperFormats';
import type { EngineId } from '../../services/latexCompiler';

// Lazy-loaded modal dialogs for zero initial bundle overhead
const SymbolPaletteModal = lazy(() =>
  import('./SymbolPaletteModal').then((m) => ({ default: m.SymbolPaletteModal }))
);
const TableBuilderModal = lazy(() =>
  import('./TableBuilderModal').then((m) => ({ default: m.TableBuilderModal }))
);
const ShareModal = lazy(() =>
  import('./ShareModal').then((m) => ({ default: m.ShareModal }))
);
const TemplateModal = lazy(() =>
  import('./TemplateModal').then((m) => ({ default: m.TemplateModal }))
);
const ImageUploadModal = lazy(() =>
  import('./ImageUploadModal').then((m) => ({ default: m.ImageUploadModal }))
);
const VersionHistoryModal = lazy(() =>
  import('./VersionHistoryModal').then((m) => ({ default: m.VersionHistoryModal }))
);
const WordCountModal = lazy(() =>
  import('./WordCountModal').then((m) => ({ default: m.WordCountModal }))
);
const AuthModal = lazy(() =>
  import('./AuthModal').then((m) => ({ default: m.AuthModal }))
);
const ProjectsDashboardModal = lazy(() =>
  import('./ProjectsDashboardModal').then((m) => ({ default: m.ProjectsDashboardModal }))
);
const CommandPaletteModal = lazy(() =>
  import('./CommandPaletteModal').then((m) => ({ default: m.CommandPaletteModal }))
);

);

  import('./EncryptionModal').then((m) => ({ default: m.EncryptionModal }))
);

export function ModalLoadingFallback() {
  return (
    <div className="modal-loading-backdrop" aria-busy="true" aria-label="Loading dialog">
      <div className="modal-loading-card">
        <Loader2 size={18} className="spin" style={{ color: 'var(--accent-cyan)' }} />
        <span>Loading dialog...</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export interface ModalContainerProps {
  activeProject?: Project;
  activeProjectId?: string;
  projectTitle: string;
  files: ProjectFile[];
  activeFile: ProjectFile;
  checkpoints: Checkpoint[];
  isCloudConnected: boolean;
  parsedDoc: ParsedDocument;
  wordCount: number;
  equationCount: number;
  roomId: string;
  peers: Collaborator[];
  selfUser: Collaborator;
  currentUser: UserProfile | null;
  currentRole: ProjectRole;
  projects: Project[];
  isTwoColumn: boolean;
  paperFormat: PaperFormatId;
  selectedEngine?: EngineId;
  onSelectEngine?: (engine: EngineId) => void;
  theme: 'dark' | 'light';

  // Action Handlers
  handleAddImageFile: (file: ProjectFile) => void;
  handleInsertCode: (snippet: string) => void;
  handleAddPreambleMacro: (macro: string) => void;
  handleCreateCheckpoint: (name: string) => void;
  handleRestoreCheckpoint: (cp: Checkpoint) => void;
  handleRestoreSingleFile: (file: ProjectFile) => void;
  handleDeleteCheckpoint: (cpId: string) => void;
  handleSyncCheckpointsCloud: () => void;
  handleInviteMember: (email: string, role: ProjectRole) => void;
  handleUpdateMemberRole: (memberId: string, newRole: ProjectRole) => void;
  handleRemoveMember: (memberId: string) => void;
  handleSelectTemplate: (template: Template) => void;
  handleAuthSuccess: (user: UserProfile) => void;
  handleSelectProject: (id: string) => void;
  handleCreateProject: (title: string, templateId?: string) => void;
  handleDuplicateProject: (id: string) => void;
  handleToggleArchiveProject: (id: string) => void;
  handleDeleteProject: (id: string) => void;
  handleToggleEncryption: (enabled: boolean, pass: string, salt: string) => Promise<void>;
  handleSelectFile: (id: string) => void;
  triggerCompile: () => void;
  handleFormatDocument: () => void;
  handleToggleTwoColumn: () => void;
  handleSelectFormat: (format: PaperFormatId) => void;
  toggleTheme: () => void;
  handleExportPdf: () => void;
  handleExportZip: () => void;
  setTargetLine: (line: number | null) => void;
  onToggleSidebar: () => void;
  onSaveProject: () => void;
  onForwardSync: () => void;
  isDeskPetEnabled?: boolean;
  onToggleDeskPet?: () => void;
  workingTreeStatus?: WorkingTreeStatus;
  handleCreateCommit?: (message: string, description?: string) => void;
  handlePushCommits?: () => Promise<void>;
  handlePullCommits?: () => Promise<void>;
  activeBranch?: string;
  branches?: string[];
  onSwitchBranch?: (branchName: string, checkoutHead?: boolean) => void;
  onCreateBranch?: (branchName: string) => void;
  onDeleteBranch?: (branchName: string) => void;
}

export const ModalContainer: React.FC<ModalContainerProps> = ({
  activeProject,
  activeProjectId,
  projectTitle,
  files,
  activeFile,
  checkpoints,
  isCloudConnected,
  parsedDoc,
  wordCount,
  equationCount,
  roomId,
  peers,
  selfUser,
  currentUser,
  currentRole,
  projects,
  isTwoColumn,
  paperFormat,
  selectedEngine,
  onSelectEngine,
  theme,

  handleAddImageFile,
  handleInsertCode,
  handleAddPreambleMacro,
  handleCreateCheckpoint,
  handleRestoreCheckpoint,
  handleRestoreSingleFile,
  handleDeleteCheckpoint,
  handleSyncCheckpointsCloud,
  handleInviteMember,
  handleUpdateMemberRole,
  handleRemoveMember,
  handleSelectTemplate,
  handleAuthSuccess,
  handleSelectProject,
  handleCreateProject,
  handleDuplicateProject,
  handleToggleArchiveProject,
  handleDeleteProject,
  handleToggleEncryption,
  handleSelectFile,
  triggerCompile,
  handleFormatDocument,
  handleToggleTwoColumn,
  handleSelectFormat,
  toggleTheme,
  handleExportPdf,
  handleExportZip,
  setTargetLine,
  onToggleSidebar,
  onSaveProject,
  onForwardSync,
  isDeskPetEnabled,
  onToggleDeskPet,
  workingTreeStatus,
  handleCreateCommit,
  handlePushCommits,
  handlePullCommits,
  activeBranch,
  branches,
  onSwitchBranch,
  onCreateBranch,
  onDeleteBranch,
}) => {
  const activeModal = useModalStore((s) => s.activeModal);
  const modalProps = useModalStore((s) => s.props);

  const isAnyModalOpen = activeModal !== null;

  // Background Isolation via HTML `inert`
  useEffect(() => {
    const workspace = document.getElementById('root-workspace');
    if (!workspace) return;

    if (isAnyModalOpen) {
      workspace.setAttribute('inert', '');
    } else {
      workspace.removeAttribute('inert');
    }

    return () => {
      workspace.removeAttribute('inert');
    };
  }, [isAnyModalOpen]);

  if (!isAnyModalOpen) return null;

  return (
    <Suspense fallback={<ModalLoadingFallback />}>
      {activeModal === 'imageUpload' && (
        <ImageUploadModal
          isOpen={true}
          onClose={closeModal}
          onAddImageFile={handleAddImageFile}
          onInsertLatex={handleInsertCode}
        />
      )}

      {activeModal === 'symbolPalette' && (
        <SymbolPaletteModal
          isOpen={true}
          onClose={closeModal}
          onInsert={handleInsertCode}
          onAddPreambleMacro={handleAddPreambleMacro}
          initialTab={(modalProps.initialTab as 'symbols' | 'snippets' | 'macros') || 'symbols'}
        />
      )}

      {activeModal === 'tableBuilder' && (
        <TableBuilderModal
          isOpen={true}
          onClose={closeModal}
          onInsert={handleInsertCode}
        />
      )}

      {activeModal === 'versionHistory' && (
        <VersionHistoryModal
          isOpen={true}
          onClose={closeModal}
          checkpoints={checkpoints}
          currentFiles={files}
          workingTreeStatus={workingTreeStatus}
          onCreateCommit={handleCreateCommit}
          onCreateCheckpoint={handleCreateCheckpoint}
          onRestoreCheckpoint={handleRestoreCheckpoint}
          onRestoreSingleFile={handleRestoreSingleFile}
          onDeleteCheckpoint={handleDeleteCheckpoint}
          onPushCommits={handlePushCommits}
          onPullCommits={handlePullCommits}
          onSyncCloud={handleSyncCheckpointsCloud}
          isCloudConnected={isCloudConnected}
          activeProjectId={activeProjectId || activeProject?.id}
          activeBranch={activeBranch}
          branches={branches}
          onSwitchBranch={onSwitchBranch}
          onCreateBranch={onCreateBranch}
          onDeleteBranch={onDeleteBranch}
        />
      )}

      {activeModal === 'wordCount' && (
        <WordCountModal
          isOpen={true}
          onClose={closeModal}
          wordCount={wordCount}
          equationCount={equationCount}
          parsedDoc={parsedDoc}
          activeCode={activeFile.content}
        />
      )}

      {activeModal === 'share' && (
        <ShareModal
          isOpen={true}
          onClose={closeModal}
          roomId={roomId}
          peers={peers}
          selfUser={selfUser}
          currentUser={currentUser}
          projectMembers={activeProject?.members || []}
          onInviteMember={handleInviteMember}
          onUpdateMemberRole={handleUpdateMemberRole}
          onRemoveMember={handleRemoveMember}
          currentRole={currentRole}
        />
      )}

      {activeModal === 'template' && (
        <TemplateModal
          isOpen={true}
          onClose={closeModal}
          onSelectTemplate={handleSelectTemplate}
        />
      )}

      {activeModal === 'auth' && (
        <AuthModal
          isOpen={true}
          onClose={closeModal}
          currentUser={currentUser}
          onAuthSuccess={handleAuthSuccess}
        />
      )}

      {activeModal === 'projectsHub' && (
        <ProjectsDashboardModal
          isOpen={true}
          onClose={closeModal}
          projects={projects}
          activeProjectId={activeProjectId || ''}
          onSelectProject={handleSelectProject}
          onCreateProject={handleCreateProject}
          onDuplicateProject={handleDuplicateProject}
          onToggleArchiveProject={handleToggleArchiveProject}
          onDeleteProject={handleDeleteProject}
          currentUser={currentUser}
        />
      )}

      {activeModal === 'encryption' && (
        <EncryptionModal
          isOpen={true}
          onClose={closeModal}
          isEncrypted={!!activeProject?.isEncrypted}
          encryptionSalt={activeProject?.encryptionSalt}
          files={files}
          onToggleEncryption={handleToggleEncryption}
        />
      )}

      {activeModal === 'auditLog' && (
        <AuditLogModal
          isOpen={true}
          onClose={closeModal}
          projectId={activeProjectId || ''}
          projectTitle={projectTitle}
        />
      )}

      {activeModal === 'commandPalette' && (
        <CommandPaletteModal
          isOpen={true}
          onClose={closeModal}
          files={files}
          projects={projects}
          activeProjectId={activeProjectId}
          onSelectProject={handleSelectProject}
          onSelectFile={handleSelectFile}
          onCompile={triggerCompile}
          onFormatDocument={handleFormatDocument}
          onToggleTwoColumn={handleToggleTwoColumn}
          isTwoColumn={isTwoColumn}
          activeFormat={paperFormat}
          onSelectFormat={handleSelectFormat}
          selectedEngine={selectedEngine}
          onSelectEngine={onSelectEngine}
          theme={theme}
          onToggleTheme={toggleTheme}
          onExportPdf={handleExportPdf}
          onExportZip={handleExportZip}
          onOpenWordCount={() => openModal('wordCount')}
          onOpenHistory={() => openModal('versionHistory')}
          onOpenProjectsHub={() => openModal('projectsHub')}
          onOpenSymbols={() => openModal('symbolPalette')}
          onOpenTableBuilder={() => openModal('tableBuilder')}
          onToggleSidebar={onToggleSidebar}
          onSaveProject={onSaveProject}
          onForwardSync={onForwardSync}
          sections={parsedDoc.sections}
          onJumpToLine={(line) => setTargetLine(line)}
          initialMode={(modalProps.initialMode as 'all' | 'files') || 'all'}
          isDeskPetEnabled={isDeskPetEnabled}
          onToggleDeskPet={onToggleDeskPet}
        />
      )}
    </Suspense>
  );
};

export default ModalContainer;
````

function sha256(buf: Buffer): string {
  return createHash('sha256').update(buf).digest('hex');
}

describe('Engine Cryptographic Integrity & Bloat Removal (S3c, S4a)', () => {
  it('manifest exists and contains valid 64-character hex digests for all profile assets', () => {
    expect(existsSync(MANIFEST_PATH), 'Manifest file must exist').toBe(true);
    const manifest = JSON.parse(readFileSync(MANIFEST_PATH, 'utf8'));

    expect(manifest.engineVersion).toBe('1.4.0');
    expect(['pdftex', 'pages']).toContain(manifest.profile);
    const expectedCount = manifest.profile === 'pages' ? 7 : 10;
    expect(Object.keys(manifest.files)).toHaveLength(expectedCount);

    for (const [name, entry] of Object.entries(manifest.files) as [string, { bytes: number; sha256: string }][]) {
      expect(entry.bytes).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(entry.sha256, `${name} must have a valid sha256 hash`).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/);
    }
  });

  it('all engine files on disk match their exact golden SHA-256 digests', () => {
    const manifest = JSON.parse(readFileSync(MANIFEST_PATH, 'utf8'));
    const filesToCheck = manifest.profile === 'pages'
      ? ['busytex_worker.js', 'busytex_pipeline.js', 'busytex_biber.js', 'busytex.js', 'texlive-basic.js', 'biber.js', 'biber.wasm']
      : Object.keys(GOLDEN_DIGESTS);

    for (const name of filesToCheck) {
      const golden = GOLDEN_DIGESTS[name];
      const p = join(DEST, name);
      expect(existsSync(p), `Required asset ${name} must exist on disk`).toBe(true);
      const buf = readFileSync(p);
      const allowedBytes = Array.isArray(golden.bytes) ? golden.bytes : [golden.bytes];
      const allowedSha = Array.isArray(golden.sha256) ? golden.sha256 : [golden.sha256];
      expect(allowedBytes, `${name} byte size mismatch`).toContain(buf.length);
      expect(allowedSha, `${name} SHA-256 digest mismatch`).toContain(sha256(buf));
    }
  });

  it('negative test: 1-byte alteration causes checksum mismatch failure', () => {
    // Read a real asset, alter 1 byte in a copy, and verify checksum calculation fails
    const realBuf = readFileSync(join(DEST, 'busytex_biber.js'));
    const mutated = Buffer.from(realBuf);
    mutated[10] = mutated[10] === 0x41 ? 0x42 : 0x41; // Flip a byte

    const mutatedHash = sha256(mutated);
    const golden = GOLDEN_DIGESTS['busytex_biber.js'];
    const allowedSha = Array.isArray(golden.sha256) ? golden.sha256 : [golden.sha256];
    expect(allowedSha).not.toContain(mutatedHash);
  });

  it('unreferenced 205MB assets (texlive-recommended) are absent on disk', () => {
    expect(existsSync(join(DEST, 'texlive-recommended.data'))).toBe(false);
    expect(existsSync(join(DEST, 'texlive-recommended.js'))).toBe(false);
    expect(existsSync(join(DEST, 'busytex.js.pre-diagnostic-restore'))).toBe(false);
  });

  it('total engine asset footprint is strictly <= 165 MB', () => {
    let totalBytes = 0;
    for (const [, golden] of Object.entries(GOLDEN_DIGESTS)) {
      const maxByte = Array.isArray(golden.bytes) ? Math.max(...golden.bytes) : golden.bytes;
      totalBytes += maxByte;
    }
    const totalMiB = totalBytes / 1024 / 1024;
    expect(totalMiB).toBeLessThan(165);
    expect(totalMiB).toBeGreaterThan(140);
  });
});

import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { resolve } from 'node:path';
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react';
import { defineConfig, type Plugin } from 'vite';

function buildConnectSrc(): string {
  const allowed = new Set<string>([
    "'self'",
    'blob:',
    'https://texlive2026.texlyre.org',
    'https://*.supabase.co',
    'wss://*.supabase.co',
  ]);

  const customRemote = process.env.VITE_TEXLIVE_REMOTE_ENDPOINT;
  if (customRemote && customRemote !== 'off') {
    try {
      const url = new URL(customRemote);
      allowed.add(url.origin);
    } catch {
      // Ignore invalid URL formatting
    }
  }

  const supabaseUrl = process.env.VITE_SUPABASE_URL || process.env.SUPABASE_URL;
  if (supabaseUrl) {
    try {
      const url = new URL(supabaseUrl);
      allowed.add(url.origin);
      if (url.protocol === 'https:') {
        allowed.add(`wss://${url.host}`);
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore invalid URL formatting
    }
  }

  return Array.from(allowed).join(' ');
}

function getCsp(): string {
  const connectSrc = buildConnectSrc();
  return `default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; img-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src ${connectSrc}; worker-src 'self' blob:; child-src 'self' blob:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self'`;
}

function cspHeadersPlugin(): Plugin {
  return {
    name: 'csp-headers-generator',
    closeBundle() {
      const rootDir = import.meta.dirname ?? process.cwd();
      const distHeaders = resolve(rootDir, 'dist', '_headers');
      if (existsSync(distHeaders)) {
        let content = readFileSync(distHeaders, 'utf8');
        const cspLine = `  Content-Security-Policy: ${getCsp()}`;
        content = content.replace(/^[ \t]*Content-Security-Policy:.*$/m, cspLine);
        writeFileSync(distHeaders, content, 'utf8');
      }
    },
  };
}

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [react(), cspHeadersPlugin()],
  worker: {
    format: 'es',
  },
  optimizeDeps: {
    /**
     * Both of these ship their own workers and WASM and resolve sibling assets
     * at runtime; dependency pre-bundling rewrites those paths and breaks the
     * lookups.
     */
    exclude: ['texlyre-busytex', 'pdfjs-dist'],
  },
  /**
   * The TeX engine (`/core/busytex/*`) and PDF.js CMaps (`/pdfjs/*`) are served
   * from `public/`, provisioned by the prebuild scripts.
   *
   * There is deliberately no dev proxy to a third-party host here. The engine's
   * Web Worker must be same-origin — browsers refuse cross-origin worker
   * scripts — so proxying was the only way to use a remote origin, and it made
   * local development depend on someone else's GitHub Pages site staying up at
   * an exact path. Self-hosting a version-pinned subset removes that.
   */
  assetsInclude: ['**/*.wasm'],
  server: {
    proxy: {
      '/api/texlive': {
        target:
          process.env.VITE_TEXLIVE_REMOTE_ENDPOINT &&
          process.env.VITE_TEXLIVE_REMOTE_ENDPOINT !== 'off'
            ? process.env.VITE_TEXLIVE_REMOTE_ENDPOINT
            : 'https://texlive2026.texlyre.org',
        changeOrigin: true,
        rewrite: (path) => path.replace(/^\/api\/texlive/, ''),
      },
    },
  },
  build: {
    rollupOptions: {
      output: {
        manualChunks(id) {
          if (
            id.includes('node_modules/react/') ||
            id.includes('node_modules/react-dom/') ||
            id.includes('node_modules/scheduler/')
          ) {
            return 'react-vendor';
          }
          if (id.includes('node_modules/pdfjs-dist')) {
            return 'pdfjs';
          }
          if (
            id.includes('node_modules/@codemirror') ||
            id.includes('node_modules/codemirror') ||
            id.includes('node_modules/@lezer')
          ) {
            return 'codemirror';
          }
          if (

            id.includes('node_modules/y-codemirror.next') ||

          if (id.includes('node_modules/katex')) {

          }

        },

  preview: {

      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL ||

});
