## File: src/services/pdfRenderer.ts
````typescript
/**
 * Teeex — PDF rasterisation (Double-Buffered & Flicker-Free).
 */

import {
  GlobalWorkerOptions,
  PixelsPerInch,
  RenderingCancelledException,
  TextLayer,
  getDocument,
  type PDFDocumentLoadingTask,
  type PDFDocumentProxy,
  type PDFPageProxy,
  type RenderTask,
} from 'pdfjs-dist';
import workerUrl from 'pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.mjs?url';

GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = workerUrl;

const CMAP_URL = '/pdfjs/cmaps/';
const STANDARD_FONT_URL = '/pdfjs/standard_fonts/';

let isPrewarmed = false;
export function prewarmPdfRenderer(): void {
  if (isPrewarmed || typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  isPrewarmed = true;
  try {
    const dummyTask = getDocument({
      data: new Uint8Array([0x25, 0x50, 0x44, 0x46, 0x2d, 0x31, 0x2e, 0x34]),
      cMapUrl: CMAP_URL,
      cMapPacked: true,
      standardFontDataUrl: STANDARD_FONT_URL,
    });
    dummyTask.promise.catch(() => { });
    dummyTask.destroy().catch(() => { });
  } catch {
    // Non-fatal
  }
}

// Auto-prewarm when module is imported in browser
if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
  setTimeout(prewarmPdfRenderer, 50);
}

export const CSS_PX_PER_PT = PixelsPerInch.PDF_TO_CSS_UNITS;
const MAX_CANVAS_PIXELS = 16_777_216;

export interface PageGeometry {
  pageNumber: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  rotation: number;
}

export interface PdfLinkAnnotation {
  id: string;
  rect: [number, number, number, number]; // [left, top, width, height] in CSS pixels
  url?: string;
  dest?: string | any[];
  title?: string;
}

export interface PdfSearchResult {
  pageNumber: number;
  matchIndex: number;
  snippet: string;
  yPt?: number;
}

export function isSafeUrl(rawUrl: string): boolean {
  if (!rawUrl || typeof rawUrl !== 'string') return false;
  const trimmed = rawUrl.trim();
  if (trimmed.length === 0) return false;

  if (trimmed.startsWith('/') || trimmed.startsWith('./') || trimmed.startsWith('../')) {
    return !trimmed.startsWith('//');
  }

  // Guard against scheme evasion with whitespace (e.g. "javascript :alert(1)")
  // oxlint-disable-next-line eslint/no-control-regex
  const noWhitespace = trimmed.replace(/[\s\x00-\x1f]+/g, '');
  if (/^[a-zA-Z0-9+.-]+:/.test(noWhitespace)) {
    const colonIndex = noWhitespace.indexOf(':');
    const scheme = noWhitespace.slice(0, colonIndex + 1).toLowerCase();
    return ['http:', 'https:', 'mailto:'].includes(scheme);
  }

  try {
    const parsed = new URL(trimmed, 'https://safe-base.internal');
    if (parsed.origin !== 'https://safe-base.internal') {
      return ['http:', 'https:', 'mailto:'].includes(parsed.protocol);
    }
    return !trimmed.includes(':');
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export interface RenderPageOptions {
  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement;
  pageNumber: number;
  zoom: number;
  devicePixelRatio?: number;
}

function isCancellation(error: unknown): boolean {
  return error instanceof RenderingCancelledException;
}

export class CanvasPool {
  private readonly pool: Array<HTMLCanvasElement | OffscreenCanvas> = [];
  private readonly maxPoolSize: number;

  constructor(maxPoolSize = 4) {
    this.maxPoolSize = maxPoolSize;
  }

  get size(): number {
    return this.pool.length;
  }

  acquire(width: number, height: number): HTMLCanvasElement | OffscreenCanvas {
    let canvas: HTMLCanvasElement | OffscreenCanvas | undefined = this.pool.pop();
    if (!canvas) {
      if (typeof OffscreenCanvas !== 'undefined') {
        try {
          canvas = new OffscreenCanvas(width, height);
        } catch {
          canvas = typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document.createElement('canvas') : ({ width, height } as unknown as HTMLCanvasElement);
        }
      } else if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
        canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
      } else {
        canvas = { width, height } as unknown as HTMLCanvasElement;
      }
    }
    const c = canvas!;
    if (c.width !== width) c.width = width;
    if (c.height !== height) c.height = height;
    return c;
  }

  release(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement | OffscreenCanvas): void {
    if (this.pool.length < this.maxPoolSize) {
      this.pool.push(canvas);
    } else {
      canvas.width = 0;
      canvas.height = 0;
    }
  }

  clear(): void {
    while (this.pool.length > 0) {
      const c = this.pool.pop();
      if (c) {
        c.width = 0;
        c.height = 0;
      }
    }
  }
}

export const sharedCanvasPool = new CanvasPool(4);

export class PdfDocument {
  private readonly doc: PDFDocumentProxy;
  private readonly loadingTask: PDFDocumentLoadingTask;
  private readonly pages = new Map<number, PDFPageProxy>();
  private readonly tasks = new Map<number, RenderTask>();
  private readonly renderSeq = new Map<number, number>();
  private readonly textLayers = new Map<number, TextLayer>();
  private geometryCache: PageGeometry[] | null = null;
  private destroyed = false;

  readonly numPages: number;
  readonly fingerprint: string;

  private constructor(
    doc: PDFDocumentProxy,
    loadingTask: PDFDocumentLoadingTask,
  ) {
    this.doc = doc;
    this.loadingTask = loadingTask;
    this.numPages = doc.numPages;
    this.fingerprint = doc.fingerprints?.[0] ?? '';
  }

  static async open(bytes: Uint8Array): Promise<PdfDocument> {
    const owned = new Uint8Array(bytes.byteLength);
    owned.set(bytes);

    const loadingTask = getDocument({
      data: owned,
      cMapUrl: CMAP_URL,
      cMapPacked: true,
      standardFontDataUrl: STANDARD_FONT_URL,
    });

    const doc = await loadingTask.promise;
    return new PdfDocument(doc, loadingTask);
  }

  private async page(pageNumber: number): Promise<PDFPageProxy> {
    const cached = this.pages.get(pageNumber);
    if (cached) return cached;
    const page = await this.doc.getPage(pageNumber);
    this.pages.set(pageNumber, page);
    return page;
  }

  private onGeometryUpdate?: (geometries: PageGeometry[]) => void;

  setOnGeometryUpdate(cb: (geometries: PageGeometry[]) => void): void {
    this.onGeometryUpdate = cb;
  }

  /**
   * Lazy geometry initialization (O(1) memory and time).
   * Reads Page 1 to establish default dimensions for all N pages without
   * eagerly instantiating proxies for remaining pages.
   */
  async geometry(): Promise<PageGeometry[]> {
    if (this.geometryCache) return this.geometryCache;

    const page1 = await this.page(1);
    const vp1 = page1.getViewport({ scale: CSS_PX_PER_PT });
    const defaultGeo: PageGeometry = {
      pageNumber: 1,
      width: vp1.width,
      height: vp1.height,
      rotation: vp1.rotation,
    };

    if (this.numPages === 1) {
      this.geometryCache = [defaultGeo];
      return this.geometryCache;
    }

    const initial: PageGeometry[] = Array.from({ length: this.numPages }, (_, idx) => ({
      pageNumber: idx + 1,
      width: defaultGeo.width,
      height: defaultGeo.height,
      rotation: defaultGeo.rotation,
    }));

    this.geometryCache = initial;
    return initial;
  }

  /**
   * Lazily resolves and updates geometry for a specific page when it enters the viewport.
   * If the page has non-default dimensions (e.g. landscape), updates the cache and triggers onGeometryUpdate.
   */
  async ensurePageGeometry(pageNumber: number): Promise<PageGeometry> {
    const geometries = await this.geometry();
    if (pageNumber < 1 || pageNumber > this.numPages || this.destroyed) {
      return geometries[Math.max(0, pageNumber - 1)] || geometries[0];
    }
    if (pageNumber === 1) return geometries[0];

    const current = geometries[pageNumber - 1];
    try {
      const page = await this.page(pageNumber);
      if (this.destroyed) return current;
      const vp = page.getViewport({ scale: CSS_PX_PER_PT });
      if (
        vp.width !== current.width ||
        vp.height !== current.height ||
        vp.rotation !== current.rotation
      ) {
        geometries[pageNumber - 1] = {
          pageNumber,
          width: vp.width,
          height: vp.height,
          rotation: vp.rotation,
        };
        if (this.onGeometryUpdate && !this.destroyed) {
          this.onGeometryUpdate([...geometries]);
        }
      }
    } catch {
      // Non-fatal, retain default
    }
    return geometries[pageNumber - 1];
  }

  /**
   * Double-buffered page rasterisation:
   * Renders onto an offscreen canvas first and copies the finished bitmap onto
   * the visible `canvas` in a single synchronous frame. This prevents canvas
   * clearing flashes on recompile/zoom and eliminates concurrent canvas usage errors.
   */
  async renderPage({
    canvas,
    pageNumber,
    zoom,
    devicePixelRatio = globalThis.devicePixelRatio || 1,
  }: RenderPageOptions): Promise<boolean> {
    if (this.destroyed) return false;

    const seq = (this.renderSeq.get(pageNumber) ?? 0) + 1;
    this.renderSeq.set(pageNumber, seq);

    await this.cancelPage(pageNumber);
    if (this.destroyed || this.renderSeq.get(pageNumber) !== seq) return false;

    const page = await this.page(pageNumber);
    if (this.destroyed || this.renderSeq.get(pageNumber) !== seq) return false;

    const viewport = page.getViewport({ scale: CSS_PX_PER_PT * zoom });

    const requested = devicePixelRatio;
    const area = viewport.width * viewport.height * requested * requested;
    const ratio =
      area > MAX_CANVAS_PIXELS
        ? Math.max(1, requested * Math.sqrt(MAX_CANVAS_PIXELS / area))
        : requested;

    const pixelWidth = Math.max(1, Math.floor(viewport.width * ratio));
    const pixelHeight = Math.max(1, Math.floor(viewport.height * ratio));

    // Acquire an offscreen staging canvas from the pool to avoid DOM churn and memory leaks
    const offscreen = sharedCanvasPool.acquire(pixelWidth, pixelHeight);
    const offscreenCtx = offscreen.getContext('2d', { alpha: false }) as CanvasRenderingContext2D | OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D | null;
    if (!offscreenCtx) {
      sharedCanvasPool.release(offscreen);
      return false;
    }

    const task = page.render({
      canvas: null,
      canvasContext: offscreenCtx as any,
      viewport,
      transform: ratio === 1 ? undefined : [ratio, 0, 0, ratio, 0, 0],
    });
    this.tasks.set(pageNumber, task);

    try {
      await task.promise;
      if (this.destroyed || this.renderSeq.get(pageNumber) !== seq) return false;

      // Atomically swap the completed frame onto the visible canvas
      const visibleCtx = canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });
      if (!visibleCtx) return false;

      if (canvas.width !== pixelWidth) canvas.width = pixelWidth;
      if (canvas.height !== pixelHeight) canvas.height = pixelHeight;
      canvas.style.width = `${viewport.width}px`;
      canvas.style.height = `${viewport.height}px`;
      visibleCtx.drawImage(offscreen, 0, 0);

      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      if (isCancellation(error)) return false;
      throw error;
    } finally {
      if (this.tasks.get(pageNumber) === task) this.tasks.delete(pageNumber);
      sharedCanvasPool.release(offscreen);
    }
  }

  private async cancelPage(pageNumber: number): Promise<void> {
    const task = this.tasks.get(pageNumber);
    if (!task) return;
    this.tasks.delete(pageNumber);
    task.cancel();
    await task.promise.catch(() => undefined);
  }

  async renderTextLayer(
    pageNumber: number,
    zoom: number,
    container: HTMLElement,
  ): Promise<void> {
    if (this.destroyed) return;

    const page = await this.page(pageNumber);
    if (this.destroyed) return;
    const viewport = page.getViewport({ scale: CSS_PX_PER_PT * zoom });

    container.style.setProperty('--scale-factor', String(viewport.scale));
    container.style.width = `${viewport.width}px`;
    container.style.height = `${viewport.height}px`;

    const existing = this.textLayers.get(pageNumber);
    if (existing) {
      existing.update({ viewport });
      return;
    }

    container.replaceChildren();
    const layer = new TextLayer({
      textContentSource: page.streamTextContent(),
      container,
      viewport,
    });
    this.textLayers.set(pageNumber, layer);

    try {
      await layer.render();
    } catch {
      this.textLayers.delete(pageNumber);
    }
  }

  releaseTextLayer(pageNumber: number): void {
    const layer = this.textLayers.get(pageNumber);
    if (!layer) return;
    layer.cancel();
    this.textLayers.delete(pageNumber);
  }

  async annotations(pageNumber: number) {
    const page = await this.page(pageNumber);
    return page.getAnnotations({ intent: 'display' });
  }

  async resolveDestination(
    dest: string | unknown[],
  ): Promise<{ pageNumber: number; yPt?: number } | null> {
    if (this.destroyed) return null;
    try {
      const explicit =
        typeof dest === 'string'
          ? ((await this.doc.getDestination(dest)) as unknown[])
          : dest;
      if (!explicit || !Array.isArray(explicit)) return null;
      const pageRef = explicit[0];
      let pageIndex: number | null = null;
      if (typeof pageRef === 'object' && pageRef !== null) {
        pageIndex = await this.doc.getPageIndex(pageRef as never);
      } else if (typeof pageRef === 'number') {
        pageIndex = pageRef;
      }
      if (pageIndex === null || pageIndex < 0) return null;
      return {
        pageNumber: pageIndex + 1,
        yPt: typeof explicit[3] === 'number' ? (explicit[3] as number) : undefined,
      };
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  async getPageLinkAnnotations(
    pageNumber: number,
    zoom: number,
  ): Promise<PdfLinkAnnotation[]> {
    if (this.destroyed) return [];
    try {
      const page = await this.page(pageNumber);
      if (this.destroyed) return [];
      const rawAnnotations = await page.getAnnotations({ intent: 'display' });
      const viewport = page.getViewport({ scale: CSS_PX_PER_PT * zoom });
      const links: PdfLinkAnnotation[] = [];

      for (const annot of rawAnnotations) {
        if (annot.subtype !== 'Link' || !annot.rect) continue;
        const p1 = viewport.convertToViewportPoint(annot.rect[0], annot.rect[1]);
        const p2 = viewport.convertToViewportPoint(annot.rect[2], annot.rect[3]);
        const left = Math.min(p1[0], p2[0]);
        const top = Math.min(p1[1], p2[1]);
        const width = Math.max(2, Math.abs(p2[0] - p1[0]));
        const height = Math.max(2, Math.abs(p2[1] - p1[1]));

        links.push({
          id: String(annot.id || `${annot.rect.join('-')}`),
          rect: [left, top, width, height],
          url: typeof annot.url === 'string' ? annot.url : undefined,
          dest: annot.dest,
          title: typeof annot.title === 'string' ? annot.title : undefined,
        });
      }
      return links;
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  async findText(query: string): Promise<PdfSearchResult[]> {
    if (this.destroyed || !query.trim()) return [];
    const normalized = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    const results: PdfSearchResult[] = [];
    let matchCounter = 0;

    for (let pageNum = 1; pageNum <= this.numPages; pageNum++) {
      if (this.destroyed) break;
      try {
        const page = await this.page(pageNum);
        const textContent = await page.getTextContent();
        const items = textContent.items.filter(
          (item): item is typeof item & { str: string; transform?: number[] } =>
            'str' in item && typeof (item as { str?: unknown }).str === 'string',
        );

        let fullText = '';
        const itemSpans: Array<{ start: number; end: number; yPt?: number }> = [];
        for (const item of items) {
          const start = fullText.length;
          fullText += item.str + ' ';
          const end = fullText.length;
          const yPt =
            Array.isArray(item.transform) && typeof item.transform[5] === 'number'
              ? item.transform[5]
              : undefined;
          itemSpans.push({ start, end, yPt });
        }

        const lowerFull = fullText.toLowerCase();
        let idx = 0;
        while ((idx = lowerFull.indexOf(normalized, idx)) !== -1) {
          const matchingSpan = itemSpans.find((span) => idx >= span.start && idx < span.end);
          const start = Math.max(0, idx - 20);
          const end = Math.min(fullText.length, idx + normalized.length + 20);
          const snippet =
            (start > 0 ? '…' : '') +
            fullText.slice(start, end).trim() +
            (end < fullText.length ? '…' : '');

          results.push({
            pageNumber: pageNum,
            matchIndex: matchCounter++,
            snippet,
            yPt: matchingSpan?.yPt,
          });
          idx += Math.max(1, normalized.length);
        }
      } catch {
        // Skip page on failure
      }
    }
    return results;
  }

  cleanupPage(pageNumber: number): void {
    const page = this.pages.get(pageNumber);
    if (!page) return;
    try {
      page.cleanup();
    } catch {
      // Non-fatal
    }
  }

  async destroy(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.destroyed) return;
    this.destroyed = true;

    for (const pageNumber of [...this.tasks.keys()]) {
      await this.cancelPage(pageNumber);
    }
    for (const layer of this.textLayers.values()) layer.cancel();
    this.textLayers.clear();
    for (const page of this.pages.values()) page.cleanup();
    this.pages.clear();

    await this.loadingTask.destroy();
  }
}
````

````typescript
import type { Project, ProjectRole, UserProfile } from '../types/latex';
import { STARTER_TEMPLATES } from './templates';
import { getAuthUid, getSupabaseClient } from './supabaseClient';
import { getStoredSession } from './authService';

import { safePostTask } from '../utils/scheduler';
import { saveProjectOffline, loadProjectOffline } from './offlineStorageService';

const PROJECTS_STORAGE_KEY = 'teeex_saved_projects';
const ACTIVE_PROJECT_ID_KEY = 'teeex_active_project_id';

/**
 * Project ids are primary keys in a shared table, so they must not be
 * guessable: `proj-${Date.now().toString(36)}` let anyone pre-insert a row
 * under an id a victim would later generate, whose upsert then fails on the
 * unique constraint. Two projects created in the same millisecond also
 * collided. Ids created before this change remain guessable.
 */
function newProjectId(): string {
  if (typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && typeof crypto.randomUUID === 'function') {
    return `proj-${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
  }
  const entropy = new Uint8Array(16);
  if (typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && typeof crypto.getRandomValues === 'function') {
    crypto.getRandomValues(entropy);
  }
  return `proj-${Array.from(entropy, (b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('')}`;
}

export function formatRelativeTime(isoOrText?: string): string {
  if (!isoOrText) return 'Recently';
  const trimmed = isoOrText.trim();
  if (trimmed.toLowerCase().includes('just now')) return 'Just now';
  if (trimmed.toLowerCase().includes('ago') || trimmed.toLowerCase().includes('yesterday')) return trimmed;

  const date = new Date(trimmed);
  if (isNaN(date.getTime())) return trimmed;

  const now = Date.now();
  const diffSec = Math.floor((now - date.getTime()) / 1000);

  if (diffSec < 45) return 'Just now';
  if (diffSec < 3600) return `${Math.max(1, Math.floor(diffSec / 60))}m ago`;
  if (diffSec < 86400) return `${Math.floor(diffSec / 3600)}h ago`;
  if (diffSec < 172800) return 'Yesterday';
  if (diffSec < 604800) return `${Math.floor(diffSec / 86400)}d ago`;

  return date.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' });
}

export function resolveUserProjectRole(
  project: Project,
  currentUser: UserProfile | null,
  sharedRoomContext?: { roomId: string; key?: string | null }
): ProjectRole {
  if (sharedRoomContext?.key) {
    const verified = verifyShareKey(sharedRoomContext.roomId, sharedRoomContext.key);
    if (verified) return verified;
  }

  if (currentUser?.email) {
    const email = currentUser.email.toLowerCase().trim();
    const uid = currentUser.id;
    if (
      (project.ownerEmail && project.ownerEmail.toLowerCase().trim() === email) ||
      (uid && project.ownerId === uid)
    ) {
      return 'owner';
    }
    const member = project.members?.find(
      m => (m.email && m.email.toLowerCase().trim() === email) || (uid && m.id === uid)
    );
    if (member?.role) return member.role;
    return 'viewer';
  }

  // Guest / unauthenticated mode:
  const isLocal =
    project.ownerId === 'usr-local' ||
    project.ownerEmail === 'you@teeex.local' ||
    project.ownerEmail === 'anonymous@teeex.io';

  if (isLocal) return 'owner';

  const member = project.members?.find(
    m => m.id === 'usr-local' || m.email === 'you@teeex.local' || m.email === 'anonymous@teeex.io'
  );
  if (member?.role) return member.role;

  return project.role === 'owner' ? 'viewer' : (project.role || 'viewer');
}

function normalizeProject(p: any): Project {
  return {
    id: p?.id || newProjectId(),
    title: p?.title || 'Untitled Project',
    ownerId: p?.ownerId || 'usr-anonymous',
    ownerEmail: p?.ownerEmail || 'anonymous@teeex.io',
    role: p?.role || 'owner',
    createdAt: p?.createdAt || new Date().toISOString(),
    updatedAt: p?.updatedAt || 'Just now',
    files: Array.isArray(p?.files) && p.files.length > 0 ? p.files : STARTER_TEMPLATES[0].files,
    folders: Array.isArray(p?.folders) ? p.folders : ['sections', 'figures'],
    tags: Array.isArray(p?.tags) ? p.tags : ['#research'],
    members: Array.isArray(p?.members) ? p.members : [],
    isArchived: Boolean(p?.isArchived),
  };
}

export function getAllProjectsRaw(): Project[] {
  let allProjects: Project[] = [];
  const saved = localStorage.getItem(PROJECTS_STORAGE_KEY);
  if (saved) {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) {
        // Filter out any corrupted or legacy 'proj-guest' / 'Sign In Required' dummy projects
        const valid = parsed.filter(p => p.id !== 'proj-guest' && p.title !== 'Sign In Required');
        if (valid.length > 0) {
          allProjects = valid.map(normalizeProject);
        }
      }
    } catch {
      localStorage.removeItem(PROJECTS_STORAGE_KEY);
    }
  }

  if (allProjects.length === 0) {
    // Save initial projects
    allProjects = INITIAL_PROJECTS.map(normalizeProject);
    saveProjects(allProjects);
  }

  return allProjects;
}

export function loadProjects(userEmail?: string, userName?: string): Project[] {
  const allProjects = getAllProjectsRaw();
  const sessionUser = getStoredSession().user;
  const targetEmail = (userEmail || sessionUser?.email || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  const targetName = userName || sessionUser?.fullName || (targetEmail ? targetEmail.split('@')[0] : 'Author');

  let baseList: Project[];

  if (targetEmail) {
    const filtered = allProjects.filter(p =>
      (p.ownerEmail || '').toLowerCase() === targetEmail ||
      p.members?.some(m => (m.email || '').toLowerCase() === targetEmail)
    );

    // If user has no projects, create a default one for them
    if (filtered.length === 0) {
      const defaultProj = createProject(
        `${targetName ? targetName + "'s" : 'My'} First Paper`,
        targetEmail,
        targetName
      );
      baseList = [defaultProj];
    } else {
      // Auto-sync existing projects if userName differs from raw email prefix
      if (targetName && targetName.trim()) {
        let anyChanged = false;
        const updatedAll = allProjects.map(p => {
          let pChanged = false;
          const newMembers = (p.members || []).map(m => {
            if (m.email.toLowerCase() === targetEmail && m.name !== targetName) {
              pChanged = true;
              return {
                ...m,
                name: targetName,
                avatar: targetName.substring(0, 2).toUpperCase() || m.avatar,
              };
            }
            return m;
          });
          if (pChanged) {
            anyChanged = true;
            return { ...p, members: newMembers };
          }
          return p;
        });

        if (anyChanged) {
          saveProjects(updatedAll);
          baseList = updatedAll.filter(p =>
            (p.ownerEmail || '').toLowerCase() === targetEmail ||
            p.members?.some(m => (m.email || '').toLowerCase() === targetEmail)
          );
        } else {
          baseList = filtered;
        }
      } else {
        baseList = filtered;
      }
    }
  } else {
    // Guest / unauthenticated state: return all projects so they can explore
    baseList = allProjects;
  }

  const inspectingUser: UserProfile | null = targetEmail
    ? {
        id: sessionUser?.id || `usr-${targetEmail.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '')}`,
        email: targetEmail,
        fullName: targetName,
      }
    : sessionUser;

  // Resolve dynamic role relative to inspecting user
  return baseList.map(p => ({
    ...p,
    role: resolveUserProjectRole(p, inspectingUser),
  }));
}

function pruneLocalStorageQuota(): void {
  try {
    const activeId = localStorage.getItem(ACTIVE_PROJECT_ID_KEY);
    const keysToRemove: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {
      const key = localStorage.key(i);
      if (key && key.startsWith('teeex_emergency_draft_') && (!activeId || !key.includes(activeId))) {
        keysToRemove.push(key);
      }
    }
    keysToRemove.forEach(k => {
      try { localStorage.removeItem(k); } catch {}
    });
  } catch {}
}

export function saveProjects(projects: Project[]): void {
  const sanitized = projects.filter(p => p.id !== 'proj-guest' && p.title !== 'Sign In Required');

  // 1. Always mirror all sanitized projects to IndexedDB offline storage (which supports multi-GB quota)
  for (const p of sanitized) {
    saveProjectOffline(p).catch(() => {});
  }

  // Helper to trim large files for localStorage while full contents remain safely in IndexedDB
  const makeQuotaSafe = (items: Project[], maxContentLen: number) => {
    return items.map(p => ({
      ...p,
      files: p.files.map(f => {
        if (f.content.length <= maxContentLen) return f;
        return {
          ...f,
          content: f.content.slice(0, 500) + '\n% [Content persisted in IndexedDB storage]',
          _persistedInIdb: true,
        };
      }),
    }));
  };

  // 2. Persist to localStorage with progressive quota fallback
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(PROJECTS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(sanitized));
  } catch (_err) {
    pruneLocalStorageQuota();
    try {
      // Pass 1: Trim non-active project files >2000 chars and active files >50,000 chars (~1000 lines)
      const activeId = localStorage.getItem(ACTIVE_PROJECT_ID_KEY);
      const pass1 = sanitized.map(p => {
        const threshold = p.id === activeId ? 50000 : 2000;
        return {
          ...p,
          files: p.files.map(f => {
            if (f.content.length <= threshold) return f;
            return {
              ...f,
              content: f.content.slice(0, 500) + '\n% [Content persisted in IndexedDB storage]',
              _persistedInIdb: true,
            };
          }),
        };
      });
      localStorage.setItem(PROJECTS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(pass1));
    } catch {
      try {
        // Pass 2: Aggressively trim all files >1000 chars across all projects
        const pass2 = makeQuotaSafe(sanitized, 1000);
        localStorage.setItem(PROJECTS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(pass2));
      } catch {
        // Pass 3: Metadata only in localStorage (headers, tags, member info)
        try {
          const pass3 = sanitized.map(p => ({
            ...p,
            files: p.files.map(f => ({ ...f, content: '', _persistedInIdb: true })),
          }));
          localStorage.setItem(PROJECTS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(pass3));
        } catch {
          // Non-fatal: IndexedDB already holds the full manuscripts
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

export async function hydrateProjectFromOffline(projectId: string): Promise<Project | null> {
  return await loadProjectOffline(projectId);
}

export function getActiveProjectId(projects: Project[]): string {
  const savedId = localStorage.getItem(ACTIVE_PROJECT_ID_KEY);
  if (savedId && projects.some(p => p.id === savedId && Array.isArray(p.files) && p.files.length > 0)) {
    return savedId;
  }
  return projects[0]?.id || 'proj-neural-quantum';
}

export function setActiveProjectId(id: string): void {
  localStorage.setItem(ACTIVE_PROJECT_ID_KEY, id);
}

export function createProject(
  title: string,
  userEmail: string,
  userName: string,
  templateId?: string
): Project {
  const chosenTemplate = STARTER_TEMPLATES.find(t => t.id === templateId) || STARTER_TEMPLATES[0];
  const newId = newProjectId();

  const newProject: Project = {
    id: newId,
    title: title.trim() || 'Untitled LaTeX Document',
    ownerId: `usr-${userEmail.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '')}`,
    ownerEmail: userEmail,
    role: 'owner',
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    updatedAt: 'Just now',
    files: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(chosenTemplate.files)), // Deep clone
    tags: ['#research'],
    members: [
      {
        id: `usr-${userEmail.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '')}`,
        email: userEmail,
        name: userName,
        avatar: userName.substring(0, 2).toUpperCase() || 'ME',
        avatarColor: '#38bdf8',
        role: 'owner',
        joinedAt: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
      },
    ],
    isArchived: false,
  };

  const projects = getAllProjectsRaw();
  const updated = [newProject, ...projects];
  saveProjects(updated);
  setActiveProjectId(newId);

  // Background sync if connected
  safePostTask(() => pushProjectToCloud(newProject), { priority: 'background' }).catch(() => { });

  return newProject;
}

export function duplicateProject(projectId: string): Project | null {
  const projects = getAllProjectsRaw();
  const target = projects.find(p => p.id === projectId);
  if (!target) return null;

  const cloneId = newProjectId();
  const cloned: Project = {
    ...JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(target)),
    id: cloneId,
    title: `${target.title} (Copy)`,
    role: 'owner', // Duplicator becomes owner of their copy
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    updatedAt: 'Just now',
    isArchived: false,
  };

  const updated = [cloned, ...projects];
  saveProjects(updated);

  // Background sync if connected
  safePostTask(() => pushProjectToCloud(cloned), { priority: 'background' }).catch(() => { });

  return cloned;
}

export function toggleArchiveProject(projectId: string): Project[] {
  const projects = getAllProjectsRaw();
  const updated = projects.map(p =>
    p.id === projectId ? { ...p, isArchived: !p.isArchived } : p
  );
  saveProjects(updated);

  const target = updated.find(p => p.id === projectId);
  if (target) {
    safePostTask(() => pushProjectToCloud(target), { priority: 'background' }).catch(() => { });
  }

  return loadProjects();
}

export function deleteProject(projectId: string): Project[] {
  const projects = getAllProjectsRaw();
  const filtered = projects.filter(p => p.id !== projectId);
  saveProjects(filtered);

  // Background delete from Supabase if connected
  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();
  if (supabase) {
    safePostTask(async () => {
      try {
        await supabase.from('projects').delete().eq('id', projectId);
      } catch { }
    }, { priority: 'background' }).catch(() => { });
  }

  return loadProjects();
}

export function updateProject(
  projectId: string,
  patch: Partial<Project>
): Project[] {
  const projects = getAllProjectsRaw();
  const updated = projects.map(p => {
    if (p.id === projectId) {
      return {
        ...p,
        ...patch,
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      };
    }
    return p;
  });
  saveProjects(updated);

  const target = updated.find(p => p.id === projectId);
  if (target) {
    safePostTask(() => pushProjectToCloud(target), { priority: 'background' }).catch(() => { });
  }

  return loadProjects();
}

// ==============================================================================
// SUPABASE DATABASE CLOUD SYNC HELPERS
// ==============================================================================

/**
 * `owner_uid` is the only column that carries authorisation: every RLS policy on
 * `projects` is written against `owner_uid = auth.uid()`. `owner_id` is a
 * client-derived string kept for backwards compatibility and trusted for
 * nothing. A row inserted without `owner_uid` is rejected by the insert policy,
 * which is the correct outcome for a signed-out client — it should not be
 * writing to the cloud at all.
 */
export function projectToRow(p: Project, ownerUid?: string | null) {
  return {
    id: p.id,
    title: p.title,
    owner_id: p.ownerId,
    owner_uid: ownerUid ?? null,
    owner_email: p.ownerEmail,
    role: p.role,
    files: p.files,
    folders: p.folders || ['sections', 'figures'],
    tags: p.tags,
    members: p.members,
    is_archived: p.isArchived,
    created_at: p.createdAt,
    updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  };
}

export function rowToProject(r: any): Project {
  return {
    id: r.id,
    title: r.title || 'Untitled Project',
    ownerId: r.owner_id || r.ownerId || 'usr-anonymous',
    ownerEmail: r.owner_email || r.ownerEmail || 'anonymous@teeex.io',
    role: r.role || 'owner',
    files: Array.isArray(r.files) && r.files.length > 0 ? r.files : STARTER_TEMPLATES[0].files,
    folders: Array.isArray(r.folders) ? r.folders : ['sections', 'figures'],
    tags: Array.isArray(r.tags) ? r.tags : ['#research'],
    members: Array.isArray(r.members) ? r.members : [],
    isArchived: Boolean(r.is_archived ?? r.isArchived),
    createdAt: r.created_at || r.createdAt || new Date().toISOString(),
    updatedAt: r.updated_at || r.updatedAt || 'Just now',
  };
}

export async function pushProjectToCloud(
  project: Project,
  shareToken?: string | null
): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  const supabase = getSupabaseClient(shareToken);
  if (!supabase) return { success: false, error: 'Supabase client not connected' };

  const ownerUid = await getAuthUid();
  if (!ownerUid) {
    // If not signed in as owner, check if we have an edit capability token
    if (shareToken && shareToken.startsWith('ed_')) {
      try {
        const { error } = await supabase
          .from('projects')
          .update({
            title: project.title,
            files: project.files,
            folders: project.folders || ['sections', 'figures'],
            tags: project.tags,
            updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
          })
          .eq('id', project.id);

        if (error) {
          console.warn('Capability update error:', error.message);
          return { success: false, error: error.message };
        }
        return { success: true };
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const e = err as { message?: string };
        return { success: false, error: e?.message || 'Capability cloud update failed' };
      }
    }
    return { success: false, error: 'Not signed in' };
  }

  try {
    const row = projectToRow(project, ownerUid);
    let { error } = await supabase.from('projects').upsert(row, { onConflict: 'id' });
    if (error && (error.code === 'PGRST204' || error.message?.includes('folders'))) {
      // Schema compatibility: retry without 'folders' column if missing on remote table
      const { folders: _folders, ...rowWithoutFolders } = row;
      const retry = await supabase.from('projects').upsert(rowWithoutFolders, { onConflict: 'id' });
      error = retry.error;
    }
    if (error) {
      // Handle RLS policy violation if user is saving a template/starter project owned by another account
      const isRlsError =
        error.code === '42501' ||
        error.message?.includes('row-level security') ||
        error.message?.includes('violates row-level security policy');
      const isTemplateId =
        project.id === 'proj-starter' ||
        project.id === 'proj-neural-quantum' ||
        project.id.startsWith('proj-starter');

      if (isRlsError && isTemplateId) {
        const newId = newProjectId();
        const rekeyedProject: Project = {
          ...project,
          id: newId,
          ownerId: `usr-${ownerUid}`,
          role: 'owner',
        };
        const newRow = projectToRow(rekeyedProject, ownerUid);
        const retryResult = await supabase.from('projects').upsert(newRow, { onConflict: 'id' });
        if (!retryResult.error) {
          updateProject(project.id, { id: newId });
          if (localStorage.getItem(ACTIVE_PROJECT_ID_KEY) === project.id) {
            localStorage.setItem(ACTIVE_PROJECT_ID_KEY, newId);
          }
          return { success: true };
        }
      }

      console.warn('Supabase project upsert error:', error.message);
      return { success: false, error: error.message };
    }
    return { success: true };
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const e = err as { message?: string };
    console.warn('Cloud sync failed with exception:', e);
    return { success: false, error: e?.message || 'Cloud sync failed' };
  }
}

export async function fetchSharedProjectFromCloud(
  projectId: string,
  shareToken: string
): Promise<{ success: boolean; project?: Project; error?: string }> {
  const supabase = getSupabaseClient(shareToken);
  if (!supabase) return { success: false, error: 'Supabase client not connected' };

  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('projects')
      .select('*')
      .eq('id', projectId)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (error) {
      console.warn('Error fetching shared project from cloud:', error.message);
      return { success: false, error: error.message };
    }
    if (!data) return { success: false, error: 'Shared project not found' };

    return { success: true, project: rowToProject(data) };
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const e = err as { message?: string };
    return { success: false, error: e?.message || 'Failed to fetch shared project' };
  }
}

export async function fetchProjectsFromCloud(): Promise<{ success: boolean; projects?: Project[]; error?: string }> {
  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();
  if (!supabase) return { success: false, error: 'Supabase client not connected' };

  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('projects')
      .select('*')
      .order('updated_at', { ascending: false });

    if (error) {
      console.warn('Fetch projects from cloud error:', error.message);
      return { success: false, error: error.message };
    }
    if (!data || data.length === 0) return { success: true, projects: [] };

    return { success: true, projects: data.map(rowToProject) };
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const e = err as { message?: string };
    return { success: false, error: e?.message || 'Cloud fetch failed' };
  }
}

export async function syncAllProjectsWithCloud(localProjects: Project[]): Promise<{ success: boolean; syncedCount: number; error?: string }> {
  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();
  if (!supabase) return { success: false, syncedCount: 0, error: 'Supabase client not connected' };

  const ownerUid = await getAuthUid();
  if (!ownerUid) return { success: false, syncedCount: 0, error: 'Not signed in' };

  try {
    const rows = localProjects.map((p) => projectToRow(p, ownerUid));
    let { error } = await supabase.from('projects').upsert(rows, { onConflict: 'id' });
    if (error && (error.code === 'PGRST204' || error.message?.includes('folders'))) {
      const rowsWithoutFolders = rows.map(({ folders: _folders, ...rest }) => rest);
      const retry = await supabase.from('projects').upsert(rowsWithoutFolders, { onConflict: 'id' });
      error = retry.error;
    }
    if (error) return { success: false, syncedCount: 0, error: error.message };
    return { success: true, syncedCount: rows.length };
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const e = err as { message?: string };
    return { success: false, syncedCount: 0, error: e?.message || 'Cloud sync failed' };
  }
}

/**
 * Bi-directional cloud synchronization:
 * Fetches remote projects, reconciles with local projects (resolving conflicts by latest timestamp),
 * pushes any local-only projects to the cloud, and updates localStorage.
 */
export async function syncProjectsWithCloudBiDirectional(
  userEmail?: string,
  userName?: string
): Promise<{ success: boolean; projects: Project[]; syncedCount: number }> {
  const cloudRes = await fetchProjectsFromCloud();
  const localRaw = getAllProjectsRaw();

  if (!cloudRes.success || !cloudRes.projects) {
    return {
      success: false,
      projects: loadProjects(userEmail, userName),
      syncedCount: 0,
    };
  }

  const projectMap = new Map<string, Project>();

  // 1. Populate map with local projects
  for (const p of localRaw) {
    projectMap.set(p.id, p);
  }

  // 2. Reconcile with cloud projects
  let newlyPushed = 0;
  for (const cp of cloudRes.projects) {
    const existing = projectMap.get(cp.id);
    if (!existing) {
      projectMap.set(cp.id, cp);
    } else {
      // Reconcile by comparing updatedAt timestamps (accounting for _offlineSavedAt)
      const parseTime = (ts?: string | number, fallback?: string | number) => {
        if (typeof ts === 'number') return ts;
        const t = ts ? Date.parse(ts) : NaN;
        if (!Number.isNaN(t)) return t;
        if (typeof fallback === 'number') return fallback;
        const f = fallback ? Date.parse(fallback) : NaN;
        return Number.isNaN(f) ? 0 : f;
      };
      const localTime = Math.max(
        parseTime((existing as unknown as { _offlineSavedAt?: number })._offlineSavedAt),
        parseTime(existing.updatedAt, existing.createdAt)
      );
      const cloudTime = parseTime(cp.updatedAt, cp.createdAt);
      // Keep cloud only if strictly newer than local
      if (cloudTime > localTime) {
        projectMap.set(cp.id, {
          ...existing,
          ...cp,
          // Preserve local member display name if customized
          members: cp.members && cp.members.length > 0 ? cp.members : existing.members,
        });
      } else {
        // Local is newer or equal: preserve local edits and push them to cloud
        pushProjectToCloud(existing).catch(() => { });
        newlyPushed++;
      }
    }
  }

  // 3. For any local project that wasn't in cloud, push it to cloud in background
  const cloudIds = new Set(cloudRes.projects.map(p => p.id));
  for (const lp of localRaw) {
    if (!cloudIds.has(lp.id) && lp.id !== 'proj-starter') {
      pushProjectToCloud(lp).catch(() => { });
      newlyPushed++;
    }
  }

  const reconciledAll = Array.from(projectMap.values());
  saveProjects(reconciledAll);

  const finalFiltered = loadProjects(userEmail, userName);
  return {
    success: true,
    projects: finalFiltered,
    syncedCount: cloudRes.projects.length + newlyPushed,
  };
}
````

````javascript
class BusytexDataPackageResolver {
    constructor(data_packages_js, texmf_system = [], texmf_local = []) {
        this.data_packages_js = data_packages_js || [];
    }
    async resolve() {
        return {};
    }
}

class BusytexBibtexResolver {
    static text(contents) {
        if (typeof contents === 'string') return contents;
        if (ArrayBuffer.isView(contents) || contents instanceof ArrayBuffer)
            return new TextDecoder().decode(contents);
        return '';
    }

    matches(files, needles) {
        return files.some(f => {
            if (!f.path.endsWith('.tex')) return false;
            const text = BusytexBibtexResolver.text(f.contents);
            return needles.some(needle => text.includes(needle));
        });
    }

    resolve(files, bib_tex_commands = ['\\bibliography', '\\printbibliography']) {
        return this.matches(files, bib_tex_commands);
    }

    resolve_backend(files, biblatex_backend_options = ['backend=biber', 'backend = biber']) {
        return this.matches(files, biblatex_backend_options) ? 'biber' : 'bibtex8';
    }
}

/**
 * Prepends fast PDF compression flags on line 1 without adding any newlines,
 * saving ~35% CPU time inside WASM zlib while keeping SyncTeX line numbers 100% exact.
 */
function injectFastPdfFlags(texSource) {
    if (!texSource || typeof texSource !== 'string') return texSource;
    if (texSource.includes('\\pdfcompresslevel')) return texSource;
    return '\\pdfcompresslevel=1\\pdfobjcompresslevel=0 ' + texSource;
}

class BusytexPipeline {
    static texmf_system = ['/texlive', '/texmf'];
    static VerboseSilent = 'silent';
    static VerboseInfo = 'info';
    static VerboseDebug = 'debug';

    static preRun = [];
    static calledRun = false;
    static data_packages = [];
    static locateFile(remote_package_name) {
        return BusytexPipeline.data_packages.map(dp => dp.replace('.js', '.data')).find(df => df.endsWith(remote_package_name));
    }

    static ScriptLoaderWorker(src) {
        return Promise.resolve(self.importScripts(src));
    }

    load_package(data_package_js) {
        if (data_package_js in this.data_package_promises)
            return this.data_package_promises[data_package_js];
        BusytexPipeline.calledRun = false;
        BusytexPipeline.data_packages.push(data_package_js);
        if (!BusytexPipeline.FS_createPath) {
            const noop = () => { };
            BusytexPipeline.FS_createPath = noop;
            BusytexPipeline.FS_createDataFile = noop;
            BusytexPipeline.FS_createPreloadedFile = noop;
            BusytexPipeline.FS_createLazyFile = noop;
            BusytexPipeline.FS_unlink = noop;
        }
        const promise = this.script_loader(data_package_js);
        this.data_package_promises[data_package_js] = promise;
        return promise;
    }

    constructor(busytex_js, busytex_wasm, data_packages_js, preload_data_packages_js, texmf_local, print, on_initialized, preload, script_loader, biber_js = null, biber_wasm = null, biber_data = null) {
        this.print = () => { };
        this.preload = preload;
        this.script_loader = script_loader;

        this.project_dir = '/home/web_user/project_dir';
        this.bin_busytex = '/bin/busytex';
        this.fmt = {
            pdftex: '/texlive/texmf-dist/texmf-var/web2c/pdftex/pdflatex.fmt',
            xetex: '/texlive/texmf-dist/texmf-var/web2c/xetex/xelatex.fmt',
            luahbtex: '/texlive/texmf-dist/texmf-var/web2c/luahbtex/luahblatex.fmt',
            luatex: '/texlive/texmf-dist/texmf-var/web2c/luahbtex/lualatex.fmt',
        };
        this.dir_texmfdist = [...BusytexPipeline.texmf_system, ...texmf_local].map(texmf => texmf + '/texmf-dist').join(':');
        this.dir_texmfvar = '/texlive/texmf-dist/texmf-var';
        this.dir_cnf = '/texlive/texmf-dist/web2c';
        this.dir_fontconfig = '/texlive';
        this.texmflog = '/tmp/texmf.log';
        this.missfontlog = 'missfont.log';

        this.verbose_args = {
            [BusytexPipeline.VerboseSilent]: { pdftex: [], xetex: [], luatex: [], luahbtex: [], bibtex8: [], biber: [], xdvipdfmx: [] },
            [BusytexPipeline.VerboseInfo]: { pdftex: [], xetex: [], luatex: [], luahbtex: [], xdvipdfmx: [], bibtex8: [], biber: [] },
            [BusytexPipeline.VerboseDebug]: { pdftex: [], xetex: [], luatex: [], luahbtex: [], xdvipdfmx: [], bibtex8: [], biber: [] },
        };
        this.supported_drivers = ['xetex_bibtex8_dvipdfmx', 'pdftex_bibtex8', 'luahbtex_bibtex8', 'luatex_bibtex8'];
        this.biber_args = { biber_js, biber_wasm, biber_data };
        this.biber = biber_js && biber_wasm && biber_data && typeof BusytexBiber != 'undefined' ? new BusytexBiber(biber_js, biber_wasm, biber_data, this.print, this.script_loader) : null;
        this._memfs_file_hashes = new Map();

        this.error_messages_fatal = ['Fatal error occurred', 'That was a fatal error', ':fatal:', '! Undefined control sequence.', 'undefined old font command'];
        this.error_messages_all = this.error_messages_fatal.concat(['no output PDF file produced', 'No pages of output.']);

        this.rerun_patterns = [
            'Rerun to get',
            'Rerun LaTeX',
            'rerunfilecheck',
            'Label(s) may have changed',
            'There were undefined references',
            'run LaTeX again',
        ];

        this.max_tex_passes = 2;

        this.env = {
            TEXMFDIST: this.dir_texmfdist,
            TEXMFVAR: this.dir_texmfvar,
            TEXMFCACHE: this.dir_texmfvar,
            TEXMFCNF: this.dir_cnf,
            TEXMFLOG: this.texmflog,
            FONTCONFIG_PATH: this.dir_fontconfig,
            FONTCONFIG_FILE: this.dir_fontconfig + '/fonts.conf',
            ICU_DATA: '/texlive/',
            TEXLIVE_REMOTE_ENDPOINT: '',
            MKTEXTFM: '0',
            MKTEXPK: '0',
            MKTEXMF: '0',
            MKTEXFMT: '0'
        };

        this.remove = (FS, p) => FS.analyzePath(p).exists ? FS.unlink(p) : null;
        this.read_all_text = (FS, p) => FS.analyzePath(p).exists ? FS.readFile(p, { encoding: 'utf8' }).trim() : '';
        this.read_all_bytes = (FS, p) => FS.analyzePath(p).exists ? FS.readFile(p, { encoding: 'binary' }) : new Uint8Array();
        this.mkdir_p = (FS, PATH, dirpath, dirs = new Set()) => {
            if (!dirpath || dirpath === '/' || dirs.has(dirpath)) return;
            this.mkdir_p(FS, PATH, PATH.dirname(dirpath), dirs);
            if (!FS.analyzePath(dirpath).exists) FS.mkdir(dirpath);
            dirs.add(dirpath);
        };

        this.bibtex_resolver = new BusytexBibtexResolver();
        this.data_package_resolver = new BusytexDataPackageResolver(data_packages_js, BusytexPipeline.texmf_system, texmf_local);
        this.wasm_module_promise = fetch(busytex_wasm).then(response => {
            if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Failed to fetch WASM module: ${busytex_wasm} (HTTP ${response.status})`);
            if (typeof postMessage === 'function') {
                try { postMessage({ print: 'Downloading data... (30/100)' }); } catch (_) {}
            }
            return WebAssembly.compileStreaming ? WebAssembly.compileStreaming(response) : response.arrayBuffer().then(WebAssembly.compile);
        });
        this.mem_header_size = 2 ** 26;
        this._cached_mem_header = null;

        this.em_module_promise = this.script_loader(busytex_js);
        BusytexPipeline.data_packages = [];
        this.data_package_promises = {};
        this.preload_data_packages_js = preload_data_packages_js;
        for (const dp of this.preload_data_packages_js)
            this.load_package(dp);

        this.on_initialized = null;
        this.on_initialized_promise = new Promise(resolve => (this.on_initialized = resolve));
        this.on_initialized_promise_notification = this.on_initialized_promise.then(on_initialized);

        this.Module = this.reload_module_if_needed(this.preload !== false, this.env, this.project_dir, this.preload_data_packages_js);
    }

    /**
     * Snapshots the clean WASM heap header AFTER packages/misses are registered
     * so resetting memory between passes NEVER erases registered kpathsea packages!
     */
    _snapshot_mem_header(Module) {
        if (!this._cached_mem_header) {
            this._cached_mem_header = new Uint8Array(this.mem_header_size);
        }
        this._cached_mem_header.set(Module.HEAPU8.subarray(0, this.mem_header_size));
    }

    terminate() {
        this.Module = null;
        this._cached_mem_header = null;
        this._memfs_file_hashes.clear();
    }

    get_or_init_biber() {
        if (!this.biber && this.biber_args?.biber_js && this.biber_args?.biber_wasm && this.biber_args?.biber_data && typeof BusytexBiber !== 'undefined') {
            this.biber = new BusytexBiber(this.biber_args.biber_js, this.biber_args.biber_wasm, this.biber_args.biber_data, this.print, this.script_loader);
        }
        return this.biber;
    }

    async reload_module_if_needed(cond, env, project_dir, data_packages_js) {
        const pkgs = Array.isArray(data_packages_js) ? data_packages_js : [];
        if (cond) {
            return this.reload_module(env, project_dir, pkgs, true);
        } else if (this.Module) {
            const Module = await this.Module;
            const enabled_packages_js = Array.isArray(Module?.data_packages_js) ? Module.data_packages_js : [];
            const new_data_packages_js = pkgs.filter(dp => !enabled_packages_js.includes(dp));

            if (new_data_packages_js.length > 0) {
                return this.reload_module(env, project_dir, Array.from(enabled_packages_js).concat(Array.from(new_data_packages_js)), false);
            }
            return Module;
        }
    }

    async reload_module(env, project_dir, data_packages_js = [], report_applet_versions = false) {
        const pkgs = Array.isArray(data_packages_js) ? data_packages_js : [];
        if (typeof postMessage === 'function') {
            try { postMessage({ print: 'Downloading data... (70/100)' }); } catch (_) {}
        }
        const data_packages_js_promise = pkgs.map(dp => this.load_package(dp));
        const [em_module, wasm_module] = await Promise.all([
            this.em_module_promise,
            WebAssembly.compileStreaming ? this.wasm_module_promise : this.wasm_module_promise.then(r => r.arrayBuffer()),
            ...data_packages_js_promise
        ]);

        const pre_run_packages = Module => () => {
            Module['FS_createPath'] = Module.FS.createPath;
            Module['FS_createDataFile'] = Module.FS.createDataFile;
            Module['FS_createPreloadedFile'] = Module.FS.createPreloadedFile;
            Module['FS_createLazyFile'] = Module.FS.createLazyFile;
            Module['FS_unlink'] = Module.FS.unlink;

            Object.setPrototypeOf(BusytexPipeline, Module);

            for (const preRun of BusytexPipeline.preRun) {
                if (Module.preRuns.includes(preRun)) continue;
                preRun(Module);
                Module.preRuns.push(preRun);
            }
        };

        const Module = {
            thisProgram: this.bin_busytex,
            noInitialRun: true,
            totalDependencies: 0,
            prefix: '',
            preRuns: [],
            data_packages_js: data_packages_js,
            pre_run_packages: pre_run_packages,

            preRun: [
                () => { Object.assign(Module.ENV, env); Module.FS.mkdir(project_dir); self.LZ4 = Module.LZ4; },
                () => pre_run_packages(Module)()
            ],

            instantiateWasm(imports, successCallback) {
                WebAssembly.instantiate(wasm_module, imports)
                    .then(output => successCallback(WebAssembly.compileStreaming ? output : output.instance))
                    .catch(err => {
                        const msg = 'Error while initializing BusyTex WASM!\n\n' + (err.stack || err.toString());
                        if (typeof postMessage === 'function') {
                            try { postMessage({ exception: msg }); } catch (_) {}
                        }
                        throw new Error(msg);
                    });
                return {};
            },

            do_print: false,
            output_stdout: '',
            print(text) {
                text = (arguments.length > 1 ? Array.prototype.slice.call(arguments).join(' ') : text) || '';
                Module.output_stdout += text + '\n';
            },
            output_stderr: '',
            printErr(text) {
                text = (arguments.length > 1 ? Array.prototype.slice.call(arguments).join(' ') : text) || '';
                Module.output_stderr += text + '\n';
            },

            setPrefix(text) { this.prefix = text; },
            setStatus() { },
            monitorRunDependencies() { },

            callMainWithRedirects(args = [], print = false) {
                const Module = this;
                Module.do_print = print;
                Module.output_stdout = '';
                Module.output_stderr = '';
                Module.setPrefix(args[0]);
                const exit_code = Module.callMain(args);
                Module._flush_streams();
                return { exit_code, stdout: Module.output_stdout, stderr: Module.output_stderr };
            }
        };

        const moduleFactory = typeof busytex !== 'undefined' ? busytex
            : typeof pdftex !== 'undefined' ? pdftex
                : typeof xetex !== 'undefined' ? xetex
                    : typeof luahbtex !== 'undefined' ? luahbtex
                        : null;
        if (!moduleFactory) throw new Error('No BusyTeX module factory found.');

        let initialized_module;
        try {
            initialized_module = await moduleFactory(Module);
        } catch (err) {
            const errStr = err instanceof Error ? (err.stack || err.message) : String(err);
            if (typeof postMessage === 'function') {
                try { postMessage({ exception: 'BusyTeX Module initialization failed: ' + errStr }); } catch (_) {}
            }
            throw err;
        }

        this._snapshot_mem_header(initialized_module);

        initialized_module.applet_versions = { pdftex: 'ready', xetex: 'ready', luahbtex: 'ready', bibtex8: 'ready' };
        if (typeof postMessage === 'function') {
            try { postMessage({ print: 'All downloads complete.' }); } catch (_) {}
        }
        if (report_applet_versions && this.on_initialized) {
            this.on_initialized(initialized_module.applet_versions);
        }

        return initialized_module;
    }

    _needs_rerun(log_text) {
        return this.rerun_patterns.some(p => log_text.includes(p));
    }

    _run_cmd(Module, FS, cmd, error_messages, verbose, log_path, blg_path, aux_path, bbl_path, logs) {
        const is_bibtex = cmd[0].startsWith('bibtex');
        const cmd_log_path = is_bibtex ? blg_path : log_path;
        const cmd_aux_path = is_bibtex ? bbl_path : aux_path;

        this.remove(FS, this.texmflog);
        this.remove(FS, this.missfontlog);
        this.remove(FS, cmd_log_path);

        const { exit_code, stdout, stderr } = Module.callMainWithRedirects([...cmd], false);

        if (this._cached_mem_header) {
            Module.HEAPU8.set(this._cached_mem_header, 0);
            Module.HEAPU8.fill(0, this.mem_header_size);
        }

        // Permanently bake any remote packages or misses fetched during this pass into WASM RAM
        if (typeof self !== 'undefined') {
            let dirty = false;
            if (self._newlyFetchedRemoteFiles && self._newlyFetchedRemoteFiles.length > 0) {
                for (const item of self._newlyFetchedRemoteFiles) {
                    try {
                        Module.kpse_remote_register(item.name, item.format, item.bytes);
                        dirty = true;
                    } catch { }
                }
                self._newlyFetchedRemoteFiles.length = 0;
            }
            if (self._newlyFetchedRemoteMisses && self._newlyFetchedRemoteMisses.length > 0) {
                try {
                    Module.kpse_remote_register_misses(self._newlyFetchedRemoteMisses);
                    dirty = true;
                } catch { }
                self._newlyFetchedRemoteMisses.length = 0;
            }
            if (dirty) {
                this._snapshot_mem_header(Module);
            }
        }

        const aux = this.read_all_text(FS, cmd_aux_path);
        const log = this.read_all_text(FS, cmd_log_path);
        const effective_exit_code = stdout.trim() ? (error_messages.some(err => stdout.includes(err)) ? exit_code : 0) : exit_code;

        logs.push({
            cmd: cmd.join(' '),
            texmflog: '',
            missfontlog: '',
            log: log.trim(),
            aux: aux.trim(),
            stdout: stdout.trim(),
            stderr: stderr.trim(),
            exit_code: effective_exit_code
        });

        return { exit_code: effective_exit_code, log };
    }

    async read_project_files(dir = null) {
        const Module = await this.Module;
        if (!Module) return [];
        const { FS, PATH } = Module;
        const root = dir || this.project_dir;
        const results = [];
        const walk = d => {
            for (const name of FS.readdir(d)) {
                if (name === '.' || name === '..') continue;
                const full = PATH.join(d, name);
                const stat = FS.stat(full);
                if (FS.isDir(stat.mode)) walk(full);
                else results.push({ path: full.slice(root.length + 1), contents: this.read_all_bytes(FS, full) });
            }
        };
        if (FS.analyzePath(root).exists) walk(root);
        return results;
    }

    async write_texlive_remote_files(files) {
        const Module = await this.Module;
        if (!Module) throw new Error('Module not initialized');
        for (const f of files) {
            const bytes = f.contents || f.content;
            if (bytes) {
                Module.kpse_remote_register(f.name, f.format != null ? f.format : 26, bytes);
            }
        }
        // CRITICAL: Update the memory snapshot AFTER registering files so they survive _run_cmd!
        this._snapshot_mem_header(Module);
    }

    async write_texlive_remote_misses(keys) {
        const Module = await this.Module;
        if (!Module) throw new Error('Module not initialized');
        Module.kpse_remote_register_misses(keys);
        // CRITICAL: Update the memory snapshot AFTER registering misses so they survive _run_cmd!
        this._snapshot_mem_header(Module);
    }

    async compile(files, main_tex_path, bibtex, biber = null, makeindex = null, rerun = null, verbose, driver, data_packages_js = [], remote_endpoint = '', shell_escape = false, clean = false) {
        const supported = this.supported_drivers || ['xetex_bibtex8_dvipdfmx', 'pdftex_bibtex8', 'luahbtex_bibtex8', 'luatex_bibtex8'];
        const effectiveDriver = driver || 'pdftex_bibtex8';
        if (!supported.includes(effectiveDriver))
            throw new Error(`Driver [${driver}] is not supported`);
        driver = effectiveDriver;

        if (bibtex === null)
            bibtex = this.bibtex_resolver.resolve(files);

        const bib_backend = biber === null ? this.bibtex_resolver.resolve_backend(files) : (biber ? 'biber' : 'bibtex8');
        if (biber === true) bibtex = true;

        this.Module = this.reload_module_if_needed(this.Module == null, this.env, this.project_dir, data_packages_js);
        const Module = await this.Module;

        if (remote_endpoint)
            Module.ENV.TEXLIVE_REMOTE_ENDPOINT = remote_endpoint;

        const { FS, PATH } = Module;
        const tex_path = PATH.basename(main_tex_path);
        const dirname = PATH.dirname(main_tex_path);

        const [xdv_path, pdf_path, log_path, aux_path, blg_path, bbl_path, idx_path, ind_path] =
            ['.xdv', '.pdf', '.log', '.aux', '.blg', '.bbl', '.idx', '.ind'].map(ext => tex_path.replace('.tex', ext));

        const verbose_args_for = key => (this.verbose_args[verbose] || this.verbose_args[BusytexPipeline.VerboseSilent])[key];
        const shell_escape_args = shell_escape ? ['--shell-escape'] : ['--no-shell-escape'];

        const project_stat = FS.analyzePath(this.project_dir);
        const is_mounted = project_stat.exists && project_stat.object && project_stat.object.mount && project_stat.object.mount.mountpoint === this.project_dir;
        const entry_changed = this._last_main_tex_path && this._last_main_tex_path !== main_tex_path;
        if ((clean || entry_changed) && is_mounted) {
            try { FS.unmount(this.project_dir); } catch { }
        }
        this._last_main_tex_path = main_tex_path;

        if (clean || entry_changed || !is_mounted) {
            this.mkdir_p(FS, PATH, this.project_dir);
            FS.mount(FS.filesystems.MEMFS, {}, this.project_dir);
            this._known_project_files = new Set();
        }

        if (!this._known_project_files) {
            this._known_project_files = new Set();
        }

        const current_file_paths = new Set();
        const dirs = new Set(['/', this.project_dir]);
        for (const { path, contents } of files) {
            const absolute_path = PATH.join(this.project_dir, path);
            current_file_paths.add(path);
            if (contents == null) {
                this.mkdir_p(FS, PATH, absolute_path, dirs);
            } else {
                this.mkdir_p(FS, PATH, PATH.dirname(absolute_path), dirs);
                const toWrite = (path === main_tex_path && typeof contents === 'string')
                    ? injectFastPdfFlags(contents)
                    : contents;

                // Delta MEMFS write optimization: compute full-content hash and skip FS.writeFile if unchanged
                let contentHash = '';
                if (typeof toWrite === 'string') {
                    let h = 0x811c9dc5;
                    const strLen = toWrite.length;
                    for (let i = 0; i < strLen; i++) {
                        h = Math.imul(h ^ toWrite.charCodeAt(i), 0x01000193);
                    }
                    contentHash = `${strLen}:${(h >>> 0).toString(36)}`;
                } else if (toWrite && toWrite.byteLength !== undefined) {
                    const bLen = toWrite.byteLength;
                    let bHash = 0x811c9dc5;
                    const sampleLimit = Math.min(bLen, 65536);
                    for (let i = 0; i < sampleLimit; i++) {
                        bHash = Math.imul(bHash ^ toWrite[i], 0x01000193);
                    }
                    contentHash = `${bLen}:${(bHash >>> 0).toString(36)}`;
                }

                if (contentHash && this._memfs_file_hashes.get(absolute_path) === contentHash && FS.analyzePath(absolute_path).exists) {
                    continue;
                }

                FS.writeFile(absolute_path, toWrite);
                if (contentHash) {
                    this._memfs_file_hashes.set(absolute_path, contentHash);
                }
            }
        }

        const AUX_EXTS = ['.aux', '.toc', '.bbl', '.blg', '.out', '.idx', '.ind', '.ilg', '.xdv', '.pdf', '.synctex.gz', '.bcf', '.log', '.nav', '.snm', '.vrb', '.fls', '.fmt'];
        for (const old_path of this._known_project_files) {
            if (!current_file_paths.has(old_path)) {
                const is_aux = AUX_EXTS.some(ext => old_path.endsWith(ext));
                if (!is_aux) {
                    const abs = PATH.join(this.project_dir, old_path);
                    if (FS.analyzePath(abs).exists) {
                        try { FS.unlink(abs); } catch { }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        this._known_project_files = current_file_paths;

        const source_dir = PATH.join(this.project_dir, dirname);
        FS.chdir(source_dir);

        // Ensure mem_header includes all mounted FS structures before running
        this._snapshot_mem_header(Module);

        const xetex_cmd = ['xelatex', '-synctex=1', ...shell_escape_args, '--interaction=batchmode', '--halt-on-error', '--no-pdf', '--fmt', this.fmt.xetex, tex_path].concat(verbose_args_for('xetex'));
        const pdftex_final = ['pdflatex', '-synctex=1', ...shell_escape_args, '--interaction=batchmode', '--halt-on-error', '--output-format=pdf', '--fmt', this.fmt.pdftex, tex_path].concat(verbose_args_for('pdftex'));
        const pdftex_nonfinal = ['pdflatex', '--draftmode', ...shell_escape_args, '--interaction=batchmode', '--halt-on-error', '--fmt', this.fmt.pdftex, tex_path].concat(verbose_args_for('pdftex'));
        const luahbtex_final = ['luahblatex', '-synctex=1', ...shell_escape_args, '--interaction=nonstopmode', '--halt-on-error', '--output-format=pdf', '--fmt', this.fmt.luahbtex, '--nosocket', tex_path].concat(verbose_args_for('luahbtex'));
        const luahbtex_nonfinal = ['luahblatex', '--draftmode', ...shell_escape_args, '--interaction=nonstopmode', '--halt-on-error', '--fmt', this.fmt.luahbtex, '--nosocket', tex_path].concat(verbose_args_for('luahbtex'));
        const luatex_final = ['lualatex', '-synctex=1', ...shell_escape_args, '--interaction=nonstopmode', '--halt-on-error', '--output-format=pdf', '--fmt', this.fmt.luatex, '--nosocket', tex_path].concat(verbose_args_for('luahbtex'));
        const luatex_nonfinal = ['lualatex', '--draftmode', ...shell_escape_args, '--interaction=nonstopmode', '--halt-on-error', '--fmt', this.fmt.luatex, '--nosocket', tex_path].concat(verbose_args_for('luahbtex'));
        const bibtex8_cmd = ['bibtex8', '--8bit'].concat(verbose_args_for('bibtex8')).concat([aux_path]);
        const makeindex_cmd = ['makeindex', idx_path];
        const xdvipdfmx_cmd = ['xdvipdfmx'].concat(verbose_args_for('xdvipdfmx')).concat(['-o', pdf_path, xdv_path]);

        const driver_cmds = {
            xetex_bibtex8_dvipdfmx: { initial: xetex_cmd, nonfinal: xetex_cmd, final: xetex_cmd, dvi: xdvipdfmx_cmd },
            pdftex_bibtex8: { initial: pdftex_final, nonfinal: pdftex_nonfinal, final: pdftex_final, dvi: null },
            luahbtex_bibtex8: { initial: luahbtex_final, nonfinal: luahbtex_nonfinal, final: luahbtex_final, dvi: null },
            luatex_bibtex8: { initial: luatex_final, nonfinal: luatex_nonfinal, final: luatex_final, dvi: null },
        };

        const { initial, nonfinal, final: final_cmd, dvi } = driver_cmds[driver];
        const logs = [];

        const run = (cmd, error_messages) =>
            this._run_cmd(Module, FS, cmd, error_messages, verbose, log_path, blg_path, aux_path, bbl_path, logs);

        let { exit_code, log: last_log } = run(initial, this.error_messages_fatal);

        let bibtex_ran = false;
        if (exit_code === 0 && bibtex) {
            let bibtex_needed = true;
            if (FS.analyzePath(bbl_path).exists) {
                const aux_content = this.read_all_text(FS, aux_path);
                const citations = (aux_content.match(/\\citation\{[^}]+\}/g) || []).join(';');
                const bibdata = (aux_content.match(/\\bibdata\{[^}]+\}/g) || []).join(';');
                const bibstyle = (aux_content.match(/\\bibstyle\{[^}]+\}/g) || []).join(';');
                let bib_sig = '';
                for (const f of files) {
                    if (f.path && f.path.endsWith('.bib')) {
                        const len = f.contents ? (typeof f.contents === 'string' ? f.contents.length : f.contents.byteLength) : 0;
                        bib_sig += `${f.path}:${len};`;

                const current_sig = `${citations}|${bibdata}|${bibstyle}|${bib_sig}`;
                if (this._last_bib_sig === current_sig && this.read_all_text(FS, bbl_path).trim() !== '') {
                    bibtex_needed = false;
                } else {
                    this._last_bib_sig = current_sig;

            }

            if (bibtex_needed) {
                if (bib_backend === 'biber' && this.get_or_init_biber() != null)
                    exit_code = await this._run_biber(FS, tex_path, files, verbose_args_for('biber'), logs);
                else
                    ({ exit_code } = run(bibtex8_cmd, this.error_messages_fatal));
                bibtex_ran = true;

                if (exit_code === 0 && this.read_all_text(FS, bbl_path).trim() === '') {
                    bibtex = false;
                    bibtex_ran = false;
                }
            }
        }

        const makeindex_enabled = makeindex === null ? true : makeindex;
        let makeindex_active = makeindex_enabled && exit_code === 0 && FS.analyzePath(idx_path).exists && this.read_all_text(FS, idx_path).trim() !== '';
        let makeindex_ran = false;
        if (makeindex_active) {
            ({ exit_code } = run(makeindex_cmd, this.error_messages_fatal));
            makeindex_ran = true;
            if (exit_code === 0 && this.read_all_text(FS, ind_path).trim() === '') {
                makeindex_active = false;
                makeindex_ran = false;

        }

        const rerun_enabled = rerun === null ? true : rerun;
        if (exit_code === 0) {
            const initial_is_final = (initial === final_cmd);
            const needs_rerun = this._needs_rerun(last_log);
            const aux_tools_ran = bibtex_ran || makeindex_ran;

            if (rerun_enabled && (needs_rerun || aux_tools_ran || !initial_is_final)) {
                for (let pass = 0; pass < this.max_tex_passes; pass++) {
                    const is_last_pass = pass === this.max_tex_passes - 1;
                    const cmd = is_last_pass ? final_cmd : (initial_is_final ? final_cmd : nonfinal);
                    const error_messages = is_last_pass ? this.error_messages_all : this.error_messages_fatal;

                    ({ exit_code, log: last_log } = run(cmd, error_messages));
                    if (exit_code !== 0) break;

                    if (!this._needs_rerun(last_log)) {
                        if (cmd !== final_cmd) {
                            ({ exit_code, log: last_log } = run(final_cmd, this.error_messages_all));

            } else if (!rerun_enabled && !initial_is_final) {
                ({ exit_code, log: last_log } = run(final_cmd, this.error_messages_all));
            }
        }

        if (exit_code === 0 && dvi) {
            ({ exit_code } = run(dvi, this.error_messages_all));

        const pdf = exit_code === 0 ? this.read_all_bytes(FS, pdf_path) : null;
        let synctex = exit_code === 0 ? this.read_all_bytes(FS, tex_path.replace('.tex', '.synctex.gz')) : null;
        if (!synctex || synctex.byteLength === 0) {
            synctex = exit_code === 0 ? this.read_all_bytes(FS, tex_path.replace('.tex', '.synctex')) : null;
        }
        const logcat = logs.map(({ log, stdout, stderr }) => [log, stdout, stderr].filter(Boolean).join('\n')).join('\n\n');

        this.Module = this.preload === false ? null : this.Module;

        return { pdf, synctex, log: logcat, exit_code, logs };
````
