/**
 * Teeex — React binding for the TeX engine.
 *
 * Two behaviours here exist specifically to make real TeX compilation feel
 * usable, since a genuine pdfLaTeX pass costs seconds rather than milliseconds:
 *
 *  - The last successful PDF stays on screen while a new compile runs, and
 *    while a failing compile is being fixed. The preview never blanks, and a
 *    syntax error mid-edit does not destroy the user's view of their document.
 *
 *  - Compiles are keyed on a content fingerprint, so re-renders that do not
 *    change any file never trigger a recompile.
 */

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import type { CompileMode, ProjectFile } from '../types/latex';
import {
  texEngine,
  type CompileOutcome,
  type EngineId,
  type EngineStatus,
} from '../services/latexCompiler';
import { loadCompiledSnapshot } from '../services/pdfSnapshotCache';

export interface UseTexEngineOptions {
  files: ProjectFile[];
  engine?: EngineId;
  autoCompile?: boolean;
  debounceMs?: number;
  projectId?: string;
  compileMode?: CompileMode;
  citations?: string[];
}

export interface UseTexEngineResult {
  status: EngineStatus;
  /** Most recent successfully compiled PDF, retained across failures. */
  pdf: Uint8Array | null;
  /** Result of the latest compile that actually ran. */
  outcome: CompileOutcome | null;
  isCompiling: boolean;
  /** True when a keystroke has queued compilation and the debounce timer is counting down. */
  isDebouncing: boolean;
  /** Wall-clock time of the last TeX compilation in milliseconds. */
  durationMs: number | null;
  /** True when `pdf` predates `outcome` — i.e. the view is a last-good build. */
  isStale: boolean;
  lastCompiledAt: number | null;
  compile: () => void;
}

/**
 * Cheap rolling hash over everything the engine would read.
 *
 * Deliberately a hash rather than a concatenation: building a string of the
 * whole project on every render allocates megabytes for a large document, on
 * the keystroke path. FNV-1a over name + content + the fields that change what
 * gets mounted is enough to decide "did anything change", which is all this is
 * for. A collision would mean one skipped recompile, recoverable with the
 * Recompile button; the cost of being wrong is low and bounded.
 */
function mixHash(initialHash: number, text: string): number {
  let hash = initialHash;
  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
    hash ^= text.charCodeAt(i);
    hash = Math.imul(hash, 0x01000193);
  }
  return hash;
}

function fingerprintFiles(files: ProjectFile[]): string {
  let hash = 0x811c9dc5;

  for (const file of files) {
    hash = mixHash(hash, file.name);
    hash = mixHash(hash, file.content);
    hash = mixHash(hash, file.isEntry ? '\u0001' : '\u0002');
    // Figures hold their bytes in dataUrl; hashing a multi-megabyte base64
    // string per render is exactly what this function exists to avoid, so use
    // its length plus a short prefix as a replacement signal.
    if (file.dataUrl) {
      hash = mixHash(hash, String(file.dataUrl.length));
      hash = mixHash(hash, file.dataUrl.slice(0, 64));
    }
  }

  // Length guards against a hash collision between projects of different size.
  return `${files.length}:${(hash >>> 0).toString(36)}`;
}

export function useTexEngine({
  files,
  engine = 'pdflatex',
  autoCompile = true,
  debounceMs,
  projectId,
  compileMode = 'fast',
  citations,
}: UseTexEngineOptions): UseTexEngineResult {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<EngineStatus>(() => texEngine.getStatus());
  const [outcome, setOutcome] = useState<CompileOutcome | null>(null);
  const [pdf, setPdf] = useState<Uint8Array | null>(null);
  const [isCompiling, setIsCompiling] = useState(false);
  const [isDebouncing, setIsDebouncing] = useState(false);
  const [lastCompiledAt, setLastCompiledAt] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const filesRef = useRef(files);
  filesRef.current = files;

  const engineRef = useRef(engine);
  engineRef.current = engine;

  const projectIdRef = useRef(projectId);
  projectIdRef.current = projectId;

  const compileModeRef = useRef(compileMode);
  compileModeRef.current = compileMode;

  const citationsRef = useRef(citations);
  citationsRef.current = citations;

  /** Highest request id whose result we have accepted. */
  const acceptedRef = useRef(0);
  const timerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => texEngine.subscribe(setStatus), []);

  // Start the engine download immediately so it overlaps with the user's first
  // edits rather than blocking their first compile.
  useEffect(() => {
    texEngine.prewarm(engineRef.current);
  }, []);

  // Layer 1: Instant IndexedDB snapshot restoration (< 50ms) to eliminate cold-start wait
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!projectId) return;
    let active = true;
    void loadCompiledSnapshot(projectId).then((cached) => {
      if (active && cached && cached.pdf && cached.pdf.byteLength > 0) {
        setPdf((curr) => (curr ? curr : cached.pdf));
        if (cached.synctex && cached.synctex.byteLength > 0) {
          setOutcome((prev) => {
            if (prev) return prev;
            return {
              ok: true,
              pdf: cached.pdf,
              synctex: cached.synctex,
              log: 'Restored from local snapshot cache.',
              diagnostics: [],
              missingPackages: [],
              rerunRequired: false,
              entryPath: 'main.tex',
              engine: engineRef.current,
              durationMs: 0,
              requestId: 0,
              superseded: false,
            };
          });
        }
      }
    });
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [projectId]);

  const runCompile = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsDebouncing(false);
    setIsCompiling(true);
    try {
      const result = await texEngine.compile({
        files: filesRef.current,
        engine: engineRef.current,
        projectId: projectIdRef.current,
        compileMode: compileModeRef.current,
        citations: citationsRef.current,
        onIntermediateResult: ({ pdf: pass1Pdf }) => {
          // Pass-1 Instant Streaming: update active viewport PDF immediately!
          if (pass1Pdf && pass1Pdf.byteLength > 0) {
            setPdf(pass1Pdf);
          }
        },
      });

      if (result.superseded) return;
      // Guard against out-of-order resolution.
      if (result.requestId < acceptedRef.current) return;
      acceptedRef.current = result.requestId;

      setOutcome(result);
      const timestamp = Date.now();
      setLastCompiledAt(timestamp);
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        const win = window as unknown as {
          __teeexLastCompiledAt?: number;
          __teeexCompileCount?: number;
          __teeexLastOutcome?: CompileOutcome;
        };
        win.__teeexLastCompiledAt = timestamp;
        win.__teeexCompileCount = (win.__teeexCompileCount ?? 0) + 1;
        win.__teeexLastOutcome = result;
      }
      if (result.pdf && result.pdf.byteLength > 0) {
        setPdf(result.pdf);
      }
    } finally {
      setIsCompiling(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const fingerprint = useMemo(() => fingerprintFiles(files), [files]);

  // Ultra-responsive adaptive debounce for live editing:
  // Short docs: 250ms, medium: 380ms, large papers: 500ms.
  // Cuts up to 600ms of dead-time lag while preserving typing fluidity.
  const effectiveDebounceMs = useMemo(() => {
    if (debounceMs !== undefined) return debounceMs;
    const totalChars = files.reduce((acc, f) => acc + (f.content ? f.content.length : 0), 0);
    if (totalChars < 5000) return 250;
    if (totalChars < 25000) return 380;
    return 500;
  }, [debounceMs, files]);

  const isInitialMount = useRef(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!autoCompile) return;
    if (!fingerprint) return;

    // Immediately trigger compilation on initial mount without any debounce delay
    if (isInitialMount.current) {
      isInitialMount.current = false;
      setIsDebouncing(false);
      void runCompile();
      return;
    }

    if (timerRef.current) clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
    setIsDebouncing(true);
    timerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setIsDebouncing(false);
      void runCompile();
    }, effectiveDebounceMs);

    return () => {
      if (timerRef.current) clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
    };
  }, [fingerprint, autoCompile, effectiveDebounceMs, runCompile]);

  const isStale = Boolean(pdf) && Boolean(outcome) && !outcome!.ok;

  return {
    status,
    pdf,
    outcome,
    isCompiling,
    isDebouncing,
    durationMs: outcome?.durationMs ?? null,
    isStale,
    lastCompiledAt,
    compile: () => {
      if (timerRef.current) clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
      setIsDebouncing(false);
      void runCompile();
    },
  };
}

import type { Diagnostic, ParsedDocument, ProjectFile, LatexLabel } from '../types/latex';

/**
 * Converts standard LaTeX dimension strings into browser-compatible CSS dimensions.
 */
export function parseLatexDimensionToCss(dim: string, fallback: string = '100%'): string {
  if (!dim) return fallback;
  const clean = dim.trim().replace(/[{}]/g, '');
  if (!clean) return fallback;

  const isNeg = clean.startsWith('-');
  const unsigned = isNeg ? clean.slice(1).trim() : clean;

  const relWidthMatch = unsigned.match(/^([0-9.]*)\s*\\(textwidth|columnwidth|linewidth|paperwidth|pagewidth)$/i);
  if (relWidthMatch) {
    const factor = relWidthMatch[1] ? parseFloat(relWidthMatch[1]) : 1.0;
    if (!isNaN(factor)) {
      const val = Math.round(factor * 1000) / 10;
      return isNeg ? `-${val}%` : `${val}%`;
    }
    return isNeg ? '-100%' : '100%';
  }

  const relHeightMatch = unsigned.match(/^([0-9.]*)\s*\\(textheight|paperheight)$/i);
  if (relHeightMatch) {
    const factor = relHeightMatch[1] ? parseFloat(relHeightMatch[1]) : 1.0;
    if (!isNaN(factor)) {
      const val = Math.round(factor * 1000) / 10;
      return isNeg ? `-${val}vh` : `${val}vh`;
    }
    return isNeg ? '-100vh' : '100vh';
  }

  const baseLineMatch = unsigned.match(/^([0-9.]*)\s*\\baselineskip$/i);
  if (baseLineMatch) {
    const factor = baseLineMatch[1] ? parseFloat(baseLineMatch[1]) : 1.0;
    const emVal = Math.round(factor * 1.25 * 100) / 100;
    return isNeg ? `-${emVal}em` : `${emVal}em`;
  }

  if (unsigned === '\\fill' || unsigned.startsWith('\\stretch')) {
    return '100%';
  }
  if (unsigned.includes('\\bigskipamount')) return isNeg ? '-18px' : '18px';
  if (unsigned.includes('\\medskipamount')) return isNeg ? '-10px' : '10px';
  if (unsigned.includes('\\smallskipamount')) return isNeg ? '-5px' : '5px';
  if (unsigned.includes('\\parskip')) return isNeg ? '-6px' : '6px';

  const unitMatch = unsigned.match(/^([0-9.]+)\s*(cm|mm|in|pt|em|ex|px|pc)$/i);
  if (unitMatch) {
    const val = parseFloat(unitMatch[1]);
    const unit = unitMatch[2].toLowerCase();
    if (!isNaN(val)) {
      if (unit === 'pc') {
        const pxVal = Math.round(val * 16);
        return isNeg ? `-${pxVal}px` : `${pxVal}px`;
      }
      return isNeg ? `-${val}${unit}` : `${val}${unit}`;
    }
  }

  const numMatch = unsigned.match(/^([0-9.]+)$/);
  if (numMatch) {
    return isNeg ? `-${numMatch[1]}px` : `${numMatch[1]}px`;
  }

  if (unsigned.includes('\\textwidth') || unsigned.includes('\\columnwidth') || unsigned.includes('\\linewidth')) {
    return isNeg ? '-100%' : '100%';
  }

  return fallback;
}

/**
 * Scans ahead in `str` from `startIndex` skipping whitespace and extracts a balanced braced group `{...}`.
 */
export function extractBalancedBracedGroup(str: string, startIndex: number = 0): { content: string; endIndex: number } | null {
  let i = startIndex;
  while (i < str.length && /\s/.test(str[i])) i++;
  if (i >= str.length || str[i] !== '{') return null;

  i++;
  let depth = 1;
  const startContent = i;

  while (i < str.length && depth > 0) {
    const ch = str[i];
    if (ch === '\\') {
      i += 2;
      continue;
    }
    if (ch === '{') depth++;
    else if (ch === '}') depth--;
    i++;
  }

  if (depth === 0) {
    return {
      content: str.substring(startContent, i - 1),
      endIndex: i,
    };
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * Scans ahead in `str` from `startIndex` skipping whitespace and extracts an optional bracketed group `[...]`.
 */
export function extractOptionalBracket(str: string, startIndex: number = 0): { content: string; endIndex: number } | null {
  let i = startIndex;
  while (i < str.length && /\s/.test(str[i])) i++;
  if (i >= str.length || str[i] !== '[') return null;

  i++;
  let depth = 1;
  const startContent = i;

  while (i < str.length && depth > 0) {
    const ch = str[i];
    if (ch === '\\') {
      i += 2;
      continue;
    }
    if (ch === '[') depth++;
    else if (ch === ']') depth--;
    i++;
  }

  if (depth === 0) {
    return {
      content: str.substring(startContent, i - 1),
      endIndex: i,
    };
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * Scans ahead in `str` from `startIndex` skipping whitespace and extracts a macro with a balanced braced group `\macro{...}`.
 */
export function extractMacroWithBracedArg(
  str: string,
  macroName: string,
  startIndex: number = 0,
): { content: string; startIndex: number; endIndex: number } | null {
  const pattern = new RegExp(`\\\\${macroName}\\s*\\*?\\s*\\{`, 'g');
  pattern.lastIndex = startIndex;
  const match = pattern.exec(str);
  if (!match) return null;

  const braceStart = match.index + match[0].length - 1;
  const braced = extractBalancedBracedGroup(str, braceStart);
  if (!braced) return null;

  return {
    content: braced.content,
    startIndex: match.index,
    endIndex: braced.endIndex,
  };
}

/**
 * Recursively resolves \input{...}, \include{...}, and \subfile{...} across project files with circular reference protection.
 */
export function expandTransclusions(
  code: string,
  files?: ProjectFile[],
  maxDepth: number = 10,
  visited: Set<string> = new Set<string>(),
): string {
  if (!files || files.length === 0 || maxDepth <= 0) return code;

  if (visited.size === 0) {
    const rootFile = files.find(f => f.content === code || f.isEntry);
    if (rootFile) visited.add(rootFile.name);
  }

  return code.replace(/\\(?:input|include|subfile)\s*\{([^}]+)\}/g, (orig, rawPath) => {
    const targetName = rawPath.trim();
    if (!targetName) return orig;

    const baseName = targetName.endsWith('.tex') ? targetName.slice(0, -4) : targetName;
    const candidates = [
      targetName,
      `${baseName}.tex`,
      targetName.replace(/^\.\//, ''),
      `${baseName.replace(/^\.\//, '')}.tex`,
    ];

    const target = files.find(f => {
      const fn = f.name.replace(/\\/g, '/');
      return candidates.some(c => fn === c || fn.endsWith(`/${c}`));
    });

    if (!target || !target.content) return orig;
    if (visited.has(target.name)) return orig;

    const nextVisited = new Set(visited);
    nextVisited.add(target.name);

    return expandTransclusions(target.content, files, maxDepth - 1, nextVisited);
  });
}

/**
 * Replaces the content inside verbatim, lstlisting, minted, and inline \verb blocks with spaces
 * while preserving newlines and delimiters. This shields comments, math, and code syntax from
 * polluting AST section captures, table of contents, and linter diagnostics.
 */
export function shieldVerbatimBlocks(code: string): string {
  if (!code) return '';
  let result = code.replace(
    /(\\begin\{(?:verbatim\*?|lstlisting\*?|minted\*?)\}(?:\[.*?\])?)([\s\S]*?)(\\end\{(?:verbatim\*?|lstlisting\*?|minted\*?)\})/g,
    (_, startTag, body, endTag) => {
      const blanked = body.replace(/[^\r\n]/g, ' ');
      return startTag + blanked + endTag;
    }
  );

  result = result.replace(/\\verb\*?([^\w\s])([\s\S]*?)\1/g, (match) => {
    return ' '.repeat(match.length);
  });

  return result;
}

export function expandColSpec(spec: string): string {
  let expanded = spec;
  const repRegex = /\*\{?(\d+)\}?\{([^}]+)\}/g;
  let prev = '';
  let iterations = 0;
  while (prev !== expanded && iterations < 8) {
    prev = expanded;
    expanded = expanded.replace(repRegex, (_, countStr, pattern) => {
      const count = parseInt(countStr, 10);
      if (isNaN(count) || count <= 0 || count > 50) return pattern;
      return pattern.repeat(count);
    });
    iterations++;
  }
  return expanded;
}

export interface ColSpecItem {
  align: 'left' | 'center' | 'right' | 'justify';
  width?: string;
  borderLeft?: boolean;
  borderRight?: boolean;
  isX?: boolean;
}

export function parseColSpec(rawSpec: string): ColSpecItem[] {
  let spec = expandColSpec(rawSpec.replace(/^\{|\}$/g, '').trim());
  spec = spec.replace(/Y/g, '>{\\centering}X').replace(/Z/g, '>{\\raggedleft}X');

  const cols: ColSpecItem[] = [];
  let pendingBorderLeft = false;

  let i = 0;
  while (i < spec.length) {
    const ch = spec[i];
    if (ch === '|') {
      if (cols.length > 0) {
        cols[cols.length - 1].borderRight = true;
      }
      pendingBorderLeft = true;
      i++;
    } else if (ch === 'l') {
      cols.push({ align: 'left', borderLeft: pendingBorderLeft });
      pendingBorderLeft = false;
      i++;
    } else if (ch === 'c') {
      cols.push({ align: 'center', borderLeft: pendingBorderLeft });
      pendingBorderLeft = false;
      i++;
    } else if (ch === 'r') {
      cols.push({ align: 'right', borderLeft: pendingBorderLeft });
      pendingBorderLeft = false;
      i++;
    } else if (ch === 'p' || ch === 'm' || ch === 'b') {
      i++;
      while (i < spec.length && /\s/.test(spec[i])) i++;
      let widthStr = '';
      if (spec[i] === '{') {
        const braced = extractBalancedBracedGroup(spec, i);
        if (braced) {
          widthStr = braced.content;
          i = braced.endIndex;
        } else {
          i++;
        }
      }
      const cssWidth = widthStr ? parseLatexDimensionToCss(widthStr) : undefined;
      cols.push({
        align: ch === 'p' ? 'left' : 'center',
        width: cssWidth,
        borderLeft: pendingBorderLeft,
      });
      pendingBorderLeft = false;
    } else if (ch === 'X') {
      cols.push({ align: 'left', isX: true, borderLeft: pendingBorderLeft });
      pendingBorderLeft = false;
      i++;
    } else if (ch === '>') {
      i++;
      while (i < spec.length && /\s/.test(spec[i])) i++;
      let formatCmd = '';
      if (spec[i] === '{') {
        const braced = extractBalancedBracedGroup(spec, i);
        if (braced) {
          formatCmd = braced.content;
          i = braced.endIndex;
        } else {
          i++;
        }
      }
      while (i < spec.length && /\s/.test(spec[i])) i++;

      let alignOverride: 'left' | 'center' | 'right' | undefined;
      if (/centering|Centering/i.test(formatCmd)) alignOverride = 'center';
      else if (/raggedleft/i.test(formatCmd)) alignOverride = 'right';
      else if (/raggedright/i.test(formatCmd)) alignOverride = 'left';

      if (i < spec.length) {
        const nextCol = spec[i];
        if (nextCol === 'X') {
          cols.push({
            align: alignOverride || 'left',
            isX: true,
            borderLeft: pendingBorderLeft,
          });
          pendingBorderLeft = false;
          i++;
        } else if (nextCol === 'c' || nextCol === 'l' || nextCol === 'r') {
          cols.push({
            align: alignOverride || (nextCol === 'c' ? 'center' : nextCol === 'r' ? 'right' : 'left'),
            borderLeft: pendingBorderLeft,
          });
          pendingBorderLeft = false;
          i++;
        } else if (nextCol === 'p' || nextCol === 'm' || nextCol === 'b') {
          i++;
          while (i < spec.length && /\s/.test(spec[i])) i++;
          let widthStr = '';
          if (spec[i] === '{') {
            const braced = extractBalancedBracedGroup(spec, i);
            if (braced) {
              widthStr = braced.content;
              i = braced.endIndex;
            } else {
              i++;
            }
          }
          const cssWidth = widthStr ? parseLatexDimensionToCss(widthStr) : undefined;
          cols.push({
            align: alignOverride || (nextCol === 'p' ? 'left' : 'center'),
            width: cssWidth,
            borderLeft: pendingBorderLeft,
          });
          pendingBorderLeft = false;
        }
      }
    } else if (ch === '@' || ch === '!') {
      i++;
      while (i < spec.length && /\s/.test(spec[i])) i++;
      if (spec[i] === '{') {
        const braced = extractBalancedBracedGroup(spec, i);
        if (braced) i = braced.endIndex;
        else i++;
      }
    } else if (ch === 'S') {
      cols.push({ align: 'right', borderLeft: pendingBorderLeft });
      pendingBorderLeft = false;
      i++;
    } else {
      i++;
    }
  }

  if (pendingBorderLeft && cols.length > 0) {
    cols[cols.length - 1].borderRight = true;
  }

  return cols.length > 0 ? cols : [{ align: 'left' }];
}

export function splitLatexRowCells(rowText: string): string[] {
  const cells: string[] = [];
  let current = '';
  let braceDepth = 0;
  let inMath = false;

  for (let i = 0; i < rowText.length; i++) {
    const ch = rowText[i];
    const prev = i > 0 ? rowText[i - 1] : '';

    if (ch === '$' && prev !== '\\') {
      inMath = !inMath;
      current += ch;
    } else if (ch === '{' && prev !== '\\' && !inMath) {
      braceDepth++;
      current += ch;
    } else if (ch === '}' && prev !== '\\' && !inMath) {
      if (braceDepth > 0) braceDepth--;
      current += ch;
    } else if (ch === '&' && prev !== '\\' && braceDepth === 0 && !inMath) {
      cells.push(current.trim());
      current = '';
    } else {
      current += ch;
    }
  }
  cells.push(current.trim());
  return cells;
}

export interface TocEntry {
  title: string;
  level: number;
  line: number;
  num: string;
}

/**
 * Extracts structured Table of Contents entries (data only, never HTML strings).
 */
export function generateTableOfContents(code: string, _rawLines?: string[]): TocEntry[] {
  const shielded = shieldVerbatimBlocks(code);
  const lines = shielded.split('\n');
  const origLines = code.split('\n');
  const items: TocEntry[] = [];

  let secNum = 0;
  let subNum = 0;
  let subSubNum = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    const l = lines[i];
    const match = l.match(/\\(section|subsection|subsubsection)(\*?)\s*\{/);
    if (match && match.index !== undefined) {
      const braceStart = match.index + match[0].length - 1;
      const braced = extractBalancedBracedGroup(origLines[i], braceStart);
      if (braced) {
        const type = match[1];
        const isStarred = match[2] === '*';
        const title = cleanLatexInline(braced.content).trim();
        let num = '';

        if (type === 'section') {
          if (!isStarred) {
            secNum++;
            subNum = 0;
            subSubNum = 0;
            num = `${secNum}.`;
          }
          items.push({ title, level: 1, line: i + 1, num });
        } else if (type === 'subsection') {
          if (!isStarred) {
            subNum++;
            subSubNum = 0;
            num = `${secNum}.${subNum}`;
          }
          items.push({ title, level: 2, line: i + 1, num });
        } else if (type === 'subsubsection') {
          if (!isStarred) {
            subSubNum++;
            num = `${secNum}.${subNum}.${subSubNum}`;
          }
          items.push({ title, level: 3, line: i + 1, num });
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return items;
}

/**
 * High-speed LaTeX Diagnostic Linter
 */
export function diagnoseLatex(code: string): Diagnostic[] {
  const diagnostics: Diagnostic[] = [];
  const shieldedCode = shieldVerbatimBlocks(code);
  const lines = shieldedCode.split('\n');
  const rawLines = code.split('\n');

  const envStack: Array<{ name: string; line: number }> = [];
  const validPreamblePackages = new Set<string>();

  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    const pkgMatch = lines[i].match(/\\usepackage(?:\[.*?\])?\{([^}]+)\}/);
    if (pkgMatch) {
      pkgMatch[1].split(',').forEach(p => validPreamblePackages.add(p.trim()));
    }
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    const lineNum = i + 1;
    const rawLine = rawLines[i];
    const shieldedLine = lines[i];

    const commentIdx = shieldedLine.indexOf('%');
    const hasUnescapedPercent = commentIdx >= 0 && (commentIdx === 0 || shieldedLine[commentIdx - 1] !== '\\');
    const effectiveLine = hasUnescapedPercent ? shieldedLine.substring(0, commentIdx) : shieldedLine;

    if (effectiveLine.includes('tablular')) {
      diagnostics.push({
        id: `typo-tablular-${lineNum}`,
        line: lineNum,
        column: effectiveLine.indexOf('tablular') + 1,
        severity: 'warning',
        message: `Typo in environment name: 'tablular' should be 'tabular'.`,
        rule: 'syntax/typo',
        suggestedFix: {
          title: `Fix typo to 'tabular'`,
          description: `Replaces 'tablular' with 'tabular'.`,
          replacement: rawLine.replace(/tablular/g, 'tabular'),
          startLine: lineNum,
          endLine: lineNum,
        }
      });
    }

    if (/\\tableofcontent(?![sA-Za-z])/.test(effectiveLine)) {
      diagnostics.push({
        id: `typo-tableofcontent-${lineNum}`,
        line: lineNum,
        column: effectiveLine.indexOf('\\tableofcontent') + 1,
        severity: 'info',
        message: `Command '\\tableofcontent' is '\\tableofcontents' (with an 's') in standard LaTeX.`,
        rule: 'syntax/typo',
        suggestedFix: {
          title: `Change to '\\tableofcontents'`,
          description: `Appends 's' to '\\tableofcontent'.`,
          replacement: rawLine.replace(/\\tableofcontent(?![sA-Za-z])/, '\\tableofcontents'),
          startLine: lineNum,
          endLine: lineNum,
        }
      });
    }

    const beginMatches = [...effectiveLine.matchAll(/\\begin\{([a-zA-Z0-9*]+)\}/g)];
    for (const match of beginMatches) {
      let envName = match[1];
      if (envName === 'tablular') envName = 'tabular';
      envStack.push({ name: envName, line: lineNum });
    }

    const endMatches = [...effectiveLine.matchAll(/\\end\{([a-zA-Z0-9*]+)\}/g)];
    for (const match of endMatches) {
      let closingName = match[1];
      if (closingName === 'tablular') closingName = 'tabular';

      if (envStack.length === 0) {
        diagnostics.push({
          id: `unopened-env-${lineNum}-${closingName}`,
          line: lineNum,
          column: (match.index || 0) + 1,
          severity: 'error',
          message: `Closing environment '\\end{${closingName}}' has no matching '\\begin{${closingName}}'.`,
          rule: 'syntax/unmatched-environment',
          rawLog: `! LaTeX Error: \\begin{${closingName}} on input line ${lineNum} ended by \\end{${closingName}}.`,
          suggestedFix: {
            title: `Remove extra \\end{${closingName}}`,
            description: `Removes the orphaned closing tag on line ${lineNum}.`,
            replacement: rawLine.replace(`\\end{${match[1]}}`, ''),
            startLine: lineNum,
            endLine: lineNum,
          }
        });
      } else {
        const last = envStack[envStack.length - 1];
        if (last.name === closingName) {
          envStack.pop();
        } else {
          diagnostics.push({
            id: `mismatched-env-${lineNum}-${closingName}`,
            line: lineNum,
            column: (match.index || 0) + 1,
            severity: 'error',
            message: `Mismatched environment: expected '\\end{${last.name}}' (opened on line ${last.line}), but found '\\end{${closingName}}'.`,
            rule: 'syntax/mismatched-environment',
            rawLog: `! LaTeX Error: \\begin{${last.name}} on input line ${last.line} ended by \\end{${closingName}}.`,
            suggestedFix: {
              title: `Change to \\end{${last.name}}`,
              description: `Corrects closing environment tag to match line ${last.line}.`,
              replacement: rawLine.replace(`\\end{${match[1]}}`, `\\end{${last.name}}`),
              startLine: lineNum,
              endLine: lineNum,
            }
          });
          envStack.pop();
        }
      }
    }

    const percentMistakeMatch = effectiveLine.match(/(\d+)(%)(?!\w)/);
    if (percentMistakeMatch && percentMistakeMatch.index !== undefined) {
      const idx = percentMistakeMatch.index + percentMistakeMatch[1].length;
      if (idx === 0 || effectiveLine[idx - 1] !== '\\') {
        diagnostics.push({
          id: `unescaped-percent-${lineNum}`,
          line: lineNum,
          column: idx + 1,
          severity: 'warning',
          message: `Unescaped '%' treated as comment. Use '\\%' to display a percentage symbol.`,
          rule: 'syntax/unescaped-special-char',
          rawLog: `LaTeX Warning: '%' character interpreted as comment start on line ${lineNum}.`,
          suggestedFix: {
            title: `Escape percentage symbol (\\%)`,
            description: `Replaces '${percentMistakeMatch[1]}%' with '${percentMistakeMatch[1]}\\%'.`,
            replacement: rawLine.replace(/(\d+)%/, '$1\\%'),
            startLine: lineNum,
            endLine: lineNum,
          }
        });
      }
    }

    const dollarCount = (effectiveLine.match(/(?<!\\)\$/g) || []).length;
    if (dollarCount % 2 !== 0) {
      diagnostics.push({
        id: `unclosed-inline-math-${lineNum}`,
        line: lineNum,
        column: effectiveLine.lastIndexOf('$') + 1,
        severity: 'warning',
        message: `Mismatched inline math delimiter '$'. Odd number of '$' on this line.`,
        rule: 'syntax/unclosed-math',
        rawLog: `! Missing $ inserted on line ${lineNum}.`,
        suggestedFix: {
          title: `Append closing '$'`,
          description: `Adds closing math delimiter to line ${lineNum}.`,
          replacement: rawLine + '$',
          startLine: lineNum,
          endLine: lineNum,
        }
      });
    }

    if (effectiveLine.includes('\\includegraphics') && !validPreamblePackages.has('graphicx')) {
      diagnostics.push({
        id: `missing-graphicx-${lineNum}`,
        line: lineNum,
        column: effectiveLine.indexOf('\\includegraphics') + 1,
        severity: 'error',
        message: `Command '\\includegraphics' requires '\\usepackage{graphicx}' in preamble.`,
        rule: 'package/missing-dependency',
        rawLog: `! Undefined control sequence \\includegraphics on line ${lineNum}.`,
        suggestedFix: {
          title: `Add \\usepackage{graphicx}`,
          description: `Inserts package declaration in preamble.`,
          replacement: `\\usepackage{graphicx}\n` + rawLines[0],
          startLine: 1,
          endLine: 1,
        }
      });
    }

    if (effectiveLine.includes('\\cite{}')) {
      diagnostics.push({
        id: `empty-cite-${lineNum}`,
        line: lineNum,
        column: effectiveLine.indexOf('\\cite{}') + 1,
        severity: 'warning',
        message: `Empty citation reference '\\cite{}'. Specify a bibliography key.`,
        rule: 'bib/empty-reference',
      });
    }
  }

  while (envStack.length > 0) {
    const unclosed = envStack.pop()!;
    diagnostics.push({
      id: `unclosed-env-${unclosed.line}-${unclosed.name}`,
      line: unclosed.line,
      column: 1,
      severity: 'error',
      message: `Environment '\\begin{${unclosed.name}}' opened on line ${unclosed.line} is never closed.`,
      rule: 'syntax/unclosed-environment',
      rawLog: `! LaTeX Error: \\begin{${unclosed.name}} on input line ${unclosed.line} ended by \\end{document}.`,
      suggestedFix: {
        title: `Insert \\end{${unclosed.name}} at end`,
        description: `Appends closing tag '\\end{${unclosed.name}}' to the document.`,
        replacement: `${code.trimEnd()}\n\\end{${unclosed.name}}\n`,
        startLine: rawLines.length,
        endLine: rawLines.length,
      }
    });
  }

  return diagnostics;
}

/**
 * Structural Parser: Extracts Title, Authors, Abstract, Sections, Math, Citations, and Layout metadata.
 */
export function parseLatexDocument(code: string, files?: ProjectFile[]): ParsedDocument {
  const expandedCode = expandTransclusions(code, files);
  const shieldedCode = shieldVerbatimBlocks(expandedCode);
  const lines = shieldedCode.split('\n');
  const originalLines = expandedCode.split('\n');

  let title = 'Untitled Document';
  const authors: string[] = [];
  let date = '';
  let abstract = '';
  let documentClass = 'article';
  let isTwoColumn = false;

  const docClassMatch = expandedCode.match(/\\documentclass(?:\[(.*?)\])?\{([a-zA-Z0-9]+)\}/);
  if (docClassMatch) {
    documentClass = docClassMatch[2];
    if (docClassMatch[1] && docClassMatch[1].includes('twocolumn')) {
      isTwoColumn = true;
    }
  }

  const titleMacro = extractMacroWithBracedArg(shieldedCode, 'title');
  if (titleMacro) {
    const rawBraced = extractBalancedBracedGroup(expandedCode, expandedCode.indexOf('{', titleMacro.startIndex));
    title = cleanLatexInline(rawBraced ? rawBraced.content : titleMacro.content);
  }

  const titlePageMatch = expandedCode.match(/\\begin\{(?:titlepage|title)\}([\s\S]*?)\\end\{(?:titlepage|title)\}/);
  let hasTitlePage = false;
  let titlePageContent = '';
  if (titlePageMatch) {
    hasTitlePage = true;
    titlePageContent = titlePageMatch[1];
    if (title === 'Untitled Document') {
      const hugeMatch = titlePageContent.match(/\\(?:Huge|huge|LARGE|Large)\{?([^}\n\\]+)\}?/);
      const boldMatch = titlePageContent.match(/\\textbf\{([^}]+)\}/);
      if (hugeMatch) {
        title = cleanLatexInline(hugeMatch[1]).trim();
      } else if (boldMatch) {
        title = cleanLatexInline(boldMatch[1]).trim();
      } else {
        const line = titlePageContent.split('\n').map(l => cleanLatexInline(l).trim()).find(l => l.length > 3 && !l.startsWith('\\'));
        if (line) title = line;
      }
    }
  }

  const authorMacro = extractMacroWithBracedArg(shieldedCode, 'author');
  if (authorMacro) {
    const rawBraced = extractBalancedBracedGroup(expandedCode, expandedCode.indexOf('{', authorMacro.startIndex));
    const rawAuthorContent = rawBraced ? rawBraced.content : authorMacro.content;
    const rawAuthors = rawAuthorContent.split(/\\and|\s*,\s*/);
    for (const a of rawAuthors) {
      const cleaned = cleanLatexInline(a).trim();
      if (cleaned) authors.push(cleaned);
    }
  }

  const dateMacro = extractMacroWithBracedArg(shieldedCode, 'date');
  if (dateMacro) {
    const rawBraced = extractBalancedBracedGroup(expandedCode, expandedCode.indexOf('{', dateMacro.startIndex));
    date = cleanLatexInline(rawBraced ? rawBraced.content : dateMacro.content);
  }

  const abstractMatch = expandedCode.match(/\\begin\{abstract\}([\s\S]*?)\\end\{abstract\}/);
  if (abstractMatch) {
    abstract = cleanLatexInline(abstractMatch[1].trim());
  }

  let titleLine = 1;
  let authorLine = 1;
  let dateLine = 1;
  let abstractLine = 1;

  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    const l = lines[i];
    if ((l.includes('\\title{') || l.includes('\\begin{titlepage}') || l.includes('\\begin{title}')) && titleLine === 1) titleLine = i + 1;
    if (l.includes('\\author{') && authorLine === 1) authorLine = i + 1;
    if (l.includes('\\date{') && dateLine === 1) dateLine = i + 1;
    if (l.includes('\\begin{abstract}') && abstractLine === 1) abstractLine = i + 1;
  }

  const sections: ParsedDocument['sections'] = [];
  const mathBlocks: ParsedDocument['mathBlocks'] = [];
  const citations: string[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    const lineNum = i + 1;
    const line = lines[i];

    const secMatch = line.match(/\\(section|subsection|subsubsection)(\*?)\s*\{/);
    if (secMatch && secMatch.index !== undefined) {
      const braceStart = secMatch.index + secMatch[0].length - 1;
      const braced = extractBalancedBracedGroup(originalLines[i], braceStart);
      if (braced) {
        const level = secMatch[1] === 'section' ? 1 : secMatch[1] === 'subsection' ? 2 : 3;
        sections.push({
          title: cleanLatexInline(braced.content),
          level,
          content: '',
          line: lineNum,
        });
      }
    }

    const eqMatch = line.match(/\\begin\{(?:equation|align|gather|multline)\*?\}([\s\S]*?)\\end\{(?:equation|align|gather|multline)\*?\}/) || line.match(/\\\[([\s\S]*?)\\\]/);
    if (eqMatch) {
      mathBlocks.push({
        latex: eqMatch[1].trim(),
        display: true,
        line: lineNum,
      });
    }

    const citeMatches = line.matchAll(/\\(?:cite|citep|citet|citealp|citealt)\{([^}]+)\}/g);
    for (const cm of citeMatches) {
      if (cm[1]) {
        for (const k of cm[1].split(',')) {
          const key = k.trim();
          if (key && !citations.includes(key)) {
            citations.push(key);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return {
    title,
    authors: authors.length ? authors : [],
    date: date || '',
    abstract,
    titleLine,
    authorLine,
    dateLine,
    abstractLine,
    sections,
    mathBlocks,
    citations,
    isTwoColumn,
    documentClass,
    hasTitlePage,
    titlePageContent,
    hasParskip: /\\usepackage(?:\s*\[[^\]]*\])?\s*\{parskip\}/i.test(expandedCode) || /\\setlength\s*\{\s*\\parindent\s*\}\s*\{\s*0(?:pt|mm|cm|in|px)?\s*\}/i.test(expandedCode),
  };
}

export function cleanLatexInline(text: string): string {
  let cleaned = text;

  // Protect inline math from having backslashes stripped
  const mathSegments: string[] = [];
  cleaned = cleaned.replace(/\$[^$]+\$/g, (m) => {
    mathSegments.push(m);
    return `__MATH_SEGMENT_${mathSegments.length - 1}__`;
  });

  const formatMacros = ['textbf', 'textit', 'texttt', 'textsc', 'textsf', 'emph', 'underline'];
  let changed = true;
  let iterations = 0;
  while (changed && iterations < 8) {
    changed = false;
    iterations++;
    for (const macro of formatMacros) {
      const found = extractMacroWithBracedArg(cleaned, macro);
      if (found) {
        cleaned = cleaned.substring(0, found.startIndex) + found.content + cleaned.substring(found.endIndex);
        changed = true;
      }
    }
  }

  cleaned = cleaned
    .replace(/\\(?:indent|noindent)\b/g, '')
    .replace(/\\(?:vspace|hspace)\*?\{[^}]+\}/g, '')
    .replace(/\\(?:bigskip|medskip|smallskip|vfill|hfill|quad|qquad|enspace|thinspace)\b/g, '')
    .replace(/\\\\/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\\/g, '')
    .trim();

  // Restore inline math
  cleaned = cleaned.replace(/__MATH_SEGMENT_(\d+)__/g, (_, idx) => {
    return mathSegments[parseInt(idx, 10)] || '';
  });

  return cleaned;
}

const labelFileCache = new Map<string, { content: string; labels: LatexLabel[] }>();

export function extractLatexLabelsForFile(file: ProjectFile): LatexLabel[] {
  if (!file.content) return [];
  const fileKey = file.id || file.name;
  const cached = labelFileCache.get(fileKey);
  if (cached && cached.content === file.content) {
    return cached.labels;
  }

  const fileLabels: LatexLabel[] = [];
  const shielded = shieldVerbatimBlocks(file.content);
  const lines = shielded.split('\n');
  const origLines = file.content.split('\n');

  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    const lineText = lines[i];
    const match = lineText.match(/\\label\s*\{/);
    if (match && match.index !== undefined) {
      const braceStart = match.index + match[0].length - 1;
      const braced = extractBalancedBracedGroup(origLines[i], braceStart);
      if (braced) {
        const key = braced.content.trim();
        let type: LatexLabel['type'] = 'other';
        if (key.startsWith('sec:') || key.startsWith('subsec:')) type = 'section';
        else if (key.startsWith('fig:')) type = 'figure';
        else if (key.startsWith('tab:')) type = 'table';
        else if (key.startsWith('eq:')) type = 'equation';
        else if (key.startsWith('thm:') || key.startsWith('lem:') || key.startsWith('def:')) type = 'theorem';
        else if (key.startsWith('alg:')) type = 'algorithm';

        let caption = '';
        const start = Math.max(0, i - 3);
        const end = Math.min(origLines.length - 1, i + 3);
        for (let j = start; j <= end; j++) {
          const capMatch = origLines[j].match(/\\caption\s*\{/) || origLines[j].match(/\\(?:section|subsection)\*?\s*\{/);
          if (capMatch && capMatch.index !== undefined) {
            const capBraceStart = capMatch.index + capMatch[0].length - 1;
            const capBraced = extractBalancedBracedGroup(origLines[j], capBraceStart);
            if (capBraced) {
              caption = cleanLatexInline(capBraced.content);
              break;
            }
          }
        }

        fileLabels.push({
          key,
          type,
          caption: caption || undefined,
          line: i + 1,
          fileName: file.name,
        });
      }
    }
  }

  labelFileCache.set(fileKey, { content: file.content, labels: fileLabels });
  return fileLabels;
}

export function extractLatexLabels(files: ProjectFile[]): LatexLabel[] {
  const labels: LatexLabel[] = [];
  for (const file of files) {
    const fileLabels = extractLatexLabelsForFile(file);
    for (let k = 0; k < fileLabels.length; k++) {
      labels.push(fileLabels[k]);
    }
  }
  return labels;
}

  const [isProjectDropdownOpen, setIsProjectDropdownOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isExportDropdownOpen, setIsExportDropdownOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isToolsDropdownOpen, setIsToolsDropdownOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isUserDropdownOpen, setIsUserDropdownOpen] = useState(false);

  const projectDropdownRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const exportDropdownRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const toolsDropdownRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const userDropdownRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Close dropdowns on outside click
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (projectDropdownRef.current && !projectDropdownRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setIsProjectDropdownOpen(false);
      }
      if (exportDropdownRef.current && !exportDropdownRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setIsExportDropdownOpen(false);
      }
      if (toolsDropdownRef.current && !toolsDropdownRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setIsToolsDropdownOpen(false);
      }
      if (userDropdownRef.current && !userDropdownRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setIsUserDropdownOpen(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  const formatCompileDuration = (ms?: number | null): string => {
    if (ms === undefined || ms === null) return '';
    if (ms < 1000) return `${ms}ms`;
    return `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(1)}s`;
  };

  const getRoleIcon = (role: ProjectRole) => {
    switch (role) {
      case 'owner': return <Shield size={11} color="#38bdf8" />;
      case 'editor': return <Edit3 size={11} color="#10b981" />;
      case 'viewer': return <Eye size={11} color="#f59e0b" />;
    }
  };

  const getRoleBadgeClass = (role: ProjectRole) => {
    switch (role) {
      case 'owner': return 'badge-cyan';
      case 'editor': return 'badge-emerald';
      case 'viewer': return '';
    }
  };

  return (
    <header style={navStyle} className="app-navbar">
      {/* CLUSTER 1 (LEFT): Brand & Unified Project Scope */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 7, flexShrink: 0 }}>
        {/* Logo */}
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
          <div style={logoMarkStyle}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 900, color: '#000' }}>Tx</span>
          </div>
          <span style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 13.5, letterSpacing: '-0.02em', color: 'var(--text-primary)', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
            TEEEX<span style={{ color: '#38bdf8' }}>.</span>
          </span>
        </div>

        <div style={{ width: 1, height: 16, backgroundColor: 'var(--border-subtle)', margin: '0 2px' }} />

        {/* Unified Project Pill: Folder Icon + Title Input + Dropdown Trigger */}
        <div ref={projectDropdownRef} style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <div style={projectTitlePillStyle}>
            <FolderKanban size={13} color="#38bdf8" style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={projectTitle}
              readOnly={currentRole === 'viewer'}
              onChange={e => onTitleChange(e.target.value)}
              style={{
                ...cleanTitleInputStyle,
                opacity: currentRole === 'viewer' ? 0.8 : 1,
                cursor: currentRole === 'viewer' ? 'default' : 'text',
              }}
              placeholder="Untitled Document"
              title="Click to rename document"
            />
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setIsProjectDropdownOpen(prev => !prev)}
              style={chevronDropdownBtnStyle}
              title="Switch workspace project"
            >
              <ChevronDown size={11} color="var(--text-muted)" />
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Project Switcher Dropdown Menu */}
          {isProjectDropdownOpen && (
            <div style={dropdownMenuStyle}>
              <div style={{ padding: '8px 12px', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)', display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text-muted)', letterSpacing: '0.04em' }}>
                  WORKSPACE PROJECTS ({projects.length})
                </span>
                <button
                  onClick={() => { setIsProjectDropdownOpen(false); onOpenProjectsHub(); }}
                  style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: '#38bdf8', fontSize: 10.5, cursor: 'pointer', padding: 0, fontWeight: 600 }}
                >
                  <Plus size={10} style={{ display: 'inline', marginRight: 2 }} /> New
                </button>
              </div>

              <div style={{ maxHeight: 220, overflowY: 'auto', padding: '4px 0' }}>
                {projects.map(proj => {
                  const isActive = proj.id === activeProjectId;
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={proj.id}
                      onClick={() => {
                        onSelectProject(proj.id);
                        setIsProjectDropdownOpen(false);
                      }}
                      style={{
                        ...dropdownItemStyle,
                        backgroundColor: isActive ? 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.08)' : 'transparent',
                        fontWeight: isActive ? 600 : 400,
                      }}
                    >
                      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
                        <span style={{ width: 6, height: 6, borderRadius: '50%', backgroundColor: isActive ? '#38bdf8' : 'transparent', flexShrink: 0 }} />
                        <span style={{ textOverflow: 'ellipsis', overflow: 'hidden', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', fontSize: 12 }}>
                          {proj.title}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      {(() => {
                        const itemRole = resolveUserProjectRole(proj, currentUser);
                        return (
                          <span className={`badge ${getRoleBadgeClass(itemRole)}`} style={{ fontSize: 9.5, padding: '1px 5px', flexShrink: 0 }}>
                            {itemRole}
                          </span>
                        );
                      })()}
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>

              <div style={{ padding: '6px 8px', borderTop: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-surface-0)' }}>
                <button
                  onClick={() => { setIsProjectDropdownOpen(false); onOpenProjectsHub(); }}
                  style={dropdownFooterBtnStyle}
                >
                  <FolderKanban size={12} color="#38bdf8" />
                  <span>Open Multi-Project Hub...</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Compact Role Badge */}
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, padding: '2px 7px', borderRadius: 9999, backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-surface-1)', border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)', fontSize: 10.5, whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
          {getRoleIcon(currentRole)}
          <span style={{
            fontWeight: 600,
            color: currentRole === 'owner' ? '#38bdf8' : currentRole === 'editor' ? '#10b981' : '#f59e0b',
            textTransform: 'capitalize'
          }}>
            {currentRole === 'owner' ? 'Host' : currentRole}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* CLUSTER 2 (CENTER): Compilation, Mode & Unified Health */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, flexShrink: 0 }}>
        {currentRole !== 'viewer' ? (
          <div style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
            <button
              onClick={onCompile}
              className="btn-primary"
              style={{ padding: '4px 10px', fontSize: 11.5, display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5, whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}
              title="Recompile LaTeX Document (Ctrl+Enter)"
            >
              {compileState.status === 'compiling' ? (
                <Loader2 size={12} style={{ animation: 'spin 1s linear infinite' }} />
              ) : (
                <Play size={11} fill="currentColor" />
              )}
              <span>Compile</span>
              <span style={shortcutKbdStyle}>Ctrl+↵</span>
            </button>

            {/* Compile Mode Switcher Capsule (⚡ Fast vs 💎 Final) */}
            {onToggleCompileMode && (
              <div
                style={{
                  display: 'inline-flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  background: 'var(--bg-tertiary, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05))',
                  border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1))',
                  borderRadius: 6,
                  padding: 2,
                  gap: 2,
                }}
                role="group"
                aria-label="LaTeX compilation mode"
              >
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onToggleCompileMode('fast')}
                  style={{
                    padding: '2px 6px',
                    borderRadius: 4,
                    border: 'none',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    display: 'inline-flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    gap: 3,
                    fontSize: 10,
                    fontWeight: compileMode === 'fast' ? 600 : 400,
                    background: compileMode === 'fast' ? 'var(--primary-color, #2563eb)' : 'transparent',
                    color: compileMode === 'fast' ? '#ffffff' : 'var(--text-muted, #94a3b8)',
                    transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
                  }}
                  title="Fast Mode: Instant pass-1 streaming, cached auxiliary artifacts"
                >
                  ⚡ <span className="nav-mode-label">Fast</span>
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onToggleCompileMode('publication')}
                  style={{
                    padding: '2px 6px',
                    borderRadius: 4,
                    border: 'none',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    display: 'inline-flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    gap: 3,
                    fontSize: 10,
                    fontWeight: compileMode === 'publication' ? 600 : 400,
                    background: compileMode === 'publication' ? 'var(--primary-color, #2563eb)' : 'transparent',
                    color: compileMode === 'publication' ? '#ffffff' : 'var(--text-muted, #94a3b8)',
                    transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
                  }}
                  title="Publication Mode: Full multi-pass convergence, bibtex run"
                >
                  💎 <span className="nav-mode-label">Final</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* TeX Engine Selector Capsule */}
            {onSelectEngine && (
              <div
                style={{
                  display: 'inline-flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  background: 'var(--bg-tertiary, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05))',
                  border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1))',
                  borderRadius: 6,
                  padding: '2px 4px',
                }}
              >
                <select
                  value={selectedEngine}
                  onChange={(e) => onSelectEngine(e.target.value as EngineId)}
                  style={{
                    background: 'transparent',
                    border: 'none',
                    color: 'var(--text-secondary, #cbd5e1)',
                    fontSize: 10,
                    fontWeight: 600,
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    outline: 'none',
                    fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono, monospace)',
                    padding: '1px 2px',
                  }}
                  title="TeX Compilation Engine"
                  aria-label="Select TeX compilation engine"
                >
                  <option value="pdflatex" style={{ background: 'var(--bg-surface-0, #0d1017)', color: '#f1f5f9' }}>pdfLaTeX</option>
                  <option value="xelatex" style={{ background: 'var(--bg-surface-0, #0d1017)', color: '#f1f5f9' }}>XeLaTeX</option>
                  <option value="lualatex" style={{ background: 'var(--bg-surface-0, #0d1017)', color: '#f1f5f9' }}>LuaLaTeX</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5, padding: '4px 8px', borderRadius: 'var(--radius-sm)', backgroundColor: 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.1)', border: '1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.25)', fontSize: 11, color: '#f59e0b', fontWeight: 600, whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
            <Eye size={11} /> Read-Only
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Unified Live Status Pill */}
        <div style={statusPillStyle}>
          {compileState.status === 'compiling' ? (
            <>
              <Loader2 size={11} color="#38bdf8" style={{ animation: 'spin 1s linear infinite' }} />
              <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>Compiling...</span>
            </>
          ) : compileState.isDebouncing ? (
            <>
              <span className="pulse-dot" />
              <span style={{ color: '#38bdf8', fontWeight: 600 }}>Queued</span>
            </>
          ) : compileState.status === 'error' ? (
            <>
              <XCircle size={12} color="#f43f5e" />
              <span style={{ color: '#f43f5e', fontWeight: 600 }}>{compileState.errorCount} Error{compileState.errorCount > 1 ? 's' : ''}</span>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div style={liveRadarDotStyle} />
              <span style={{ color: '#10b981', fontWeight: 600 }}>Live</span>
              {(compileState.pdfDurationMs || compileState.durationMs) ? (
                <span
                  style={{
                    color: 'var(--text-muted)',
                    fontSize: 10,
                    fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)',
                    letterSpacing: '-0.02em',
                  }}
                  title={
                    compileState.pdfDurationMs
                      ? `Live draft: ${compileState.durationMs}ms | Engine pass: ${compileState.pdfDurationMs}ms`
                      : `Live compilation & render: ${compileState.durationMs}ms`
                  }
                >
                  ({formatCompileDuration(compileState.pdfDurationMs || compileState.durationMs)})
                </span>
              ) : null}
            </>
          )}

          {compileState.warningCount > 0 && compileState.status !== 'error' && (
            <span style={{ color: '#f59e0b', fontSize: 10.5, display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 2, marginLeft: 2 }} title={`${compileState.warningCount} warnings`}>
              <AlertTriangle size={10} /> {compileState.warningCount}
            </span>
          )}

          {/* Cloud Sync indicator */}
          {isCloudConnected && (
            <span title="Cloud synchronized" style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', marginLeft: 2, color: '#10b981' }}>
              <Cloud size={11} />
            </span>
          )}

          {/* Offline indicator */}
          {isOffline && (
            <span title="Working offline" style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', marginLeft: 2, color: '#f59e0b' }}>
              <WifiOff size={11} />
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* TeX Live WebAssembly Engine Warmup Capsule */}
        {engineStatus && (
          <EngineWarmupBadge status={engineStatus} isOffline={isOffline} compact={true} />
        )}

        {/* Command Palette Trigger Pill (Cmd+K / Ctrl+K) */}
        {onOpenCommandPalette && (
          <button
            onClick={onOpenCommandPalette}
            className="btn-ghost"
            style={{
              display: 'inline-flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              gap: 4,
              padding: '3px 7px',
              borderRadius: 5,
              fontSize: 11,
              color: 'var(--text-secondary)',
              border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)',
              backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-surface-1)',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
            }}
            title="Open Universal Command Palette (Ctrl+K / ⌘K)"
          >
            <Search size={11} color="var(--text-muted)" />
            <span className="nav-cmd-label" style={{ fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: 500 }}>Commands</span>
            <kbd
              style={{
                fontSize: 9,
                fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)',
                padding: '1px 3px',
                borderRadius: 3,
                backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-surface-2)',
                border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)',
                color: 'var(--text-muted)',
                lineHeight: 1,
              }}
            >
              ⌘K
            </kbd>
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* CLUSTER 3 (RIGHT): Collaboration, Consolidated Export, Tools & Account */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, flexShrink: 0 }}>
        {/* Share Button / Co-authors */}
        <button
          onClick={onOpenShare}
          style={presenceButtonStyle}
          title="Share project & invite collaborators"
        >
          <Share2 size={12} color="#38bdf8" />
          <span className="nav-btn-label" style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 500, color: 'var(--text-primary)', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>Share</span>
          {peers.length > 0 && (
            <span className="badge badge-cyan" style={{ fontSize: 9, padding: '0 4px', marginLeft: 2 }}>
              {peers.length + 1}
            </span>
          )}
        </button>

        {/* Consolidated Export Dropdown (PDF & ZIP) */}
        <div ref={exportDropdownRef} style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
          <button
            onClick={() => setIsExportDropdownOpen(prev => !prev)}
            className="btn-secondary"
            style={{ ...compactBtnStyle, padding: '4px 8px', gap: 4 }}
            title="Export manuscript or source bundle"
          >
            <Download size={11} />
            <span className="nav-btn-label">Export</span>
            <ChevronDown size={10} color="var(--text-muted)" />
          </button>

          {isExportDropdownOpen && (
            <div style={{ ...dropdownMenuStyle, width: 200, right: 0 }}>
              <div style={{ padding: '6px 12px', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)', fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text-muted)', letterSpacing: '0.04em' }}>
                EXPORT MANUSCRIPT
              </div>
              <div style={{ padding: '4px 0' }}>
                <button
                  onClick={() => { setIsExportDropdownOpen(false); onExportPdf(); }}
                  style={dropdownItemStyle}
                  title="Download compiled PDF document"
                >
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                    <Download size={13} color="#38bdf8" />
                    <div>
                      <div style={{ fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: 600 }}>PDF Document</div>
                      <div style={{ fontSize: 9.5, color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>Compiled vector output (.pdf)</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => { setIsExportDropdownOpen(false); onExportZip(); }}
                  style={dropdownItemStyle}
                  title="Download LaTeX source package as ZIP"
                >
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                    <FolderArchive size={13} color="#10b981" />
                    <div>
                      <div style={{ fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: 600 }}>LaTeX Source (.zip)</div>
                      <div style={{ fontSize: 9.5, color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>Complete project bundle</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Consolidated Tools & Insert Dropdown */}
        <div ref={toolsDropdownRef} style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
          <button
            onClick={() => setIsToolsDropdownOpen(prev => !prev)}
            className="btn-ghost"
            style={{ ...toolBtnStyle, padding: '4px 8px', gap: 4 }}
            title="Insert figures, tables, formulas, or browse templates"
          >
            <Plus size={12} color="#38bdf8" />
            <span className="nav-btn-label">Tools</span>
            <ChevronDown size={10} color="var(--text-muted)" />
          </button>

          {isToolsDropdownOpen && (
            <div style={{ ...dropdownMenuStyle, width: 220, right: 0 }}>
              <div style={{ padding: '6px 12px', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)', fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text-muted)', letterSpacing: '0.04em' }}>
                INSERT &amp; TEMPLATES
              </div>
              <div style={{ padding: '4px 0' }}>
                {currentRole !== 'viewer' && (
                  <>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => { setIsToolsDropdownOpen(false); onOpenImageUpload(); }}
                      style={dropdownItemStyle}
                    >
                      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                        <ImageIcon size={13} color="#38bdf8" />
                        <span>Figure &amp; Image</span>
                      </div>
                      <span style={{ fontSize: 9.5, color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)' }}>\includegraphics</span>
                    </button>

                    <button
                      onClick={() => { setIsToolsDropdownOpen(false); onOpenTableBuilder(); }}
                      style={dropdownItemStyle}
                    >
                      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                        <Table size={13} color="#10b981" />
                        <span>Table Builder</span>
                      </div>
                      <span style={{ fontSize: 9.5, color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)' }}>\tabular</span>
                    </button>

                    <button
                      onClick={() => { setIsToolsDropdownOpen(false); onOpenSymbols(); }}
                      style={dropdownItemStyle}
                    >
                      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                        <Hash size={13} color="#a855f7" />
                        <span>Math &amp; Formulas</span>
                      </div>
                      <span style={{ fontSize: 9.5, color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)' }}>\equation</span>
                    </button>
                  </>
                )}

                <button
                  onClick={() => { setIsToolsDropdownOpen(false); onOpenTemplates(); }}
                  style={dropdownItemStyle}
                >
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                    <BookOpen size={13} color="#f59e0b" />
                    <span>Starter Templates</span>
                  </div>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: 9.5, color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>IEEE, Nature...</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* PWA App Install Action */}
        {isInstallable && !isInstalled && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={installApp}
            className="pwa-install-btn"
            title="Install Teeex Desktop App (PWA)"
            aria-label="Install Teeex Desktop App"
          >
            <DownloadCloud size={12} />
            <span className="nav-btn-label">Install</span>
          </button>
        )}

        <div style={{ width: 1, height: 14, backgroundColor: 'var(--border-subtle)', margin: '0 1px' }} />

        {/* Theme Toggle */}
        <button
          onClick={onToggleTheme}
          aria-label="Toggle color theme"
          className="btn-ghost"
          style={{ padding: 4, borderRadius: 'var(--radius-sm)', display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center' }}
          title={`Switch to ${theme === 'dark' ? 'Light' : 'Dark'} mode`}
        >
          {theme === 'dark' ? <Sun size={13} color="#f59e0b" /> : <Moon size={13} color="#38bdf8" />}
        </button>

        {/* Desk Companion (TeXCat) Toggle */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onToggleDeskPet}
          aria-label="Toggle Desk Companion"
          aria-pressed={isDeskPetEnabled}
          className="btn-ghost"
          style={{
            padding: 4,
            borderRadius: 'var(--radius-sm)',
            display: 'inline-flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            backgroundColor: isDeskPetEnabled ? 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12)' : 'transparent',
          }}
          title={`Desk Companion: ${isDeskPetEnabled ? 'Active (Click to disable)' : 'Off (Click to enable)'}`}
        >
          <Cat size={13} color={isDeskPetEnabled ? '#38bdf8' : 'var(--text-muted)'} />
        </button>

        <div style={{ width: 1, height: 14, backgroundColor: 'var(--border-subtle)', margin: '0 1px' }} />

        {/* User Account / Sign In */}
        <div ref={userDropdownRef} style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
          {currentUser ? (
            <button
              onClick={() => setIsUserDropdownOpen(prev => !prev)}
              style={userProfileBtnStyle}
              title={`Signed in as ${currentUser.fullName}`}
            >
              <div style={{ ...avatarMiniStyle, backgroundColor: currentUser.avatarColor || '#38bdf8' }}>
                {currentUser.fullName ? currentUser.fullName.substring(0, 2).toUpperCase() : 'U'}
              </div>
              <ChevronDown size={10} color="var(--text-muted)" />
            </button>
          ) : (
            <button
              onClick={onOpenAuth}
              className="btn-primary"
              style={{ padding: '3px 8px', fontSize: 11, whiteSpace: 'nowrap', display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}
            >
              <User size={11} /> Sign In
            </button>
          )}

          {isUserDropdownOpen && currentUser && (
            <div style={{ ...dropdownMenuStyle, left: 'auto', right: 0, width: 230 }}>
              {/* User Profile Card */}
              <div style={{ padding: '10px 12px', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-surface-0)' }}>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                  {currentUser.fullName}
                </div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 10.5, color: 'var(--text-muted)', wordBreak: 'break-all' }}>
                  {currentUser.email}
                </div>
                <div style={{ marginTop: 4, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>

                  style={{ ...dropdownItemStyle, color: '#f43f5e' }}
                >
                  <LogOut size={12} color="#f43f5e" />
                  <span>Sign Out</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </header>
  );
};
