/**
 * Teeex — PDF preview shell and React structural outline panel.
 */

import { memo, useCallback, useMemo, useState, lazy, Suspense } from 'react';
import { AlertTriangle, BookOpen, FileCode2, FileText, Hash, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import type { LatexLabel, ParsedDocument } from '../types/latex';
import type { SyncTexIndex, ForwardMatch } from '../services/synctex';
import type { EngineStatus } from '../services/latexCompiler';

const PdfPreviewPane = lazy(() =>
  import('./PdfPreviewPane').then((m) => ({ default: m.PdfPreviewPane }))
);

type Surface = 'pdf' | 'outline';

const SURFACE_STORAGE_KEY = 'teeex_preview_surface_v3';

interface Props {
  parsedDoc: ParsedDocument;
  labels?: LatexLabel[];
  documentTitle: string;

  pdf: Uint8Array | null;
  status: EngineStatus;
  isCompiling: boolean;
  isDebouncing?: boolean;
  durationMs?: number | null;
  isStale: boolean;
  rerunRequired?: boolean;
  errorSummary?: string | null;
  onCompile: () => void;

  syncTexIndex?: SyncTexIndex | null;
  forwardTarget?: ForwardMatch | null;
  onInverseSync?: (file: string, line: number) => void;
  onJumpToLine?: (line: number) => void;
}

function readStoredSurface(): Surface {
  try {
    const val = localStorage.getItem(SURFACE_STORAGE_KEY);
    if (val === 'pdf' || val === 'outline') return val;
    return 'pdf';
  } catch {
    return 'pdf';
  }
}

const StructurePanel = memo(function StructurePanel({
  parsedDoc,
  labels,
  onJumpToLine,
}: {
  parsedDoc: ParsedDocument;
  labels: LatexLabel[];
  onJumpToLine?: (line: number) => void;
}) {
  const authorsText = useMemo(
    () => (parsedDoc.authors.length > 0 ? parsedDoc.authors.join(' · ') : ''),
    [parsedDoc.authors],
  );

  const figureAndTableLabels = useMemo(
    () => labels.filter((l) => l.type === 'figure' || l.type === 'table'),
    [labels],
  );

  const otherLabels = useMemo(
    () => labels.filter((l) => l.type !== 'figure' && l.type !== 'table'),
    [labels],
  );

  return (
    <div className="outline-scroll" style={{ padding: '20px 24px', overflowY: 'auto', flex: 1 }}>
      <div className="structure-panel" style={{ maxWidth: 680, margin: '0 auto' }}>
        <header style={{ marginBottom: 20, borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)', paddingBottom: 14 }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 11, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.06em', color: 'var(--text-muted)', marginBottom: 4 }}>
            Document Structure ({parsedDoc.documentClass})
          </div>
          <h2 style={{ fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 700, margin: 0, color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
            {parsedDoc.title || 'Untitled Document'}
          </h2>
          {authorsText && (
            <p style={{ fontSize: 13, color: 'var(--text-secondary)', margin: '4px 0 0 0' }}>
              {authorsText}
            </p>
          )}
        </header>

        {/* Sections */}
        <section style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}>
          <h3 style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.05em', color: 'var(--text-muted)', marginBottom: 8 }}>
            Sections ({parsedDoc.sections.length})
          </h3>
          {parsedDoc.sections.length === 0 ? (
            <p style={{ fontSize: 12.5, color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontStyle: 'italic' }}>
              No sections defined in this document.
            </p>
          ) : (
            <ul style={{ listStyle: 'none', padding: 0, margin: 0, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
              {parsedDoc.sections.map((sec, idx) => (
                <li key={`${sec.line}-${idx}`}>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => onJumpToLine?.(sec.line)}
                    style={{
                      width: '100%',
                      textAlign: 'left',
                      padding: '6px 10px',
                      paddingLeft: 10 + (sec.level - 1) * 16,
                      background: 'var(--bg-surface-1)',
                      border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)',
                      borderRadius: 6,
                      color: 'var(--text-primary)',
                      fontSize: sec.level === 1 ? 13 : 12.5,
                      fontWeight: sec.level === 1 ? 600 : 400,
                      cursor: 'pointer',
                      display: 'flex',
                      justifyContent: 'space-between',
                      alignItems: 'center',
                    }}
                  >
                    <span>{sec.title}</span>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
                      L{sec.line}
                    </span>
                  </button>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
        </section>

        {/* Figures & Tables */}
        {figureAndTableLabels.length > 0 && (
          <section style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}>
            <h3 style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.05em', color: 'var(--text-muted)', marginBottom: 8 }}>
              Figures &amp; Tables ({figureAndTableLabels.length})
            </h3>
            <ul style={{ listStyle: 'none', padding: 0, margin: 0, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
              {figureAndTableLabels.map((lbl) => (
                <li key={`${lbl.fileName}-${lbl.line}-${lbl.key}`}>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => onJumpToLine?.(lbl.line)}
                    style={{
                      width: '100%',
                      textAlign: 'left',
                      padding: '6px 10px',
                      background: 'var(--bg-surface-1)',
                      border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)',
                      borderRadius: 6,
                      color: 'var(--text-primary)',
                      fontSize: 12.5,
                      cursor: 'pointer',
                      display: 'flex',
                      justifyContent: 'space-between',
                      alignItems: 'center',
                      gap: 8,
                    }}
                  >
                    <span>
                      <strong style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 11.5, color: '#38bdf8' }}>{lbl.key}</strong>
                      {lbl.caption ? ` — ${lbl.caption}` : ''}
                    </span>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontFamily: 'monospace', flexShrink: 0 }}>
                      L{lbl.line}
                    </span>
                  </button>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </section>
        )}

        {/* Labels */}
        {otherLabels.length > 0 && (
          <section style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}>
            <h3 style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.05em', color: 'var(--text-muted)', marginBottom: 8, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              <Hash size={12} /> Labels ({otherLabels.length})
            </h3>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 6 }}>
              {otherLabels.map((lbl) => (
                <button
                  key={`${lbl.fileName}-${lbl.line}-${lbl.key}`}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onJumpToLine?.(lbl.line)}
                  style={{
                    padding: '4px 8px',
                    background: 'var(--bg-surface-1)',
                    border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)',
                    borderRadius: 4,
                    color: 'var(--text-secondary)',
                    fontSize: 11.5,
                    fontFamily: 'monospace',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                  }}
                  title={lbl.caption ? `${lbl.caption} (line ${lbl.line})` : `Line ${lbl.line}`}
                >
                  {lbl.key} <span style={{ opacity: 0.6 }}>L{lbl.line}</span>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </section>
        )}

        {/* Citations */}
        {parsedDoc.citations.length > 0 && (
          <section style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}>
            <h3 style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.05em', color: 'var(--text-muted)', marginBottom: 8, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              <BookOpen size={12} /> Citations ({parsedDoc.citations.length})
            </h3>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 6 }}>
              {parsedDoc.citations.map((citeKey) => (
                <span
                  key={citeKey}
                  style={{
                    padding: '3px 8px',
                    background: 'var(--bg-surface-1)',
                    border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)',
                    borderRadius: 4,
                    color: 'var(--text-secondary)',
                    fontSize: 11.5,
                    fontFamily: 'monospace',
                  }}
                >
                  {citeKey}
                </span>
              ))}
            </div>
          </section>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
});

export function PreviewPane({
  parsedDoc,
  labels = [],
  documentTitle,
  pdf,
  status,
  isCompiling,
  isDebouncing = false,
  durationMs,
  isStale,
  rerunRequired = false,
  errorSummary,
  onCompile,
  syncTexIndex,
  forwardTarget,
  onInverseSync,
  onJumpToLine,
}: Props) {
  const [surface, setSurface] = useState<Surface>(readStoredSurface);

  const selectSurface = useCallback((next: Surface) => {
    setSurface(next);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(SURFACE_STORAGE_KEY, next);
    } catch {
      // Ignore storage errors
    }
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="preview-shell">
      <div className="preview-surface-switch" role="tablist" aria-label="Preview surface">
        <button
          type="button"
          role="tab"
          aria-selected={surface === 'pdf'}
          className={`preview-surface-tab${surface === 'pdf' ? ' is-active' : ''}`}
          onClick={() => selectSurface('pdf')}
          title="The compiled document — identical to the exported PDF"
        >
          <FileText size={12} />
          PDF
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          role="tab"
          aria-selected={surface === 'outline'}
          className={`preview-surface-tab${surface === 'outline' ? ' is-active' : ''}`}
          onClick={() => selectSurface('outline')}
          title="Structural outline of sections, labels, figures, tables, and citations"
        >
          <FileCode2 size={12} />
          Structure
        </button>
      </div>

      {rerunRequired && !isCompiling && (
        <div
          role="status"
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: 8,
            padding: '6px 14px',
            fontSize: 12,
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.1)',
            color: '#f59e0b',
            borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.25)',
          }}
        >
          <AlertTriangle size={13} style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} />
          <span>Cross-references may be one pass behind — recompile to settle labels.</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Keep PdfPreviewPane mounted when surface is PDF */}
      <div
        style={{
          display: surface === 'pdf' ? 'flex' : 'none',
          flex: 1,
          flexDirection: 'column',
          overflow: 'hidden',
        }}
      >
        {pdf ? (
          <Suspense
            fallback={
              <div
                style={{
                  flex: 1,
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                  gap: 8,
                  color: 'var(--text-muted)',
                  fontSize: 12,
                }}
              >
                <Loader2 size={18} className="spin" color="#38bdf8" />
                <span>Initializing PDF Viewer…</span>
              </div>
            }
          >
            <PdfPreviewPane
              pdf={pdf}
              status={status}
              isCompiling={isCompiling}
              isDebouncing={isDebouncing}
              durationMs={durationMs}
              isStale={isStale}
              errorSummary={errorSummary}
              documentTitle={documentTitle}
              onCompile={onCompile}
              syncTexIndex={syncTexIndex}
              forwardTarget={forwardTarget}
              onInverseSync={onInverseSync}
            />
          </Suspense>
        ) : (
          <div
            style={{
              flex: 1,
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              gap: 12,
              padding: 24,
              color: 'var(--text-muted)',
              textAlign: 'center',
            }}
          >
            {status.phase === 'fetching' || isCompiling ? (
              <>
                <Loader2 size={22} className="spin" color="#38bdf8" />
                <div style={{ fontSize: 13, color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                  {status.phase === 'fetching'
                    ? `Downloading TeX engine (${Math.round(status.progress)}%)…`
                    : 'Typesetting PDF with pdfLaTeX…'}
                </div>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 13, color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                  {errorSummary || status.error || 'No PDF generated yet.'}
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={onCompile}
                  style={{
                    padding: '6px 12px',
                    borderRadius: 6,
                    border: '1px solid var(--border-medium)',
                    background: 'var(--bg-surface-1)',
                    color: 'var(--text-primary)',
                    fontSize: 12,
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                  }}
                >
                  Compile PDF
                </button>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {surface === 'outline' && (
        <div className="outline-pane" style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', flex: 1, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
          <StructurePanel
            parsedDoc={parsedDoc}
            labels={labels}
            onJumpToLine={onJumpToLine}
          />
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

];

export const BUNDLED_PACKAGE_NAMES = new Set(BUNDLED_PACKAGES.map((p) => p.name));

export interface LoadedPackage {
  name: string;
  format: number;
  content: Uint8Array;
  contents?: Uint8Array;
}

const DB_NAME = 'teeex_packages_db';
const DB_VERSION = 1;
const STORE_PACKAGES = 'packages';
const STORE_MISSES = 'misses';

export const MAX_PACKAGE_SIZE = 8 * 1024 * 1024; // 8 MiB
export const RESOLVE_CONCURRENCY = 8;

/**
 * Sniffs response headers and binary payload to reject HTML error pages (e.g. 404 SPA fallbacks)
 * from poisoning TeX package storage in IndexedDB and memory cache.
 */
export function isHtmlResponse(buf: Uint8Array, contentType?: string | null): boolean {
  if (contentType && contentType.toLowerCase().includes('text/html')) {
    return true;
  }
  if (buf.length >= 5) {
    const head = String.fromCharCode(...buf.subarray(0, Math.min(buf.length, 64))).toLowerCase();
    if (head.includes('<!doctype') || head.includes('<html') || head.includes('<head')) {
      return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

/**
 * Reads a Fetch Response with strict streaming limits.
 * Avoids response.arrayBuffer() on untrusted bodies by:
 * 1. Rejecting advertised Content-Length > maxBytes immediately.
 * 2. Streaming chunks via reader and cancelling immediately if accumulated bytes > maxBytes.
 */
export async function readResponseLimited(
  res: Response,
  maxBytes = MAX_PACKAGE_SIZE,
): Promise<Uint8Array> {
  const advertised = res.headers?.get?.('content-length');
  if (advertised !== null && advertised !== undefined) {
    const len = parseInt(advertised, 10);
    if (!Number.isNaN(len) && len > maxBytes) {
      throw new Error(`Package Content-Length ${len} exceeds limit of ${maxBytes} bytes`);
    }
  }

  if (!res.body || typeof res.body.getReader !== 'function') {
    if (typeof res.arrayBuffer === 'function') {
      const buf = await res.arrayBuffer();
      if (buf.byteLength > maxBytes) {
        throw new Error(`Package response body exceeded limit of ${maxBytes} bytes`);
      }
      return new Uint8Array(buf);
    }
    throw new Error('Response body is null');
  }

  const reader = res.body.getReader();
  const chunks: Uint8Array[] = [];
  let totalBytes = 0;

  try {
    while (true) {
      const { done, value } = await reader.read();
      if (done) break;
      if (value) {
        totalBytes += value.byteLength;
        if (totalBytes > maxBytes) {
          await reader.cancel();
          throw new Error(`Package response body exceeded limit of ${maxBytes} bytes while streaming`);
        }
        chunks.push(value);
      }
    }
  } finally {
    reader.releaseLock?.();
  }

  const merged = new Uint8Array(totalBytes);
  let offset = 0;
  for (const chunk of chunks) {
    merged.set(chunk, offset);
    offset += chunk.byteLength;
  }
  return merged;
}

/**
 * Bounds on dependency resolution. Depth 4 covers the chains real documents
 * produce (class -> package -> driver .def -> font .cfg); the file cap stops a
 * pathological preamble from issuing hundreds of requests before the first
 * pass even starts. A file missed by the prefetch is not an error — kpathsea
 * still resolves it at compile time, just more slowly.
 */
const MAX_DEPENDENCY_DEPTH = 4;
export const MAX_PRELOADED_FILES = 160;

/**
 * Long enough that a cold CDN edge is not mistaken for a missing file.
 */
const PACKAGE_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000;

const packageMemoryCache = new Map<string, Uint8Array>();
const failedFetchCache = new Set<string>();
const inFlightFetches = new Map<string, Promise<LoadedPackage | null>>();
let loadPromise: Promise<LoadedPackage[]> | null = null;
let dbPromise: Promise<IDBDatabase | null> | null = null;

export function _resetPackageCachesForTesting(): void {
  packageMemoryCache.clear();
  failedFetchCache.clear();
  inFlightFetches.clear();
  loadPromise = null;
}

function openPackagesDb(): Promise<IDBDatabase | null> {
  if (typeof indexedDB === 'undefined') return Promise.resolve(null);
  if (dbPromise) return dbPromise;

  dbPromise = new Promise((resolve) => {
    try {
      const req = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, DB_VERSION);
      req.onupgradeneeded = (ev) => {
        const db = (ev.target as IDBOpenDBRequest).result;
        if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE_PACKAGES)) {
          db.createObjectStore(STORE_PACKAGES, { keyPath: 'key' });
        }
        if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE_MISSES)) {
          db.createObjectStore(STORE_MISSES, { keyPath: 'key' });
        }
      };
      req.onsuccess = (ev) => resolve((ev.target as IDBOpenDBRequest).result);
      req.onerror = () => resolve(null);
    } catch {
      resolve(null);
    }
  });

  return dbPromise;
}

async function getAllFromIndexedDb(): Promise<LoadedPackage[]> {
  const db = await openPackagesDb();
  if (!db) return [];

  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    try {
      const tx = db.transaction(STORE_PACKAGES, 'readonly');
      const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_PACKAGES);
      const req = store.getAll();
      req.onsuccess = () => {
        const rows = (req.result || []) as Array<{ name: string; format: number; content: Uint8Array }>;
        const valid: LoadedPackage[] = [];
        for (const r of rows) {
          const bytes = r.content instanceof Uint8Array ? r.content : new Uint8Array(r.content);
          // Skip empty, oversized (> 8 MiB), or HTML-like cache entries
          if (bytes.length === 0 || bytes.length > MAX_PACKAGE_SIZE || isHtmlResponse(bytes)) {
            continue;
          }
          valid.push({
            name: r.name,
            format: r.format,
            content: bytes,
            contents: bytes,
          });
        }
        resolve(valid);
      };
      req.onerror = () => resolve([]);
    } catch {
      resolve([]);
    }
  });
}

export async function saveBatchToIndexedDb(pkgs: LoadedPackage[]): Promise<void> {
  if (pkgs.length === 0) return;
  const db = await openPackagesDb();
  if (!db) return;

  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    try {
      const tx = (db as any).transaction(
        STORE_PACKAGES,
        'readwrite',
        { durability: 'relaxed' },
      );
      const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_PACKAGES);
      for (const pkg of pkgs) {
        store.put({
          key: `${pkg.format}/${pkg.name}`,
          name: pkg.name,
          format: pkg.format,
          content: pkg.content,
        });
      }
      tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
      tx.onerror = () => resolve();
    } catch {
      try {
        const tx = db.transaction(STORE_PACKAGES, 'readwrite');
        const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_PACKAGES);
        for (const pkg of pkgs) {
          store.put({
            key: `${pkg.format}/${pkg.name}`,
            name: pkg.name,
            format: pkg.format,
            content: pkg.content,
          });
        }
        tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
        tx.onerror = () => resolve();
      } catch {
        resolve();
      }
    }
  });
}

export function saveToIndexedDb(pkg: LoadedPackage): void {
  void saveBatchToIndexedDb([pkg]);
}

export async function getCachedMisses(): Promise<string[]> {
  const db = await openPackagesDb();
  if (!db) return [];

  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    try {
      const tx = db.transaction(STORE_MISSES, 'readonly');
      const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_MISSES);
      const req = store.getAll();
      req.onsuccess = () => {
        const rows = (req.result || []) as Array<{ key: string }>;
        resolve(rows.map((r) => r.key));
      };
      req.onerror = () => resolve([]);
    } catch {
      resolve([]);
    }
  });
}

export async function fetchPackageThrottled(
  items: BundledPackageDef[],
  concurrency = 16,
  onLoaded: (pkg: LoadedPackage) => void,
): Promise<LoadedPackage[]> {
  const queue = [...items];
  const loadedList: LoadedPackage[] = [];

  const workers = Array.from({ length: Math.min(concurrency, queue.length) }, async () => {
    while (queue.length > 0) {
      const pkg = queue.shift();
      if (!pkg) break;
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`/packages/${encodeURIComponent(pkg.name)}`);
        if (res.ok) {
          const buf = await readResponseLimited(res, MAX_PACKAGE_SIZE);
          const ct = res.headers?.get?.('content-type');
          if (buf.length > 0 && !isHtmlResponse(buf, ct)) {
            const loaded: LoadedPackage = {
              name: pkg.name,
              format: pkg.format,
              content: buf,
              contents: buf,
            };
            loadedList.push(loaded);
            onLoaded(loaded);
          }
        }
      } catch {
        // Network error: leave retryable
      }
    }
  });

  await Promise.all(workers);
  return loadedList;
}

export async function getBundledPackages(): Promise<LoadedPackage[]> {
  if (packageMemoryCache.size >= BUNDLED_PACKAGES.length && loadPromise) {
    return loadPromise;
  }

  if (loadPromise) return loadPromise;

  loadPromise = (async () => {
    const resultsMap = new Map<string, LoadedPackage>();

    const stored = await getAllFromIndexedDb();
    for (const item of stored) {
      resultsMap.set(item.name, item);
      packageMemoryCache.set(item.name, item.content);
    }

    const missingCore = BUNDLED_PACKAGES.filter((p) => !resultsMap.has(p.name));
    if (missingCore.length > 0) {
      const newlyFetched = await fetchPackageThrottled(missingCore, 16, (loaded) => {
        resultsMap.set(loaded.name, loaded);
        packageMemoryCache.set(loaded.name, loaded.content);
      });
      if (newlyFetched.length > 0) {
        void saveBatchToIndexedDb(newlyFetched);
      }
    }

    return Array.from(resultsMap.values());
  })();

  return loadPromise;
}

export function getCachedPackageContent(name: string): Uint8Array | undefined {
  return packageMemoryCache.get(name);
}

/**
 * Extracts the files a TeX source references, so a package's own dependencies
 * can be fetched before the engine asks for them.
 */
function extractRequirements(text: string): Array<{ name: string; format: number }> {
  const out: Array<{ name: string; format: number }> = [];

  const add = (raw: string | undefined, defaultExt: string) => {
    if (!raw) return;
    for (const piece of raw.split(',')) {
      const name = piece.trim();
      if (!name || name.length > 64) continue;
      // Anything with a control sequence or brace is a macro, not a filename.
      if (/[\\{}$#%\s]/.test(name)) continue;
      out.push({
        name: /\.[a-z0-9]+$/i.test(name) ? name : `${name}${defaultExt}`,
        format: 26,
      });
    }
  };

  for (const m of text.matchAll(
    /\\(?:usepackage|RequirePackage(?:WithOptions)?)\s*(?:\[[^\]]*\])?\s*\{([^}]+)\}/g,
  )) {
    add(m[1], '.sty');
  }

  for (const m of text.matchAll(
    /\\(?:documentclass|LoadClass(?:WithOptions)?)\s*(?:\[[^\]]*\])?\s*\{([^}]+)\}/g,
  )) {
    add(m[1], '.cls');
  }

  for (const m of text.matchAll(
    /\\(?:input|InputIfFileExists|file_input:n|file_input:N)\s*\{([^}]+)\}/g,
  )) {
    add(m[1], '.tex');
  }

  for (const m of text.matchAll(/\\bibliographystyle\s*\{([^}]+)\}/g)) {
    const style = m[1]?.trim();
    if (style && !style.includes('\\')) {
      out.push({
        name: style.endsWith('.bst') ? style : `${style}.bst`,
        format: 26,
      });
    }
  }

  if (text.includes('IEEEtran') || text.includes('times') || text.includes('newtx') || text.includes('acmart')) {
    const timesMetrics = [
      'ot1ptm.fd', 't1ptm.fd', 'omlptm.fd', 'omsptm.fd',
      'ptmr7t.tfm', 'ptmb7t.tfm', 'ptmri7t.tfm', 'ptmro7t.tfm', 'ptmrc7t.tfm',
      'phvr7t.tfm', 'pcrr7t.tfm',
    ];
    for (const name of timesMetrics) {
      out.push({ name, format: name.endsWith('.tfm') ? 51 : 26 });
    }
  }

  if (text.includes('amssymb') || text.includes('amsfonts')) {
    const amsMetrics = [
      'msam10.tfm', 'msbm10.tfm', 'msam7.tfm', 'msbm7.tfm', 'msam5.tfm', 'msbm5.tfm',
    ];
    for (const name of amsMetrics) {
      out.push({ name, format: 51 });
    }
  }

  if (text.includes('sn-jnl') || text.includes('sn-basic')) {
    out.push({ name: 'sn-jnl.cls', format: 26 });
    out.push({ name: 'sn-basic.bst', format: 26 });
  }

  return out;
}

/**
 * Fetches a single package with in-flight deduplication.
 * Reuses the pending fetch promise if another caller is concurrently requesting the same package.
 */
async function fetchSinglePackage(
  target: { name: string; format: number },
  endpoint: string,
): Promise<LoadedPackage | null> {
  const key = `${target.format}/${target.name}`;
  const inFlight = inFlightFetches.get(key);
  if (inFlight) {
    return inFlight;
  }

  const fetchPromise = (async (): Promise<LoadedPackage | null> => {
    try {
      const isBundled = BUNDLED_PACKAGE_NAMES.has(target.name);
      const url = isBundled
        ? `/packages/${encodeURIComponent(target.name)}`
        : `${endpoint}/${target.format}/${encodeURIComponent(target.name)}`;

      const res = await fetch(url, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(PACKAGE_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS) });

      if (res.ok) {
        const buf = await readResponseLimited(res, MAX_PACKAGE_SIZE);
        const ct = res.headers?.get?.('content-type');
        if (buf.length > 0 && !isHtmlResponse(buf, ct)) {
          const loaded: LoadedPackage = {
            name: target.name,
            format: target.format,
            content: buf,
            contents: buf,
          };
          packageMemoryCache.set(target.name, buf);
          return loaded;
        }
      }

      // Only a definitive 404 is remembered as missing.
      // Transient 5xx errors or network drops remain retryable.
      if (res.status === 404) {
        failedFetchCache.add(target.name);
      }
      return null;
    } catch {
      // Network error, timeout, or streaming size limit: remain retryable!
      return null;
    }
  })();

  inFlightFetches.set(key, fetchPromise);
  try {
    return await fetchPromise;
  } finally {
    inFlightFetches.delete(key);
  }
}

/** Fetches one batch of files with bounded concurrency (8 workers) and deduplication. */
async function resolveBatch(
  targets: Array<{ name: string; format: number }>,
  endpoint: string,
): Promise<LoadedPackage[]> {
  const resolved: LoadedPackage[] = [];
  const newlyFetched: LoadedPackage[] = [];

  const needed: Array<{ name: string; format: number }> = [];

  for (const target of targets) {
    const cached = packageMemoryCache.get(target.name);
    if (cached) {
      resolved.push({
        name: target.name,
        format: target.format,
        content: cached,
        contents: cached,
      });
    } else {
      needed.push(target);
    }
  }

  if (needed.length > 0) {
    let index = 0;
    const workers = Array.from(
      { length: Math.min(RESOLVE_CONCURRENCY, needed.length) },
      async () => {
        while (index < needed.length) {
          const target = needed[index++];
          if (!target) break;

          const loaded = await fetchSinglePackage(target, endpoint);
          if (loaded) {
            newlyFetched.push(loaded);
            resolved.push(loaded);
          }
        }
      },
    );

    await Promise.all(workers);
  }

  if (newlyFetched.length > 0) {
    void saveBatchToIndexedDb(newlyFetched);
  }

  return resolved;
}

export async function preloadDocumentPackages(
  texContent: string,
  remoteEndpointUrl?: string,
): Promise<LoadedPackage[]> {
  if (!texContent || typeof texContent !== 'string') return [];

  const endpoint =
    remoteEndpointUrl ||
    (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.location?.origin
      ? `${window.location.origin}/api/texlive`
      : 'https://texlive2026.texlyre.org');

  const resolvedByName = new Map<string, LoadedPackage>();
  const seen = new Set<string>();

  const skip = (name: string): boolean =>
    seen.has(name) ||
    TEXLIVE_BASIC_PACKAGES.has(name.toLowerCase()) ||
    failedFetchCache.has(name);

  let frontier = extractRequirements(texContent).filter((t) => {
    if (skip(t.name)) return false;
    seen.add(t.name);
    return true;
  });

  // Cap initial frontier to MAX_PRELOADED_FILES
  if (frontier.length > MAX_PRELOADED_FILES) {
    frontier = frontier.slice(0, MAX_PRELOADED_FILES);
  }

  const decoder = new TextDecoder('utf-8', { fatal: false });
  const db = await openPackagesDb();

  for (let depth = 0; depth < MAX_DEPENDENCY_DEPTH && frontier.length > 0; depth++) {
    const remainingBudget = MAX_PRELOADED_FILES - resolvedByName.size;
    if (remainingBudget <= 0) break;

    // Enforce budget on each depth frontier
    if (frontier.length > remainingBudget) {
      frontier = frontier.slice(0, remainingBudget);
    }

    // Check IndexedDB for the whole level before touching the network.
    if (db) {
      await Promise.all(
        frontier
          .filter((t) => !packageMemoryCache.has(t.name))
          .map(
            (target) =>
              new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
                try {
                  const req = db
                    .transaction(STORE_PACKAGES, 'readonly')
                    .objectStore(STORE_PACKAGES)
                    .get(`${target.format}/${target.name}`);
                  req.onsuccess = () => {
                    const stored = req.result?.content;
                    if (stored) {
                      const buf =
                        stored instanceof Uint8Array ? stored : new Uint8Array(stored);
                      if (buf.length > 0 && buf.length <= MAX_PACKAGE_SIZE && !isHtmlResponse(buf)) {
                        packageMemoryCache.set(target.name, buf);
                      }
                    }
                    resolve();
                  };
                  req.onerror = () => resolve();
                } catch {
                  resolve();
                }
              }),
          ),
      );
    }

    const batch = await resolveBatch(frontier, endpoint);

    const next = new Map<string, { name: string; format: number }>();
    for (const file of batch) {
      resolvedByName.set(file.name, file);

      if (resolvedByName.size >= MAX_PRELOADED_FILES) break;

      if (!/\.(sty|cls|def|cfg|tex|clo|fd)$/i.test(file.name)) continue;

      for (const req of extractRequirements(decoder.decode(file.content))) {
        if (skip(req.name) || next.has(req.name)) continue;
        seen.add(req.name);
        next.set(req.name, req);
      }
    }

    frontier = Array.from(next.values());
  }

  return Array.from(resolvedByName.values());
}

      const targetEl = event.target as HTMLElement | null;
      if (targetEl && targetEl.closest('.pdf-link-annotation')) return;

      // Distinguish clean click from text drag-selection
      const moved = mouseDownPosRef.current
        ? Math.hypot(event.clientX - mouseDownPosRef.current.x, event.clientY - mouseDownPosRef.current.y)
        : 0;
      const hasSelection = typeof window !== 'undefined' && Boolean(window.getSelection()?.toString().trim());

      // If user dragged to highlight text, allow text selection and don't jump unless modifier is pressed
      if ((moved > 6 || hasSelection) && !event.ctrlKey && !event.metaKey) {
        return;
      }

      handleSyncJump(event);
    },
    [handleSyncJump],
  );

  const handleDoubleClick = useCallback(
    (event: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
      const targetEl = event.target as HTMLElement | null;
      if (targetEl && targetEl.closest('.pdf-link-annotation')) return;
      handleSyncJump(event);
    },
    [handleSyncJump],
  );

  return (
    <div
      className={`pdf-page${painted ? ' is-painted' : ''}`}
      data-page={geometry.pageNumber}
      style={{ width, height }}
      onMouseDown={handleMouseDown}
      onClick={handleClick}
      onDoubleClick={handleDoubleClick}
      title="Click or double-click to jump to corresponding LaTeX source line (drag to select text)"
    >
      {active && (
        <canvas
          ref={canvasRef}
          className="pdf-page-canvas"
          style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%' }}
          aria-hidden
        />
      )}
      {!painted && (
        <div className="pdf-page-placeholder pdf-shimmer" aria-hidden>
          <Loader2 size={16} className="spin" style={{ color: '#38bdf8', marginBottom: 6 }} />
          <span>Rendering Page {geometry.pageNumber}...</span>
        </div>
      )}
      <div ref={textRef} className="pdf-text-layer" />
      {links.length > 0 && (
        <div
          className="pdf-annotation-layer"
          aria-label={`Page ${geometry.pageNumber} links`}
        >
          {links.map((link) => {
            const [left, top, width, height] = link.rect;
            if (link.url) {
              const safe = isSafeUrl(link.url);
              return (
                <a
                  key={link.id}
                  className={`pdf-link-annotation${safe ? '' : ' is-unsafe'}`}
                  href={safe ? link.url : undefined}
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noopener noreferrer"
                  title={link.title || link.url}
                  aria-label={link.title || link.url}
                  style={{ left, top, width, height }}
                  onClick={safe ? undefined : (e) => e.preventDefault()}
                />
              );
            }
            if (link.dest) {
              return (
                <a
                  key={link.id}
                  className="pdf-link-annotation pdf-link-internal"
                  href={`#dest-${link.id}`}
                  title={link.title || 'Jump to cross-reference'}
                  aria-label={link.title || 'Jump to cross-reference'}
                  style={{ left, top, width, height }}
                  onClick={(e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    if (link.dest) onInternalNavigate?.(link.dest);
                  }}
                />
              );
            }
            return null;
          })}
        </div>
      )}
      {highlights.length > 0 && (
        <div className="pdf-highlight-layer" aria-hidden>
          {highlights.map((rect, index) => (
            <div
              key={`${rect.x}-${rect.y}-${index}-${highlightNonce ?? 0}`}
              className="pdf-highlight"
              style={{
                left: rect.x * CSS_PX_PER_PT * displayZoom,
                top: rect.y * CSS_PX_PER_PT * displayZoom,
                width: Math.max(4, rect.width * CSS_PX_PER_PT * displayZoom),
                height: Math.max(4, rect.height * CSS_PX_PER_PT * displayZoom),
              }}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
      {clickRipples.map((ripple) => (
        <div
          key={ripple.id}
          className="pdf-sync-ripple"
          style={{ left: ripple.x, top: ripple.y }}
          aria-hidden
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

export function PdfPreviewPane({
  pdf,
  status,
  isCompiling,
  isDebouncing = false,
  durationMs,
  isStale,
  errorSummary,
  documentTitle,
  onCompile,
  syncTexIndex,
  forwardTarget,
  onInverseSync,
}: Props) {
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const [doc, setDoc] = useState<PdfDocument | null>(null);
  const docRef = useRef<PdfDocument | null>(null);
  const [geometry, setGeometry] = useState<PageGeometry[]>([]);
  const [openError, setOpenError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [zoomMode, setZoomMode] = useState<ZoomMode>('fit-width');
  const [zoom, setZoom] = useState(1);
  const [rasterZoom, setRasterZoom] = useState(1);
  const [containerWidth, setContainerWidth] = useState(0);
  const [containerHeight, setContainerHeight] = useState(0);

  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const [activePages, setActivePages] = useState<Set<number>>(() => new Set([1, 2, 3]));
  const [elapsedCompileSec, setElapsedCompileSec] = useState(0);

  const [isFindOpen, setIsFindOpen] = useState(false);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [searchResults, setSearchResults] = useState<PdfSearchResult[]>([]);
  const [currentResultIndex, setCurrentResultIndex] = useState(0);
  const [isSearching, setIsSearching] = useState(false);
  const findInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [pageInputValue, setPageInputValue] = useState(String(currentPage));

  useEffect(() => {
    setPageInputValue(String(currentPage));
  }, [currentPage]);

  const anchorRef = useRef<{ page: number; offset: number } | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isCompiling) {
      setElapsedCompileSec(0);
      return;
    }
    const start = performance.now();
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      setElapsedCompileSec(Number(((performance.now() - start) / 1000).toFixed(1)));
    }, 100);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [isCompiling]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      setRasterZoom(zoom);
    }, 150);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [zoom]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!pdf || pdf.byteLength === 0) {
      setDoc(null);
      setGeometry([]);
      return;
    }
    let cancelled = false;
    let opened: PdfDocument | null = null;

    void (async () => {
      try {
        opened = await PdfDocument.open(pdf);
        opened.setOnGeometryUpdate((updatedPages) => {
          if (!cancelled) setGeometry(updatedPages);
        });
        const pages = await opened.geometry();
        if (cancelled) {
          void opened.destroy();
          return;
        }

        const container = scrollRef.current;
        if (container && geometry.length > 0) {
          const pageTop = pageOffsets(geometry, zoom)[currentPage - 1] ?? 0;
          anchorRef.current = {
            page: currentPage,
            offset: container.scrollTop - pageTop,
          };
        }

        setOpenError(null);
        setGeometry(pages);
        setDoc((previous) => {
          if (previous) void previous.destroy();
          return opened;
        });
        docRef.current = opened;
      } catch (error) {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setOpenError(
          error instanceof Error
            ? error.message
            : 'The compiled PDF could not be opened.',
        );
      }
    })();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [pdf]);

  useEffect(
    () => () => {
      const open = docRef.current;
      docRef.current = null;
      if (open) void open.destroy();
    },
    [],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    const container = scrollRef.current;
    if (!container) return;

    const observer = new ResizeObserver(([entry]) => {
      setContainerWidth(entry.contentRect.width);
      setContainerHeight(entry.contentRect.height);
    });
    observer.observe(container);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);

  const widest = useMemo(
    () => geometry.reduce((max, page) => Math.max(max, page.width), 0),
    [geometry],
  );
  const tallest = useMemo(
    () => geometry.reduce((max, page) => Math.max(max, page.height), 0),
    [geometry],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (zoomMode === 'custom' || widest === 0 || containerWidth === 0) return;
    const available = containerWidth - 48;
    const next =
      zoomMode === 'fit-width'
        ? available / widest
        : Math.min(available / widest, (containerHeight - 48) / tallest);
    const clamped = clampZoom(next);
    setZoom(clamped);
    setRasterZoom(clamped);
  }, [zoomMode, widest, tallest, containerWidth, containerHeight]);

  const setCustomZoom = useCallback((value: number) => {
    setZoomMode('custom');
    setZoom(clampZoom(value));
  }, []);

  const stepZoom = useCallback(
    (direction: 1 | -1) => {
      const index = ZOOM_STEPS.findIndex((step) => step > zoom + 1e-6);
      const next =
        direction === 1
          ? ZOOM_STEPS[index === -1 ? ZOOM_STEPS.length - 1 : index]
          : ZOOM_STEPS[Math.max(0, (index === -1 ? ZOOM_STEPS.length : index) - 1)];
      setCustomZoom(next);
    },
    [zoom, setCustomZoom],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    const container = scrollRef.current;
    if (!container) return;

    const onWheel = (event: WheelEvent) => {
      if (!event.ctrlKey && !event.metaKey) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      setCustomZoom(zoom * (event.deltaY < 0 ? 1.08 : 1 / 1.08));
    };

    container.addEventListener('wheel', onWheel, { passive: false });
    return () => container.removeEventListener('wheel', onWheel);
  }, [zoom, setCustomZoom]);

  const offsets = useMemo(() => pageOffsets(geometry, zoom), [geometry, zoom]);

  const recomputeVisible = useCallback(() => {
    const container = scrollRef.current;
    if (!container || geometry.length === 0) return;

    const top = container.scrollTop;
    const viewH = Math.max(container.clientHeight, 800);
    const bottom = top + viewH;
    const margin = viewH * OVERSCAN;

    const next = new Set<number>();
    let firstVisible = 1;

    for (let index = 0; index < geometry.length; index++) {
      const pageTop = offsets[index];
      const pageBottom = pageTop + geometry[index].height * zoom;

      if (pageBottom >= top - margin && pageTop <= bottom + margin) {
        next.add(geometry[index].pageNumber);
      }
      if (pageTop <= top + 60) firstVisible = geometry[index].pageNumber;
    }

    setActivePages((previous) => (sameSet(previous, next) ? previous : next));
    setCurrentPage((prev) => (prev !== firstVisible ? firstVisible : prev));
  }, [geometry, offsets, zoom]);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    recomputeVisible();
  }, [recomputeVisible]);

  const scrollRafRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const onScroll = useCallback(() => {
    if (scrollRafRef.current !== null) return;
    scrollRafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      scrollRafRef.current = null;
      recomputeVisible();
    });
  }, [recomputeVisible]);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (scrollRafRef.current !== null) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(scrollRafRef.current);
      }
    };
  }, []);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const anchor = anchorRef.current;
    const container = scrollRef.current;
    if (!anchor || !container || offsets.length === 0) return;
    anchorRef.current = null;

    const index = Math.min(anchor.page, offsets.length) - 1;
    container.scrollTop = Math.max(0, offsets[index] + anchor.offset);
    recomputeVisible();
  }, [offsets, recomputeVisible]);

  const pendingScrollRef = useRef<{ page: number; yPt?: number; isFromBottomOrigin?: boolean } | null>(null);

  const scrollToPage = useCallback(
    (pageNumber: number, yPt?: number, isFromBottomOrigin = false) => {
      const container = scrollRef.current;
      if (!container || offsets.length === 0) {
        pendingScrollRef.current = { page: pageNumber, yPt, isFromBottomOrigin };
        return;
      }
      pendingScrollRef.current = null;
      const index = Math.min(Math.max(pageNumber, 1), offsets.length) - 1;
      const baseTop = offsets[index] ?? 0;
      let targetTop = baseTop;

      if (typeof yPt === 'number' && geometry[index]) {
        let offsetFromPageTop = 0;
        if (isFromBottomOrigin) {
          // Native PDF point space (origin at bottom-left) to CSS pixel space (origin at top-left)
          const pageHeightPt = geometry[index].height / CSS_PX_PER_PT;
          offsetFromPageTop = Math.max(0, (pageHeightPt - yPt) * CSS_PX_PER_PT * zoom);
        } else {
          // SyncTeX point space (origin at top-left of page)
          offsetFromPageTop = Math.max(0, yPt * CSS_PX_PER_PT * zoom);
        }
        const viewportHeight = container.clientHeight;
        targetTop = Math.max(0, baseTop + offsetFromPageTop - viewportHeight / 2);
      }

      container.scrollTo({
        top: Math.max(0, targetTop),
        behavior: prefersReducedMotion() ? 'auto' : 'smooth',
      });
    },
    [offsets, geometry, zoom],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (pendingScrollRef.current && offsets.length > 0) {
      const { page, yPt, isFromBottomOrigin } = pendingScrollRef.current;
      pendingScrollRef.current = null;
      scrollToPage(page, yPt, isFromBottomOrigin);
    }
  }, [offsets, scrollToPage]);

  const handleInternalNavigate = useCallback(
    async (dest: string | unknown[]) => {
      if (!doc) return;
      const target = await doc.resolveDestination(dest);
      if (target) {
        scrollToPage(target.pageNumber, target.yPt, true);
      }
    },
    [doc, scrollToPage],
  );

  const handlePageInputSubmit = useCallback(() => {
    const p = parseInt(pageInputValue, 10);
    if (!isNaN(p) && p >= 1 && p <= geometry.length) {
      scrollToPage(p);
    } else {
      setPageInputValue(String(currentPage));
    }
  }, [pageInputValue, geometry.length, scrollToPage, currentPage]);

  const navigateMatch = useCallback(
    (direction: 1 | -1) => {
      if (searchResults.length === 0) return;
      const nextIdx = (currentResultIndex + direction + searchResults.length) % searchResults.length;
      setCurrentResultIndex(nextIdx);
      const match = searchResults[nextIdx];
      scrollToPage(match.pageNumber, match.yPt, true);
    },
    [searchResults, currentResultIndex, scrollToPage],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!doc || !searchQuery.trim()) {
      setSearchResults([]);
      setCurrentResultIndex(0);
      setIsSearching(false);
      return;
    }
    let cancelled = false;
    setIsSearching(true);
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      doc
        .findText(searchQuery)
        .then((results) => {
          if (cancelled) return;
          setSearchResults(results);
          setCurrentResultIndex(0);
          setIsSearching(false);
          if (results.length > 0) {
            scrollToPage(results[0].pageNumber, results[0].yPt, true);
          }
        })
        .catch(() => {
          if (!cancelled) {
            setSearchResults([]);
            setIsSearching(false);
          }
        });
    }, 200);

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      clearTimeout(timer);
    };
  }, [doc, searchQuery, scrollToPage]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isFindOpen) {
      findInputRef.current?.focus();
      findInputRef.current?.select();
    }
  }, [isFindOpen]);

  const highlightsByPage = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<number, { rects: ForwardMatch['rects']; nonce?: number }>();
    if (forwardTarget) map.set(forwardTarget.page, { rects: forwardTarget.rects, nonce: forwardTarget.nonce });
    return map;
  }, [forwardTarget]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (forwardTarget) {
      const firstRect = forwardTarget.rects?.[0];
      scrollToPage(forwardTarget.page, firstRect?.y, false);
    }
  }, [forwardTarget, scrollToPage]);

  const handlePointerSync = useCallback(
    (pageNumber: number, xPt: number, yPt: number) => {
      if (!onInverseSync) return;
      if (!syncTexIndex) {
        onCompile();
        return;
      }
      const match = inverseSync(syncTexIndex, pageNumber, xPt, yPt);
      if (match) onInverseSync(match.file, match.line);
    },
    [syncTexIndex, onInverseSync, onCompile],
  );

  const onKeyDown = useCallback(
    (event: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
      if (event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) {
        if (event.key === '=' || event.key === '+') {
          event.preventDefault();
          stepZoom(1);
          return;
        }
        if (event.key === '-') {
          event.preventDefault();
          stepZoom(-1);
          return;
        }
        if (event.key === '0') {
          event.preventDefault();
          setZoomMode('fit-width');
          return;
        }
        if (event.key.toLowerCase() === 'f') {
          event.preventDefault();
          setIsFindOpen(true);
          return;
        }
        return;
      }

      if (event.key === 'PageDown' || event.key === 'n') {
        event.preventDefault();
        scrollToPage(currentPage + 1);
      } else if (event.key === 'PageUp' || event.key === 'p') {
        event.preventDefault();
        scrollToPage(currentPage - 1);
      } else if (event.key === 'Home') {
        event.preventDefault();
        scrollToPage(1);
      } else if (event.key === 'End') {
        event.preventDefault();
        scrollToPage(geometry.length);
      }
    },
    [currentPage, geometry.length, scrollToPage, stepZoom],
  );

  const hasDocument = Boolean(doc) && geometry.length > 0;

  const previewState: PreviewState = useMemo(() => {
    if (status.phase === 'failed') {
      return { type: 'failed', error: status.error || 'The TeX engine could not start' };
    }
    if (isCompiling) {
      return { type: 'compiling', elapsedSec: elapsedCompileSec };
    }
    if (!hasDocument) {
      return { type: 'failed', error: errorSummary || 'No PDF generated yet' };
    }
    if (isStale) {
      return { type: 'stale', reason: 'compile_error', errorSummary };
    }
    if (isDebouncing) {
      return { type: 'stale', reason: 'typing' };
    }
    return { type: 'current', durationMs: durationMs ?? null };
  }, [
    status,
    isCompiling,
    elapsedCompileSec,
    hasDocument,
    isStale,
    isDebouncing,
    errorSummary,
    durationMs,
  ]);

  const totalHeight = useMemo(() => {
    if (geometry.length === 0) return 0;
    const lastIdx = geometry.length - 1;
    return (offsets[lastIdx] ?? 0) + geometry[lastIdx].height * zoom;
  }, [geometry, offsets, zoom]);

  const handleDownload = useCallback(() => {
    if (!pdf) return;
    try {
      downloadPdf(pdf, documentTitle);
    } catch (error) {
      setOpenError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
    }
  }, [pdf, documentTitle]);

  return (
    <div className="pdf-pane" data-preview-state={previewState.type}>
      <div className="pdf-toolbar">
        <div className="pdf-toolbar-group">
          <button
            type="button"
            className="btn-icon"
            onClick={() => scrollToPage(currentPage - 1)}
            disabled={!hasDocument || currentPage <= 1}
            aria-label="Previous page"
          >
            <ChevronLeft size={14} />
          </button>
          <div className="pdf-page-jumper">
            <input
              type="number"
              min={1}
              max={geometry.length || 1}
              value={pageInputValue}
              onChange={(e) => setPageInputValue(e.target.value)}
              onKeyDown={(e) => {
                if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                  e.currentTarget.blur();
                  handlePageInputSubmit();
                }
              }}
              onBlur={handlePageInputSubmit}
              disabled={!hasDocument}
              className="pdf-page-input"
              aria-label="Current page number"
            />
            <span className="pdf-page-total">/ {geometry.length > 0 ? geometry.length : '—'}</span>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="btn-icon"
            onClick={() => scrollToPage(currentPage + 1)}
            disabled={!hasDocument || currentPage >= geometry.length}
            aria-label="Next page"
          >
            <ChevronRight size={14} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="pdf-toolbar-status" role="status" aria-live="polite">
          {previewState.type === 'compiling' && (
            <span
              className="pdf-status pdf-status-compiling pdf-status-busy"
              title="Typesetting document with pdfLaTeX"
            >
              <Loader2 size={12} className="spin" />
              <span>Typesetting · {previewState.elapsedSec.toFixed(1)}s</span>
            </span>
          )}

          {previewState.type === 'current' && (
            <span
              className="pdf-status pdf-status-current"
              title={`Document up to date · compiled with ${ENGINE_LABELS[status.engine] ?? status.engine} in ${previewState.durationMs ?? 0}ms`}
            >
              <Sparkles size={11} style={{ marginRight: 4 }} />
              Up to date
              {previewState.durationMs !== null
                ? ` · ${previewState.durationMs < 1000 ? `${previewState.durationMs}ms` : `${(previewState.durationMs / 1000).toFixed(1)}s`}`
                : ''}
            </span>
          )}

          {previewState.type === 'stale' && previewState.reason === 'typing' && (
            <span
              className="pdf-status pdf-status-stale"
              title="Live sync queued — pausing for typing"
            >
              <span className="pulse-dot" />
              Changes pending · Live compile queued
            </span>
          )}

          {previewState.type === 'stale' && previewState.reason === 'compile_error' && (
            <span
              className="pdf-status pdf-status-stale"
              title={
                previewState.errorSummary ||
                'Last compile failed — showing previous successful build'
              }
            >
              <AlertTriangle size={12} />
              Showing last build · changes pending
            </span>
          )}

          {previewState.type === 'failed' && (
            <span className="pdf-status pdf-status-failed" title={previewState.error}>
              <AlertTriangle size={12} />
              Build failed
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="pdf-toolbar-group">
          <button
            type="button"
            className="btn-icon"
            onClick={() => stepZoom(-1)}
            aria-label="Zoom out"
          >
            <Minus size={14} />
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="pdf-zoom-readout"
            onClick={() => setZoomMode(zoomMode === 'fit-width' ? 'fit-page' : 'fit-width')}
            title={zoomMode === 'fit-width' ? 'Fit page' : 'Fit width'}
          >
            {Math.round(zoom * 100)}%
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="btn-icon"
            onClick={() => stepZoom(1)}
            aria-label="Zoom in"
          >
            <Plus size={14} />
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            className={`btn-icon ${isFindOpen ? 'active' : ''}`}
            onClick={() => setIsFindOpen((prev) => !prev)}
            title="Find in document (Ctrl+F)"
            aria-label="Find in document"
            disabled={!hasDocument}
          >
            <Search size={14} />
          </button>

          <div className="pdf-toolbar-divider" />

          <button
            type="button"
            className="btn-icon"
            onClick={onCompile}
            disabled={isCompiling}
            aria-label="Recompile"
            title="Recompile (Ctrl+Enter)"
          >
            <RefreshCw size={14} className={isCompiling ? 'spin' : undefined} />
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="btn-primary-sm"
            onClick={handleDownload}
            disabled={!pdf}
            title="Download the compiled PDF"
          >
            <Download size={13} />
            PDF
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {isFindOpen && hasDocument && (
        <div className="pdf-find-bar" role="search">
          <div className="pdf-find-input-wrap">
            <Search size={13} style={{ color: 'var(--text-tertiary)' }} />
            <input
              ref={findInputRef}
              type="text"
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              onKeyDown={(e) => {
                if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  navigateMatch(e.shiftKey ? -1 : 1);
                } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  setIsFindOpen(false);
                }
              }}
              placeholder="Find in document..."
              className="pdf-find-input"
              aria-label="Search text"
            />
            {searchQuery && (
              <span className="pdf-find-count" aria-live="polite">
                {isSearching
                  ? 'Searching...'
                  : searchResults.length > 0
                    ? `${currentResultIndex + 1} of ${searchResults.length}`
                    : 'No matches'}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="pdf-find-actions">
            <button
              type="button"
              className="btn-icon"
              onClick={() => navigateMatch(-1)}
              disabled={searchResults.length === 0}
              title="Previous match (Shift+Enter)"
              aria-label="Previous match"
            >
              <ChevronUp size={14} />
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="btn-icon"
              onClick={() => navigateMatch(1)}
              disabled={searchResults.length === 0}
              title="Next match (Enter)"
              aria-label="Next match"
            >
              <ChevronDown size={14} />
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="btn-icon"
              onClick={() => setIsFindOpen(false)}
              title="Close find (Esc)"
              aria-label="Close find"
            >
              <X size={14} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {(isCompiling || status.phase === 'fetching') && (
        <div
          className="pdf-compile-progress-bar"
          style={
            status.phase === 'fetching'
              ? {
                  width: `${Math.max(8, Math.min(100, status.progress))}%`,
                  transition: 'width 0.25s ease-out',
                }
              : undefined
          }
        />
      )}

      <div
        ref={scrollRef}
        className="pdf-scroll"
        onScroll={onScroll}
        onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
        tabIndex={0}
        role="document"
        aria-label="Compiled document preview"
      >
        {status.phase === 'failed' && (
          <EmptyState
            icon={<AlertTriangle size={22} />}
            tone="error"
            title="The TeX engine could not start"
            detail={status.error}
          />
        )}

        {openError && (
          <EmptyState
            icon={<AlertTriangle size={22} />}
            tone="error"
            title="This PDF could not be displayed"
            detail={openError}
          />
        )}

        {!hasDocument && status.phase !== 'failed' && !openError && (
          status.phase === 'fetching' ? (
            <div className="pdf-empty pdf-empty-neutral cold-start-card" role="status" aria-live="polite">
              <div className="pdf-empty-icon">
                <Loader2 size={24} className="spin" style={{ color: 'var(--accent-cyan)' }} />
              </div>
              <p className="pdf-empty-title">Initializing TeX Live 2026 WASM Engine</p>
              <div
                style={{
                  width: '100%',
                  maxWidth: 340,
                  height: 6,
                  borderRadius: 3,
                  backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-surface-2)',
                  overflow: 'hidden',
                  margin: '12px auto 8px',
                  border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)',
                }}
              >
                <div
                  style={{
                    width: `${Math.max(5, Math.min(100, status.progress))}%`,
                    height: '100%',
                    background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-cyan), var(--accent-emerald))',
                    transition: 'width 0.25s ease',
                  }}
                />
              </div>
              <p className="pdf-empty-detail" style={{ fontWeight: 500, color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                {Math.round(status.progress)}% downloaded
                {status.loadedBytes
                  ? ` · ${((status.loadedBytes) / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB of ${((status.totalBytes ?? 127694000) / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(0)} MB`
                  : ''}
                {status.speedMbps ? ` (${status.speedMbps} MB/s)` : ''}
              </p>
              <p className="pdf-empty-detail" style={{ fontSize: '11px', color: 'var(--text-muted)', marginTop: '4px' }}>
                One-time initial engine download. Permanently cached offline in browser storage.
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <EmptyState
              icon={
                isCompiling ? (
                  <Loader2 size={22} className="spin" />
                ) : (
                  <FileText size={22} />
                )
              }
              title={
                isCompiling
                  ? `Typesetting your document (${elapsedCompileSec.toFixed(1)}s)`
                  : 'No output yet'
              }
              detail={
                isCompiling
                  ? 'Pre-caching packages & typesetting vector pages...'
                  : errorSummary ??
                    'Start writing, or press Recompile to typeset the document.'
              }
            />
          )
        )}

        {hasDocument && doc && (
          <div
            className="pdf-pages-container"
            style={{
              position: 'relative',
              width: '100%',
              minWidth: widest * zoom,
              height: totalHeight,
            }}
          >
            {geometry.map((page, index) => {
              // True virtualization: only mount active pages in the window
              if (!activePages.has(page.pageNumber)) return null;

              const pageTop = offsets[index] ?? 0;
              const targetHighlight = highlightsByPage.get(page.pageNumber);
              return (
                <div
                  key={page.pageNumber}
                  className="pdf-page-wrapper"
                  style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    top: pageTop,
                    left: '50%',
                    transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
                  }}
                >
                  <PdfPageView
                    doc={doc}
                    geometry={page}
                    displayZoom={zoom}
                    rasterZoom={rasterZoom}
                    active={true}
                    highlights={targetHighlight?.rects ?? []}
                    highlightNonce={targetHighlight?.nonce}
                    onPointerSync={onInverseSync ? handlePointerSync : undefined}
                    onInternalNavigate={handleInternalNavigate}
                  />
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function EmptyState({
  icon,
  title,
  detail,
  tone = 'neutral',
}: {
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  title: string;
  detail?: string | null;
  tone?: 'neutral' | 'error';
}) {
  return (
    <div className={`pdf-empty pdf-empty-${tone}`} role={tone === 'error' ? 'alert' : undefined}>
      <div className="pdf-empty-icon">{icon}</div>
      <p className="pdf-empty-title">{title}</p>
      {detail && <p className="pdf-empty-detail">{detail}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}

function pageOffsets(geometry: PageGeometry[], zoom: number): number[] {
  const out: number[] = [];
  let y = 0;
  for (const page of geometry) {
    out.push(y);
    y += page.height * zoom + PAGE_GAP;
  }
  return out;
}

function sameSet(a: Set<number>, b: Set<number>): boolean {
  if (a.size !== b.size) return false;
  for (const value of a) if (!b.has(value)) return false;
  return true;
}
